title: Local subspace encoding for spectral prediction: from TabPFN to operator-adaptive calibration
comment: 25 pages, 10 figures (including 3 supplementary figures). Evidence bundle: https://github.com/GBeurier/nirs4all-aom/releases/tag/lvse-gcu-evidence-v1
summary: TabPFN has already shown useful predictive performance on near-infrared spectra. RamanPFN subsequently proposed two spectral representations for tabular inference: Global Compositional Unmixing (GCU) and Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding (LVSE). We assess whether these representations also help on datasets assembled through the nirs4all ecosystem, and whether their value extends to classical calibration. We reanalyse completed experiments from a public spectral dataset catalogue. On a post-hoc subset of 61 matched numerical prediction tasks, after excluding ten class-code, metadata or semantically ambiguous targets, LVSE reduces RMSE relative to raw-spectrum TabPFN by 10.22%, 12.80% and 14.52% on average for checkpoints 2.5, 3 and 3.5, respectively, with median reductions of 4.99%, 4.74% and 7.82%. Across 76 classification datasets, weighted F1 increases by 2.22, 2.56 and 3.81 percentage points. The 2.5 classification procedure uses output coding on 15 datasets exceeding the checkpoint's native class limit. GCU alone is less reliable in this implementation. LVSE also improves PLS and Ridge in many cases, with median RMSE reductions of 4.75% and 1.89%. Adding LVSE candidates to an operator-adaptive model is feasible, but a separate 35-task panel derived from the public AOM benchmark shows only small median gains. These results motivate evaluating LVSE alongside existing representation choices. They do not establish that a selector choosing between raw and LVSE inputs will improve every task.

AI.tldr: 在公共光谱数据集目录的再分析中，LVSE表示在TabPFN上平均降低RMSE约10–15%，并将加权F1提升2–4个百分点，同时也能改善PLS与Ridge；GCU在此实现中可靠性较低，AOM面板上的增益有限。
AI.motivation: RamanPFN提出的GCU与LVSE两种光谱表示尚未在nirs4all生态的数据上验证，也不清楚其对经典校正方法（如PLS、Ridge）是否有价值，因此需要系统评估其泛化性与适用边界。
AI.method: 对公开光谱数据目录中已完成的实验进行事后再分析：筛选出61个匹配的数值预测任务（剔除10个类编码、元数据或语义模糊的目标）以及76个分类数据集；在TabPFN 2.5、3、3.5检查点上比较原始光谱与LVSE/GCU表示，并在2.5上对超出原生类别上限的15个数据集使用输出编码；同时检验LVSE对PLS和Ridge的影响，以及在算子自适应模型中引入LVSE候选表示，另用AOM基准的35任务面板做补充验证。
AI.result: 相对原始光谱TabPFN，LVSE在检查点2.5/3/3.5上平均RMSE降低10.22%、12.80%、14.52%（中位数4.99%、4.74%、7.82%）；76个分类数据集加权F1提升2.22、2.56、3.81个百分点。单独使用GCU可靠性较低。LVSE还改善PLS与Ridge，中位RMSE降幅分别为4.75%和1.89%。加入LVSE候选表示在算子自适应模型中可行，但AOM面板仅显示小幅中位增益。
AI.conclusion: LVSE应作为光谱表示的可选方案与现有表示并列评估；但结果不能证明一个在原始输入与LVSE输入之间做选择的策略会在所有任务上都带来提升。

title: Actionwave: A Systematic Benchmark for Waveform-Centric Clinical Prediction Across Care Scenarios
summary: Continuous bedside waveforms record rapid physiological changes that can inform clinical decisions. Existing benchmarks examine selected prediction conditions, but it remains unclear how model advantages depend on signal duration, warning time, and available inputs across care settings. We introduce Actionwave, a benchmark for waveform-centric clinical prediction across intensive-care, operating-room, and emergency-department settings. Actionwave uses a common decision-time prediction interface and groups clinically grounded tasks by what is inferred and when. It varies conditions relevant to clinical use, including the warning required before an intervention. We compare diverse architectures and pretrained biosignal encoders under specified model-size and compute budgets. The protocol requires patient-level splits, strict information cutoffs, and comparisons that isolate individual modeling factors. Across 20 tasks and 1.4M task-labelled windows from source datasets, the experimental grids account for over 87,000 model fits. These comparisons identify task-specific choices and show why matched cohorts, unimodal controls, and explicit timing are necessary when interpreting waveform model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Actionwave，一个以波形为中心的临床预测基准，覆盖 ICU、手术室与急诊三类场景，采用统一的决策时刻预测接口，系统性考察信号时长、预警时间与可用输入对模型优势的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有基准仅在若干选定预测条件下评估模型，模型优势如何随信号时长、预警窗口和可用输入（跨护理场景）变化仍不清楚，导致波形模型的性能解读缺乏可比性与临床可迁移性。
AI.method: Actionwave 采用统一决策时刻预测接口，按"推断内容"与"推断时间"对临床有依据的任务分组；在指定模型规模与算力预算下比较多种架构与预训练生物信号编码器；协议要求患者级划分、严格信息截断，并通过隔离单一建模因素的对照实验（匹配队列、单模态对照、显式时序）进行归因。
AI.result: 在 20 项任务、来自源数据集的 140 万个任务标注窗口上进行实验，实验网格累计超过 87,000 次模型拟合；结果显示最优选择具有任务特异性，且匹配队列、单模态对照与显式时序建模是正确解读波形模型性能的必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 模型优势高度依赖于任务、信号时长与预警时间设定，跨机构性能比较必须控制队列匹配、模态与信息截断等混杂因素；Actionwave 为波形中心临床预测提供了可复现、可归因的标准化评测框架。

title: Chain-of-Thought Is Not Explainability
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Position Paper Track). 27 pages, 3 figures
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) allows language models to verbalise multi-step rationales before producing their final answer. While this technique often boosts task performance and offers an impression of transparency into the model's reasoning, this position paper argues that rationales generated by current CoT techniques can be misleading and are neither necessary nor sufficient for trustworthy interpretability. We analyse faithfulness as whether CoTs are not only human-interpretable but also reflect the model's underlying reasoning well enough to support responsible use. By synthesising evidence from prior work, we systematically show that verbalised chains are frequently unfaithful, diverging from the critical hidden computations that drive a model's predictions. As CoT is increasingly relied upon in application domains, including high-stakes ones such as medicine, law, and autonomous systems, we further argue that this unfaithfulness is not taken seriously enough in these settings: our analysis of 1,000 recent CoT-centric papers finds that approximately 21.7% explicitly treat CoT as a load-bearing interpretability technique, building pipelines or safety arguments that would not hold if CoT is unfaithful to the model's actual reasoning. They include papers in high-stakes domains that heavily hinge on such interpretability claims. Building on prior work, we make three proposals: (i) avoid treating CoT as being sufficient for interpretability without additional verification, (ii) adopt rigorous methods that assess faithfulness for downstream decision-making, and (iii) report such assessments alongside any interpretability claims based on CoT, while continuing to use CoT for its communicative and monitoring benefits.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，论证当前CoT生成的理由可能不可信（unfaithful），既非可解释性的必要条件也非充分条件；作者对1000篇近期CoT论文的分析显示约21.7%将CoT当作承重式可解释性技术，并提出三项改进建议。
AI.motivation: CoT能提升任务表现并给人"透明"的错觉，且在高风险领域（医疗、法律、自动驾驶）日益被依赖。但既有证据表明语言化的推理链常与驱动模型预测的真实隐藏计算不一致，而实践界对此重视不足，因此需要一篇立场论文系统性地厘清并纠正这一误用。
AI.method: 立场论文（position paper）。方法为两部分：一是综合既有文献，系统梳理CoT理由不可信（unfaithfulness）的证据；二是对1000篇近期以CoT为中心的论文进行人工分析/编码，统计其中明确将CoT作为承重式可解释性技术（构建若CoT不可信则不成立的流程或安全论证）的比例，并识别其涉及的高风险领域分布。作者将faithfulness定义为"不仅人类可解释，且足够反映模型底层推理以支撑负责任使用"。
AI.result: 文献综合表明，语言化的推理链经常偏离真正驱动模型预测的关键隐藏计算，即频繁不忠实。文献计量分析显示，1000篇近期CoT相关论文中约21.7%明确将CoT视为承重式可解释性技术，其中包含在医疗、法律、自主系统等高风险领域重度依赖此类可解释性主张的工作。
AI.conclusion: CoT对可解释性既不必要也不充分。作者提出三项建议：(i) 不应在缺乏额外验证的情况下把CoT当作可解释性的充分条件；(ii) 应采用严格方法评估忠实性对下游决策的影响；(iii) 在任何基于CoT的可解释性主张旁报告此类忠实性评估结果，同时继续发挥CoT在沟通与监控方面的价值。

title: Hidden Clues in WM-811K: Uncovering the Spatial Signals Behind Wafer Map Prediction
summary: WM-811K (also known as LSWMD) is a wafer map dataset first made publicly available in a 2015 paper by Wu et al. Convolutional neural networks have been used to achieve high classification accuracy on this dataset, yet it's not easy to decipher which features of the dataset are driving that performance. This study attempts to answer this specifically for WM-811K: how much of the predictive performance results from the wafer layout, the count of failed dies, their distance from the center and their exact 2-D location. After analyzing duplicate wafer maps, removing same wafer maps with conflicting labels and ensuring that the same manufacturing lot or exact same map doesn't appear in training, validation and test data, we were left with 25,513 defect-labeled wafer maps from eight classes. We then constructed four variations of each wafer map. The Original was the actual wafer map present in the dataset. The Layout-only kept only the layout of the non-background dies. The Global-shuffle kept the count of failed dies while shuffling them around. The Radial-shuffle randomized the locations of failed dies only in their radial bin, which was chosen out of 8 radial bins based on distance from the center. The data split, preprocessing and CNN architecture remained the same for all four of them. Macro-F1 progressed like this: 0.3829 (Layout-only), 0.5803 (Global-shuffle), 0.7439 (Radial-shuffle) and 0.8563 (Original). These results show that WM-811K contains useful information at several levels: wafer layout, number of failures, distribution of failed dies in a given radius, and exact 2-D locations of the failed dies. Therefore, high classification performance on this benchmark does not come only from learning the exact defect configuration.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过构造四组受控的晶圆图变体（仅布局、全局置换、径向置换、原始），量化了WM-811K数据集中各类信息对CNN分类性能的贡献，Macro-F1从0.3829依次升至0.8563。
AI.motivation: CNN在WM-811K晶圆图数据集上取得高分类精度，但难以判别究竟是数据集的哪些特征（晶圆布局、失效芯片数量、其距中心距离、精确二维位置）驱动了性能。作者希望拆解并量化各层信息对预测性能的贡献。
AI.method: 数据清洗：分析重复晶圆图、剔除标签冲突的相同图谱、确保同一批次或完全相同的图谱不同时出现在训练/验证/测试集，最终保留八个类别共25,513张带缺陷标签的晶圆图。随后为每张图构造四个变体：Original（原始图谱）、Layout-only（仅保留非背景芯片的布局）、Global-shuffle（保留失效芯片数量但全局随机置换位置）、Radial-shuffle（按距中心距离划分8个径向区间，仅在各自径向区间内随机化位置）。四组变体的数据划分、预处理与CNN结构完全一致。
AI.result: Macro-F1依次为：Layout-only 0.3829、Global-shuffle 0.5803、Radial-shuffle 0.7439、Original 0.8563，呈单调递增趋势。
AI.conclusion: WM-811K在多个层次上均含有可用信息：晶圆布局、失效数量、给定半径内失效芯片的分布、以及失效芯片的精确二维位置。因此该基准上的高分类性能并非仅来自学习精确的缺陷构型，还来源于更粗粒度的统计与结构信息。该结论提示需谨慎解读基准成绩，并可作为数据泄露与捷径学习的诊断参考。

title: EvoMisty: Building, Optimizing, and Evolving Capabilities on a Social Robot
summary: Social robots face diverse and changing tasks in companionship and education. LLM-based methods can generate task programs, but they still rely on manually developed control interfaces and predefined capabilities. They also lack a general mechanism to optimize completed tasks based on user-specified metrics and reuse performance improvements across tasks.We present EvoMisty, a plugin-based framework that enables coding agents to build and continually improve robot capabilities. EvoMisty builds a control program from official documentation and verifies candidate capabilities on a physical robot. Verified capabilities are stored in an atomic capability library and combined with existing skills to solve tasks. After task completion, EvoMisty can collect execution data, measure user-specified metrics, and iteratively improve task programs. It then distills reusable skills from final solutions into a skill library for future tasks.We evaluate EvoMisty on a physical Misty II robot using Claude Code and Codex. The two agents construct 109 and 107 verified atomic capabilities, respectively. Both complete all 28 AutoMisty benchmark tasks and seven additional tasks beyond AutoMisty's capabilities. Optimization improves all seven evaluated metrics across five tasks. For example, dialogue response latency decreases by 52% and 71%, respectively. Reusing skills from one optimized dialogue task reduces latency by 33% to 72% in three other dialogue tasks without further optimization. All code and experimental videos will be publicly released through the webpage: https://wangxiaoshawn.github.io/projects/evomisty/index.html

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EvoMisty——一个插件式框架，让编码智能体基于官方文档自动构建控制程序、在真实机器人上验证能力，并以原子能力库、指标驱动迭代优化与技能蒸馏实现机器人能力的持续改进；在 Misty II 实体机器人上，Claude Code 与 Codex 分别构建 109/107 个验证能力，完成全部 28 项 AutoMisty 任务及 7 项额外任务，对话响应延迟降低 52%/71%，技能复用进一步在三个对话任务上降低 33%–72% 延迟。
AI.motivation: 社交机器人在陪伴与教育场景中面临多样且变化的任务。现有基于 LLM 的方法虽能生成任务程序，但仍依赖人工开发的控制接口与预定义能力，且缺乏按用户指定指标优化已完成任务的通用机制，也无法跨任务复用性能改进。
AI.method: EvoMisty 为插件式框架：(1) 依据官方文档由编码智能体自动生成控制程序，避免手工接口；(2) 在物理机器人上验证候选能力，通过者存入原子能力库；(3) 将原子能力与既有技能组合以求解任务；(4) 任务完成后采集执行数据、按用户指定指标度量并迭代优化任务程序；(5) 从最终解中蒸馏可复用技能入技能库，供后续任务使用。
AI.result: 在 Misty II 实体机器人上以 Claude Code 与 Codex 评测：两者分别构建 109 与 107 个验证通过的原子能力，均完成全部 28 项 AutoMisty 基准任务及 7 项超出基准范围的附加任务；优化在五个任务上提升全部七项评测指标，如对话响应延迟分别下降 52% 与 71%；将一个已优化的对话任务技能复用至另外三个对话任务，无需再优化即降低延迟 33%–72%。
AI.conclusion: EvoMisty 表明编码智能体可自主构建并持续改进实体机器人能力，指标驱动的迭代优化与技能蒸馏跨任务复用有效，为社交机器人任务实现提供可扩展、免手工接口的通用路径。

title: PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL: Polarization-Keyed Examination Papers and Mandatory Issued Eyewear that Displace AI Glasses and Extend Universal Design
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Framework, optical analysis, simulation study (Mueller-calculus page model, capture/OCR leakage experiment, metamerism test with 151 observers and 28 cameras), and evaluation protocol; no physical or human-subject results. Companion to arXiv:2611.26033 (SEOYUN). Simulation code in anc/
summary: Camera-equipped AI glasses turn an examination page into a query for a remote vision-language model. Device detection targets possession, and our companion work SEOYUN targets the model. PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL instead changes who owns the eyewear. Every candidate wears authority-issued glasses for the whole session, and the question paper is printed so that it can be read only through them. As in cinema stereoscopy, a patterned laminate encodes the text in the handedness of circular polarization rather than in brightness. The page looks uniformly grey to the naked eye and to unfiltered cameras, and the issued circular analyzer reveals the text. Compulsory issued eyewear turns the smart-glasses form factor against itself. The face position is occupied by a device the authority supplies and collects, and a camera anywhere else needs its own analyzer. Spectacle wearers receive prescription inserts in the issued frame, low-vision candidates may use an offline assistive mixed-reality tier, and blind candidates keep braille, audio, and screen-reader formats. We derive the luminance and contrast budget and show why circular keying tolerates head tilt. A simulation study supports the analysis. A spectral Mueller model confirms tilt invariance and invisibility to linear-polarization cameras, but a 1 degree axis misregistration leaks a few percent of contrast. A capture-and-OCR experiment on English and Korean text shows that video averaging can recover leakage too weak to read in a single frame, so leakage must be bounded against the adversary's total photon budget. Data from 151 observers and 28 cameras show that spectral (metameric) keys are visible to all of them. The key carries no secrecy, and filtered covert cameras remain possible. All results are simulations; no prototypes, physical measurements, or human-subject results are reported.

AI.tldr: 提出PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL：考试现场统一配发权威机构制作的圆偏振分析眼镜，试题页用图案化层压以圆偏振手性编码文字，裸眼与无滤光相机只见均匀灰色，从而把AI眼镜形态"反用于自身"，使远程视觉-语言模型查询失效。
AI.motivation: 现有防御思路针对"设备持有"（设备检测）或"模型侧"（配套工作SEOYUN），但无法应对佩戴AI眼镜把试卷拍成查询发给远程VLM的作弊方式；因此需要从"谁拥有眼镜"这一所有权层面重构考场，使任何相机都必须自带分析器。
AI.method: 仿电影立体显示原理，用图案化层压将文本编码在圆偏振手性而非亮度中；试卷对裸眼及无滤光相机呈均匀灰色，仅配发的圆分析器可显字。同步设计无障碍分层（处方插片、离线辅助MR层、盲文/音频/屏幕阅读器），推导亮度与对比度预算，并论证圆偏振键控对头部倾斜的容忍性。评估手段包括仿真、谱域Mueller矩阵建模、英韩文拍摄-OCR实验，以及151名观察者与28台相机的可见性数据。
AI.result: Mueller模型确认倾斜不变性及对线偏振相机的不可见性；但1度轴失配会泄漏数个百分点对比度。英韩文捕获-OCR实验表明，视频多帧平均可恢复单帧不可读的微弱泄漏，故泄漏必须按对手总光子预算设限。151名观察者与28台相机的数据表明谱域（同色异谱）密钥对所有人可见。密钥不具保密性，加滤光的隐蔽相机仍可能奏效。
AI.conclusion: 该协议是概念与仿真层面的可行性论证，尚无原型、物理测量或人体实验；核心结论是"所有权反转"可制造有效的取证/工程门槛，但泄漏需以光子预算为约束严格界定，且不能依赖密钥保密性，需与设备检测、模型侧防御叠加使用。

title: Irreducible Governance Structure for Autonomous Agent Systems: Fair Allocation, Strategy-Proofness, and Multi-Scale Composition
summary:
Autonomous agent governance is commonly framed as a problem of enforcing correct execution. However, in multi-agent systems, an equally fundamental question precedes execution: which agents are allowed to act.
  In this paper, we show that allocation is not an auxiliary concern but a structural component of governance. When multiple agents compete for execution under constrained resources, any allocation mechanism introduces unavoidable trade-offs between fairness, efficiency, and resistance to strategic manipulation. We formalize this through a set of impossibility results, including Sybil amplification and the incompatibility of desirable allocation properties.
  We then show that these allocation constraints cannot be resolved within a single layer of control. Instead, they propagate across the system, interacting with execution atomicity, state enforcement, and behavioral drift. This leads to a multi-scale governance structure composed of four orthogonal dimensions: temporal (atomicity), state (enforcement), behavioral (drift monitoring), and population (allocation).
  Our main result is an irreducibility theorem: under finite observability, no governance architecture can collapse these dimensions without loss of correctness or stability. Allocation, in particular, acts as a first-class constraint that prevents simplification of the governance stack.
  We validate these results through a series of analytical constructions and empirical ablations, showing that removing or approximating any layer leads to systematic failure modes.
  This work reframes agent governance as a structural problem: not only how actions are executed, but how access to execution is determined, and why these decisions impose irreducible architectural requirements.

AI.tldr: 论文主张多智能体治理中"分配"（谁有权行动）是结构性组件而非辅助问题：给出Sybil放大等不可能性结果，提出时序/状态/行为/种群四维正交治理结构，并证明在有限可观测性下维度不可归约，最后用分析构造与消融实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有自主智能体治理通常被框定为"确保正确执行"的问题，忽视了执行之前的根本问题——哪些智能体被允许行动。资源受限下多智能体竞争执行时，任何分配机制都会在公平性、效率与抗策略操纵之间产生不可避免的权衡，这一结构性约束未被系统性研究。
AI.method: 将分配问题形式化，导出一组不可能性结果（包括Sybil放大、理想分配属性互不兼容）；论证分配约束无法在单一控制层内消解，而会与执行原子性、状态强制、行为漂移相互作用，据此构建时序（原子性）、状态（强制）、行为（漂移监测）、种群（分配）四维正交的多尺度治理结构；提出不可归约性定理并辅以分析构造与经验性消融验证。
AI.result: 证明在有限可观测性条件下，任何治理架构若将四维折叠简化，都会损失正确性或稳定性；分配作为一阶约束阻止治理栈的简化。消融实验显示移除或近似任一层次均导致系统性失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体治理解构为结构性问题：不仅关注动作如何被执行，更需关注执行访问权如何被决定，以及为何这些决策带来不可归约的架构要求。

title: Conformalized Tree-Based Gradient Ensembles for Out-of-Distribution Detection and Plausible Recourse
summary: Counterfactual recourse provides actionable feature adjustments that reverse unfavourable predictions made by automated decision models. However, when recourse search optimizes purely against classifier confidence or narrow proxy scores over gradient-boosted decision trees (GBDT), search procedures can exploit boundary artifacts and low-density regions---an instance of Goodhart's law---yielding out-of-distribution (OOD) recommendations that appear favourable nominally while lacking manifold plausibility. In this paper, we study conformalized OOD gating coupled with actionability-constrained counterfactual search across two tabular benchmarks: Adult and Give Me Some Credit (GMSC). Calibrating finite-sample anomaly gates (gate_IF, gate_LOF, and the conjunctive gate_ALL) at significance level delta = 0.05 over isolation forest, local outlier factor, and k-nearest-neighbor signals, we audit generated counterfactuals against held-out GMM and OCSVM detectors alongside ablation studies (gen10, gen100, and relax). Across matched recourse pairs where both constrained and unconstrained searches succeed, gate_ALL significantly reduces held-out OCSVM flags on Adult (N=541, Delta flag_OCSVM = -0.0296, p_Holm = 4.0e-4) and lowers both held-out flags on GMSC (N=540, Delta flag_OCSVM = -0.0346, p = 1.0751e-4; Delta flag_GMM = -0.1663, p = 3.5679e-16) while increasing matched recourse cost (Delta cost = +0.3035, p = 1.3365e-5) and narrowing overall feasibility. Our findings formalize the cost--feasibility--plausibility trade-off and demonstrate how conformal OOD gating audits recourse reliability on tabular ensembles.

AI.tldr: 本文研究共形化OOD门控与可行动性约束反事实搜索的结合，在Adult与GMSC两个表格基准上审计GBDT反事实推荐的可靠性，并形式化"成本—可行性—合理性"权衡。
AI.motivation: 当反事实搜索仅针对分类器置信度或狭窄代理分数优化时，在梯度提升决策树（GBDT）上会利用边界伪影与低密度区域（Goodhart定律的体现），产生名义上有利但缺乏流形合理性的分布外（OOD）推荐，由此需要可校准的OOD门控机制来审计反事实可靠性。
AI.method: 在delta=0.05显著性水平下，基于孤立森林、局部离群因子和k近邻信号校准有限样本异常门控（gate_IF、gate_LOF及合取门gate_ALL），并将其与可行动性约束的反事实搜索结合；用留出的GMM与OCSVM检测器审计生成的反事实，并设置gen10、gen100、relax消融实验。
AI.result: 在约束与无约束搜索均成功的匹配反事实对中，gate_ALL显著降低Adult上的留出OCSVM标记（N=541，Δflag_OCSVM=-0.0296，p_Holm=4.0e-4）；在GMSC上同时降低两类留出标记（N=540，Δflag_OCSVM=-0.0346，p=1.0751e-4；Δflag_GMM=-0.1663，p=3.5679e-16），但提高匹配反事实成本（Δcost=+0.3035，p=1.3365e-5）并收窄整体可行性。
AI.conclusion: 共形OOD门控能有效提升表格集成模型反事实推荐的流形合理性，但以成本上升与可行性下降为代价，从而形式化了成本—可行性—合理性的三重权衡，并展示了OOD门控作为反事实可靠性审计工具的价值。

title: Learning from Human Corrections through Temporal Preferences
summary: When people intervene to correct a robot, they provide information not only through how they correct its behavior, but also through when they choose to intervene. Existing approaches to Learning from Corrections focus on comparing the new trajectory to the robot's originally intended behavior, thus underutilizing the context of the robot's behavior before the intervention. In this work, we investigate how both pre- and post-intervention behavior can be translated into preference pairs for learning value functions that approximate a human's latent reward. We construct post-intervention preferences by comparing corrected behavior with the behavior it replaces, and pre-intervention preferences from temporal relationships among states leading up to an intervention. We evaluate the learned value representations through two downstream tasks: goal inference and correction forecasting. Our results show that post-intervention preferences are particularly effective for goal inference, while pre-intervention preferences provide strong correction-forecasting performance. Combining both sources of information performs strongly across both tasks, even when generalizing to participants unseen during training. These findings demonstrate that both when and how humans correct provide complementary information for learning value representations from corrective interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将人类纠正机器人时的“如何纠正”（干预后）与“何时干预”（干预前）信息统一转化为偏好对，用于学习逼近人类潜在奖励的价值函数，并在目标推断与纠正预测两项下游任务上验证两类偏好信息的互补性。
AI.motivation: 现有 Learning from Corrections 方法仅将纠正后的新轨迹与机器人原始意图行为进行比较，忽略了干预发生前机器人行为所提供的上下文，从而浪费了“干预时机”这一隐含信息。
AI.method: 构建两类偏好对：1）干预后偏好——将纠正后的行为与其所替代的行为进行比较；2）干预前偏好——利用干预发生前状态之间的时间关系构造。基于这些偏好对学习价值函数（价值表示），并通过目标推断（goal inference）与纠正预测（correction forecasting）两个下游任务进行评估。
AI.result: 干预后偏好对目标推断特别有效；干预前偏好则显著提升纠正预测性能。二者结合在两个任务上均表现强劲，且在泛化到训练中未见过的参与者时依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 人类“何时”干预与“如何”干预为从纠正交互中学习价值表示提供了互补信息，应同时加以利用。

title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
comment: Guo Chen, Fuxiao Liu, Haoqin Tu, and Yiyang Zhou contributed equally and are listed alphabetically by surname. Project lead: Guilin Liu
summary: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs. A shared generation-and-rendering interface connects these representations to visual feedback across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents. A Nemotron-native harness coordinates planning and raster candidate selection, with targeted repair for editable structured and hybrid artifacts. To support this interface, we develop Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer, the autoregressive raster generator Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, and the structured-code model family Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode. On approximately 178K images spanning six visual domains, our tokenizer improves reconstruction PSNR from 26.08 to 29.57 dB over Emu3.5 IBQ. It also provides 7.13x faster encoding and 10.93x faster decoding at batch size one on A100. In standalone evaluation, one Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode variant surpasses Kimi K3.1 Pro on the aggregate across Chart2Code, MMSVG, Design2Code, and Image2Struct. At the system level, the Nemotron-native configuration raises GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM from 31.71 to 52.56 using the same raster generator. With our best setting, Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation achieves performance competitive with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro across most benchmarks with available comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出 Pixel as Code 的智能体式视觉创作框架 Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation，用离散视觉 token 表示栅格图像、用显式程序表示结构化产物，经统一的生成-渲染接口实现跨图像、矢量图、网页与文档的精确可控创作，并配套图像 tokenizer、30B-A3B 自回归图像生成器与 VisionCode 模型族。
AI.motivation: 视觉创作既需要富有表现力的图像生成，又需要对文本、版式和结构进行精确控制；现有方法难以在同一系统中兼顾"表现力"与"可控性/可编辑性"。
AI.method: 以 Pixel as Code 为核心：栅格图像由学习到的离散视觉 token 表示，结构化产物用显式程序表示；构建共享的生成与渲染接口，将各表示映射到图像、矢量图形、网页、文档上的视觉反馈；采用 Nemotron-native harness 协调规划与栅格候选选择，并对可编辑的结构化/混合产物做定向修复。支撑组件包括 Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer、自回归生成器 Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B 与结构化代码模型族 Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode。
AI.result: 在约 178K 图像、六个视觉域上，tokenizer 重建 PSNR 由 Emu3.5 IBQ 的 26.08 dB 提升至 29.57 dB；A100、batch size 1 下编码快 7.13×、解码快 10.93×。单模型评测中某 VisionCode 变体在 Chart2Code、MMSVG、Design2Code、Image2Struct 的汇总指标上超过 Kimi K3.1 Pro。系统级上，相同栅格生成器下 Nemotron-native 配置将 GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM 从 31.71 提升至 52.56；最佳设置下在多数有对比基准上与 GPT Image 2、Nano Banana Pro 表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 统一"离散 token 生成"与"程序化结构化代码"的智能体框架可在保持生成质量的同时显著增强精确控制与可编辑性，并达到与主流商业系统有竞争力的水平。

title: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
summary: Audio-video (AV) deepfakes can fake the face, the voice, or both. Most benchmarks only ask whether a clip is real or fake, so they cannot show whether a detector relies on the picture, the voice, or encoding traces. We present MOZAIC, a paired benchmark with a 4-way label in which every source clip is released in all four combinations of real or fake video and real or fake audio so each modality contribution can be measured directly. Fakes cover inner-face swapping, whole-frame video diffusion and voice conversion. MOZAIC has 137,745 clips from 15,014 source pairs and four tasks: T1 AV authenticity, T2 manipulation type, T3 identity verification and T4 explanation. We evaluate 12 AV multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), train four detectors and fine-tune MLLMs with LoRA. Overall, the best MLLM reaches only 35.6% on the four-way T1 and catches far more video-only fakes than voice-only fakes (43.6% vs 7.5%). Trained detectors reach 98.4% on T1, and LoRA fine-tuning raises explanation scores (OmniVinci 4.17 to 7.40, Qwen2.5-Omni 4.42 to 6.98), but the best T1 detector falls to 78.3% when the face-swap generator is held out of training, so generalization and explanation remain open. We release the dataset, the compact MOZAIC-SMALL split, the code and the prompts. https://vectorinstitute.github.io/mozaic/

AI.tldr: MOZAIC 是一个音视频深度伪造配对基准，用"真/假视频 × 真/假音频"四组合标签直接量化各模态贡献，含137,745个片段与四项任务，并系统评测了12个音视频多模态大模型与自训练检测器。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频深度伪造基准大多只做"真/假"二元判断，无法揭示检测器究竟依赖画面、语音还是编码痕迹；而深度伪造可能只伪造人脸、只伪造声音或两者同时伪造，需要可控的模态级归因评测。
AI.method: 构建配对式基准MOZAIC：每个源片段同时发布真实/伪造视频与真实/伪造音频的全部四种组合，形成4类标签，从而可直接测量单模态贡献。伪造类型覆盖内脸替换、整帧视频扩散生成与语音转换。数据规模为15,014个源配对、137,745个片段，设四项任务：T1音视频真实性、T2操纵类型识别、T3身份验证、T4解释生成。实验评测12个音视频多模态大模型（MLLM），训练4个专用检测器，并用LoRA微调MLLM。
AI.result: 最佳MLLM在四分类T1上仅达35.6%，且对纯视频伪造的识别率（43.6%）远高于纯语音伪造（7.5%）；训练的检测器在T1上达98.4%；LoRA微调显著提升解释得分（OmniVinci 4.17→7.40，Qwen2.5-Omni 4.42→6.98）；但最佳T1检测器在训练中剔除人脸替换生成器后降至78.3%。
AI.conclusion: MLLM在细粒度音视频伪造判别上仍明显偏科视觉模态，专用检测器性能高但跨生成器泛化不足，解释能力虽可通过微调改善却仍未解决。因此跨生成器泛化与可解释性仍是开放问题。作者开源数据集、轻量MOZAIC-SMALL子集、代码与提示词。

title: Layer-Readout Interfaces in EEG Foundation Models: Predictive Accessibility and Cross-Dataset Transfer
summary: Intermediate layers often outperform final layers when foundation models are used as frozen feature extractors, but the source of this advantage is unclear. We study this question in EEG foundation models by separating three factors: how representations are read out, whether intermediate layers provide predictive utility beyond the final-layer interface, and whether useful depth structure transfers across datasets. Across five models and three tasks, improving the final-layer readout consistently recovers substantial predictive performance, yet intermediate layers remain advantageous within frozen extraction. We also find that layers selected on one dataset remain useful on another across five dataset pairs and four task families, and that a compact set of source-derived task directions retains predictive value after transfer in sleep staging. Together, these results show that predictive utility varies across depth, and its usefulness depends on how representations are read out and transferred. More crucially, source-selected layers provide a reusable feature interface across datasets, reducing the need for target-side layer search while outperforming final-layer baselines on target datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文在EEG基础模型上通过分离"读出方式"、"中间层是否提供超越最终层接口的预测效用"、"深度结构是否可跨数据集迁移"三个因素，探究中间层为何优于最终层的来源。
AI.motivation: 基础模型作为冻结特征提取器时，中间层常优于最终层，但其优势来源不清楚；需要厘清是读出方式的问题、中间层本身的信息优势，还是深度结构的可迁移性。
AI.method: 在5个模型、3个任务上进行系统实验：分别控制并解耦三个因素（读出方式、中间层的额外预测效用、跨数据集的可迁移性）；并在5组数据集对、4类任务家族上验证源数据集选层在目标数据集上的可复用性；在睡眠分期任务中考察源数据导出的紧凑任务方向在迁移后的预测价值。
AI.result: 改进最终层读出可一致地恢复大量预测性能，但在冻结提取下中间层仍具优势；在一个数据集上选出的层在另一数据集上仍有用（5组数据集对、4类任务）；源数据导出的紧凑任务方向在睡眠分期迁移后仍保持预测价值。
AI.conclusion: 预测效用随深度变化，其价值取决于读出方式与迁移方式；源数据选出的层可作为跨数据集可复用的特征接口，减少目标端选层搜索，并在目标数据集上优于最终层基线。

title: Geometric Control Analysis of an Internally Actuated Flying Wing
comment: Submitted to IEEE TCST for review
summary: This paper presents a rigorous geometric accessibility and controllability analysis for a fixed-wing Uncrewed Aircraft System (UAS) actuated solely by an internal moving mass, a momentum wheel, and external thrust. This configuration eliminates traditional control surfaces, which in turn reduces the combinatorial set of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) studies necessary for high-fidelity modeling of flight through unsteady flow fields. Using Lie bracket computations and the strong Lie Algebra Rank Condition, it is shown that the full nonlinear dynamics are generically small-time locally accessible, with singular configurations explicitly characterized and shown to be immediately escapable by direct mass actuation. The stronger property of small-time local controllability is shown to hold for the attitude subsystem at equilibrium points, using Sussmann's condition. A key contribution is the explicit treatment of the time-varying inertia tensor via the Huygens-Steiner Theorem, which introduces nontrivial coupling between the control vector fields. The momentum wheel provides direct yaw authority that, combined with inertia variation from the moving mass, generates a full-rank accessibility Lie algebra. A nonlinear Model Predictive Controller (MPC) is derived with consideration of flight envelope constraints and is applied to track different trajectories under unperturbed and perturbed flow field conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文对仅由内部移动质量、动量轮和外部推力驱动的固定翼无人机进行严格的几何可达性与可控性分析，并设计非线性MPC实现轨迹跟踪。
AI.motivation: 去除传统控制舵面可减少高保真非定常流场建模所需的大量CFD计算量，但需从几何控制理论角度严格验证这种非常规驱动配置是否具备可达性与可控性。
AI.method: 采用李括号计算与强李代数秩条件（Lie Algebra Rank Condition）分析非线性系统的短时局部可达性；刻画奇异构型并证明其可由直接质量驱动立即脱离；用Sussmann条件证明姿态子系统在平衡点处具有短时局部可控性；借助Huygens-Steiner定理显式处理时变惯性张量及其引起的控制向量场非平凡耦合；在此基础上推导考虑飞行包线约束的非线性模型预测控制器（MPC）。
AI.result: 证明完整非线性动力学一般情形下短时局部可达，奇异构型可立即挣脱；姿态子系统在平衡点满足短时局部可控；动量轮提供直接偏航控制能力，与移动质量引起的惯性变化耦合生成满秩可达性李代数；MPC在无扰动与扰动流场条件下均实现多轨迹跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 该无舵面、移动质量+动量轮驱动方案在几何意义上具备充分的可达性与姿态可控性，时变惯性张量的显式建模是实现满秩李代数的关键，所设计MPC可有效完成带约束的轨迹跟踪任务。

title: Look Where Camouflage Breaks: Concealment-Guided Observation for Camouflaged Object Detection
summary: A camouflaged object can blend into its surroundings at one scale and become distinguishable at another. Yet a region's apparent ambiguity gives limited guidance on which observation would resolve it. The challenge is to connect the form and scale of concealment to the evidence that a new view can reveal. We introduce CamoBreak, an active framework for camouflaged object detection guided by a Concealment Spectrum. From the image and current predictions, the spectrum measures regional resemblance and boundary ambiguity across comparison scales, distinguishing persistent concealment from separation emerging at finer or broader scales. These measurements guide crop selection from the already-captured image and recognition against global foreground and background references. An object-conditioned spatial preference then selects where local evidence should update the prediction and feature memory, retaining target corrections while suppressing background distractions. Accepted corrections reshape the next measurement, while predicted segmentation benefit determines whether to observe again. Experiments across encoder families and related segmentation tasks show consistent improvements. Targeted analyses support improved small-target recovery, multiple-object coverage, and selective evidence integration. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: CamoBreak：以" Concealment Spectrum（隐藏谱）"为引导的主动式伪装目标检测框架，通过多尺度相似度/边界歧义测量指导局部裁剪观测与证据更新，在多种编码器与相关分割任务上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 伪装目标可在一个尺度上与背景融合、在另一尺度上可分辨。但仅凭某区域"看起来有歧义"难以判断应当获取何种观测才能消解歧义。核心挑战在于：把"隐藏的形式与尺度"与"新视角能揭示的证据"建立联系，从而决定"看哪里、看多大范围、是否需要再看"。
AI.method: 1) Concealment Spectrum：由图像与当前预测出发，在不同比较尺度上度量区域相似度与边界歧义，区分"持续隐藏"与"在更细/更粗尺度上显现的分离"；2) 基于该测量指导从已获取图像中选择裁剪区域，并与全局前景/背景参考进行识别比对；3) 物体条件化的空间偏好（object-conditioned spatial preference）决定局部证据应更新预测与特征记忆的位置，保留目标修正、抑制背景干扰；4) 被接受的修正反过来重塑下一次测量，由预测的分割收益决定是否再次观测。
AI.result: 跨多种编码器族与相关分割任务实验显示一致性能提升；针对性分析支持小目标恢复、多目标覆盖以及选择性证据融合方面的改进。代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 将伪装检测由单次静态推理转为"测量—观测—更新"的闭环主动感知，用尺度化的隐藏度量作为"是否再观测、观测何处"的决策依据，是一种可插拔、模型无关的改进范式。

title: Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Sets for Incomplete Data
summary: Attribute reduction in incomplete information systems is difficult because missing values break the equivalence-class structure of rough set theory. We propose the Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set (COFRS) model. Each object is described by its set of present attributes. The similarity of two objects is a weighted overlap on the attributes present in both, divided by the fixed number of attributes |A| instead of the size of their union, so missing values are penalised globally and are not matched as wildcards. From this similarity we define a soft dependency degree based on weighted granule consistency, and we search for reducts by greedy backward elimination in O(|U|^2 |A|^2) time. We show that the relation is symmetric and non-reflexive, that the dependency degree is not monotone, and we give a sufficient condition under which monotonicity holds. On 11 UCI benchmarks with missing rates from 0.15% to 20.46%, COFRS gives the smallest reducts on average (4.1 attributes, against 5.0-11.2 for Tolerance-RS, a range-threshold variant Tol-RS_tau, Zhou-RS and the min-aggregation variant COFRS-min). The difference is significant against Tol-RS_tau, Zhou-RS and COFRS-min (Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon p<0.01) but not against Tolerance-RS (p=0.56), and it is small against the Jensen-Shen selector (adjusted p=0.084). At equal reduct size, COFRS selects more informative attributes than random subsets. With a kNN classifier the methods do not differ significantly in accuracy, F1 or G-mean; with an RBF-SVM they do, and COFRS ranks last. The gain is therefore compactness, not predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出保守重叠模糊粗糙集（COFRS）模型，以"共同存在属性上的加权重叠 / 固定属性总数|A|"定义对象相似度，使缺失值被全局惩罚而非当作通配符；据此构造基于加权颗粒一致性的软依赖度，并用贪心后向消除在O(|U|^2|A|^2)时间内搜索约简。实验表明COFRS平均约简最小（4.1个属性），但预测精度无显著优势。
AI.motivation: 不完备信息系统的属性约简因缺失值破坏粗糙集理论的等价类结构而困难；现有容忍关系、变精度或范围阈值等处理方式易将缺失值视为可匹配的通配符，从而低估缺失带来的不确定性，亟需一种对缺失值做全局惩罚且计算可行的约简框架。
AI.method: 1) 每个对象由其"现存属性集合"描述；两对象相似度定义为二者共同存在属性上的加权重叠，分母取固定属性数|A|（而非并集大小），实现缺失值全局惩罚与通配符排除；2) 由该相似度定义基于加权颗粒一致性的软依赖度；3) 以贪心后向消除搜索约简，时间复杂度O(|U|^2|A|^2)；4) 理论上讨论关系的对称性与非自反性、依赖度非单调性及单调性成立的充分条件；5) 在11个UCI基准（缺失率0.15%–20.46%）上与Tolerance-RS、Tol-RS_tau、Zhou-RS、COFRS-min、Jensen-Shen选择器对比。
AI.result: COFRS平均约简最小（4.1个属性，对比方法为5.0–11.2）；相对Tol-RS_tau、Zhou-RS、COFRS-min差异显著（Holm校正Wilcoxon p<0.01），相对Tolerance-RS不显著（p=0.56），相对Jensen-Shen差异较小（校正p=0.084）。同等约简规模下COFRS所选属性比随机子集更具信息量。kNN分类器下各方法在accuracy、F1、G-mean上无显著差异；RBF-SVM下有显著差异且COFRS排名最后。
AI.conclusion: COFRS的核心贡献在于约简的紧致性而非预测精度：其对缺失值的"全局惩罚"相似度可得到更小的属性子集，且保留较高信息量；但依赖度非单调、需附加充分条件，且在下游分类器（尤其RBF-SVM）上未体现精度收益，说明该方法的定位是紧凑特征选择而非提升泛化性能。

title: Flagging Batch Shift in Flow Cytometry using Jeffreys Divergence between Gaussian Mixtures
summary: Machine learning models for clinical flow cytometry are usually evaluated on data drawn from their training distribution. In routine practice, however, acquisition conditions and reagents may change, potentially making predictions unreliable without warning. We propose a model agnostic criterion for prediction reliability based on a notion of distance from the training distribution: each patient sample is represented by a Gaussian mixture model, and its Jeffreys divergence to a reference fitted on the training data is estimated using Monte Carlo integration. We illustrate our approach on real-life shifted cohorts of acute myeloid leukaemia patients, using a classifier trained to predict NPM1 mutation status. First, we show graphically and statistically that pairwise divergences capture acquisition cohort structure. We then calibrate a rejection threshold on a subset of shifted cohort samples and evaluate it on held-out subjects. Across 20 runs, the misclassification rate of rejected samples was 2.5 times larger than for retained samples. These results suggest that input divergence can help identify unreliable predictions, providing a strong candidate component for abstention frameworks, along with quality control measures and classifier confidence.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种模型无关的预测可靠性判据：以每个患者样本的高斯混合模型表示，并计算其与训练数据参考分布的Jeffreys散度（蒙特卡洛估计），据此拒绝不可靠预测。在急性髓系白血病真实偏移队列上，被拒绝样本的误分类率为保留样本的2.5倍。
AI.motivation: 临床流式细胞术机器学习模型通常在训练分布内评估，但常规实践中采集条件与试剂变化会导致分布偏移，使预测在无预警情况下失效，因此需要一个与模型无关、可量化输入偏离程度的可靠性判据。
AI.method: 将每个患者样本建模为高斯混合模型，对训练数据拟合参考分布，用蒙特卡洛积分估计样本与参考分布之间的Jeffreys散度；在AML偏移队列上以预测NPM1突变状态的分类器为例，通过图示与统计检验验证两两散度能反映采集批次结构，并在偏移队列部分样本上校准拒绝阈值，于留出受试者上评估。
AI.result: 散度可图形化与统计地刻画采集队列结构；在留出受试者上20次重复运行中，被拒绝样本的误分类率约为保留样本的2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 输入散度有助于识别不可靠预测，可作为弃权（abstention）框架的有力候选组件，与质量控制指标及分类器置信度联合使用。

title: CRAB-H: Task-Centric Certification for Healthcare Autonomous Systems
summary: This paper introduces CRAB H as a task-centric certification methodology for healthcare autonomous systems. CRAB H extends the ARC governance architecture by introducing the task as a first-class governance object, represented through Task Requirement Profiles TRP H. Each profile defines the cognitive capabilities, governance constraints, evidentiary requirements, and operational assumptions necessary for the safe execution of a specific healthcare activity. Rather than asking whether a robot achieves a sufficiently high benchmark score, CRAB H asks whether demonstrated capabilities satisfy the requirements of the task. Certification becomes a comparison between demonstrated capability and required capability. A reliability-gated assurance allocation mechanism routes cognitive dimensions that cannot be reproducibly evaluated to LEA operational requirements rather than discarding them. Governance integrity is preserved: unreliable dimensions are governed, not ignored. The Capability Margin is defined as the threshold-based conjunction of per-dimension compliance determinations, not as a subtracted scalar preserving non compensatory governance logic appropriate for safety-critical healthcare deployment

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CRAB H，一种面向医疗自主系统的任务中心认证方法：以任务作为一类治理对象，通过任务需求画像 TRP H 将认证转化为"已验证能力"与"任务所需能力"之间的比较，并引入可靠性门控的保证分配机制与阈值合取式 Capability Margin。
AI.motivation: 现有认证依赖基准分数门槛，即询问机器人是否达到足够高的基准得分，无法回答"该机器人能否安全完成特定医疗任务"；同时部分认知维度无法可复现地评测，常被直接丢弃，导致治理完整性受损。因此需要将治理重心从分数转向任务需求。
AI.method: 在 ARC 治理架构基础上扩展，引入任务作为一等治理对象，用 Task Requirement Profiles（TRP H）刻画每类医疗活动的认知能力、治理约束、证据要求与运行假设；认证即"已展示能力 vs 所需能力"的比对；采用可靠性门控的保证分配机制，将不可可复现评估的维度路由至 LEA 运行要求；Capability Margin 定义为各维度合规判定的阈值式合取，而非标量相减。
AI.result: 摘要未提供实证结果；概念性结论是：不可靠维度被纳入 LEA 运行要求而仍受治理（"被治理而非被忽略"），治理完整性得以保持；Capability Margin 的合取式定义保留了非补偿性治理逻辑，避免某一维度高分掩盖另一维度缺陷。
AI.conclusion: CRAB H 将医疗自主系统认证重构为任务需求满足度问题，兼顾不可复现维度的治理覆盖与非补偿性安全逻辑，适用于安全关键型医疗部署场景。

title: CoRe: Jointly Learning Contextual Representations for Understanding and Generation
summary: We introduce CoRe, in which understanding and generation jointly shape one contextual representation for images and one for text, trained from scratch. Each representation is read for understanding, conditions the other modality, and is the space in which that modality is generated by a continuous flow from Gaussian noise. With 383M parameters trained on CC12M and no pretrained language model, text encoder, or VAE at inference, CoRe matches a same-data contrastive-only baseline in global understanding and reaches COCO-30K FID 10.10, comparable to much larger generators built on pretrained components. In controlled comparisons at equal data and architecture, CoRe generates better in both directions (text to image and image to text) than a representation shaped by understanding alone and then frozen, and follows prompts better than generating in a space that understanding does not shape. In the other direction, with an attentive segmentation probe, on monocular depth, and when read by a frozen language model, CoRe surpasses the contrastive-only baseline: generation adds information that stronger readouts reach. Because generation runs inside the understanding representation, frozen real-image probes read and steer intermediate states and the model ranks its own samples without extra training. Because both modalities use continuous flows, both also distill to a few steps. Our controls indicate why one representation suffices: understanding organizes the representation semantically, while generation makes it retain more information.

AI.tldr: CoRe用单一共享表征同时承担理解与生成：图像和文本各有一个由高斯噪声经连续流生成的表征空间，既用于理解、又作为另一模态的条件，383M参数在CC12M上从零训练即可在理解与生成上匹敌对比学习基线与更大生成器。
AI.motivation: 探究图像与文本的"理解"与"生成"能否共用同一表征，而非分别训练理解表征与生成表征；并分析单一表征为何足够。
AI.method: 为图像和文本各学习一个表征空间，从零训练：表征既被读取用于理解任务，也用于条件化另一模态，同时是该模态由高斯噪声经连续流（continuous flow）生成的目标空间；不使用预训练语言模型、文本编码器或VAE。通过等数据等架构的受控实验比较三类方案：联合塑造、仅理解后冻结、理解不塑造的生成空间。
AI.result: 383M参数、CC12M训练下，全局理解匹配同数据纯对比基线；COCO-30K FID 10.10，可比于依赖预训练组件的大模型。等数据等架构下双向生成（文生图、图生文）均优于"仅理解后冻结"的表征，且提示词跟随优于理解不塑造的空间。在注意力分割探针、单目深度、冻结语言模型读取等更强读出下超过对比基线。冻结的真实图像探针可读取并操控中间状态，模型无需额外训练即可对自采样排序；两模态均可蒸馏至极少步数。
AI.conclusion: 一个表征足以兼顾理解与生成：理解使其语义结构化，生成使其保留更多信息，二者互补。

title: Beyond Static Charts: Benchmarking Interactive Chart-to-Code Generation for MLLMs
comment: ACM WSDM 2027 (Main Track), Our code and data are available at https://github.com/bianyh/ChartInt
summary: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant progress in chart-to-code generation. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on static charts, overlooking interactive charts that enable richer and more expressive data exploration. Unlike static chart-to-code generation, which emphasizes visual consistency, interactive chart-to-code evaluation targets behavioral consistency, requiring chart states to evolve correctly under sequences of user interactions, thereby rendering traditional one-step evaluation paradigms ineffective. To address this gap, we introduce ChartInt, the first benchmark specifically designed for interactive chart-to-code generation. ChartInt consists of 2,779 carefully annotated examples covering common interaction patterns such as hover, highlight, and tooltips. Additionally, ChartInt incorporates editing tasks such as data updates, style adjustments, and cross-chart style transfer to expand real-world application scenarios. To enable reliable evaluation of interaction behavior, we propose a preset state snapshot protocol that predefines target interaction states and deterministically triggers interaction events, transforming dynamic behaviors into reproducible evaluation targets. Based on this protocol, we design a multi-dimensional evaluation framework measuring semantic and stylistic consistency. Experiments show that while current MLLMs perform well on static charts, their performance drops significantly on interactive tasks, highlighting the need for interaction-aware benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ChartInt，首个面向交互式图表到代码生成（interactive chart-to-code）的基准，含 2,779 个标注样本，并提出"预设状态快照"协议与多维评估框架，揭示 MLLM 在交互任务上性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有图表到代码基准几乎只覆盖静态图表，评价侧重视觉一致性；而交互式图表强调"行为一致性"——图表状态需在一系列用户交互下正确演化，传统单步评估范式无法衡量。因此缺少专门针对交互式图表生成的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 ChartInt 基准：2,779 个精细标注样本，覆盖 hover、highlight、tooltip 等常见交互模式，并纳入数据更新、样式调整、跨图表风格迁移等编辑任务以贴近真实场景。评估上提出"预设状态快照（preset state snapshot）"协议：预先定义目标交互状态并确定性触发交互事件，将动态行为转化为可复现的评测目标；在此基础上设计衡量语义一致性与风格一致性的多维度评估框架。
AI.result: 实验表明当前 MLLM 在静态图表任务上表现良好，但在交互任务上性能显著下降，说明交互感知基准的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 交互式图表到代码生成不应沿用静态图表的单步视觉一致性评估，需引入行为一致性视角；ChartInt 与预设状态快照协议提供了可复现的评测路径，并暴露出 MLLM 在交互建模上的明显短板，为后续交互感知模型与评测研究提供基础。

title: Fusion Gains Depend on the Implementation and the Calibration Target: An 18-Task Study of Prediction Intervals with a Single-Source Fallback
comment: 4 figures; supplementary material included as an ancillary file
summary: A fused model can benefit from an extra learning stage as well as from a second data source. We compare four fusion implementations with matched single-source learners on 18 regression tasks with prediction intervals. Across ten refits under group-wise calibration, linear stacking improved the interval score by 6.0% against a source model without a second stage and by 0.1% against its matched single source. The four implementations agreed on 3 of 18 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 12, including 8 of the 10 tasks with naturally distinct sources. With pointwise calibration, they agreed on 5 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 9. A development-set selector with a matched single-source fallback improved ten-refit task-averaged scores by 2.2--6.3% in every implementation under both calibrations. Adding fused arms to the pool of single-source candidates improved the mean relative score by about 5 percentage points. Under group-wise calibration, the gradient-boosted selector met the criterion frozen before evaluation on eight held-out tasks. In post-opening refits, selectors lost to the matched single source in 4.4--6.1% of task-level runs under group-wise calibration. Under signed pointwise calibration, three implementations lost in 19--23% of runs. Fusion evaluations should compare matched candidates on held-out data and report how often the selector loses alongside its average gain.

AI.tldr: 该文评估四种融合实现与匹配单源学习器在18个带预测区间的回归任务上的差异，发现融合实现之间结论不一致，融合增益主要来自额外的学习阶段而非第二数据源；开发集选择器可稳定带来2.2–6.3%提升，但需报告其失败频率。
AI.motivation: 融合模型可能同时受益于额外学习阶段与第二数据源，但既有评估常将二者混同，缺少与匹配单源基线的对照，也未考察不同融合实现间结论是否一致，以及选择器在留出数据上的失败风险。
AI.method: 在18个带预测区间的回归任务上，比较四种融合实现与其匹配的单源学习器；采用组内校准与逐点校准两种设置，各进行十次重拟合；使用区间评分与相对评分评估，并引入带匹配单源回退的开发集选择器（含梯度提升选择器），在留出任务上按预先冻结的准则检验。
AI.result: 组内校准下线性堆叠将区间评分相对无第二阶段源模型改善6.0%，相对匹配单源仅0.1%；四种实现在3/18任务上一致，在12个任务上给出相反的明确结论（含10个天然异源任务中的8个）；逐点校准下一致5个、相反9个。开发集选择器在两种校准、所有实现下使十次重拟合任务平均评分提升2.2–6.3%；将融合臂加入单源候选池使平均相对评分提升约5个百分点；组内校准下梯度提升选择器在8个留出任务上满足预冻准则，但开启后重拟合中选择器在4.4–6.1%任务级运行中劣于匹配单源，带符号逐点校准下三种实现失败率达19–23%。
AI.conclusion: 融合评估应在留出数据上比较匹配候选，并同时报告选择器的平均增益与其落后于匹配单源的频率；融合的主要收益来自额外学习阶段，而非第二数据源本身。

title: Embodied Neuro-symbolic AI: Making Robot Behavior Auditable, Safe, and Scalable
summary: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) end-to-end systems have driven major progress in robot learning, yet they still face persistent barriers to dependable real-world deployment. In practice, these models often exhibit brittle generalization under distribution shift (i.e., novel objects, layouts, lighting, or contact conditions), limited physical and causal reasoning, and inconsistent fine-grained motor control. Critically, many VLA pipelines offer limited ways to express and audit what a robot must not do, making it difficult to provide assurance in safety-critical settings. These limitations constrain scalability, maintainability, and trust when robots move beyond controlled demonstrations. We propose Embodied Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) AI: a deployment-oriented paradigm that integrates learned perception, planning and control with explicit, machine-readable background knowledge and formal constraints. By combining knowledge-guided perception, constraint-aware symbolic planning, and hybrid learning, Embodied NeSy AI enables robots to reason about their environment, adapt to new tasks, and provide auditable, machine-checkable compliance with safety and operational requirements, thus supporting scalable, trustworthy robot deployment.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"具身神经符号（Embodied NeSy）AI"范式，将学习式感知、规划与控制同显式、机器可读的背景知识与形式化约束结合，目标是在分布偏移下鲁棒的泛化、可推理的物理与因果理解、细粒度运动控制，以及可审计的安全合规，从而支撑可扩展、可信赖的真实场景机器人部署。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA端到端系统在真实部署中面临持续障碍：分布偏移（新物体、布局、光照、接触条件）下泛化脆弱；物理与因果推理能力有限；细粒度运动控制不一致；且缺乏表达与审计"机器人不得做什么"的手段，难以在安全关键场景中提供保障。这些限制制约了可扩展性、可维护性与信任度。
AI.method: 提出部署导向的具身神经符号范式，核心为三条融合路径：(1) 知识引导的感知；(2) 约束感知的符号规划；(3) 混合学习（神经网络学习与符号知识/形式化约束协同）。以显式机器可读背景知识与形式约束作为神经模块之上的可检验层。
AI.result: 摘要为立场/愿景型论述，未报告定量实验结果；声称该范式可赋予机器人环境推理、新任务适应能力，并对安全与运行要求提供可审计、机器可校验的合规性。
AI.conclusion: 具身神经符号AI被视为超越受控演示、走向真实世界规模化部署的可行路径，关键在于将安全与运行约束显式化、可检查化，从而同时提升泛化、推理、控制精度与可信保障。

title: Enhancing Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting with Feed-Forward Priors via Spectral Fusion and Distillation
summary: Gaussian splatting from sparse training views renders high-quality images near training views, but reconstruction quality degrades at distant regions, which are undersampled by the training set. Feed-forward novel view synthesis (NVS) models use strong learned priors to resample the scene from substantially different viewpoints, but they take more than ten times as long to render and produce high-frequency artifacts on out-of-domain scenes. We propose a plug-and-play method that enhances an existing sparse-view Gaussian model with a pretrained feed-forward NVS model. We observe that the two are complementary in the frequency domain: the prior is more accurate at low frequencies, and the Gaussians at high frequencies. The reliability of the prior relative to the Gaussians is inversely proportional to the image frequency, so the optimal fusion weight is a first-order low-pass filter with one parameter that can be fitted. Our key idea is then to intelligently fuse the reliable part of each of the two methods. To remove the slow feed-forward model at render time, we use these fused images as teachers and distill them back into Gaussians, balanced with supervision from input views. Our method improves the quality of various sparse-view Gaussian methods without sacrificing rendering speed, and our analysis works on different prior models. Project page: https://linwk20.github.io/spectral-fusion-gs/

AI.tldr: 提出一种即插即用方法，将预训练前馈新视角合成(NVS)模型与稀疏视角高斯泼溅模型在频域融合并蒸馏回高斯，提升重建质量而不牺牲渲染速度。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角训练的高斯泼溅在远离训练视角的区域重建质量下降；前馈NVS模型具有强先验可重采样场景，但渲染耗时超过十倍且在外域场景产生高频伪影。二者优势互补。
AI.method: 观察到二者在频域互补：先验在低频更准确，高斯在高频更准确；先验相对高斯的可靠性随图像频率成反比，故最优融合权重为仅含一个可拟合参数的一阶低通滤波器。据此智能融合两者各自可靠的部分，得到融合图像作为教师，蒸馏回高斯，并与输入视角监督平衡；渲染时无需前馈模型。
AI.result: 提升了多种稀疏视角高斯方法的质量，且不牺牲渲染速度；分析在不同先验模型上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 频域互补性可指导先验与高斯的融合，通过教师蒸馏将收益固化到高斯表示中，实现质量与效率的双赢。

title: What People Choose Not to Say: A Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-Grained Information Manipulation in Conversations
comment: ACM WSDM 2027 (Main Track), Our benchmark dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/xilinghuiye/RoomReader-Full
summary: Recent advances in MLLMs have improved social understanding, enabling models to recognize emotions and distinguish truthful from deceptive behaviors. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on coarse-grained emotion recognition or binary truth-deception detection, overlooking the diverse ways people manipulate information in conversations, such as withholding, leakage, fabrication, evasion, and defensive counterclaim. Understanding these behaviors requires reasoning about underlying facts, participant knowledge, and conversational context, making them difficult to evaluate reliably. To address this gap, we introduce InfoCon, a multimodal benchmark for fine-grained information manipulation in conversations. InfoCon identifies six fine-grained strategies and derives a coarse consistency label from their factual and interactional relations. We develop an evidence-grounded multi-agent annotation framework to construct and verify reliable labels from rich contextual evidence. We benchmark representative multimodal models and systematically analyze their fine-grained information manipulation understanding, providing a testbed beyond binary truth-deception judgments.

AI.tldr: 该文提出InfoCon——一个面向对话中细粒度信息操纵理解的多模态基准，包含六种操纵策略及由策略关系推导出的一致性标签，并采用证据驱动的多智能体标注框架构建可靠标签，为超越二元真假判断提供测试平台。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型（MLLM）社会理解基准局限于粗粒度情绪识别或二元真伪检测，忽视了对话中扣留、泄露、编造、回避、防御性反诉等多样化的信息操纵方式；此类行为需推理底层事实、参与者知识与对话语境，难以可靠评测。
AI.method: 构建多模态基准InfoCon：界定六种细粒度信息操纵策略，并依据策略间事实关系与交互关系推导粗粒度一致性标签；设计基于证据的多智能体标注框架，从丰富上下文证据中构建并校验标签；对代表性多模态模型进行基准测试与细粒度分析。
AI.result: 给出代表性多模态模型在细粒度信息操纵理解上的系统评测结果，揭示其能力边界，形成超越二元真伪判断的测试平台。
AI.conclusion: InfoCon弥补了细粒度信息操纵评测的空白，为多模态社会理解研究提供了可扩展、标签可靠的基准。

title: GHC:Expanding Residual Interfaces in Hyper-Connections
summary: Hyper-Connections expand residual capacity across parallel streams, yet restrict every branch to narrow read and write interfaces: each branch still reads a single stream mixture and writes scaled copies of one output vector to all streams. To lift this bottleneck, we propose Grouped Hyper-Connections (GHC). By partitioning each branch into parallel groups along attention heads or FFN channels, GHC supplies each group with a distinct stream mixture and aggregates their separate outputs into each stream with learned weights. Extensive experiments across dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models show that GHC consistently improves upon Identity Hyper-Connections (IHC) with negligible parameter and memory-access overhead, increasing training efficiency by 35% over Pre-Norm and 10% over IHC. Moreover, expanding residual interfaces overcomes the diminishing returns of adding streams, allowing wider residual states to yield further gains.

AI.tldr: 提出分组超连接（GHC），将每个分支沿注意力头或FFN通道划分为多组，各组读取不同的流混合并以学习权重汇总到各流，突破原有窄读写接口瓶颈，在几乎不增加参数与访存开销下提升训练效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 Hyper-Connections 虽在并行流间扩展了残差容量，但每个分支的读写接口过窄：只读取单一混合流，并将同一输出向量的缩放副本写入所有流，构成瓶颈。
AI.method: 将每个分支沿注意力头或 FFN 通道划分为若干并行组，为每组提供各自不同的流混合输入，并用可学习权重把各组独立输出聚合写入各条流。
AI.result: 在密集模型与 MoE 模型上均稳定优于 Identity Hyper-Connections（IHC），参数与访存开销可忽略；相对 Pre-Norm 训练效率提升 35%，相对 IHC 提升 10%。
AI.conclusion: 扩展残差接口可缓解增加流数带来的边际收益递减，使更宽的残差状态继续带来增益。

title: Hi3R-VLA: Grounding Semantics and Actions in 3D
summary: While recent vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate 3D geometry, how to effectively exploit it for precise and generalizable action prediction remains a central challenge. We introduce Hi3R-VLA, a 3D policy that grounds heterogeneous modalities - vision, language, and action - in explicit 3D geometry for robotic manipulation. Our model integrates spatially-aligned visual features and language conditioning into point cloud representations, enriching scene geometry with fine-grained, task-relevant semantics. It then anchors low-level control commands in the same 3D coordinate frame and uses 3D-RoPE enhanced action-to-point attention over coarse-to-fine point features to model geometric relationships between action targets and observed points. Our analysis demonstrates the importance of semantic fusion within 3D and spatial alignment between observations and actions. With fewer than 250M trainable parameters, Hi3R-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa, RLBench, RoboTwin2, DexJoCo and DexSuite across diverse manipulation tasks and embodiments, from single-arm and dual-arm grippers to dexterous hands. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate its effectiveness in the physical world. The model, code and dataset are publicly released at https://cshizhe.github.io/projects/hi3r_vla.html.

AI.tldr: Hi3R-VLA 是一个将视觉、语言与动作统一锚定在显式三维几何中的 3D 操作策略，仅用不到 250M 可训练参数即在多个仿真基准与真实机器人上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 近期 VLA 模型越来越多引入 3D 几何，但如何有效利用 3D 几何实现精确且可泛化的动作预测仍是核心难题；作者还希望厘清 3D 语义融合与观测-动作空间对齐的关键作用。
AI.method: 将空间对齐的视觉特征与语言条件注入点云表示，用任务相关语义丰富场景几何；再把底层控制指令锚定到同一 3D 坐标系，并在粗到细点特征上使用 3D-RoPE 增强的动作到点注意力，建模动作目标与观测点之间的几何关系。
AI.result: 在 RoboCasa、RLBench、RoboTwin2、DexJoCo、DexSuite 上，跨单臂/双臂夹爪与灵巧手等多样任务和本体均达到 SOTA；真实机器人实验验证了物理世界有效性；可训练参数少于 250M，模型、代码与数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: 显式 3D 几何作为异构模态的统一接地空间是高效路径：3D 内语义融合与观测-动作空间对齐至关重要，且小参数量的 3D 策略即可实现强精度与跨本体泛化。

title: Tornado4D: Physics-Guided 4D Gaussian Reconstruction of a Laboratory Tornado from Sparse One-Sided Videos
summary: Characterizing how tornadoes evolve over space and time is critically important for understanding and preparing for these highly destructive weather events. Towards this end, we develop algorithms capable of forming time-resolved 3D reconstructions of laboratory smoke tornadoes from sparse one-sided videos. Even in a controlled environment, reconstruction is severely underconstrained: appearance is view dependent, motion is non-rigid, and the unobserved volume admits many geometries. We present Tornado4D, a physics-guided 4D Gaussian framework capable of reconstructing laboratory tornadoes from sparse, one-sided videos. Tornado4D uses knowledge of the enclosure geometry to introduce rotational airflow field priors that constrain how the 3D structure evolves over time. These rotational priors allow us to reconstruct otherwise unobserved structure. We evaluate reconstruction accuracy by computing novel-view synthesis accuracy on a held out camera view: Tornado4D outperforms frame-by-frame 3DGS and video-based 4DGS by a considerable margin.

AI.tldr: 提出Tornado4D：一个物理引导的4D高斯框架，利用旋转气流场先验，从稀疏单侧视频重建实验室烟雾龙卷风的时间分辨3D结构，并显著优于逐帧3DGS与视频型4DGS。
AI.motivation: 理解并应对龙卷风这类高破坏性天气，需要刻画其在时空上的演化过程。但即使在受控实验环境中，从单侧稀疏视频做重建也严重欠约束：外观依赖视角、运动非刚性、未观测体积对应多种可能几何。
AI.method: Tornado4D 基于4D高斯表示，利用实验装置外壳几何信息引入旋转气流场先验，约束3D结构随时间的演化方式，从而补全未被观测到的结构。
AI.result: 在留出相机视角上以新视角合成精度评估重建质量，Tornado4D 明显优于逐帧3DGS和基于视频的4DGS。
AI.conclusion: 将领域物理先验（旋转气流场与装置几何）嵌入4D高斯重建，可有效缓解单侧稀疏视频下的病态性，实现实验室龙卷风的时空重建。

title: Antares-Smaug: Adversarial Names, Tokens and Attack Rewrites: Sanitisers Miss Unseen Generalisations
summary: Laya is an open decision model: given a text, a question and K named options with descriptions, it returns one probability per option in a single pass, and software may act on the answer unseen. We attack six Laya models with 81 programmatic edits of 566 synthetic items (injected sentences, label leaks, edited descriptions, decoy options, invisible and look-alike characters, floods) and report the share of correctly answered items hijacked or lost, with bootstrap intervals. Attack wordings that no defence was built from win the attacker's option on 59% of items for released Laya and 36% for fine-tune v1 (trained on 109 written injections). An injection works through the option name: a sentence naming an option steers the released model even when negated (32%), while an imperative naming no option does not (5%). Option descriptions barely matter (2%). Character edits alone cost v1 up to 72% of right answers. A sanitiser frozen before any held-out result cuts the attacks it was built from by 72% but held-out sentence attacks by 27%, and an attacker who picks the best of 34 held-out strings per item restores success to 84% (mean string 18%). The same oracle takes the model fine-tuned on the four build families of injected sentences from 5% (mean string) to 58%. Fine-tuning on build families only (against an unchanged-rows control) cuts held-out sentence attacks (three held-out families) from 33% to 3% but character edits only from 25% to 20%. A label-free check that deletes the option names and measures the shift flags held-out sentence attacks (AUROC 0.95) but not character edits (0.46), and thresholds set on dev schemas for 5% false alarms gave 8% to 18% on an unseen schema and other languages. All data are synthetic with LLM labels, on one backbone. Several planned runs (other checkpoints, a second seed, some fine-tunes) were not run.

AI.tldr: 该文对开放性决策模型Laya做系统对抗评估：81类程序化编辑、566条合成样本、6个模型，量化注入/字符/洪泛等攻击的成功率与冻结式消毒、微调、无标签检测等防御的泛化边界。
AI.motivation: Laya类开放决策模型单次前向即输出各选项概率，且下游软件可能直接按未见过的答案行动，因此需要知道在输入被恶意或无意扰动时模型是否会被劫持；同时现有防御多在攻击构造集上设计，其跨措辞、跨模板的泛化能力缺乏量化证据。
AI.method: 构造566条合成决策样本，施加81种程序化编辑（注入句、标签泄漏、描述篡改、诱饵选项、不可见与形近字符、洪泛），攻击6个Laya模型，报告被劫持或答错比例及bootstrap区间；对比冻结式消毒器、在注入句构建族上微调（设不变行对照）、以及删除选项名测位移的无标签检测（报告AUROC并跨界阈值测试）。
AI.result: 未参与防御设计的攻击措辞在released版成功劫持59%、在微调v1上36%；注入经选项名起作用——命名选项的句子即使被否定仍达32%，不含选项名的祈使句仅5%；描述篡改仅2%；纯字符编辑使v1损失最多72%正确答案。冻结消毒器对构建族攻击降72%，对留出句攻击仅降27%；逐样本34选1的oracle把留出攻击成功率恢复到84%（平均单串18%）。在四类构建族微调后，oracle攻击由5%升至58%；仅按构建族微调将留出三类家族句子攻击从33%降至3%，字符编辑仅25%→20%。无标签检测对留出句攻击AUROC 0.95，对字符编辑0.46；在dev模式上设5%误报的阈值，迁移到未见模式及其他语言后误报升至8%–18%。
AI.conclusion: Laya式开放决策模型的对抗脆弱性集中于选项名通道，且防御在留出措辞、字符扰动和新模式上泛化有限；单串或单族防御易被搜索型oracle绕过，需多通道、跨分布评估。

title: Detecting Harmful Short Videos in Toxic Diet Culture: A Governance-Ready Evidence Framework with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Algorithmic content moderation is increasingly important for governing short-form video content, yet harmful-content detection research focuses primarily on prediction or limited explanations. This leaves a governance challenge underexplored: producing decision-linked evidence that supports the review and justification of moderation decisions. Using toxic diet culture as an empirical case, we conceptualize governance-ready evidence as computational traceability, evidence localization, policy grounding, and evidence inspectability. We develop the Sparse Autoencoder-based Policy-Aligned Contrastive Evidence (SPACE) framework in a pretrained SAE feature space derived from a large multimodal model. A global relevance gate and decomposable linear evidence head identify decision-linked evidence; segment supervision and within-video ranking localize this evidence; policy alignment maps it to platform guidelines; and Pareto-efficient selection yields a compact, task-specific evidence vocabulary. On 3,711 labeled TikTok videos, SPACE achieves the highest harmful-category Macro F1 among benchmarks across four families, at 0.8507. Its highest-scoring observation overlaps a ground-truth harmful span for 88.0% of harmful test videos, while its evidence representation retrieves the corresponding policy category for 87.0%. Stakeholder evaluations indicate that the SPACE evidence report is perceived as useful for understanding, reviewing, documenting, and responding to moderation decisions. The study contributes computational design science knowledge for embedding governance-ready evidence within predictive content-moderation systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SPACE框架，在预训练大模型稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征空间中为短视频有害内容审核生成"面向治理的可追溯证据"，在3,711条TikTok视频上取得最高Macro F1 0.8507，88.0%有害视频的最高分证据与真实有害片段重叠，87.0%的证据表示可检索到对应政策类别。
AI.motivation: 算法内容审核对短视频治理日益重要，但既有有害内容检测研究多聚焦于预测或有限解释，忽视了一项治理难题：如何产出与决策相链接、可支撑审核复核与决策正当化的证据。作者以"有毒饮食文化"为实证场景，将治理可用证据概念化为四个维度：计算可追溯性、证据定位、政策依据对接、证据可检视性。
AI.method: 在大型多模态模型衍生的预训练SAE特征空间中构建SPACE框架：全局相关性门控与可分解线性证据头识别决策相关证据；片段级监督与视频内排序实现证据定位；政策对齐将证据映射至平台准则；帕累托高效选择得到紧凑、任务特定的证据词表。
AI.result: 在3,711条带标注TikTok视频上，SPACE在四个方法族基准中取得最高的有害类别Macro F1（0.8507）；88.0%的有害测试视频其最高分观测与真实有害片段重叠；87.0%的证据表示可检索到相应政策类别；利益相关者评估显示SPACE证据报告在理解、复核、记录与回应审核决策方面被认为有用。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在预测性内容审核系统中嵌入"面向治理的证据"贡献了计算设计科学知识，将内容审核从单纯预测推进到可追溯、可定位、可对接政策且可检视的证据化治理。

title: Sampling at Scale: Distributed Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization
summary: Multi-agent trajectory optimization poses two coupled challenges: effectively exploring non-convex landscapes and scaling favorably to large teams of agents. Sampling-based methods are natural candidates for the exploration challenge but scale poorly with problem dimension. Moreover, their off-the-shelf integration into distributed optimization introduces a fundamental trade-off: sampling either fails to address the constraint-induced non-convexity or its search space grows with neighborhood size. We address this gap by introducing a $\underline{D}\text{istributed}$ $\underline{S}\text{ampling-based}$ $\underline{T}\text{rajectory}$ $\underline{O}\text{ptimization} \ \text{(DS-TO)}$ architecture built on a splitting mechanism tailored to sampling. Under this splitting, each agent samples only in its own control space, independent of neighborhood size, while still remaining exposed to both the constraint-induced non-convexity and the decisions of other agents. The resulting algorithm is fully decentralized, requiring only neighborhood communication, with all local updates executed in parallel across agents. Efficient variations, including parallel Jacobi updates within each agent's subproblem and single-step constraint linearization, further reduce computation. Experiments on 2D and 3D tasks with up to 1024 agents demonstrate improved exploration and constraint satisfaction over state-of-the-art derivative-based distributed optimization, and superior scalability to existing distributed sampling methods.

AI.tldr: 提出分布式采样轨迹优化架构 DS-TO，通过为采样定制的分裂机制，使每个智能体仅在本体控制空间内采样、与邻域规模无关，实现全去中心化、可并行的多智能体轨迹优化，在多达 1024 个智能体的 2D/3D 任务中优于基于导数的分布式优化与现有分布式采样方法。
AI.motivation: 多智能体轨迹优化存在两个耦合难题：一是非凸地形（由约束诱导）的有效探索，二是面向大规模智能体团队的良好可扩展性。采样方法擅长探索，但随问题维度扩展差；将其直接嵌入分布式优化会带来本质权衡——采样要么无法应对约束诱导的非凸性，要么搜索空间随邻域规模增长。
AI.method: 构建 DS-TO（Distributed Sampling-based Trajectory Optimization）架构：基于为采样定制的分裂（splitting）机制，各智能体仅在其自身控制空间采样，与邻域规模无关，同时仍暴露于约束诱导的非凸性与其他智能体决策；算法完全去中心化，仅需邻域通信，所有局部更新并行执行；并给出高效变体，包括每个子问题内的并行 Jacobi 更新与单步约束线性化。
AI.result: 在 2D 与 3D 任务（智能体数量最多 1024）上，相较最先进的基于导数的分布式优化方法，探索能力与约束满足程度均有提升；相较现有分布式采样方法具备更优的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: DS-TO 以采样导向的分裂机制化解了分布式采样在探索能力与可扩展性之间的权衡，为大规模多智能体轨迹优化提供了可扩展、去中心化且约束满足良好的方案。

title: Which Ellipses Are Outlines of a Given Ellipsoid? A Ratio Test with Unknown Focal Length
comment: 36 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables; supplementary material included as an ancillary file. Submitted to SIAM Journal on Imaging Sciences. Code: https://github.com/michael-werman/realizability-code
summary: When is an image ellipse the outline of a given ellipsoid with semi-axes $a <= b <= c? For a camera with square pixels, zero skew and known principal point, we show that it is an outline at focal length $f$ exactly when a cone ratio kappa(f), computed from two eigenvalues, is at most a/c; the middle semi-axis b plays no role. With f unknown, the admissible focal lengths form an interval; whether it is empty is decided by the smallest cone ratio over $f$, which, when attained, is obtained from an explicit quartic. The interval is bounded above only when the principal point is closer to the long axis of the ellipse than to its short axis. Thus one ellipse can rule out ellipsoids that are too round, never ones that are too elongated, and none if the principal point is unknown. Simulations and 45 Cassini images of Saturn's moons support the test.

AI.tldr: 本文给出一个可直接检验的判据：在方像素、零倾斜、主点已知的相机假设下，一条图像椭圆是某个半轴为 a≤b≤c 的椭球的轮廓，当且仅当由两个特征值算出的锥比 κ(f) ≤ a/c；中间半轴 b 不影响判定。焦距未知时可行焦距构成区间，其非空性由 κ(f) 的最小值（可由显式四次方程求得）决定；仅当主点更靠近椭圆长轴时区间才有上界。
AI.motivation: 从单张图像中的一条椭圆轮廓反推三维椭球几何是视觉与天体测量中的基础问题，但现有方法多为拟合式重建，缺少简洁、可判定的充要条件。作者希望明确回答"给定图像椭圆能否是某个给定形状（a,b,c）椭球的轮廓"，并厘清焦距未知、主点位置对可解性的影响，从而为形状排除与可行性判断提供理论工具。
AI.method: 以方像素、零倾斜、主点已知的相机模型为基础，将图像椭圆由两个特征值（即长短轴平方）参数化，构造随焦距 f 变化的"锥比"κ(f)（由轮廓锥的轴比关系导出）。证明轮廓存在性与 κ(f) ≤ a/c 等价，且与 b 无关。对焦距未知情形，把可行集刻画为 κ(f) 的下水平集，证明其为区间，并用求 κ(f) 极值导出的显式四次方程确定最小值及非空性；再依据主点相对椭圆长、短轴的距离讨论区间是否有上界。最后用仿真与 45 幅土星卫星（Cassini）实测图像做验证。
AI.result: 理论上得到：给定 (a,c) 时判定条件为 κ(f) ≤ a/c，且 b 完全不起作用；f 未知时可行焦距集合是区间，非空性取决于 κ(f) 的最小值是否不超过 a/c，该最小值在可取到时由显式四次方程的根给出；当且仅当主点离椭圆长轴更近（相较于短轴）时，可行焦距区间才有上界。据此，一条椭圆可以排除"过圆"的椭球，但永远无法排除"过扁长"的椭球；若主点未知，则任何椭球都无法被排除。仿真实验与 45 幅 Cassini 土星卫星图像支持该判据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把"图像椭圆是否为给定椭球轮廓"的问题化归为一个关于焦距的一维锥比不等式，给出闭式、可判定的充要条件及焦距可行区间的解析刻画，明确了单视图形状约束的方向性与信息极限（只能排除过圆形状、无法排除过长形状、主点未知时无约束力），并以实测图像验证了实用性。

title: ContextLure: Exploiting Benign Conversation History for Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: As LLMs become more capable, agents can perform more complex tasks with tools and maintain longer interactions with users. These benign conversations contain evidence on task results, user concerns, and operational constraints. The risk is that attackers who can observe benign conversations (evidence) may construct stronger indirect prompt injections without increasing the attackers' control over prior turns or the later injection. However, we still lack a clear study of how effectively attackers can select and use this evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ContextLure, a red-teaming framework in which an attacker silently observes an existing benign conversation, extracts evidence, and constructs an injection. The challenges are twofold: (a) selecting useful evidence and (b) presenting it as reasons for an unauthorized action, without changing the prior benign conversation. To efficiently exploit (a) the effect of evidence on attack success, our framework selects evidence across 2 dimensions: User/System Preferences with 3 selection policies. And to enhance (b) the process of turning the selected information into the malicious request, we introduce an Urgency/Priority matrix with 4 rewriting strategies. Across the evaluated conditions, we reach 67.4% ASR on AgentDojo and 87.3% on InjecAgent. These results show that attackers can use benign interaction evidence in later attacks without first poisoning the benign conversation.

AI.tldr: 提出ContextLure红队框架：攻击者静默观察良性对话并提取证据构造间接提示注入，在AgentDojo上达67.4% ASR、InjecAgent上达87.3% ASR。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体能力增强后与用户进行更长时间、更复杂的良性交互，其中包含任务结果、用户关切与操作约束等证据；能被观察这些良性对话的攻击者可在不增加对先前轮次或后续注入控制力的前提下构造更强间接提示注入，但现有研究缺乏对攻击者如何有效选择与利用此类证据的清晰认识。
AI.method: ContextLure框架：攻击者在不改动良性对话的前提下静默观察、抽取证据并构造注入。针对难点(a)证据选择，沿User/System Preferences两个维度、采用3种选择策略筛选证据；针对难点(b)将所选信息转化为恶意请求，设计Urgency/Priority矩阵含4种重写策略。
AI.result: 在所评估的各条件下，AgentDojo上攻击成功率达67.4%，InjecAgent上达87.3%。
AI.conclusion: 攻击者无需预先污染良性对话，即可在后续攻击中利用良性交互证据显著提升间接提示注入的成功率，表明良性对话证据构成现实的攻击面。

title: CaLA: Causal Latent Adjustment for World Models under Adaptive Policies
summary: World models is answering ``imagine" answers to ``what-if'' questions via imagined rollouts. But rollouts collected by adaptive policies induce treatment-outcome confounding in imagined rollouts. We study this problem in Match-3 difficulty adjustment, where latent player skill influences both assigned difficulty and churn. We build a fully specified Match-3 SCM with sequential mechanics, adaptive assignment, and paired ground-truth interventions, on which unadjusted models fit to the logged trajectories select difficulty settings that raise churn. We then introduce Causal Latent Adjustment (CaLA), a DAG-constrained world model that infers a variational player representation from pretreatment history. Across our evaluations, CaLA provides the most reliable population-level intervention estimates and competitive individualized decisions, although rich handcrafted histories can remain advantageous for individual-level adjustment. We further find that residual correction can degrade causal decision quality despite improving predictive fit, highlighting the need to distinguish predictive accuracy, confounding adjustment and the behavior of downstream causal estimators.

AI.tldr: 论文研究世界模型在自适应策略收集的 imagined rollout 中存在 treatment-outcome 混杂的问题，以 Match-3 难度调整为场景构建完整 SCM，并提出 DAG 约束的世界模型 CaLA，用预处理历史推断变分玩家表征以消除混杂；结果显示 CaLA 给出最可靠的人群级干预估计，且残差修正虽提升预测拟合却可能损害因果决策质量。
AI.motivation: 世界模型通过 imagined rollout 回答"what-if"问题，但当 rollout 由自适应策略收集时，潜在玩家技能等混杂因子会同时影响被分配的难度与实际流失（churn），导致 treatment-outcome 混杂，使拟合日志轨迹的模型做出错误的干预推断。作者希望在一个可控且完全显式的环境中系统刻画该问题，并给出可行的因果校正方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建一个完全给定的 Match-3 SCM（结构因果模型），包含序列化机制、自适应难度分配以及成对（paired）的 ground-truth 干预，用于评测干预估计与个体决策；2) 提出 Causal Latent Adjustment (CaLA)：一个受 DAG 约束的世界模型，从预处理（pretreatment）历史中推断变分玩家表征，以阻断混杂路径；3) 与未校正的日志拟合模型、以及使用丰富手工特征历史的模型进行对比，并考察残差修正对因果决策的影响。
AI.result: 未校正、仅拟合日志轨迹的模型所选的难度设置会提高 churn（即再现了混杂导致的错误决策）。CaLA 在人群级干预估计上最为可靠，个体级决策也具竞争力；但对于个体级调整，丰富的手工历史特征仍可能更有优势。此外，残差修正虽然改善了预测拟合，却可能降低因果决策质量。
AI.conclusion: 在自适应策略驱动的世界模型中，混杂是不可忽视的问题；基于 DAG 约束并从预处理历史推断潜在表征的 CaLA 能有效改善人群级干预估计。研究还强调必须区分预测精度、混杂校正与下游因果估计器行为三者，不能以预测拟合提升作为因果决策质量改善的依据。

title: FabricBench: A Standardized Policy Benchmark for Bimanual Fabric Manipulation with a Contact-Driven Deformable Simulator
summary: Fabric manipulation challenges robot policies with changing geometry, self-occlusion, and contact, yet standardized evaluation remains focused on rigid objects. We introduce FabricBench, a benchmark for bimanual fabric manipulation with six tasks spanning garments, silk, and bags, 10,000 simulation-ready assets, and controlled tests of configuration and appearance generalization. Built on an open-source solver in Newton, our simulator enables stable bimanual grasping, holding, and release through contact forces, without artificial attachment. Redesigned cloth-rigid contact and bidirectional force coupling support interactions among robot arms, fabric, and free rigid objects, allowing a bag to support its contents and transmit their weight to the grippers. In a controlled grasp-hold-release evaluation, our solver succeeds in all 45 trials, compared with none for the tested baseline configurations. Evaluating six representative policies, including vision-language-action models and world action models, reveals substantial remaining challenges: the best policy achieves 77% average success, while no policy exceeds 36% on long-horizon T-shirt folding. Under the most deformed initial T-shirt configurations, success falls to 6-14% across policies, with larger drops than under the evaluated appearance shifts. Zero-shot deployment of $π_{0.5}$ on a real robot largely preserves task difficulty ordering across six tasks (Spearman $ρ=0.94$). These results establish FabricBench as a reproducible testbed for measuring fabric-manipulation capabilities and exposing limitations in configuration generalization. The project website is available at https://fabricbench.github.io/.

AI.tldr: FabricBench：面向双臂布料操作的标准化基准，含6任务、10,000仿真就绪资产，基于Newton开源求解器实现真实接触式抓取-保持-释放，并系统评测配置与外观泛化。
AI.motivation: 布料操作面临几何形变、自遮挡与接触复杂性，但现有标准评测仍以刚体物体为主，缺乏可复现、可控制的布料操作基准，难以衡量策略在配置泛化上的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建涵盖服装、丝绸、包袋的6类双臂任务与10,000个仿真就绪资产；在Newton开源求解器上重建布料-刚体接触与双向力耦合，实现无人工附着的稳定抓取、保持与释放，支持布料与自由刚体（如包内物品）交互；设计配置与外观扰动的受控泛化实验，并评测6种代表性策略（含VLA与世界动作模型），另做真机零样本迁移验证。
AI.result: 抓取-保持-释放受控测试45/45成功，基线配置0/45；最佳策略平均成功率77%，但长时序T恤折叠无一超过36%；在最变形的初始T恤配置下成功率降至6%–14%，降幅大于外观扰动；π0.5零样本真机部署基本保持六任务难度排序（Spearman ρ=0.94）。
AI.conclusion: FabricBench提供了可复现的布料操作评测平台，揭示当前策略在长时序任务与极端配置泛化上的显著短板；仿真难度排序可较好迁移至真机，表明其可作为衡量与诊断布料操作能力的有效测试台。

title: Ground, Guide, Act: Improving VLA Spatial Generalization with Multimodal Foundation Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models effectively learn action policies from robot demonstrations, but struggle to generalize to changes in object positions and task goals. General multimodal foundation models (MFMs) offer complementary scene understanding and spatial reasoning, but remain slow and unreliable for direct fine-grained control. To understand how MFMs can improve VLA spatial generalization, we conduct a systematic capability analysis across multiple VLA architectures using atomic-stage interventions, revealing that many failures stem from poor target grounding and global spatial routing, while local manipulation skills remain largely usable. Based on these findings, we propose MFM-VLA, a selective collaboration framework in which an MFM provides target grounding and spatial guidance, controllers execute free-space motion, and the VLA retains control over fine-grained manipulation. We fine-tune the VLA with action-chunk-level dense geometric captions and perturbed-state recovery data to improve local guidance following and recovery from unfamiliar handoff states. A development-calibrated capability router selects between direct VLA execution and MFM-assisted execution to avoid unnecessary intervention. Across LIBERO-PRO, ALOHA-Sim-PRO, RoboCasa365, and real-world chemistry tasks, MFM-VLA improves success rates by 14.9, 74.0, 3.6, and 30.9 percentage points, respectively, over the corresponding base VLA. The project page is available at https://tom-zgt.github.io/MFM-VLA

AI.tldr: 本文提出MFM-VLA，一种多模态基座模型（MFM）与VLA的选择性协作框架：MFM负责目标定位与空间路由，控制器执行自由空间运动，VLA保留细粒度操作能力，从而显著提升VLA的空间泛化成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型能从机器人示教中学习动作策略，但在物体位置变化与任务目标变化下泛化能力差；多模态基座模型具备场景理解与空间推理能力，却速度慢、难以直接用于细粒度控制。作者希望系统性地定位VLA失败根源，并设计一种扬长避短的协作机制。
AI.method: 1）通过原子阶段（atomic-stage）干预对多种VLA架构进行系统能力分析；2）据此设计MFM-VLA选择性协作框架：MFM提供目标定位与空间引导，控制器执行自由空间运动，VLA负责细粒度操作；3）用动作块级（action-chunk-level）稠密几何描述与扰动状态恢复数据微调VLA，提升其对局部引导的跟随与从陌生交接状态恢复的能力；4）引入开发集校准的能力路由器，在直接VLA执行与MFM辅助执行间选择，避免不必要干预。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO、ALOHA-Sim-PRO、RoboCasa365及真实化学实验任务上，相较对应基座VLA，成功率分别提升14.9、74.0、3.6和30.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: VLA的空间泛化失败主要源于目标定位与全局空间路由缺陷，而非局部操作技能缺失；将MFM用于高层定位与路由、VLA用于局部操作的选择性协作，并配合针对性微调与能力路由，可大幅提升空间泛化性能。

title: Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training
summary: LLM agents operate through harnesses that define system prompts, action formats, feedback loops, and resource constraints. A model may possess the knowledge needed to solve a task yet fail to express that knowledge through a particular harness. This raises a basic question: when a policy fails under a given harness, is it missing task knowledge or the competence to operate the interface? We distinguish two components of agentic competence: task competence, the knowledge and reasoning needed to solve a task, and interface competence, the ability to act on that knowledge through a given harness. Across four reasoning and agentic benchmarks, we show that harness-conditioned training yields vastly different outcomes depending on how these interact. Multi-harness distillation aggregates task knowledge from trajectories collected through different harnesses into a shared policy, but this knowledge is realised only when training preserves or improves competence on the inference-time interface. Otherwise, single-harness training can induce interference in interface competence, sometimes catastrophically collapsing performance on a held-out harness despite improvements in underlying task knowledge. To disentangle task and interface supervision, we introduce harness rehearsal: distillation on traces that carry minimal task knowledge while exercising the target interface. Cross-harness task supervision or rehearsal alone yields little gain, but their combination yields gains far larger than either: on BFCL V3 multi-turn with Qwen3-4B, they achieve 8.5% and 32.5% respectively, versus 58.8% together. Finally, on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is more robust than distillation to single-harness training: it does not substantially degrade performance on other harnesses, and interface competence acquired through multi-harness distillation persists through subsequent RL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出智能体能力可分解为"任务能力"与"接口能力"，用多harness蒸馏与harness rehearsal解耦二者监督，证明跨harness任务监督与接口练习必须结合才能取得大幅增益，且RL比蒸馏对单一harness训练更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通过harness（系统提示、动作格式、反馈循环、资源约束）运行，模型可能具备任务知识却无法在特定harness中表达。核心问题：策略在某harness下失败，是缺任务知识还是缺操作接口的能力？这一区分此前未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 提出任务能力与接口能力的二分框架；在四个推理/智能体基准上考察harness条件化训练；使用多harness蒸馏将不同harness轨迹的任务知识聚合进共享策略；提出harness rehearsal——在几乎不含任务知识的轨迹上仅练习目标接口以分离接口监督；并与跨harness任务监督单独、组合进行对照；另比较on-policy RL与蒸馏在单一harness训练下的迁移/退化表现。
AI.result: 单一harness训练可能引发接口能力干扰，在未见harness上出现灾难性性能崩塌，即便底层任务知识提升；单独的跨harness任务监督或rehearsal增益很小。Qwen3-4B在BFCL V3多轮上：仅跨harness任务监督8.5%，仅rehearsal 32.5%，二者结合58.8%。
AI.conclusion: 任务知识与接口能力需分别监督、协同训练；多harness蒸馏获得的知识只有在推理时接口能力被保持或提升时才能兑现。on-policy RL对单一harness训练更鲁棒，不显著损害其他harness表现，且多harness蒸馏习得的接口能力可在后续RL中保持。

title: Is 4 Bits Enough for EEG Sleep Staging? A Subject-Level Benchmark of MXFP4, NVFP4 and FP8
summary: Staging sleep on a wearable device keeps the raw electroencephalogram (EEG) private and saves the energy needed to transmit it. It also requires small, energy-efficient neural networks. We benchmark 13 post-training quantization (PTQ) configurations, from FP16 to the block-scaled 4-bit formats MXFP4 and NVFP4, for five-stage sleep staging from single-channel Fpz-Cz EEG. We use Sleep-EDF-78 (78 subjects), subject-wise cross-validation, three training seeds, value-exact emulation, and per-subject paired statistics. All 8- and 16-bit formats stay within 0.45 percentage points (pp) of FP32 Macro-F1. With 4-bit weights and activations, an epoch-wise CNN loses 1.98 to 3.04 pp, and a temporal-context network loses at most 1.19 pp. A same-encoder ablation shows that temporal context explains little of this gap.
