AI.result: 在真实、高度不平衡的工业 I&C 测试数据集上，SOTS-Greedy 仅用 30% 训练数据即达到全数据集精度的 95% 以上，在多数预算下优于标准核心集基线；该优势可推广到公开 UEA 规则多变量时间序列基准，但仅在类别判别信息纯粹为几何结构时成立。
AI.conclusion: 路径签名+Sliced Wasserstein 贪心选择为不规则多变量时间序列提供了一种有效的无监督核心集方法，在工业场景显著节省标注；但其收益依赖几何型判别信息，适用范围存在明确边界。

title: Beyond the Benchmark: Localizing Released Autonomous Driving Models to Real Vehicles
summary: Released autonomous-driving models achieve strong benchmark performance, yet deploying them on a new real vehicle remains challenging. We study this deployment gap and find that released models can remain coupled to assumptions from their source sensing, data, and execution processes even after conventional adaptation. We introduce Released-to-Real (R2R), a deployment-localization methodology that identifies such source-system coupling and corrects only the affected components while preserving the released model. For data and behavior adaptation, we find that the mismatch between trajectory-level optimization and receding-horizon execution enters through the ego state rather than the observation, and introduce Human-Anchored Reinforcement Learning (HA-RL), which corrects it on recorded target driving without the costly rollouts of generative closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). For physical sensor adaptation, R2R localizes and corrects source-dependent spatial and temporal representations with frozen perception weights, requiring neither target annotations nor retraining. HA-RL improves the closed-loop success rate of a released diffusion-based planner from 82.2% to 95.2%, while sensor adaptation across multiple released detectors and three real sensor rigs improves the vehicle mean average precision (mAP) of a released multi-camera detector from 0.041 to 0.420 on a five-camera target rig. These results provide a practical path for preparing released models before deployment on new real vehicles. Our project page is publicly available at https://released-to-real.github.io.

AI.tldr: 论文研究已发布自动驾驶模型在新实车上的"部署鸿沟"，提出Released-to-Real（R2R）部署定位方法：通过识别并仅修正源系统耦合组件，在不破坏已发布模型的前提下完成数据/行为与物理传感器两类适配，显著提升闭环成功率与实车mAP。
AI.motivation: 已发布自动驾驶模型在基准上表现优异，但迁移至新实车时仍难以部署。作者发现即使经过常规适配，模型仍与源端的传感、数据与执行过程假设深度耦合，因此需要一种能定位并最小化修正此类耦合的部署方法。
AI.method: 提出R2R部署定位方法学：定位源系统耦合来源，仅修正受影响组件并冻结其余已发布权重。(1) 数据与行为适配：指出轨迹级优化与滚动时域执行的不匹配通过自车状态而非观测引入，提出Human-Anchored Reinforcement Learning（HA-RL），在记录的目标驾驶数据上完成修正，避免生成式闭环RL的高成本rollout。(2) 物理传感器适配：以冻结感知权重定位并校正源相关的空间与时间表征，无需目标域标注与重训练。
AI.result: HA-RL将已发布扩散式规划器的闭环成功率从82.2%提升至95.2%；传感器适配在多个已发布检测器与三套真实传感器配置上，使五相机目标配置下已发布多相机检测器的实车mAP从0.041提升至0.420。
AI.conclusion: R2R为已发布模型在新实车部署前的准备提供了可行路径：通过定位源系统耦合并进行最小化、免标注、免重训练的定向修正，可有效跨越部署鸿沟。

title: Fast Anatomy-Aware Diffeomorphic Augmentation for Brain MRI
summary: Data augmentation is essential for training deep learning models that are generalizable, particularly when training data are limited. In brain MRI, augmentation methods that synthesize anatomically diverse images without relying on large cohorts are particularly attractive, especially when training supervised models for scans with a specific resolution or MRI contrast. While conventional random nonlinear fields offer a simple means of achieving such diversity, they fail to capture the underlying spatial dependencies among morphological changes across brain regions. To address this limitation, we introduce BrainAug, an anatomy-aware augmentation framework that generates diverse, anatomically coordinated deformations without relying on population imaging data. BrainAug constructs an anatomical graph encoding spatial proximity and bilateral correspondence between brain regions, then incorporates these relationships into a probabilistic model designed to sample correlated regional volume changes. These sampled variations are translated into diffeomorphic transformations, enabling substantial structural changes while preserving anatomical topology. Combined with contrast-agnostic image synthesis, BrainAug generates training images with independently varying anatomy and appearance. Evaluations across eight brain MRI datasets demonstrate stronger segmentation generalization across diverse populations, while registration experiments show improved alignment under substantial morphological differences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BrainAug，一种不依赖群体影像数据的解剖感知数据增强框架，通过构建脑区解剖图并结合概率模型采样相关区域体积变化，生成保持拓扑的微分同胚形变，配合对比度无关的图像合成，显著提升脑MRI分割与配准的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 脑MRI训练数据往往有限，且当需要针对特定分辨率或特定MRI对比度训练监督模型时，难以依赖大规模队列。传统随机非线性形变场虽简单，但无法刻画不同脑区形态变化之间的空间依赖性，导致合成的解剖多样性不足。
AI.method: BrainAug 首先构建编码脑区间空间邻近性与左右对称对应关系的解剖图，再将此类关系嵌入概率模型以采样具有相关性的区域体积变化，并将采样结果转化为微分同胚变换，从而在保持解剖拓扑的前提下实现显著结构变化；最后与对比度无关的图像合成结合，实现解剖结构与外观的独立变化。
AI.result: 在八个脑MRI数据集上的评估表明，该方法在不同人群上带来更强的分割泛化性能；配准实验显示在存在较大形态差异时对齐效果得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 解剖结构协调、无需群体数据的形变增强是一种有效且可推广的策略，可同时提升脑MRI分割与配准模型对解剖变异的鲁棒性。

title: Off-the-Shelf Autonomous Agents for Game Playtesting
summary: In playtesting games, a human operator is typically required to test most gameplay elements. In this work we present Buddy, an autonomous game solving agent which can solve long time horizon objectives in an unseen 3D role-playing game using off-the-shelf language model systems. Buddy will take actions, receive feedback on those actions, and pursue a goal across many turns. No written walkthrough or model training of any kind is required, and we show that this paradigm holds in a novel environment where the agent must discover solutions via exploration rather than recalling them from pretraining. We demonstrate three downstream capabilities: game solving with no provided walkthrough, logging bug tickets for encountered difficulties, and conversion of successful agent traces into scripted hierarchical task networks for regression testing. Unlike existing playtesting solutions, our framework is fully modular: language models and harnesses can be easily swapped out as capabilities improve over time.

AI.tldr: 提出Buddy——一个基于现成语言模型的自主游戏求解智能体，可在未见过的3D角色扮演游戏中通过多轮探索完成长时程目标，无需攻略或模型训练，并支持打bug单与轨迹转HTN脚本用于回归测试。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏playtesting通常依赖人工操作者测试多数玩法元素，成本高且难以规模化；同时大语言模型若依赖预训练记忆中的攻略，则无法验证其在真正新颖环境中的探索能力。
AI.method: Buddy以off-the-shelf语言模型系统为核心，采用"执行动作—接收反馈—继续推理"的多轮闭环范式，不提供书面walkthrough、不进行任何模型训练；框架为全模块化设计，语言模型与执行harness均可替换。在新颖3D RPG环境中要求智能体通过探索发现解法，并额外实现：记录遇到困难的bug工单、将成功的智能体轨迹转换为分层的HTN脚本。
AI.result: 在未经预训练覆盖的新环境中实现了长时程目标的自主求解，证明该范式不依赖记忆而是依靠探索；并成功演示三项下游能力：无攻略游戏通关、自动生成bug工单、成功轨迹到分层任务网络脚本的转换（可用于回归测试）。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型驱动的模块化自主智能体可作为可扩展的游戏playtesting方案，兼具求解、缺陷报告与测试脚本生成能力，且随模型能力提升可无缝替换组件，具备良好的可维护性与扩展性。

title: Diagnosing Epistemic Uncertainty in Neural Operators: Effects of Initialization, Discretization, and Function Sampling
summary: Neural operators provide efficient surrogates for mappings between function spaces, but their reliability cannot be characterized by the performance of a single trained model. Existing neural operator uncertainty quantification approaches often characterize predictive uncertainty without separately identifying the contributions of individual sources of epistemic uncertainty. Finite sampling of the training function space, output discretization, and model initialization can produce substantial variation among learned operators even when the underlying physical problem is deterministic. We systematically investigate these sources of epistemic uncertainty across a diverse set of operator learning architectures. Across our experiments, we train approximately 46,000 neural operator models and construct ensembles over training datasets, model initializations, and output discretizations to characterize distributions of relative $L_2$ error rather than individual trained realizations. We find substantial architecture-dependent differences in epistemic uncertainty, with model initialization often accounting for the largest proportion of variance in relative $L_2$ error. The ranked performance of neural operator architectures can invert as the number and spatial distribution of output samples change, with the best architectures under sparse or randomly sampled observations differing from those at higher-resolution or structured discretizations. Furthermore, ensembles that reliably characterize aggregate operator error can provide unreliable estimates of error quantiles for individual test functions. These results highlight the importance of distinguishing the sources of epistemic uncertainty when evaluating neural operator reliability and establishing robust benchmarking practices.

AI.tldr: 系统研究了神经算子中三类认知不确定性来源（训练集采样、输出离散化、模型初始化），通过约46,000个模型的集成实验发现：模型初始化通常贡献相对L2误差方差的最大比例；架构排名会随输出采样数量与空间分布改变而反转；可靠刻画总体误差的集成对单个测试函数的误差分位数估计可能不可靠。
AI.motivation: 神经算子可作为函数空间映射的高效代理模型，但其可靠性无法由单个已训练模型的表现来刻画。现有不确定性量化方法往往只给出预测不确定性，未区分各认知不确定性来源的贡献。而训练函数空间的有限采样、输出离散化与模型初始化，即便在底层物理问题确定的情形下，也会导致学到的算子存在显著差异，因此需要系统拆分并量化这些来源。
AI.method: 在多种算子学习架构上系统开展实验，共训练约46,000个神经算子模型；分别针对训练数据集、模型初始化与输出离散化构建集成，从而刻画相对L2误差的分布，而非依赖单个训练实现的性能；并比较误差方差在不同来源间的分配以及不同输出采样条件下的架构排名。
AI.result: 认知不确定性存在显著的架构依赖性差异；模型初始化通常占相对L2误差方差的最大比例；随着输出样本数量与空间分布的变化，神经算子架构的性能排名可能发生反转——稀疏或随机采样观测下的最优架构不同于高分辨率或结构化离散化下的最优架构；此外，能够可靠刻画总体算子误差的集成，对单个测试函数的误差分位数估计并不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 评估神经算子可靠性时必须区分认知不确定性的不同来源，并据此建立更稳健的基准测试规范；仅报告单一模型性能或单一集成的总体误差不足以说明算子学习的可信度。

title: VG-GP: Uncertainty-Gated Visuo-Geometric Memory for Negative-Transfer-Resistant Grasp Adaptation
summary: Pretrained antipodal grasping networks generalize well to canonical shapes but frequently fail zero-shot on novel objects with irregular mass distributions, thin rims, or unfamiliar handles. While episodic experience memory adapts a frozen base policy without retraining, naive retrieval suffers from visual appearance bias, negative transfer from overriding working base grasps, and degenerate closed-loop acquisition. We present VG-GP, a plug-and-play Visuo-Geometric Gaussian Process memory framework for closed-loop $SE(2)$ residual grasp transfer. First, we fuse color-invariant surface-normal DINOv2 features, canonical $SE(2)$ gripper-aligned 3D local heightmaps, and contact-geometry descriptors under a product kernel with Automatic Relevance Determination (ARD) lengthscales learned strictly on source objects. Second, we model the joint posterior over the base grasp and candidate $SE(2)$ alternatives, overriding the base policy only when the joint-covariance Lower Confidence Bound (LCB) clears a risk-sensitive threshold. Third, an online counterfactual curation gate using single-record necessity and sufficiency interventions quarantines source experiences causing negative transfer. Fourth, we close the acquisition loop via Bayesian Expected Improvement (EI) over equal-budget $SE(2)$ probes. Across 42 disjoint YCB objects in ManiSkill3 (20 source, 12 development, 10 held-out test), VG-GP wraps a pretrained GR-ConvNet base policy and raises physical lift rate across all 22 unseen objects from 38.6% (34/88) to 53.4% (47/88) with zero regressions (+13 rescues, 0 losses; object-clustered 95% CI [+6.8%, +22.7%], exact McNemar $p = 0.00024$). On the 10 held-out objects, EI active acquisition reaches 45.0% (18/40 vs. 32.5% base, 5/7 of oracle headroom), achieves 55.0% probe divergence over passive fallback, and monotonically reduces epistemic uncertainty.

AI.tldr: VG-GP 是一种即插即用的"视-几何高斯过程"经验记忆框架，用于闭环 SE(2) 残差抓取迁移，在不重训练基础策略的前提下，将预训练对跖抓取网络在 22 个未见物体上的物理抬升成功率从 38.6% 提升到 53.4%，且零退化。
AI.motivation: 预训练对跖抓取网络对常规形状泛化良好，但在质量分布不规则、薄边缘、陌生手柄等新物体上零样本失败率高。情节式经验记忆虽可免训练地适配冻结基础策略，但朴素检索存在三个问题：(1) 视觉外观偏置；(2) 覆盖有效基础抓取导致负迁移；(3) 闭环采集退化。
AI.method: 1) 特征融合：颜色不变的表面法向 DINOv2 特征 + 规范 SE(2) 夹爪对齐 3D 局部高度图 + 接触几何描述子，采用乘积核，ARD 长度尺度仅在源物体上学习；2) 联合后验建模基础抓取与候选 SE(2) 替代方案，仅当联合协方差下置信界（LCB）超过风险敏感阈值才覆盖基础策略；3) 在线反事实策展门，用单记录必要性与充分性干预隔离引发负迁移的源经验；4) 以等预算 SE(2) 探针上的贝叶斯期望改进（EI）闭合采集循环。
AI.result: 在 ManiSkill3 的 42 个互斥 YCB 物体（20 源 / 12 开发 / 10 留出测试）上包裹预训练 GR-ConvNet：全部 22 个未见物体抬升率由 38.6%(34/88) 升至 53.4%(47/88)，13 次挽救、0 次损失，物体聚类 95% CI [+6.8%, +22.7%]，精确 McNemar p=0.00024。10 个留出物体上，EI 主动采集达 45.0%(18/40，基线 32.5%)，取得 oracle 提升空间的 5/7；相对被动回退实现 55.0% 探针分歧率，并单调降低认知不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 视-几何联合建模、风险敏感覆盖判据与反事实经验策展相结合，可使冻结基础抓取策略在不重训练条件下实现安全、无损的零样本迁移；EI 驱动的闭环 SE(2) 主动采集优于被动回退，是高效利用有限探针预算的关键。

title: Lit Up but Not Needed: Scoped Lesions Show Where Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Depend on Their Experts
summary: Cognitive neuroscience learned that an activation map is not a map of necessity. Regions that light up during a task are not always needed for it, and only lesions reveal which ones are. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) vision-language models come with an activation map for free, since the router records which experts respond to image and text tokens, and recent work reads modality-specialized experts off this map. We bring the lesion. In Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, Kimi-VL-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, 3 to 12% of the experts are vision-exclusive: image tokens route to them at up to five times the uniform rate and text tokens almost never. In Qwen3-VL they receive a quarter of all image-token routing, and lesioning all of them costs less than one percentage point on average over eight perception benchmarks and free-form OCR, no more than lesioning a random set of the same size. In Kimi-VL and Gemma-4 the lesion also costs no more than a random set. Scoped lesions, which remove an expert set only at image positions or only at text positions, then show where the models do depend on their experts. In Qwen3-VL, silencing every expert at every image position costs 3 points, against 45 at text positions, where the dependence sits in dual-use experts that text-only tasks need as well. Across models the image-side dependence is 2 to 3 points in Qwen3-VL and Kimi-VL and 26 in Gemma-4. Reading text in images is the one ability that needs image-position experts in every model. The exclusive experts receive informative patches, produce outputs of ordinary size, and stay inert under sensory deprivation: text-only training recruits them only when load balancing forces it. In Kimi-VL the balancing bias itself manufactures most of them. Load balancing draws the modality map in the part of the computation the models depend on least. Expert selection, pruning and skipping should follow the lesion, not the map.

AI.tldr: 在Qwen3-VL、Kimi-VL、Gemma-4等MoE视觉语言模型中，3–12%的专家为"视觉专属"，但其损伤几乎不影响性能；真正的图像侧依赖集中在共享（dual-use）专家上，因此专家选择/剪枝应依据损伤实验而非路由激活图。
AI.motivation: 认知神经科学表明，任务中"激活"的区域并非"必需"——只有损伤（lesion）才能揭示哪些区域真正被依赖。MoE视觉语言模型的路由器天然提供了一张激活图，近期工作据此识别"模态专属性专家"。本文质疑这种由激活图推断功能必要性的做法，主张用损伤实验替代。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B、Kimi-VL-A3B、Gemma-4-26B-A4B上：1) 统计视觉专属专家（图像token以远高于均匀分布的比例路由、文本token几乎不路由）；2) 对全部视觉专属专家进行损伤，与同规模随机专家集合在八个感知基准及自由格式OCR上对比；3) 进行"限定范围损伤"（仅在图像位置或仅在文本位置移除专家集），定位依赖所在；4) 分析专属专家的输入patch信息量、输出幅值，以及纯文本训练下的惰性表现与负载均衡偏置的作用。
AI.result: Qwen3-VL中视觉专属专家占3–12%，接收全部图像token路由的四分之一，图像token路由率最高达均匀的5倍；损伤全部此类专家的损失不足1个百分点，且不高于随机同规模集合。Kimi-VL与Gemma-4同样未见更高损失。限定损伤显示：Qwen3-VL在所有图像位置静默全部专家损失3点，而文本位置达45点，依赖位于文本任务也需要的双用途专家；图像侧依赖在Qwen3-VL、Kimi-VL为2–3点，Gemma-4为26点。读图中的文字（OCR）是唯一在每个模型中都依赖图像位置专家的能力。专属专家接收信息量高的patch、输出幅值正常、在感官剥夺下保持惰性（纯文本训练仅在负载均衡强制时才招募它们）；Kimi-VL中负载均衡偏置本身制造了大部分此类专家。
AI.conclusion: 路由激活图描绘的模态分工，恰恰落在模型依赖最弱的计算部分；负载均衡会人为制造"专属"专家。专家选择、剪枝与跳过的策略应以损伤实验为依据，而非激活图。

title: Safe Autoformalization: Sufficiency and Necessity with Entailment Graphs
comment: 34 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. The results are machine-checked in Lean 4
summary: Autoformalization translates a natural-language statement into a formula that captures its intent, which depends on the statement's context: the background that disambiguates it. LLMs make autoformalization practical, but their probabilistic output carries no formal guarantees. We propose techniques for safe autoformalization that certify one-sided logical adequacy: a formula sufficient for the intent is safe to enforce, and a formula necessary for it is safe to rely on. We use LLMs to generate candidate formulas and order them by logical strength in an Entailment Graph (EG), an ordering a solver decides. Each edge carries a residual and a co-residual, the two adjoints of the entailment order, all fixed by the candidate pool alone. In a context, two searches return the sufficient frontier, the weakest candidates that entail the statement, and the necessary frontier, the strongest candidates the statement entails; each step is one local check against an edge's residual or co-residual. The frontiers bracket the statement and yield the ambiguity residue, which holds exactly of the situations the candidates certify neither as satisfying nor as violating it; the statement is ambiguous precisely when the residue is satisfiable. For natural-language statements and contexts, an LLM entailment oracle decides the checks; it is sound if it accepts only checks that hold, and complete if it accepts every check that holds. We prove that a sound oracle makes the search safe regardless of pool quality, and that a complete one makes the frontiers tight. On security-critical AWS properties, EGs are safe in all 20 cases of an expert-adjudicated study, where majority vote over equivalence clusters and Universal Self-Consistency are unsafe in 25% and 10%. An ablation with the same oracle but no graph is unsafe in 25% and rejects every candidate in another 30%. We machine-checked our proofs in Lean.

AI.tldr: 提出基于蕴含图（Entailment Graph）的安全自动形式化方法，借助LLM生成候选公式并由求解器确定其逻辑强度排序，通过"充分前沿"与"必要前沿"两侧搜索对自然语言陈述进行逻辑夹逼认证，在AWS安全性质上全部20例安全，显著优于多数投票（25%不安全）与Universal Self-Consistency（10%不安全）。
AI.motivation: 自动形式化（自然语言→逻辑公式）依赖上下文消歧，而LLM的概率性输出不具备形式化保证；现有方法（如多数投票、Universal Self-Consistency）缺乏可靠的安全性认证，在安全关键场景中可能产生不安全结果。
AI.method: 1) 用LLM生成候选公式池，构建蕴含图EG，边由求解器判定，每条边携带残差（residual）与余残差（co-residual）这两个蕴含序的伴随量，且完全由候选池确定；2) 在给定上下文中进行两次搜索：返回"充分前沿"（蕴含陈述的最弱候选）与"必要前沿"（被陈述蕴含的最强候选），每步仅需对一条边的残差或余残差做局部检查；3) 两前沿夹逼陈述并给出"歧义残余量"，其可满足当且仅当陈述歧义；4) 用LLM蕴含预言机裁决自然语言层面的检查，理论上证明：预言机可靠（sound）则搜索无论候选池质量如何均安全，预言机完备（complete）则前沿紧致；5) 全部证明在Lean中机器验证。
AI.result: 在安全关键的AWS性质上，经专家裁决的研究中，EG方法在全部20例均安全；等价簇多数投票不安全率25%，Universal Self-Consistency不安全率10%；相同预言机但去掉图的消融实验不安全率25%，另有30%情况拒绝所有候选。Lean形式化验证了全部理论证明。
AI.conclusion: 以蕴含图为核心的顺序搜索可将自动形式化的安全认证从概率性启发式转变为具备单侧逻辑充分性保证的程序，可靠预言机保证安全性、完备预言机保证紧致性，为安全关键领域的LLM自动形式化提供了可证明的保障。

title: ECLIPSE: Embedding-Centered Foundation-Model Federated Knowledge Transfer for Data-Free Edge Intelligence
summary: Foundation Models (FMs) are envisioned to become an integral component of intelligent federated edge networks because of their strong representation and generalization capabilities. However, their integration into resource-constrained and privacy-sensitive edge environments remains challenging. This challenge is particularly pronounced in data-free settings, where no shared, public, or server-accessible reference dataset is available to establish a common reference space for aligning distributed knowledge. To address this challenge, we propose ECLIPSE, which is an embedding-centered FM-based federated knowledge transfer framework developed for data-free edge intelligence. ECLIPSE enables edge intelligence capitalizing on a server-hosted FM without sharing raw data, local models, or a public reference dataset. It establishes a shared embedding reference space through which edge devices encode their local task knowledge. Only the resulting embeddings are transmitted to the server for alignment and aggregation. Using the aggregated embeddings, the server constructs a task-aware surrogate dataset through an embedding-guided generative process. This surrogate dataset is then used to adapt the server-hosted FM to the downstream task. The adapted FM is subsequently distilled into a lightweight global model and distributed to the edge devices. This process allows edge devices to benefit from both distributed task knowledge and the generalization capabilities of the FM. Experimental results across diverse classification datasets show that ECLIPSE outperforms conventional Federated Learning (FL) and data-free Federated Knowledge-Transfer (FKT) baselines. It also achieves competitive performance compared with databased approaches. Furthermore, the framework remains robust under statistical and model heterogeneity across different data distributions and local architectures.

AI.tldr: ECLIPSE：一种以嵌入为中心、面向无数据边缘智能的基础模型（FM）联邦知识迁移框架，无需共享原始数据、本地模型或公共参考数据集。
AI.motivation: FM 具备强表征与泛化能力，适合作为智能联邦边缘网络的核心组件，但资源受限且隐私敏感的边端环境难以直接部署；在“无数据”设定下（无共享/公共/服务器可达的参考数据集）缺乏建立共同参考空间以对齐分布式知识的手段，使问题尤突出。
AI.method: 通过服务器托管的 FM 建立共享嵌入参考空间，边缘设备将本地任务知识编码为嵌入并仅上传嵌入；服务器对齐与聚合嵌入，并以嵌入引导的生成过程构建任务感知替代数据集（surrogate dataset）；用其将服务器 FM 适配到下游任务，再将适配后的 FM 蒸馏为轻量全局模型并下发至边缘设备。
AI.result: 在多种分类数据集上，ECLIPSE 优于传统联邦学习与无数据联邦知识迁移基线的表现，并与基于数据的方案性能相当；在不同数据分布与本地架构下的统计异构与模型异构条件下保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 以嵌入为通信与对齐载体，可在完全不共享原始数据与本地模型的条件下实现 FM 与分布式边缘知识的有效融合，使边缘设备同时获益于分布式任务知识与 FM 的泛化能力，为无数据联邦边缘智能提供可行方案。

title: POISE: Curvature-Aware Critic Regularization for Smooth Actor-Critic Control
summary: Actor-critic methods achieve high returns in robotic control, yet trained actors exhibit high-frequency action oscillations. Most smoothness methods constrain the actor, whereas PAVE regularizes the critic by separately penalizing action-gradient variation and encouraging negative action curvature. The same gradient change, however, moves the critic's preferred action farther where the critic is flat, and separate penalties do not measure this motion. We characterize this motion through the greedy shift, which approximates greedy-action displacement across state transitions to first order under local concavity. Since displacement alone does not reflect its critic-value consequences, the analysis further shows that the shift's curvature-weighted energy approximates the value lost by retaining the previous greedy action to second order. Based on this relationship, POISE regularizes the curvature-weighted energy along temporal and spatial state displacements. It employs a saddle-free curvature metric and reward-scale-consistent scaling while leaving the actor unchanged. On six continuous control tasks with TD3, POISE reduces the smoothness score on every task by $5.9\times$ on average ($4.5\times$ geometric mean), compared with $2.2\times$ ($1.9\times$) for the strongest baseline, and achieves the lowest score on five tasks. Paired return intervals include zero on four tasks, with a 14% increase on Ant and an 11% decrease on Hopper.

AI.tldr: POISE 通过正则化 critic 的"曲率加权贪婪位移能量"，在不改变 actor 的前提下显著降低 TD3 动作振荡，平滑度平均提升 5.9 倍。
AI.motivation: actor-critic 方法回报高但训练出的 actor 存在高频动作振荡。现有平滑方法多约束 actor；PAVE 改为正则化 critic，但分别惩罚动作梯度变化与鼓励负曲率，无法刻画"相同梯度变化在 critic 平坦处会使偏好动作移动更远"这一效应，即未度量贪心动作的实际位移及其价值后果。
AI.method: 提出 greedy shift 刻画贪心动作在状态转移下的一阶位移（依赖局部凹性）；进一步证明该位移的曲率加权能量可二阶近似"保留上一贪心动作"所损失的价值。据此设计 POISE：沿时间与空间状态位移对曲率加权能量做正则化，采用 saddle-free 曲率度量与奖励尺度一致的缩放，actor 不变。
AI.result: 在 TD3 的六个连续控制任务上，POISE 使每个任务的平滑度分数均下降，平均 5.9×（几何均值 4.5×），最强基线为 2.2×（1.9×），并在五个任务上取得最低分数。四任务回报的配对区间包含零，Ant 提升 14%，Hopper 下降 11%。
AI.conclusion: 以"曲率加权贪婪位移能量"为理论桥梁的 critic 侧正则化，比现有平滑方法更有效且几乎不牺牲回报，但存在任务相关的回报波动（如 Hopper 下降），平滑与回报的权衡仍需进一步控制。

title: Spec$^2$R: Recovering Emergent Properties in Supervised Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance across computer vision tasks, but the quality of their learned representations differs drastically depending on the training paradigm. While self-supervised ViTs often demonstrate emergent properties, such as object-aligned patch representations and attention maps, supervised ViTs typically lack these properties, even when trained with strong data augmentations. Understanding the origin of this difference is important for explaining and controlling the object-level structure. To investigate it, we perform a spectral analysis of supervised and self-supervised models, and identify a key distinction: MLP layers in supervised ViTs introduce high-frequency variations into patch representations, disrupting their spatial organization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spec$^2$R, a lightweight spectral regularization method that fine-tunes the MLP layers of pretrained supervised ViTs. Spec$^2$R recovers object-aligned patch representations and attention maps, while improving adversarial robustness and preserving competitive classification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文对监督与自监督ViT进行谱分析，发现监督ViT的MLP层在patch表示中引入高频变化、破坏空间组织，据此提出轻量谱正则化方法Spec$^2$R，仅微调预训练监督ViT的MLP层即可恢复物体对齐的patch表示与注意力图，并提升对抗鲁棒性同时保持竞争性分类精度。
AI.motivation: 自监督ViT常表现出物体对齐的patch表示与注意力图等涌现性质，而监督ViT即便使用强数据增强也普遍缺乏这些性质。理解这一差异的来源，对于解释并控制表示中的物体级结构至关重要。
AI.method: 对监督与自监督模型进行谱分析，定位到关键差异：监督ViT的MLP层向patch表示中注入高频变化，扰乱其空间组织。基于此提出Spec$^2$R——一种轻量级谱正则化方法，用于微调预训练监督ViT的MLP层。
AI.result: Spec$^2$R恢复了物体对齐的patch表示与注意力图，提升了对抗鲁棒性，同时保持具有竞争力的分类精度。
AI.conclusion: 监督ViT缺乏物体级结构的根源在于MLP层引入的高频扰动，可通过谱正则化在MLP层上以低成本加以纠正，从而兼具可解释性与鲁棒性收益。

title: Provably Near-Optimal PQ in the Extended Zador Model
summary: This paper investigates Product Quantization (PQ) Optimization with Gaussian data. It offers three key contributions (i) a proof that SVD is the optimal preconditioning rotation for PQ; (ii) a new Extended Zador (EZ) estimator of the $k$-means quantization cost that is accurate in low bit rates and low dimensions; and (iii) a novel segmentation algorithm based on 1-d bin packing of global bit allocations. The result is a simple algorithm (EZPQ) with strong approximation guarantees. It matches OPQ's empirical accuracy while providing a per-instance distortion lower bound certificate under the Gaussian EZ cost model. On typical real embedding spectra, EZPQ with 2 bits per coordinate is often certifiably within 1% of the optimum in this model. It also consistently achieves a lower reconstruction error than all random-rotation-based algorithms such as EDEN, E-RaBitQ, and TurboQuant.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高斯数据下的乘积量化（PQ）优化，提出EZPQ算法：证明SVD是最优预条件旋转；提出低码率、低维下准确的扩展Zador（EZ）量化代价估计器；并基于全局比特分配的1-d装箱给出分段算法。EZPQ精度与OPQ相当，同时可给出每实例的失真下界证书，在真实嵌入谱上2比特/维时通常可证在最优值1%以内，重构误差优于EDEN、E-RaBitQ、TurboQuant等随机旋转类方法。
AI.motivation: 现有PQ优化（如OPQ）缺乏理论保证与可验证的误差界；随机旋转类方法（EDEN、E-RaBitQ、TurboQuant）在真实嵌入谱上重构误差不优；且k-means量化代价在低码率、低维情形下缺乏准确的解析估计工具。
AI.method: (i) 理论证明SVD为PQ最优预条件旋转；(ii) 构建扩展Zador（EZ）估计器，用于刻画低码率、低维下k-means量化代价；(iii) 提出基于全局比特分配一维装箱（1-d bin packing）的新分段算法；三者结合形成EZPQ。
AI.result: EZPQ具备较强近似保证，经验精度与OPQ相当，并在高斯EZ代价模型下提供逐实例的失真下界证书；在典型真实嵌入谱上，2比特/坐标时通常可证在最优1%以内；重构误差一致低于EDEN、E-RaBitQ、TurboQuant等随机旋转方法。
AI.conclusion: SVD预条件旋转在处理高斯型嵌入时应作为PQ的标准选择，EZ代价模型为PQ提供了可验证的最优性证书，EZPQ在精度与可证明性之间取得良好平衡。

title: JevBench: Metamorphic Coherence Testing for Typed Probabilistic Decision Models
summary: Typed probabilistic decision models return distributions over specified answers, such as yes or no, a set of options or levels on an ordered scale. We ask whether their probabilities remain coherent when questions about the same input are reworded, negated, combined, given different options or placed in different batches. JevBench tests this coherence without gold labels. Its 50 metamorphic relations each test one law of probability or choice across five dimensions: representation, batch independence, probability measure, logical order and choice-set conditioning. Each test changes the question or batch while keeping the input fixed. Every model receives the same requests, fixed in advance. JevBench-240 contains 12,000 tests across 240 synthetic cases in 12 decision domains. A fixed subset of 1,200 tests, JevBench-mini, closely reproduces the full-suite ranking (Spearman 0.983). Across 21 openly released models, coherence scores range from 56.5 to 83.9. Batch independence holds for most models. Additivity fails broadly, particularly for complements, where the probabilities of a proposition and its negation should sum to one. A uniform reference model ignores the input and scores 89.4 at chance accuracy, exceeding every evaluated model's coherence score. Among decoders, accuracy ranges from 82.4% to 89.2%, while coherence ranges from 64.2 to 83.9. These results show why both measures are needed to assess decision models. JevBench is available as an open-source Python package.

AI.tldr: 论文提出JevBench：一个无需金标签的元变形测试基准，用50条变形关系（覆盖表示、批次独立性、概率测度、逻辑顺序、选项集条件化五个维度）检验类型化概率决策模型在问题改写、取反、组合等变换下概率是否保持连贯；该基准含240个合成案例共12,000测试，其中1,200条的JevBench-mini与全套排名高度一致（Spearman 0.983）；21个开源模型连贯性得分56.5–83.9，但均低于忽略输入的均匀参考模型（89.4）。
AI.motivation: 类型化概率决策模型输出yes/no、选项集或序数量表上的分布，但用户在部署时关心这些概率在被改写或重新组合后是否仍保持自洽。现有评估依赖金标签，只能测准确率，无法测概率是否符合概率论与选择理论的基本公理。
AI.method: 构建JevBench无标签元变形基准：50条变形关系各对应一条概率或选择定律，分属五个维度（表示、批次独立性、概率测度、逻辑顺序、选项集条件化）；每个测试固定输入、仅改变提问表述或批次，所有模型接收预先固定的相同请求。共12,000测试、240个合成案例、12个决策领域，并抽取1,200条构成JevBench-mini；以开源Python包发布。
AI.result: 21个公开模型连贯性得分56.5–83.9；批次独立性对多数模型成立；可加性广泛失败，尤其互补性（命题与其否定概率之和应为1）；忽略输入的均匀参考模型以89.4的连贯性超过全部被测模型；解码器准确率82.4%–89.2%而连贯性仅64.2–83.9；JevBench-mini与全套排名Spearman 0.983。
AI.conclusion: 高准确率不等于概率自洽：模型在标签意义上的准确率区间明显高于其连贯性区间，二者需并用以评估决策模型。JevBench提供了无金标签、可复现、低成本的连贯性评估工具，且显著揭示互补性与可加性这类系统性缺陷。

title: Co-DRIS: Physics-Informed Predictive Belief and Variable-Impedance Learning for Reactive Catching under Coupled Uncertainty
summary: Reactive robotic manipulation is acutely sensitive to simultaneous sensing noise, measurement dropouts, joint execution errors, and contact parameter variations. While single-frame frameworks like Domain-Randomized Instance Set (DRIS) achieve strong robustness under isolated uncertainties (86.4%), they degrade severely when perception and actuation uncertainties co-occur (27.6% across 10 coupled stress scenarios) due to memoryless encoding and fixed high-stiffness PD control. We propose Co-DRIS + SuperMimic, a perception-action co-design framework coupling: (i) an inertial world-frame physics-informed world model combining exact ballistic kinematics with a zero-initialized contact residual to roll forward missing observations and accelerate training via zero-cost counterfactual dropout consistency; (ii) an action-conditioned dual-stream causal GRU belief encoder resolving the denoising-vs-lag deadlock; and (iii) phase-aware variable-impedance soft-catching that transitions the 7-DoF Franka Research 3 arm into an overdamped regime (zeta/zeta0 ~ 2.26x) at the torque layer. Under unbiased 3-seed tail evaluation on unseen throws (15,360 throws/scenario), our method achieves 89.6 +/- 0.4% on standard benchmarks (+10.5% on 4-sigma noise to 70.5%) and 66.6 +/- 0.5% across 10 coupled/dropout stress scenarios (+39.0% over DRIS; +30.4% on 50% dropout). We further validate impedance decoupling, causal contact triggering under +0.65 s flight-time shifts, and cross-task transfer to steel-plate ping-pong bouncing (87.5% to 100.0%) and FR3+Hand catching (+8.4% under 4x noise with 6-13% lower peak impact force).

AI.tldr: 提出Co-DRIS + SuperMimic感知-动作协同设计框架，将惯性世界模型、双流因果GRU信念编码器与相位感知变阻抗软接策略耦合，在耦合/丢帧压力场景下将成功率从27.6%提升至66.6%，标准基准达89.6%。
AI.motivation: 反应式机器人操作对传感噪声、测量丢帧、关节执行误差与接触参数变化同时出现极为敏感。现有单帧框架（如DRIS）在单一不确定性下可达86.4%，但因无记忆编码与固定高刚度PD控制，在感知与执行不确定性耦合出现时性能骤降至27.6%（10个耦合压力场景）。因此需要感知与动作层面的协同设计来同时应对多源不确定性。
AI.method: 三项协同组件：(i) 惯性世界坐标系下的物理知情世界模型，将精确抛体运动学与零初始化接触残差结合，用于滚动预测缺失观测，并通过零成本反事实丢帧一致性加速训练；(ii) 动作条件双流因果GRU信念编码器，缓解"去噪—滞后"两难；(iii) 相位感知变阻抗软接策略，在力矩层将7-DoF FR3机械臂切换至过阻尼区间（ζ/ζ0≈2.26×）。
AI.result: 基于无偏3种子尾部评测、未见投掷样本（每场景15,360次投掷）：标准基准89.6±0.4%（4σ噪声下70.5%，+10.5%）；10个耦合/丢帧压力场景66.6±0.5%（较DRIS +39.0%，50%丢帧下+30.4%）。进一步验证了阻抗解耦、+0.65 s飞行时间偏移下的因果接触触发，以及跨任务迁移：钢板乒乓弹跳87.5%→100.0%，FR3+灵巧手接取在4×噪声下+8.4%且峰值冲击力降低6–13%。
AI.conclusion: 感知-动作协同设计可有效化解单帧无记忆框架在耦合不确定性下的性能崩塌；物理知情惯性世界模型、因果信念滤波与相位感知变阻抗控制三者互补，在鲁棒性、时序适应性与跨任务泛化上均取得一致提升，并降低接触冲击力。

title: GoldiBench: Right Tools, Wrong Amount -- Benchmarking Agents on Effect Judgement in Professional Editing
summary: Real editing requests describe a look, not the steps to reach it, so an agent that serves them must judge how much of each tool the look takes. Existing benchmarks do not measure this: their tasks either state the tools and values, or leave the amount open and are scored by VLM judges that pass more than half of half- and triple-strength results. We introduce GoldiBench, a benchmark of 500 editing tasks in five professional applications (darktable, RawTherapee, GIMP, Inkscape, Blender), solvable by writing a program or by operating the GUI. Each task pairs a START image with a TARGET rendered from a hidden program, so the amount is fixed by a known target; the agent's edit is re-rendered and compared with TARGET, and the same task is posed with the tools and values, the tools only, or the goal only, separating operation from effect judgement. Across 25 open, GUI and closed models, agents operate well (99-100% with programs from 4B up when told the values) but fall off a cliff when they must judge the amount: given only the tools, the best model passes 19% of the tasks with programs and 33% through the GUI, and scale does not close the gap. Manuals barely help; the measured TARGET-START difference more than doubles the pass rate, but the same difference shown as an image does not for open models. Allowed four renders, agents almost always stop after the first; forced to compare, the strong models double their pass rate. Agents know the tools, but neither read nor check the amount.

AI.tldr: 提出 GoldiBench 基准（500 个任务，覆盖 darktable、RawTherapee、GIMP、Inkscape、Blender），用"隐藏程序渲染的 TARGET"锁定编辑强度，并分三种提示（工具+数值 / 仅工具 / 仅目标）分离"操作能力"与"效果判断能力"；结果显示现有智能体"会操作、不会估量"。
AI.motivation: 真实编辑需求只描述"想要的样子"而非操作步骤，因此智能体必须自行判断每个工具需要用多少强度。现有基准无法度量这一点：任务要么直接给出工具与数值，要么强度开放却由 VLM 评判，而 VLM 会把一半强度和三分之一强度的结果中超过一半判为通过。
AI.method: 构建 GoldiBench：500 个任务、5 个专业软件，可通过写程序或操作 GUI 完成。每个任务由 START 图像与一个由隐藏程序渲染的 TARGET 配对，强度由已知目标固定；智能体编辑结果重新渲染后与 TARGET 比较。同一任务分别以"工具+数值""仅工具""仅目标"三种条件呈现，以解耦操作与效果判断。评测 25 个开源、GUI 与闭源模型，并做手册提示、显式测量 TARGET−START 差值、以图像呈现差值、限制/强制多轮渲染等消融。
AI.result: 给出数值时，4B 以上模型的程序化任务通过率即达 99–100%，操作能力接近饱和；仅给工具时，最佳模型程序化通过率 19%、GUI 通过率 33%，仅给目标更低，增大模型规模也无法弥补。说明书几乎无帮助；显式给出测量出的 TARGET−START 差距可使通过率翻倍以上，但把同一差距以图像形式提供对开源模型无效。允许四次渲染时智能体几乎总在第一次后停止；强制对比后强模型通过率翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 智能体掌握工具知识，但既不主动读取也不校验"用量/强度"，这构成当前智能体式图像编辑的核心瓶颈；瓶颈在于效果量判断与自我校验，而非操作熟练度。

title: Frequency-Conditioned Privacy Auditing of Fine-Tuned Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly fine-tuned on sensitive data, where the same person's information may appear multiple times across records. This can cause models to memorize sensitive information, but memorization does not necessarily mean that the information can be recovered. A more serious privacy risk arises when the model begins to reproduce that information during generation. In this paper, we study how often sensitive information must appear in the fine-tuning data before it becomes recoverable. Across four language models, we vary the frequency of email addresses and phone numbers from $1\times$ to $50\times$ and compare standard fine-tuning, gradient clipping, and differentially private training. We find that the number of repetitions required before sensitive information becomes recoverable varies substantially across models. Gradient clipping can delay extraction, but it does not consistently prevent leakage at high repetition. DP-SGD at $\varepsilon=5$ produces zero observed extraction through $50\times$ repetition across all four models under the attacks we test, although the utility cost varies by model. These findings characterize how observed extraction varies across sensitive-data frequencies, model families, and training mechanisms, and highlight substantial differences in extraction behavior across models. Code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该文研究敏感信息在微调数据中需重复出现多少次才会变得"可提取"，并比较标准微调、梯度裁剪与DP-SGD在1×–50×重复频率下的泄漏差异。
AI.motivation: 大模型越来越多在含敏感数据（同一人信息多次出现）上微调，可能导致记忆甚至生成时复现。记忆不等于可恢复，真正的隐私风险在于生成阶段的可提取性，而"需要多少重复才可提取"这一问题尚缺乏系统刻画。
AI.method: 以邮箱地址和电话号码为敏感信息，在四种语言模型上将其出现频率从1×变化到50×，分别采用标准微调、梯度裁剪和差分隐私训练（DP-SGD，ε=5），并在多种攻击下测量可提取率，同时考察效用代价。
AI.result: 可提取所需的重复次数在不同模型间差异显著；梯度裁剪可延迟提取，但在高重复下不能一致地阻止泄漏；DP-SGD（ε=5）在四种模型、最高50×重复下、所测试攻击中观测到零提取，但效用损失因模型而异。
AI.conclusion: 观测到的提取行为随敏感数据频率、模型家族与训练机制显著不同；DP-SGD在测试设置下提供最强防护但存在效用权衡。代码与数据已公开。

title: Denoising Diffusion with Progressive Posterior Sampling
summary: Diffusion models provide effective generative priors for solving noisy linear inverse problems. However, existing posterior sampling methods may require singular value decomposition (SVD) of the measurement operator or prior knowledge of the measurement noise variance, while guidance based on local gradients provides only a limited view of posterior geometry. We propose progressive posterior sampling (PPS) with manifold projection, which automatically estimates the measurement noise variance and avoids SVD. During reverse diffusion, PPS constructs a Gaussian approximation to the posterior distribution in closed form and guides a sample drawn from the local prior toward the approximate posterior mean. We then project the guided sample onto a spherical level set that approximates the local noisy image manifold, promoting consistency with the local geometry of the diffusion prior. Experiments on FFHQ and ImageNet across four restoration tasks and three measurement noise levels demonstrate competitive reconstruction accuracy and perceptual quality by PPS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出渐进后验采样（PPS）与流形投影方法，用于扩散模型求解含噪线性逆问题：自动估计测量噪声方差、无需SVD，在反向扩散中以闭式高斯近似后验引导采样并投影到球面水平集，在FFHQ/ImageNet四类复原任务、三种噪声水平上取得有竞争力的重建精度与感知质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的后验采样方法存在三方面局限：一是需要测量算子的奇异值分解（SVD）或需预先知道测量噪声方差；二是基于局部梯度的引导只能提供有限的局部信息，难以刻画后验几何结构；因此需要一种免SVD、噪声方差自适应且能更好贴合先验局部几何的采样方案。
AI.method: 提出渐进后验采样（PPS）：在反向扩散过程中以闭式构造后验分布的高斯近似，并将从局部先验采样的样本引导至该近似后验均值；随后把引导后的样本投影到一个球面水平集上，以近似局部含噪图像流形，从而保持与扩散先验局部几何的一致性。方法可自动估计测量噪声方差并避免SVD。
AI.result: 在FFHQ与ImageNet数据集上，针对四类图像复原任务与三种测量噪声水平进行实验，PPS在重建精度与感知质量上均表现出竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PPS通过闭式高斯后验近似引导加球面流形投影，在无需SVD与噪声方差先验的条件下实现了有效的含噪线性逆问题求解，验证了结合后验近似与先验流形几何约束的采样思路的有效性。

title: BendGS: Observation-Conditioned Gaussian Self-Modeling for Continuum Robots
summary: Visual self-models learn from images how a robot moves under motor commands. Continuum robots need them even more, as they bend continuously without measured joint angles or fixed link geometry. Existing continuum self-models predict point clouds, image-space curves, or future images, but not the next 3D shape, appearance, and tip pose together from an observed body. 3D Gaussians offer a renderable representation of shape and appearance, yet articulated Gaussian self-models rely on joint angles to drive deformation. In this work, we propose BendGS, which uses a virtual backbone estimated from observation to drive command-conditioned Gaussian deformation, enabling next-state prediction for continuum robots without measured joint angles. In Gaussian modeling, a feed-forward network reconstructs the robot as 3D Gaussians from multi-view images, and the backbone, a chain of coordinate frames, is fitted to back-projected depth points to estimate the bending state. In transition, a network predicts its change under a relative motor command to deform the bound Gaussians. The deformed Gaussians render the next images and the 3D shape, and the distal frame gives the tip pose. Training losses use RGB-D images and masks, without bending or tip labels. On simulated and real robots, BendGS achieves the lowest Chamfer distance, best image quality, and lowest tip errors among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: BendGS：用观测估计的虚拟骨架驱动高斯形变，实现连续体机器人无需关节角测量的命令条件下一状态预测（形状、外观、末端位姿）。
AI.motivation: 连续体机器人无关节角与固定连杆几何，现有自模型仅预测点云、图像曲线或未来图像，无法同时给出下一状态的3D形状、外观与末端位姿；而3D高斯自模型依赖关节角驱动形变，不适用于连续体机器人。
AI.method: 高斯建模阶段：前馈网络从多视图图像重建机器人为3D高斯；将坐标框架链构成的骨架拟合到反投影深度点，估计弯曲状态。过渡阶段：网络在相对电机指令下预测骨架变化并形变绑定的高斯；形变后高斯可渲染下一帧图像与3D形状，末端框架给出末端位姿。训练损失仅用RGB-D图像与掩码，无需弯曲或末端标签。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人上，BendGS在对比方法中取得最低Chamfer距离、最佳图像质量与最低末端位姿误差。
AI.conclusion: 以观测估计的虚拟骨架替代关节角作为形变驱动，可构建无监督标签依赖的连续体机器人高斯自模型，统一预测形状、外观与末端位姿。

title: RePT: 3D Geometry Emerges from 2D Relational Pretraining
summary: Learning spatial representations often relies on explicitly predicting geometric quantities, but how physical geometry is organized within learned representations remains less understood. We ask whether 3D structure can emerge from learning relations across 2D observations, without 3D prediction targets. We introduce RePT, which learns compact relations between distinct physical points through cross-view 2D point prediction. The learned relation space develops a geometric organization in which magnitudes, angles, and neighborhoods reflect physical 3D displacement. A single linear readout fitted on 16 scenes recovers displacement length and angle on 39 held-out scenes without refitting (Pearson r = 0.72 and 0.78). The ARKitScenes-trained checkpoint also retains strong geometric organization on ScanNet++, showcasing generalizability. In controlled comparisons, distinct-point relational prediction consistently yields stronger geometric organization than matched same-point correspondence learning. This organization depends on additive relations and adaptive scene context, and higher point-transfer accuracy does not by itself produce stronger organization. More broadly, our results suggest that 3D geometry need not be an explicit prediction target and can instead emerge as a structural property of representations trained to relate 2D observations, pointing to relational prediction as a complementary route to learning the representations that spatial intelligence builds on.

AI.tldr: RePT通过跨视角2D点预测学习不同物理点之间的关系，无需3D预测目标即可在关系空间中自发组织出反映真实3D位移的几何结构（长度、角度、邻域），且具备跨数据集泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有空间表征学习多依赖显式预测几何量（如深度、位姿），而学习到的表征内部如何组织物理几何仍不清楚。作者追问：在没有3D预测目标的情况下，仅通过学习二维观测间的关系，3D结构能否自发涌现。
AI.method: 提出RePT：通过对不同物理点在跨视角下的2D位置进行预测，学习点与点之间的紧凑关系表征。关系空间通过加性关系与自适应场景上下文形成；并设计受控对比实验，比较"不同点关系预测"与"同点对应学习"对几何组织的影响。
AI.result: 关系空间的幅值、角度与邻域结构对应真实3D位移。仅在16个场景上拟合的单一线性读出器，在39个留出场景上无需重拟合即可恢复位移长度与角度（Pearson r = 0.72 与 0.78）。在ARKitScenes上训练的检查点在ScanNet++上仍保持强几何组织，显示泛化性。受控对比中，不同点关系预测一致优于同点对应学习；更高的点迁移精度本身并不带来更强几何组织。
AI.conclusion: 3D几何不必作为显式预测目标，而可作为"学习关联2D观测"的表征结构属性自发涌现；关系预测是通向空间智能所需表征的一条互补路径。

title: Monitorable-by-design architectures for a post-Astra world: a compartmentalization-based approach
comment: 14 pages plus 2 pages of references, 1 figure
summary: Frontier models like GPT-6 Astra are increasingly able to do substantial reasoning without a monitorable chain of thought, chains of thought are becoming less legible, and are often monitored asynchronously to reduce cost. With the future of chain of thought monitoring unclear, it may be necessary to design LLMs with monitorability in mind. We propose a modification to existing LLM architectures based on GRAM, SGTM, DEMix, BTS, and similar methods to compartmentalize dangerous capabilities so that their use, especially in combination with dangerous reasoning types that may indicate strategic adversarial use, can be monitored more cheaply than chain of thought in a way that might outlast monitorable chain of thought. We propose several variants of this architecture designed to balance tradeoffs and discuss other benefits, such as capability removal.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于GRAM、SGTM、DEMix、BTS等方法的LLM架构改造方案，将危险能力"区隔化"（compartmentalize），使其调用（尤其是与可能指示战略性对抗使用的危险推理类型组合时）能够以比思维链更廉价、且可能比可监控思维链更持久的方式被监控，并给出若干权衡变体及其他收益（如能力移除）。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型（如GPT-6 Astra）日益能够在无可监控思维链的情况下完成大量推理，思维链本身的可读性下降，且常因成本原因被异步监控。思维链监控前景不明，因此有必要在设计阶段就将"可监控性"纳入LLM架构考量。
AI.method: 借鉴GRAM、SGTM、DEMix、BTS等已有方法，对现有LLM架构进行修改，实现危险能力的模块化区隔（compartmentalization），使危险能力的启用及与其他危险推理类型的组合调用可被独立、低成本地监测；并提出多种架构变体以平衡不同权衡。
AI.result: 摘要为立场/设计提案性质，未给出实验数据；主张该区隔化监控方式相较思维链监控成本更低，且可能不依赖于思维链是否可读，因此更持久。同时讨论了若干附带收益，例如能力移除（capability removal）。
AI.conclusion: 在思维链监控可靠性下降的背景下，应以"可监控性优先"为设计目标改造LLM架构；通过能力区隔化实现低成本、可持续的危险能力使用监控，并兼顾能力移除等安全收益。

title: Latent Channel Completion for Forecasting in Sensor Networks with Failed Detectors
summary: Monitoring networks for traffic and utility infrastructure lose sensors routinely, and forecasting models that couple sensors together to gain accuracy also inherit an exposure to those losses. When a detector stops reporting, the substituted value is embedded as though it were a reading and propagates through the shared representation that couples the network, degrading forecasts for sensors that are still healthy. Because these models are selected on benchmarks where every sensor reports, the exposure is absent from the numbers used to choose them. We introduce Latent Channel Completion, a channel-axis joint embedding predictive objective that reconstructs missing sensors' latent representations rather than their values, since a coupling operator consumes embeddings and never sees raw readings. Channels are masked during training and their representations predicted from surviving channels against stop-gradient targets; at inference the operator fills in whichever sensors the monitoring system reports as dark, using parameters shared with the forecaster. On three highway detector networks, after half of each network goes dark, the accuracy advantage of coupling changes by -1.0, -0.5 and +8.8 percentage points, against losses of 10.2 to 50.3 points for the unmodified forecaster, which on one network falls behind an uncoupled reference entirely. Against cross-channel ridge imputation drawing on the same surviving sensors, completing the latent lowers error by a further 13.9% and 28.6%, and on complete inputs, the method matches its backbone. The benefit tracks how much a network gains from coupling when intact, giving operators a criterion evaluable before any outage occurs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Latent Channel Completion(潜通道补全)，一种通道轴的联合嵌入预测目标，在训练时掩盖传感器通道并预测其潜在表示，使耦合预测器在传感器失联时仍能稳健保持耦合带来的精度优势。
AI.motivation: 交通与公用设施监测网络中的传感器经常失效；而通过耦合多个传感器以提升精度的预测模型，也会继承对这些传感器丢失的暴露。当检测器停止上报时，替代值被当作真实读数嵌入，并经由耦合网络的共享表示传播，恶化仍健康传感器的预测。此外，这些模型通常在"所有传感器均上报"的基准上选择，因此这种脆弱性不会体现在选型所用的指标中。
AI.method: 提出Latent Channel Completion：一种通道轴的联合嵌入预测目标，重建缺失传感器的潜在表示而非其数值，因为耦合算子消费的是嵌入、从不直接看到原始读数。训练时对通道进行掩蔽，以存活通道预测被掩蔽通道的表示，目标端使用stop-gradient；推理时，耦合算子利用与预测器共享的参数，填补监控系统报告为失联的任意传感器。
AI.result: 在三个高速公路检测器网络上，当每个网络一半传感器失联后，耦合的精度优势变化分别为-1.0、-0.5和+8.8个百分点，而未修改的预测器则损失10.2至50.3个百分点，在某一个网络上甚至完全落后于非耦合基线。与使用相同存活传感器的跨通道岭回归插补相比，潜空间补全进一步降低误差13.9%和28.6%；在完整输入下，该方法与骨干模型持平。收益大小与该网络在完好状态下从耦合中获益的幅度相关，为运维方提供了可在任何故障发生前评估的判据。
AI.conclusion: 在潜空间而非数值空间补全缺失通道，能有效防止传感器失联通过共享表示传播污染，使耦合预测模型在部分传感器失联时几乎保持原有精度优势，并优于传统插补方法，同时不牺牲完整输入下的性能。

title: Ada-BFM: Adapting Behavior Foundation Models for Humanoid Scene Interaction
summary: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose humanoid control through pretraining on large-scale behavioral data. However, their proficiency in whole-body coordination does not readily extend to scene interaction, which requires adapting motion to scene-dependent geometric constraints and contact dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce Ada-BFM, a post-training framework that adapts pretrained BFMs for humanoid scene interaction. Ada-BFM augments the original architecture with a lightweight adapter, enabling interaction-specific adjustments while leveraging pretrained control capabilities. Rather than producing a separate controller for each task, the framework yields a shared model for each interaction domain, supporting diverse tasks involving terrain or object interaction. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that Ada-BFM enables diverse scene interaction behaviors, accelerates learning compared with training from scratch, and largely preserves pretrained behavioral competence. These findings establish Ada-BFM as an effective and efficient approach to extending the capabilities of BFMs beyond their pretraining settings while retaining their strengths in general whole-body control.

AI.tldr: 提出Ada-BFM后训练框架，通过轻量适配器将预训练行为基础模型适配到人形机器人场景交互任务。
AI.motivation: 行为基础模型（BFMs）虽在全身协调控制上表现优异，但其能力难以直接迁移到场景交互，因为场景交互需要动作适应依赖场景的几何约束与接触动力学。
AI.method: 在预训练BFM原有架构上增加轻量适配器（adapter），实现交互专用的调整，同时保留预训练控制能力；不针对每个任务单独训练控制器，而是为每个交互域产出一个共享模型，支持地形或物体交互等多样的任务。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明：Ada-BFM能实现多样的场景交互行为，相比从零训练显著加速学习，并基本保持预训练的行为能力。
AI.conclusion: Ada-BFM是一种有效且高效的方法，可将BFM能力扩展到预训练设定之外，同时保留其在通用全身控制方面的优势。

title: Adapt, Label, Distill: Foundation-Model Supervision for Efficient Object Detection
comment: Accepted at the 7th Workshop on Real-World Surveillance: Applications and Challenges (RWS), WACV 2027. 12 pages, 6 figures, including supplementary material
summary: Object detectors often transfer poorly to specialized domains, where box annotations are scarce and deployment requires compact, real-time models. Large vision foundation models can provide offline supervision, but their zero-shot predictions may be poorly aligned with the target domain. We present an adapt-label-distill pipeline that uses limited target annotations to specialize a foundation teacher and transfer its supervision to compact detectors. We adapt SAM3 on the labeled subset, generate pseudo-labels for the remaining unlabeled images, and train YOLOv11 students with confidence-guided supervision. Teacher confidence weights pseudo-label losses, while zero-gating retains uncertain hypotheses during assignment without applying their associated training losses. Experiments across six target domains and three student capacities show substantial gains in several domains, while revealing limited or negative transfer in others. Teacher comparisons under a common hard-label training recipe support the choice of SAM3, and comparisons with an EfficientTeacher adaptation provide additional evidence against an online SSOD baseline. With YOLOv11m, our pipeline improves over STAC-style self-training by up to 15.3 AP and reaches 51.6 AP on Garbage, compared with 54.1 under full supervision. On NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the deployed student achieves 188 FPS versus 2.9 FPS for SAM3, benefiting from foundation-model supervision without incurring the teacher's deployment cost. Code is available at https://github.com/zk2172-columbia/ProjectAdaptLabelDistill_ObjectDetection.

AI.tldr: 提出"适应-标注-蒸馏"流水线：用少量目标域标注微调SAM3作为教师，生成伪标签并以置信度引导训练紧凑YOLOv11学生模型，实现专用域实时检测。
AI.motivation: 目标检测器迁移到专用域时表现差，且该域边框标注稀缺、部署需紧凑实时模型；视觉基础模型可提供离线监督，但其零样本预测与目标域对齐不佳。
AI.method: 在标注子集上适配SAM3教师，为其余无标注图像生成伪标签；以置信度加权伪标签损失训练YOLOv11学生，并用zero-gating在匹配阶段保留不确定假设但不计入其损失；对比硬标签训练范式下的多个教师，并与EfficientTeacher在线SSOD基线比较。
AI.result: 在6个目标域、3种学生容量上实验：YOLOv11m较STAC式自训练最高提升15.3 AP，Garbage上达51.6 AP（全监督54.1 AP）；Jetson AGX Orin上学生188 FPS，SAM3仅2.9 FPS；部分域收益有限甚至负迁移。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型离线监督可有效支撑紧凑学生检测器，规避教师部署开销，但迁移增益具域依赖性；教师选择与置信度引导监督是关键设计。

title: Multi-agent System for Automatic Discovery of Pareto-optimal Meta-solvers for PDEs
summary: Designing linear solvers for discretized partial differential equations requires problem-specific expertise. We present a multi-agent framework, in which language-model agents propose, critique, implement, and evaluate solver configurations assembled from Krylov methods, preconditioners, block factorizations, and neural operators. Inside the proposing agent, a non-dominated sorting genetic evolutionary algorithm evolves the population of meta-solvers toward the Pareto front of six measured quantities, so that one run returns a front of trade-offs rather than a single tuned solver. The system runs on small open-weight language models served on a single laptop, and we compare it with a single agent on four problems. For three-dimensional acoustic scattering and elasticity, it delivers 47 and 48 convergent hybrid solvers out of 60 candidates. Relative to the Jacobi-preconditioned Krylov baselines, the best of the discovered solvers reduce the iteration counts by factors of 4.7 and 60 and the online solve time by factors of 2.3 and 3.0, whereas the single agent produces no executable plan. For coupled dynamic thermoelasticity in two and three dimensions, where the baselines fail, it completes 98 of 100 transient candidates and, compared with the single agent, reaches a given accuracy 15 times faster in two dimensions and a displacement error 20 times lower in three dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出多智能体（语言模型智能体）框架，用于自动设计PDE离散系统的线性求解器：智能体提出、批评、实现并评估由Krylov方法、预条件子、块分解与神经算子组合而成的求解器配置；提议智能体内部用非支配排序遗传算法演化元求解器种群，一次运行返回Pareto权衡前沿而非单一调优求解器。系统在单台笔记本上运行小型开源权重模型，在四个问题上与单智能体对比。
AI.motivation: 为离散化偏微分方程设计线性求解器高度依赖问题专业知识，自动化配置与调优困难；同时现有自动调优方法通常只输出单一最优解，无法体现迭代次数、求解时间等多指标之间的权衡。
AI.method: 多智能体框架：语言模型智能体分别承担提出、批评、实现与评估角色，组合Krylov方法、预条件子、块分解和神经算子构造求解器配置；提议智能体内嵌非支配排序遗传进化算法，对六项测量指标优化元求解器种群以获得Pareto前沿；模型为小型开源权重模型，部署于单台笔记本。
AI.result: 三维声散射与弹性问题：60个候选中分别有47、48个收敛的混合求解器；相比Jacobi预条件Krylov基线，最佳求解器迭代次数分别降低4.7倍与60倍，在线求解时间降低2.3倍与3.0倍，而单智能体未能产出可执行方案。二维/三维耦合动态热弹性问题（基线失效）中，100个瞬态候选完成98个；相比单智能体，二维达到给定精度快15倍，三维位移误差低20倍。
AI.conclusion: 基于小型开源模型的多智能体+进化搜索框架可在消费级硬件上自动发现高质量混合求解器，显著优于单智能体与经典基线，并能以Pareto前沿形式提供多目标权衡解，具备较强的实用性与可扩展性。

title: LatentLens: Rethinking Latent Interface in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Latent interfaces let agents in a multi-agent system communicate through continuous representations rather than decoded text. Prior work reports performance and efficiency gains, but neither separates latent communication from the agent harness nor examines its internal components, leaving its actual contribution unclear. We propose LatentLens, a framework that decouples the latent interface at two levels: externally from the agent harness, to measure its contribution to overall performance (RQ1), and internally into realignment compatibility, information accessibility, and propagation dynamics, to identify the benefits and limitations of each (RQ2). Across seven benchmarks with Qwen3 models, adding the latent interface to the same harness does not improve and can even substantially degrade accuracy. Internally, latent representations retain some domain information, but incompatible realignment can substantially degrade performance, and repeated latent steps can amplify representation-level failures. Thus, while latent representations may preserve information, they do not necessarily ensure effective communication, which also requires compatible realignment, information accessibility, and stable propagation.

AI.tldr: 提出 LatentLens 框架，将多智能体系统中的潜在接口从智能体框架外部（RQ1）和内部组件（RQ2）两个层面解耦分析，发现潜在接口在相同框架下并不能提升甚至显著降低准确率。
AI.motivation: 已有工作报告潜在通信带来性能与效率增益，但未将潜在通信与智能体框架（agent harness）分离，也未剖析其内部组件，导致潜在接口的真实贡献不清晰。
AI.method: LatentLens 在两层解耦潜在接口：外部与智能体框架解耦，以衡量其对整体性能的贡献（RQ1）；内部拆解为三部分——重对齐兼容性（realignment compatibility）、信息可访问性（information accessibility）与传播动态（propagation dynamics），以识别各自的收益与局限（RQ2）。实验在七个基准上使用 Qwen3 系列模型。
AI.result: 在相同框架下加入潜在接口并未提升准确率，甚至可能显著下降；内部层面，潜在表示保留了一定的领域信息，但不兼容的重对齐会显著损害性能，重复的潜在步会放大表示层面的失效。
AI.conclusion: 潜在表示虽可能保留信息，但并不必然保证有效通信；有效通信还需兼容的重对齐、信息可访问性与稳定的传播。

title: CALVIN-MAX: When Does a Mid-Execution Change Hurt a Robot Policy?
comment: 34 pages (8-page main paper and 23-page supplementary material), 19 figures, 28 tables. Project page: https://forall-labs.github.io/CALVIN-MAX/
summary: Robots must often keep working after the world changes, as when a block moves or the camera shifts while the robot still acts on what it saw before. Recent work showed that one change during a task lowers success for every policy tested, but did not separate the effect of its timing from the cost of the changed world, or measure what it costs afterwards. We introduce CALVIN-MAX, a benchmark of 7,828 cases on CALVIN's five-instruction chains, each with one change to the objects, the camera, the robot, or the instruction. Each case compares three runs that are identical until the affected instruction begins: one without the change, one with it in place from that moment, and one in which it arrives while the robot is moving. The second run against the first gives the cost of the changed world, and the third against the second the effect of meeting it mid-motion. On 1,526 held-out cases per policy, with hypotheses fixed in advance, each of ten released policies loses 4.4 to 9.9 percentage points on the affected instruction over the eight core changes. Whether timing matters depends on the change: one that alters what the robot sees costs 5.4 points less mid-motion than from the start, whereas a change to the scene itself or to the robot shows no detectable effect. Rewinding the robot to the start of the instruction removes the benefit for every policy; the stricter test we fixed in advance, that the rewound run then matches the second run, passes for three. The cost also outlasts the affected instruction: the change stays in place, and a policy that still completes that instruction is 5.0 to 16.8 points less likely to complete the next one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CALVIN-MAX 基准（7,828 个案例），通过三组对照运行，把"变化世界本身的代价"与"变化发生时机（任务中途遭遇）的影响"解耦，并测量变化对后续指令的溢出代价。
AI.motivation: 已有工作发现任务执行期间出现一次变化会降低所有策略的成功率，但未能区分该下降源于变化本身还是变化的时机，也未测量变化之后持续付出的代价，因此需要一个可解耦二者的受控基准。
AI.method: 基于 CALVIN 的五指令链构建 7,828 个案例，每个案例对物体、相机、机器人和指令中的一项施加一次变化。每个案例比较三条在被影响指令开始前完全相同的运行：无变化；变化从该时刻起已存在；机器人运动过程中变化才到达。第二条对比第一条给出"变化世界的代价"，第三条对比第二条给出"运动中遭遇变化的影响"。另有回卷（rewind）实验，将机器人回卷到指令起点以检验收益是否可消除。每策略 1,526 个留出案例，假设预先固定。
AI.result: 十种已发布策略在八种核心变化上，受影响指令的成功率下降 4.4–9.9 个百分点。时机是否重要取决于变化类型：改变机器人所见（如相机）的变化在运动中遭遇时比从始至终存在少损失 5.4 个百分点，而对场景本身或机器人的变化无可检测的时机效应。回卷对每个策略都消除了该收益；预先固定的更严格检验（回卷运行应与第二条运行持平）仅三个策略通过。代价还超出受影响指令：若策略仍完成该指令，其完成下一条指令的概率降低 5.0–16.8 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 变化的代价既来自世界本身，也部分来自遭遇时机（仅对感知类变化显著），且会跨指令持续影响后续表现；回卷仅能消除时机收益，说明该收益与运动中的状态/观测更新有关而非单纯的指令残差。

title: What You See Is What You Certify: Concept-Based Certificates for Unseen Compositions
summary: Concept-based models justify a decision by concepts they claim to see, decoded through an explicit ontology. Yet concept predictions are known to leak label information, ignore locality, and be poorly grounded on new attribute combinations. A decision decoded from such concepts can satisfy the ontology and still be wrong, so we ask when it can serve as a certificate. On unseen combinations of familiar parts, a joint concept bottleneck model and a concept embedding model, trained as is standard, certify wrong classes 93-94% of the time despite a correct ontology (60% for a joint model trained only on visible parts and gated by a localizer). The joint model's part errors copy co-occurring values more often than chance (cross-concept shortcutting). Treating the ontology as an error-detecting code, we show that a certificate needs visible evidence excluding every rival, unseen parts reported as such, and rare misreads not driven by a shared shortcut. A minimal reference design, OCVE, reads each part from a local crop in its own forward pass. On unseen FunnyBirds classes, it certifies 52% of images at 0.4% risk, against 14% for mask-pooled features and 33% for full-image part readers (5.6% when trained and gated alike), at similar zero-shot accuracy. The best baselines, even calibrated or restricted to unseen classes, and a decoder counting only agreeing parts remain about 3-8 times riskier. On CUB, isolated region readers are more accurate than an attribute-prototype model (63.1% vs. 55.3%) and certify unseen species at about 6 points less risk than it and about 10 points less than features pooled in the same keypoint boxes. On real traffic signs, isolated readers lower certified risk from 99.8% to 67%, which is still far too high; most remaining errors are misread pictograms. On seen classes the ontology brings no gain over a fairly trained black box, and isolation costs accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将概念本体（ontology）视为一种纠错码，研究概念模型何时能作为"证书"（certificate）来证明决策正确；指出现有概念瓶颈模型在未见属性组合上会因概念级捷径而系统性认证错误类别，并提出最小参考设计OCVE（每个部件在独立前向中以局部裁剪读取）以实现低风险认证。
AI.motivation: 概念模型通过显式本体解码概念来"解释"决策，但概念预测已知会泄漏标签信息、忽略局部性、在新属性组合上缺乏依据。于是从概念解码出的决策可能满足本体却依然错误，因此需要追问：在什么条件下概念解码结果能作为正确性的证书。作者尤其关注未见组合下的跨概念捷径（cross-concept shortcutting）导致的错误认证问题。
AI.method: 将本体形式化为错误检测码，推导出证书成立的三项必要条件：可见证据须排除所有竞争类别；未观测部件须如实报告为缺失；罕见误读不能由共享捷径驱动。据此提出最小参考设计OCVE：对每个部件从局部裁剪中、在各自独立的前向传播中读取概念，实现部件读取隔离，避免信息混叠与捷径。
AI.result: FunnyBirds未见类上，标准训练的联合概念瓶颈模型与概念嵌入模型错误认证率达93–94%；仅用可见部件并在定位器门控下训练的联合模型为60%。OCVE在相似零样本准确率下，于0.4%风险下认证52%图像，而mask-pooled特征为14%、全图部件读取器为33%（训练与门控一致时为5.6%）；最佳基线（含校准、限定未见类、仅计数一致部件）风险高约3–8倍。CUB上隔离区域读取器准确率63.1% vs 属性原型模型55.3%，未见物种认证风险低约6个百分点，比同关键点框内池化特征低约10个百分点。真实交通标志上隔离读取器将认证风险由99.8%降至67%，但仍过高，剩余误差多为图形符号误读。在已见类上本体相对公平训练的黑箱无增益，且隔离会损失准确率。
AI.conclusion: 概念本体能作为纠错码提供认证，但前提是部件读取的隔离性、缺失部件的诚实报告以及无共享捷径的独立误读；OCVE表明这些条件是可行且有效的，代价是已见类上准确率的下降。真实场景（如交通标志）的图形误读仍使认证风险过高，说明该框架尚不足以覆盖所有高风险应用。

title: Self-Improving Long-Horizon Reasoning by Learning Summaries from Local Continuations
summary: Reasoning models degrade as their context grows, so longer reasoning traces do not by themselves give longer effective horizons. One way to extend the horizon is to compress the reasoning history into a compact state from time to time and continue from the state. Existing methods train the state with the final-answer reward or distill it from a stronger model. Neither signal is tailored to measure the contribution of the state alone. We observe that a reasoning model that degrades over long trajectories still behaves reliably in short contexts. We aim to preserve this short-context behavior when compressing the reasoning history. Motivated by this, we train a separate summarizer with Delta-KL, a reward computed from the frozen reasoning model's token-level predictions on sampled continuations, and run inference by truncating the trace, summarizing it, and continuing from the summary (TruSuCo). Training uses a few thousand questions with 4k-token reasoning prefixes and does not need answers or external teachers. Under a fixed 32k-token budget, the trained summarizer improves on vanilla reasoning and on an untrained summarizer in all nine settings across mathematical benchmarks and Reasoning Gym puzzles, by up to 7.7 points and 12 points, respectively. The improvement over vanilla reasoning grows with the budget. At 128k tokens, our method outperforms it by 10 points on AIME 2024--2026. Analyses show that truncation prevents the collapse of vanilla reasoning and that the trained summaries retain more of the reasoning history.

AI.tldr: 训练独立摘要器（Delta-KL 奖励）把推理历史压缩成紧凑状态，再从上文继续推理（TruSuCo），在固定 token 预算下显著提升长程推理表现。
AI.motivation: 推理模型随上下文增长而性能退化，长推理链并不能自动带来更长的有效推理视野。把历史压缩成状态续推是扩展视野的途径，但现有方法用最终答案奖励或强模型蒸馏训练状态，这两种信号都未直接衡量"状态本身"的贡献。作者的关键观察是：长轨迹上退化的模型在短上下文下仍可靠，因此目标是压缩历史时保留这种短上下文行为。
AI.method: 提出 Delta-KL 奖励：用冻结的推理模型在采样续写上的 token 级预测来衡量摘要状态保留原上下文行为的程度，据此单独训练一个摘要器；推理时执行"截断轨迹—摘要—从摘要续推"的流程（TruSuCo）。训练仅需数千道题、4k token 推理前缀，不需要答案标签或外部教师模型。
AI.result: 在固定 32k token 预算下，训练后的摘要器在数学基准与 Reasoning Gym 谜题共九个设置上均优于原始推理和未训练摘要器，分别最高提升 7.7 分与 12 分；相对原始推理的增益随预算增大而扩大，128k token 时在 AIME 2024–2026 上领先 10 分。分析表明截断可防止原始推理的性能崩塌，且训练出的摘要保留了更多推理历史信息。
AI.conclusion: 以 Delta-KL 单独监督摘要状态、配合截断续推，是一种无需答案与教师的长上下文推理扩展方案，增益随预算增长且具备可解释的行为机制。

title: One Phase Is Enough: Sim-to-Real Transfer with Direct Visual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has enabled impressive robotic behaviors, yet deploying policies directly from vision remains challenging. A common approach first trains a teacher policy with RL using privileged state observations, then distills its behavior into a vision-based student via imitation. However, the resulting student can substantially underperform its teacher. Directly training visual policies with RL offers a promising alternative, but learning task-relevant visual representations from scratch can be sample-inefficient, making one-phase visual RL intractable. We propose DRIFT, a simple recipe for efficient one-phase visual RL using image observations available at test time. Our key insight is to use frozen, pretrained foundation vision encoders, allowing RL to focus on learning control from existing visual representations. Freezing the encoder avoids costly backpropagation through the vision backbone, while its pretrained representations enable real-world transfer from fast, rasterized simulation rendering. Under matched architectures, observations, and compute budgets, DRIFT outperforms two-phase distillation and achieves a 58.8% relative improvement in average real-world success rate across three manipulation tasks. Controlled simulation evaluations demonstrate that DRIFT's relative advantage grows from roughly 9% in-distribution to over 61% under out-of-distribution shifts, suggesting that stronger generalization contributes to superior real-world transfer. Project website: https://jmarangola.github.io/one-phase-visual-rl/

AI.tldr: 提出DRIFT：冻结预训练视觉基础编码器，实现高效单阶段视觉强化学习，避免教师-学生蒸馏的性能损失，真实任务平均成功率相对提升58.8%。
AI.motivation: 视觉sim-to-real通常采用两阶段流程（特权状态训练教师+模仿蒸馏学生），但学生策略显著弱于教师；而直接用RL从零训练视觉策略样本效率低、单阶段视觉RL难以实现。
AI.method: DRIFT使用冻结的预训练基础视觉编码器，将RL学习聚焦于基于既有视觉表征的控制策略；冻结编码器免去视觉骨干的反向传播开销，其预训练表征使其能从快速光栅化仿真渲染迁移到真实世界。对比实验在匹配架构、观测与算力预算下与两阶段蒸馏对比。
AI.result: 在三个操作任务上真实世界平均成功率相对提升58.8%；受控仿真中相对优势从分布内约9%扩大至分布外超61%。
AI.conclusion: 冻结基础视觉编码器的单阶段视觉RL优于两阶段蒸馏，更强的泛化能力是其真实世界迁移优势的重要来源。

title: RESET: One Demonstration, One Verified World, Self-Improved Skills Across Embodiments
summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents can iteratively self-improve robot manipulation skills in simulation benchmarks, yet real-world tasks provide neither ground-truth success scorers nor resettable practice environments. Our key observation is that a single real demonstration simultaneously specifies scene geometry, defines the terminal success criterion, and serves as a physical reference trajectory for verifying world fidelity---all decoupled from the source robot's kinematics. We present {RESET}: we reconstruct a contact-rich world and derive a frozen read-only criterion from one demonstration ({R}ebuild); check that world against the demonstration by open-loop replay and silhouette consistency ({E}xamine); evolve modular white-box task graphs and skill code from per-node failure evidence ({S}elf-improve); deploy frozen code on real robots with zero runtime LLM calls ({E}xecute); and share the verified world and criterion with unseen robots without new demonstrations ({T}ransfer). On 8 manipulation tasks, each rebuilt from one real demonstration, RESET achieves 97% average success on unseen layouts in simulation, whereas zero-shot code reaches 27%, per-task fine-tuned pi0.5 policies 31%, and Diffusion Policy 50%; injecting reconstruction defects shows that practice tolerates many reconstruction errors, that geometric errors can still stall or mislead it, and that the check flags most of them while physical randomization covers the rest. Without any target demonstrations, 3 heterogeneous robots acquire the same task skills in the shared world: a robot with similar arms copies 95% of its skill functions unchanged from the source robot, while robots with different arms and hands write their own. In real-robot experiments, the resulting programs run on 4 robots and succeed in 80% of 280 trials.

AI.tldr: RESET 提出用单次真实演示重建接触丰富的仿真世界，并从中导出冻结的成功判据，通过开环回放与轮廓一致性校验、白盒任务图自改进、零运行时 LLM 部署与跨机器人迁移，在 8 项任务上实现 97% 仿真成功率与 80% 真机成功率。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人任务缺乏真值成功评分器与可重置的练习环境，使 LLM 编码智能体的迭代自改进难以落地；作者观察到单次真实演示同时携带场景几何、终端成功判据和物理参考轨迹三项信息，且与源机器人运动学解耦，可作为替代监督来源。
AI.method: RESET 五阶段流程：(1) Rebuild 由一次演示重建接触丰富世界并导出冻结的只读判据；(2) Examine 用开环回放与轮廓一致性检验世界保真度；(3) Self-improve 依据逐节点失败证据演进模块化白盒任务图与技能代码；(4) Execute 冻结代码在真机部署，运行时零 LLM 调用；(5) Transfer 将已校验世界与判据共享给未见过的新机器人，无需新演示。
AI.result: 8 项任务上，未见布局仿真平均成功率 97%，对比零样本代码 27%、逐任务微调 pi0.5 31%、Diffusion Policy 50%。注入重建缺陷实验表明：练习环节可容忍多数重建误差，几何误差仍可能致停滞或误导，检验环节能标记多数误差，其余由物理随机化覆盖。3 台异构机器人无目标演示即习得技能：相似臂型机器人 95% 技能函数原样复用，不同臂型与手型则自行重写。真机 4 台机器人、280 次试验成功率 80%。
AI.conclusion: 单次真实演示足以作为可复用、可校验、可迁移的监督源，支撑白盒技能程序在真实机器人上的自主改进；缺陷注入分析界定了重建保真度的容错边界，验证了"演示即世界、判据与参照"这一设计假设。

title: MSW: a Multi-Scale Sliced Wasserstein Distance Between Image Distributions
summary: We propose the multi-scale sliced Wasserstein (MSW) distance between image distributions, which operates in pixel space and requires no trained network. MSW convolves images with a fixed bank of discrete cosine filters at several scales, pools the responses over all positions, and compares the resulting one-dimensional distributions using the Wasserstein distance. We pair MSW with an exact two-sample test that gives calibrated p-values. Most metrics compare two image sets in the latent space of a pretrained network. We show that these metrics are insensitive to simple perturbations of the images, because the latent space is nearly invariant to them. In contrast, MSW detects smaller perturbations than latent-space metrics and needs far fewer images to do so. Although it uses no learned features, it still detects semantic changes of the image distribution. Finally, MSW matches or outperforms existing Wasserstein-based metrics in our experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度切片Wasserstein（MSW）距离，直接在像素空间用固定DCT滤波器组比较图像分布，无需训练网络，并配以精确两样本检验给出校准p值。
AI.motivation: 现有图像分布度量多在预训练网络的潜空间比较两个图像集合，但潜空间对简单扰动近乎不变，导致这些度量对细微扰动不敏感。
AI.method: MSW在多个尺度上用固定的离散余弦滤波器对图像卷积，对所有位置做池化，得到一维响应分布，再用Wasserstein距离比较；并配合精确两样本检验获得校准p值。
AI.result: MSW能检测到比潜空间度量更小的扰动，且所需图像数量显著更少；尽管不使用学习特征，仍能检测图像分布的语义变化；实验中与现有Wasserstein类度量持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 无需训练特征的像素空间多尺度切片Wasserstein度量是一种高灵敏、样本高效的图像分布比较方案，可作为潜空间度量的有力替代。

title: Wavefront: Low-Rank Drafting with Parallel Causal Refinement for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Parallel block drafters such as DFlash and P-EAGLE propose a whole block in one forward pass, but they lose the dependence between tokens in the block; DSpark restores part of it with a lightweight correction head that runs sequentially. Measuring DSpark, we find that this head overrides the base prediction on most slots, so the expensive base readout through the target's full lm_head mostly provides a seed. We therefore propose Wavefront, which follows a simple principle: shrink the base and strengthen the correction head. Wavefront replaces the full lm_head with a learned low-rank base, conditions the correction head on the whole drafted prefix within the same block, and resolves it with a few parallel Jacobi passes. A fixed pass budget makes the draft step free of data-dependent control flow, so we capture it as a single CUDA graph in vLLM with fused kernels. On Qwen3-8B, Wavefront improves throughput over xPress, DSpark and DFlash by 2.6%, 10.7% and 23.6% on average across math, code, chat and agentic benchmarks, and by 9.6%, 14.3% and 28.9% on SPEED-Bench long-context prompts. On Qwen3.8-27B it leads DFlash2, DSpark and xPress by 7.6%, 10.6% and 5.0%, and by 7.4%, 5.8% and 6.0% on the same long-context prompts. The gains persist as serving load grows to concurrency 32.

AI.tldr: Wavefront 通过“缩小基座、强化修正头”改进并行块草稿器：用可学习低秩基替代完整 lm_head，并让修正头基于块内完整前缀、以固定次数的并行 Jacobi 迭代求解，从而在 vLLM 中以单张 CUDA graph 高效执行，在多种基准上超越 DFlash、DSpark 与 xPress。
AI.motivation: 并行块草稿器（如 DFlash、P-EAGLE）一次前向提出整块 token，但丢失了块内 token 间的依赖关系；DSpark 用顺序运行的轻量修正头部分恢复该依赖。作者实测发现该修正头在多数位置上会覆盖基座预测，说明通过目标模型完整 lm_head 的昂贵基座读出其实只起到提供“种子”的作用，因此存在优化空间。
AI.method: 提出 Wavefront，遵循“缩小基座、强化修正头”的原则：(1) 以可学习的低秩基替代完整 lm_head；(2) 修正头以同一块内的完整草稿前缀为条件（而非仅依赖局部信息）；(3) 用少量并行 Jacobi 迭代求解该条件依赖。由于迭代次数固定，草稿步骤不含数据相关控制流，可在 vLLM 中封装为单张 CUDA graph 并结合融合算子实现。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B 上，Wavefront 在数学、代码、对话与 agentic 基准上平均较 xPress、DSpark、DFlash 提升 2.6%、10.7%、23.6%，在 SPEED-Bench 长上下文提示上分别提升 9.6%、14.3%、28.9%。Qwen3.8-27B 上较 DFlash2、DSpark、xPress 分别领先 7.6%、10.6%、5.0%，长上下文场景分别领先 7.4%、5.8%、6.0%。增益在并发度增至 32 时仍保持。
AI.conclusion: 基座读出的主要价值在于提供初始种子而非最终预测，因此低秩基座加更强修正头是更优的并行块草稿设计；固定迭代预算带来的无分支执行使 CUDA graph 化成为可能。Wavefront 在短/长上下文、不同模型规模与更高服务负载下均取得一致的吞吐提升。

title: Noise-Level Adjacency in Diffusion Training
summary: Diffusion models train one network across all noise levels, although their training objective is pointwise in the noise level. If training on each pair of adjacent levels were an independent problem, separate networks with the same total parameter count would be expected to match one shared network. But in practice, on images, sharing weights across levels gives better results, which hints at an implicit dependence on their order. An order fixes both which levels are adjacent and the direction in which they run. In this paper, we show that, of the two, the benefit of sharing rests on adjacency in the noise-level embedding. The fitting error of a shared network is bounded below by the distances between neighbouring posterior means, minus the change the network can make between neighbouring embeddings. We first distinguish adjacency from direction: on a Gaussian mixture and CIFAR-10, reversing the embeddings keeps every neighbour and leaves the fitting error unchanged, whereas shuffling them raises it. Second, we rule out sharing between distant levels as the source of the benefit: separate networks on contiguous ranges match the shared network at its width, and with the parameters fixed, breaking adjacency at the same places costs less than 40\% of a full shuffle. Dividing the levels at equal shares of these distances lowers the error of all but the smallest networks. We therefore show that the order of the noise levels enters a diffusion model through adjacency, with its direction being a design choice. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/Noise-Level-Adjacency-in-Diffusion-Training.

AI.tldr: 该论文论证扩散模型中跨噪声级共享权重的好处来自"噪声级嵌入的邻接性"，而非噪声级顺序的方向；作者用一个拟合误差下界把邻接性与方向分离，并通过重排、切分、非均匀划分噪声级等实验加以验证。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在所有噪声级上训练同一网络，但训练目标是逐点（pointwise）的。若每个相邻噪声级对是独立问题，则同等参数量的多个独立网络应能达到共享网络的性能；然而在图像上共享权重效果更好，说明存在对噪声级"顺序"的隐式依赖。顺序同时决定了"哪些级相邻"和"级运行的方向"，二者中究竟是哪一个带来收益尚未被区分。
AI.method: 理论上给出共享网络的拟合误差下界：误差下界由相邻后验均值之间的距离，减去网络在相邻嵌入之间所能产生的变化量构成。实验上先区分邻接与方向：（1）在高斯混合与CIFAR-10上反转（reverse）嵌入，保持所有邻接关系不变；（2）打乱（shuffle）嵌入，破坏邻接关系。再排除"在远距离噪声级之间共享"是收益来源：在连续区间上训练独立网络（与共享网络同宽度、参数固定），以及在相同位置切断邻接。最后按后验均值距离的等分点划分噪声级。
AI.result: 反转嵌入使每个邻接关系保留，拟合误差不变；打乱嵌入则使误差上升。参数固定时，在相同位置切断邻接的代价不足完全打乱的40%；连续区间上的独立网络在同宽度下可匹配共享网络。按这些距离的等分份额划分噪声级，可降低除最小网络外所有网络的误差。
AI.conclusion: 噪声级顺序通过"邻接性"进入扩散模型，而其方向只是设计选择；跨级共享权重的收益源于嵌入空间中的局部邻接，而非远距离级之间的共享。

title: PreWAM: Exploring the Design of Latent Future Prediction for World-Action Modeling
summary: World-action models combine action generation with future prediction, allowing visual transitions to serve as supervision for policy learning. Our controlled study of prediction spaces shows that spatially structured semantic features support better overall generalization under visual perturbations and make motion information more readily recoverable from learned predictive representations. Building on these observations, we introduce PreWAM, a world-action model that organizes future supervision around state changes in a prediction space defined by pretrained DINO features. Specifically, Residual World Prediction jointly learns source-relative changes and their resulting future states to emphasize dynamic information while preserving future-state semantics. Temporal-Scale Prediction conditions world queries on temporal distance to capture both short-term local motion and longer-horizon state evolution. These predictive objectives jointly shape a shared vision-language backbone with action supervision during pretraining and downstream policy learning. Experiments across the LIBERO benchmark family, SimplerEnv, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world robotic manipulation demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved generalization and robustness under diverse distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreWAM——以预训练 DINO 特征定义预测空间的世界-动作模型，通过残差世界预测与时间尺度预测构建未来监督，在 LIBERO、SimplerEnv、RoboTwin 2.0 及真机任务上取得强操作性能与更优的分布偏移泛化与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAM）用未来预测作为策略学习的监督信号，但"在何种预测空间中构造未来监督"这一关键设计未被系统研究。作者通过受控实验发现：空间结构化的语义特征（如 DINO 特征）在视觉扰动下整体泛化更好，且其学习到的预测表征更易恢复运动信息。据此动机，需在语义化预测空间中围绕"状态变化"组织未来监督。
AI.method: 1）以预训练 DINO 特征空间作为世界预测空间；2）Residual World Prediction：联合学习源相对变化量及其导致的未来状态，既强调动态信息又保留未来状态语义；3）Temporal-Scale Prediction：以时间距离为条件调制 world queries，兼顾短期局部运动与长时程状态演化；4）上述预测目标在预训练与下游策略学习阶段与动作监督共同塑造共享的视觉-语言骨干网络。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 系列基准、SimplerEnv、RoboTwin 2.0 以及真实世界机器人操作任务上均表现出较强的操作性能，并在多种分布偏移下提升了泛化能力与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 预测空间的选择对 WAM 的泛化与鲁棒性至关重要；基于结构化语义特征的残差式、多时间尺度未来监督，能在保持未来语义的同时突出动态变化，是提升机器人策略泛化与鲁棒性的有效路径。

title: Anchoring VAE Fine-Tuning to Its Latent Diffusion Prior
summary: Pretrained latent diffusion models are effective priors for transfer learning, from geometry estimation to physics simulation. Existing approaches fine-tune the diffusion backbone but freeze the encoder of the VAE to preserve the latent distribution. However, a frozen encoder may miss salient details in non-RGB inputs and is limited to three channels. We introduce Diffusion Prior Anchoring (DPA), a regularizer applied during VAE fine-tuning that uses a score-distillation update to steer latents toward the high-density manifold on which the pretrained diffusion model denoises accurately. We validate DPA across three image and video models (FLUX 3, LTX-Video, Wan2.2) and four tasks: monocular depth estimation, MRI reconstruction, wind-flow simulation, and surface normal estimation, where DPA lowers the prediction error by 7.5% relative to the frozen VAE, 4.9% to decoder-only fine-tuning, and 4.0% to unanchored VAE fine-tuning. Its gain grows the further the target data lies from the RGB training distribution, from 3.3% on monocular depth estimation to 7.2% on complex-valued MRI. DPA also applies to modified VAEs, including pruned and multi-channel variants. With a four-channel VAE that encodes depth and surface normals, it lowers depth estimation error by 9.3%.

AI.tldr: 提出扩散先验锚定（DPA）正则项：在VAE微调时用分数蒸馏更新把潜变量拉向预训练扩散模型能准确去噪的高密度流形，从而在非RGB、多通道输入任务上获得更低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 现有迁移学习做法是微调扩散骨干但冻结VAE编码器以保持潜分布，而冻结编码器难以捕捉非RGB输入中的显著细节，且被限制为三通道；直接微调VAE又会使潜变量偏离预训练扩散模型的去噪流形。
AI.method: DPA作为VAE微调期间施加的正则化：基于分数蒸馏（score-distillation）的更新规则，引导潜变量趋向预训练扩散模型可准确去噪的高密度潜流形；在FLUX 3、LTX-Video、Wan2.2三个图像/视频模型与四个任务（单目深度估计、MRI重建、风场模拟、表面法向估计）上验证，并扩展至剪枝与多通道VAE。
AI.result: 相对冻结VAE预测误差降低7.5%，相对仅微调解码器降低4.9%，相对无锚定VAE微调降低4.0%；目标数据偏离RGB训练分布越远增益越大（单目深度3.3%→复值MRI 7.2%）；四通道VAE同时编码深度与表面法向时深度误差降低9.3%。
AI.conclusion: 对VAE微调施加扩散先验锚定可在保留潜空间适配能力的同时维持扩散模型去噪可靠性，是一种通用、可迁移至图像/视频生成模型及改造型VAE的微调正则化方案，尤其适用于远离RGB分布的多通道科学成像任务。

title: E2SIM: Long-Horizon Simulation of Everyday Human Behavior with Evolving States
summary: AI agents are increasingly expected to support users over long periods, across work, and daily life. This requires modeling not only who users are, but also how their goals, interests, activities, and interactions evolve over time. A challenge in longitudinal user simulation is maintaining consistency between these evolving states and the consequences of actions in a shared environment. We introduce E2SIM, a longitudinal user simulation framework that jointly models evolving actor states and a dynamic shared environment. E2SIM connects actor-state updates with shared-world changes through a feedback loop linking immediate actions, delayed outcomes, and actor-specific observations across work and life. This allows the consequences of earlier actions to shape later behavior, while preserving differences in what each actor knows. We further propose a suite of longitudinal trajectory diagnostics, measuring dynamic consistency, coherent event progression and collaboration, and non-degenerate trajectory development rather than static consistency alone. In one 60-day simulation, E2SIM produced more extracted event threads judged meaningful by our evaluator and fewer near-duplicate actions than four direct-generation baselines. The framework and evaluation methods provide a basis for studying longitudinal user simulation, with potential applications in training and evaluating AI agents that assist users over extended periods.

AI.tldr: 提出纵向用户模拟框架E2SIM，将行动者状态演化与动态共享环境通过反馈回路耦合，并提出纵向轨迹诊断指标；60天模拟中抽取的有意义事件线索多于4个直接生成基线，近重复动作更少。
AI.motivation: AI智能体需在长周期内跨工作与生活支持用户，要求不仅建模用户身份，还要建模其目标、兴趣、活动与交互随时间演化；纵向用户模拟的难点在于保持演化状态与共享环境中行为后果之间的一致性。
AI.method: E2SIM联合建模演化中的行动者状态与动态共享环境，通过连接即时行动、延迟结果与行动者特定观测的反馈回路，将状态更新与世界变化耦合，使早期行为后果影响后续行为，同时保留各行动者知识差异；并提出一组纵向轨迹诊断指标，度量动态一致性、事件推进与协作的连贯性以及轨迹发展的非退化性。
AI.result: 在60天模拟中，E2SIM抽取出的被评测者判定为有意义的事件线索多于四个直接生成基线，且近重复动作更少。
AI.conclusion: 该框架与评测方法为纵向用户模拟研究提供了基础，可应用于训练和评估长期协助用户的AI智能体。

title: Eliciting sandbagged LLM capability via structural interventions on attention-head functional networks
summary: Reliably evaluating the capabilities of advanced AI systems is critical for safe development and deployment, yet such evaluations may be undermined by sandbagging, a situation in which a model strategically suppresses capabilities it possesses. Existing work has developed controlled sandbagging settings and methods for detecting or eliciting hidden capabilities, but comparatively little is known about how a model's internal neural computation changes when its capabilities are suppressed. In this work, we study sandbagging through the lens of internal functional organization.
