AI.result: 16 次首拨 15 次就绪（Wi-Fi 7/8，中位 5.57 s；蜂窝 8/8，中位 6.76 s）；20 个占用与恢复场景均允许后续呼叫；5 次 60 s 中断期间手机离线而线路已释放；40 次回放中 1 s 决策时门控成功抑制，3 s 时对话与控制器反馈顺序播放且全程无重叠；两条边界轨迹分别出现回执指向后续反馈项、新呼叫查询返回前任反馈。
AI.conclusion: 系统在连接建立、资源占用与恢复、输出抑制方面具备可观测的时序保障，但存在反馈回执错配的边界缺陷；结论仅覆盖单一平台的应用层事件与模拟控制器决策，声学输出与任务正确性不在评估范围内。

title: VISOR: A Vision-Language Selector for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Recent time-series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast a distribution over futures, and multimodal time-series (TS) forecasting further exploits other modalities to improve forecasting accuracy. However, existing works have two limitations: 1) TSFMs reduce the predictive distribution to its median or mean, flattening diverse futures into a calm line, and 2) multimodal TS forecasting models incorporate text into the forecaster through TS-language alignment, which is substantially weaker than vision-language alignment. To address these limitations, we propose the VIsion-language SelectOR (VISOR), a multimodal TS forecasting framework that selects one plausible future instead of averaging across candidates, leveraging the alignment capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) to select the most suitable candidate based on textual information. VISOR consists of two components: 1) a text-free stochastic predictor that samples diverse candidate futures, and 2) a VLM selector that reads the candidates as a single chart image and selects one based on the text. To avoid overly calm forecasting paths, we train the selector with a shape-aware target that evaluates each candidate based on both point-wise error and path shape. Across three benchmarks covering ten datasets, VISOR achieves the best average ranking in both point and volatility errors compared with TSFMs and multimodal TS forecasting models. Code: https://github.com/seunghan96/VISOR.

AI.tldr: VISOR 提出一种多模态时间序列预测框架：先用无文本的随机预测器采样多条候选未来轨迹，再由视觉语言模型（VLM）将候选轨迹渲染为单张图表图像，结合文本信息选出最合适的一条，并以形状感知目标训练选择器。
AI.motivation: 现有 TSFM 将预测分布塌缩为均值/中位数，导致预测路径过于平缓、丢失未来多样性；而多模态 TS 预测依赖 TS-语言对齐，其效果远弱于视觉-语言对齐。
AI.method: 提出 VISOR，包含两部分：(1) text-free 随机预测器，采样多样化候选未来；(2) VLM 选择器，把所有候选读取为一张图表图像，依据文本从中选出单一候选。为缓解预测过平问题，采用形状感知（shape-aware）目标训练选择器，同时考虑逐点误差与路径形状。
AI.result: 在覆盖 10 个数据集的 3 个基准上，VISOR 在点误差和波动率误差两项指标上均取得优于 TSFM 与多模态 TS 预测模型的最佳平均排名。
AI.conclusion: 以“选择而非平均”的方式结合 VLM 的视觉-语言对齐能力，可有效提升多模态时间序列预测的精度与波动结构保真度。

title: Not All Interpretation Methods Are Created Equal: Tiered Evaluation of AI Interpretability
summary: As AI transitions to sociotechnical deployments, uninterpretable models pose serious threats to reliability, public trust and contestability. However, not all interpretation methods are created equal: for interpretability to enhance deployment safety and effectiveness, interpretation methods must be evaluated in a tiered system to differentiate evidence levels of trustworthiness, rather than validated through isolated interpretation instances. Our core vision is that elevating the evaluation of interpretation methods to a core AI assessment metric will drive robust knowledge discovery from data (KDD) and ensure safe, contestable sociotechnical deployments of AI. To this end, we propose TRUST, a tiered evaluation framework that builds upon the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) principles for Veridical Data Science (VDS) and the Predictive, Descriptive and Relevant (PDR) foundations. To differentiate interpretation methods effectively and systematically, TRUST grades interpretation across five tiers: Task-Aligned PDR Foundations, Rigorous Epistemic Grounding, Unifying Semantic Understanding, Scope Transferability, and Targeted Prospective Validation. We present a start-to-finish case study of the iterative Random Forest (iRF) family under TRUST and contrast it with other LLM interpretation methods that struggle to clear specific tiers. Finally, we conclude with brief initial thoughts on how TRUST principles can extend in autonomous agentic frameworks. Ultimately, the TRUST framework fosters contestability and epistemic grounding as foundational evaluation principles for human-machine workflows and, eventually, autonomous agentic workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出TRUST分层评估框架，将解释方法的评估提升为核心AI评估指标，以PCS/VDS原则与PDR基础为依据，对解释方法按五层级进行可信度分级，并以iRF族为案例贯穿式验证。
AI.motivation: AI进入社会技术部署阶段后，不可解释模型对可靠性、公众信任与可争议性（contestability）构成威胁；而解释方法本身良莠不齐，孤立个例式的验证不足以支撑部署安全性，需要分层的、体系化的评估来区分不同解释方法的可信证据等级。
AI.method: 构建TRUST分层评估框架：(1) 以可预测性-可计算性-稳定性（PCS）的Veridical Data Science原则与Predictive-Descriptive-Relevant（PDR）基础为理论根基；(2) 设五个层级——任务对齐的PDR基础、严格的认知论依据（epistemic grounding）、统一的语义理解、范围可迁移性、以及针对性的前瞻性验证；(3) 以迭代随机森林（iRF）族做端到端案例研究，并与难以通过特定层级的LLM解释方法进行对照；最后讨论TRUST原则向自主智能体框架的延伸。
AI.result: iRF族在TRUST框架下完成start-to-finish的案例演示，形成可对照的分级评价；相较之下，若干LLM解释方法在特定层级上难以通过，说明该分层机制具备区分力。
AI.conclusion: TRUST将可争议性与认知论依据确立为人机工作流、乃至自主智能体工作流的基础性评估原则；把解释方法评估提升为核心AI评估指标，可推动稳健的知识发现（KDD）并保障AI在社会技术场景中安全、可争议地部署。

title: Meta-Amortized Cognitive Modeling
summary: Cognitive modeling is highly iterative. Researchers repeatedly revise model structures, parameterizations, covariates, and experimental designs as theories evolve and data accumulates. Amortized Bayesian inference with neural networks provides rapid estimation for individual models, but every revision requires new simulations and training. Here, we introduce CogFormerV2, a meta-amortized framework that enables researchers to specify, revise, and fit cognitive models with a single network, carrying amortization across an entire space of models all at once. Trained once in about a day on a single GPU, it delivers accurate, well-calibrated posteriors across more than 14.6 billion model configurations spanning binary, multi-alternative, and continuous decisions, with varying parameter sets, covariate structures, trial counts, and contamination levels. It can fit empirical data from distinct behavioral tasks and extends to new models through continual learning and representation transfer. Released as an open-source interactive application, CogFormerV2 provides a reusable infrastructure for meta-amortized inference in cognitive modeling, while carrying the potential to accelerate computational modeling workflows at large.

AI.tldr: CogFormerV2是一个元摊销贝叶斯推断框架，用单个网络覆盖整个认知模型空间，一次训练即可对14.6亿+模型配置给出校准良好的后验，并支持持续学习扩展到新模型。
AI.motivation: 认知建模是高度迭代的过程：模型结构、参数化、协变量与实验设计随理论演化和数据积累被反复修改。现有的神经网络摊销贝叶斯推断虽能对单个模型快速估计，但每次修改都需重新模拟与训练，成本高且不可复用。
AI.method: 提出元摊销框架CogFormerV2：单网络同时摊销一个模型空间（而非单个模型）；在单GPU上约一天训练一次；覆盖二选一、多选项与连续决策三类任务，包含不同参数集、协变量结构、试次数与污染水平；并借助持续学习与表征迁移扩展到新模型；以开源交互式应用形式发布。
AI.result: 在超过14.6亿个模型配置上给出准确且良好校准的后验；可拟合来自不同行为任务的实证数据；能通过持续学习与表征迁移纳入新模型。
AI.conclusion: CogFormerV2为认知建模提供了可复用的元摊销推断基础设施，避免逐模型重训练，有望加速整体计算建模工作流。

title: Any2Act: Scaling In-Context Robot Learning from Heterogeneous Demonstrations
summary: Robot in-context learning (ICL) enables a policy to perform unseen tasks by following contextual demonstrations, without task-specific fine-tuning. This is increasingly valuable as large language models reasoning at low frequency can specify tasks through demonstrations and delegate high-frequency execution to such a policy. However, methods conditioned on human videos are bounded by scarce human-robot pairs, while those conditioned on robot demonstrations accept only one or two source types at limited scale. We present Any2Act, a foundation model for robot ICL. Our key insight is that a demonstration should be expressed in the camera layout and action space of the robot that performs it (the executor), not of whoever provided it (the demonstrator). This unified embodiment-grounded representation decouples learning to follow from admitting a new source. Any2Act learns to follow once, from robot-to-robot pairs that already take this form in 1.2M real trajectories spanning 10K tasks. Human videos, simulation, UMI, and other robots are then translated into this representation, and source-routed adapters trained on only a few hundred pairs each absorb the residual gap while the pretrained model stays frozen. For long horizons, a training-free tracker feeds only the demonstration window around the executor's progress, bounding the context and rolling back to redo failed steps. From a single demonstration, Any2Act achieves 57.5% success on unseen tasks without fine-tuning, exceeding VLAs fine-tuned on 50 demonstrations per task; other demonstrators retain 74-91% of the success achieved with the executor's own demonstrations.

AI.tldr: Any2Act 提出统一的“以执行者具身为基准”的演示表征，使机器人上下文学习（ICL）能够一次性学会跟随演示，并可接纳人类视频、仿真、UMI 及其他机器人等多来源演示。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人 ICL 方法受限于数据来源：基于人类视频的方法依赖稀缺的人机配对数据，基于机器人演示的方法只接受一两种来源类型且规模有限。核心障碍在于不同演示者的相机布局与动作空间不一致，导致"学会跟随演示"与"接纳新来源"被耦合在一起。
AI.method: 关键思路是将演示表达为执行者（executor）而非演示者（demonstrator）的相机布局与动作空间。以此统一表征在 120 万条真实轨迹、1 万任务的机器人-机器人配对上只学习一次跟随能力；人类视频、仿真、UMI 及其他机器人数据被翻译到该表征，再由仅用数百配对训练、且预训练模型冻结的"源路由适配器"吸收残余域差。长程任务采用免训练跟踪器，仅向策略输入执行进度附近的演示窗口，从而限制上下文长度并支持回滚重做失败步骤。
AI.result: 单条演示、无需微调条件下，Any2Act 在未见任务上取得 57.5% 成功率，超过按每任务 50 条演示微调的 VLA；使用其他演示来源时，成功率可保持执行者自身演示的 74–91%。
AI.conclusion: 将演示统一到执行者具身表征可有效解耦"学习跟随"与"扩展来源"，为非微调、跨来源的通用机器人上下文学习提供了可扩展范式。

title: SceneMemBench: A Benchmark for Scene Memory in Interactive Video World Models
summary: Interactive video world models generate navigable worlds frame by frame, but a persistent world requires previously observed scenes to remain recoverable as users move away and return. Existing memory evaluations, however, often focus on seen-view revisits and full rollouts, leaving cross-view scene recovery underexplored while entangling memory with trajectory-following errors and accumulated generation degradation. We introduce SceneMemBench, a benchmark for scene memory in interactive video world models. It evaluates two complementary dimensions: seen-view recall versus novel-view recovery, and controlled diagnosis versus end-to-end interaction. We introduce Continued Rollout from a shared ground-truth observation history, alongside Full Rollout over complete model-generated interactions. SceneMemBench contains 600 controlled trajectories across 33 Unreal Engine scenes and 60 Full Rollout cases, covering eight representative open- and closed-source models. We evaluate scene recovery along subject consistency, appearance fidelity, and geometric consistency. Results show that novel-view recovery is generally more challenging than seen-view recall, while model profiles under controlled histories can differ markedly from those observed in full interaction. Together, these findings reveal complementary failure modes obscured by seen-view revisits or end-to-end rollouts alone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SceneMemBench 基准，用于评估交互式视频世界模型中的场景记忆，区分"已见视角回忆"与"新视角恢复"两个维度，并引入基于共享真实历史观测的 Continued Rollout 与完整交互的 Full Rollout 两种协议。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型逐帧生成可导航世界，但持续存在的世界要求用户离开后返回时先前场景仍可恢复。现有记忆评估多聚焦已见视角重访与完整 rollout，跨视角场景恢复研究不足，且将记忆能力与轨迹跟随误差、累积生成退化混杂在一起。
AI.method: 构建 SceneMemBench：从两个互补维度评估（已见视角回忆 vs. 新视角恢复；受控诊断 vs. 端到端交互），提出从共享真实观测历史出发的 Continued Rollout 协议，以及基于模型自生成完整交互的 Full Rollout 协议；数据含 33 个 Unreal Engine 场景下 600 条受控轨迹与 60 个 Full Rollout 案例，覆盖 8 个代表性开源与闭源模型；从主体一致性、外观保真度和几何一致性三方面度量场景恢复。
AI.result: 新视角恢复普遍比已见视角回忆更具挑战性；模型在受控历史下的能力画像与完整交互中的表现可能显著不同。二者共同揭示了仅靠已见视角重访或端到端 rollout 所掩盖的互补失效模式。
AI.conclusion: SceneMemBench 提供了分离记忆与轨迹误差的诊断框架，表明已见视角回忆与新视角恢复、受控诊断与端到端交互分别暴露互补的失效模式，需结合多维度评估世界模型的场景记忆。

title: Modeling Event-Conditioned Emotional Expression Response with LLM Agents in a Synthetic Social Simulation
summary: Emotions are central drivers of human behavior, yet most behavioral models fail to capture their role in shaping perception, decision-making, and collective action. Application areas such as emergency response and public health are especially constrained by the lack of emotion-aware modeling. While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into agent-based models (ABMs), little work has examined how to endow LLM agents with emotional reasoning or validated their ability to reproduce empirically observed emotional patterns. This study addresses this gap by introducing a hierarchical prompting framework that conditions LLM agents with demographic, psychological, and contextual cues to generate event-conditioned emotional responses to real-world events. We validate the resulting event-conditioned emotional responses against large-scale social media reaction data derived from the Social Science One Facebook URL Shares Dataset, complemented by demographic and personality benchmarks. Our simulation results reproduce both polarized and consensus-driven emotional patterns with significant fidelity, supporting the application of LLM agents for emotion-aware modeling in behavioral simulations. We also find, however, that systematic gaps in emotional expression of LLM agents and human populations exist, such as the underexpression of anger relative to human baselines. As such, these findings highlight the need for continued calibration if LLM agents are to serve as proxies for human populations in behavioral modeling. By quantifying their divergence from human populations in terms of emotional expression, we hope that our methods can aid in this effort.

AI.tldr: 该文提出分层提示框架，为LLM智能体赋予"事件条件化"情绪反应能力，并用Social Science One Facebook URL Shares大规模社交媒体数据验证其在ABM中的情绪建模保真度。
AI.motivation: 情绪是行为核心驱动力，但多数行为模型忽略情绪；应急响应、公共卫生等领域缺乏情绪感知建模工具。LLM虽已嵌入ABM，但如何赋予智能体情绪推理能力、以及其能否复现实证情绪模式尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 构建分层提示（hierarchical prompting）框架，以人口学、心理学与情境线索为条件，使LLM智能体对真实世界事件生成事件条件化情绪反应；随后以Social Science One Facebook URL Shares数据集（辅以人口学与人格基准）作为大规模社交媒体反应参照进行验证。
AI.result: 模拟能高保真复现极化型与共识型两类情绪模式（统计显著）；同时发现系统性偏差，如相比人类基线智能体对愤怒的表达不足。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体可用于情绪感知的行为仿真，但尚不能直接作为人类群体代理，需持续校准；本文通过量化其与人类情绪表达的偏离为校准提供方法基础。

title: Rethinking Universal Time Series Foundation Models from Unified Representations to Shared Dynamics (UniTFU)
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have attracted increasing attention in cross-domain forecasting. Existing works mainly rely on large-scale pre-training and general modeling paradigms. However, the former heavily relies on the diversity and domain coverage of pre-training data. Meanwhile, the latter learns unified representations across heterogeneous domains without explicitly identifying the temporal regularities shared among them, limiting robust cross-domain generalization. This work explores cross-domain generalization by characterizing commonalities in recurring local dynamics across domains, rather than relying solely on implicitly learned temporal representations. To capture such cross-domain commonalities, we propose Time Series Foundation Units (TFUs) as reusable building blocks discovered from multi-scale temporal segments, each characterizing a recurring local dynamic pattern shared across domains. Building on TFUs, we develop a unified time series foundation model (UniTFU) that explicitly reuses and composes shared temporal regularities across domains for forecasting. Experiments on seven public datasets show that UniTFU substantially outperforms existing TSFMs in cross-domain forecasting and can efficiently adapt to target-domain dynamics by updating its reusable components with limited target data. UniTFU also achieves strong forecasting performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出从多尺度时间片段中挖掘可复用的"时间序列基础单元"(TFUs)来刻画跨域共有的局部动态模式，并据此构建统一基础模型 UniTFU，在七个公开数据集上显著优于现有 TSFM，且能用少量目标域数据高效适配。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型依赖大规模预训练与通用建模范式：前者受限于预训练数据的多样性与域覆盖；后者在异构域间学习统一表示，却未显式识别域间共享的时间规律，导致跨域泛化能力受限。因此作者希望显式刻画跨域重复出现的局部动态共性。
AI.method: 1) 从多尺度时间片段中发现可复用构件 TFU（Time Series Foundation Unit），每个 TFU 表征一个跨域重复出现的局部动态模式；2) 基于 TFU 构建统一模型 UniTFU，通过显式复用与组合共享时间规律进行预测；3) 适配阶段仅用少量目标域数据更新可复用组件，实现高效域适应。
AI.result: 在七个公开数据集上，UniTFU 的跨域预测性能显著优于现有 TSFM；相较当前最优方法也取得较强的预测表现；并能以有限目标域数据高效适配目标域动态。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模跨域共有的局部时间规律（以可复用单元形式）是提升时间序列基础模型跨域泛化的有效途径，同时兼具参数复用带来的高效适配优势。

title: Does Research-Paper Context Improve LLM-Generated Quadruped Navigation? An Exploratory Simulation Study
summary: Large language models can write competent robot navigation code, but not only does the research on the topic advance, a model may also, due to the volume of findings, fail to recall relevant findings and apply them to the task at hand. In this work, we test whether providing particular research papers as context improves the LLM-written navigation code for the Go2 quadruped, with the LLM (Claude Opus 5) and locomotion policy frozen. Specifically, we compare the navigation controllers the LLM writes when provided with and without particular papers across three settings: behavior trees, navigators edited from a shared base, and controllers written from scratch. When a maze's shortest route is blocked mid-episode, 2 of 8 controllers written with the context of an incremental-replanning paper complete all four trips under Isaac Sim physics, against 7 of 8 without it (two-sided Fisher's exact test, p = 0.041). This difference appears only under physics: in an idealized kinematic simulator, the controllers written with and without the paper are indistinguishable. We hypothesize that an LLM provided research papers as context tends to overweight both their content and their goals -- in this case, the efficiency of incremental replanning -- negatively affecting the fulfillment of the main task and leading to less robust code.

AI.tldr: 在LLM与运动策略冻结的条件下，将特定研究论文作为上下文提供给Claude Opus 5，反而降低了其为Go2四足机器人编写导航控制器的鲁棒性：在中途封锁最短路线的迷宫任务中，引入"增量重规划"论文上下文的8个控制器仅2个完成全部四次行程，而无该上下文的为7/8（Fisher精确检验 p=0.041），且该差异仅在Isaac Sim物理仿真中出现。
AI.motivation: LLM已能编写可用的机器人导航代码，但随着相关研究快速积累，模型可能因文献体量过大而无法回忆起并正确应用相关发现。作者希望检验"把特定论文作为上下文注入"这一朴素做法是否真能改进LLM生成的导航代码质量，而非想当然地假定其有益。
AI.method: 控制变量实验：固定LLM（Claude Opus 5）与运动策略，仅操纵是否提供特定论文作为上下文。在三种设定下比较生成的导航控制器——行为树、基于共享基座编辑的导航器、从零编写的控制器。评价环境对比理想化运动学仿真与Isaac Sim物理仿真，任务为迷宫导航，并在情景中途封锁最短路线以施加扰动。
AI.result: 在物理仿真下，给定"增量重规划"论文上下文的8个控制器中仅2个完成全部四次行程，而无该上下文时为7/8，差异显著（双侧Fisher精确检验，p=0.041）。在理想化运动学仿真中，有/无论文上下文生成的控制器表现无法区分，说明缺陷与物理真实性、扰动鲁棒性相关。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出假设：LLM在获得研究论文作为上下文时，会同时过度加权论文的内容与其目标（此处为增量重规划的效率），从而损害主任务的完成度并产出更脆弱、鲁棒性更差的代码。研究提示"检索相关论文并塞入上下文"并非稳健的代码增强手段，需要更谨慎的上下文注入与目标对齐机制。

title: Generalizable Feed-Forward 3D Hand-Object Reconstruction with Coarse-to-Fine Contact Estimation
summary: Reconstructing the 3D poses of hands and objects from a single image, together with the contact between them, is fundamental to understanding manipulation. To be practical, the reconstruction must generalize to unseen objects, and the contact must be localized precisely. Yet joint feed-forward estimators often rely on predefined object sets, while contact is typically predicted from image features alone, without the explicit geometry needed to localize it. To address both limitations, we present HORCRUX, a unified feed-forward transformer with coarse-to-fine contact estimation. For unseen objects, a frozen foundation model encodes the object from a given or image-reconstructed mesh rather than from object-specific knowledge. A shared transformer then reasons jointly over the object and one or two hands to keep them aligned. For precise contact, coarse per-joint predictions from latent features are resolved over finer hand regions using the reconstructed geometry. Across seven benchmarks, HORCRUX achieves state-of-the-art object and hand pose accuracy among joint estimators and outperforms a dedicated contact estimator in fine-grained contact. These results suggest that contact is best estimated jointly with reconstruction, whose geometry directly localizes it.

AI.tldr: HORCRUX：统一前馈Transformer从单图联合重建手与物体3D位姿及接触，采用冻结基础模型编码物体网格以泛化至未见物体，并用粗到细策略借助重建几何精确定位接触，在七个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 从单图重建手与物体3D位姿及二者接触是理解操作行为的基础。实用性要求两点：对未见物体的泛化能力，以及接触的精确定位。现有联合前馈估计器依赖预定义物体集合，且接触仅由图像特征预测、缺乏显式几何来定位，难以满足需求。
AI.method: 提出HORCRUX，统一前馈Transformer，含粗到细接触估计。物体部分用冻结基础模型，从给定或图像重建的网格编码物体，而非依赖物体专属知识；共享Transformer对物体与一只或两只手进行联合推理以保持对齐；接触部分先由隐特征给出逐关节粗预测，再借助重建几何在手部更细区域上细化。
AI.result: 在七个基准上，HORCRUX在联合估计器中达到最优的物体与手部位姿精度，并在细粒度接触上优于专用接触估计器。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明接触最好与重建联合估计，因为重建几何可直接用于定位接触。

title: Explainable Deep Learning for Malaria Parasite Detection and Species Differentiation in Thick Blood Smear Images: A Pilot Feasibility Study
summary: Species-level differentiation of Plasmodium falciparum (PF) and P. vivax (PV) determines treatment, yet deep learning detectors rarely test whether their explanations are reliable. In this pilot feasibility study of TRACE-Mal, a research prototype combining YOLOv8n-seg detection and a six-model soft-voting ensemble, we examined whether agreement among three post-hoc explanation methods (Grad-CAM, LIME and SHAP) is associated with the correctness of species calls. the study analysed 2,847 parasite crops from 250 thick smears within publicly available Lacuna Malaria Datasets. The model achieved an mAP50 score of 0.79 and the ensemble had a macro F1 of 0.84 (PF recall 0.86; PV recall 0.74). Unadjusted analyses of crops revealed that predictions explained by greather than or equal to 2 methods were more accurate (86.2% vs 78.9%; difference 7.3 percentage points; 95% CI 3.5-11.1) compared to those explained by less than 2 methods. As the number of explanatory methods increased so did prediction accuracy (from 73.8% for no methods to 89.5% for all three methods). When performing a cluster-bootstrap analysis of 60 test images, again there was a positive consensus difference (7.3 percentage points; 95% CI 2.9-11.8). Further, incorporating explanation information into a model's prediction confidence enhanced its error differentiation ability (AUROC 0.024; 95% CI 0.008-0.041). PF and PV parasite crops have distinct morphologies. Although based on one unvalidated public data source, these findings demonstrate proof-of-concept and should not be taken as a measure of diagnostic capability.

AI.tldr: 该可行性研究提出TRACE-Mal原型（YOLOv8n-seg检测+六模型软投票集成），考察Grad-CAM、LIME、SHAP三种事后解释方法之间的一致性是否与疟原虫虫种判读正确性相关：≥2种方法一致解释的预测准确率更高（86.2% vs 78.9%，差7.3个百分点），且将解释信息纳入置信度可提升错误判别能力。
AI.motivation: 恶性疟原虫（PF）与间日疟原虫（PV）的虫种鉴别直接决定治疗方案，但深度学习检测器很少检验其解释的可靠性。作者希望探究事后解释方法间的一致性是否能作为预测正确性的信号，从而为模型可信度评估提供一种低成本、可操作的质性校验途径。
AI.method: 研究在公开Lacuna Malaria Datasets的250张厚血膜、2,847个寄生虫裁剪图像上开展试点可行性研究。检测采用YOLOv8n-seg分割模型，分类采用六模型软投票集成。对每个裁剪图分别应用Grad-CAM、LIME、SHAP三种事后解释方法，统计被≥2种方法"解释到"的样本比例与预测正确性的关系；采用未调整分析与60张测试图像上的聚类自助法（cluster-bootstrap）进行稳健性检验；并进一步将解释一致性信息与模型预测置信度融合，评估其对错误的区分能力（AUROC）。
AI.result: 检测mAP50为0.79；集成分类宏平均F1为0.84（PF召回0.86，PV召回0.74）。未调整分析显示，被≥2种解释方法覆盖的预测准确率显著更高（86.2% vs 78.9%，差7.3个百分点，95% CI 3.5–11.1）；准确率随一致方法数单调上升（无方法73.8%→三种方法89.5%）。聚类自助法分析同样呈正向一致性差异（7.3个百分点，95% CI 2.9–11.8）。将解释信息纳入预测置信度后，错误区分能力提升（AUROC增量0.024，95% CI 0.008–0.041）。
AI.conclusion: PF与PV寄生虫裁剪图像具有可区分的形态特征。解释方法间的一致性可作为预测正确性的辅助指示信号，并能增益置信度校准。但研究仅基于单一未经外部验证的公开数据源，属概念验证性质，不能视为诊断性能的度量，需在多中心、经病理金标准验证的数据上进一步确认。

title: Beyond the Last Loop: Reinforcement Learning with a Teacher Extrapolated from the Model Itself
summary: Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop can be read out through the shared language-model head. Post-training them with verifiable rewards is hard: the outcome reward carries one bit per response, spreading it over loops trains intermediate loops on tokens sampled from the last loop, and distillation needs either a teacher that ignores the reward or an external, larger model. We observe that a looped model already contains a teacher stronger than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELGO (Extrapolated-Loop Group-relative Optimization) adds to GRPO a dense per-token distillation term towards this distribution. The teacher is computed from an anchor copy of the model, which stays frozen and is replaced by the current model once the student's KL to the teacher falls below a threshold, so the teacher improves with the student without chasing its own extrapolation. The outcome reward splits probability between correct and incorrect responses, and the teacher decides which tokens are preferred inside a response. Between refreshes the objective is KL-regularised RL anchored at the teacher, whose optimum tilts the teacher by the reward. On Ouro-1.4B-Thinking, ELGO raises the average avg@8 over five math benchmarks from 62.32 with GRPO to 64.20 and is the best compared method on every benchmark, while spreading the reward over loops falls below the base model.

AI.tldr: ELGO在GRPO基础上加入一个向“外推教师”分布的逐token蒸馏项，外推教师由冻结的锚模型计算并周期性替换，从而把单比特结果奖励更有效地分配给循环语言模型的各层循环，在Ouro-1.4B-Thinking上五个数学基准的avg@8由62.32提升至64.20。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型对每个token多次复用同一transformer栈，每次循环都可通过共享LM head读出，但其可验证奖励后训练困难：结果奖励每响应仅1比特，直接摊到各循环会让中间循环拟合末次循环采样的token；蒸馏则需无奖励教师或外部更大模型。作者希望利用模型自身内部的更强信号替代外部教师。
AI.method: 关键观察是循环模型本身含有一个强于末次循环的教师——由第一循环到最后一循环外推得到的下一token分布。ELGO在GRPO中加入朝向该外推分布的稠密逐token蒸馏项；教师由模型的一个锚副本计算，锚副本保持冻结，当学生到教师的KL低于阈值时用当前模型替换锚，使教师随学生共同改进而不追逐自身外推。结果奖励在正确/错误响应间分配概率，教师决定响应内哪些token被偏好。两次刷新之间目标为以教师为锚的KL正则化RL，其最优解为教师被奖励倾斜。
AI.result: 在Ouro-1.4B-Thinking上，ELGO将五个数学基准的平均avg@8从GRPO的62.32提升到64.20，并在每个基准上都是对比方法中最优；而将奖励摊到各循环的做法低于基座模型。
AI.conclusion: 循环模型的自外推分布可作为有效的内部稠密教师，配合锚模型刷新机制将结果奖励转化为逐token监督，优于直接在各循环间摊派奖励的朴素方案，为循环LM的可验证奖励后训练提供了新路径。

title: Delay-Tolerant Formation Tracking for Multi-AGV Systems via Reference-Shift Coupling
summary: Automated guided vehicles (AGVs) that transport a load together must keep a formation while each vehicle tracks its own reference, and they coordinate over wireless links with link-dependent, time-varying and jumping delays. We propose a cascade design for differential-drive AGVs modelled as kinematic unicycles: delayed data from the neighbours drive only a second-order filter that shifts each vehicle's own reference, and an unmodified gain-scheduled tracking law follows the shifted reference. A saturation keeps the shifted reference feasible, and the feed-forward is exact, so the tracking loop never sees the network. We prove that tracking and formation errors remain bounded for arbitrary delays and converge for every bounded delay and every directed, possibly switching, graph. We also construct a strict Lyapunov function with explicit constants and prove exponential convergence and a local input-to-state estimate with delay-independent gains. On undirected graphs, the coupling attenuates the formation error caused by persistent local errors by at least the factor lambda/(lambda+Lambda*lambda_2(L)) (leak lambda, coupling gain Lambda, algebraic connectivity lambda_2(L)), for any delay. Every inequality is verified with an event-driven, error-controlled simulation. A robustness study on a high-fidelity AGV model (drive dynamics, slip, localisation errors, clock offsets, lossy Wi-Fi) comprises 4,894 runs, including paired comparisons against tuned baselines. The cascade never failed, with latencies up to 4 s, 90% packet loss and up to 12 vehicles, whereas a direct delayed coupling failed when its gain saturated the drives. Coupling reduced the formation error after traction losses by 21-32% and after safety stops by up to 47%, at the price of tracking accuracy. Localisation bias and clock offsets, which no coupling law can observe, limit the achievable accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种级联设计的多AGV编队控制方法：邻居的延迟数据仅驱动一个二阶滤波器来平移各车自身参考轨迹，跟踪回路本身完全不受网络影响；并给出严格Lyapunov分析与大规模高保真仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 多台共同搬运负载的AGV需要在各自跟踪自身参考的同时保持编队，而它们通过无线链路协调，存在依赖链路、时变且跳变的延迟。直接将延迟的邻居数据耦合进控制回路会破坏稳定性（增益饱和时驱动器失效）。作者希望设计一种使跟踪回路"看不到"网络的控制结构，从而在任意延迟下都能保证有界性与收敛性。
AI.method: 针对建模为运动学独轮车的差速驱动AGV，提出级联方案：1）延迟的邻居数据只进入一个二阶滤波器，用于平移本车参考；2）饱和环节保证平移后的参考仍然可行；3）前馈精确，跟踪回路采用未修改的增益调度跟踪律跟随平移参考。理论上证明跟踪误差与编队误差在任意延迟下有界，并在任意有界延迟、任意有向（可切换）图下收敛；构造带显式常数的严格Lyapunov函数，证明指数收敛及延迟无关增益的局部输入-状态估计；无向图上给出耦合对持续局部误差引起编队误差的衰减因子 λ/(λ+Λλ₂(L))。实验上采用事件驱动、误差可控仿真逐条验证不等式，并在包含驱动动态、打滑、定位误差、时钟偏移、丢包Wi-Fi的高保真AGV模型上开展4,894次运行及与调优基线的配对比较。
AI.result: 级联方案从未失效，可在高达4 s延迟、90%丢包、最多12台车条件下工作；而直接延迟耦合方案在其增益使驱动器饱和时失效。耦合使牵引力丧失后的编队误差降低21–32%，安全停车后降低最多47%，代价是跟踪精度下降。定位偏差与时钟偏移无法被任何耦合律观测，限制了可达精度上限。所有不等式均通过事件驱动、误差可控的仿真得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过将网络延迟隔离在参考平移滤波器中，级联结构实现了对任意延迟和切换拓扑的鲁棒编队控制，并获得严格且常数显式的稳定性与性能保证；高保真大规模实验证实其在极端通信条件下的可靠性及对编队误差的显著衰减作用，同时明确了定位偏差与时钟偏移等不可观测因素构成精度瓶颈。

title: G0.7: Scaling Up a Fast World Action Model with Long Context
summary: World action models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generators for robot control by jointly predicting future camera frames and actions, transferring physical priors learned from video into manipulation policies. However, generating future frames before every action makes test-time inference too slow for closed-loop control, while most existing policies remain restricted to short observation histories. Building on Fast-WAM, which showed that video prediction shapes policy representations during training so that future frame synthesis can be skipped at deployment, we present G0.7, a generalist world action model scaled along two axes: extending the context window from a single observation to up to five minutes of history, and scaling pretraining to a large-scale corpus of robot teleoperation and human egocentric (ego) video. Across public simulation suites and real-robot deployments, direct action decoding (Fast mode) matches imagine-then-act (IDM) inference from the same checkpoint while running in 60 ms per 16-step action chunk on a single RTX 5090 (7.6x faster than IDM) and supporting pause-free real-time chunking. Performance scales consistently with pretraining data, with human ego video driving the largest gains in out-of-distribution generalization: G0.7 achieves a 70.8 mean score across five simulation benchmark suites, 48% and 54% zero-shot pick-and-place success on Galaxea R1 Pro and R1 Lite, 96.7% in-distribution and 93.3% out-of-distribution success on video-conditioned in-context learning tasks, and 86.9% mean task progress across seven real-world post-training tasks including multi-minute box folding, drink preparation, and product bagging.

AI.tldr: G0.7 是一个通用世界动作模型，将上下文窗口从单帧扩展到最长5分钟历史，并将预训练规模扩展至大规模机器人遥操作与人类自我中心视频语料；其 Fast 模式直接解码动作，单卡 60 ms/16步动作块（比 IDM 快 7.6 倍），在仿真与真机上取得 SOTA 级结果。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）需在每次动作前生成未来帧，测试时推理过慢，难以闭环控制；且多数策略仅支持短观测历史，长时序任务与分布外泛化能力受限。作者希望验证：训练期的视频预测已足以塑造策略表征，从而可在部署时跳过帧合成，并沿"长上下文"与"大规模预训练数据"两轴扩展。
AI.method: 基于 Fast-WAM 的思路（训练时联合预测未来帧以塑造策略表征，部署时省略未来帧生成），构建 G0.7：1）将上下文窗口从单次观测扩展至最长约5分钟历史；2）将预训练语料扩展至大规模机器人遥操作数据与人类自我中心（ego）视频；3）提出 Fast 模式直接动作解码，与同一 checkpoint 的 imagine-then-act（IDM）推理对比，支持无停顿的实时动作分块。
AI.result: Fast 模式与 IDM 性能相当，单张 RTX 5090 上 16 步动作块仅需 60 ms，比 IDM 快 7.6 倍。性能随预训练数据一致提升，人类 ego 视频带来最大的分布外泛化增益：五个仿真基准套件平均分 70.8；Galaxea R1 Pro / R1 Lite 零样本抓放成功率 48% / 54%；视频条件上下文学习任务 ID 96.7%、OOD 93.3%；七项真实世界后训练任务（含多分钟叠箱、饮品制作、商品装袋）平均任务进度 86.9%。
AI.conclusion: 训练期视频预测可有效充当表征学习信号，使部署阶段的未来帧生成成为可选而非必需，从而兼顾世界模型的物理先验与实时控制效率；长上下文与人类自我中心视频预训练是提升长时序操作与 OOD 泛化的关键扩展轴。

title: No Fixed Configuration Is Best: Context- and Cost-Aware Tuning of LLM Pipelines, with an Application to Schema Matching and Mapping
summary: The numeric settings of a multi-stage LLM pipeline (a compound AI system) are the usual target of tuning. We tuned all of them for an LLM pipeline for schema matching and mapping, with accuracy and cost as joint objectives, and we show what this buys, what it cannot buy, and where the remaining accuracy is. First, tuning buys cost and a little accuracy. On 35 tasks, with whole groups of tasks held out from tuning, one tuned configuration gains 2.9 points of top-1 accuracy (HR@1) over the default at 18% more cost, and another keeps the accuracy of the default at 32% lower cost. Second, the accuracy depends on a choice that numeric tuning cannot reach. Restricting the search for each source column to one assigned target table changes HR@1 by +30 points on a MIMIC-III to OMOP task and by -52 points on a task built from database views, more than numeric tuning gains on nine of ten test tasks. Neither setting is right for all tasks: on the larger set of 41 tasks used for the remaining results, mean HR@1 is 75.7% with the restriction (the default) and 83.1% without it. Third, choosing the setting per task is not enough either: even an oracle that picks the better setting for each task reaches only 87.8% on the 41 tasks, because the better setting differs between the columns of one task. The pipeline therefore runs both settings, and an LLM judge chooses among their candidate answers on the 26% of columns on which they disagree. This reaches 91.5% HR@1 on the 41 tasks, at 5.9 times the cost of the default, about one cent per column.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了一个用于Schema Matching/Mapping的多阶段LLM流水线（compound AI system）中数值超参调优的收益边界，并指出真正的精度瓶颈在于一个数值调优无法触及的结构性决策——是否将每个源列限制到单一指定目标表；最终通过同时运行两种设置并用LLM judge裁决分歧，在41个任务上把HR@1提升到91.5%。
AI.motivation: 以往对LLM流水线的优化通常聚焦于数值型超参（如模型参数、提示设置等），但作者希望弄清：对多阶段LLM流水线的数值设置进行联合调优（以准确率与成本为双重目标）究竟能带来什么、不能带来什么，以及剩余精度损失来自何处。
AI.method: 在Schema Matching/Mapping流水线上对全部数值设置进行联合搜索，目标为top-1准确率（HR@1）与成本；采用任务组整体留出的方式评估泛化性。同时对比一个非数值型结构性选择：是否将每个源列的搜索范围限制到唯一指定的目标表。进一步分析按任务选择该设置的oracle上界，并提出"双设置并行+LLM judge在分歧列上裁决"的组合策略。
AI.result: 在35个任务上：一套配置相比默认提升+2.9点HR@1但成本增加18%；另一套在成本降低32%的情况下保持默认精度。结构性设置的影响远大于数值调优：在MIMIC-III→OMOP任务上提升+30点，在基于数据库视图构建的任务上降低-52点，其幅度在十个测试任务中的九个超过数值调优收益。41个任务上，限制设置（默认）平均HR@1为75.7%，不限制为83.1%。即便逐任务选择最优设置的oracle也仅达87.8%，因为同一任务内不同列的最优设置不同。双设置运行并由LLM judge在26%存在分歧的列上裁决，达到91.5% HR@1，成本为默认的5.9倍，约每列一美分。
AI.conclusion: 数值调优只能带来有限成本节省与小幅精度提升，无法触及关键的架构性/语义性决策；此类离散决策的影响跨任务高度异质，甚至在任务内部逐列不同。因此更有效的做法不是调数值或按任务选设置，而是并行运行互补设置并用LLM judge做列级集成，以可控成本换取显著精度提升。

title: Sounding the Black Box: Online Training of Embedded Neural Networks in Forward-Only Physical Simulators
summary: Hybrid physics-neural simulators embed neural networks in partial differential equation (PDE) solvers to model unresolved subgrid dynamics while preserving resolved physics and conservation laws. Because closure outputs feed back across time steps, single-step offline regression does not directly minimize multi-step rollout error, motivating online trajectory optimization. Solver backpropagation through time (BPTT) is the standard online solution when solver derivatives are available, yet many operational Fortran and C/C++ simulators expose only non-differentiable, forward-only interfaces. We introduce FORGE (Forward-Only Response and Gauss-Newton Estimation), an online framework that trains embedded networks from forward runs alone by decoupling exact network derivatives from black-box simulator dynamics. Stage I warms up the rollout via a low-dimensional Gauss-Newton step along output-orthonormal weight directions, canceling multi-layer feature drift via a final-layer correction. Stage II perturbs spatial output fields to fit a gain-bounded causal linear response operator across rollout steps, solves for regularized target outputs, and updates all weights via network backpropagation. Across five 2D and 3D benchmarks spanning phase separation, reaction-diffusion, fluid and MHD turbulence, and ocean circulation, FORGE outperforms gradient-free, reinforcement-learning, and emulator-based baselines, cutting coarse-solver test mean squared error (MSE) by 50%-96% in 2D and 70% in 3D, outperforming the strongest forward-only baseline by 16%-69%, and recovering 88%-98% of Solver BPTT's gains. Code is available at https://github.com/ChiyodaMomo01/FORGE.

AI.tldr: FORGE 是一种仅依赖前向模拟器接口的在线训练框架，通过解耦网络精确导数与黑箱求解器动力学，在五类2D/3D基准上显著超越无梯度、强化学习与代理模型基线，并恢复 Solver BPTT 88%–98% 的收益。
AI.motivation: 混合物理-神经模拟器将神经网络嵌入PDE求解器以建模未解析的亚网格动力学。由于闭包输出跨时间步反馈，单步离线回归无法直接最小化多步 rollout 误差，因而需要在线轨迹优化；然而许多实际运行的 Fortran/C/C++ 模拟器仅提供不可微、仅前向的接口，无法使用求解器 BPTT。
AI.method: 提出 FORGE（Forward-Only Response and Gauss-Newton Estimation），含两阶段：阶段一对输出正交的权重方向做低维 Gauss-Newton 步进行 rollout 预热，并通过末层校正抵消多层特征漂移；阶段二扰动空间输出场，拟合带增益约束的因果线性响应算子，求解正则化目标输出，再经网络反向传播更新全部权重。
AI.result: 在相分离、反应扩散、流体与MHD湍流、海洋环流共五个2D/3D基准上，FORGE优于无梯度、强化学习和基于代理模型的基线：粗求解器测试MSE在2D降低50%–96%、3D降低70%，比最强仅前向基线优16%–69%，并恢复 Solver BPTT 收益的88%–98%。
AI.conclusion: FORGE 证明在求解器不可微的约束下，仅用前向运行即可实现有效的多步在线闭包训练，为遗留 Fortran/C/C++ 模拟器中的嵌入网络提供实用、接近 BPTT 的替代方案。

title: A Face Robot which Imitates Human Musculoskeletal Skin System and Its Evaluation on Basic Movement of Facial Expression
comment: Accepted to IEEE-RAS Humanoids 2026, website - https://haraduka.github.io/musculoskeletal-face/, youtube - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eRuoUJ056uc
summary: Facial robots require many coordinated, smallamplitude motions, but accommodating these motions in a compact face remains difficult. This paper presents an anatomically inspired facial-robot platform that reproduces the layered organization of the human facial musculoskeletal system. The platform comprises bone, muscle, and skin components whose geometry, shape, and attachment locations are derived from three-dimensional anatomical data. Wire-driven, compliant muscle components are routed through PTFE tubes, allowing actuation to be placed away from the face. We describe the selection and fabrication of 65 muscles (34 muscle types) required to reproduce the 47 target action units (AUs) in the Facial Action Coding System (FACS). We then evaluate the reproducibility of individual AUs in two stages: muscle actuation without skin and actuation after the silicone skin is attached. Forty of the 47 target AUs were reproduced with the muscle components, and 30 were reproduced after skin attachment. These results demonstrate the feasibility of reproducing a broad range of FACS facial expressions using an anatomically inspired musculoskeletal structure. The proposed platform provides a foundation for the systematic development and evaluation of future anatomically inspired facial robots

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种解剖学启发的面部机器人平台，按人体面部骨骼-肌肉-皮肤的分层结构设计，用基于三维解剖数据的线驱柔性肌肉复现FACS动作单元，47个目标AU中肌肉层可复现40个、附着硅胶皮肤后可复现30个。
AI.motivation: 面部机器人需要大量协调的小幅运动，而在紧凑面部空间内集成这些运动十分困难；现有设计缺乏与人体面部肌肉骨骼组织方式对应的系统化方案。
AI.method: 构建包含骨骼、肌肉、皮肤三层组件的平台，几何形状与附着位置取自三维解剖数据；肌肉为线驱柔性单元，通过PTFE管走线以将驱动器移出面部；共设计65个肌肉（34种肌肉类型）以对应FACS的47个目标AU；分两阶段评估AU可复现性：无皮肤肌肉驱动阶段与贴附硅胶皮肤后阶段。
AI.result: 肌肉组件阶段成功复现47个目标AU中的40个；贴附硅胶皮肤后复现30个。皮肤附着导致可复现AU数量下降约10个。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明基于解剖学启发的肌肉骨骼结构可复现较广范围的FACS面部表情，该平台为未来解剖学启发式面部机器人的系统化开发与评估提供了基础。

title: Gaze World Model
summary: Where a person looks indicates their focus of attention, and how their gaze shifts between targets reveals how that attention responds to a changing scene. Existing gaze target estimation methods largely operate frame by frame and do not model these shifts. Gaze shifts are often driven by dynamic changes in the scene, which is the kind of information world models are designed to encode. This relationship is subtle, however, since an event far across the frame may produce only a slight movement of the person's head or eyes. We therefore introduce the Gaze World Model (GWM), which co-trains latent scene prediction with person-conditioned gaze supervision on a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder; in our ablations, the latent prediction objective improves both shift detection and gaze localization. Given a video clip and the person's head box, GWM estimates gaze locations and detects gaze shifts in the observed clip, and forecasts future gaze and shifts from predicted scene features. To train and evaluate these tasks, we augment VideoAttentionTarget and ChildPlay with event-level gaze-shift annotations. GWM achieves state-of-the-art shift detection on these benchmarks, about 10 points higher in four-class AP than the strongest baseline, while remaining comparable to the strongest image-based models in gaze target estimation, and outperforms the compared baselines on future gaze localization and shift forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出Gaze World Model（GWM），在冻结V-JEPA 2.1编码器上联合训练潜在场景预测与人条件化注视监督，实现注视目标估计、注视转移检测与未来注视预测。
AI.motivation: 现有注视目标估计方法多为逐帧处理，未建模注视在目标间的转移；而注视转移常由场景动态变化驱动，这类信息正是世界模型擅长编码的内容。二者关联微妙：画面远处的事件可能仅引起头部或眼部的细微运动，因此需要借世界模型捕捉弱耦合关系。
AI.method: 在冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器上协同训练两个目标：潜在场景预测与以人物为条件的注视监督；输入为视频片段与人物头部框，输出当前片段内的注视位置与注视转移检测结果，并基于预测的场景特征外推未来注视与转移。此外在VideoAttentionTarget与ChildPlay上扩充事件级注视转移标注用于训练与评测。
AI.result: 在两项基准上取得最优的注视转移检测性能，四类AP比最强基线高约10个点；注视目标估计与最强图像模型相当；在未来注视定位与转移预测上优于对比基线。消融显示潜在预测目标同时提升了转移检测与注视定位。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型的潜在动态预测与人物条件化注视建模结合，可有效利用场景动态线索，统一处理过去的注视估计、转移检测与未来预测，验证了场景预测目标对注视理解的增益。

title: RepoEviAgent: Scalable Synthesis of Evidence-Grounded Repository-Level Question Answering Tasks
summary: Real-world software engineering (SWE) tasks require agents to understand repository structures, cross-module dependencies, and runtime behaviors, posing significant challenges for constructing high-quality training and evaluation data. To address this, we propose RepoEviAgent, a scalable SWE data construction framework that integrates quality-aware data curation and role-specialized multi-agent task synthesis. Starting from 8,477 open-source repositories and approximately 2.48 million pull request records, we employ semantic alignment, complexity constraints, and multidimensional quality assessment to identify valuable SWE data. We further develop a sandbox-based multi-agent framework that integrates automated environment construction, execution validation, repository exploration, and evidence-grounded Q&A synthesis. Based on this framework, we construct RepoEviQA, a benchmark for Repository-Level Evidence-Grounded Question Answering, comprising 334 tasks across five programming languages and diverse SWE categories, with rigorous rubric-based evaluation. We evaluate five frontier coding models on RepoEviQA, revealing substantial performance differences across task categories and programming languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可扩展的仓库级SWE数据构建框架RepoEviAgent，融合质量感知数据筛选与角色分工多智能体合成，构建了RepoEviQA基准（334个任务、5种语言）。
AI.motivation: 真实软件工程任务要求智能体理解仓库结构、跨模块依赖与运行时行为，而构建高质量训练与评测数据代价高昂、难度大，现有数据难以支撑此类能力评测。
AI.method: 从8,477个开源仓库、约248万条PR记录出发，通过语义对齐、复杂度约束与多维质量评估筛选数据；再构建基于沙箱的多智能体框架，集成自动化环境搭建、执行验证、仓库探索与基于证据的问答合成，并采用严格的rubric评分体系。
AI.result: 构建了RepoEviQA基准，包含跨5种编程语言、覆盖多类SWE任务的334个评测任务；对5个前沿编码模型的评测显示出任务类别与编程语言间的显著性能差异。
AI.conclusion: RepoEviAgent为仓库级证据问答数据提供了可扩展的自动化构建路径，RepoEviQA可作为区分模型能力的诊断性基准，并为后续SWE智能体训练与评测提供数据基础。

title: On the Information Loss of Multi-Token Prediction: Origin and Solution
summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) accelerates autoregressive decoding through block-wise prediction, but remains vulnerable to error accumulation across sequentially generated blocks. To investigate this limitation, we analyze the distinction between block-wise and sequence-level cumulative information loss (CIL). Specifically, when the model generates using its own previous outputs without access to reference answers, the input-conditional gap equals the cross-block dependence of the reference targets. To improve prediction when these generated prefixes are imperfect, we propose Dual-MTP, which supervises shared prediction heads under full and randomly masked contexts. Together, complete-prefix supervision and context perturbations provide complementary training signals while retaining the MTP architecture. To characterize this training objective, we use the normalized dual loss to bound the divergence between the model's predictive distributions under full and masked contexts. Experiments across five backbones and six tasks spanning mathematical reasoning and GLUE understanding show that Dual-MTP achieves the highest average task score on four of five backbones, with gains of up to 2.46 points over MTP. On mathematical reasoning tasks, Dual-MTP also achieves 1.4 to 1.9 times the decoding throughput of the NTP reference. Together, these results show that dual-context supervision can improve prediction accuracy while retaining efficient multi-token decoding.

AI.tldr: 论文分析多token预测（MTP）中跨块误差累积问题，提出Dual-MTP——在全上下文与随机掩码上下文下共同监督共享预测头，在不改变MTP架构的前提下提升预测精度并保持高效解码。
AI.motivation: MTP通过块级预测加速自回归解码，但由于逐块顺序生成，误差会在块间累积，导致后续预测质量下降。作者希望刻画这一局限：当模型以自身输出作为前缀（无参考答案）时，块级与序列级累积信息损失（CIL）的差异，以及输入条件间隙与参考目标跨块依赖之间的关系，从而为改进监督提供理论依据。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：区分块级与序列级累积信息损失（CIL），指出在自生成前缀条件下，输入条件间隙等于参考目标的跨块依赖；2) 提出Dual-MTP：在完整前缀上下文和随机掩码上下文两种条件下，对共享预测头同时施加监督，结合完整前缀监督与上下文扰动提供互补训练信号，并保持原MTP架构不变；3) 用归一化对偶损失（normalized dual loss）界定全上下文与掩码上下文下预测分布之间的散度，刻画该训练目标。
AI.result: 在5个骨干模型、6个任务（数学推理与GLUE理解）上评测：Dual-MTP在5个骨干中的4个上取得最高平均任务分数，相比MTP最高提升2.46分；在数学推理任务上，解码吞吐达到NTP参考的1.4至1.9倍。
AI.conclusion: 对偶上下文监督（完整前缀+掩码扰动）既能提升预测准确率，又能保留多token高效解码的优势，是一种无需改动MTP架构的轻量改进方案。

title: ROVO: Robust Rotation-Only Visual Odometry for UAVs at Low and Moderate Altitudes
summary: Image noise can confound rotation and translation estimates in monocular visual navigation for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) at low and moderate altitudes, where even small perturbations may cause large errors in translation direction. Inspired by angular cues in long-range visual perception, we propose rotation-only visual odometry (ROVO) for monocular aerial imagery. ROVO estimates pairwise rotations from matched images, robustly averages them over overlapping windows, and aligns consecutive windows through shared frames. By retaining only orientation in the trajectory state, it prevents uncertain landmark depth from propagating to later estimates. In trajectory simulation, sliding-window ROVO achieved a mean orientation error just 10.7% as large as that of the conventional SLAM baseline. On real flight data, ROVO achieved rotation accuracy comparable to ORB-SLAM3 and DPVO under the original Bell412 settings. With a narrower FoV or at higher flight altitude, ROVO reduced relative rotation RMSE by 19.7--69.4% compared with the next-best method in each comparison. Code and simulation tools are available at https://github.com/sssxxxkkkk/ROVO.

AI.tldr: 该文提出只估计旋转的单目视觉里程计ROVO，用滑窗鲁棒平均抑制图像噪声对平移方向估计的影响，仿真与真实飞行数据均显示其在姿态精度上优于常规SLAM基线，并在窄视场/高空场景显著降低相对旋转RMSE。
AI.motivation: 无人机在中低空飞行时，图像噪声会干扰单目视觉导航中的旋转与平移估计，即使很小的扰动也会导致平移方向出现较大误差；受远距离视觉感知中角度线索的启发，作者希望只利用方向信息进行估计。
AI.method: 提出旋转-only视觉里程计ROVO：对匹配图像估计成对旋转，在重叠窗口内做鲁棒平均，并通过共享帧对齐相邻窗口；轨迹状态中仅保留姿态，从而避免不确定的地标深度误差向后传播。
AI.result: 轨迹仿真中滑窗ROVO的平均姿态误差仅为常规SLAM基线的10.7%；在原始Bell412真实飞行数据上旋转精度与ORB-SLAM3、DPVO相当；在更窄视场或更高飞行高度下，相对旋转RMSE相比各对比中的次优方法降低19.7%–69.4%。
AI.conclusion: ROVO以纯旋转估计规避了深度不确定性带来的误差累积，在噪声敏感与几何退化（窄视场、高空）场景中具有明显的旋转精度优势；代码与仿真工具已开源。

title: JECT: Addressing the Context Shortcut in Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Chest CT
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 23 tables, including supplementary material. Code and weights: https://github.com/lukeingawesome/JECT
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn by predicting features of masked regions from visible context. In chest computed tomography, the findings that decide a diagnosis, such as a small nodule, are often not predictable from the surrounding anatomy. A hidden finding is then best predicted toward normal anatomy, and the prediction loss stops rewarding the encoder for representing it. We call this the context shortcut. Conditioning the predictor on the radiology report repairs the prediction, but in our setup the encoder gains little over image-only pretraining: the report supplies what the encoder never had to learn. JECT therefore gives the report two roles: a condition for the predictor and, through masked section-text prediction, a target for the encoder, which must predict the report's anatomical sections from the unmasked scan. A hierarchical three-dimensional encoder that predicts at every stage keeps this clinical content at every scale. In ablations, the text target improves classification and localization, while conditioning adds little to the encoder. Trained from scratch on 173k volumes, the recipe reaches the level of current computed tomography foundation models in classification, retrieval and nodule malignancy, and of task-specific models in lung-cancer risk prediction after fine-tuning. Conditioning still matters: its predictor can be reused, with no extra training, to show where a report sentence acts, changing most at the finding the sentence describes. Code and pretrained weights are available.

AI.tldr: JECT将放射报告同时作为预测器的条件与编码器的预测目标，解决胸部CT中JEPA式表征学习被"上下文捷径"削弱的问题。
AI.motivation: JEPA通过从可见上下文预测被遮挡区域的特征来学习，但胸部CT中决定诊断的关键征象（如小结节）往往无法从周围解剖结构推断。此时模型倾向于把被遮挡的异常区域预测为正常解剖，预测损失不再激励编码器表征该征象——作者称之为"上下文捷径"。若仅将放射报告作为预测器的条件，虽能修复预测，但编码器几乎学不到额外信息，因为报告提供了编码器本应自己学到的内容。
AI.method: 提出JECT，赋予报告两种角色：(1)作为预测器的条件；(2)作为编码器的预测目标，通过掩码片段文本预测，让模型从未遮挡扫描预测报告中的解剖章节。采用分层三维编码器，在每个阶段都进行预测，以在各个尺度保留临床内容。从头在173k个体积上训练。
AI.result: 消融实验显示：文本目标提升分类与定位性能，而条件化对编码器贡献很小。性能方面，在分类、检索和结节恶性判定上达到当前CT基础模型水平；微调后在肺癌风险预测上达到任务专用模型水平。条件化仍然有价值：其预测器可零额外训练复用，用于定位报告句子作用位置，且变化最大处正是句子所描述的征象。
AI.conclusion: 报告作为编码器预测目标（而非仅作条件）是JEPA在医学影像中避免上下文捷径的关键设计；条件化分支虽对表征学习贡献有限，但可作为无需训练的可解释性工具。

title: HEAR, SEE, SPIKE ONCE: Highly Efficient NeuroAI Temporal Neural Networks for Low-Precision Multimodal Audio-Visual Classification and Online Learning
summary: Spiking neural networks for multimodal audio-visual classification reach high accuracy by adopting deep-learning machinery: multi-stage convolutional or transformer encoders trained end-to-end with surrogate-gradient backpropagation through time. These prior works typically rely on full-precision (32-bit) parameters and do not treat hardware efficiency as a primary design objective. In this paper, we propose NeuTNN-AV, a much simpler hardware-amenable multimodal substrate built on the recently proposed NeuroAI Temporal Neural Network (NeuTNN) and demonstrate that it can match or outperform state-of-the-art SNN baselines with a fraction of their synapse counts. NeuTNN neurons carry multiple active dendritic segments. Each input line spikes at most once (temporal coding) and every weight is learned via a local reward-modulated spike-timing dependent plasticity (STDP) rule. All weights are 4-bit integers and inference uses only comparisons and additions. On CREMA-D, it reaches 78.6% with 2.34M synapses establishing a new state-of-the-art SNN accuracy, against 77.14% for MISNet-XL (31M parameters). On UrbanSound8K-AV, NeuTNN reaches 98.82% with 1.38M synapses, against 96.85% for SMMT (9.99M parameters) and 98.96% for MISNet-XL (31M parameters). Weight memory is 23-106x smaller than the spiking baselines, and the measured synaptic energy per inference is two to three orders of magnitude lower. Furthermore, the proposed NeuTNN learns CREMA-D in a single pass with 73.8% accuracy and demonstrates rapid online continual learning by adapting to unseen actors from a few dozen clips.

AI.tldr: 提出NeuTNN-AV，一种基于多树突段神经元、4-bit权重、局部奖励调制STDP训练和时序编码的硬件友好型多模态视听分类基底，以远少于SNN基线的突触数达到或超过SOTA精度，并大幅降低权重存储与突触能耗。
AI.motivation: 现有用于多模态视听分类的脉冲神经网络依赖深度学习机制（多级卷积/Transformer编码器、BPTT+替代梯度端到端训练），普遍使用32位全精度参数，且未将硬件效率作为主要设计目标，导致参数规模与能耗庞大。
AI.method: 构建NeuTNN-AV：神经元具有多个活跃树突段；输入线采用时序编码，每条输入线最多发放一次；所有权重通过局部奖励调制STDP规则学习；权重为4-bit整数，推理仅需比较与加法运算。
AI.result: CREMA-D上达78.6%（2.34M突触），超过MISNet-XL的77.14%（31M参数），刷新SNN SOTA；UrbanSound8K-AV上98.82%（1.38M突触），对比SMMT 96.85%（9.99M参数）与MISNet-XL 98.96%（31M参数）。权重内存缩小23–106倍，实测每次推理突触能耗低2–3个数量级；单遍学习CREMA-D即可达73.8%，并能用数十个片段快速在线持续学习新说话人。
AI.conclusion: 简化的局部学习型NeuTNN基底可在多模态视听任务上以极少突触与极低能耗匹配或超越重型SNN基线，并具备单遍学习与在线持续学习能力，验证了硬件友好设计路线的可行性。

title: Predict Backbone, Graft Dynamics: A Decoupled Paradigm for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Modern long-term forecasters are typically optimized for point-wise accuracy, which rewards dominant low-frequency backbones but often suppresses high-utility local dynamics such as abrupt variations, transient surges, and turning points. We propose Predict Backbone, Graft Dynamics, a decoupled forecasting paradigm that separates stable structural prediction from grounded dynamic restoration. We instantiate it as GRAFT, where a base forecaster predicts the reliable trajectory backbone, and a dedicated grafting path restores historically recurrent dynamics through retrieval-based evidence, phase-aware release, channel-wise control, and restoration-cooperative optimization. Unlike generic post-hoc revision methods that correct residual errors, GRAFT formulates the second stage as grounded dynamic grafting, where historical response evidence is calibrated into transferable dynamics and selectively grafted onto the backbone under phase-, channel-, and confidence-aware constraints. Across the full evaluation grid of seven benchmarks, two metrics, four horizons, and six backbones, GRAFT improves over the corresponding backbone in 87% of all comparisons, with average MSE/MAE reductions of 4.6%/3.9%. Dynamic-window analyses show that GRAFT restores local dynamics while preserving the stable backbone structure. These results suggest a new principle for high-utility forecasting: predict the backbone, then graft the dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出"预测骨架、嫁接动态"的解耦预测范式,并实例化为GRAFT框架,在七个基准、两个指标、四个预测步长、六个骨干模型的全网格评估中87%比较优于对应骨干,MSE/MAE平均降低4.6%/3.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有长期预测模型多以逐点精度为优化目标,这奖励了主导的低频骨架,却抑制了高价值的局部动态(突变、瞬态冲击、转折点)。通用的事后修正方法只纠正残差误差,难以恢复这类动态。
AI.method: 将稳定结构预测与动态恢复解耦:基预测器输出可靠轨迹骨架;独立"嫁接"通路通过基于检索的证据、相位感知释放、通道级控制和恢复协同优化,把历史中反复出现的响应证据校准为可迁移动态,并在相位、通道、置信度约束下选择性嫁接到骨架之上。
AI.result: 七基准×两指标×四步长×六骨干的完整评估网格中,87%的比较优于对应骨干,平均MSE/MAE分别下降4.6%/3.9%;动态窗口分析表明GRAFT在保留稳定骨架结构的同时恢复了局部动态。
AI.conclusion: 面向高可用性预测的新原则是"先预测骨架,再嫁接动态";解耦式两阶段设计可在不破坏骨架的前提下提升局部动态刻画能力。

title: ViTacLab: Physically Consistent Visuo-Tactile Simulation, Benchmarking, and Representation Learning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Tactile sensing is essential for contact-rich robotic manipulation, but existing visuo-tactile simulators trade physical fidelity for scalability, and benchmarks largely focus on two-finger grippers. We present ViTacLab, a framework comprising ViTacSim, ViTacBench, and ViTacPolicy. ViTacSim uses a tri-modal tactile primitive: a global sparse contact-force lattice, a local dense force array, and tactile images. Anchored to PhysX contact-solver outputs, it corrects normal inconsistency through local stiffness alignment and reconstructs tangential forces under decoupled slip-stick regimes while preserving GPU parallelism. A joint projection preserves the sparse wrench and enforces local friction cones. ViTacBench spans parallel grippers, dexterous hands, and bimanual systems, with tasks ranging from vision-dominant to tactile-dominant regimes. ViTacPolicy aggregates variable numbers of heterogeneous tactile inputs using spatial-pose embeddings and a Transformer, and aligns force-array and tactile-image modalities through a two-stream VQ-VAE with a shared codebook. Controlled Hertzian-reference indentation and real-sensor sliding tests reduce normal and tangential force RMSE from 2.31 and 1.85 N to 0.42 and 0.53 N, respectively. Throughput reaches 2,482.9 tactile-pipeline FPS at 256 parallel environments. Simulation and real-world experiments show gains on several contact-rich tasks, while low absolute success on tactile-dominant tasks highlights the remaining difficulty of purely tactile control.

AI.tldr: ViTacLab：一套包含高保真视触觉仿真器ViTacSim、覆盖多手型任务的基准ViTacBench与多模态策略ViTacPolicy的触觉机器人操作框架，显著降低触觉力重建误差并保持GPU并行吞吐。
AI.motivation: 现有视触觉仿真器在物理保真度与可扩展性之间难以兼顾，且相关基准多局限于两指夹爪，缺乏面向灵巧手、双臂等复杂构型及触觉主导任务的统一评测与策略学习平台。
AI.method: 提出三重触觉基元表示（全局稀疏接触力格点、局部稠密力阵列、触觉图像），以PhysX接触求解器输出为锚，通过局部刚度对齐修正法向不一致，并在解耦滑移-粘着机制下重建切向力，同时保持GPU并行；采用联合投影保留稀疏力旋量并施加局部摩擦锥约束。ViTacBench覆盖平行夹爪、灵巧手与双臂系统及从视觉主导到触觉主导的任务谱系。ViTacPolicy以空间位姿嵌入与Transformer聚合可变数量的异构触觉输入，并用共享码本的双流VQ-VAE对齐力阵列与触觉图像模态。
AI.result: 在受控Hertzian参考压痕与真实传感器滑动测试中，法向与切向力RMSE分别从2.31 N、1.85 N降至0.42 N、0.53 N；在256个并行环境下触觉流水线吞吐达2482.9 FPS。仿真与真机实验在多项接触丰富任务上取得性能提升，但触觉主导任务的绝对成功率偏低。
AI.conclusion: ViTacLab在仿真保真度、并行效率与多构型基准覆盖方面取得进展，验证了异构触觉融合与跨模态对齐的有效性；同时表明纯触觉控制仍是开放性难题，触觉主导任务的成功率提升是后续研究重点。

title: Don't Miss the Forest for the Trees: Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition with Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototypes
summary: Zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition is evaluated almost exclusively on flat leaf labels, which leaves open whether a representation also grounds the broader concepts that contain an action in skeleton motion. We find that strong leaf alignment does not carry over to them: when ancestor concepts are scored directly under independent decoding, eight flat methods with 57.86-73.29% mean leaf Top-1 reach only 6.15-31.21% mean full-path accuracy across four NTU RGB+D splits. We propose the Hyperbolic Hierarchical Semantic Prototype ($H^2SP$) framework, which represents every node of an action taxonomy in the Lorentz model of hyperbolic space. First, instead of learning a free vector per node, $H^2SP$ synthesizes hierarchy-aware prototypes by recursive parent-child geodesic interpolation under a single tree-wide gate. Second, tangent-space semantic and distributional alignment on seen classes anchor the leaf prototypes in skeleton motion. Third, a soft entailment-cone regularizer encourages directional parent-child inclusion, propagating this motion grounding to ancestor concepts. We evaluate hierarchical concept prediction under independent and cascade decoding, and transfer to an alternative taxonomy without retraining. Across the four splits, $H^2SP$ attains the best mean independent and cascade full-path accuracy among the evaluated methods, at a comparable leaf Top-1 of 72.40%. Transferred to the alternative taxonomy, it outperforms both flat baselines and the same-tree Euclidean control across every split and decoding mode, indicating that its concept-level correspondence extends beyond the training taxonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文指出零样本骨架动作识别仅在扁平叶子标签上评测，强叶子对齐并不能迁移到祖先概念（八种方法叶子Top-1达57.86–73.29%，但全路径准确率仅6.15–31.21%），为此提出双曲层级语义原型框架H²SP，在Lorentz双曲空间中建模动作分类学全部节点，显著提升层级概念预测与跨分类学迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本骨架动作识别评测几乎只关注扁平叶子标签，缺乏对"表示是否也能在骨架运动上落地其上层概念"的检验。作者实证发现：叶子层面强对齐并不迁移到祖先概念——八种扁平方法平均叶子Top-1为57.86–73.29%，但在四个NTU RGB+D划分下独立解码的全路径准确率仅6.15–31.21%。因此需要一种能显式建模层级概念结构的表示方法。
AI.method: 提出H²SP（双曲层级语义原型）框架，在双曲空间Lorentz模型中表示动作分类学的每个节点。三点设计：(1) 不逐节点学习自由向量，而是在单一树级门控下通过递归父子测地线插值合成层级感知原型；(2) 在已见类上做切空间语义与分布对齐，将叶子原型锚定于骨架运动；(3) 引入软蕴含锥正则项，鼓励有向的父子包含关系，从而把这种运动落地性传播到祖先概念。评测覆盖独立解码与级联解码下的层级概念预测，以及不重训练的跨分类学迁移。
AI.result: 在四个NTU RGB+D划分上，H²SP在被评测方法中取得最佳的平均独立解码与级联解码全路径准确率，同时叶子Top-1保持在可比的72.40%。迁移到替代分类学时，其在每个划分与每种解码模式下均优于扁平基线和同树欧氏对照，说明其概念级对应关系可超越训练所用分类学。
AI.conclusion: 仅优化叶子标签不足以获得层级概念层面的骨架—语义对应；在双曲空间中以层级合成原型并用蕴含锥正则传播运动落地性，能同时改善祖先概念预测和跨分类学泛化，为层级化零样本骨架动作识别提供了有效范式。

title: Cheap Memory Costs Future Compute: Co-Designing Persistent KV and GPU Execution for Efficient Streaming Video Diffusion
summary: Block-causal video diffusion generates long videos block by block, conditioned on a persistent key-value (KV) cache. After each block is denoised, an extra noise-free ($t=0$) forward pass writes its clean KV into the cache; once distillation and speculative early exit make denoising cheap, this clean KV update dominates the runtime. Reusing stale KV shortens the update, but stale memory corrupts the conditioning of later blocks and inflates their denoising steps, so the saved compute reappears downstream. We present SAMR (Step-Aware Memory Reconstruction), a training-free method for frozen causal video DiTs that refreshes only part of the cache and reconstructs the rest without DiT forwards. Our key observation is that, once rotary position phases are removed, motion-aligned historical KV and the in-flight KV a token holds at its exit step are complementary estimates of its clean KV. SAMR debiases in-flight KV with offline-calibrated per-head affine maps in Pre-RoPE space, fuses the two estimates, and reserves true $t=0$ refreshes for tokens flagged by an attention-readout error proxy, all executed by tile-aligned, synchronization-free Triton kernels. On 48-second LongLive-1.3B videos, SAMR reduces DiT latency by 20.9% and principal FLOPs by 30.7% relative to dense KV updates, lowers downstream denoising steps, and improves final-quarter PSNR over token reuse by 1.61 dB (1.14 dB on held-out VidProM-16). The reconstruction also transfers to frozen Self-Forcing-DMD-1.3B: zero-shot, it reduces reuse-induced step inflation ($2.47 \to 2.30$ steps/token) and improves late PSNR by $+0.33$ dB, and a one-time training-free calibration recovers the diagnostic score that zero-shot transfer lowers ($89.62 \to 91.10$).

AI.tldr: SAMR：面向冻结因果视频DiT的无训练KV缓存重建方法，通过部分刷新+无前向重建替代稠密t=0 KV更新，降低长视频生成延迟与FLOPs并提升质量。
AI.motivation: 块因果视频扩散逐块生成长视频并依赖持久KV缓存，每块去噪后需额外t=0前向写入干净KV；当蒸馏与投机早退使去噪变廉价后，该干净KV更新成为运行瓶颈。直接复用陈旧KV虽缩短更新，却污染后续块的条件、抬高其去噪步数，节省的算力在下游重新出现。
AI.method: 提出SAMR（Step-Aware Memory Reconstruction），针对冻结因果视频DiT的无训练方法：仅刷新部分缓存，其余无需DiT前向即重建。核心观察是去除RoPE相位后，运动对齐的历史KV与token在退出步所持的在途KV是其干净KV的互补估计。方法在Pre-RoPE空间用离线校准的逐头仿射映射对在途KV去偏，融合两种估计，并仅对由注意力读出误差代理标记的token保留真实t=0刷新；全部由分块对齐、无同步的Triton核实现。
AI.result: 在48秒LongLive-1.3B视频上，相较稠密KV更新，DiT延迟降低20.9%、主要FLOPs降低30.7%，下游去噪步数下降，末四分之一PSNR较token复用提升1.61 dB（留出集VidProM-16上为1.14 dB）。零样本迁移到冻结Self-Forcing-DMD-1.3B：复用导致的步数膨胀从2.47降至2.30步/token，末期PSNR +0.33 dB；一次性无训练校准使零样本迁移降低的诊断分数从89.62恢复到91.10。
AI.conclusion: 干净KV写入是块因果视频扩散在廉价去噪后的主要开销；SAMR证明可用互补估计（去偏在途KV＋运动对齐历史KV）加误差代理驱动的稀疏真刷新，无训练地重建缓存，兼顾效率与长程条件质量，并可零样本迁移至其他冻结模型。

title: Metric-Dependent Scaling Laws for Sketched Multiclass Softmax Regression
summary: We study scaling laws for full-batch gradient descent with general stable deterministic learning rates in sketched multiclass softmax regression. In a Gaussian teacher student model with power law feature and teacher spectra, the student observes a random feature sketch and reuses a finite labeled sample throughout optimization. Sketching generally makes the student misspecified, so the analysis must jointly account for approximation, nonlinear finite time learning, and the fixed empirical perturbation induced by data reuse. On an exponentially likely sketch event, we show that cross entropy excess and excess zero one risk share a common spectral scale, consisting of a resolution term and an effective learned dimension divided by sample size; teacher student decision disagreement follows the square root of that scale. The resulting balance gives rate optimal sketch and cumulative horizon choices, and synthetic experiments support the predicted regimes and metric dependent exponents.

AI.tldr: 本文研究sketched多类softmax回归中全批量梯度下降（一般稳定确定性学习率）的缩放律，在幂律特征/教师谱的Gaussian教师-学生模型下给出精度标度与最优sketch/horizon选择。
AI.motivation: sketching导致学生模型必然误设定（misspecified），需同时刻画近似误差、非线性有限时间学习动力学与数据复用带来的固定经验扰动，此前缺乏统一的缩放律分析。
AI.method: 采用Gaussian教师-学生模型（特征与教师谱均为幂律），学生仅在随机feature sketch上观测并复用有限标注样本进行全批量梯度下降；在指数高概率的sketch事件上，联合分析近似项、非线性有限时间学习项与数据复用引起的经验扰动，推导交叉熵超额风险、零一超额风险与决策不一致率的谱标度。
AI.result: 交叉熵超额与零一超额风险共享同一谱标度：由resolution项与"有效学习维度/样本量"构成；师生决策不一致概率为该标度的平方根。该平衡给出速率最优的sketch维度与累积horizon选择，合成实验验证了预测的区间与指标相关的指数。
AI.conclusion: sketching引入的误设定可通过谱标度统一刻画不同指标的收敛行为，指标间仅指数不同；sketch维度与训练horizon需按该标度平衡以取得速率最优。

title: CodeWAM: A Code World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving world models anticipate action consequences through representations of how the world evolves. For autonomous driving, these representations must capture both the surrounding scene and the ego vehicle's motion under a candidate plan. We propose CodeWAM, a driving world model that incorporates executable code as part of its world representation. Code represents ego dynamics by expressing how the vehicle state evolves under plan execution, while a learned visual model captures scene-dependent consequences. Executing the code produces a candidate-conditioned motion sequence, which is evaluated relative to the prior plan and recorded motion history. The resulting execution consequences and learned scene outcomes jointly represent the candidate's future, enabling the planner to assess both what a plan may lead to and how the vehicle transitions into that future. The selected plan becomes part of the next decision's execution context, linking successive choices within the model. CodeWAM achieves 93.6 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, 92.1 EPDMS on v2 navtest, and 50.6 EPDMS on NAVHARD. Further experiments demonstrate improved pairwise execution consistency and gains on Hydra-MDP and DrivoR without additional training, supporting executable code as a complementary representation for driving world models.

AI.tldr: CodeWAM 将可执行代码引入驾驶世界模型的世界表征，用代码表达自车状态在候选规划执行下的演化，配合学习式视觉模型刻画场景相关后果，在 NAVSIM v1/v2 与 NAVHARD 上取得 93.6 PDMS、92.1 EPDMS、50.6 EPDMS。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶世界模型需要同时刻画周围场景与候选规划下自车的运动，但纯视觉/隐式表征难以显式描述"规划如何被执行、车辆如何过渡到该未来"，缺少可解释、可计算的自车动力学建模。
AI.method: 提出 CodeWAM：把可执行代码作为世界表征的一部分。代码负责表达自车动力学（在规划执行下车辆状态的演化），学习式视觉模型负责场景相关后果；执行代码得到以候选为条件的运动序列，并与先验规划及历史记录运动进行相对评估；执行后果与学习到的场景结果联合表征候选未来，使规划器既评估"规划通向何处"，也评估"如何过渡到该未来"；被选中的规划作为下一次决策的执行上下文，实现连续决策的链式衔接。
AI.result: NAVSIM v1 navtest 达 93.6 PDMS，v2 navtest 达 92.1 EPDMS，NAVHARD 达 50.6 EPDMS；额外实验显示成对执行一致性提升，并在 Hydra-MDP 与 DrivoR 上无需额外训练即获得增益。
AI.conclusion: 可执行代码可作为驾驶世界模型的有效互补表征，兼顾显式动力学与场景学习，具备跨模型、免训练的迁移收益。

title: RELAY: Learning Compatible Representations One Encoder at a Time
summary: Old and new document embeddings coexist during incremental gallery re-encoding. RELAY trains a new query encoder with a learned projection against the original gallery, then freezes both to train the new document encoder. The same query vector scores both document versions throughout a single re-encoding pass. After backfill, optional query refinement drops the projection and reuses the stored document vectors. Across three text-to-image retrieval upgrades on COCO and Flickr30K, RELAY improves Recall@1 on untouched galleries by 8.66-10.23 percentage points over the original systems. For direct re-encoding, RELAY ranks first in both Qwen-to-Qwen upgrades and second in CLIP-to-Qwen by area under the Recall@1 curve, under both native scoring and matched calibration. With embeddings held fixed, calibrating scores separately for each document version can reduce drops in Recall@1 during backfill and change which method achieves the highest backfill AUC. After query refinement, final Recall@1 is within 0.97 percentage points of conventional joint training in all three upgrades.

AI.tldr: RELAY提出一种用于增量式图库重编码的检索模型升级框架：先冻结原始图库、用学习到的投影训练新查询编码器，再冻结两者训练新文档编码器，使同一次重编码过程中同一查询向量可同时匹配新旧两种文档向量；回填后可选的查询精炼阶段丢弃投影并复用已存文档向量。
AI.motivation: 增量式图库重编码期间，旧文档嵌入与新文档嵌入共存，导致查询编码器与文档编码器难以同时适配新旧向量，直接联合训练代价高且易在回填过程中出现检索性能骤降。
AI.method: 分阶段训练：(1) 以学习到的投影对齐新查询编码器与原始（冻结）图库；(2) 冻结查询编码器与投影，训练新文档编码器；(3) 回填完成后可选查询精炼，去掉投影并直接复用存储的文档向量。同一查询向量在整个重编码过程中同时给两种文档版本打分；另评估按文档版本分别校准分数的策略。
AI.result: 在COCO与Flickr30K上的三次文到图检索升级中，RELAY在未改动图库上将Recall@1提升8.66–10.23个百分点；直接重编码场景下，按Recall@1曲线下面积在Qwen-to-Qwen升级中排名第一、CLIP-to-Qwen中排名第二（原生打分与匹配校准下均成立）；固定嵌入时按版本分别校准可减小回填期Recall@1下降并改变最高回填AUC的方法归属。
AI.conclusion: RELAY通过投影中介与分阶段冻结实现新旧文档嵌入共存下的平滑检索升级；查询精炼后最终Recall@1在三次升级中均与常规联合训练相差不超过0.97个百分点，具备实用性与可迁移性。

title: Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Unlearning
summary: Large language model unlearning aims to remove the influence of designated training data while preserving unrelated model capabilities. Existing likelihood-based methods commonly optimize against fixed forget sequences, providing only negative supervision on what the model should not generate and overlooking the states visited by the evolving unlearned policy. We introduce Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation (CPSD), a new unlearning framework that constructs an explicit knowledge-reduced target distribution and distills it along the model's own trajectories. Given a student rollout, a frozen reference model evaluates each token under a plain context and a privileged context containing the forget information. CPSD treats the resulting distributional shift as a knowledge-associated direction and reverses it to obtain a counterfactual unlearning target. The student is then trained to match this target at every rollout position while retaining its utility on unrelated data. We further introduce a privacy-enhanced variant that combines distributional unlearning with lightweight sequence-level suppression. Experiments under OpenUnlearning show that CPSD improves the forgetting-utility trade-off over NPO across TOFU forget-set sizes and Llama models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters. On MUSE-News, the privacy-enhanced variant improves all reported knowledge, memorization, privacy, and utility metrics over NPO.

AI.tldr: 提出对比式同策略自蒸馏（CPSD）框架，将遗忘建模为沿模型自身轨迹的知识分布反演，显著改善遗忘-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于似然（likelihood-based）的遗忘方法对固定的遗忘序列优化，只提供"不该生成什么"的负向监督，忽略了演化中遗忘策略所访问的状态，缺少显式的目标分布。
AI.method: 构造显式的知识削减目标分布并沿模型自身轨迹进行蒸馏：对学生 rollout 的每个 token，冻结参考模型分别在普通上下文与含遗忘信息的特权上下文下评估；将两分布的偏移视为"知识相关方向"并反向，得到反事实遗忘目标；学生在该轨迹各位置匹配此目标，同时在不相关数据上保持效用。另提出结合序列级轻量抑制的隐私增强变体。
AI.result: 在 OpenUnlearning 基准下，CPSD 在 TOFU 各遗忘集规模及 1B–8B 的 Llama 模型上，遗忘-效用权衡优于 NPO；在 MUSE-News 上，隐私增强变体在知识、记忆、隐私与效用各指标上均优于 NPO。
AI.conclusion: CPSD 通过同策略自蒸馏与反事实目标分布，弥补了固定序列负向监督的不足，提供了可扩展且隐私友好的 LLM 遗忘方案。

title: ADE: A Zero-Training Unlearning Method for Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models learn compact recurrent dynamics from offline trajectories, yet deployed simulators can retain backdoor triggers or stale transitions from outdated physical regimes. Existing unlearning methods fail in autoregressive physics: gradient updates distort latent manifolds and compound rollout drift, naive output zeroing suppresses valid control responses on trigger onset, and single-step deletion leaves corruption inside recurrent hidden states. We propose Analytical Dynamics Excision (ADE), a deterministic, zero-training closed-form unlearning algorithm for latent world models. Using only cached pretraining moments, ADE recovers retain covariances via single-pass matrix downdating without raw retain data and cascades closed-form edits across the input bottleneck, hidden states, and downstream heads. Pairing orthogonal excision with whitened recurrent damping and mean-preserving affine calibration neutralizes out-of-manifold backdoors and realigns in-manifold shifts without variance collapse. Across four regimes on three MuJoCo benchmarks, ADE outperforms seven tuned baselines on DreamerV1, eliminating HalfCheetah and Hopper velocity-flip triggers $4.4\times$ faster than fine-tuning, and transfers zero-shot to DreamerV3.

AI.tldr: 提出ADEx（Analytical Dynamics Excision），一种面向潜世界模型的确定性、零训练的闭式遗忘算法：仅用缓存的预训练矩，通过单遍矩阵降秩更新恢复保留协方差，并在输入瓶颈、隐藏状态与下游头级联闭式编辑，配合正交切除、白化循环阻尼与保均值仿射校准，消除后门触发与陈旧转移。
AI.motivation: 已部署的潜世界模型模拟器可能残留后门触发器或来自过时物理机制的陈旧转移。现有遗忘方法在自回归物理动力学中失效：梯度更新扭曲潜流形并累积推演漂移；朴素输出置零会在触发出现时压制有效控制响应；单步删除无法清除循环隐藏状态内部的污染。
AI.method: ADEx为闭式、确定性、免训练算法。先利用缓存的预训练统计矩，通过单遍矩阵downdating在无原始保留数据条件下恢复保留集协方差；随后将闭式编辑级联至输入瓶颈、隐藏状态与下游输出头三个位置。核心组件包括：正交切除（orthogonal excision）、白化循环阻尼（whitened recurrent damping）以及保均值仿射校准（mean-preserving affine calibration），分别用于中和流形外后门、抑制自回归漂移、对齐流形内漂移且避免方差塌缩。
AI.result: 在三个MuJoCo基准、四个情形下，ADEx在DreamerV1上优于七个调优基线；消除HalfCheetah与Hopper速度翻转触发的速度快于微调4.4倍，并可零样本迁移至DreamerV3。
AI.conclusion: ADEx表明，针对潜世界模型的自回归结构可设计无需梯度训练的闭式遗忘方案，在保持控制响应与潜流形几何的同时高效移除后门与陈旧转移，并具备跨模型版本的迁移能力。

title: CoFiNav: VLM-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Semantic Navigation for Open-Ended Last-Mile UAV Delivery
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) delivery is an important application of the low-altitude economy, enhancing the flexibility and accessibility of last-mile logistics. Existing UAV delivery methods generally rely on precise terminal coordinates, predefined terminal specifications, or task-specific localization procedures, limiting the scope and flexibility of delivery. As UAV logistics becomes more intelligent, open-ended semantic descriptions offer a new paradigm for specifying terminal destinations. However, conventional aerial navigation methods have limited ability to generalize to delivery scenarios that require open-vocabulary terminal navigation. To enable this broader delivery paradigm, we propose CoFiNav, a VLM-guided coarse-to-fine UAV semantic navigation framework that progressively grounds relation-defined terminal destinations through hierarchical semantic search and active 3D observation. Given a task description, a coarse prior map from OpenStreetMap (OSM), and accumulated observations, CoFiNav uses a vision-language model (VLM) to determine which unresolved entity or spatial relation should be verified next. A geometry-aware module converts the semantic observation request into feasible viewpoints using RGB images and LiDAR, while conventional motion planning handles safe execution. Experiments across multiple urban environments show that CoFiNav outperforms representative adapted baselines in success rate while requiring shorter flight paths and fewer observations.

AI.tldr: 提出CoFiNav：一个由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的“由粗到细”无人机语义导航框架，通过分层语义搜索与主动三维观测，逐步定位由关系式语义描述定义的投递目的地，摆脱对精确坐标和预定义终端规格的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机配送依赖精确终端坐标、预定义终端规格或任务专用定位流程，限制了配送范围与灵活性。随着无人机物流智能化，开放式语义描述成为指定目的地的新范式，但传统空中导航方法难以泛化到需要开放词汇终端导航的配送场景。
AI.method: 输入包括任务描述、来自OpenStreetMap（OSM）的粗粒度先验地图与累积观测。VLM负责决策下一步应验证哪个未解析实体或空间关系；几何感知模块将语义观测请求转化为基于RGB图像与LiDAR的可行视点；常规运动规划模块负责安全执行。整体构成分层语义搜索＋主动三维观测的闭环。
AI.result: 在多个城市环境实验中，CoFiNav在成功率上优于代表性的适配基线，同时所需飞行路径更短、观测次数更少。
AI.conclusion: VLM引导的由粗到细语义导航可有效支撑开放词汇的无人机投递终端定位，兼顾成功率与效率，为语义化无人机物流提供可行技术路径。

title: Rethinking Video Agents: When and Why Video Harnesses Work
summary: Video understanding depends not only on how models reason about visual evidence, but also on which evidence they observe. Fixed observation policies determine this evidence in advance; agentic harnesses allow models to seek further observations as their understanding develops. This shift creates an opportunity to realize capabilities that fixed inputs leave untapped, yet the ability to request observations does not ensure their effective use. We investigate when and why video harnesses improve understanding, examining how task demands and models' capacity for interaction jointly shape their benefits. Using Video-Relook as an experimental framework, we let models adapt their temporal and spatial observations from a common default configuration, and analyze performance and interaction trajectories across models and tasks. Adaptive observation yields substantial gains on fine-grained action understanding, with benefits also extending to Video-MME-v2. Even under the same observation interface, gains differ substantially across models; interaction traces reveal corresponding differences in evidence seeking and the reliability of answer revision. The benefits also vary across tasks for the same model, ranging from substantial improvements to limited gains and regressions. Together, these findings support an account in which harness effectiveness depends on the alignment between opportunities for informative observation and the model's ability to turn interaction into reliable revisions. They motivate video harnesses that coordinate perception and reasoning, matching observational autonomy to task demands and model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文研究视频理解中"智能体式观测框架"(video harness)何时以及为何带来收益，提出框架Video-Relook让模型在统一默认配置下自适应调整时间与空间观测，发现收益取决于任务需求（可提供信息性观测的机会）与模型将交互转化为可靠答案修订能力的对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 视频理解不仅依赖模型如何推理视觉证据，还依赖模型观察到哪些证据。固定观测策略预先决定证据，而智能体式框架允许模型随理解深化主动寻求更多观测，这带来了释放固定输入所无法触及能力的机遇；然而"能请求观测"并不等于"能有效利用观测"。因此需要实证研究交互式视频框架的收益条件与机制。
AI.method: 以Video-Relook作为实验框架，让模型从共同的默认配置出发，自适应地调整时间维度与空间维度的观测；跨多个模型与任务分析性能表现与交互轨迹（证据寻求行为、答案修订的可靠性）。
AI.result: 自适应观测在细粒度动作理解上取得显著提升，收益也延伸至Video-MME-v2；即使观测接口相同，不同模型间收益差异明显，交互轨迹显示证据寻求方式与答案修订可靠性的相应差异；同一模型在不同任务上收益亦分化，从显著提升到有限收益甚至性能回退。综合来看，框架有效性取决于"信息性观测机会"与"模型将交互转化为可靠修订能力"之间的对齐。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持一种解释：视频框架的有效性源于观测机会与模型交互能力之间的匹配。据此倡导协调感知与推理的视频框架，将观测自主权与任务需求、模型能力相匹配。

title: CAPE: Coordinating Calibration and Search for Tool-Use Policies
summary: A tool call can fail even when the operation behind it is correct, because the receiving tool parses delimiters, dates or record layouts under a configuration the agent cannot inspect. Compiling a tool-use policy for such a tool requires both calibration, which evaluates candidate calls on candidate configurations, and search over the evaluated calls. The two share one compilation budget: calibrating everything first postpones any improved policy until the end, while re-solving every partially known model delays the next useful query. A call becomes usable as soon as its effects are known on the configurations that reach it. We present CAPE, a training-free compiler built on this observation. It maintains an executable policy at all times, directs calibration to the calls that can improve this policy, and tightens bounds only where doing so ends calibration early. Returned policies preserve every configuration the initial policy completes, and CAPE certifies optimality when its executable and optimistic values meet. On CSV and JSON workflows built from 64 requests, CAPE reaches the independently computed optimum in 502 of 504 compilations while taking 22.0% less compilation time than eager exact search. On larger CSV families it returns policies with higher completion at similar compilation time, and it raises completion by 15.38 to 34.66 percentage points over an LLM that revises its serialization from error feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无训练编译器 CAPE，将"标定"与"搜索"统一在单一编译预算内，始终维持可执行策略，并把标定引导到能改进策略、或能提前终止标定的调用上；在 504 次 CSV/JSON 编译中 502 次达到最优，编译时间比朴素精确搜索少 22.0%。
AI.motivation: 工具调用即使操作本身正确也可能失败，因为接收端按 agent 无法观测的配置解析分隔符、日期或记录布局。为这类工具编译 tool-use 策略需要标定（在候选配置上评估候选调用）与搜索（在已评估调用上寻优），而二者共享同一编译预算：先全部标定会把策略改进推迟到最后，反复重解部分已知模型又会拖延下一次有用查询。核心动机是让"调用一旦在可达配置上效果已知即可用"这一观察转化为编译效率。
AI.method: CAPE 是一个 training-free 的策略编译器：全程维护一个可执行策略；将标定预算定向分配给最有可能改进当前可执行策略的调用；仅在能提前结束标定时才收紧界（bounds）；通过可执行值与乐观值的对比来认证最优性。
AI.result: 在基于 64 个请求构建的 CSV 与 JSON 工作流上，CAPE 在 504 次编译中的 502 次达到独立计算的最优解，同时比 eager exact search 少用 22.0% 的编译时间；在更大的 CSV 族上，在相近编译时间下返回完成率更高的策略；相较依据错误反馈修改序列化的 LLM 方法，完成率提升 15.38 至 34.66 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将标定与搜索交织、并以"可执行策略始终可用"和"界仅在有助提前终止时收紧"为原则，可在不训练的前提下显著提升工具使用策略编译的效率与质量；返回的策略保守地保留初始策略所能完成的全部配置，并具备可认证的最优性条件。

title: To Critic Or Not To Critic
summary: As large language models tackle longer and more complex tasks, understanding when a critic improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning (RL) becomes increasingly important. Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) trains a critic to reduce variance and provide fine-grained credit assignment, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) drops the critic and avoids the bias of bootstrapping from the critic's value estimates. Although recent critic-based methods have reported strong performance relative to GRPO, it remains unclear when each approach is preferable. We argue that there is no universal answer; instead, the choice depends on several interacting factors, including batch size, critic reliance, and task complexity. We study the bias-variance tradeoff in terms of gradient direction, measuring how closely each method's gradient estimates align with the true policy gradient as batch size grows. Under a shared actor objective, we compare GRPO with PPO in control tasks, short-horizon math, and long-horizon terminal agents. Across more than 1,200 training runs, including 96 with LLMs, we find that PPO generally leads at small batch sizes, while GRPO often overtakes heavily bootstrapped PPO and reaches parity with lightly bootstrapped PPO at larger batches. At longer horizons and in more complex domains, GRPO needs larger batches to catch up to PPO's performance. Accounting for training compute, critics pay off at small budgets, but their returns diminish at larger budgets.

AI.tldr: 该文系统研究PPO（带critic）与GRPO（无critic）的优劣条件，从梯度方向的偏差-方差权衡角度出发，在控制任务、短horizon数学任务和长horizon终端智能体任务上进行超1200次训练实验（含96次LLM实验），发现不存在普遍最优方法，选择取决于batch size、critic依赖程度与任务复杂度。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型处理更长更复杂的任务，需要明确critic何时能提升强化学习效率。PPO用critic降低方差并提供细粒度信用分配，GRPO去掉critic以避免bootstrap偏差，近期基于critic的方法报告了相对GRPO的强劲表现，但两者各自的适用条件尚不清晰。作者认为不存在通用答案。
AI.method: 以梯度方向刻画偏差-方差权衡，衡量各方法梯度估计随batch size增大时与真实策略梯度的对齐程度；在共享actor目标下，将GRPO与PPO在控制任务、短horizon数学任务和长horizon终端智能体任务上对比，共进行超1200次训练运行，其中96次使用LLM。
AI.result: PPO通常在小batch size下领先；GRPO常能超越重度bootstrap的PPO，并在较大batch下与轻度bootstrap的PPO持平。在更长horizon和更复杂领域中，GRPO需要更大batch才能追上PPO。考虑训练计算量时，critic在小预算下收益明显，但在较大预算下回报递减。
AI.conclusion: PPO与GRPO之间不存在普遍最优选择，应依据batch size、critic依赖程度和任务复杂度共同决定；critic在小计算预算下更有价值，预算增大后其收益递减。

title: MRCT: An Object-Centric Two-Layer Control Architecture for Heavy-Payload Multi-Robot Transportation
summary: Cooperative transportation of heavy payloads by heterogeneous mobile manipulators requires coordinated payload motion, force distribution, and compliant physical interaction. This paper presents MRCT, an object-centric two-layer control architecture for multi-robot transportation. At the object level, a model predictive controller (MPC) generates a coordinated contact-force reference for the payload. At the robot level, whole- body impedance control (WBIC) modules on individual robots realise the reference through a confidence-based blending of velocity-tracking and impedance torques. The blending mechanism emphasises tracking when the joint-velocity error is small and increases compliance when tracking degrades because of abrupt reference changes or physical disturbances.
