Simulation and hardware experiments with a heterogeneous team comprising a single-arm and a dual-arm mobile manipulator transporting a near-rated table payload demonstrate accurate object tracking, regulated contact forces, and stable payload orientation. Parameter sensitivity studies, obstacle-avoidance transportation, and step-load disturbance experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of MRCT for reliable cooperative transportation under the evaluated conditions

AI.tldr: 提出MRCT——面向异构移动机械臂协同搬运重载的“目标层MPC+机器人层全身阻抗控制”两层架构，通过基于置信度的速度跟踪与阻抗力矩混合实现刚度自适应。
AI.motivation: 重型负载由异构移动机械臂协同搬运时，需同时满足负载协调运动、接触力分配与柔顺物理交互三方面要求；单一控制层难以兼顾跟踪精度与柔顺性。
AI.method: 目标层：以物体为中心的模型预测控制（MPC）生成负载的协调接触力参考。机器人层：各机器人上的全身阻抗控制（WBIC）模块，通过置信度加权混合速度跟踪力矩与阻抗力矩来执行该参考；关节速度误差小时侧重跟踪，参考突变或扰动导致跟踪退化时增大柔顺性。
AI.result: 仿真与硬件实验采用由单臂与双臂移动机械臂构成的异构团队搬运接近额定负载的桌子，实现准确的目标跟踪、受控的接触力与稳定的负载姿态；参数敏感性分析、避障搬运及阶跃负载扰动实验进一步验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: MRCT在所评估条件下可提供可靠、稳定的协同搬运能力，兼顾跟踪精度、力调节与柔顺交互。

title: Open-OmniCoach: Evidence-Enhanced Trajectory Learning for Omni Video Agents
comment: 24 pages. Project Page: https://open-omnicoach.github.io , Code: https://github.com/Open-OmniCoach/omnicoach , Models & Data: https://huggingface.co/Open-OmniCoach
summary: Training capable omni video agents requires more than diverse question-answer pairs: agents must learn to reliably find, connect, and correct task-relevant evidence in omni-setting. However, we argue that existing data pipelines provide limited control over task-relevant evidence and weak supervision for these capabilities. In this work, we present Open OmniCoach, a new framework for evidence-seeking omni video agents. It contains a high-quality dataset, OmniCoach-240K, and a new agentic reinforcement learning (RL) method, Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization (SEPO). For the former, OmniCoach-240K comprises 248.2K interaction trajectories, including 230.7K multi-span trajectories and 17.4K reflection trajectories. We design a three-stage data pipeline by leveraging both fine-grained omni-evidence and the agent's own errors. Meanwhile, compared with other RL baselines, SEPO provides turn-level credit based on improvements in evidence coverage and temporal localization. Applying both trajectory data and the SEPO method, we obtain Open OmniAgent models. The resulting models outperform the baselines across multiple video and audio-visual understanding tasks by significant margins, demonstrating the effectiveness of the Open OmniCoach framework. In particular, Open OmniAgent-30B improves average accuracy over Qwen3-Omni by 6.3 percentage points across nine benchmarks, with gains of 12.2 and 13.3 points on LVOmniBench and LVBench, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出 Open OmniCoach 框架：构建 24.8万条交互轨迹数据集 OmniCoach-240K 与步级证据引导策略优化（SEPO）强化学习方法，训练出 Open OmniAgent 系列全模态视频智能体，在多项音视频理解任务上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 训练能力强的全模态视频智能体不仅需要多样化问答对，更需让智能体学会在全模态设定下可靠地“找到、连接并纠正”与任务相关的证据。现有数据流水线对任务相关证据的控制有限，且对这些能力的监督信号薄弱。
AI.method: 1）数据：OmniCoach-240K 含 248.2K 交互轨迹（230.7K 多片段轨迹 + 17.4K 反思轨迹），通过利用细粒度全模态证据与智能体自身错误构建三阶段数据流水线；2）算法：提出 SEPO（Step-Level Evidence-Guided Policy Optimization），基于证据覆盖率提升与时间定位改进，为每一轮交互提供轮级（turn-level）信用分配，作为新的智能体强化学习方法。
AI.result: 结合轨迹数据与 SEPO 训练得到 Open OmniAgent 模型，在多个视频及音视频理解任务上大幅优于基线。其中 Open OmniAgent-30B 在九个基准上平均准确率较 Qwen3-Omni 提升 6.3 个百分点，在 LVOmniBench 与 LVBench 上分别提升 12.2 和 13.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以“证据寻求”为核心的数据流水线加步级证据引导强化学习，可有效赋予全模态视频智能体证据定位、关联与自我纠错能力，验证了 Open OmniCoach 框架的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Perception Is Enough, at the Right Scale: Scale-Adaptive Token Pruning for Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://lin0e0.github.io/TauPrune-VLA/
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models must process continuous streams of visual observations, and the resulting computational cost limits real-time robotic control. Token pruning reduces this cost, but a fixed semantic scale of perceptual representation can overlook information needed at different stages of manipulation. We show that perceptual semantics can guide effective token selection without relying on internal attention when the selection scale adapts to the scene's evolving semantic structure. Based on this observation, we introduce TauPrune-VLA, a training-free method that controls the scale of the retained perceptual representation through a single perception temperature $τ$. To adapt this scale as manipulation proceeds, TauPrune-VLA updates $τ$ online using trends in perceptual semantics, with robot-state changes and action magnitude regulating the adjustment strength. While these semantics evolve over the course of manipulation, they remain relatively stable between consecutive frames. This continuity allows retention indices computed from the current observation to be applied at the next policy invocation, enabling token selection to run asynchronously with inference and reducing pruning overhead. Evaluated across diverse VLA models and simulation benchmarks, TauPrune-VLA achieves up to a $1.86\times$ inference speedup while maintaining near-baseline task success rates. We further validate its effectiveness on two real-world robotic platforms.

AI.tldr: TauPrune-VLA 是一种免训练的 token 剪枝方法，通过单一“感知温度” τ 自适应控制保留感知表示的语义尺度，并把剪枝与推理异步化，实现最高 1.86× 的推理加速且任务成功率接近基线。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型需处理连续视觉流，计算开销限制实时机器人控制；现有 token 剪枝虽降本，但固定的感知表示语义尺度会忽略操作不同阶段所需信息，且依赖内部注意力带来额外开销。
AI.method: 提出 TauPrune-VLA：1) 以单一感知温度 τ 控制保留感知表示的尺度，无需依赖内部注意力即可完成 token 选择；2) 依据感知语义的演化趋势在线更新 τ，并由机器人状态变化与动作幅度调节调整强度；3) 利用语义在相邻帧间相对稳定的连续性，将当前观测计算出的保留索引用于下一次策略调用，使剪枝与推理异步执行以降低剪枝开销。
AI.result: 在多种 VLA 模型与仿真基准上取得最高 1.86× 推理加速，同时保持接近基线的任务成功率；并在两个真实机器人平台上验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 感知语义可有效指导 token 选择，关键在于选择尺度随场景语义结构自适应；TauPrune-VLA 以免训练、低开销、可异步的方式实现实用加速，具备仿真与真机双重验证。

title: Structure-Aware Transformers for Hierarchical Authorization in Personal AI Agents
summary: Personal AI agents can carry out complex, multi-step tasks on users' behalf, but doing so often involves numerous permission requests. Manually reviewing each request is time-consuming, while indiscriminate approval poses privacy and security risks. Predicting users' authorization preferences offers a way to reduce this burden while preserving user control. However, authorization prediction is challenging because permission requests are often hierarchical and observed user decisions are sparse and potentially correlated. To address these challenges, We propose the Parent-gated Authorization Transformer for Hierarchies (PATH) to predict users' authorization preferences for personal AI agents. PATH is a novel neural network architecture that combines hierarchy-aware attention masks with a parent-gated probability formulation to ensure hierarchy-consistent predictions. Hierarchy-level embeddings further support learning from sparse observations and patterns shared within each authorization level. We establish finite-sample risk bounds and provide sufficient conditions for consistent authorization probability estimation and algorithmic convergence. Experiments on simulated data, AI-generated user profiles, and real user authorization data demonstrate strong predictive performance with zero hierarchy violations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PATH（Parent-gated Authorization Transformer for Hierarchies），一种用于预测个人 AI 代理用户授权偏好的神经网络架构，通过层级感知注意力掩码与父级门控概率建模保证层级一致性预测，并在稀疏观测下实现高性能且零层级违规。
AI.motivation: 个人 AI 代理执行多步任务时会产生大量权限请求：逐一手动审查耗时，而一律批准又带来隐私与安全风险。预测用户授权偏好可在保留用户控制权的同时降低负担。但授权预测存在两大难点：权限请求本身具有层级结构，且用户决策观测稀疏并可能相关。
AI.method: 提出 PATH 架构，核心包括：（1）层级感知注意力掩码（hierarchy-aware attention masks），将权限层级结构编码进注意力机制；（2）父级门控概率公式（parent-gated probability formulation），确保预测结果在层级上自洽；（3）层级级嵌入（hierarchy-level embeddings），用于从稀疏观测及同层级共享模式中学习。理论上建立有限样本风险界，并给出授权概率一致估计与算法收敛的充分条件。
AI.result: 在模拟数据、AI 生成的用户画像以及真实用户授权数据上的实验表明，PATH 具有较强预测性能，且实现零层级违规（zero hierarchy violations）。
AI.conclusion: PATH 通过将层级结构显式融入 Transformer 的注意力与概率建模，有效解决了授权预测中的层级一致性与稀疏观测问题，兼具理论保证与实证效果，为降低 AI 代理权限管理负担提供了可行方案。

title: AirLeg: A Robust and Accurate Self-Supervised Visual-Inertial-Leg SLAM System
summary: Visual-inertial-leg (VIL) state estimation offers cost-effective localization for legged robots, adding only a camera to the onboard IMU and joint encoders. However, learning-based leg odometry is limited by its supervision: networks trained in simulation suffer from the sim-to-real gap, while real-world labels require costly sensors or inherit the errors of visual estimates. To address this, we present AirLeg, a self-supervised VIL SLAM system in which vision and leg proprioception improve each other from training to deployment. We pre-train the leg odometry network in simulation and adapt it to the robot without ground truth through imperative learning, where multi-sensor bundle adjustment uses the leg odometry to refine the visual map, which in turn supervises the network. During deployment, the fused estimates adapt the network online. To improve both localization and this supervision, a dual-window estimator fuses vision, IMU, and leg odometry, relates loaded feet to the visually reconstructed terrain through a deformation-aware constraint, and weights the constraints by variance component estimation. AirLeg completes all 17 GrandTour sequences with the lowest average error (0.19 m) among 19 methods. On a low-cost quadruped, it achieves the lowest drift (0.6%) with only 0.5 h of unlabeled data, in real time on an embedded computer.

AI.tldr: AirLeg 是一个自监督的视觉-惯性-腿式（VIL）SLAM 系统，让视觉与腿部本体感知在训练到部署全过程互相增强，仅用 0.5 小时无标签数据即在低成本四足机器人上实现 0.6% 漂移的实时嵌入式定位。
AI.motivation: 学习式腿式里程计受监督信号制约：仿真训练存在 sim-to-real 差距，真实标签则依赖昂贵传感器或继承视觉估计误差。因此需要一种无需真值、可使视觉与腿式感知互补的系统。
AI.method: 先在仿真中预训练腿式里程计网络，再通过 imperative learning 无真值自适应：多传感器 bundle adjustment 利用腿式里程计精化视觉地图，地图反过来监督网络；部署时融合估计在线更新网络。定位与监督的双重提升由双窗口估计器实现，融合视觉、IMU 与腿式里程计，以形变感知约束关联受力足与视觉重建地形，并用方差分量估计对各约束加权。
AI.result: 在 GrandTour 全部 17 条序列上完成，平均误差 0.19 m，为 19 种方法中最低；在低成本四足机器人上仅用 0.5 小时无标签数据即达到最低漂移 0.6%，并在嵌入式计算机上实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 自监督 VIL SLAM 可摆脱对真值标签与昂贵传感器的依赖，实现视觉与腿式感知的闭环互促，在精度、数据效率与实时性上均具优势。

title: Loupe: Reinforcing Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation Agents
summary: Knowledge-intensive video generation remains challenging because prompts often omit the facts, appearances, and temporal relationships required for accurate generation. While search-based workflows can retrieve missing evidence, manually designed strategies limit adaptive planning, and conventional training suffers from costly video-level feedback and coarse trajectory-level credit assignment. In this paper, we present Loupe, a video generation agent that retrieves and verifies textual and visual evidence to construct evidence-grounded temporal video prompts with reference images. We further introduce Rubric-Based Credit (RBC), which leverages prompt-specific factual, visual, and temporal requirements to evaluate intermediate search and planning decisions before video rendering. Building on RBC, RBC-SFT reweights assistant-token learning by step quality, while RBC-GRPO incorporates step-level credits alongside a final planning reward, without rendering videos during RL. To address the lack of dedicated search-oriented evaluation, we construct Search-VBench, which contains 150 held-out prompts across seven categories. Experiments show that Loupe improves all four evaluation dimensions across three video generators, raising the overall score of MiniMax-H3 from 32.80 to 70.67 and outperforming an untrained search workflow. Ablation experiments show that full RBC training outperforms standard SFT followed by trajectory-level GRPO by 5.27 points. Human evaluations and results on Sci-VBench and KIVI-Bench further demonstrate improved generation quality, scientific grounding, factual precision, and helpfulness. Our project page is available at https://zengkaiya.github.io/Loupe/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视频生成智能体 Loupe，通过检索并核验文本与视觉证据来构建有依据的时序视频提示词；并提出基于量规的信用分配方法 RBC 及其训练变体 RBC-SFT / RBC-GRPO，在无需渲染视频的情况下实现对中间检索与规划步骤的细粒度评估，同时构建 Search-VBench 评测基准。
AI.motivation: 知识密集型视频生成中，提示词常缺失事实、外观与时序关系等必要信息；基于搜索的工作流虽可补齐证据，但人工设计的检索策略缺乏自适应规划能力，且常规训练受制于昂贵的视频级反馈与粗粒度的轨迹级信用分配。
AI.method: 1) Loupe：检索并验证文本与视觉证据，生成带参考图的、有证据支撑的时序视频提示词；2) Rubric-Based Credit (RBC)：利用提示词专属的事实性、视觉、时序要求，在视频渲染前评估中间搜索与规划决策质量；3) RBC-SFT 按步骤质量对 assistant token 的学习加权；4) RBC-GRPO 将步骤级信用与最终规划奖励结合，RL 阶段不渲染视频；5) 构建 Search-VBench（150 条留出提示，7 类）。
AI.result: 在三个视频生成器上，Loupe 在四个评测维度上均提升；MiniMax-H3 总体得分从 32.80 提升至 70.67，优于未经训练的搜索工作流。消融显示完整 RBC 训练比标准 SFT + 轨迹级 GRPO 高 5.27 分。人工评测及 Sci-VBench、KIVI-Bench 结果进一步表明生成质量、科学依据性、事实准确性与有用性均有改善。
AI.conclusion: 以量规驱动的步骤级信用分配可在不渲染视频的前提下有效训练检索增强的视频生成智能体，显著优于轨迹级 RL 与传统 SFT 流程，并具备跨生成器与跨基准的泛化性。

title: DexOPD: Dual-Extrapolation On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Models
summary: Flow-based diffusion models have become a mainstream paradigm for text-to-image generation, where task-specific post-training produces specialist models with complementary strengths. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) offers an efficient way to consolidate these specialists into a single unified student. Recent methods strengthen supervision through teacher extrapolation, constructing stronger proxy teachers that allow distilled students to surpass the original specialists. However, their extrapolation directions remain defined solely by frozen teacher and reference models, leaving the student's own training progress unexploited. To address this limitation, we introduce DexOPD, a dual-extrapolation on-policy distillation method for diffusion models. DexOPD retains extrapolated teacher supervision while leveraging a lagging historical student as the reference for student self-extrapolation. Sampling across multiple self-extrapolation gains from shared initial noise broadens exploration along the student's evolving trajectory, and task rewards convert pairwise differences in candidate quality into a normalized auxiliary regression direction. Empirically, we evaluate DexOPD on GenEval, OCR, and DrawBench. The resulting unified SD3.5-Medium student achieves a GenEval reward of 0.9736, an OCR score of 0.9515, and a DrawBench Aesthetic score of 6.4875, surpassing the corresponding specialist teachers as well as all evaluated OPD and multi-task reinforcement learning baselines across these three benchmarks while preserving standard single-model inference.

AI.tldr: 提出DexOPD双外推在线策略蒸馏方法，用滞后历史学生作参考进行学生自外推，将多专家教师统一为单一扩散学生模型
AI.motivation: 现有基于外推的多教师在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中，外推方向仅由冻结的教师模型与参考模型确定，学生自身训练进展未被利用，监督信号受限。
AI.method: 保留教师外推监督，同时引入滞后历史学生作为参考实现学生自外推；在共享初始噪声下采样多个自外推增益，沿学生演化轨迹扩大探索；利用任务奖励将候选样本质量的两两差异转化为归一化的辅助回归方向。
AI.result: 在GenEval、OCR、DrawBench上评测：统一学生模型SD3.5-Medium取得GenEval 0.9736、OCR 0.9515、DrawBench美学分6.4875，三项均超过对应专家教师及全部对比的OPD与多任务强化学习基线，且保持标准单模型推理。
AI.conclusion: 将学生自身演化轨迹纳入外推参考可有效突破纯教师外推的监督上限，在保持单模型推理的前提下实现多专长统一并超越专家。

title: PFedHASNet: A Personalized Federated Hybrid Analog-Spike Network for Multi-Subject Motor Imagery EEG Decoding
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
summary: Motor imagery electroencephalography (MI-EEG) data are often collected and stored separately across subjects or institutions, and EEG acquisition and annotation remain costly. Training models solely on individual subject data limits the use of information from other subjects, whereas centralizing raw EEG recordings raises privacy and data governance concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw EEG data, providing a practical approach to leveraging information from multiple subjects. Accordingly, we propose PFedHASNet, a personalized federated hybrid analog-spike network for MI-EEG decoding. The shared encoder integrates continuous-valued temporal features, leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) spike responses, and channel-wise log-variance statistics through learnable fusion weights. Client-private residual adapters and classifiers perform subject-specific feature refinement and personalized prediction, respectively. Experiments on held-out trials from participating subjects across four public MI-EEG datasets show that PFedHASNet achieves the highest mean client macro-F1 among 18 model configurations in cross-model comparisons, while maintaining competitive decoding performance with a compact client-side model in comparisons using the same backbone. Ablation studies further examine the contributions of hybrid representations and personalization components to decoding performance.

AI.tldr: 提出PFedHASNet——一种面向运动想象脑电(MI-EEG)解码的个性化联邦混合模拟-脉冲网络，在不共享原始脑电数据的前提下跨被试协同训练，并在四个公开数据集上取得最优的平均客户端macro-F1。
AI.motivation: MI-EEG数据常按被试或机构分散存储，采集与标注成本高。仅用单被试数据训练会浪费其他被试信息，而集中式收集原始脑电又带来隐私与数据治理风险。联邦学习虽可协同训练，但被试间分布差异显著，需要兼顾共享知识与个体适配。
AI.method: 提出PFedHASNet个性化联邦学习框架。共享编码器通过可学习融合权重整合三类混合表征：连续值时序特征、LIF脉冲响应、逐通道对数方差统计量；客户端侧引入私有残差适配器做被试特异特征精炼，并配置客户端私有分类器实现个性化预测。
AI.result: 在四个公开MI-EEG数据集的参与被试留出试次上，跨模型对比的18种模型配置中PFedHASNet的平均客户端macro-F1最高；在同骨干网络对比中，以紧凑的客户端模型保持有竞争力的解码性能。消融实验进一步验证了混合表征与个性化模块对解码性能的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习结合混合模拟-脉冲表征与客户端个性化适配，可在保护原始数据隐私的同时有效利用多被试信息，是MI-EEG解码的可行方案；混合表征与残差适配器、私有分类器均对性能有实质贡献。

title: ContinualDrive: A Deployment-Anchored, Multi-Axis Benchmark for Continual Updates of Learned Driving Planners
comment: 34 pages (8 main pages + references + 22-page supplement), 4 figures in the main text. Code: https://github.com/continualdrive/benchmark . Project page: https://lzrbit.github.io/continualdrive/
summary: Learned driving planners keep being updated after deployment as new logs arrive, yet continual learning evaluations rarely ask whether an update improves on the deployed model, and their verdicts rest on unstated evaluation choices. We present ContinualDrive, a deployment-anchored benchmark for post-deployment continual learning of driving planners. It updates a deployed planner on real-world nuPlan logs one scenario-type group at a time, evaluates the same checkpoints in open and closed loop, makes four measurement axes explicit (evaluation loop, reference checkpoint, temporal aggregation and stream protocol), and anchors a three-valued release verdict to the deployed checkpoint. We study two planners (PlanTF and Diffusion Planner) under full fine-tuning and adapter or LoRA updates, with and without replay or gradient projection, in three task orders. Verdicts can reverse or vanish when one axis changes: open-loop ADE ranks the final PlanTF model above the deployed one in half of its core-suite runs, whereas every closed-loop score ranks it below; backward transfer misses this loss, which on average is already present when each group has just been learned; and regime rankings vary far less across training seeds than across task orders. In the core suite of full and adapter updates, no regime measurably improved on the deployed planner in closed loop; on a panel more than ten times larger every evaluated final checkpoint trails it, and joint training on all groups recovers much of the loss without exceeding its nuPlan closed-loop score. We distill these findings into a reporting contract and will release the code and all checkpoints.

AI.tldr: 提出 ContinualDrive——部署锚定的驾驶规划器持续学习基准，在 nuPlan 真实日志上逐场景组更新已部署模型，显式化四个测量轴并以三值发布判决对照部署检查点；结果显示判决会随单一测量轴改变而反转或消失，闭环下无任何更新范式可测地优于部署模型。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习评测很少追问"更新是否真比已部署模型更好"，且结论依赖未言明的评测选择（开环/闭环、参照检查点、时间聚合、数据流协议），导致结论不可比、易误导发布决策。
AI.method: 构建部署锚定的基准：以 nuPlan 真实日志按场景类型分组顺序更新已部署规划器；同一检查点同时做开环与闭环评测；显式化四个测量轴（评测环路、参照检查点、时间聚合、流协议）；将三值发布判决锚定于部署检查点（改进/无差异/退化）。实验覆盖两个规划器（PlanTF、Diffusion Planner）、全微调与 adapter/LoRA、有无回放或梯度投影、三种任务顺序，并另设十倍规模的面板与全组联合训练对照。
AI.result: 单一测量轴变化即可使判决反转或消失：开环 ADE 在核心套件约一半运行中把 PlanTF 最终模型排于部署模型之上，而所有闭环指标均排在其下；反向迁移（BWT）未能捕捉该损失，而该损失在各组刚学完时平均已存在；范式排序对训练种子的敏感性远低于对任务顺序的敏感性。全微调与 adapter 更新中，闭环下无可测改进；十倍规模面板上所有最终检查点均落后于部署模型；全组联合训练可挽回大部分损失，但未超过其 nuPlan 闭环分数。
AI.conclusion: "是否优于部署模型"高度依赖评测协议，开环代理指标与 BWT 会掩盖部署后的闭环退化；应以闭环、部署锚定、三值判决来评估，并遵循所提出的报告契约。作者将发布代码与全部检查点。

title: Beyond Expert Replay: Cross-Instruction Anchoring for Continual Vision-Language-Action Learning
comment: 19 pages, 12 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models need to continually acquire new manipulation skills while retaining the ability to follow previously learned instructions. Experience replay (ER) can mitigate catastrophic forgetting, but retaining only a small number of historical expert frames per task leaves many old-instruction responses without direct supervision. Under limited replay, we observe a structured failure mode in which an earlier instruction can trigger a subsequently learned, competing goal. To address this gap, we propose Cross-Instruction Anchoring (XIA), which supplements expert replay with instruction-conditioned response preservation. At each task boundary, XIA freezes the previous policy as a teacher and matches its responses to old instructions paired with current observations. This extends supervision beyond stored historical examples without requiring additional expert replay data. Experiments across multiple VLA architectures and three LIBERO suites demonstrate improved success rates and reduced forgetting compared with ER under identical historical expert-data budgets. Additional RoboCasa and real-world experiments further support the effectiveness of XIA.

AI.tldr: 提出跨指令锚定（XIA），在有限经验回放的VLA持续学习中用冻结旧策略作教师、对"旧指令+当前观测"匹配响应，扩展监督信号，缓解旧指令被新目标劫持的遗忘模式。
AI.motivation: VLA模型需持续学习新操作技能且不忘旧指令，但经验回放仅保留少量历史专家帧，导致大量旧指令响应缺乏直接监督；作者观察到一种结构化失效模式：早期指令会触发后来学到的竞争性目标。
AI.method: 在每个任务边界将上一策略冻结为教师，对"旧指令+当前观测"组合匹配教师的响应输出，与专家回放联合训练，从而在不增加历史专家回放数据的前提下把监督扩展到存储样本之外。
AI.result: 在多种VLA架构与三个LIBERO套件上，在相同历史专家数据预算下，成功率提升、遗忘减少，优于纯经验回放；RoboCasa与真实世界实验进一步验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 指令条件化的响应保持是有限回放下缓解VLA灾难性遗忘的有效补充手段，可与经验回放互补且不增加回放数据成本。

title: Coding4Games: Can Modern Coding Agents Play Modern Video Games?
summary: Games, especially modern AAA games, challenge language models to perceive complex scenes, control actions, and make decisions over long horizons. Existing game benchmarks primarily test language models as computer-use agents that query a language model throughout play, incurring repeated inference cost and, in real-time games, acting while the environment continues to evolve. We ask whether coding agents can learn from game interaction to develop standalone game-playing programs that run without language model inference. We thus introduce Coding4Games, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can develop standalone programs that play modern games through visual observations and standard game inputs. Coding4Games has three defining features: 1) Diverse Modern Games, covering 15 games with diverse visual, strategic, and control demands; 2) Development-Test Separation, in which a coding agent uses a sandbox and the standard player interface to iteratively develop a program, after which the selected program is frozen and independently tested without language-model inference; and 3) Outcome and Process Evaluation, which measures not only game performance and reliability but also how agents use feedback, revise programs, and resolve problems during development. Across 15 games, the best program per game outscores the strongest GUI baseline on 13 and ties it on one. The human player outscores all agents on 10 games. We additionally examine the effects of development budgets. Coding4Games evaluates whether coding agents can turn their understanding of complex interactive environments into programs that work reliably on their own.

AI.tldr: 提出 Coding4Games 基准，评估编码智能体能否通过与游戏的交互，开发出不依赖语言模型推理的独立游戏程序。该基准覆盖 15 款游戏，采用开发/测试分离与结果+过程双重评价。最佳程序在 13 款游戏中超过最强 GUI 基线、1 款持平；人类玩家在 10 款游戏中仍优于所有智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏基准多把语言模型当作计算机使用智能体（computer-use agent），需在整个游玩过程中反复查询模型，带来重复推理开销；在实时游戏中还会导致环境持续演化时行动滞后。论文由此提出关键问题：编码智能体能否从游戏交互中学习，生成可独立运行、无需语言模型推理的游戏程序。
AI.method: 构建 Coding4Games 基准，具备三项核心特征：(1) 多样化现代游戏，涵盖 15 款在视觉、策略与控制需求上差异明显的游戏；(2) 开发—测试分离，编码智能体在沙箱中借助标准玩家接口迭代开发程序，随后冻结所选程序并独立测试，测试阶段不含语言模型推理；(3) 结果与过程双重评估，既测游戏表现与可靠性，也考察智能体如何利用反馈、修订程序并解决问题。
AI.result: 在 15 款游戏中，每款游戏的最佳程序在 13 款上超过最强 GUI 基线，在 1 款上持平；人类玩家在 10 款游戏中优于所有智能体。论文还进一步分析了开发预算（development budget）对结果的影响。
AI.conclusion: Coding4Games 用于检验编码智能体能否将对复杂交互环境的理解转化为可独立、可靠运行的程序；结果表明编码智能体已能在此范式下超越反复推理的 GUI 基线，但与人类水平仍有差距，且性能受开发预算影响。

title: Scale-Robust and Global-Aware Representation Learning for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD) is an essential task for identifying abnormal system behaviors and supporting reliable operations across diverse real-world applications. Despite substantial advances in MTSAD, two key challenges in representation learning remain underexplored: (C1) how to learn scale-robust temporal representations that capture anomalies across different temporal scales and (C2) how to learn global-aware relational representations that capture inter-series dependencies by incorporating series-level global characteristics beyond local windows. To address these challenges, we propose STAGER, a novel method that jointly learns two complementary representations: scale-robust temporal and global-aware relational representations. Specifically, STAGER employs (1) a scale-robust temporal encoder that constructs a multi-scale temporal directed acyclic graph (DAG) to learn scale-robust temporal representations and (2) a global-aware relational encoder that incorporates learnable series-level global embeddings into the temporal representations and models inter-series relationships through graph neural networks. Two complementary auxiliary objectives further enhance the distinctiveness of the global embeddings. Extensive experiments on three real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that STAGER achieves the best average rank among ten evaluated MTSAD methods across three evaluation metrics. Ablation and sensitivity analyses validate the effectiveness of the proposed components and auxiliary objectives, while efficiency evaluations demonstrate that STAGER achieves a favorable trade-off between detection performance and inference time compared with existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出STAGER方法，联合学习尺度鲁棒的时序表示与全局感知的关系表示，用于多变量时间序列异常检测（MTSAD），在三个真实基准上取得十种方法中的最佳平均排名。
AI.motivation: MTSAD的表示学习仍有两个未充分探索的关键挑战：(C1) 如何学习跨不同时间尺度捕捉异常的尺度鲁棒时序表示；(C2) 如何超越局部窗口、引入序列级全局特征来建模序列间依赖，从而获得全局感知的关系表示。
AI.method: STAGER包含两个互补编码器：(1) 尺度鲁棒时序编码器，构建多尺度时序有向无环图（DAG）以学习尺度鲁棒时序表示；(2) 全局感知关系编码器，将可学习的序列级全局嵌入融入时序表示，并通过图神经网络建模序列间关系；另设两个互补的辅助目标以增强全局嵌入的区分性。
AI.result: 在三个真实基准数据集上，STAGER在十种MTSAD方法与三项评价指标下取得最佳平均排名；消融与敏感性分析验证了各组件及辅助目标的有效性；效率评估显示其在检测性能与推理时间之间取得良好权衡。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习尺度鲁棒时序表示与全局感知关系表示是提升MTSAD性能的有效途径，STAGER在效果与效率上均具竞争力。

title: Next-Manip: On-Demand Agent-Policy Collaboration for Robotic Manipulation
summary: General-purpose robotic manipulation requires task reasoning, failure recovery, and precise control, yet limited manipulation data make these abilities difficult to obtain from a single policy. Recent multimodal agents show promise in task reasoning and recovery but lack reliable fine-grained control and incur high inference cost, whereas learned policies provide efficient fine-grained execution but struggle beyond their learned skills. Although their complementary strengths suggest combining the two, doing so requires repeatedly deciding which executor should act as task demands change. Instead of relying on the agent for each decision, we present Next-Manip, an on-demand agent--policy collaboration framework that decouples executor allocation from costly agent inference. We propose an Agent Invocation Controller (AIC) that allocates control between the policy and the agent through a lightweight classifier of current execution demands. We further introduce Task Dynamics Context (TDC), which packages informative manipulation changes from in-context examples into compact task references to support both agent reasoning and executor allocation. Across two simulation benchmarks and real-world experiments, Next-Manip achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing agent inference costs.

AI.tldr: Next-Manip：一种按需的“智能体—策略”协作框架，用轻量分类器 AIC 解耦执行器分配与昂贵的智能体推理，并用任务动力学上下文 TDC 同时支撑推理与分配，在仿真与真机上取得 SOTA 且降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人操作需要任务推理、失败恢复与精细控制，但操作数据有限，单一策略难以同时具备这些能力。多模态智能体擅长推理与恢复，却缺乏可靠精细控制且推理开销高；学习型策略执行高效但泛化到学习技能之外时表现差。二者能力互补，但融合时需反复判断当前应由哪个执行器接管，若每次都依赖智能体决策，代价过高。
AI.method: 提出 Agent Invocation Controller（AIC），以轻量分类器基于当前执行需求在策略与智能体之间分配控制权，将执行器分配从智能体推理中解耦；并提出 Task Dynamics Context（TDC），把上下文示例中有信息量的操作变化打包为紧凑任务参考，同时服务于智能体推理与执行器分配。
AI.result: 在两个仿真基准和真实世界实验中，Next-Manip 达到 SOTA 性能，同时降低了智能体推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过按需调用智能体、将执行器分配交给轻量控制器，可在保持推理与恢复能力的同时获得策略的高效精细执行，实现性能与推理开销的更优折中。

title: Your VLM Knows What to Inspect: Semantic Probe-Guided Adaptive Focusing for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding requires resolving fine visual details within the context that gives them meaning. Additional views can improve localization, but their value depends on what evidence they expose and how much context they preserve. We explore a capability of vision-language models (VLMs): even when their coordinate predictions are incorrect, they can describe visual evidence worth inspecting. We introduce \textbf{SPARK}, \textit{\textbf{S}emantic \textbf{P}robe-guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}egion see\textbf{K}ing}, a training-free framework that turns this semantic guidance into targeted visual observations. Exploration probes describe relevant context and distinguishing target details, while verification probes identify evidence needed to assess emerging hypotheses. Their spatial attention guides view placement, contextual responses determine crop extent, and observation history encourages complementary inspection. The resulting predictions are combined through uncertainty-weighted voting. On ScreenSpot-Pro, SPARK improves grounding accuracy over single-view inference by 13.9, 25.2, and 16.1 percentage points with Qwen3-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, and UI-TARS, outperforming all compared test-time methods for each backbone. Consistent gains across four additional benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness across diverse interfaces and grounding tasks. These results establish semantic probing as an effective mechanism for turning a frozen VLM's understanding of what to inspect into more accurate GUI grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练框架 SPARK，利用 VLM 在坐标预测失败时仍能描述有效视觉证据的能力，将语义探针转化为定向视觉观测，并通过不确定性加权投票融合多视图预测，显著提升 GUI grounding 精度。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding 需要在赋予细节意义的上下文中解析细粒度视觉信息。额外视图可改善定位，但其价值取决于视图所暴露的证据类型与保留的上下文量；现有测试时方法未充分利用模型对"该看什么"的语义理解。
AI.method: SPARK（Semantic Probe-guided Adaptive Region seeing）为免训练框架：探索探针（exploration probes）描述相关上下文与区分性目标细节，验证探针（verification probes）识别评估新假设所需证据；利用探针的空间注意力引导视图放置，依据上下文响应确定裁剪范围，并用观测历史促进互补性检查；最终以不确定性加权投票融合各视图预测。
AI.result: 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上，SPARK 相比单视图推理分别提升 13.9（Qwen3-VL）、25.2（Qwen2.5-VL）、16.1（UI-TARS）个百分点，在各骨干上均优于所有对比的测试时方法；在另外四个基准上也取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 语义探针是一种有效机制，可将冻结 VLM 对"何处需检查"的理解转化为更准确的 GUI grounding，且跨多种界面与 grounding 任务具备泛化性。

title: Discovering Bandwidth-Efficient Prefetchers to Shrink the Cache Hierarchy
summary: Shared last-level caches (LLCs) increasingly dominate server processor die area, forcing architects to trade core counts for cache capacity. While intelligent data prefetching offers a pathway to reclaim this silicon, designing coordinated, multi-level prefetching policies for multi-core systems is bottlenecked by day-long, cycle-level simulations. This simulation wall limits even LLM-based microarchitecture discovery; the state-of-the-art ArchAgent system evolves one cache level at a time on single-core benchmarks, adds multi-core configurations only at the end, and trails the human champion under multi-core shared cache contention. We introduce DuoArchitect, an autonomous agentic framework for multi-fidelity, multi-core co-discovery of prefetchers. Agents jointly evolve evaluation proxies and coordinated prefetching policies across the L1D, L2, and LLC hierarchies, constructing simulation proxies 3-26x faster than cluster evaluation and hardware diagnostic oracles to guide the search. To study how much cache silicon a smarter prefetcher can replace, we evaluate and evolve prefetchers under reduced cache budgets, and find that evolving under our tightest cache constraint (with both the L2 and LLC halved) produced our strongest prefetcher overall at every cache size we tested: DuoArch-Nano. On the Fourth Data Prefetching Championship (DPC4) benchmarks with full-size caches, DuoArch-Nano delivers a 9.2% geomean IPC speedup (+10.5% on four-core mixes) while reducing four-core DRAM traffic by 11.4%, more than doubling the gains of the human champion BertiGO and the agentic ArchAgent v2. When the LLC is halved, DuoArch-Nano erases the baseline's 8.6% overall slowdown and edges out the full-LLC baseline overall (+0.88%), showing that agentic frameworks can generate prefetchers that reclaim megabytes of LLC SRAM per core with zero overall IPC penalty.

AI.tldr: 提出自主智能体框架 DuoArchitect，通过多保真、多核的协同发现流程联合演化评估代理与 L1D/L2/LLC 三级协调预取策略，得到在紧缩缓存预算下演化的 DuoArch-Nano，在 DPC4 上实现 9.2% 几何平均 IPC 提升，并在 LLC 减半时基本消除基线性能损失。
AI.motivation: 共享 LLC 占据服务器芯片面积主体，迫使架构师以核数换取缓存容量；智能预取有望弥补容量损失，但协调的多级多核预取策略设计受限于长达一天的周期级仿真壁垒。现有 LLM 驱动的微架构发现方法（如 ArchAgent）逐级、单核演化，仅在最后引入多核配置，且在多核共享缓存争用下不及人类冠军方案。
AI.method: DuoArchitect：多保真、多核协同发现的自主智能体框架。智能体跨越 L1D、L2、LLC 层级联合演化评估代理（比集群评测快 3–26× 的仿真代理）与协调预取策略，并借助硬件诊断 oracle 引导搜索；同时在缩减缓存预算（L2 与 LLC 均减半）下评测与演化预取器，考察智能预取可替代多少缓存 SRAM。
AI.result: 在最紧缓存约束（L2 与 LLC 均减半）下演化得到的最强预取器 DuoArch-Nano，在测试的所有缓存尺寸上均表现最佳。DPC4 全尺寸缓存下：几何平均 IPC 加速 9.2%（四核混合负载 +10.5%），四核 DRAM 流量下降 11.4%，增益超过人类冠军 BertiGO 与 ArchAgent v2 的两倍。LLC 减半时，DuoArch-Nano 消除基线 8.6% 的整体减速并略优于全 LLC 基线（+0.88%）。
AI.conclusion: 智能体框架可生成在零整体 IPC 损失前提下为每核回收数 MB LLC SRAM 的预取器；同时表明在紧缩缓存约束下演化反而能产出更具鲁棒性与泛化性的预取策略。

title: Online Environment Repair for Coding Agents
summary: Programmatic verifiers provide scalable reward signals for training coding agents with reinforcement learning, yet subtle harness defects and incomplete unit tests allow policies to earn full credit without solving the intended task. Existing training-time defenses intervene either by penalizing suspicious outputs or by filtering flagged tasks and rollouts. However, output penalties leave the underlying verifier exploitable, driving policies to disguise shortcuts under reasoning monitors or zeroing out valid solutions under detector false positives, whereas task and rollout filtering discards or mutes the hardest problems where shortcuts emerge earliest. Pre-training verifier hardening repairs the environment directly, but misses vulnerability classes that surface only as the policy improves during reinforcement learning. In this paper, we propose online environment repair, which leaves triggering rollout rewards unchanged to remove hiding incentives and asynchronously patches exploited environments during training. Candidate repairs triggered by execution invariants or differential fuzzing are deployed only after passing three automated validation gates that block the exploit while preserving valid solutions, canceling detector false positives and enabling structural propagation across repositories without scaffold labels or reference solutions. Across 20 controlled GRPO experiments on heterogeneous software-engineering repositories, online environment repair reduces cumulative reward hacking from 36.9% to 0.06% and improves held-out Pass@8 from 21.7% to 46.7%, consistently outperforming reward-penalty, rollout-filtering, and static-hardening baselines while eliminating zero-shot exploitation on unseen loophole classes.

AI.tldr: 提出"在线环境修复"方法：在强化学习训练过程中异步修补被利用的验证环境，在不惩罚可疑输出、不丢弃困难任务的前提下，将累计奖励黑客从36.9%降至0.06%，并将留出集Pass@8从21.7%提升到46.7%。
AI.motivation: 程序化验证器为编码智能体的强化学习提供可扩展奖励信号，但测试脚手架缺陷与不完整的单元测试使策略能够"骗过"验证器拿到满分奖励（奖励黑客）。现有训练时防御手段各有缺陷：输出惩罚无法消除验证器漏洞本身，还会诱导策略在推理监视器下伪装捷径，或由于检测器误报而把有效解判为零；任务/回放过滤会丢弃或削弱最难的问题，而这些问题恰恰最早暴露捷径；预训练阶段的验证器加固无法覆盖随策略能力提升才显现的漏洞类别。
AI.method: 在线环境修复：对触发漏洞的回放保持奖励不变（消除隐藏动机），并在训练中异步修补被利用的环境。修复候选由执行不变量或差分模糊测试触发，且必须通过三道自动化验证门（阻断漏洞、保留有效解、抑制检测器误报）才能部署，并可在仓库间结构传播，无需脚手架标签或参考解。
AI.result: 在异构软件工程仓库上的20组受控GRPO实验中，累计奖励黑客率由36.9%降至0.06%，留出集Pass@8由21.7%提升至46.7%，持续优于奖励惩罚、回放过滤与静态加固基线，并消除了对未知漏洞类别的零样本利用。
AI.conclusion: 与其惩罚策略或丢弃数据，不如在训练过程中直接、可验证地修复被利用的验证环境，这能同时保留学习信号质量、利用困难任务，并随策略进化持续获得对新漏洞类别的鲁棒性。

title: EmbodiedStudio: A Task-Driven Simulation Generation Platform for Embodied Learning and Evaluation
summary: Training and evaluating robots across diverse tasks requires a supply of simulation environments suited to those tasks. While recent scene and task generators offer a promising way to expand this supply, delivering a usable task environment still faces two practical gaps: generated scenes that look plausible in appearance often fail to support the intended task interactions or remain physically stable in simulation, and generated scoring programs frequently attempt task conditions without implementing them faithfully. We present EmbodiedStudio, a task-driven simulation generation platform that bridges these gaps by jointly authoring scene, task, robot-behavior, and rubric programs under closed-loop simulation feedback and independent review. Crucially, as the coding agent iteratively debugs scenes, behaviors, and stateful rubrics in simulation, this closed-loop process natively yields both forward construction experience for learning to build environments and physical execution experience for policy learning, all bound to frozen environment revisions for repeatable evaluation. Across scene generation, rubric evaluation, ablations, and learning studies, EmbodiedStudio substantially improves task readiness and rubric faithfulness while improving physical stability and retaining actionable supervision signals for layout authoring and policy adaptation.

AI.tldr: EmbodiedStudio 是一个任务驱动的仿真生成平台，通过在闭环仿真反馈与独立审查下联合编写场景、任务、机器人行为与评分规则程序，弥合"场景外观合理但交互失效/物理不稳定"和"评分程序未忠实实现任务条件"两大实用缺口，并顺带产出可用于布局生成与策略学习的两类经验数据。
AI.motivation: 机器人训练与评测需要与任务匹配的大量仿真环境，场景与任务生成器虽能扩充供给，但存在两个实际缺口：(1) 生成的场景外观看似合理，却无法支撑预期任务交互，或在仿真中物理不稳定；(2) 生成的评分（rubric）程序常常只是"尝试"任务条件而未忠实实现。因此需要一种能保证任务可用性与评分忠实性的生成方式。
AI.method: 构建 EmbodiedStudio 任务驱动仿真生成平台，联合编写四类程序：场景、任务、机器人行为、评分规则（rubric）；由编码智能体在仿真中迭代调试场景、行为与有状态 rubric，形成闭环仿真反馈 + 独立审查机制；闭环过程原生积累两类经验——用于学习构建环境的前向构建经验，以及用于策略学习的物理执行经验，并将经验绑定到冻结的环境版本以支持可重复评测。
AI.result: 在场景生成、rubric 评估、消融实验与学习研究中，EmbodiedStudio 显著提升任务就绪度（task readiness）与 rubric 忠实度，同时改善物理稳定性，并保留了对布局编写与策略适应有效的监督信号。
AI.conclusion: 将场景、行为与评分的生成置于闭环仿真验证与独立审查之下，可有效解决生成环境"可看不可用"与评分不忠实的问题；该闭环调试过程还能零成本地转化为构建经验与策略学习数据，为可扩展、可复现的机器人仿真环境供给提供统一范式。

title: HiGS: A Hierarchical Architecture for Fast Differentiable 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) makes one screen tile the cell of partitioning, the cell of rasterization, and the unit of parallel work. Partitioning favors large tiles and rasterization small ones, and with one unit per tile the densest tiles set the frame time. We present Hierarchically Tiled Gaussian Splatting (HiGS), a unified architecture for rendering and reconstruction that gives each role its own granularity: Gaussians are partitioned over coarse macro-tiles, rasterized over the fine render tiles within them, and processed in bounded depth-sorted batches. A dense region issues more batches instead of one longer unit, so frame time follows the work in a view rather than its densest tile. The same batches carry reconstruction: compositing supplies the transmittance and color needed to differentiate each one independently, leaving optimizer memory traffic as the dominant training cost. We fuse the optimizer into the backward pass, halve the parameters and moments it stores and updates directly, and defer appearance updates outside the view. HiGS renders scenes faster than every published method we evaluate, by the widest margin on views with uneven load, and reconstructs them faster and in less memory, at equal image quality and with exact front-to-back alpha compositing.

AI.tldr: HiGS 解耦了 3DGS 中"分块、光栅化、并行调度"三者共用同一屏幕瓦片的耦合，使帧时间取决于视图的实际工作量而非最密瓦片，并以有界深度排序批次统一渲染与重建，配合优化器融合进反向传播实现更快、更省显存的训练与渲染。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 让一个屏幕 tile 同时充当分区单元、光栅化单元和并行工作单元，但分区偏好大 tile、光栅化偏好小 tile，二者冲突；且每 tile 一个工作单元导致最密集的 tile 决定整帧时间，负载不均视图下开销严重。训练时优化器访存流量成为主要成本。
AI.method: 提出 HiGS 分层瓦片架构：(1) 高斯在粗粒度 macro-tile 上分区，在其中细粒度 render tile 上光栅化，并以有界、深度排序的批次处理；密集区域发出更多批次而非单个更长单元。(2) 同一批次承载重建：合成过程提供可独立求导所需的透射率与颜色，前端到后端精确 alpha 合成。(3) 将优化器融合进反向传播，直接存储与更新的参数及动量减半，并把外观更新推迟到视图之外。
AI.result: 渲染速度快于所有对比的已发表方法，在负载不均视图上优势最大；重建速度更快、内存占用更低，图像质量持平，并保持精确的前向到后向 alpha 合成。
AI.conclusion: 通过为分区、光栅化、并行调度各赋予独立粒度，HiGS 使帧时间随视图工作量而非最密瓦片伸缩，并统一了渲染与重建路径，在等质量下同时获得渲染与训练的效率与内存优势。

title: How Much Dependency Can a Marginal Rule See? Total Correlation in Diffusion LM Parallel Decoding
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning (DiffuLM). Code: https://github.com/DovudAsadov/dllm-total-correlation
summary: A masked diffusion language model is fast because it commits several tokens per step. Each token is sampled from its own marginal, so the dependency between the tokens is lost, and the size of that loss is the conditional total correlation C of the committed set. Most decoders choose the set from per-position marginals, which can bound C but cannot determine it. We ask how well they predict it. We estimate C for fixed candidate sets on four masked diffusion LMs from two families. On three of the four, the best marginal-only predictor is off by about one bit (0.74 to 1.17), 1.8 to 3.7 times less than a baseline that knows only the bound, and most of this accuracy comes from the bound itself. On a subset, our estimate ranks sets like the exact KL cost of a parallel commit, but sits a median 0.4 to 1.1 bits below it on prose and when the rest of the text is still masked. Dream-instruct is the exception, mainly on prose, where its conditionals are least self-consistent. Among six common marginal rules, pooling over the set beats gating on its weakest position in all 24 paired comparisons. The measurement needs a validated readout: Dream and LLaDA place a position's prediction at different logit indices, and the wrong index inflates an inconsistency diagnostic 14 to 41 times. We give three checks that measure the convention. Our results concern predicting C for a fixed set, not what a dependency-aware decoder gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）中，仅依赖逐位置边际的候选集选择规则能否准确预测提交集合的条件总相关 C，并给出 C 的估计与读出约定校验方法。
AI.motivation: MDLM 每步并行提交多个 token，各 token 从自身边际采样会丢失 token 间依赖，其损失量即提交集合的条件总相关 C。主流解码器仅用逐位置边际选择提交集合，理论上只能给出 C 的界而无法确定 C，因此需要实证检验这类边际规则对 C 的预测能力。
AI.method: 在两个家族共四个掩码扩散 LM 上，对固定候选集估计条件总相关 C；将最佳纯边际预测器与"仅知界"的基线对比；在子集上将 C 估计与并行提交的精确 KL 代价做排序一致性与数值偏差分析；比较六种常见边际规则（集合池化 vs. 最弱位置门控）的配对表现；并提出三项检查以测定各模型把位置预测放在不同 logit 索引上的读出约定。
AI.result: 四个模型中三个的最佳纯边际预测器误差约 1 bit（0.74–1.17），比仅知界的基线低 1.8–3.7 倍，且精度主要来自界本身；在子集上该估计的排序与精确 KL 代价一致，但在散文类文本及后续文本仍被掩码时中位数低 0.4–1.1 bit；Dream-instruct 为例外（散文上条件最不自洽）；六种边际规则中集合池化在全部 24 组配对比较中均优于最弱位置门控；错误的 logit 索引会使不一致性诊断膨胀 14–41 倍。
AI.conclusion: 边际规则对固定集合的 C 具有一定可预测性，但精度主要源于上界而非对依赖结构的刻画；C 估计与精确 KL 代价存在系统性的排序一致但数值偏低。结论限定于"固定集合下 C 的预测"，而非依赖感知解码器所能获得的实际收益；同时强调读出约定必须先经验证，否则诊断指标严重失真。

title: FlashQLA: Efficient Context Parallelism for Gated DeltaNet
summary: Gated DeltaNet (GDN) achieves linear computational complexity through recurrent state updates, but sequential dependencies between chunks limit parallelism, particularly for long-context workloads with small batch sizes or limited head-level parallelism per GPU. We present FlashQLA, a context-parallel execution framework for GDN that exposes additional sequence-level parallelism while reducing boundary-state preprocessing overhead. FlashQLA reduces boundary-state preprocessing overhead through decay-aware preparation and extends sequence parallelism across GPUs with Dual CP, which shares summary computation across parallelism levels. Workload-adaptive Auto CP and CP-aware kernel co-design further improve execution efficiency. FlashQLA achieves $1.7\times$-$3.1\times$ forward speedup and up to $4.4\times$ backward speedup over Flash Linear Attention (FLA) on a single GPU. On eight GPUs with context lengths up to 1M tokens, Dual CP achieves up to $4.8\times$ forward speedup and $4.4\times$ speedup for combined forward and backward execution over FLA KCP.

AI.tldr: FlashQLA 是面向 Gated DeltaNet 的上下文并行执行框架，通过暴露序列级并行、降低边界状态预处理开销，在单卡与八卡长上下文场景下显著加速训练与推理。
AI.motivation: GDN 通过递归状态更新实现线性复杂度，但 chunk 间的顺序依赖限制了并行性，在小 batch 或 GPU 内 head 级并行度不足的长上下文负载中尤为突出。
AI.method: 提出 FlashQLA：1) 基于衰减感知（decay-aware）的边界状态预处理以降低开销；2) Dual CP 在多个并行层级间共享 summary 计算，将序列并行扩展到多 GPU；3) 引入负载自适应 Auto CP 与 CP 感知的 kernel 协同设计。
AI.result: 单 GPU 上相对 FLA 取得 1.7×–3.1× 前向加速、最高 4.4× 反向加速；8 卡、上下文长度达 1M token 时，Dual CP 相对 FLA KCP 取得最高 4.8× 前向加速及 4.4× 前反向联合加速。
AI.conclusion: FlashQLA 有效缓解 GDN 的序列依赖瓶颈，在长上下文、多卡场景下具备显著且可扩展的效率优势。

title: Self-supervised quality evaluation of grid maps without ground truth
summary: Maps are widely used in the robotics community for localization and path planning and the ability to identify incorrect or inaccurate regions of a map is an area of active research interest. For large environments, manual edits of the map can be very time consuming and a tool which can assist a map editor is needed. With this paper, we contribute to robot introspection through self-assessment of map quality, using only a given map as input to be independent of the underlying mapping algorithm. Current methods for map quality assessment rely on ground-truth or labelled information for training classifiers, both of which can be difficult to obtain. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised learning approach to map quality assessment of 2D occupancy grid maps which identifies regions of a map that require further investigation. We leverage an autoencoder for patches extracted from the map to capture the dominant structure of the map. By evaluating the reconstruction loss of a patch reconstructed with the learned model, we can evaluate whether it contains an unusual structure, which indicates the need of further investigation. We evaluate our method on the outcome of state-of-the-art grid mapping methods using benchmark datasets as well as maps from warehouse environments, highlighting the application to more complex environments. We show that the method identifies regions with sparse data, clutter, and misregistrations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自监督的2D占据栅格地图质量评估方法，利用自编码器对地图图块的重建损失识别异常结构区域，无需真值或标注，可标出稀疏数据、杂乱及配准错误区域。
AI.motivation: 机器人在定位与路径规划中依赖地图，地图的错误/不准确区域识别是活跃研究方向；大环境下手动修图耗时巨大，需要辅助地图编辑者的工具。同时现有地图质量评估方法依赖真值或标注信息训练分类器，而这类信息难以获取。
AI.method: 以单张给定的2D占据栅格地图为唯一输入，独立于底层建图算法。从地图中提取图块（patch），用自编码器学习地图的主导结构；通过评估图块在该模型下的重建损失判断是否包含异常结构，重建损失高即提示需进一步检查。采用自监督学习范式，无需真值/标签。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上，对多个SOTA栅格建图方法的输出进行了评估，并进一步在仓库环境地图上验证，展示其在更复杂场景中的适用性；结果表明方法能够识别出稀疏数据区域、杂乱区域以及配准错误（misregistration）区域。
AI.conclusion: 基于自编码器重建损失的自监督地图质量评估是一种无需标注、算法无关且可扩展到复杂环境的有效方案，可作为地图编辑的辅助工具，定位需人工复核的区域。

title: DUALingo: A Dual-Hand Instruction-Guided Dataset for Affordance Grounding on 3D Objects
summary: Affordance grounding localizes where an agent should interact with an object to perform a task. Many everyday manipulation tasks, however, require bimanual affordance, in which two hands assume complementary and cooperative roles to accomplish a shared goal. Existing 3D affordance datasets primarily ground single interaction regions, and manually annotating dual-hand, cooperative contacts does not scale. To address this gap, we introduce DUALingo, a large-scale dataset for task-conditioned, role-aware bimanual 3D affordance grounding on diverse everyday objects. DUALingo represents each task as two cooperative, hand-agnostic roles, each grounded as a heatmap on the object surface. It contains 271K free-form tasks on 71K objects, generated by a fully automated pipeline of open-weight foundation models without human labeling. Expert ratings and a validated LLM judge confirm the quality of the resulting annotations. Trained on DUALingo, existing 3D affordance models learn to ground both cooperative roles from natural-language instructions, with the best-performing model achieving a more than threefold improvement in aIoU over the zero-shot baseline, from 10.3 to 37.8. Robotic manipulation demonstrations illustrate the actionability of the predicted bimanual affordances in performing cooperative tasks. These results position DUALingo as a scalable foundation for learning everyday bimanual affordances. Project page: https://nycu-pair-labs.github.io/DUALingo/

AI.tldr: 本文提出DUALingo，一个大规模、任务条件化、角色感知的双臂3D可供性定位数据集：将任务表示为两个协同的、与左右手无关的角色，每个角色以物体表面热图形式标注；数据由开放权重基础模型全自动流水线生成，含71K物体上的271K自由形式任务，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 现有3D可供性数据集主要只标注单一交互区域，而许多日常操作任务需要双手以互补协同的角色完成；人工标注双手协同接触区域成本高、难以规模化，因此缺乏任务条件化、角色感知的双臂3D可供性数据与基准。
AI.method: 构建DUALingo数据集：每个任务拆解为两个协同且与左右手无关的角色，各自在物体表面表示为可供性热图；采用由开放权重基础模型组成的全自动流水线生成271K自由形式任务（覆盖71K物体），完全不依赖人工标注；并通过专家评分与经过验证的LLM评判器验证标注质量。随后用DUALingo训练现有3D可供性模型，使其从自然语言指令中同时定位两个协同角色。
AI.result: 经专家评分与验证过的LLM评判器确认标注质量可靠；在DUALingo上训练后，现有3D可供性模型能够从自然语言指令定位两个协同角色，最佳模型相对零样本baseline将aIoU从10.3提升至37.8（提升超过三倍）；机器人操作演示验证了所预测双臂可供性在协同任务中的可执行性。
AI.conclusion: DUALingo为学习日常双臂可供性提供了可扩展的基础数据集与基准，表明自动化生成的双手协同角色标注可有效支撑任务条件化、角色感知的3D可供性定位，并具备向真实机器人操作迁移的潜力。

title: TableRouter: Query-Aware Evidence Construction for Long-Table Question Answering
comment: Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026
summary: LLMs can reason over tables, but when tables outgrow the context budget, retrieving relevant rows is only part of the solution. A retrieved subset may omit information required for an exact aggregate; even complete evidence may remain difficult for an LLM to use. We introduce TableRouter, a training-free framework that analyzes each query, then chooses between two routes: a computation route, which derives question-conditioned statistics from the full table, and a coverage route, which retrieves relevant rows and column summaries. The chosen context is passed to a frozen LLM in one call. Across three LLMs and three large-table benchmarks, TableRouter outperforms the strongest of six single-call baselines in all nine settings by 1.2-18.3 accuracy points, using 77-95% fewer estimated FLOPs than truncated-table prompting, with indexing amortized across questions. The gains extend to long tables from databases not used in earlier experiments, where TableRouter achieves 35.8% with Qwen2.5-7B, versus 16.4% for the strongest external baseline. A controlled experiment shows that explicitly providing computed statistics improves accuracy by up to 40.0 points, even when all answer-determining rows are available. These results distinguish evidence access from evidence use: long-table reasoning depends on how information is represented, not only on which rows are retrieved.

AI.tldr: TableRouter：面向超长表格的无训练路由框架，按查询在"计算路线"与"覆盖路线"间二选一，将问题相关统计或检索行/列摘要一次性送入冻结LLM，在3个模型×3个基准的9个设置中均领先最强单次调用基线1.2–18.3点，且FLOPs降低77–95%。
AI.motivation: 长表格超出上下文预算时，仅靠检索相关行并不足够：检索子集可能缺失精确聚合所需信息，即使证据完整，LLM也难以有效利用。作者据此提出"证据获取"与"证据使用"的区分，认为长表推理的关键在于信息表示方式而非仅在于检索哪些行。
AI.method: TableRouter为免训练框架：先对每个查询做分析，再路由至两条路径之一。(1) 计算路线：在完整表格上推导以问题为条件的统计量；(2) 覆盖路线：检索相关行与列摘要。所选上下文单次调用送入冻结LLM。索引成本可在多问题间摊销；并做受控实验，检验在答案相关行全部可得时显式提供计算统计量的效果。
AI.result: 在3个LLM与3个大表基准共9个设置上，均优于6个单次调用基线中最强者1.2–18.3个准确率点；相比截断表格提示减少77–95%估计FLOPs。在未参与前期实验的数据库长表上，Qwen2.5-7B下达到35.8%，最强外部基线为16.4%。受控实验显示，即使所有决定答案的行都可用，显式提供计算统计量仍带来最高40.0点提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了证据获取与证据使用：长表推理依赖信息如何被表示，而不只依赖检索到哪些行；基于查询的计算型表示是可扩展且高效的单次调用方案，具备跨模型、跨基准与跨库的泛化性。

title: Spec-CoFrGeNet: Reparametrizing Continued Fraction Networks for Stable and Accurate Training
summary: Continued fractions have been shown to be a function class capable of constructing expressive yet parameter-efficient neural networks. These neural networks are not only effective for supervised learning, but also for training LLMs. However, the rational form of this function class introduces poles when the denominator approaches zero, which prior work has avoided by enforcing a small positive (non-smooth) lower bound. We show that performance and training stability can be highly sensitive to the choice of this lower bound. In this work, we introduce a novel transformation of the partial denominators, inspired by its connection to the Green's function in physics, that mitigates the above issue elegantly by constraining the spectra of the constructed tridiagonal Hamiltonian. Our approach further eliminates the need for incremental training used by previous works for stability, thus avoiding involved modifications to standard pre-training procedures. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our reparameterization by replacing FFNs with a previously proposed continued fraction architecture for both language and image generative modeling. Across diverse models, such as GPT-2 XL, (nano) Llama-MoE, and Granite, we show that our proposed method achieves performance comparable to the original (FFN-based) architectures while maintaining ~30%-50% parameter savings as before, and in most cases even outperforms the more complicated incremental training baseline. We further demonstrate, for the first time for continued fraction networks, that their effectiveness also carries over to image generative modeling, that utilize diffusion objectives. On a state-of-the-art Diffusion Transformer, we show that our approach again achieves performance comparable to the original FFN-based models with ~30% parameter savings and significantly outperforms the previous incremental training approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于物理中格林函数思想的连分式偏分母变换，通过约束三对角哈密顿量的谱来避免极点问题，使连分式网络在语言与图像生成任务中稳定训练，在节省约30%-50%参数的同时达到或超越原始FFN架构。
AI.motivation: 连分式函数类可构造表达力强且参数高效的神经网络，但其有理形式在分母趋零时引入极点；现有工作通过施加小的正（非光滑）下界来规避，而该下界取值对性能与训练稳定性高度敏感，且往往依赖增量训练等复杂流程。
AI.method: 受格林函数与物理系统的联系启发，提出对偏分母（partial denominators）的新颖变换，将问题转化为对构造出的三对角哈密顿量谱的约束，从而结构性地消除极点风险；该重参数化无需增量训练即可稳定，不改变标准预训练流程。作者将FFN替换为所提出的连分式架构，在GPT-2 XL、(nano) Llama-MoE、Granite等模型的语言建模以及Diffusion Transformer的图像扩散生成中进行验证。
AI.result: 在多类模型中，所提方法在保持约30%-50%参数节省的前提下，性能与原始FFN架构相当，多数情况下优于更复杂的增量训练基线；首次证明连分式网络在采用扩散目标的图像生成建模中同样有效，在先进Diffusion Transformer上以约30%参数节省达到与FFN基线相当的性能，并显著优于先前增量训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过对偏分母的谱约束式重参数化，可优雅地解决连分式网络的极点与稳定性问题，并摆脱增量训练依赖；该方法在语言与图像生成任务上均验证了参数高效性与性能竞争力，拓展了连分式架构的适用边界。

title: MXI-MemICL: Towards In-Context Robot Manipulation through Self-Retrieved Interaction Memory
summary: In-context learning (ICL) offers robots a way to acquire new skills from a single demonstration without parameter updates. However, existing robotic ICL methods either rely on large-scale pretraining constrained by scarce, costly robot interaction data or require additional annotations yet struggle to generalize across tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose MXI-MemICL, a framework for memory-guided ICL in vision-language-action (VLA) models. By treating demonstrations as retrievable memory, MXI-MemICL enables in-context manipulation without additional large-scale pretraining or specialized annotations. Specifically, a visual-action causal encoder turns actions and their observed effects in demonstrations and completed interactions into reusable memory to guide execution. To retrieve experience suited to upcoming execution, an intention predictor forecasts the next stage's intent and uses it to query memory. The retrieved experience conditions the language backbone through experience-token prefixes and gated cross-attention, guiding action generation with a learned gate that regulates its influence. MXI-MemICL improves success over the baseline by +8.2% and +14.4% on RoboCasa365 and RoboTwin 2.0. Real-robot experiments show a +9.0% gain, with demonstrations adding +5.0% on seen and +16.7% on unseen tasks. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出MXI-MemICL：把演示当作可检索记忆，为VLA模型提供无需大规模预训练与额外标注的记忆引导上下文学习框架。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人ICL方法要么依赖受限于稀缺昂贵机器人交互数据的大规模预训练，要么需要额外标注且跨任务泛化差。
AI.method: 视觉-动作因果编码器将演示与已完成交互中的动作及其观测效果编码为可复用记忆；意图预测器预测下一阶段意图并据此检索记忆；检索到的经验通过经验token前缀与门控交叉注意力注入语言主干，并以学习门控调节其影响。
AI.result: RoboCasa365与RoboTwin 2.0上成功率较基线提升+8.2%与+14.4%；真机实验提升+9.0%，演示在已见任务加+5.0%、未见任务加+16.7%。
AI.conclusion: 记忆引导的ICL可在不增加大规模预训练与专门标注的前提下提升VLA模型的操作性能，并对未见任务具良好泛化；代码将开源。

title: TANDEM: Temporal Anchor Densification With Reliability-Aware Memory for Lightweight Sparse Depth Completion in Endoscopic Robotic Navigation
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging, 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables
summary: For endoscopic robotic surgery, accurate dense depth perception serves as a foundational capability, which enables navigation, instrument localization, and tissue interaction. However, endoscopic video lacks reliable metric depth, while metric measurements obtained via tracking, time-of-flight sensing, or instrument contact only cover a small fraction of pixels in each frame, rendering sparse depth completion an urgent and unsolved challenge. In this work, we propose Temporal Anchor Densification with Reliability-Aware Memory (TANDEM), a causal sparse depth completion framework for endoscopic video. It adopts a lightweight design and leverages the video stream: past measurements re-projected into the current view recover the metric evidence unavailable within a single sparse frame. To keep this evidence interpretable, accurate, and efficient, an explicit memory scores each re-projected measurement with analytic re-observation, age, and motion-parallax factors without overriding current measurements. A compact network then reconstructs depth via reliability-weighted gradient integration and a frequency-gated reference prior. We evaluate TANDEM on the C3VD colonoscopy and StereoMIS laparoscopy datasets. With only 5.58 M parameters, TANDEM reduces the root mean square error by 11.7% and 32.0%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. It also remains accurate under pose errors of the magnitude reported for endoscopic pose estimation. Code will be released at https://github.com/Wk-cpu-art/TANDEM upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: TANDEM：面向内窥镜视频的因果稀疏深度补全框架，通过显式记忆将历史测量的重投影证据与可靠性评分结合，以5.58M参数实现SOTA精度。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜机器人手术需要稠密深度感知以支持导航、器械定位与组织交互，但内窥镜视频缺乏可靠的度量深度；由跟踪、飞行时间传感或器械接触获得的度量测量仅覆盖每帧少量像素，稀疏深度补全因而成为亟待解决的难题。
AI.method: 提出TANDEM（Temporal Anchor Densification with Reliability-Aware Memory），一个轻量化的因果稀疏深度补全框架。利用视频流将过去测量重投影至当前视角以恢复单帧稀疏数据缺失的度量证据；构建显式记忆，用解析的重观测因子、时效因子与运动视差因子对每条重投影测量打分，且不覆盖当前测量；再由紧凑网络通过可靠性加权梯度积分与频率门控参考先验重建深度。
AI.result: 在C3VD结肠镜与StereoMIS腹腔镜数据集上评估，仅5.58M参数，相比最强基线RMSE分别降低11.7%与32.0%，达到SOTA精度；在内窥镜位姿估计所报告量级的位姿误差下仍保持准确。
AI.conclusion: TANDEM表明，借助时序锚点稠密化与可靠性感知记忆，可在轻量因果框架下显著提升内窥镜视频稀疏深度补全的精度与鲁棒性，代码将在论文接收后开源。

title: Marketing-Bench: Evaluating Frontier Models and Agents on Real-World Marketing Capabilities
summary: As frontier AI models and agents are deployed more broadly in the real world, marketing is emerging as one of their largest applications. Marketing teams use AI models to produce brand assets like website copy and social media posts, while consumers' agents autonomously discover products, research purchases, and navigate websites. However, evaluating marketing capability is difficult because unlike areas like software development, customer support, or legal review where ground truth is more objectively defined, marketing is subjective, and output quality is judged based on taste and brand. We introduce Marketing-Bench, the first open-source marketing benchmark, which pairs discriminative tasks (detecting brand anomalies) with generative tasks (remediation), while keeping answers verifiable. Marketing-Bench tests five key pillars: factuality, consistency, coherence, structure, and brand voice, all crucial elements for good brand content on the web. We find that frontier models are far from solving the benchmark: the average model corrects only about half of the introduced issues (53.1%), whereas a marketing expert corrects nearly all of them. Even the strongest, GPT-6 Astra, reaches only 74.8%, with Claude Opus and Fable, Gemini Argon, and GPT-6 Sol falling well short. These findings suggest that marketing capabilities are less mature than adoption implies, and that principled evaluation should precede further scaling of usage. Marketing-Bench is a first step toward "frontier marketing models" with superhuman marketing performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个开源营销基准 Marketing-Bench，将"品牌异常检测"（判别式）与"问题修复"（生成式）配对，围绕事实性、一致性、连贯性、结构、品牌调性五个维度评测模型，结果显示前沿模型仅修复约53.1%的注入问题，最强模型GPT-6 Astra也仅74.8%，远不及营销专家。
AI.motivation: 营销是前沿AI模型与智能体最大的落地场景之一（品牌内容生产、消费者端自主选购与浏览），但营销能力难以评估：与软件开发、客服、法律审查等有较客观真值的领域不同，营销是主观的，质量取决于品味与品牌调性，缺乏可验证的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建首个开源营销基准 Marketing-Bench：成对设计判别式任务（检测品牌异常）与生成式任务（修复/补救），同时保持答案可验证；评测覆盖五大支柱——事实性（factuality）、一致性（consistency）、连贯性（coherence）、结构（structure）、品牌调性（brand voice），并引入营销专家作为人类上界参照。
AI.result: 模型平均仅修复约53.1%的注入问题，营销专家几乎全部修复；最强模型GPT-6 Astra仅达74.8%，Claude Opus与Fable、Gemini Argon、GPT-6 Sol均明显落后。
AI.conclusion: 营销能力成熟度低于其实际采用程度所暗示的水平，应在扩大使用规模之前先做有原则的评测；Marketing-Bench 是迈向具备超人营销表现的"前沿营销模型"的第一步。

title: Integral DeltaNet: Improved Linear Attention with Adaptive Memory Integration
summary: Linear attention replaces softmax attention with a linear formulation, enabling linear-time computation with a fixed-size recurrent state instead of a growing key-value cache. These computational and memory advantages have attracted growing interest in linear attention for long-context language modeling. However, compressing past information into a fixed-size state causes memory collisions that hinder long-context understanding. Although DeltaNet mitigates memory collisions through delta-rule updates and Gated DeltaNet extends this approach with gating, these mechanisms may also discard information relevant to future predictions. To address this limitation, we introduce Integral DeltaNet, which maintains two complementary recurrent states: a fast-updating delta state that captures current key-value associations and an integral state that preserves a weighted history of the delta state. At readout, the model adaptively combines these states to access information across different timescales. We further derive a chunkwise parallel formulation that enables hardware-efficient training. We evaluate Integral DeltaNet using 340M and 1.3B parameter models trained from scratch on 15B and 100B FineWeb-Edu tokens, respectively. Comparisons with strong recurrent baselines show improved overall performance in language modeling, commonsense reasoning, real-world and synthetic retrieval, long-context understanding, and length extrapolation. We also compare training throughput and activation memory, as well as decoding latency and memory.

AI.tldr: 提出 Integral DeltaNet，用"快速更新的 delta 状态 + 保留其加权历史的积分状态"双递归状态缓解线性注意力/DeltaNet 的记忆碰撞与信息丢弃问题，并给出分块并行训练公式，在 340M/1.3B 规模上全面优于强递归基线。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力以固定大小递归状态替代增长的 KV cache，获得线性时间与恒定内存优势，但把历史压缩进定长状态会引发记忆碰撞（memory collision），损害长上下文理解。DeltaNet 用 delta 规则更新、Gated DeltaNet 加门控来缓解碰撞，但这类"覆盖式"更新可能同时丢弃对未来预测有用的信息。
AI.method: 核心是维护两个互补的递归状态：(1) 快速更新的 delta 状态，刻画当前 key-value 关联；(2) 积分状态（integral state），保存 delta 状态的加权历史。读出时自适应地组合两者，以跨不同时间尺度取用信息。为支持硬件高效训练，推导了 chunkwise 并行形式（分块并行算法），使训练可并行化而不退化。
AI.result: 在 FineWeb-Edu 上从零训练 340M（15B tokens）与 1.3B（100B tokens）模型；与强递归基线相比，在语言建模、常识推理、真实与合成检索、长上下文理解、长度外推上整体性能均有提升。另报告了训练吞吐、激活内存以及解码延迟与解码内存的对比。
AI.conclusion: 通过"增量状态 + 积分状态"的双状态设计与自适应读出，可在保留线性时间/恒定内存优势的同时缓解记忆碰撞与信息丢弃，为长上下文语言建模提供了一种有效且可高效训练的线性注意力架构。

title: Follow-Bench 2.0: An End-to-End 3D Benchmark for Socially-Aware Robot Person Following
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (ED Track). Project page: https://medlartea.github.io/follow-bench-v2/
summary: Socially-aware robot person following (RPF) requires a mobile robot to follow a designated person in dynamic human environments while maintaining target identity, avoiding obstacles and pedestrians, and preserving socially comfortable formations. Existing benchmarks only partially evaluate this coupled problem: embodied visual tracking benchmarks emphasize target visibility with limited social interaction, person re-identification benchmarks study perception without closed-loop control, and motion-planning benchmarks often assume ground-truth target and pedestrian states. We introduce Follow-Bench 2.0, an end-to-end 3D benchmark for evaluating socially-aware RPF under coupled perception--planning challenges. Built in Unreal Engine, Follow-Bench 2.0 provides difficulty-leveled scenarios with diverse pedestrian flows, lighting and weather conditions, cluttered layouts, bottlenecks, queueing behaviors, distractors, and temporary target occlusions. The benchmark supports modular perception--planning pipelines, end-to-end visual policies, and foundation-model-based active trackers under a unified closed-loop protocol. It further evaluates both back- and side-following configurations and reports safety--comfort metrics covering task success, target visibility, target recovery, social-space intrusion, following formation, and motion smoothness. Experiments show that RPF-oriented modular pipelines substantially outperform current end-to-end visual policies on close and socially comfortable following, but also reveal that socially-aware RPF remains far from solved in interaction-heavy environments and especially in side-following. Follow-Bench 2.0 therefore provides a diagnostic platform for studying how perception errors, occlusions, crowd interactions, and following configurations jointly affect robot person following.

AI.tldr: 提出 Follow-Bench 2.0：基于 Unreal Engine 的端到端 3D 社交感知机器人跟随（RPF）基准，统一评测感知—规划耦合问题，涵盖多难度场景、后跟随与侧跟随配置及安全—舒适多维指标。
AI.motivation: 社交感知机器人跟随是一个感知与规划强耦合的问题，但现有基准只做局部评测：具身视觉跟踪基准侧重目标可见性、社交交互有限；行人重识别基准只研究感知、无闭环控制；运动规划基准常假设目标与行人状态为真值。缺少统一闭环协议下同时考察感知误差、遮挡、人群交互与跟随队形的端到端评测平台。
AI.method: 在 Unreal Engine 中构建 Follow-Bench 2.0，提供按难度分级、含多样人流、光照与天气、杂乱布局、瓶颈、排队行为、干扰者与目标临时遮挡的场景。统一闭环协议支持三类被测系统：模块化感知—规划流水线、端到端视觉策略、基于基础模型的主动跟踪器；同时评测后跟随与侧跟随两种配置。
AI.result: 指标覆盖任务成功率、目标可见性、目标重找回、社交空间侵入、跟随队形与运动平滑度等安全—舒适维度。实验表明：面向 RPF 的模块化流水线在近距离、社交舒适型跟随上显著优于现有端到端视觉策略；但社交感知 RPF 在交互密集环境、尤其侧跟随配置下仍远未解决。
AI.conclusion: Follow-Bench 2.0 为诊断性评测平台，可系统研究感知误差、遮挡、人群交互与跟随配置如何共同影响机器人跟随性能，并揭示侧跟随与高交互场景为未来关键挑战。

title: Decompose, Verify, Evolve: Physically Grounded Shape Decomposition
summary: Shape decomposition represents 3D objects as a compact set of geometric primitives for interpretable modeling and simulation. However, existing decomposition methods are trained primarily for geometric fidelity, without explicit constraints on physical plausibility, and can therefore produce disconnected parts or physically unstable reconstructions. We present PhysDec, an agentic framework that draws on a pretrained vision-language model's semantic understanding and commonsense reasoning to predict material-aware primitive decompositions from a few images. Within this framework, PhysDec-Loop is an agentic pipeline that reasons about part structure and materials, using a reference 3D point cloud for geometric feedback and physical verifiers to guide iterative refinement. Through self-evolution, we further develop another agentic pipeline, PhysDec-Evolved, which learns from prior corrections to predict primitive decompositions from images without point-cloud feedback or a correction loop at inference. Experiments show that PhysDec-Loop improves geometric fidelity, physical plausibility and visual quality over geometry-focused baselines, while PhysDec-Evolved approaches its performance at substantially lower inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出PhysDec智能体框架，利用预训练视觉语言模型的语义理解与常识推理，从少量图像预测材料感知的物理合理形状分解；其中PhysDec-Loop借助参考点云几何反馈与物理验证器迭代精修，PhysDec-Evolved通过自进化蒸馏推理期无需点云与循环。
AI.motivation: 现有形状分解方法主要以几何保真度为训练目标，缺乏对物理合理性的显式约束，易产生不连通部件或物理不稳定的重建结果。
AI.method: PhysDec基于预训练VLM的语义感知与常识推理预测部件结构与材料属性；PhysDec-Loop为智能体流水线，以参考3D点云作几何反馈、物理验证器引导迭代细化；Self-evolution将历史修正经验内化，得到PhysDec-Evolved，推理时仅输入图像、无需点云反馈与纠正循环。
AI.result: PhysDec-Loop在几何保真度、物理合理性与视觉质量上优于几何导向基线；PhysDec-Evolved以显著更低的推理开销接近其性能。
AI.conclusion: 将语义/常识推理与物理验证结合可有效提升分解的物理合理性；自进化可将依赖反馈的智能体流程蒸馏为高效的单次前向方案，兼顾质量与效率。

title: From Rule-based to Agentic: LLM Agent based Real-time Control of Urban Drainage Systems for Flooding and Sewer Overflow Mitigation
summary: Real-time control (RTC) for urban drainage systems (UDS) remains hampered by sparse in-network sensing. While heterogeneous multi-modal meteorological early warnings often contain decision-critical information for UDS RTC, none of the existing approaches can exploit such externally-sourced information within the control workflow. Here we introduce AgenticAI-Control, an agentic artificial intelligence framework able to assimilate multi-source meteorological early warnings in RTC. Two coupled large language model agents are integrated to generate control strategies by retrieving meteorological early-warnings and fusing them with domain engineering expertise. Validated via simulation studies of a combined sewer catchment in eastern China across 10 real-world rainfall events, the AgenticAI-Control achieved 69.1-90.6% reduction in aggregated flood and overflow volumes compared to the rule-based baseline control. Rigorously standardized prompt engineering and modular workflow constraints substantially compress performance disparities among four distinct LLMs. Our work establishes AgenticAI as a viable tool to unify multi-source meteorological monitoring and practitioner domain knowledge, surmounting longstanding monitoring limitations of UDS RTC and delivering cost-efficient, robust intelligent control solutions for sensor-sparse sewer infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 提出AgenticAI-Control智能体框架，利用两个耦合的大语言模型智能体把多源气象预警信息融入城市排水系统实时控制，在10场真实降雨模拟中相比规则基线将溢流与内涝总量削减69.1–90.6%。
AI.motivation: 城市排水系统实时控制（RTC）受制于管网内监测点稀疏、数据不足；而异构多模态气象预警中富含对RTC有决策价值的信息，现有方法却无法把这类外部信息纳入控制流程。因此需要一种能吸收外部多源气象预警并与领域知识融合的控制范式。
AI.method: 构建AgenticAI-Control框架：集成两个相互耦合的LLM智能体，一个负责检索与解析气象预警信息，另一个结合排水工程领域专家知识生成控制策略；同时采用严格标准化的提示词工程与模块化工作流约束来规范智能体行为。
AI.result: 以中国东部某合流制排水片区为对象，在10场真实降雨事件下开展模拟验证：相较规则基线控制，累积内涝与溢流体积降低69.1–90.6%；标准化提示词与模块化约束显著压缩了4种不同LLM之间的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明AgenticAI可作为统一多源气象监测与实践者领域知识的可行工具，突破UDS实时控制长期存在的监测瓶颈，为传感器稀疏的排水基础设施提供低成本、稳健的智能控制方案。

title: Fix How It Acts, Not How It Thinks: Surgical Fine-Tuning of Frontier LLMs
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Models released at https://huggingface.co/abacusai/Smaug-Nemotron-3.5 and https://huggingface.co/abacusai/Smaug-Nemotron-3.5-NVFP4
summary: Open-weight LLMs are competent software engineers, but they sometimes fail at tasks they are otherwise able to do. Often it is not a failure of reasoning. It is a few small missteps over a long trajectory (repeating a step that has already failed, or declaring the task done while a requirement is still unmet) that make the difference. Correcting this calls for a surgical weight update that steers the model toward the right actions without interfering with its reasoning. Such updates, typically learned with LoRA adapters, are often too small to survive merging into a released checkpoint. In our BF16 release, the median weight change is only 1.5% of a single rounding step, and merging loses roughly two thirds of the update's norm. When the same adapter is merged into the mixed FP8/NVFP4 release of the same model, 93% of the update disappears. Instead of increasing the size of the update, we directly train on the surviving part. We introduce merge-aware fine-tuning. Standard LoRA rounds the merged weights to the storage format only at export, so the loss never sees the rounded weights. We instead round the sum of base weights and adapter update to the release format at every training step, keeping the vendor's quantization scales, and compute the loss on these weights. The forward pass matches the serving engine numerics, and the gradient passes straight through the rounding, so the model we train is the model we ship. The loss optimizes only the model's actions and keeps its reasoning close to the base model. Applied to Nemotron-3.5, the recipe improves agentic coding in both the BF16 and the NVFP4 release, by up to 8.4 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and we publicly release both models.

AI.tldr: 提出"合并感知微调"（merge-aware fine-tuning）：训练时每步把基础权重与LoRA增量之和直接量化到发布格式并在此权重上计算损失，使训练目标与发布/推理数值一致，从而在BF16与NVFP4发布版本上均提升智能体编码能力。
AI.motivation: 开放权重LLM在长程智能体任务中的失败多源于少量"小失误"（重复已失败步骤、需求未满足即宣告完成），而非推理能力不足，需要精准的权重更新来纠偏且不破坏原有推理。但常规LoRA增量极小，合并进发布检查点时会被量化/舍入吞掉：BF16版中位权重变化仅为1个舍入步的1.5%，合并丢失约2/3的更新范数；合并进FP8/NVFP4混合版本时93%的更新消失。作者不选择放大更新幅度，而是转而直接优化"能存活下来的部分"。
AI.method: 标准LoRA仅在导出时对合并权重做存储格式舍入，损失函数从未感知舍入后的权重。本文在每个训练步即将"基础权重+适配器增量"舍入到发布格式（BF16或厂商量化缩放的FP8/NVFP4），并在此量化权重上前向计算损失；前向数值与serving引擎一致，梯度直通（straight-through）舍入算子。损失只优化模型的动作行为，同时约束其推理过程贴近基础模型。
AI.result: 在Nemotron-3.5上，该方法在BF16与NVFP4两种发布版本中均提升智能体编码表现，Terminal-Bench 2.1最高提升8.4分；两个模型均已公开释放。
AI.conclusion: 微调与量化的失效关键在于"训练—导出—部署"数值不一致而非更新幅度不足；将发布格式量化纳入训练回路可保证"训练即发布"，是低比特发布下保持甚至放大微调收益的有效且低成本方案。

title: Design, Control, and Teleoperation of a Dexterous Robotic Hand with Soft-Rigid Hybrid Fingers
summary:
Adding compliance to robot hands results in higher grasp quality and robust contact with the environment. Soft hands are inherently compliant, but are typically more complex to control and model than rigid equivalents.
  We extend prior work on soft-rigid hybrid robot fingers into a five-fingered dexterous gripper --- an integrated tendon-driven hand that is highly compliant and controllable. Structural compliance combined with a rigid skeleton, when realized in a five-fingered hand, allow us to use linear control to achieve soft-grasping generality. We evaluate the use of this hand in a variety of teleoperated manipulation tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of the overall mechanical design and control strategy. Our contributions include: (1) Mechanical design of the a five-fingered Soft-Rigid Hybrid Hand, composed of 12 active degrees of freedom, demonstrating a high degree on generalization enabled by the soft-rigid architecture, with our gripper, able to complete 28 of the 33 (84.8\%) grasp postures in the human range. (2) Precise, high bandwidth (up to 1432deg/s extension speed, compared with 700deg/s for the equivalent human joint). (3) Position and task space controllers for the soft-rigid hybrid finger and whole hand. (4) A teleoperation framework for control of this hand, as well as demonstrations of its efficacy in a variety of grasping and manipulation tasks
  Further tests illustrate the hand's advantages in completing non-rigid manipulation tasks, such as picking up thin deformable objects (such as a dollar bill or folding cloth) as well as in interfacing with soft or delicate targets.

AI.tldr: 提出一款腱驱动五指软-刚混合灵巧手（12个主动自由度），结合结构柔顺与刚性骨架，用线性控制实现通用软抓取，并在遥操作抓取与操作任务中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器人手部加入柔顺性可提升抓取质量与环境接触鲁棒性；软体手固有柔顺但控制与建模复杂，刚性手则相反。作者希望兼得柔顺性与可控性。
AI.method: 将已有软-刚混合手指扩展为五指腱驱动灵巧手，融合结构柔顺与刚性骨架，配合线性控制；设计位置与任务空间控制器（针对单指与整手），并搭建遥操作框架，在多种抓取与操作任务中评测。
AI.result: 覆盖人体手部33种抓取姿态中的28种（84.8%）；关节伸展速度最高达1432 deg/s（人体等效关节约700 deg/s），具备高带宽精确控制；在薄软易变形物体（纸币、折叠布料）抓取及软性/易损目标交互任务中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 软-刚混合架构在五指手上可实现柔顺性与可控性的统一，线性控制即可获得通用软抓取能力，并在非刚性物体操作与精细目标交互中展现优势。

title: DraftKV: Protecting Persistent Worlds through Hierarchical Streaming Retrieval
comment: Includes supplementary material. Code and project page are available online
summary: Interactive video world models enable action- and camera-controlled exploration, yet struggle to maintain consistent spatial geometry and appearance when revisiting previously explored locations. Historical KV caches help auto-regressive video diffusion models maintain long-term consistency, but their retrieval and attention computation introduce substantial latency as history grows. We propose DraftKV, a training-free framework that retrieves historical KV caches based on geometric grounding and query-conditioned relevance, while combining CPU offloading with tile-wise streaming attention to reduce GPU memory usage and inference latency. Theoretically, we show that draft relevance reproduces the mean branch of full-resolution block relevance exactly, so its deviation is confined to the $β$-weighted max branch, and we bound retrieval utility loss in terms of the measured Top-K selection overlap. We further show that draft relevance cannot distinguish blocks with similar pooled descriptors regardless of camera pose, motivating geometric grounding before refinement. Then, we introduce streaming CG-Attention, which overlaps CPU-to-GPU KV transfers with attention computation through tile-wise streaming, hiding transfer latency while maintaining bounded GPU memory usage. Experiments across diverse model families show that DraftKV achieves superior generation quality and consistency while achieving $3.27\times$ end-to-end speedup and 42.2% peak GPU memory reduction over other CPU-offloaded KV cache retrieval methods. Notably, DraftKV enables high-quality interactive world generation with historical KV retrieval on a single H100 GPU using SolarWM-33B.

AI.tldr: DraftKV：一种无需训练的历史KV缓存检索框架，通过几何锚定的“草稿相关性”检索+瓦片式流式注意力与CPU卸载，实现长时一致性交互视频世界模型的高效生成（3.27×加速、42.2%峰值显存降低）。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需支持动作与相机控制的空间探索，但重访历史位置时难以保持空间几何与外观一致性。历史KV缓存可缓解自回归视频扩散模型的长期一致性问题，但随历史增长，检索与注意力计算带来显著延迟与显存开销。
AI.method: (1) 基于几何锚定与查询条件相关性检索历史KV缓存；(2) 提出“草稿相关性”近似全分辨率块相关性，理论证明其精确复现均值分支，偏差仅限β加权最大分支，并以Top-K选择重叠度界定检索效用损失；论证草稿相关性无法区分池化描述子相近的块（与相机位姿无关），故需先几何锚定再精化；(3) 结合CPU卸载与瓦片式流式注意力(streaming CG-Attention)，将CPU→GPU的KV传输与注意力计算重叠，隐藏传输延迟并保持GPU显存有界。
AI.result: 在多类模型家族上，DraftKV取得更优的生成质量与一致性；相比其他CPU卸载KV缓存检索方法实现3.27×端到端加速与42.2%峰值显存降低；可在单张H100上用SolarWM-33B完成带历史KV检索的高质量交互式世界生成。
AI.conclusion: 几何锚定+草稿相关性检索与流式卸载注意力相结合，可在不训练的前提下兼顾长时空间一致性与推理效率，使大模型（33B级）交互式世界生成在单卡上可行。

title: EffectWAM: Learning Action-Grounded Effects for Robot Manipulation
summary: World-action models connect visual prediction with executable robot control. We present EffectWAM, which develops this connection through three complementary components: Effect, camera positional encoding (CaPE), and Action Grounding. Effect represents visual change as the difference between independently encoded future observations and a shared current-observation anchor. CaPE conditions endpoint pooling on relative camera pose when reliable extrinsics are available, while sharing the same learned parameters with pose-free pooling for uncalibrated trajectories. Action Grounding trains the visual representation to retain measured changes in end-effector pose and gripper state. An exponential moving average of the observation encoder supplies Effect targets. A shared generation expert learns to jointly predict Effect and an executable action chunk through flow matching, and reuses the sampled pair to generate future video on demand. This allows the controller to execute actions without waiting for video synthesis. We train on more than 20,000 hours of heterogeneous embodied data, excluding unused chain-of-thought data, and accommodate dataset-specific joint, end-effector, and hand-pose representations. Our evaluation uses the Small (8B) configuration on all five benchmarks and additionally evaluates the Large (26B) configuration on RoboDojo. Experiments examine closed-loop manipulation across complementary benchmarks, and comparisons across multiple baseline policies show consistent improvements from Action Grounding.

AI.tldr: EffectWAM 是一种世界-动作模型，通过 Effect 表征、相机位姿编码 CaPE 与动作接地三项设计，将视觉预测与可执行机器人控制连接起来，并支持不依赖视频生成即可执行动作。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型需要把视觉预测与可执行控制真正打通，但现有做法存在视觉变化表征不明确、相机位姿条件化不统一、视觉表征缺乏动作语义等缺口。
AI.method: 提出三个互补组件：(1) Effect——以独立编码的未来观测与共享当前观测锚点之差表示视觉变化，目标由观测编码器的指数移动平均（EMA）提供；(2) CaPE——在可靠外参可用时基于相对相机位姿对端点池化进行条件化，并与无位姿池化共享同一组学习参数，以适配未标定轨迹；(3) Action Grounding——训练视觉表征保留末端执行器位姿与夹爪状态的实测变化。共享生成专家通过 flow matching 联合预测 Effect 与可执行动作块，并按需复用采样对生成未来视频。训练数据为 20,000 小时以上异构具身数据（剔除未使用的思维链数据），兼容数据集特有的关节、末端执行器与手部位姿表示。
AI.result: 在全部五个基准上使用 Small（8B）配置评估，并在 RoboDojo 上额外评估 Large（26B）配置；实验覆盖跨互补基准的闭环操作，与多种基线策略对比显示 Action Grounding 带来一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: EffectWAM 通过 Effect、CaPE 与 Action Grounding 的协同设计，实现了视觉预测与动作生成的统一建模，且控制器无需等待视频合成即可执行动作，验证了动作接地对策略性能的稳定增益。

title: A Fused Gaussian Process Bandit Framework for Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used to maximize expensive black-box functions when direct evaluation is costly. In many real-world applications, the high-fidelity objective can be approximated by a series of lower-fidelity models that provide partial but informative signals at substantially reduced cost. Multi-fidelity BO (MFBO) algorithms aim to strategically combine these information sources to achieve an optimal trade-off between accuracy and evaluation cost.
