However, existing MFBO methods often oversimplify the complex dependencies between fidelity levels or rely on heuristic acquisition functions that lack theoretical performance guarantees. To address these limitations, we introduce a new formulation of the MFBO problem as a fused Gaussian Process bandit and develop a corresponding Fused Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound (FGP-UCB) algorithm. Our approach accurately predicts the high-fidelity function by fusing multi-fidelity observations through an autoregressive Gaussian Process model and explicitly quantifies the uncertainty arising from parameter estimation across fidelity levels. The proposed method also provides theoretical simple-regret guarantees, overcoming a key limitation of existing MFBO algorithms that lack provable performance bounds. Effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated via both theoretical analysis and empirical studies.

AI.tldr: 本文将多保真贝叶斯优化（MFBO）建模为融合高斯过程赌博机问题，提出FGP-UCB算法，通过自回归GP融合多保真观测并显式量化跨保真度的参数估计不确定性，给出了简单遗憾理论保证，并在理论与实验上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 高保真目标函数评估代价高昂，但可由低成本的低保真模型近似提供部分信息。现有MFBO方法存在两类不足：一是对保真度层级间复杂依赖关系过度简化；二是依赖启发式采集函数，缺乏理论性能保证。
AI.method: 提出MFBO的新形式化：将其建模为融合高斯过程赌博机（fused GP bandit）问题；基于自回归高斯过程模型融合多保真观测以预测高保真函数，并显式量化跨保真度参数估计带来的不确定性；据此构造Fused Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound（FGP-UCB）算法进行采集决策。
AI.result: 给出了该算法的简单遗憾（simple regret）理论保证，弥补了现有MFBO算法缺乏可证明性能界的关键缺陷；通过理论分析与实证研究共同验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将MFBO统一到融合GP赌博机框架下，可在保持保真度间依赖建模精度的同时获得理论保障，FGP-UCB为多保真优化提供了一种兼具原则性与可证明性能的解决方案。

title: An XR-Based System for Enhanced Spatial Awareness in Mobile Robot Teleoperation
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Author accepted manuscript published in the 2026 IEEE/ASME International Conference on Advanced Intelligent Mechatronics (AIM)
summary: Teleoperation of mobile robots represents a critical capability for operations in hazardous environments, yet maintaining adequate situational awareness remains challenging without effective visualization and control interfaces. This work presents a multi-modal extended reality (XR) system for robot teleoperation and scene exploration that integrates immersive visual and haptic feedback modalities. To address motion sickness commonly induced by 360-degree camera feeds in head-mounted displays (HMDs), the system employs a fixed dual-camera configuration: a forward-facing camera for primary navigation and a rear-facing camera for enhanced situational awareness without operator discomfort. For navigation in confined or low-visibility conditions, a 16-channel Velodyne LiDAR generates real-time 2D occupancy grid maps, which are converted into vibrational haptic feedback on handheld controllers to provide intuitive, non-visual obstacle detection. User evaluation with 20 participants demonstrates that this haptic modality significantly reduces the cognitive load associated with obstacle avoidance during teleoperation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一套集沉浸式视觉与振动触觉反馈的XR多模态机器人遥操作系统，采用固定双摄像头方案规避360°视频引起的晕动症，并用16线LiDAR生成2D占据栅格图转化为手柄振动避障提示；20人用户实验表明触觉反馈显著降低避障认知负荷。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人遥操作在危险环境中至关重要，但缺乏有效的可视化与控制界面时难以维持足够的态势感知；同时HMD中360°摄像头画面常引发操作者晕动症，狭窄或低能见度环境下的避障也存在困难。
AI.method: 构建融合视觉与触觉的多模态XR遥操作与场景探索系统：以固定双摄像头配置替代360°视频流（前向相机用于主导航，后向相机提供态势感知）；使用16通道Velodyne LiDAR实时生成2D占据栅格地图，并映射为手持控制器的振动触觉反馈，实现非视觉的直观障碍检测。
AI.result: 20名参与者的用户评估显示，该触觉模态显著降低了遥操作过程中避障相关的认知负荷。
AI.conclusion: 双摄像头固定布局结合LiDAR驱动的振动触觉反馈，可在缓解晕动症的同时提升态势感知并减轻认知负担，为XR机器人遥操作提供了有效的多模态交互方案。

title: Beyond Rigid Hands: Deforming Skin into Contact-Consistent Hand Meshes
summary: Hands grasp objects with soft skin. A fingertip flattens against a mug, and a palm curves around a bottle. Yet hand-object datasets and estimators represent the hand as a rigid articulated mesh, which hovers above or penetrates the object where skin would press against it. Existing refiners keep the mesh rigid and adjust only the pose, trading pose accuracy for physical plausibility. We ask whether a rigid hand can instead touch the object as skin does while staying close to its original pose. We lift annotated or estimated rigid hands to contact-consistent meshes through an optimization that (i) slightly adjusts the joints and wrist to bring the fingers onto the object, (ii) deforms the skin so that penetrating regions settle onto the surface, and (iii) keeps this deformation consistent over time. Since deformation reaches only skin already near the object, we further train a lightweight head on the lifted annotations to predict where an estimated hand should touch and steer the deformation there. Unlike existing refiners, the lift more than doubles the skin lying on the object surface for three published estimators while barely changing the pose. Guidance from the learned head further improves grasp stability by closing contact gaps that the estimate leaves open. Existing hand-object datasets and estimators can thus adopt contact-consistent hands without changing the hand model or retraining the estimators.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"提升(lift)"方法，在不改变刚体手模型、不重训练估计器的前提下，将标注或估计的刚体手网格转化为与物体接触一致的网格：通过微调关节/手腕、使穿透皮肤贴合表面并保持时序一致，实现接触面积翻倍以上而姿态几乎不变。
AI.motivation: 手—物体数据集与估计器普遍将手表示为刚体铰接网格，忽略皮肤的柔软性，导致网格在接触处悬空或穿透物体。现有refiner保持网格刚性、仅调整姿态，以姿态精度换取物理合理性，两者难以兼顾。作者因此提出：能否让刚体手模型像皮肤一样真正接触物体，同时仍贴近原始姿态？
AI.method: 核心为接触一致性优化，含三项：(i) 轻微调整关节与手腕，使手指贴到物体上；(ii) 变形皮肤，让穿透区域沉降到物体表面；(iii) 在时间维度上约束变形一致性。由于变形只作用于已靠近物体的皮肤，作者进一步在提升后的标注上训练一个轻量头部(head)，用于预测估计手应当接触的位置，并引导变形朝该区域进行，从而闭合估计遗留的接触间隙。
AI.result: 在三个已发表的估计器上，该方法使贴合物体表面的皮肤面积提升一倍以上，而姿态变化极小；相比现有refiner避免了以姿态精度换物理合理性的权衡。学到的头部引导还能通过闭合估计留下的接触空隙，进一步提升抓握稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 刚体手模型可以被"提升"为接触一致的手，而无需更换手模型或重训练估计器；现有手—物体数据集与估计器均可直接采用该方案获得接触一致的软性手表示。

title: More Powerful, Less Verifiable? Mitigating Hard-to-Verify Hallucinations in MLLM's Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) strengthens model capabilities through feedback from humans and environments. However, emerging evidence suggests that reward optimization can produce outputs whose errors are harder for humans to detect. To address this issue, we construct ITHV (the Image-Text Hallucination Verifiability Dataset), comprising 2,728 visually grounded instances that distinguish between obvious hallucinations, which humans readily detect, and elusive hallucinations, which humans struggle to identify. We then propose DAPO-V, an extension of DAPO that maximizes correctness subject to a budget on verifiability-aware risk. Specifically, DAPO-V combines a verifiability-aware reward with adaptive dual control, where larger penalties are assigned to incorrect responses on questions with lower human verification accuracy. An adaptive multiplier further adjusts the penalty strength according to risk-budget violations. Across three MLLM base models, DAPO-V improves overall accuracy while substantially improving accuracy on elusive hallucination questions by 5.78--9.72 percentage points over accuracy-only DAPO. We further test DAPO-V with a blinded human study, which shows that hallucinations are more readily detected in DAPO-V than those of the base model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ITHV 数据集与 DAPO-V 方法，在可验证性风险预算约束下优化正确性，减少难以被人察觉的幻觉，并在三个 MLLM 上显著提升隐蔽幻觉问题的准确率，经人类盲评验证幻觉更易被发现。
AI.motivation: 强化学习（RL）通过人类与环境反馈增强模型能力，但已有证据表明奖励优化可能产生人类更难察觉的错误输出，即"隐蔽型幻觉"，使得模型表面正确率提升的同时可验证性下降。因此需要显式约束输出错误的可检测性。
AI.method: 1）构建 ITHV（Image-Text Hallucination Verifiability Dataset），含 2,728 个视觉接地实例，区分"明显幻觉"（人易识别）与"隐蔽幻觉"（人难识别）；2）提出 DAPO-V，在 DAPO 基础上引入可验证性感知奖励与自适应对偶控制：对人工验证准确率较低的问题上的错误回答施加更大惩罚，并用自适应乘子依据风险预算违反程度调节惩罚强度，从而在可验证性风险预算约束下最大化正确性。
AI.result: 在三个 MLLM 基座上，DAPO-V 相比仅优化准确率的 DAPO，整体准确率提升，且在隐蔽幻觉问题上的准确率提升 5.78–9.72 个百分点；盲评人类研究显示，DAPO-V 的幻觉比基座模型更易被检测到。
AI.conclusion: 将可验证性作为风险预算纳入 RL 奖励设计，可同时提升准确率与幻觉可检测性，缓解奖励优化导致错误隐蔽化的风险；ITHV 与 DAPO-V 为该问题提供了评测基准与可行方法。

title: PhysRF-WorldJEPA: Transforming Heterogeneous Large Language Models into Manifold-Decoupled Millimeter-Wave Radar World Models
summary: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving, all-weather physical scene understanding across darkness, smoke, and walls. However, standard instruction tuning treats continuous radar streams as static text-like tokens, causing near-random global radar-to-text retrieval and severe physical drift under sensor blackouts. Conversely, coupling pairwise contrastive losses (e.g., SigLIP) directly into the shared backbone improves retrieval but injects $O(B^2)$ repulsive gradients that fracture continuous coordinate manifolds ($R^2 < 0$). We present PhysRF-WorldJEPA, a manifold-decoupled Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) that separates continuous electromagnetic state prediction from cross-modal language alignment. An unattenuated 1.0x clock anchor and parallel dual-scale RF encoder feed a lean ~3% LoRA LLM trained with two-step state-space EMA-JEPA (Denoise -> Rollout) and sample-axis Batch-VICReg to predict +3.0 s physical states; a stop-gradient alignment head then maps frozen prompt states onto the text hypersphere with false-negative masking. On a 4,541-window tri-domain suite (77/60.25/60 GHz) against 10 baselines, freezing the physical backbone and training only the decoupled head lifts R->T R@10 from 5.95% to 15.01% and improves MedRank from 107.0 to 60.0 while preserving identical physical readout: 3.37 deg ($R^2=+0.961$) blackout +3.0 s torso tilt, 1.89 m ($R^2=+0.679$; 1.19 m/+0.863 at the RF front-end) cluttered UAV altitude, 2.04 m ($R^2=+0.461$) behind-wall NLOS range, 0.9976 virtual-RIS invariance, and 100% fall recall. Across five 0.5B-1.8B LLM families (15 zero-overhead models), World-JEPA improves retrieval and 75%-drop completion in 10/10 runs and blackout tilt in 4/5 (Span-Euc), 2/5 (Scatter), and 5/5 (per-family best) over SFT.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhysRF-WorldJEPA：将连续电磁物理状态预测与跨模态语言对齐解耦的联合嵌入预测架构，在冻结物理主干、仅训练对齐头的情况下，将雷达→文本 R@10 从 5.95% 提升至 15.01%（MedRank 107.0→60.0），同时物理读数（黑障倾角、无人机高度、穿墙距离等）完全保持不变。
AI.motivation: 将 LLM 适配到毫米波雷达可实现隐私保护、全天候的物理场景理解，但存在两个问题：（1）标准指令微调把连续雷达流当作静态类文本 token，导致全局雷达-文本检索接近随机，且传感器黑障下出现严重物理漂移；（2）把 SigLIP 类成对对比损失直接耦合进共享主干虽能改善检索，却注入 O(B²) 的排斥梯度，撕裂连续坐标流形（R²<0）。因此需要一种将“连续电磁状态预测”与“跨模态语义对齐”分离的架构。
AI.method: 提出流形解耦的 JEPA 架构：1）无衰减 1.0x 时钟锚 + 并行双尺度 RF 编码器，馈入约 3% LoRA 的轻量 LLM；2）采用两步状态空间 EMA-JEPA（Denoise → Rollout）与沿样本轴的 Batch-VICReg，预测 +3.0 s 后的物理状态；3）使用带停止梯度的对齐头，将冻结的 prompt 状态映射到文本超球面，并施加假阴性掩码。实验在 4,541 窗口、三频段（77/60.25/60 GHz）数据集上与 10 个基线对比。
AI.result: 冻结物理主干、仅训练解耦对齐头后，R→T R@10 由 5.95% 升至 15.01%，MedRank 由 107.0 降至 60.0，且物理读出指标不变：黑障 +3.0 s 躯干倾角 3.37°（R²=+0.961）、杂乱场景无人机高度 1.89 m（R²=+0.679；RF 前端 1.19 m/+0.863）、穿墙 NLOS 距离 2.04 m（R²=+0.461）、虚拟 RIS 不变性 0.9976、跌倒召回 100%。在 5 个 0.5B–1.8B LLM 家族（15 个零开销模型）中，相比 SFT，检索与 75% 丢帧补全在 10/10 次运行中改善，黑障倾角分别在 4/5（Span-Euc）、2/5（Scatter）及 5/5（各家族最优）设置下改善。
AI.conclusion: 将物理状态预测与语言对齐在流形层面解耦，可在不牺牲（甚至完全保持）雷达物理读数精度的前提下显著提升检索与鲁棒性，并具备跨模型家族的泛化性；对比式对齐梯度对连续坐标流形的破坏是雷达-LLM 适配的关键瓶颈。

title: RoboRecast: Intent-Preserving Demonstration Augmentation via Diagnosis-Driven Optimization
comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material. Corresponding author: Ruizhen Hu
summary: Collecting diverse real-world manipulation demonstrations is costly, motivating the use of simulation to augment existing demonstrations for robot policy learning. When objects, layouts, or robots change, transferring motions from a source demonstration can produce behavior that is semantically implausible or physically infeasible in the new setting. We introduce RoboRecast, an agentic optimization framework that preserves the interactions required by the source task while jointly optimizing the simulated scene and robot motion to make those interactions executable in the target setting. When an interaction fails, the agent uses simulation feedback to diagnose the cause, revise the relevant scene or motion parameters, and test whether the revision resolves the failure. This flexibility allows RoboRecast to generate synthetic data from both human and robot demonstrations and to adapt them to new layouts, objects, and robot embodiments. When target demonstrations are available, adding RoboRecast data improves policy success on both real-world single-arm and simulated bimanual tasks. Even without demonstrations in the target configuration, RoboRecast adapts source demonstrations to support policy learning with new objects or robot embodiments.

AI.tldr: RoboRecast：一种智能体式优化框架，通过仿真反馈迭代诊断并修正场景/运动参数，将源演示的交互迁移到新物体、新布局和新机器人本体，从而生成可用且物理可行的合成演示数据。
AI.motivation: 真实世界操作演示采集成本高，需借助仿真增强数据；但当物体、布局或机器人发生变化时，直接迁移源演示的运动会得到语义不合理或物理不可行的行为。
AI.method: 以源任务所需交互为约束，联合优化仿真场景与机器人运动。交互失败时，智能体利用仿真反馈诊断失败原因，修改相关场景或运动参数，并测试修正是否能消除失败，形成闭环迭代；支持从人类演示与机器人演示生成数据，并适配新布局、新物体与新本体。
AI.result: 在有目标演示时，加入 RoboRecast 数据可提升真实世界单臂任务与仿真双臂任务上的策略成功率；在没有目标配置演示时，也能将源演示适配用于新物体或新机器人本体的策略学习。
AI.conclusion: 以交互保持为核心、结合仿真反馈的智能体式场景-运动联合优化，可实现低成本、可扩展的演示数据增强与跨场景、跨本体策略学习。

title: VLG-Drive: Unifying Vision-Language and Geometric Priors for Autonomous Driving
summary: A driving planner needs both scene semantics, which vision-language models (VLMs) provide, and spatial structure, which geometric foundation models recover from visual history. We present VLG-Drive, which keeps both models frozen and trains only a fusion interface and a planner from trajectory labels. At each camera-grid cell, the interface fuses the paired VLM and geometry features into one joint token through a geometry-anchored residual, and a command-conditioned planner reads these tokens to predict the ego trajectory. VLG-Drive achieves 31.78 EPDMS on NavHard under perturbed initial states, the highest among the compared methods, and 88.27 PDMS on NavTest from cameras alone. Pointwise fusion outperforms independent VLM and geometry streams on both benchmarks. In closed-loop driving on 420 HUGSIM scenarios, VLG-Drive outperforms all compared planners. These results indicate that a lightweight planner trained on fused features of frozen vision-language and geometric foundation models is an effective alternative to adapting either model for planning.

AI.tldr: VLG-Drive 通过冻结 VLM 与几何基础模型、仅训练融合接口与规划器，实现语义与空间结构的联合利用，在 NavHard、NavTest 与 HUGSIM 闭环驾驶中均优于对比方法。
AI.motivation: 驾驶规划器既需要 VLM 提供的场景语义，也需要几何基础模型从视觉历史恢复的空间结构；已有做法通常微调其中某一类模型，成本高且可能破坏预训练能力。
AI.method: 保持 VLM 与几何基础模型完全冻结，仅用轨迹标签训练融合接口和规划器：在每个相机网格单元上，通过“几何锚定的残差”将配对的 VLM 特征与几何特征融合为联合 token，再由命令条件化的规划器读取这些 token 预测自车轨迹。
AI.result: 扰动初始状态下的 NavHard 上 EPDMS 达 31.78（对比方法中最高）；仅用相机输入的 NavTest 上 PDMS 达 88.27；逐点融合在两个基准上均优于独立的 VLM 流与几何流；420 个 HUGSIM 场景闭环测试中优于所有对比规划器。
AI.conclusion: 在冻结的视觉语言与几何基础模型融合特征上训练轻量规划器，是替代对任一模型进行规划适配的有效方案。

title: ExpGuard: Guarding Long-Horizon LLM Agents against Corrupted Experience
summary: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents distill past trajectories into reusable experiences. Misleading or adversarial guidance in source trajectories can corrupt these experiences, allowing harmful instructions to persist across tasks and influence future agent actions. Assessing the risks of potentially corrupted experiences poses three challenges: (1) modeling provenance and execution dependencies before experience reuse, (2) learning task-conditioned risk from trajectory outcomes, and (3) repairing risky experiences at online inference. To address these challenges, we present ExpGuard, a framework for retrieval-triggered experience risk assessment and online repair. Specifically, to tackle challenge (1), ExpGuard integrates experience semantics with provenance and execution dependencies in a task-conditioned heterogeneous graph to predict attack and task-failure risks before experience reuse. To enable task-conditioned risk supervision and tackle challenge (2), we conduct matched counterfactual replays of each original experience and its minimally neutralized counterpart from the same task and environment checkpoint, deriving separate risk labels from differences in attack success and legitimate task completion. To tackle challenge (3) at inference time, ExpGuard repairs candidate experiences flagged as high-risk by the graph-based predictor at retrieval and re-predicts their risks before they enter the agent's active experience context. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpGuard in identifying risky experiences and defending agents against experience corruption.

AI.tldr: 提出 ExpGuard 框架，用于检索触发的经验风险评估与在线修复，防止长程 LLM 智能体因被污染的可复用经验而受到误导。
AI.motivation: 长程 LLM 智能体会将历史轨迹蒸馏为可复用经验，但源轨迹中的误导或对抗性引导会污染这些经验，使有害指令跨任务持续存在并影响后续行为。评估此类风险面临三点挑战：(1) 在经验复用前建模来源与执行依赖；(2) 从轨迹结果中学习任务条件下的风险；(3) 在在线推理阶段修复高风险经验。
AI.method: ExpGuard 将经验语义与来源信息、执行依赖整合进任务条件的异质图，在经验复用前预测攻击风险与任务失败风险；通过配对反事实重放——对原始经验与其最小中性化版本在同一任务和环境检查点下分别重放，依据攻击成功与合法任务完成度差异导出独立风险标签，实现任务条件下的风险监督；推理阶段对被图预测器标记为高风险的候选经验在检索时进行修复，并在其进入智能体活跃经验上下文之前重新预测风险。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ExpGuard 能有效识别高风险经验，并防御智能体遭受经验污染攻击。
AI.conclusion: ExpGuard 通过异质图风险预测、反事实重放监督与在线修复三者结合，构建了针对经验污染的端到端防护机制，验证了在智能体经验复用流程中前置风险识别与修复的可行性与有效性。

title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Classifier Chains
summary: Multi-label classification continues to be relevant to a variety of modern tasks. Among other challenges, modern data sets are increasingly large with respect to the number of labels, and these labels may be noisy or missing in the training sets. Label-wise scores and ranking-based metrics have been popular, but optimising exact multi-label evaluation (where a predicted set of labels should match the true set exactly) is particularly relevant for many domains, e.g., in medicine; alongside some measure of confidence. This requires an estimation of joint probability across labels (a model of label dependence; conditioned on each input instance). A family of methods known as probabilistic classifier chains provides such inference. However, these existing varieties either do not scale to a large number of labels or do so by approximating joint via marginal distributions in a way that compromises the estimation of uncertainty for exact match accuracy. We overcome this issue by proposing TSCC; leveraging a Monte Carlo Tree Search methodology to enhance chain inference via an efficient balance between the exploration of label space and the exploration of promising label-set predictions. Results are promising both in terms of predictive and computational performance.

AI.tldr: 提出TSCC：用蒙特卡洛树搜索改进概率分类器链的推理，在标签空间探索与高质量标签集预测之间取得平衡，从而更准确地估计联合概率（面向精确匹配与置信度），兼顾预测与计算性能。
AI.motivation: 现代多标签数据集标签数量庞大，且训练标签可能存在噪声或缺失；许多领域（如医学）需要"精确匹配"式评估并附带置信度，这要求对每个输入实例估计标签间的联合概率（标签依赖模型）。已有的概率分类器链方法要么难以扩展到大量标签，要么用边缘分布近似联合分布，损害了精确匹配精度下不确定性估计的可靠性。
AI.method: 将蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）引入分类器链推理：把标签序列的逐级条件预测视为搜索树，通过探索（大范围标签空间）与利用（有希望的标签集预测）之间的高效平衡，实现可扩展的链式联合推断。
AI.result: 在预测性能与计算性能两方面均取得有前景的结果。
AI.conclusion: TSCC 通过 MCTS 增强的链式推理，在大规模标签场景下更可靠地估计联合概率与不确定性，克服了现有概率分类器链在可扩展性与近似精度上的局限。

title: ReFocus: Progress-Guided Adaptive Practice for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation Reinforcement Learning
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) enables vision-language-action policies to improve through environmental interaction. However, in long-horizon manipulation, sparse success/failure feedback provides little information about where policies encounter bottlenecks. Moreover, repeated full-task rollouts also leave these bottlenecks weakly analyzed and insufficiently practiced. To this end, we introduce ReFocus, a progress-guided multi-round RL framework that alternates between Global and Local RL to identify task-specific bottlenecks and allocate additional practice to them. Specifically, during Global RL, we decompose each task into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of subtasks. Then a DAG-based Progress Reward is leveraged for both policy training and bottleneck diagnosis. Based on the identified bottlenecks, ReFocus selects Adaptive Practice Windows, defining task segments from an entry stage to a target stage. It allocates additional interaction to these segments during Local RL while updating the entire policy. After that, it evaluates the policy to perform the full task for the next round of RL, forming an iteration between Global and Local RL. Experiments on LIBERO-Long and RoboCasa365 show that ReFocus achieves success rates of 97.8% and 51.3%, respectively, compared with 90.6% and 39.3% for the $π_{0.5}$ baseline. Furthermore, we evaluate a real-world adaptation on three long-horizon tasks. On BreadBaker, ReFocus achieves 95% success, compared with 30% for the $π_{0.5}$. Project page: https://refocus-robotics.github.io.

AI.tldr: ReFocus：一种进度引导的多轮在线强化学习框架，通过 Global RL 与 Local RL 交替迭代，识别长程操作任务的瓶颈并对其进行针对性强化练习。
AI.motivation: 在线 RL 能让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过环境交互持续改进，但在长程操作任务中，稀疏的成功/失败反馈几乎无法说明策略究竟卡在哪个环节；同时，反复执行完整任务 rollout 也使瓶颈区域分析不足、练习不够，训练效率低下。
AI.method: 提出进度引导的多轮 RL 框架：(1) Global RL 阶段将任务分解为子任务的有向无环图（DAG），并基于 DAG 设计 Progress Reward，同时用于策略训练与瓶颈诊断；(2) 依据诊断出的瓶颈选择"自适应练习窗口"（Adaptive Practice Windows），即从入口阶段到目标阶段的任务片段；(3) Local RL 阶段对该片段分配额外交互预算，同时更新整体策略；(4) 随后在完整任务上评估策略，进入下一轮 Global RL，形成 Global–Local 交替迭代。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-Long 与 RoboCasa365 上成功率分别为 97.8% 与 51.3%，相比 π_{0.5} 基线的 90.6% 与 39.3% 显著提升；在三个真实世界长程任务上验证迁移能力，其中 BreadBaker 任务成功率达 95%，基线仅 30%。
AI.conclusion: 以子任务 DAG 进度奖励驱动瓶颈诊断，并将交互预算集中分配到瓶颈片段的 Global–Local 交替 RL，可有效缓解长程操作中稀疏反馈与全任务 rollout 低效的问题，在仿真与真实场景均取得明显性能提升。

title: TACTUS: Unifying Surgical Action Understanding in Time and Space
comment: 32 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary material. Lurui Wang and Hao Ding contributed equally. Mathias Unberath is the corresponding author. Project page: https://ruifreddie.github.io/TACTUS/
summary: Advancing surgical automation requires a comprehensive spatio-temporal understanding of how instruments act on tissue throughout an action. Existing surgical benchmarks, however, largely define supervision through task-specific targets, leaving the relationships between action semantics, instrument motion, and tissue interaction incompletely specified. To address this limitation, we introduce TACTUS (Tool, Action, Contact and Trajectory Understanding in Surgery), a new dataset and benchmark that establishes a unified annotation framework for complete surgical actions. The framework jointly specifies tool and action identities, nested action and interaction windows, instrument-specific landmark trajectories, and tissue-region tracks. To construct these annotations at scale, we develop a two-tier pipeline combining human annotation, point tracking, and model-generated spatial prompts. Using this pipeline, we re-annotate 141 videos from five public sources, producing 22,995 action clips spanning 2.9 million frames. The dataset comprises 15,668 Gold clips with human spatial prompts followed by review and re-checking, and 7,327 Silver clips combining human semantic and temporal annotations with model-generated spatial prompts. We further introduce TactusNet, the companion reference network, to benchmark semantic, temporal, and spatial prediction from shared video features. Across TactusNet and 13 published baselines, tool-action accuracy reaches 95.8% with per-head encoder fine-tuning, while the best temporal recall and contact Dice reach 46.6% at temporal IoU 0.7 and 0.351, respectively. Moreover, adding Silver improves the default TactusNet's pair accuracy from 93.8% to 95.5%. Together, these contributions establish a foundation for learning and evaluating the instrument-tissue interactions underlying future surgical automation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TACTUS 数据集与基准，用统一标注框架同时刻画手术动作语义、器械运动轨迹与组织交互，并给出伴随参考网络 TactusNet。
AI.motivation: 现有手术基准多以任务特定目标定义监督，未完整刻画动作语义、器械运动与组织交互之间的关系，难以支撑对器械-组织交互的时空理解与手术自动化。
AI.method: 构建统一标注框架，联合标注工具与动作身份、嵌套的动作与交互时间窗、器械相关关键点轨迹和组织区域轨迹；采用两层流水线（人工标注+点跟踪+模型生成空间提示）规模化生产标注；对来自五个公开来源的141段视频重新标注，共22,995个动作片段、290万帧，其中15,668个Gold片段（人工空间提示并复核）与7,327个Silver片段（人工语义与时序标注+模型空间提示）；并提出共享视频特征上联合预测语义、时序与空间的参考网络 TactusNet。
AI.result: 在 TactusNet 与13个已发表基线中，逐头编码器微调下工具-动作准确率达95.8%；时序IoU 0.7下最佳时序召回为46.6%，接触Dice最佳为0.351；加入Silver数据后默认TactusNet的pair准确率由93.8%提升至95.5%。
AI.conclusion: TACTUS 为学习和评测器械-组织交互提供了统一基础，同时表明语义识别已较成熟，而精确时序定位与接触分割仍是主要瓶颈。

title: From Memory Access to Evidence Sufficiency: Diagnosing and Addressing Demand--Evidence Misalignment
summary: Long-term memory retrieval often returns query-relevant records, but relevance does not guarantee sufficient evidence: answering requires a set of records that jointly satisfies a question's factual, relational, temporal, and state constraints. We study this demand--evidence misalignment through MemPath, an interventional framework that diagnoses failures in memory access, demand coverage, and evidence utilization. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose BiDE-Mem, which represents questions as typed demands and uses them to guide retrieval and evidence organization. We formalize demand--evidence support; in the evaluated compact path, it is conveyed through provenance-aware evidence organization and Reader guidance rather than a separate generative four-state verification step. On LoCoMo, BiDE-Mem improves accuracy by 6.23 percentage points over Mnemis; on LongMemEval, it achieves 91.80%, with strong multi-hop and temporal performance. Supplementary Qwen-Reader evaluations place it first among seven systems on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S under two judging protocols. Ablations and evidence-level analyses show that demand representation, retrieval, and evidence presentation each contribute to answer quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MemPath干预框架诊断长期记忆检索中的"证据错位"问题，并据此设计BiDE-Mem：将问题表示为类型化需求，指导检索与证据组织，在LoCoMo上较Mnemis提升6.23个百分点，在LongMemEval上达91.80%。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆检索虽能返回与查询相关的记录，但"相关"不等于"证据充分"。回答一个问题需要一组记录共同满足其事实、关系、时间与状态四类约束，检索结果与真实证据需求之间存在错位（evidence misalignment），而现有系统缺乏对该失配环节的细粒度诊断。
AI.method: 1) MemPath：干预式（interventional）诊断框架，将失败归因于记忆访问、需求覆盖、证据利用三个环节；2) BiDE-Mem：把问题解析为类型化需求（typed demands）引导检索与证据组织；3) 形式化定义"需求—证据支持"（demand–evidence support），在所评估的紧凑路径中通过溯源感知（provenance-aware）的证据组织与Reader引导来实现该支持，而非依赖独立的生成式四状态验证步骤。
AI.result: LoCoMo上准确率较Mnemis提升6.23个百分点；LongMemEval上达91.80%，多跳与时序任务表现突出；补充的Qwen-Reader评测中，在两种评判协议下于LoCoMo与LongMemEval-S均位列七个系统之首；消融与证据级分析显示，需求表示、检索与证据呈现三者各自贡献于回答质量。
AI.conclusion: 长期记忆问答的关键不只在于检索相关性，而在于需求驱动的证据覆盖与组织。以类型化需求为中心的BiDE-Mem在诊断框架指引下有效缓解证据错位，且需求表示、检索、证据呈现三环节均有独立增益。

title: Rethinking Reasoning Effort Training in Large Language Models: On-Policy Distillation or Reinforcement Learning?
summary: Large language models have shown strong capabilities on complex tasks, yet how to control their reasoning effort remains a significant challenge for practical deployment. This paper provides a systematic investigation of reasoning-effort training, contrasting reinforcement learning (RL) with on-policy distillation (OPD). We find that compressing reasoning and separating effort tiers are governed by different signals. Length-penalized RL reliably compresses a single policy, reducing thinking on AIME25 by 70\% without accuracy loss, but collapses the tiers when they are trained jointly. Multi-teacher OPD separates them: across 33 benchmarks, low and medium use 58\% and 43\% fewer thinking tokens than high, while high improves on the reference policy by 3.1 points. We trace this difference to the training signal. A sequence-level reward cannot tell tier-specific behavior from shared behavior, whereas OPD supplies a tier-specific target at every visited state, including the decision to stop. Building on this analysis, we show that a single token-level KL anchor on the high tier is sufficient to learn separated tiers within one RL stage, and that natural-language effort instructions make this separation emerge from the start of training, yielding a policy competitive with multi-teacher OPD at matched thinking length. Finally, the separation built by dense targets holds only on the states seen in training: it does not carry over to unseen agentic tasks, where effort acts mainly through the number of interaction turns, whereas the compression induced by sequence-level rewards does.

AI.tldr: 本文系统对比强化学习（RL）与在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在"推理努力（reasoning effort）"控制上的差异：序列级奖励擅长压缩单一策略的推理长度但无法维持分档，而稠密的分档目标（OPD/词元级KL锚）能实现推理努力分层，但该分层仅在训练见过的状态上成立。
AI.motivation: 大模型在复杂任务上能力很强，但如何在实际部署中控制其推理努力（思考长度）仍是难题；尤其"压缩推理"与"划分努力档位"两个目标如何用训练信号实现，缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 对比实验研究：(1) 长度惩罚RL（序列级奖励）用于单策略压缩与多档联合训练；(2) 多教师OPD，为每个档位提供状态级分档目标（含"停止"决策）；(3) 基于分析提出单档位词元级KL锚，在单一RL阶段内实现档位分离；(4) 进一步用自然语言努力指令引导分离从训练初期涌现。评测覆盖33个基准，并检验向未见智能体任务的泛化。
AI.result: 长度惩罚RL可将单策略在AIME25上的思考长度减少70%且无精度损失，但联合训练时档位坍塌；多教师OPD在33个基准上使低/中档分别比高档少用58%/43%思考词元，高档相对参考策略提升3.1分；单档词元级KL锚即可在单阶段RL中实现分档分离；努力指令使分离自训练开始即涌现，在匹配思考长度下与多教师OPD竞争力相当；稠密目标构建的分离不能迁移到未见智能体任务（该处努力主要体现为交互轮数），而序列级奖励带来的压缩可以迁移。
AI.conclusion: 压缩与分档由不同信号驱动：序列级奖励只约束整体长度、无法区分档位专属与共享行为，故联合训练导致档位坍塌，但其压缩效应可泛化到未见状态；分档需要每个访问状态上的档位特异目标（OPD或词元级KL锚、自然语言指令），然而这种分离局限于训练分布内的状态。实践上，单一RL阶段加词元级KL锚（配合努力指令）是高效可行的分档方案。

title: BARE: Body-Aware Reflexive Evasion for Humanoid Robots
summary: Dynamic obstacle avoidance is essential for safely deploying humanoid robots in real-world environments, where rapidly approaching objects require immediate evasive responses. Recent advances in reflexive evasion have focused primarily on quadrupeds, which typically rely on large-scale whole-body maneuvers. In contrast, humanoids can exploit their rich body articulation to evade through small, localized body adjustments. By moving threatened body regions without repositioning the entire body, these responses may require less execution time and less surrounding free space. However, local adjustments can alter mass distribution or support conditions, making it challenging to achieve rapid evasion while maintaining whole-body stability. To this end, we propose BARE (Body-Aware Reflexive Evasion), a humanoid reflexive evasion framework guided by human motion priors that enables rapid local evasion while maintaining whole-body stability. A risk-guided motion adapter is designed to select reference motions from a retargeted human evasive motion library based on the threatened body region and to adjust their temporal phases based on collision urgency, allowing the robot to reach evasive postures before potential contact. Conditioned on the adapted reference and link-level collision risk, a reflexive evasion policy learns through reinforcement learning to coordinate local body adjustments with whole-body stabilization. We validate BARE in simulation and real-world experiments, demonstrating its ability to perform targeted local evasion while maintaining whole-body stability.

AI.tldr: 提出 BARE 框架，利用人体运动先验引导人形机器人进行快速局部反射式避障，同时保持全身稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有反射式避险研究多集中于四足机器人，依赖大幅度全身机动。人形机器人可凭借丰富的身体关节做小幅局部调整来避险，执行时间更短、所需周围自由空间更少；但局部调整会改变质量分布与支撑条件，因此难以在快速避险的同时保持全身稳定。
AI.method: BARE 由两部分组成：(1) 风险引导运动适配器，根据受威胁身体区域从经重定向的人体避险动作库中选取参考动作，并按碰撞紧迫度调整其时间相位，使机器人能在潜在接触前达到避险姿态；(2) 以适配参考动作和连杆级碰撞风险为条件的反射式避险策略，通过强化学习协调局部身体调整与全身稳定。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界实验中验证了 BARE 能够执行有针对性的局部避险，并维持全身稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 借助人体运动先验与风险引导的动作适配，加上强化学习策略对局部避险与全身稳定的联合优化，人形机器人可实现快速、局部化且稳定的反射式避障。

title: SPAR: Self-Referenced World-Model Rewards for Physical Alignment in Video Generation
summary: Generating videos with physically plausible dynamics remains challenging despite advances in visual quality. Latent world models offer predictive signals for evaluating physical plausibility, but higher agreement between predicted and observed features may reflect easier-to-predict scene content rather than more plausible dynamics. We propose \textbf{S}elf-Referenced \textbf{P}hysical \textbf{A}lignment \textbf{R}ewards (\textbf{SPAR}), a framework that uses world-model predictions for inference-time physical alignment. SPAR compares each video's prediction error with that of static clips constructed by repeating its own frames, providing a content-matched reference for evaluating generated dynamics. To account for the uneven spatial and temporal distribution of physical interactions, we introduce a unified \textbf{spatiotemporal reward refinement} strategy. \textbf{Spatial refinement} emphasizes localized prediction discrepancies, while \textbf{temporal refinement} moderates brief error peaks and supplements prediction errors with agreement between predicted and observed feature changes. Evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SPAR improves the physical plausibility of both \textbf{text-to-video generation} and \textbf{image-to-video continuation}, bringing generated dynamics into closer alignment with the physical regularities governing real-world events. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/spar-page/

AI.tldr: 提出SPAR（自参考物理对齐奖励）框架，利用世界模型预测误差与"静态参考片段"（重复自身帧构成）对比，结合时空奖励精化，作为推理时奖励提升生成视频的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 生成视频视觉质量提升但物理动态仍不真实。已有潜世界模型可提供预测信号评估物理合理性，但"预测特征与观测特征越一致越好"存在偏置：一致性高可能仅说明场景内容易于预测，而非动态更符合物理规律，缺乏内容可比的参照基准。
AI.method: 1）自参考对齐：将每个生成视频的预测误差与其自身帧重复构成的静态片段预测误差作对比，形成内容匹配的参考基线，抵消内容可预测性差异；2）空间精化：强调局部化的预测差异区域；3）时间精化：抑制短暂误差尖峰，并补充预测特征变化量与观测特征变化量之间的一致性度量；4）整体作为推理时（inference-time）奖励引导生成。
AI.result: 在多个基准上评估，SPAR在文生视频与图生视频续写两类任务上均提升物理合理性，生成的动态更贴近真实世界事件的物理规律。
AI.conclusion: 以内容匹配的自参考基线替代绝对预测一致性，是评估并改进生成动态物理合理性的有效途径；配合时空奖励精化可广泛用于推理时对齐，无需重新训练生成模型。

title: CoverMem: Coverage-Constrained Visual Memory for Budgeted Embodied Question Answering
summary: Episodic-memory embodied question answering enables agents to answer questions based on previously recorded visual observations of the surrounding scenes. However, growing observation histories, varying observation quality across viewpoints, and limited computational resources make it challenging to construct and maintain compact visual memories while retrieving sufficient evidence for question answering. To address these challenges, we introduce CoverMem, which incorporates three key components: (1) a coverage-constrained memory construction method that selects a compact set of informative full frames satisfying object-quality and representative-scene coverage requirements; (2) a coverage-preserving incremental maintenance strategy that locally reselects only the affected frames to satisfy updated coverage requirements as observations arrive; and (3) a budgeted complementary frame selection method that balances question relevance, additional support for question requirements, and redundancy with selected frames within a fixed budget. Experimental results on three benchmarks covering diverse environments and question types demonstrate that CoverMem improves question-answering performance under limited visual budgets.

AI.tldr: CoverMem：以覆盖率约束构建与增量维护紧凑视觉记忆，并用预算化互补帧选择为具身问答检索证据，在有限视觉预算下提升 episodic-memory embodied QA 性能。
AI.motivation: 情景记忆具身问答需要基于历史视觉观测作答，但观测历史持续增长、不同视角下观测质量差异大、计算资源受限，使得"构建并维护紧凑视觉记忆"与"检索足够证据"之间存在矛盾。
AI.method: 提出 CoverMem，含三部分：(1) 覆盖约束的记忆构建，挑选满足物体质量与代表性场景覆盖要求的紧凑全帧集合；(2) 保覆盖的增量维护策略，新观测到来时仅对受影响帧做局部重选以满足更新后的覆盖需求；(3) 预算化互补帧选择，在固定预算内平衡问题相关性、对问题需求的额外支持与已选帧的冗余度。
AI.result: 在覆盖多种环境与问题类型的三项基准上，CoverMem 在有限视觉预算下提升问答性能。
AI.conclusion: 以覆盖率为核心约束统一记忆构建、增量维护与证据检索，可在受限预算下兼顾记忆紧凑性与证据充分性。

title: Calibrated Reading of Latent Reasoning and Communication
summary: Latent reasoning and key-value communication store intermediate information in continuous representations, limiting direct inspection of model behavior. Existing activation readers trade the low cost of task-specific probes against the flexibility of language-model decoders. We propose the Calibrated Latent Reader, CLR, a compact transformer that predicts reasoning outcomes and message content through task-conditioned interactions between states and candidate answers. Source adapters support transfer across models, while conformal calibration provides coverage and false-alarm guarantees under exchangeability. On two CODI models, CLR improves accuracy over MLP and attention probes by 4-18 percentage points for final-answer prediction and reference-value membership. On CODI-GPT-2, it achieves accuracy comparable to a 1.7B LatentQA-based verbalizer using 437-648 times fewer inference FLOPs. On synthetic Qwen3-4B communications, comparing decoded facts with public commitments detects 93.1% of message substitutions at a nominal 5% false-positive rate.

AI.tldr: 提出校准潜空间读取器（CLR）：一个紧凑的 Transformer，通过状态与候选答案的任务条件交互预测推理结果与消息内容，并提供一致性校准下的覆盖率与误警保证，以低推理成本取得优于探针、接近大模型语言解码器的读取性能。
AI.motivation: 潜空间推理与键值通信把中间信息存放在连续表示中，使模型行为难以直接检查。现有激活读取器存在两难：任务专用探针成本低但缺乏灵活性，语言模型解码器灵活但代价高，且缺少可靠性（覆盖/误警）保证。
AI.method: 构建 CLR——小型 Transformer 读取器，将内部状态与候选答案做任务条件化交互，用于预测最终答案与消息内容（如参考值成员判定）；引入源适配器实现跨模型迁移；采用一致性预测（conformal calibration）在可交换性假设下给出覆盖率与误警率保证。
AI.result: 在两个 CODI 模型上，CLR 相比 MLP 与注意力探针在最终答案预测和参考值成员判定上提升 4–18 个百分点；在 CODI-GPT-2 上，精度与基于 LatentQA 的 1.7B 语言化器相当，而推理 FLOPs 减少 437–648 倍；在合成 Qwen3-4B 通信中，将解码事实与公开承诺比对，在名义 5% 误报率下检测出 93.1% 的消息替换。
AI.conclusion: CLR 以紧凑结构与任务条件化读取在精度上超越传统探针，在成本上大幅优于大模型语言化器，并借助保形校准提供可量化的可靠性保障，为潜空间通信的可审计性提供了高效方案。

title: DexWAC: A Unified World-Actor-Critic Model for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot demonstrations provide more than actions to imitate: they reveal how actions change the world and how those changes contribute to task success. Recent world-action models (WAMs) extend vision-language-action (VLA) models with the first signal by jointly predicting actions and future observations, yet this predictive ability serves only as an auxiliary loss for policy learning. Meanwhile, most policy improvement methods learn dynamics and values in separate models, increasing training overhead and limiting representation sharing between these complementary objectives. We introduce DexWAC, a unified world-actor-critic model that jointly learns an actor, an action-conditioned world model, and a bootstrapped critic in a single robot pretraining stage. Our key insight is that visual prediction encourages control-relevant features, while value supervision promotes task-relevant representations; together, they shape a representation suited to policy learning. Built on an image-editing backbone, DexWAC predicts, for each action chunk, the visual latent and proprioception at its endpoint together with its reward and continuation, so the world model alone efficiently yields complete imagined transitions without generating intermediate video frames. After adapting the world model and critic on real rollouts, we improve the pretrained actor through either PPO on imagined rollouts or critic-guided best-of-$N$ selection. DexWAC surpasses the large-scale pretrained VLA and WAM baselines in simulation and achieves 75% average success on two real-world tasks, compared with 45% for $π_{0.5}$. Its world model is more accurate and faster than video-based baselines, and ablations confirm that learning dynamics and value together improves the policy.

AI.tldr: DexWAC将actor、动作条件世界模型与bootstrapped critic统一在单阶段机器人预训练中，以图像编辑骨干直接预测动作块终点的视觉潜变量、本体感受及奖励/终止，实现高效想象rollout，并用PPO或critic引导的best-of-N提升策略。
AI.motivation: 现有WAM仅把未来观测预测当作策略学习的辅助损失，世界模型能力未被充分利用；且主流策略改进方法将动力学与价值学习分离到不同模型，训练开销大、表征共享不足。
AI.method: 提出统一world-actor-critic模型DexWAC，在单次预训练中联合学习actor、动作条件世界模型与bootstrap critic。基于图像编辑骨干，对每个动作块预测其终点的视觉潜变量和本体感受，以及奖励与继续概率，从而无需生成中间视频帧即可获得完整想象转移。在真实rollout上适配世界模型与critic后，通过想象rollout上的PPO或critic引导的best-of-N选择改进预训练actor。
AI.result: 在仿真中超过大规模预训练的VLA与WAM基线；两个真实任务上平均成功率75%，而π_{0.5}为45%；世界模型比基于视频的基线更准确且更快；消融实验证实联合学习动力学与价值可提升策略。
AI.conclusion: 视觉预测促成控制相关特征，价值监督促成任务相关表征，二者共同塑造利于策略学习的表征；将动力学与价值学习统一，可在降低开销的同时有效改进真实机器人策略。

title: Visual Thinking: Training-Free Active Perception for Counting and Localizing Hard-to-Find Objects
summary: Vision foundation models can precisely segment objects based solely on a text prompt. However, they struggle to recover objects that are small, occluded or whose appearance is poorly captured by the original textual description. Vision language models can examine the image and its context, they can propose richer descriptions of the objects to be detected. But these models struggle with precise segmentation and localization. We introduce Visual Thinking, a training-free framework that combines a vision-language model with Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) through an iterative active perception loop. At each iteration, the VLM proposes short noun phrases using the image, candidate crops and history from past iterations. A controller ranks these phrases using embedding similarity between the original prompt and the proposal, an entropy-based verification priority and the novelty of the prompt. Next, SAM 3 uses prompts to detect objects in the image. We associate detections across iterations and update each object's confidence score using a weighted mean of scores obtained from SAM 3 with a larger weight for detections using narrower prompts. We supply confident detections as positive visual exemplars for SAM 3, and incorporate image tiling to recover small objects in cluttered images. We evaluate counting and localization on CARPK, FSCD-147, PixMo-Count, and OmniCount (Fruits). Compared with SAM 3, Visual Thinking reduces the counting mean absolute error (MAE) by about 18 on FSC-147 and about 8 on CARPK. It improves box average precision (AP) by more than 12 on FSCD-147 and CARPK. Visual Thinking, with fixed or no tiling, performs on par with Claude Opus 5.5 at extra-high reasoning effort, while running on single desktop GPU in about 5.91 seconds per image, compared to about 46.53 seconds per image for Claude through its API.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 Visual Thinking 框架，通过 VLM 与 SAM 3 的迭代主动感知闭环，提升小目标/遮挡目标的分割、计数与定位精度。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型可仅凭文本提示精确分割，但对小目标、遮挡目标或原始文本描述不充分的目标召回差；VLM 能生成更丰富的描述却缺乏精确分割与定位能力。二者能力互补。
AI.method: 免训练框架：每轮迭代中 VLM 依据图像、候选裁剪与历史提出简短名词短语；控制器按嵌入相似度、基于熵的验证优先级与新颖性排序；SAM 3 依提示检测；跨轮关联检测并用加权均值更新置信度（越窄的提示权重越大）；将高置信检测作为正例视觉示例回馈 SAM 3，并结合图像切块恢复密集场景中的小目标。
AI.result: 在 CARPK、FSCD-147、PixMo-Count、OmniCount(Fruits) 上评估计数与定位。相比 SAM 3，在 FSC-147 计数 MAE 降低约 18、CARPK 约 8；FSCD-147 与 CARPK 的 box AP 提升超过 12。固定切块或无切块设置下与 Claude（额外高推理强度）持平，单卡桌面 GPU 约 5.91 秒/图，而 Claude API 约 46.53 秒/图。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 的语义描述能力与 SAM 3 的分割定位能力通过主动感知循环耦合，可在无需训练的情况下显著提升开放词汇计数与定位性能，并在效率上远优于大模型 API 方案。

title: Breaking the Binary-Lifting Barrier for DNA Minimizer Density: Exact Optimization of a Native 4-ary Order at (w, k) = (12, 5)
comment: 5 pages, 1 table; includes 7 ancillary files in anc/ (explicit 1,024-entry 4-ary minimizer rank tables in .gm and .csv formats, standalone Python 3 standard-library exact verifier, and cold-start C99 optimizer sources)
summary: Minimizer schemes sample at least one $k$-mer from every window of $w$ consecutive $k$-mers via a total order $π$ on $Σ^k$. For DNA ($σ= 4$), state-of-the-art lookup schemes such as GreedyMini and OptMini optimize a binary order ($2^k$ ranks) and lift it to $Σ^k$ by ranking one bit-plane primarily and breaking $2^k$-way ties lexicographically on the other bit-plane. At $(w, k) = (12, 5)$, this projection locks sets of $32$ DNA $5$-mers into contiguous blocks and restricts the active universal hitting set (UHS) prefix to $448$ of $1024$ $5$-mers, giving exact expected DNA density $2246214544 / 2^{34} \approx 0.1307468945$ for OptMini (k5-w12-13.txt) and $2248978620 / 2^{34} \approx 0.1309077849$ for GreedyMini (w12_k5.gm). We bypass binary lifting and optimize directly over native $4$-ary permutations ($|Σ^k| = 1024$) from scratch via: (i) an exact de Bruijn endpoint transfer-matrix dynamic program over $B(4, 4)$ ($256$ states), (ii) a weighted set-cover ratio initializer (SetCover4) producing a compact $U = 314$ UHS prefix, (iii) bitmask-sparse simulated annealing preserving the zero-cost $w$-walk-free tail invariant, and (iv) two-pass $O(N)$ exact best-insertion sweeps with large-neighborhood ruin-and-recreate search. The resulting explicit $4$-ary order achieves exact expected DNA density $2234289615 / 2^{34} \approx 0.130052772292$ (density factor $1.690686$), cutting charged windows by $11924929$ contexts ($-0.530890\%$ relative) below OrensteinLab/Minimizers and $14689005$ ($-0.653141\%$) below w12_k5.gm at $8200$-byte lookup storage ($1280$ bytes bit-packed). Warm-start relaxation stalls at $U = 379$ ($0.1301728789$), whereas native $4$-ary initialization breaks $32/32$ high-bit blocks across all $2+2$ nucleotide partitions.

AI.tldr: 该文绕过"二进制序提升到4-ary序"的投影瓶颈，直接在DNA 5-mer的1024个原生4-ary排列上从头优化minimizer序，在(w,k)=(12,5)上取得精确期望密度0.130052772292（密度因子1.690686），显著优于OptMini、GreedyMini及OrensteinLab/Minimizers。
AI.motivation: 现有SOTA查表式minimizer方案（GreedyMini、OptMini）先优化2^k个秩的二进制序，再通过"主位平面排序+另一位平面字典序破平"提升到Σ^k。该投影在(w,k)=(12,5)时把32个DNA 5-mer锁进连续块，将活跃UHS前缀限制在448/1024，造成结构性次优，故需直接优化原生4-ary排列以释放排序自由度。
AI.method: 方法包含四部分：(i) 在B(4,4)（256状态）上的精确de Bruijn端点转移矩阵DP，用于精确评估期望密度；(ii) 加权集合覆盖比初始化器SetCover4，生成紧凑的U=314 UHS前缀；(iii) 位掩码稀疏模拟退火，保持"零代价w-walk-free尾部"不变式；(iv) 两趟O(N)精确最佳插入扫描，配合大邻域ruin-and-recreate搜索。
AI.result: 显式4-ary序达到精确期望DNA密度2234289615/2^34≈0.130052772292（密度因子1.690686），在8200字节查表存储（1280字节位压缩）下，计入窗口数比OrensteinLab/Minimizers少11924929个上下文（相对-0.530890%），比w12_k5.gm少14689005个（-0.653141%）。热启动松弛停在U=379（0.1301728789），而原生4-ary初始化在全部2+2核苷酸划分上打破了32/32个高位块。
AI.conclusion: 原生4-ary直接优化优于二进制提升投影：不仅打破投影诱导的32-mer块锁定、将活跃UHS前缀从448缩至314个5-mer，还获得更低的精确期望密度。热启动与从头初始化对比说明搜索需从原生空间出发才能跨越投影造成的局部最优。

title: RetraQ: Manifold-Constrained Critic Guidance for Flow Policies in RL
summary: A learned critic can improve a pretrained flow-matching policy by steering sampled actions toward higher predicted value. However, even a critic that fits the behavior data well can provide misleading action gradients. Gradient components pointing away from the data-supported region are weakly constrained by behavior data and can lead guidance to exploit critic extrapolation errors. We introduce RetraQ (Retraction-based Q-guidance), which uses geometry encoded by the pretrained flow to constrain both the direction and the destination of critic guidance. A single velocity evaluation of the frozen flow defines a denoising map. RetraQ filters the critic gradient with the map's Jacobian and applies the map itself to correct the updated action. Our analysis characterizes when these operations approximate tangent filtering and retraction onto the behavior manifold. The same update guides actions at test time and provides targets for policy distillation and online reinforcement learning. In controlled studies, RetraQ improves true return while keeping refined actions close to the data-supported region, and its distillation targets remain more stable than those of raw critic ascent. In offline-to-online training on LIBERO and OGBench, RetraQ achieves higher mean final success than the evaluated critic-guidance baselines. On a real-world plug-insertion task, test-time RetraQ improves the success rate of a behavior-cloned $π_{0.5}$ policy from 55.0% to 76.7%. Online training further increases success to 98.3% in only 30 minutes and 100% within one hour. Project page: https://2027ICLR.github.io/retraq/

AI.tldr: RetraQ 利用预训练 flow 的几何结构（去噪映射的 Jacobian 与映射本身）对 critic 梯度做切向过滤与回缩校正，使 Q-guidance 方向与落点都贴近数据支撑区域，在离线到在线 RL 及真实机器人插接任务上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 学习到的 critic 即便对行为数据拟合良好，其动作梯度仍可能误导：指向数据支撑区域之外的梯度分量受数据约束弱，会被用于利用 critic 的外推误差（OOD 动作处价值高估），导致策略被引导至不可靠区域。
AI.method: 以冻结预训练 flow 的单次速度评估定义一个去噪映射。RetraQ 用该映射的 Jacobian 过滤 critic 梯度（近似切向过滤），再将映射本身作用于更新后的动作（近似回缩到行为流形）。同一更新既用于测试时引导动作，也用于生成策略蒸馏目标与在线强化学习目标。文中给出该操作近似切向过滤与行为流形回缩的分析。
AI.result: 受控实验中，RetraQ 提升真实回报，同时使精炼动作保持在数据支撑区域附近，其蒸馏目标比原始 critic 上升更稳定。LIBERO 与 OGBench 的离线到在线训练中，平均最终成功率高于所对比的 critic-guidance 基线。真实插接任务中，测试时 RetraQ 将行为克隆 π0.5 策略成功率由 55.0% 提升至 76.7%；在线训练 30 分钟达 98.3%，1 小时内达 100%。
AI.conclusion: 以预训练 flow 的几何约束 critic 引导的方向与终点，是缓解 critic 外推误差、实现稳定 Q-guidance 的有效途径，且同一更新形式可统一支撑测试时引导、蒸馏与在线 RL，并在仿真与真实任务上验证有效。

title: DiffGR00T: Execution-Aware Differentiable Training for Humanoid Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Conference preprint. Corresponding author: Hesheng Wang
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong results in arm-centric manipulation, yet humanoid whole-body control (WBC) requires dynamic balance and tightly coupled full-body coordination. Existing hierarchical humanoid VLAs typically decouple motion generation from physical execution, leaving tracking and balance errors unable to directly optimize the VLA generator. We propose DiffGR00T, an end-to-end differentiable training framework that couples GR00T N1.7 with SONIC, a pretrained whole-body behavior foundation model. To enable execution-aware differentiable training, we replace the non-differentiable simulator with a learned, action-conditioned world model, allowing multi-step body-execution losses to backpropagate through the frozen whole-body controller and the flow-matching sampler directly into the VLA action head. On four HumanoidArena simulation tasks, DiffGR00T improves average task success by 12.5 percentage points over the supervised base VLA (59.2% to 71.7%), demonstrating that execution-aware gradients effectively align high-level motion generation with closed-loop whole-body dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端可微训练框架DiffGR00T，用可学习世界模型替代不可微仿真器，使执行层损失可回传到VLA动作头，在HumanoidArena四项任务上平均成功率由59.2%提升至71.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有分层人形VLA将高层动作生成与底层物理执行解耦，跟踪误差与平衡误差无法直接优化VLA生成器，导致生成的高层动作与全身动力学不匹配。
AI.method: 将GR00T N1.7与预训练全身行为基础模型SONIC耦合成端到端可微框架；以动作条件化的学习型世界模型替代不可微仿真器，使多步身体执行损失可穿过冻结的全身控制器与流匹配采样器，直接反传至VLA动作头。
AI.result: 在四个HumanoidArena仿真任务上，平均任务成功率相对监督基线VLA提升12.5个百分点（59.2%→71.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 执行感知梯度可有效对齐高层运动生成与闭环全身动力学，验证了可微耦合训练在人形全身控制VLA中的有效性。

title: CodeHOI: Code with Agents for Physically Plausible 4D Hand-Object Interaction
summary: Modeling 4D hand-object interaction (HOI) is fundamental to understanding manipulation. This requires physics, since hands move objects only by touch and each material responds differently. Yet existing methods ignore this physics or simulate only a narrow range of matter. Programs can instead describe any matter with its physics, but coding agents omit the hand that drives the interaction. We close this gap with CodeHOI, to our knowledge the first agentic framework that writes physically plausible 4D HOI as programs. To write one, an Object Agent first builds each object with the physics of its matter. An HOI Agent then specifies the hands by their contacts and simulates each kind of matter with an established physics solver. Finally, an Evaluator Agent checks each result against physical laws. We also introduce CodeHOI-Bench with 100 reconstruction and generation tasks across four kinds of matter. With off-the-shelf frontier models, CodeHOI writes interactions that are plausible for every kind of matter and remain so when transferred to an independent physics engine. It thereby enables coding agents to write physically plausible HOI across diverse matter.

AI.tldr: 提出 CodeHOI——首个以程序形式编写物理合理 4D 手物交互（HOI）的智能体框架，由 Object Agent、HOI Agent、Evaluator Agent 三段式协作构成，并发布涵盖四类物质的 CodeHOI-Bench（100 个重建与生成任务）。
AI.motivation: 理解操作行为需要建模 4D 手物交互，而手只能通过接触移动物体、且不同材质响应各异，因此物理是必需的。现有方法要么忽略物理，要么只仿真很窄的一类物质；而程序化物理仿真虽能描述任意物质，现有编码智能体却把驱动交互的"手"排除在外。
AI.method: CodeHOI 采用多智能体流水线：Object Agent 依据物质物理属性构建每个物体；HOI Agent 以接触（contact）方式指定手部，并调用成熟物理求解器分别仿真各类物质；Evaluator Agent 依据物理定律对每个结果进行校验。同时构建 CodeHOI-Bench，包含跨四类物质的 100 个重建与生成任务。
AI.result: 使用现成的前沿模型（off-the-shelf frontier models），CodeHOI 生成的交互在每一类物质上都物理合理，且迁移到独立物理引擎后仍保持合理性，说明结果并非对特定求解器的过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使编码智能体能够跨多样物质编写物理合理的 4D 手物交互，弥合了"物理仿真程序"与"驱动交互的手"之间的缺口，并提供了可复用的评测基准。

title: XMind: Thinking Twice via Cross-Memory Reasoning for LLM-Based Autonomous Driving
summary: Memory-augmented large language model (LLM) driving agents can reuse past experience, yet previously learned corrections often fail to transfer when traffic conditions change. A key limitation is that existing memories mainly record observed outcomes, providing little evidence about alternative actions. We introduce XMind, a training-free framework that enables LLM-based driving to "Think Twice" through cross-memory reasoning. XMind integrates working memory of recent traffic states with episodic memory of critical risk events. The agent first makes an initial decision from the current context and then cross-checks it against retrieved historical experience. If a conflict arises, it makes a second decision guided by the retrieved evidence. To construct reliable episodic memory, XMind evaluates alternative actions through counterfactual rollouts under perturbed traffic conditions and stores the verified outcomes as structured risk capsules. These capsules are retrieved by jointly matching spatial risk patterns and scenario semantics. Across closed-loop highway simulations, XMind achieves success rates of 83.3-93.3%, exceeding the strong baseline by 6.6 percentage points on average. Evaluation on K-Risk further demonstrates lower decision risk on unseen real-world high-risk interactions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary benefits of working memory, risk-text retrieval, and counterfactual verification. Code is available at https://github.com/xiangxiangliuwo/XMind

AI.tldr: XMind：一种免训练框架，让LLM驾驶智能体通过"工作记忆+情景记忆"的跨记忆推理实现"三思而后行"，在闭环高速仿真中成功率达83.3–93.3%，平均超过强基线6.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 记忆增强的LLM驾驶智能体可复用过往经验，但当交通条件变化时，已学到的纠正往往难以迁移。核心局限在于现有记忆主要记录已观测到的结果，缺乏关于"替代动作"的证据，导致决策无法在情境变化时有效借鉴历史。
AI.method: 提出免训练的XMind框架：(1) 融合近期交通状态的工作记忆与关键风险事件的情景记忆；(2) 智能体先基于当前上下文做初始决策，再与检索到的历史经验交叉核验，若出现冲突则以检索证据引导做第二次决策（"Think Twice"）；(3) 通过扰动交通条件下的反事实推演评估替代动作，将验证结果存为结构化风险胶囊（risk capsules）；(4) 通过空间风险模式与场景语义联合匹配进行检索。
AI.result: 闭环高速仿真中成功率83.3–93.3%，平均领先强基线6.6个百分点；在K-Risk上对未见真实高风险交互的决策风险更低；消融实验证实工作记忆、风险文本检索与反事实验证的互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过记录"替代动作的验证证据"而非仅观测结果，并以跨记忆二次推理机制加以利用，可显著提升LLM驾驶智能体的决策可靠性与跨情境迁移能力，且无需额外训练。代码已开源。

title: Multi-view Random-set Learning
comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material. Corresponding author: Cai Xu
summary:
Trusted multi-view learning aims to integrate heterogeneous views for accurate and reliable predictions. However, multi-view data often exhibit the view degradation phenomenon: individual views contain only partial discriminative information and cannot independently determine the instance-level label. Requiring such views to produce unambiguous class evidence can distort evidence learning and mislead subsequent fusion. Existing methods addressing this problem have at least one of the following drawbacks: (1) assigning evidence to individual classes without explicitly representing unresolved class groups; (2) projecting composite beliefs onto individual classes before fusion, preventing direct refinement of candidate groups through cross-view set intersections.
  To address these limitations, we propose a new Multi-view Random-Set Learning (MRSL) paradigm, which preserves view-specific support for candidate class sets and refines candidate classes through cross-view fusion. Specifically, we quantify class overlap to select a compact collection of sets for each view, avoiding the exponential cost of modeling all class subsets. We then perform set-level fusion by assigning joint support to set intersections, allowing complementary views to narrow the candidate classes before probability conversion. Experiments on synthetic and eight real-world datasets validate the proposed overlap measure and demonstrate that MRSL achieves the highest accuracy on all eight datasets. Compared with the strongest baselines, MRSL improves average accuracy by 4.71% and reduces average expected calibration error by 6.33%. All datasets and code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出多视图随机集学习（MRSL）范式，用类集合上的证据表示与集合级融合来应对视图退化问题。
AI.motivation: 多视图数据存在视图退化：单视图仅含部分判别信息，无法独立确定实例标签。强制其为单个类别输出明确证据会扭曲证据学习并误导融合。现有方法缺陷：(1) 仅给单类分配证据，未显式表示未解决的类集合（候选组）；(2) 在融合前就把复合信念投影到单类，无法通过跨视图集合交集直接精化候选组。
AI.method: 提出MRSL：在随机集（mass函数）框架下保留各视图对候选类集合的支持，并通过跨视图融合精化候选类。先用类重叠度度量选取每个视图的紧凑集合集合，避免对全部类别子集的指数级建模；再进行集合级融合，把联合支持分配给集合交集，使互补视图在概率转换之前收窄候选类。
AI.result: 合成数据实验验证了所提重叠度量的有效性；在8个真实数据集上MRSL均取得最高准确率。相较最强基线，平均准确率提升4.71%，平均期望校准误差（ECE）降低6.33%。
AI.conclusion: 以类集合为载体的证据表示与集合级交集融合能有效缓解视图退化，同时提升精度与校准性能；数据集与代码将在录用后公开。

title: DeCoNav-Act: Benchmarking Collective Physical Capability in Multi-Robot Mobile Manipulation
summary: Robot teams can split workloads or combine complementary bodies, but only if each robot leaves the shared world in a state its teammate can use. Existing multi-robot benchmarks emphasize task allocation and skill sequencing, rarely testing whether the resulting physical states are usable. To evaluate collective physical capability, we introduce DeCoNav-Act, a benchmark for language-guided multi-robot mobile manipulation in a shared physics simulation. Its 350 homogeneous and 150 heterogeneous tasks, each verified by joint reference execution, span two coordination mechanisms: parallel workloads in shared space and physical dependencies in which one robot establishes a condition for a teammate to use. Beyond team success, DeCoNav-Act measures path efficiency and handoff coverage and success, and adds a diagnostic from verified pre-handoff states. Evaluating sensor-grounded adaptations of ASPIRE and RAX and our agent CoMoMa, we find that with GPT-5.6-luna no method completes a task, at most 8.8% of dependencies are reached, and even from pre-handoff states no handoff is completed; with GPT-6.1-sol, CoMoMa establishes the condition in 26.5% of trials, but only 4.1% succeed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DeCoNav-Act 基准，用于在共享物理仿真中评测语言引导的多机器人移动操作，重点检验机器人交接后留下的物理状态是否可被队友使用。该基准包含 350 个同构任务与 150 个异构任务，覆盖并行分工与物理依赖两类协调机制，并引入路径效率、交接覆盖率与成功率等指标。实验显示现有方法（ASPIRE、RAX 及作者提出的 CoMoMa）在多机器人物理交接上表现极差。
AI.motivation: 机器人团队可通过分工或互补本体协作完成任务，但前提是每个机器人离开共享世界时留下的状态能被队友使用。现有多机器人基准主要关注任务分配与技能序列，很少检验由此产生的物理状态是否可用，缺乏对"集体物理能力"的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建 DeCoNav-Act 基准：在共享物理仿真中开展语言引导的多机器人移动操作评测。任务由 350 个同构任务与 150 个异构任务组成，每个任务均经联合参考执行验证。任务覆盖两种协调机制：共享空间中的并行工作负载，以及一个机器人为队友建立使用条件的物理依赖。评价指标除团队成功率外，还包括路径效率、交接覆盖率与交接成功率，并基于已验证的"交接前状态"增加诊断性评测。方法上对 ASPIRE 与 RAX 做基于传感的适配，并与作者提出的 CoMoMa 智能体对比。
AI.result: 在 GPT-5.6-luna 下，所有方法均未完成任何任务，最多仅触及 8.8% 的依赖条件，即使从验证过的交接前状态出发也无法完成任何交接；在 GPT-6.1-sol 下，CoMoMa 在 26.5% 的试验中建立所需条件，但最终成功率仅为 4.1%。
AI.conclusion: 现有多机器人方法在"物理状态可交接性"这一核心能力上严重不足，任务成功与依赖建立之间存在巨大落差。DeCoNav-Act 通过物理依赖任务与交接前状态诊断，揭示了任务分配与技能序列之外的集体物理能力瓶颈，为后续研究提供了明确的评测与改进方向。

title: Distill to Loop: Turning Pretrained Diffusion Transformers into Looped Models with Adjustable Depth
summary: Looped transformers reuse one block of shared weights along the depth of the network. Recent looped diffusion transformers are trained from scratch, which repeats the full pretraining cost although strong pretrained non-looped diffusion transformers exist. We propose Distill to Loop (Dooop), which distills a pretrained non-looped diffusion transformer into a looped student whose blocks are initialized from the teacher's. We cast distillation as a fixed-point iteration toward the teacher, in which the output after every loop is trained toward the teacher, and each loop is one step of an ordinary differential equation in depth. As a result, one model runs any number of loops at test time without retraining, and the higher-order ODE solvers of diffusion model sampling can be applied along the depth dimension for better results. Meanwhile, because a looped model produces an output after every loop, we also construct loop guidance between the outputs of different loop counts, which improves the generated samples at little extra compute. On SD3-medium, a looped student with about 37% of the teacher's parameters matches the teacher on average over GenEval, ImageReward, PickScore and HPSv2.1 with two to four loops, and with two loops it uses about 58% of the teacher's compute. And on a four-step SD3-medium, loop guidance raises the average of the four metrics from 88.2 to 99.2.

AI.tldr: 提出 Distill to Loop (Dooop)，将预训练的非循环扩散 Transformer 蒸馏为共享权重的循环学生模型，把蒸馏建模为向教师模型收敛的不动点迭代，并沿深度维度引入高阶 ODE 求解器与 loop guidance，实现推理时任意循环次数且无需重训练。
AI.motivation: 现有循环（looped）扩散 Transformer 需从头训练，重复了完整预训练成本；而高质量的非循环预训练扩散模型已存在，因此希望复用其权重，避免从零训练的高昂代价。
AI.method: 以教师模型的块初始化循环学生模型的共享块；将蒸馏视为朝教师模型收敛的不动点迭代，每次循环输出均对齐教师；把每次循环视为深度方向上 ODE 的一步，从而可迁移扩散采样中的高阶 ODE 求解器；另利用不同循环次数输出的差异构建 loop guidance。
AI.result: SD3-medium 上，约 37% 参数量的循环学生在 GenEval、ImageReward、PickScore、HPSv2.1 平均指标上以 2–4 次循环匹配教师；2 次循环时计算量约为教师 58%。四步 SD3-medium 上，loop guidance 将四项指标均值从 88.2 提升至 99.2。
AI.conclusion: Dooop 可在无需重训练的前提下将预训练扩散 Transformer 压缩为循环学生，推理时灵活选择循环次数，并结合高阶 ODE 求解与 loop guidance 以低额外开销获得与教师相当甚至更优的生成质量。

title: PoseVLN: Learning Geometric State Evolution for Vision-Language Navigation
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, including appendix. Project page: https://houpengyu123.github.io/PoseVLN/
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to relate past experience, current spatial state, and future motion while following natural-language instructions. Recent approaches improve these capabilities through long-horizon memory, state-aware reasoning, and future prediction, yet these components are often modeled separately, leaving navigation state evolution insufficiently connected across time. We argue that camera pose provides a natural geometric representation for bridging past, present, and future states. Based on this insight, we propose PoseVLN, a pose-aware VLN framework that jointly learns navigation decisions and geometric state evolution. PoseVLN organizes visual memory and the current observation in an episode-relative coordinate frame, and jointly predicts the next K navigation actions together with a local $Δ$Pose over the same horizon. The predicted $Δ$Pose is composed with the current trajectory-level pose to obtain the future pose state, which is recursively propagated throughout navigation, forming a continuous geometric state evolution from past memory to future motion. Experiments on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen splits demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly modeling geometric state evolution, with PoseVLN outperforming the strongest compared baselines by 2.6 and 2.9 percentage points in success rate, respectively, using only single RGB observations.

AI.tldr: 提出PoseVLN：以相机位姿作为统一几何表示，联合学习导航决策与几何状态演化，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE Val-Unseen上成功率分别超越最强基线2.6与2.9个百分点（仅用单目RGB）。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN方法虽分别引入长程记忆、状态感知推理与未来预测，但这些组件多为独立建模，导致跨时间的导航状态演化连接不足，过去经验、当前空间状态与未来运动的关联不够紧密。
AI.method: 核心洞察为相机位姿可作为桥接过去、现在与未来状态的天然几何表示。PoseVLN将视觉记忆与当前观测统一组织在episode-relative坐标系中，联合预测未来K步导航动作及同一时域上的局部ΔPose；将预测ΔPose与当前轨迹级位姿复合得到未来位姿状态，并在导航过程中递归传播，形成从过去记忆到未来运动的连续几何状态演化。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE与RxR-CE的Val-Unseen划分上，仅使用单目RGB观测，成功率较最强对比基线分别提升2.6和2.9个百分点，验证了显式建模几何状态演化的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式地以位姿为纽带建模几何状态演化可有效提升VLN性能；将记忆、状态推理与未来预测统一于同一几何表示下是可行且有前景的方向。

title: A Unified Control Framework for Gradient Inversion Defense in Federated Learning
summary: Gradient perturbations are widely recognized as an effective defense against gradient inversion attacks in federated learning, but they are equally known to impair optimization, creating a persistent tension between privacy and utility. In this paper, we show that existing gradient perturbation defenses, despite their different formulations, can be unified under a controlled dynamics framework, providing a cohesive understanding of their optimization behavior and enabling the derivation of universal convergence and safety conditions without relying on case-specific analyses. Leveraging this observation, we propose ``Near Orthogonal Gradient Projection (NODE)'', which injects perturbations only along directions orthogonal to the original gradient so that the defended gradient maintains a fixed cosine similarity with the true gradient. By preserving the first-order descent direction, NODE substantially reduces the optimization cost of strong perturbations while maintaining effective protection against gradient inversion attacks. We theoretically establish convergence guarantees under standard optimization assumptions and further show that, under mild conditions on the gradient distribution, NODE remains effective in preventing inversion attacks. Comprehensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets, including CIFAR-10, ImageNet, and Chest X-ray, together with a variety of gradient inversion attacks, demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves an improved privacy--utility trade-off over existing defenses across a broad range of training settings.

AI.tldr: 该文将现有梯度扰动防御统一到"受控动力学"框架，据此提出近正交梯度投影（NODE）：仅沿与原始梯度正交的方向注入扰动，使防御后梯度与真实梯度保持固定余弦相似度，从而在保持强隐私保护的同时显著降低优化代价。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中的梯度反转攻击可用梯度扰动防御，但扰动会损害优化，隐私与效用存在持续张力；现有各类扰动防御公式各异，缺乏统一理解，收敛性与安全性条件只能逐案分析。
AI.method: 1) 证明现有梯度扰动防御可统一为受控动力学框架，从而无需个案分析即可导出通用的收敛性与安全性条件；2) 基于该观察提出NODE，将扰动限制在与原梯度正交的方向上，使防御梯度与真实梯度的余弦相似度固定；3) 保留一阶下降方向，理论建立标准优化假设下的收敛保证，并在温和的梯度分布条件下证明其仍能有效阻止反转攻击；4) 在CIFAR-10、ImageNet、Chest X-ray等基准及多种梯度反转攻击上开展实验。
AI.result: 理论上有收敛保证与反演防御有效性证明；实验表明在广泛训练设置下，该框架相较现有防御取得更优的隐私—效用权衡，强扰动下的优化代价明显降低。
AI.conclusion: 梯度扰动防御可由统一的受控动力学视角刻画；沿正交方向注入扰动、固定余弦相似度的设计能在不牺牲一阶下降方向的前提下实现强隐私保护，为隐私—效用权衡提供了更优解。

title: Semidefinite Programming for Cold-Start GNSS Doppler-Based Alignment: A Comparison with Nonlinear Least Squares
summary: Initial attitude alignment between local navigation frames and the Earth-centered Earth-fixed (ECEF) frame is a critical prerequisite for multi-sensor integrated navigation, such as Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)/inertial/odometry fusion, before global and local measurements can be jointly processed. While GNSS Doppler-based alignment eliminates the need for carrier-phase ambiguity resolution or multi-antenna hardware, solving this non-convex problem via local nonlinear least squares (NLS) suffers from local minima, whereas direct semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation incurs high latency and omits local covariance outputs. This study systematically compares NLS and SDP on a unified maximum-likelihood Doppler objective across Monte Carlo simulations and three real-world driving datasets. We demonstrate that attaching a modular dual SDP certifier to a standard manifold NLS solver recovers the global accuracy of direct SDP within 0.001 degrees, reduces real-world 95th-percentile yaw errors from over 86 degrees down to 2.88 degrees to 4.70 degrees, and cuts median solve times by up to an order of magnitude while preserving native Jacobian covariances. We conclude that candidate-driven certification bridges local estimation and global optimization due to two structural advantages: (1) our theoretical comparison reveals that SDP relaxation enlarges the feasible region while preserving the lifted cost, allowing Lagrangian duality to verify whether a fixed NLS candidate attains the global lower bound without invoking a full SDP solver, and (2) the candidate-driven architecture acts as a non-intrusive module that plugs directly into existing navigation pipelines without replacing the local estimator, preserving native tangent-space covariance outputs and low typical latency.

AI.tldr: 提出将模块化对偶SDP认证器嵌入标准流形NLS求解器，对GNSS多普勒目标进行全局最优性验证，在几乎不损失精度的情况下显著降低时延并保留雅可比协方差。
AI.motivation: 局部导航系与ECEF框架的初始姿态对齐是GNSS/惯性/里程计等多源融合导航的前提。基于GNSS多普勒的方法虽无需载波相位整周模糊度解算或多天线硬件，但该问题非凸：局部NLS易陷入局部极小，直接SDP松弛时延高且不输出局部协方差。
AI.method: 在同一最大似然多普勒目标函数下系统比较NLS与SDP；通过蒙特卡洛仿真与三个真实驾驶数据集评估；提出在标准流形NLS求解器上附加模块化对偶SDP认证器（candidate-driven certification），利用拉格朗日对偶检验给定NLS候选解是否达到全局下界，而无需调用完整SDP求解器。
AI.result: 认证器可在0.001度以内恢复直接SDP的全局精度；真实数据中95百分位偏航误差由超过86度降至2.88–4.70度；中位求解时间最多降低一个数量级；同时保留原生雅可比协方差输出。
AI.conclusion: 候选驱动认证兼具局部估计的低时延与全局优化的精度：理论上SDP松弛扩大可行域而保持提升后的代价，使对偶可验证全局下界；架构上作为非侵入式模块可直接接入现有导航流水线，无需替换局部估计器。

title: WaveSR: Physics-Inspired Wave Evolution Attention for Efficient Image Super-Resolution
comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia
summary: Recently, physics-inspired neural networks have gained widespread attention due to their interpretability. The closed-form, frequency-time decoupled solution of the wave equation offers linear complexity and allows different frequency components to evolve independently, making it a potential alternative solution for efficient image super-resolution. Therefore, a physics-inspired wave evolution attention framework is proposed, namely WaveSR. The WaveSR framework involves two key modules, i.e., wave evolution attention (WEA) and Frequency-Adaptive Feed-Forward Network (FA-FFN). The WEA module achieves feature interactions through the analytical solution of the 2D wave equation in the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) domain, enabling independent evolution of different frequency components with learnable wave speed \(c\) and damping coefficient \(α\). The FA-FFN module realizes adaptive frequency feature selection through learnable spectral modulation, effectively enhancing feature representation capability. Subsequently, we employ a two-stage training strategy with a hybrid objective that combines a spatial-domain pixel loss and a frequency-domain loss to improve reconstruction quality. Our method provides a preliminary exploration of physics-inspired neural networks for efficient image super-resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出受物理启发的波演化注意力框架WaveSR，利用二维波动方程在FFT域的解析解实现频域解耦的特征演化，结合频率自适应前馈网络与混合空域-频域损失，探索高效图像超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 物理启发神经网络因可解释性受关注；波动方程的闭式频-时解耦解具有线性复杂度且各频率分量可独立演化，因而有望成为高效图像超分辨率的替代方案。
AI.method: 包含两个核心模块：波演化注意力（WEA）在FFT域通过二维波动方程解析解实现特征交互，以可学习波速c和阻尼系数α使不同频率分量独立演化；频率自适应前馈网络（FA-FFN）通过可学习谱调制实现自适应频率特征选择。采用两阶段训练策略，并使用空域像素损失与频域损失结合的混合目标。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅说明该框架具备线性复杂度、频率分量可独立演化，并通过谱调制增强特征表示能力、借助混合损失提升重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为物理启发神经网络用于高效图像超分辨率提供了初步探索。

title: Refining and Aligning Clinical Reasoning with Health Guidelines via Formal Constraints
summary: Clinical reasoning from incomplete or conflicting patient evidence must account for low-probability but high-risk concerns while remaining grounded in health guidelines. We introduce VerClin, an explainable framework that extracts guideline conditions, exclusions, recommendations, and priorities into executable knowledge and represents patient conversations as scoped cases. A deterministic four-valued reasoner produces traceable guideline matches while preserving uncertainty and enforcing exclusions. Multiple specialty agents then screen matched guidelines for case applicability, and a consultation model synthesizes accepted guidance through specialty recommendations and a sentence-preserving formal-constraint channel. We present accepted guidance in ascending order of the sum of its priority and trigger-strength ranks, which can surface high-risk guidance with weaker triggers. VerClin outperforms direct generation and Top-5 RAG on HealthBench Hard and HealthBench Professional. On the LLMEval-Med subset, it outperforms direct generation and ties Top-5 RAG. Component analyses further examine semantic closure, example-guided refinement, specialty screening, and constraint-conditioned delivery.

AI.tldr: VerClin：将指南条件/排除/推荐/优先级编译为可执行知识，患者对话表示为作用域化病例，用确定性四值推理器生成可追溯匹配，再经多专科智能体筛选与咨询模型综合，按优先级与触发强度秩和升序呈现指南。
AI.motivation: 临床推理面对不完整或冲突的患者证据，需在遵循健康指南的前提下兼顾低概率高风险问题；直接生成与常规RAG难以保证指南落地性与可追溯性。
AI.method: 1) 从指南抽取条件、排除项、推荐与优先级，构建可执行知识；2) 将患者对话表示为作用域化病例（scoped cases）；3) 确定性四值推理器输出可追溯的指南匹配，保留不确定性并强制排除项；4) 多专科智能体对匹配指南做病例适用性筛查；5) 咨询模型通过专科建议与保句形式约束通道综合被接受的指导；6) 按"优先级秩+触发强度秩"之和升序输出。
AI.result: 在HealthBench Hard与HealthBench Professional上优于直接生成与Top-5 RAG；在LLMEval-Med子集上优于直接生成、与Top-5 RAG持平。消融/组件分析考察了语义闭合、示例引导精化、专科筛查与约束条件化生成的作用。
AI.conclusion: 结构化可执行指南知识+四值可追溯推理+专科筛查的组合，可在保持指南合规与不确定性的同时提升临床建议质量，并借秩和排序凸显弱触发但高风险的指南条目。

title: Steerable by Design: Conditional Pretraining for Robust Control of Language Models
summary: Our goal is to build language models that are steerable by design. Today's language models are pretrained with next-token prediction, which relegates alignment and control to the final 1% of training tokens or inference-time interventions. These models repurpose a single input channel for both instructions and data, leading to common failure modes where the model mistakenly treats data as instructions such as intentional jailbreaks and unintentional in-context alignment drift. To correct this, we propose a pretraining method and architecture that separates the two from the very start, producing Mancelle-3B. An encoder processes high-level semantic features of upcoming text with cross-attention that prevents the token stream from writing back into this control channel. During pretraining, the model learns to rely on these features to predict the next token, turning the channel into an effective handle for steering the model. Mancelle-3B steers more strongly than prompt- and activation-based methods on comparable open models while maintaining fluency, and it withstands adversarial black-box and soft-prompt counter-steering that defeats those baselines. We reproduce this against a more controlled baseline with Mancelle-400M. Our results show that robust control can be built into language models if we do so early and intentionally.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从预训练阶段就分离"指令"与"数据"两个输入通道的架构与预训练方法，训练出 Mancelle-3B，实现更强的可操控性与抗对抗干扰的鲁棒控制。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型用 next-token prediction 预训练，把对齐与控制留到最后约1%的 token 或推理时干预；且指令与数据共用一个输入通道，导致模型误把数据当指令（有意越狱、无意中的上下文对齐漂移）等失效模式。
AI.method: 在预训练时即引入独立控制通道：一个编码器提取即将生成文本的高层语义特征，通过 cross-attention 注入，且该 token 流无法回写控制通道（单向信息流）；预训练中模型学习依赖这些特征预测下一个 token，使该通道成为有效的操控手柄。
AI.result: 在同类开源模型上，Mancelle-3B 的操控强度优于基于 prompt 与基于激活的方法，同时保持流畅性；并能抵御击败上述基线的黑盒对抗与软提示反向操控。用 Mancelle-400M 在更受控的基线上复现了该结果。
AI.conclusion: 若在早期并有意识地设计，鲁棒的控制能力可以被内建到语言模型中。

title: Seeing to Drive on a Single Board: Attention-Free Depth for Onboard Robot Navigation
comment: 13 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Code, models and data: https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL
summary: A small ground robot can carry one camera and a few watts of compute, but the depth foundation models that could turn that camera into a range sensor are vision transformers sized for GPUs. We bring one to a Raspberry Pi 5 with the Hailo-8L, an accelerator that runs every layer in integer arithmetic, attention included. Quantised for it, Depth Anything V2 loses large parts of the scene, and we measure why: at 449 tokens, 91% of softmax weights fall below one int8 step while carrying 17-33% of the attention mass. Our answer is to distil, not quantise. An attention-free ResNet-34 U-Net student of Depth Anything V2-Large (24.5M parameters) runs at 27.1 FPS on the chip, its int8 output matches its float twin (Pearson 0.99993), and on held-out scenes of its simulated yard it is the most accurate depth network on the chip (AbsRel 0.269 against 0.354-0.530). On 1,000 stereo-verified points of a real outdoor drive it is not resolvably different from the vendor's Depth Anything V2-Small build, while running faster (27.1 vs 21.6 FPS). Ranging obstacles by where they meet the floor needs only the camera height, so mapping, hybrid-A* planning and SLAM run on the Pi's own CPU. In real-time hardware-in-the-loop tests in a Gaussian-splat reconstruction of a real yard, the stack reaches the goal without contact in 7.9$\pm$1.1 of 10 scenes, against 9.2$\pm$0.4 with exact obstacles, and in 7.7$\pm$0.7 on its own pose with simulated wheel odometry (ten seeds each; 8.2$\pm$0.4 with the real Pi and Hailo-8L in the loop, five seeds). The source code, pre-trained models and data are available at https://github.com/itaim18/DANIEL.

AI.tldr: 将 Depth Anything V2 知识蒸馏为无注意力 ResNet-34 U-Net 学生模型，在树莓派5 + Hailo-8L 上以 27.1 FPS 运行 int8 深度估计并支撑完整导航栈。
AI.motivation: 小型地面机器人只能携带一个相机和数瓦算力，而可把相机变成测距传感器的深度基础模型是面向 GPU 的 ViT，无法在边缘部署；且直接在 Hailo-8L 上做 int8 量化会使注意力权重严重失真（449 token 时 91% softmax 权重低于一个 int8 步长，却承载 17–33% 注意力质量），导致场景大范围丢失。
AI.method: 不采用量化路线而采用蒸馏：以 Depth Anything V2-Large 为教师，蒸馏出 24.5M 参数、无注意力的 ResNet-34 U-Net 学生模型，全部层以整型算术在 Hailo-8L 上执行；障碍物测距仅依赖相机高度与地面接触点，映射、hybrid-A* 规划与 SLAM 均在 Pi 的 CPU 上运行。
AI.result: 学生模型在芯片上达 27.1 FPS，int8 输出与 float 孪生模型高度一致（Pearson 0.99993）；仿真场地留出场景上 AbsRel 0.269，优于片上其他网络（0.354–0.530）；真实户外行驶的 1000 个立体校验点上与厂商 Depth Anything V2-Small 无明显差异，且更快（27.1 vs 21.6 FPS）。高斯泼溅重建场地的硬件在环测试中，10 个场景成功 7.9±1.1 次（精确障碍物下 9.2±0.4，自带位姿+仿真轮式里程计下 7.7±0.7）；真实 Pi + Hailo-8L 在环时 8.2±0.4（5 个随机种子）。
AI.conclusion: 在极低功耗边缘硬件上，蒸馏而非量化是部署深度基础模型的可行路径；所得无注意力小模型可实时支撑完整的感知—建图—规划—SLAM 导航栈，代码、预训练模型与数据已开源。

title: InCue: Making Better Use of What Multimodal LLMs Already See at Test Time
summary: Even when multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer incorrectly, their internal cues often point to the relevant region. A widely used remedy re-presents the cue-selected region as an enlarged crop to supply finer detail. However, we find that much of its gain requires no new detail: it largely survives when the crop comes from the already-seen low-resolution input, and partly even when the region's cached tokens are merely copied. Part of re-presentation's gain thus comes from drawing attention to evidence the model already holds. We propose InCue, a test-time framework that makes better use of this evidence without additional visual input. InCue treats visual attention and predictive-entropy gradients as Internal Cues, couples them into a spatial target, and optimizes only an offset on the existing visual tokens to steer attention toward it. Under matched visual-token budgets, InCue achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming recent test-time methods and improving four MLLMs by up to 8.9% on V$^*$ and 23.4% on its hard samples. Its gains carry over to eight general benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/paul-swu/InCue.

AI.tldr: 多模态大模型答错时内部线索仍指向相关区域；"放大裁块再呈现"的增益大多来自引导注意力而非新细节。作者提出测试时框架InCue：用视觉注意力与预测熵梯度作为内部线索耦合出空间目标，仅优化现有视觉token上的偏移来引导注意力，无需额外视觉输入，在匹配token预算下取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有补救手段将线索选中的区域放大裁剪后重新输入以提供更精细细节，但实验发现其增益在裁剪取自已见低分辨率输入时仍大体保留，甚至仅复制该区域缓存token也能部分保留，说明增益主要来自"把注意力引向模型已持有的证据"而非新细节。因此需要一种不增加视觉输入、更充分利用内部证据的测试时方法。
AI.method: 提出InCue测试时框架：将视觉注意力与预测熵梯度统一视为"内部线索"（Internal Cues），二者耦合定位出空间目标区域；随后仅在已有视觉token上优化一个偏移量（offset），以此引导模型注意力转向该目标，不引入任何额外视觉输入。方法在匹配的视觉token预算下评估。
AI.result: 在匹配视觉token预算条件下达到SOTA，持续优于近期测试时方法；在四个MLLM上最高提升V* 8.9%、其困难样本23.4%，增益可迁移至八个通用基准。
AI.conclusion: 重呈现方法的主要收益来自注意力重定向而非新增细节，InCue通过内部线索定位+视觉token偏移优化的轻量测试时干预，即可在不增加视觉输入的情况下稳定提升多个MLLM的感知与推理表现，并具备良好泛化性。

title: VC-OPD: Learning to See What Matters via Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Visual On-Policy Distillation (OPD) commonly uses cropped or zoomed-in image regions as teacher-side privileged information to improve fine-grained perception in small Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, local pixel-level cues are insufficient for complex visual reasoning that requires global structure, spatial relationships, and high-level semantics. We propose Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation (VC-OPD), which extends teacher-side privileged information beyond local image regions to question-conditioned visual cues. Advanced MLLMs generate cues capturing key visual details, structural relationships, and semantic evidence needed to answer each question. A multi-stage quality filtering process selects reliable cues, which are provided only to the teacher during training. This enables informative token-level supervision along student-generated trajectories, helping the student learn to identify and reason over critical evidence directly from the original image. No additional information is required at inference time. Since advanced MLLMs are used only for visual cue generation, VC-OPD is compatible with both open-weight and proprietary black-box models. Experiments on STEM and general visual reasoning benchmarks show consistent improvements across model scales over reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation baselines. Notably, a 4B model trained with VC-OPD outperforms many baselines with 8B or more parameters, demonstrating effective capability transfer through question-conditioned visual cues.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉线索在策略自蒸馏（VC-OPD），用问题条件化的视觉线索作为教师侧特权信息，替代传统局部裁剪/放大区域，实现小多模态模型细粒度与复杂视觉推理能力的高效迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉OPD通常以裁剪或放大的局部图像区域作为教师特权信息来提升小MLLM的细粒度感知，但局部像素级线索不足以支撑需要全局结构、空间关系和高层语义的复杂视觉推理任务，因此需要更强、更全面的特权信息形式。
AI.method: 让先进MLLM针对每个问题生成包含关键视觉细节、结构关系与语义证据的视觉线索；经多阶段质量过滤筛选可靠线索；仅在训练阶段提供给教师模型，从而在学生自生成轨迹上获得信息量更高的token级监督；推理阶段无需任何额外信息，且先进MLLM仅用于线索生成，兼容开源与闭源黑盒模型。
AI.result: 在STEM与通用视觉推理基准上，跨模型规模均稳定优于强化学习与在策略蒸馏基线；4B模型经VC-OPD训练后可超越许多8B及以上参数的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 以问题条件化视觉线索作为教师特权信息，能有效实现能力迁移，是小MLLM复杂视觉推理的一种可扩展、易部署的蒸馏方案。

title: Who gets the information? An $α$-fair label-coverage framework for multi-label feature selection
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material is provided as an ancillary file
summary: Recent information-theoretic filters for multi-label feature selection disagree on how to distribute relevance over labels: some amplify features that inform a few labels, others balance what every label receives. We show these choices are implicit social welfare functions. Treating labels as agents whose utility is the information they receive, we propose FLIC, which greedily maximises the $α$-fair welfare of per-label information coverage.
