A single parameter $α$ moves from utilitarian ($α=0$) through proportionally fair ($α=1$) to max-min selection ($α\to\infty$), and a dozen published relevance terms lie on this axis, most as special cases, first-order approximations or limits. The objective is monotone submodular for every $α\ge0$ whenever each label's information is, so greedy selection is a $(1-1/e)$-approximation; this fails for $α<0$, and the max-min limit is inapproximable. Fano's and the Hellman-Raviv inequalities tie raw coverage to the Bayes Hamming loss and normalised coverage to per-label relative error. FLIC uses bias-corrected, label-wise conditional information and has no relevance-redundancy trade-off parameter. On 22 data sets, FLIC is the best of 14 information-theoretic filters on seven of nine metrics, winning 86 of 117 pairwise comparisons significantly and losing none significantly. Among 17 methods it ranks first on ranking loss, coverage and macro-AUC with two classifiers and has the best mean rank (narrowly with ML-kNN), while three embedded methods lead on Hamming loss, one-error and micro-F1.

AI.tldr: 该文指出现有多标签特征选择的信息论滤波器中"相关性分配"策略实为隐式的社会福利函数，提出FLIC——以α-公平福利最大化逐标签信息覆盖，统一了十余种已发表相关性度量，并给出子模性与近似保证及大规模实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有多标签特征选择的信息论滤波方法在"如何将相关性分配到各标签上"存在分歧：一类放大只对少数标签有信息量的特征，另一类追求每个标签获得的信息均衡。作者认为这些选择并非中立的技术细节，而是隐含的社会福利函数（utilitarian / proportional fairness / max-min），因此需要一个可显式刻画并统一这些立场的框架。
AI.method: 将标签视为"代理"，其效用为所获得的信息量；定义逐标签信息覆盖的α-公平福利目标并贪心最大化（FLIC）。单一参数α从utilitarian（α=0）经比例公平（α=1）到max-min（α→∞）；证明当每个标签的信息函数满足条件时，目标对任意α≥0为单调子模，贪心获得(1-1/e)近似；α<0时性质失效，max-min极限不可近似。用Fano与Hellman-Raviv不等式将原始覆盖联系到Bayes Hamming损失、将归一化覆盖联系到逐标签相对误差。实现上采用偏差校正的、逐标签条件信息，且无需相关性-冗余权衡参数。
AI.result: 在22个数据集、14种信息论滤波器上，FLIC在9项指标中的7项最优；117次成对比较中86次显著胜出、无一显著落败。在17种方法中，配合两个分类器时在ranking loss、coverage、macro-AUC上排名第一，平均排名最优（与ML-kNN接近）；Hamming loss、one-error、micro-F1上由三种嵌入式方法领先。
AI.conclusion: 多标签特征选择中的相关性分配本质上是社会福利函数的选择，α-公平框架可将十余种已发表相关性项统一为该轴上的特例、一阶近似或极限；FLIC以单一α参数、无权衡参数的形式给出可证明的近似保证并在多数指标上取得最优，是信息论滤波器中的强基线。

title: AG-WAM: Attention-Guided World Action Model for Accurate and Efficient Robot Manipulation
summary: Recently developed World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and robot actions, providing predictive context for control. However, existing WAMs typically learn implicit attention allocation with limited explicit action-relevant attention guidance, leading to limited performance. To unleash strong capabilities of WAMs, we introduce explicit attention guidance as a unifying principle and propose our Attention-Guided WAM (AG-WAM), an end-to-end framework with three plug-and-play attention guidance modules that directly reformulate internal attention paradigm in WAMs: the Content-Adaptive Predictive Attention module, the Guidance-Point Visual Attention module, and the State-Conditioned Text Attention module. Without any external plugin module adopted, our end-to-end framework with the unifying principle of explicit attention guidance boosts the accuracy and efficiency of WAMs. Without using any private embodied training data, our AG-WAM establishes new state-of-the-art performance on multiple public robotic manipulation benchmarks including LIBERO-X, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin-2.0, significantly outperforming other methods, even those using massive private embodied training data by a notable margin, meanwhile notably improving training and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AG-WAM框架，以"显式注意力引导"为统一原则，通过三个即插即用的注意力引导模块重构世界动作模型内部的注意力范式，在不使用私有具身训练数据的条件下于LIBERO-X、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin-2.0等基准上取得新的SOTA，并提升训练与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）同时预测未来观测与机器人动作以提供预测性上下文，但其注意力分配依赖隐式学习，缺乏显式的、与动作相关的注意力引导，导致性能受限。作者希望以显式注意力引导作为统一原则，释放WAMs的强能力。
AI.method: 端到端AG-WAM框架，内含三个可直接插拔的注意力引导模块，直接重构WAM内部的注意力范式：内容自适应预测注意力模块（Content-Adaptive Predictive Attention）、引导点视觉注意力模块（Guidance-Point Visual Attention）、状态条件文本注意力模块（State-Conditioned Text Attention）。方法不依赖任何外部插件模块。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-X、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin-2.0等多个公开机器人操作基准上刷新SOTA，显著优于其他方法，甚至大幅领先使用海量私有具身训练数据的方法；同时明显提升训练与推理效率，且未使用任何私有具身训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 显式注意力引导可作为统一原则有效增强WAMs的精度与效率，三个注意力引导模块以即插即用方式实现端到端集成，验证了"以注意力引导为核心"的建模范式在机器人操作任务上的优越性与数据效率优势。

title: Describe, Don't Decide: Correcting Answer Bias in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Comparing two entities in an image, multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) often answer wrongly. We find that the answer bias enters not when the model sees, but when it decides with the image in view: the model's own descriptions of the two entities often already hold the right answer. We therefore propose D$^3$ (Describe, Don't Decide): the model describes each entity alone, decides from these descriptions without the image, and merges this decision with its direct answer. Without any training, D$^3$ improves all 79 model-benchmark pairs across ten benchmarks and eight 7-9B MLLMs. On held-out GQA comparison questions, the mean accuracy of these models rises from 72.4% to 83.2% (up to +21.5% per model), higher than that of Qwen2.5-VL-32B answering directly (82.8%). Code will be available at https://github.com/paul-swu/describe-dont-decide.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法 D³（Describe, Don't Decide）：让 MLLM 分别描述单个实体、在无图像条件下基于描述做判断，再与直接答案融合，可缓解图像比较类问题的答案偏置。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在图像内比较两个实体时常答错。作者发现偏置并非产生于“看”的环节，而在于“在图像可见条件下做决策”的环节：模型自身对两个实体的描述往往已含正确答案。
AI.method: D³ 分三步：①分别单独描述每个实体；②隐藏图像，仅依据这些描述做比较决策；③将该决策与模型图像可见时的直接答案进行合并融合。全过程无需训练。
AI.result: 在 10 个基准、8 个 7–9B MLLM 上共 79 个模型-基准组合全部提升；在留出 GQA 比较题上，平均准确率由 72.4% 升至 83.2%（单模型最高 +21.5%），超过 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 直接作答的 82.8%。
AI.conclusion: 比较类视觉问答的错误主要源于决策阶段的图像语境干扰；显式解耦“描述”与“决策”即可在零训练成本下稳定提升性能，小模型经该方法可超越更大模型的直接表现。

title: Sparse Poison, Strong Hijack: Efficient Trajectory-Level Backdoors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Only 1\% Poisoning
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, including supplementary material. Simin Huang and Jiawei Chen contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/vla-attack/Sparse_Poison_Strong_Hijack
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models advance robotic manipulation, but their reliance on demonstrations exposes them to backdoor threats. Among these threats, trajectory-level targeted backdoors are particularly challenging and may pose greater safety risks than behavior-disrupting attacks: rather than merely causing task failures or local action deviations, they must sustain closed-loop redirection to complete an attacker-specified multi-step task. To reliably induce such behaviors, existing methods typically rely on high poisoning rates to obtain sufficient target-trajectory supervision. However, high poisoning rates may compromise clean-task performance, whereas low rates leave target-trajectory supervision scarce and backdoor learning vulnerable to interference from dominant clean-task updates. To resolve this trade-off at low poisoning rates, we propose a two-stage co-optimization framework guided by vision, language, and action. Stage I freezes the policy and uses differentiable rendering and multimodal supervision to optimize a 3D trigger's texture, translation, and scale, strengthening trigger-target associations from limited poisoned demonstrations. Building on the optimized trigger, Stage II applies source-selective dual-LoRA adaptation to decouple clean and backdoor updates and mitigate their interference, followed by learned column-wise calibration and analytic fusion into a unified policy. Experiments on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$ across four LIBERO suites show consistent gains over all evaluated attack baselines. With only 1% poisoned data, our method achieves 86.4% target success and 95.2% clean-task success on OpenVLA-OFT in LIBERO-Spatial. Real-robot trials also demonstrate trajectory-level hijacking.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉-语言-动作引导的两阶段协同优化框架，在仅1%投毒率下实现VLA模型的轨迹级定向后门，兼顾目标轨迹劫持成功率与干净任务性能。
AI.motivation: VLA模型依赖演示数据训练，易受后门威胁。轨迹级定向后门比破坏性攻击更危险：需维持闭环重定向以完成攻击者指定的多步任务。现有方法依赖高投毒率获取足够目标轨迹监督，但高投毒率损害干净任务性能；低投毒率则目标监督稀疏，后门学习易被主导的干净任务更新干扰。核心问题是该权衡取舍。
AI.method: 两阶段协同优化框架，由视觉、语言、动作三模态引导。阶段I冻结策略，利用可微渲染与多模态监督优化3D触发器的纹理、平移与尺度，从有限投毒演示中增强触发器-目标关联。阶段II在此基础上采用源选择性双LoRA适配，解耦干净与后门更新以缓解相互干扰，再通过学习式逐列校准与解析融合得到统一策略。
AI.result: 在OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、π0、π0.5四个模型及四个LIBERO套件上，相对所有评估的攻击基线取得一致提升。OpenVLA-OFT在LIBERO-Spatial上仅用1%投毒数据即达86.4%目标成功率与95.2%干净任务成功率。真机实验亦验证了轨迹级劫持效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过触发器优化与双LoRA解耦相结合，可在低投毒率下有效植入轨迹级定向后门，同时保持干净任务性能，揭示了VLA模型在真实操控场景中的新型安全风险。

title: Joint Classification and Generation on Tabular Data: an Empirical Study
summary: Many applications of machine learning on tabular data need both a classifier and a generator of realistic records. The default is to train two separate models, whereas a single joint model promises both from one set of weights. Several families of tabular deep learning models can be turned into such a joint model, which raises the question of which joint model is preferable at which computational budget. In this empirical study, we introduce and compare joint models based on four state-of-the-art tabular data modeling families (energy-based models, probabilistic circuits, tabular foundation models and tabular diffusion models) against measured FLOPs and wall-clock time, on 29 classification datasets. Methods are evaluated based on two defined aggregate scores that take into account different aspects of prediction and generation. We then also compare these joint models with every pair of a separate classifier and generator at different computational budgets, to see when a joint model may be a defendible choice against the regular practice of keeping a separate classifier and generator. We find that the best joint model is a probabilistic circuit at the smallest budgets and, beyond that, a tabular foundation model that generates column by column using a regressor (TabICL). Compared with pairs of separate models, this study finds a joint model is rarely preferable but often very close to the best pair, without the hassle of training and maintaining two separate models.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项实证研究，在29个分类数据集上以FLOPs和实际耗时为预算度量，比较了基于能量模型、概率电路、表格基础模型和表格扩散模型四类家族的联合分类-生成模型，并与"独立分类器+独立生成器"的组合方案对比，发现最小预算下概率电路最优，更大预算下TabICL最优；联合模型很少占优但通常非常接近最佳组合。
AI.motivation: 表格数据上的机器学习应用常同时需要分类器与真实记录生成器，默认做法是训练两个独立模型；单一联合模型可从一套权重同时提供二者，但"哪类联合模型在何种计算预算下更优"缺乏系统比较。此外，还需回答联合模型相对常规"分离式"实践是否值得选择。
AI.method: 将四类先进表格建模家族（能量模型、概率电路、表格基础模型、表格扩散模型）改造为联合模型，在29个分类数据集上按实测FLOPs与墙钟时间刻画计算预算；采用两个聚合评分分别度量预测与生成的不同侧面；并将每个联合模型与"分离分类器+生成器"的所有配对在不同预算下对比。
AI.result: 最小预算下最佳联合模型为概率电路；预算增大后最佳为逐列生成（以回归器生成各列）的表格基础模型TabICL。与分离模型配对相比，联合模型很少更优，但常接近最佳配对，且免去了训练与维护两个模型的负担。
AI.conclusion: 联合方案在多数情形下并非性能最优，但在成本-效果上是一个可辩护的选择：在预算受限或工程简易性优先时尤为合理；实践建议为先明确预算区间，再据此选择概率电路或TabICL，并以最佳分离配对作为性能上界参照。

title: Support2Sim: Visually Faithful Real2Sim with Stable Object Supports
summary: Reconstructing a scene for physics simulation requires recovering its spatial layout and the support relationships that govern its behavior. We present Support2Sim, a Real2Sim system that reconstructs simulation-ready scenes from a single RGB image. Our design objective is to maximize source fidelity, support realization, and stability within a practical time budget for scene generation. Support2Sim infers a support graph, which a contact-guided pose initializer uses to propose poses for objects with multiple supports. The initializer generates and ranks candidates by geometric fit and source-image agreement. A coarse-to-fine refiner allocates a fixed search budget across supported objects and evaluates pose updates with physics rollouts. After an accepted update, it searches from the new pose at a finer translation and rotation scale. We benchmark our method on 50 scenes spanning four datasets. Compared with the strongest baseline, Support2Sim improves source-mask IoU after 10 seconds by 21.4 pp, realizes 87.1% versus 73.2% of intended supports, and reduces mean object drift from 79.6 to 45.3 mm. See our project page at https://support2sim.github.io for more details.

AI.tldr: Support2Sim：从单张RGB图像重建可仿真的物理场景，通过推断支撑图、接触引导的位姿初始化与粗到细物理验证精化，在10秒预算内显著提升源图像保真度、支撑实现率与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 场景物理仿真需要恢复空间布局及物体间的支撑关系。现有方法难以在实用时间预算内同时兼顾来源图像保真、支撑关系实现与仿真稳定性。
AI.method: 系统推断支撑图（support graph）；接触引导的位姿初始化器为多支撑物体生成候选并按几何贴合度与源图像一致性排序；粗到细精化器在受支撑物体间分配固定搜索预算，用物理rollout评估位姿更新，接受更新后在新位姿处以更细的平移/旋转尺度继续搜索。
AI.result: 在覆盖四个数据集的50个场景基准上，相比最强基线：10秒后源掩码IoU提升21.4个百分点；支撑实现率87.1%（基线73.2%）；平均物体漂移从79.6mm降至45.3mm。
AI.conclusion: Support2Sim以单图输入即可生成兼顾保真度与物理稳定性的仿真就绪场景，且在有限时间预算下优于现有基线。

title: Reconstructing Natural Images from Brain Activity during Natural Vision
comment: 40 pages, 18 figures, 4 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Reconstructing images from brain activity has two broad goals. The first is to build brain-computer interfaces. The second is to understand how the brain sees. The eyes deliver incomplete, noisy input, so the brain must fill in the gaps with its expectations of what natural scenes look like. This filling-in relies on the brain's prior over natural images. Image reconstruction lets us test which natural image prior best matches the brain's natural image prior. However, most previous work on image reconstruction relies on an unnatural condition: subjects must hold their eyes still. In reality, primates constantly move their eyes to see the world. We introduce a framework for reconstructing images from neural activity while a primate freely views a static natural scene. We record from five monkeys with high-density electrode arrays in the lateral geniculate nucleus (LGN) and primary visual cortex (V1). The recorded receptive fields cover only a small part of the image. Thus, we combine neural activity across eye movements, trials, and sessions to reconstruct the full image. We first present a simple linear method with a 1/f prior. We then scale this approach up with modern deep learning. We train a decoder by tokenizing spiking activity and measured gaze; these tokens are fed into a transformer and diffusion model to reconstruct the full scene. Three factors determine reconstruction quality: the amount of neural evidence combined over viewing time, the accuracy of eye tracking, and the choice of image prior. Our method sets a new state-of-the-art performance in reconstructing natural images from brain activity, across brain recording modalities: fMRI, EEG, MEG and electrophysiology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个在灵长类自由注视静态自然场景时，从神经活动中重建图像的框架，结合高密度电极阵列（LGN与V1）记录，先用1/f先验的简单线性方法，再用将脉冲与眼动token化的Transformer+扩散模型。重建质量由神经证据量、眼动追踪精度与图像先验选择三者决定，并在fMRI、EEG、MEG与电生理等多模态上取得新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 从脑活动重建图像有两大目标：构建脑机接口，以及理解大脑如何"看"世界——即用重建来检验哪个自然图像先验最接近大脑的先验。但既有工作多依赖"固定注视"这一不自然条件，而灵长类实际会不断移动眼睛，因此需要研究自由注视下的重建。
AI.method: 在5只猴子的LGN与V1植入高密度电极阵列记录；由于感受野仅覆盖图像一小部分，将跨眼动、试次与session的神经活动组合以重建完整图像。方法上先给出带1/f先验的简单线性模型，再扩展到深度学习：将脉冲活动与实测注视位置token化，输入Transformer与扩散模型解码完整场景。
AI.result: 重建质量取决于三因素：随注视时间累积的神经证据量、眼动追踪精度、图像先验的选择。该方法在fMRI、EEG、MEG与电生理记录等多种脑记录模态上，均创下从脑活动重建自然图像的新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 自由注视条件下的图像重建框架可行且效果领先，既推进脑机接口，也为比较大脑自然图像先验提供了可检验手段；性能上限由证据累积、眼动精度与先验选择共同决定。

title: Alpha-Beta Pruning via Monadic Continuations
summary: Alpha-beta pruning is a fundamental technique in game-playing AI, enabling efficient minimax search by avoiding the exploration of branches that cannot affect the optimal decision. We present a monadic formulation of alpha-beta pruning based on the combination of the continuation monad and the reader monad. Unlike previous approaches that encode alpha-beta bounds into the types of available moves, our construction records these bounds within monadic outcomes, leaving the move types unchanged. We further show that the ordinary continuation monad suffices to compute not only optimal outcomes but also optimal plays, by extending the outcome type to include the corresponding sequences of moves. This provides an alternative to generalisations of the continuation monad proposed to address the inefficiencies associated with the selection monad in alpha-beta search. We illustrate our approach with an implementation of Tic-Tac-Toe, observing a 39-fold reduction in the number of plays evaluated, compared with exhaustive search, in computing an optimal play. Finally, we formally establish the correctness of our construction by proving that the monadic alpha-beta search computes the same optimal outcomes and plays as exhaustive minimax search. Our results demonstrate how a foundational algorithm in AI can be expressed and verified using standard monadic abstractions, providing a basis for further development of compositional approaches to adversarial search.

AI.tldr: 本文基于延续单子（continuation monad）与读取单子（reader monad）的组合，给出 alpha-beta 剪枝的 monadic 形式化，将界限记录在单子结果而非走子类型中，并证明其与穷举 minimax 搜索等价。
AI.motivation: alpha-beta 剪枝是博弈 AI 的基础技术，但已有单子化工作通常把 alpha-beta 界限编码进可用走子的类型中，导致走子类型被改动；同时以 selection monad 实现 alpha-beta 搜索存在效率问题，催生了多种延续单子的推广。作者希望用标准单子抽象来统一、简化地表达并验证该算法。
AI.method: 构造延续单子与读取单子的组合，把 alpha-beta 界限存放在单子结果（monadic outcomes）里，保持走子类型不变；进一步扩展结果类型以包含走子序列，从而仅用普通延续单子即可同时计算最优结果与最优走法，作为延续单子推广方案的替代。
AI.result: 在井字棋（Tic-Tac-Toe）实现中，计算最优走法时被评估的走法序列数量相比穷举搜索减少约 39 倍；并形式化证明了单子化 alpha-beta 搜索与穷举 minimax 搜索得到相同的最优结果与最优走法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明 AI 中的基础算法可以用标准单子抽象来简洁表达并形式化验证，为对抗搜索的组合式（compositional）方法奠定了可扩展的基础。

title: Seldon TFM family: Seldon-Mini, Seldon and Seldon+
comment: Technical report. 18 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables. Models: https://huggingface.co/Neuralk-AI/seldon and https://huggingface.co/Neuralk-AI/seldon-mini
summary: We introduce Seldon, a family of tabular foundation models. Our classifier Seldon+ ranks first among 15 models on TabBench, our benchmark of 124 classification datasets, and on its variant with missing values. In our own runs of public benchmarks, it also ranks first on BeyondArena IID classification and TabBench-Bio, and second on TabArena classification. The open-weight models Seldon-Mini (27M parameters) and Seldon (213M parameters) both lie on the TabArena Pareto front of Elo against inference time: no entry is both more accurate and faster. On TabArena, Seldon ranks fourth and Seldon-Mini seventh among 109 leaderboard entries, and on the IID track of BeyondArena, Seldon ranks second among 42 entries. Seldon-Mini and Seldon handle both classification and regression, use an architecture similar to those of Kumo-Tabular, TabFM and TabPFN-3.5, and are trained on synthetic tables only.

AI.tldr: 提出表格基础模型系列 Seldon：分类器 Seldon+ 在自建 TabBench（124 个分类数据集）及缺失值变体上排名第一；开源权重 Seldon-Mini（27M）与 Seldon（213M）位于 TabArena 的 Elo–推理时间帕累托前沿，且仅用合成表格训练。
AI.motivation: 表格数据仍缺乏类似 NLP/视觉领域的基础模型；作者希望建立一族在准确率与推理效率上同时具竞争力的表格基础模型，并在统一、含缺失值场景的基准上验证其效果。
AI.method: 构建 Seldon 模型族：分类器 Seldon+，以及开源权重模型 Seldon-Mini（27M 参数）与 Seldon（213M 参数）；两者同时支持分类与回归；架构与 Kumo-Tabular、TabFM、TabPFN-3.5 类似；训练数据仅使用合成表格。评测采用自建 TabBench（124 个分类数据集，含缺失值变体）与公开基准 BeyondArena、TabArena、TabBench-Bio。
AI.result: Seldon+ 在 TabBench 及其缺失值变体上于 15 个模型中排名第一；在作者自跑的公开基准中，BeyondArena IID 分类与 TabBench-Bio 排名第一，TabArena 分类排名第二。Seldon-Mini 与 Seldon 均处于 TabArena 的 Elo–推理时间帕累托前沿（不存在同时更准且更快的条目）。在 TabArena 109 个榜单条目中 Seldon 第四、Seldon-Mini 第七；BeyondArena IID 赛道 42 个条目中 Seldon 第二。
AI.conclusion: Seldon 系列在准确率与效率维度上均具备较强竞争力，且可仅凭合成数据训练获得，为表格基础模型提供了可复现的开源权重方案；但主要领先结果依赖作者自建的 TabBench 及自跑基准，结论的独立性有待第三方复现验证。

title: Risk-Informed Path Planning: Collision and Grounding Avoidance Application for Autonomous Surface Vessels
summary: Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships (MASS) must demonstrate safety before and during operations, necessitating online risk assessment to guide decision-making at sea. This paper presents a risk-informed Rapidly Exploring Random Tree Star (RRT*) path planner that integrates a Bayesian Belief Network (BBN) as an online risk model. The BBN evaluates the probability and severity distribution of hazardous events, which are aggregated into a bounded scalar risk index. During the search, this risk index is evaluated at sample points along candidate edges. The planner optimizes a composite cost function comprising path distance, heading change penalties, and accumulated risk, subject to a hard constraint enforcing a risk acceptance limit. Each search tree vertex stores the BBN posterior at its state, enabling the tree to function as an explainable risk map for individual hazards. We define design requirements for the BBN to serve as the risk model in this context and introduce a runtime model that translates replanning deadlines into strict limits on single risk calculation times. The planner is demonstrated in a simulated harbor entry scenario involving collision and grounding hazards. Measured run times validate that the planner operates within the computational bounds predicted by the runtime model for a single replanning cycle.

AI.tldr: 提出一种风险感知的RRT*路径规划器，将贝叶斯信念网络（BBN）作为在线风险模型嵌入搜索过程，实现受风险接受上限约束的自主水面船舶路径规划，并在仿真港口进港场景中验证了运行时可行性。
AI.motivation: 自主水面船舶（MASS）在运营前及运营中须证明安全性，需要在线风险评估以支持海上决策。现有路径规划器通常缺乏可解释、可量化且计算可控的在线风险模型。
AI.method: 方法核心为：1) 以BBN评估危险事件的发生概率与严重度分布，聚合成有界标量风险指数；2) 在RRT*搜索中沿候选边采样点评估该风险；3) 优化由路径长度、航向变化惩罚与累积风险构成的复合代价函数，并施加风险接受极限作为硬约束；4) 每个搜索树顶点存储其状态下的BBN后验，使搜索树成为可解释的逐类危险风险地图；5) 给出BBN作为此类风险模型的设计要求，并提出将重规划截止时间转化为单次风险计算时间严格上限的运行时模型。
AI.result: 在包含碰撞与搁浅危险的仿真港口进港场景中完成演示；实测运行时间满足运行时模型所预测的单次重规划周期计算边界。
AI.conclusion: BBN-RRT*集成方案可在硬性风险约束下生成安全路径，且计算耗时有可预测的理论界，为MASS在线风险感知决策提供了兼顾安全性、可解释性与实时性的可行框架。

title: Change the Base, Change the Game: Rethinking Pan-sharpening
comment: The first two authors contributed equally to this work (equal contribution). Please visit our project page at this https://kaist-viclab.github.io/PanBase_site/
summary: Many pan-sharpening (PS) networks reconstruct high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) images by adding learned residuals to 4$\times$-interpolated low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) inputs, incorporating panchromatic (PAN) detail only through these residual corrections. This raises a simple question: Why start with a blurry base when sharp spatial detail is already available? We propose PanBase, a sharper multispectral starting point designed for more effective residual learning. Guided by physical sensor characteristics, PanBase combines PAN spatial detail with LRMS spectral information while enforcing consistency with the LRMS observations under sensor-specific blur. We construct this base without neural network training, estimating only nine coefficients per spectral band through closed-form calibration. Our PanBase can be easily integrated into existing backbones with a global residual skip through two simple changes: (i) replacing the skip base with PanBase and (ii) concatenating it as an additional input. Using each backbone's original training recipe and matched training budgets, PanBase improves most reduced- and full-resolution metrics on WorldView-3, QuickBird, and GaoFen-2, while achieving 4.4$\times$ faster training convergence on average. In zero-shot evaluation on WorldView-2, standalone PanBase achieves competitive reconstruction without target-sensor fitting or neural refinement.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于传感器物理特性的更清晰残差学习起点PanBase，替代4×插值LRMS基线，以每波段9个闭式标定系数构造，可无缝嵌入现有骨干网络，提升多项指标并平均加速训练收敛4.4倍。
AI.motivation: 现有全色锐化网络均以4×上采样的低分辨率多光谱（LRMS）图像作为残差学习的起点，仅通过残差修正引入全色（PAN）细节。这种"模糊基线"使得网络需额外承担恢复空间细节的负担，学习效率受限。作者质疑：既然锐利的空间细节已可得，为何还要从模糊基线出发？
AI.method: 提出PanBase作为更锐利的多光谱起点：以物理传感器特性为先验，将PAN空间细节与LRMS光谱信息融合，并在传感器特定模糊核下约束其与LRMS观测的一致性。该基线无需神经网络训练，仅通过闭式解对每个光谱带标定9个系数。集成方式极简：(i) 以PanBase替换残差跳连的基线；(ii) 将其拼接为额外输入。
AI.result: 在WorldView-3、QuickBird、GaoFen-2数据集上，沿用各骨干原始训练配方与相同训练预算，PanBase在多数降分辨率与全分辨率指标上均带来提升，且平均训练收敛速度加快4.4倍；在WorldView-2的零样本评测中，单独使用PanBase（无需目标传感器拟合或神经精修）即可获得有竞争力的重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 更合理的残差学习基线设计可同时提升精度与训练效率，物理先验+闭式标定的轻量方案具备良好的通用性与可插拔性，并展现出跨传感器泛化潜力。

title: FigmaEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating AI Agents in Professional UI Design
summary: Recent advances in AI agents have enabled autonomous UI design using professional tools such as Figma, yet evaluating their design capabilities remains challenging due to the open-ended nature of design tasks and the absence of unique ground truths. We introduce FigmaEval, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on professional UI design tasks, comprising 84 tasks and 783 screens derived from real-world Figma design files. FigmaEval adopts a constrained-specification, open-solution paradigm, standardizing task requirements and design resources while allowing agents to independently determine layouts, visual hierarchies, component composition, and visual presentation. To assess design quality beyond reference similarity, we develop 22 expert-grounded evaluation rubrics across six dimensions and introduce a human evaluation arena where professional designers compare agent-generated designs through blinded pairwise judgments. Evaluating eleven models under a unified Figma agent setup, we find substantial agreement between rubric-based assessments and human preferences, alongside distinct differences in design practices and quality--efficiency trade-offs. FigmaEval provides a framework for systematically assessing professional UI design capabilities and understanding the strengths and limitations of current AI agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FigmaEval，一个面向专业 UI 设计任务的 AI agent 评测基准，包含 84 个任务、783 个来自真实 Figma 文件的界面；采用"约束规格、开放解法"范式，构建 22 条六维度专家评分量表并引入人类盲评竞技场，在统一 agent 框架下评测 11 个模型，发现量表评分与人类偏好高度一致，且模型间在设计实践与质量-效率权衡上存在明显差异。
AI.motivation: AI agent 已能借助 Figma 等专业工具自主完成 UI 设计，但设计任务开放性强、不存在唯一标准答案，导致其设计能力难以客观评估；现有评测多依赖与参考稿的相似度，无法衡量真实设计质量。
AI.method: 构建 FigmaEval 基准（84 任务、783 屏，源自真实 Figma 设计文件），采用约束规格-开放解法的评测范式：统一任务需求与设计资源，而布局、视觉层级、组件组合与视觉呈现由 agent 自主决定。同时设计 22 条专家驱动的评分量表，覆盖六个维度，并搭建人类评测竞技场，由专业设计师对 agent 生成设计进行盲评两两比较。在统一的 Figma agent 设置下评测 11 个模型。
AI.result: 量表化自动评估与人类偏好之间呈显著一致性；不同模型在设计实践模式及质量—效率权衡上表现出明显差异。
AI.conclusion: FigmaEval 为系统评估专业 UI 设计能力提供了可复用框架，有助于理解当前 AI agent 在设计任务中的优势与局限。

title: Pando: Noise-Coupled Parallel Draft Trees for Efficient Edge Speculative Decoding
summary:
Autoregressive (AR) decoding emits one token per forward pass, reloading the full model each time, so LLM inference on edge devices is memory-bound while the compute units sit idle. Speculative decoding puts that idle compute to work by verifying several drafted tokens in a single pass. State-of-the-art parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark propose an entire block of draft tokens in one forward pass, which makes drafting compute-efficient. However, they are deployed with draft chains whose length is capped by the block size they are trained for, leaving most of the computational budget for verification unused.
  To tackle this problem, we propose Pando, which builds dynamic draft trees on top of a parallel drafter and thereby removes this cap. Pando employs noise-coupled pruning, which draws the target model's sampling noise before drafting and ranks candidate branches under that noise, so the tree retains the branches the target will actually sample. Noise coupling is lossless and requires no retraining or additional model pass, yet increases acceptance length by up to $8.4\%$ on Qwen3-8B. To optimize and evaluate Pando configurations across hardware, we normalize an operator-level roofline to AR decoding, reducing every platform to its ridge point. On a representative edge device, a 16-node Pando tree attains $5.3\times$ speedup and $4.2\times$ energy reduction over AR decoding: $25\%$ faster than DSpark's released chain, and $27\%$ faster and $72\%$ more energy-efficient than an EAGLE-3 tree. The best configurations remain memory-bound on every edge device we model, so added compute capacity does not reduce their latency.

AI.tldr: 提出 Pando，在并行草稿器上构建动态草稿树以解除草稿链长度上限，并用噪声耦合剪枝保留目标模型真正会采样的分支，实现无损加速。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码逐 token 生成需反复加载全模型，边缘推理受内存带宽限制而算力闲置；推测解码可利用闲置算力，但 DFlash、DSpark 等并行草稿器受块大小限制，草稿链长度被截断，验证阶段的计算预算大量浪费。
AI.method: 在并行草稿器之上构建动态草稿树（如 16 节点树）以取代固定长度草稿链；核心为噪声耦合剪枝：在草稿前先抽取目标模型的采样噪声，并在该噪声下对候选分支排序，从而保留目标模型实际会采样的路径；该方法无损、无需重训练、无需额外前向。另将算子级 roofline 归一到 AR 解码，把各平台约化为脊点以便跨硬件调优与评估。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B 上接受长度提升最高 8.4%；在代表性边缘设备上，16 节点 Pando 树相对 AR 解码达 5.3× 加速与 4.2× 能耗降低，比 DSpark 已发布链快 25%，比 EAGLE-3 树快 27% 且能效高 72%。
AI.conclusion: 动态草稿树可突破并行草稿器的链长上限并提升验证预算利用率；然而最优配置在所有建模边缘设备上仍为内存受限，额外算力无法进一步降低延迟，说明后续优化应聚焦内存访问与带宽。

title: Simulator-as-Proxy World Model for Robot Manipulation
comment: 27 pages. Project page: https://sim-pwm.pages.dev Code: https://github.com/TingtingLiao/SimPWM
summary: Video world models for robots are increasingly conditioned on a simulated or rendered proxy of the scene, on the assumption that the video will show what the proxy shows. Testing this assumption requires a proxy whose state is explicit and can be perturbed. We present SimPWM (Simulator-as-Proxy World Model): given a calibrated camera, it represents, from the first frame alone, the robot by its 3D model and the objects the gripper may touch as 3D points; a rule-based simulator with no trained parameters moves them under the actions, and a video model renders the result. SimPWM returns the realistic video together with the simulated state. We then freeze the simulated objects while the arm moves as recorded and check whether the video still shows the object lifted. On DROID episodes from unseen setups, the answer differs for the arm and for the objects. With each of three base video models, the arm follows the proxy (robot IoU 0.75-0.78, against at most 0.69 for end-to-end models); rendering the robot alone already gives this. What the simulated objects add is the object state: against a robot-only proxy, they cut missed pick-ups from 54% to 38%, and the video follows them only with some base models: on rigid objects, freezing them lowers the lift rate of MiniMax-H3, fine-tuned on episodes whose simulation agrees with the real video, from 42% to 10%, but that of LTX-2.3, trained on the same episodes, only from 57% to 49%, as if it inferred the grasp from the arm motion; more than half of the remaining lifts of MiniMax-H3 are of cloth and rope, which the simulator carries rigidly. With any base model, the simulated state records what the simulation did; under perturbed actions, a video that disagrees with it reveals that the video ignores the simulated state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SimPWM（Simulator-as-Proxy World Model）：仅凭标定相机与首帧，用机器人3D模型与物体3D点表示场景，由无训练参数的规则模拟器在动作下演化状态、再由视频模型渲染，从而获得"真实感视频+可解释模拟状态"的代理。通过在DROID未见场景上冻结模拟物体做扰动实验，发现视频模型对机械臂的跟随强、对物体状态则依赖基座模型。
AI.motivation: 机器人视频世界模型越来越多地以仿真/渲染代理为条件，隐含假设"视频会呈现代理所呈现的内容"。验证该假设需要一个状态显式且可被扰动的代理，而现有端到端模型缺乏可显式干预的状态表示，难以检验其对模拟状态的遵循程度。
AI.method: 从首帧出发，用机器人3D模型与抓取可能接触物体的3D点建立场景表示；使用无训练参数的规则模拟器在给定动作下推进位姿与物体状态；再由现成视频模型渲染出写实视频，同时输出模拟状态。关键验证手段为扰动实验：固定模拟物体不动、机械臂按记录运动，检测视频是否仍表现物体被抬起。
AI.result: 在未见装置配置的DROID片段上，机械臂与物体结论不同。三种基座视频模型下机械臂均跟随代理（机器人IoU 0.75–0.78，端到端模型至多0.69），且仅渲染机器人即可达成。加入模拟物体后漏拾率由54%降至38%；视频对物体的跟随因模型而异：MiniMax-H3在冻结刚体时抬升率由42%降至10%，而同样数据训练的LTX-2.3仅由57%降至49%，提示其从机械臂运动推断抓取；MiniMax-H3剩余抬升中过半为布、绳等被模拟器刚体化处理的物体。
AI.conclusion: 模拟状态可被任何基座模型如实记录，但视频不一定遵循它：在扰动动作下，与模拟状态不一致的视频即暴露其忽略模拟状态。机械臂条件易被满足，物体状态才是代理信息的核心；不同基座模型对模拟状态的依赖程度存在显著差异，且软体/柔性物体的刚体建模是剩余误差来源。

title: Distractors are the Real Enemy: Visual Distraction Adversarial Perturbations on SAM2-Based Video Tracking and Segmentation
summary: Promptable video trackers such as SAM2 achieve accurate and robust performance through strong temporal consistency, making them important foundations for downstream video understanding and tracking applications. As their use continues to expand, understanding their robustness to adversarial perturbations becomes increasingly important. Existing attacks on SAM2 largely focus on local mask degradation and short-term temporal feature disruption, leaving its longer-term dynamics and competing object interferences (Distractors) insufficiently explored. We observe that SAM2 itself exposes useful distractor cues when tracking becomes uncertain. Based on these observations, we propose DistractAttack, a white-box attack that uses background distractors to disrupt target tracking persistently. Its core procedure, Counterfactual Distractor Search (CDS), propagates clean and attacked trajectories in parallel to discover plausible competing regions and identify those that become increasingly effective under perturbation. The discovered evidence is accumulated over time to weaken target support and promote recurrent alternatives or disappearance predictions. Extensive experiments under video-level and one-shot perturbations across Visual Object Tracking and Video Object Segmentation demonstrate strong attack effectiveness, raising DRE to $4.4\times$ and NRE to $7.3\times$ their nearest baselines under video perturbation, while transferring effectively across model scales and tracker variants in black-box settings. Project page: https://adonaydem.github.io/sam2-da-page/

AI.tldr: 提出 DistractAttack：利用背景干扰物持续破坏 SAM2 跟踪的白盒对抗攻击方法，核心为反事实干扰物搜索（CDS），在 VOT/VOS 上大幅超越现有基线并具黑盒迁移性。
AI.motivation: SAM2 等可提示视频跟踪器依赖强时序一致性，其安全性至关重要；现有攻击多集中于局部掩码退化与短期时序特征扰动，缺乏对长程动态与竞争性干扰物的研究。作者观察到 SAM2 在跟踪不确定时会暴露有用的干扰物线索，据此设计攻击。
AI.method: 白盒攻击框架 DistractAttack：核心为反事实干扰物搜索（CDS），并行传播干净轨迹与被攻击轨迹，以挖掘可信的竞争区域（干扰物），并筛选在扰动下逐渐更具竞争力的候选；将随时间累积的证据用于削弱目标支持，促成反复出现的替代预测或目标消失预测。
AI.result: 在 VOT 与 VOS 任务的视频级扰动与单帧（one-shot）扰动设置下均表现出强攻击效果：视频扰动下 DRE 提升至最近基线的 4.4 倍、NRE 提升至 7.3 倍；并在不同模型规模与跟踪器变体的黑盒设置中有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: 利用跟踪器自身暴露的干扰物线索构建长程、持续性攻击是可行且高效的，DistractAttack 揭示了 SAM2 类跟踪器在时序动态与干扰竞争层面上的安全脆弱性，具备跨模型迁移能力。

title: The Control-Flow Tax: Specialized Decision Routing for LLM Agent Workflows
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Shuanghu Wang and Li Jiang share second authorship
summary: An agent can spend almost as much deciding what to do as doing it. In our documentation workflow, control-flow routing accounts for 42.5% of baseline reference cost on the initial task. Lower token prices alone do not solve this control-flow tax: inexpensive general-purpose routers can trigger additional calls to the expensive generator. We evaluate a heterogeneous architecture in which Jev, a specialized System 1 decision model, controls finite actions while Sol generates documents. Across four software tasks, 480 valid runs comprise 470 completions and ten request-limit endpoints. Jev full routing achieves the lowest mean cost and elapsed time on every task, completing all 40 specialist-controlled runs along the shortest trajectory. On the initial task, mean cost falls by 49.6% (95% paired-bootstrap interval: 42.9% to 56.3%) and elapsed time by 33.2% (19.6% to 46.7%). Across three further tasks, cost reductions are 40.5% to 42.9% and concurrent elapsed-time reductions are 12.9% to 14.4%. Existence-only specialization saves just 1.8% on the initial task. Separately, Sol and Jev each select accepted actions on 100/100 reviewed retail states, with Jev using 97.88% less reference cost and 72.30% less mean request time. The results identify two requirements for efficient agent control: inexpensive decisions and trajectories that preserve those savings.

AI.tldr: 提出异构"System 1/System 2"架构：由专用小模型Jev负责控制流路由（有限动作决策），大模型Sol负责文档生成，从而降低智能体的"控制流税"。四个软件任务480次运行显示，Jev全路由在每项任务上均取得最低平均成本与最短耗时，初始任务成本降49.6%、耗时降33.2%。
AI.motivation: 智能体在"决定做什么"上的开销几乎与"实际执行"相当：在文档工作流中，控制流路由占初始任务基线参考成本的42.5%。仅降低token单价无法解决该"控制流税"，因为廉价通用路由器可能额外触发对昂贵生成器的调用。
AI.method: 评估异构架构：专用决策模型Jev（System 1，低成本、有限动作空间）负责控制流路由，Sol负责文档生成。在四个软件任务上开展实验，共480次有效运行（470次完成、10次触及请求上限）。对比条件包括Jev全路由、仅存在性特化（existence-only specialization）等，并采用配対bootstrap置信区间进行统计检验；另在100个零售状态上对比Sol与Jev的动作选择质量。
AI.result: Jev全路由在每个任务上取得最低平均成本与最短耗时，40次特化控制运行全部沿最短轨迹完成。初始任务平均成本下降49.6%（95%配对bootstrap区间42.9%–56.3%），耗时下降33.2%（19.6%–46.7%）；其余三项任务成本降40.5%–42.9%，并发耗时降12.9%–14.4%。仅存在性特化在初始任务上仅节省1.8%。在100个经审核的零售状态上，Sol与Jev均100/100选择被接受的动作，而Jev的参考成本低97.88%、平均请求时间低72.30%。
AI.conclusion: 高效智能体控制需满足两个条件：(1) 决策本身廉价；(2) 轨迹能够保持这些节省（避免额外调用昂贵生成器）。将控制流决策与内容生成解耦的专用化设计可显著降低控制流税，而单纯的模型存在性特化收益有限。

title: CoMNO: Commutator Memory Neural Operators for Long-Horizon PDE Prediction
comment: In preparing an earlier version of this manuscript under time pressure, we did not adequately verify all reported experimental results. In this preprint, we correct the numerical reporting errors we identified and update the affected analyses
summary: Solving nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs) over long time horizons is computationally expensive using traditional numerical methods. While neural operators provide an efficient alternative, they suffer from the accumulation of approximation errors along the predicted trajectory, typically caused by the failure to capture fine-scale details. In this work, we design a Commutator Memory Neural Operator that identifies fine-scale dynamical details by commuting two operations and leverages these details to enhance the neural operator's capability in capturing fine-scale features over long time horizons. Specifically, we identify a performance gap between two operations: downsampling the high-resolution field before rollout prediction versus performing rollout prediction before downsampling. We observe that fine-scale dynamical details are often encoded in this gap. By commuting these two operations, the fine-scale details removed during downsampling can be captured. Furthermore, we employ a memory module to store these fine-scale features along the trajectory and retrieve them during rollout, generating spatially adaptive corrections that enhance long-horizon fidelity. Empirical results across five systems demonstrate that CoMNO improves prediction accuracy and long-horizon rollout stability.

AI.tldr: 提出Commutator Memory Neural Operator (CoMNO)，通过"交换"下采样与rollout两个操作识别细尺度动力学细节，并用记忆模块存储与检索这些特征，提升神经算子长时程PDE预测精度与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统数值方法求解长时程非线性PDE计算代价高；神经算子虽高效，但沿预测轨迹会累积近似误差，其根源在于难以捕捉细尺度细节，导致长期rollout精度下降与不稳定。
AI.method: 核心思想是对比两种操作顺序造成的性能差异：（1）先对高分辨率场下采样再rollout；（2）先rollout再下采样。二者之差即为下采样所丢失的细尺度动力学信息。通过交换（commute）这两个操作显式捕获该细节；再引入记忆模块，沿轨迹存储细尺度特征，并在rollout过程中检索，生成空间自适应的修正项。
AI.result: 在五个系统上的实验表明，CoMNO提高了预测精度，并改善了长时程rollout的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 利用操作交换间隙提取细尺度动力学细节、辅以记忆模块进行空间自适应校正，是一种有效缓解神经算子长时程误差累积的通用策略。

title: Keypose or Dense? A Controlled Comparison of Action Representations for Stage-Structured Manipulation
summary: Most imitation policies that predict chunks of future actions use the dense action representation, in which the chunk holds one control target per step. In stage-structured manipulation, where a task can be divided into stages with definable endpoints, the keypose action representation instead sets each step of the chunk to the endpoint of the stage that step belongs to, and a speed-capped servo supplies the motion. We compare the two in several simulated manipulation tasks and on a real robot, with the same chunk length and matched demonstrations, observations, policy architectures and update budgets; in simulation, each one's execution rule is selected on tuning scenes. When the simulated demonstrations are slowed, paused and rerouted, dense success falls sharply while keypose stays roughly level, across three policy architectures and with endpoints extracted from the recorded demonstrations; keypose also leads under object-size and position shift. With clean demonstrations, keypose leads only when they are scarce and is otherwise close to or behind dense across the simulated tasks, provided that the demonstrations and execution rule suit its executor; when they do not, it falls far below dense. The same dependence on the executor appeared on a real robot learning to open a drawer from human demonstrations: dense succeeded more often, and keypose improved substantially only after its executor's rotation and forward speed were adjusted to the demonstrations. These results suggest that keypose trades sensitivity to such variation in the demonstrations for sensitivity to execution that departs from them.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了动作分块模仿学习中两种动作表示——稠密动作表示与关键位姿（keypose）表示，发现在演示被减速、暂停、改道等扰动时，keypose 的成功率基本保持稳定而稠密方法显著下降；但在干净演示与执行器匹配良好的条件下，keypose 仅在演示稀缺时占优，否则持平或落后。
AI.motivation: 在阶段化（stage-structured）操作任务中，任务可分解为具有明确终点的若干阶段，关键位姿表示（每步取所属阶段的终点，并由限速伺服驱动）是一种自然的替代方案；但其相对稠密动作表示（每步一个控制目标）的优劣条件尚不明确，需要公平受控的比较。
AI.method: 在相同分块长度、匹配的演示、观测、策略架构与更新预算下，于多个仿真操作任务与真机上对比两种表示；仿真中各自的执行规则在调参场景上选定；关键位姿的端点从录制演示中提取；考察演示被减速、暂停、改道以及物体尺寸与位置偏移等扰动，并跨三种策略架构验证。
AI.result: 仿真中，演示经减速、暂停、改道处理后，稠密方法成功率急剧下降而 keypose 大致持平（三种策略架构均如此）；在物体尺寸与位置偏移下 keypose 也领先。干净演示下，keypose 仅在演示稀缺时领先，其余情况持平或落后，前提是演示与执行规则适配其执行器；不适配时远低于稠密。真机开抽屉任务中，稠密成功率更高，keypose 仅在其执行器的旋转速度与前向速度按演示调整后才大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: keypose 以降低对演示时序变化（速度、暂停、路径）的敏感性为代价，换取对执行器偏离演示的敏感性；其优势条件是演示噪声大或稀缺、且执行器与演示匹配良好，此时可作为稠密表示的有效替代。

title: DynaCue: Comparing Motion and Timing Between Groups of Videos
summary: A score that distinguishes videos with different temporal-consistency ratings can miss differences associated with motion preference. VideoScore's temporal consistency score distinguished higher- from lower-rated Pika videos in 95% of comparisons with 15 videos per group, yet could not detect the difference between preferred videos and their same-prompt alternatives in any of the 200 comparisons of 41 VideoGen-RewardBench pairs. We introduce DynaCue, a two-sample permutation test that combines complementary measurements of motion, frame continuity, and appearance to compare groups of videos without choosing a single cue in advance. DynaCue measures local changes in optical flow both before and after accounting for each clip's usual activity, captures interruptions through frame differences and freeze counts, and incorporates scores for motion and appearance. In controlled experiments, DynaCue detected group differences across five interventions affecting playback continuity, displacement, or rhythm. In real-world evaluations of generated videos where viewers rated temporal consistency or chose which of two videos they preferred for its motion, DynaCue detected group differences in at least 80% of resampled comparisons on each of the three datasets at the smaller sample sizes studied. Every other method evaluated on all three had a detection rate of 60% or less on at least one dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DynaCue：一种融合光流局部变化、帧差/冻结计数与运动外观评分的两组样本置换检验，用于比较视频组在运动偏好上的差异；在5种受控干预与3个真实数据集上检测率≥80%，显著优于其他方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频质量评价的时序一致性分数虽能区分整体评分不同的视频（如95%比较中可区分Pika视频高低分组），却无法检测"同提示下用户偏好的视频与其替代品"之间的差异（41对、200次比较全部失败），说明单一标量分数会遗漏与运动偏好相关的差异，需要多线索、组水平的统计检验方法。
AI.method: DynaCue为两样本置换检验框架，不预先选定单一线索，而是组合三类互补测量：(1)在扣除每个片段自身常规活动水平前后分别度量光流的局部变化；(2)通过帧间差异与冻结帧计数捕捉播放中断；(3)引入运动与外观评分。
AI.result: 受控实验中，DynaCue在影响播放连续性、位移或节奏的5种干预下均检测出组间差异；在观看者对时序一致性评分或对两视频运动偏好二选一的真实生成视频评测中，DynaCue在三个数据集、较小样本条件下重采样比较的检测率均≥80%；而在三个数据集上全部评测的其他方法，至少在一个数据集上检测率≤60%。
AI.conclusion: 单一标量分数不足以刻画与人类运动偏好相关的差异；多线索组合的组水平置换检验（DynaCue）在灵敏度和跨数据集稳健性上均优于现有方法，为生成视频运动质量评估提供了更可靠的评测手段。

title: Can AI Design a Better nnU-Net? A Hypothesis-Driven Architecture Discovery Loop from Failures to Design Rules
summary: Neural architecture search and LLM-driven evolution often reduce evaluation to a scalar fitness score, discarding failures that could explain why designs succeed or fail. We present a hypothesis-driven architecture discovery loop in which LLM agents diagnose structured error patterns, formulate falsifiable hypotheses, test counterfactual controls under a frozen nnU-Net pipeline, and distill validated mechanisms into executable trigger-to-action rules. Across eight search waves, the loop identifies two principles for 3D medical image segmentation. First, reallocating computation from high-resolution decoders to the mid-encoder preserves thin-anatomy boundaries while reducing cost. Second, support-confined region contrast addresses errors between nested anatomical compartments, with anatomy-dependent triggers selecting when the rule applies. These principles produce LeanNeXt (0.78 MACs and 0.92 training-step time relative to nnU-Net; +1.63 Dice points on four-fold KiTS23 cross-validation) and trigger-routed LeanNeXt+. The latter improves all 15 evaluated CT/MRI settings over nnU-Net and exceeds the 3.3 larger ResEnc-M on 12 of 15 benchmarks at 0.30 its parameter count. Relative to random sampling, one-shot LLM generation, and score-selected agent search, the loop shows how failure analysis can yield reusable design rules across modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出假设驱动的架构发现闭环：LLM智能体诊断结构化错误模式、提出可证伪假设、在冻结nnU-Net流程下做反事实对照实验，并将验证的机制蒸馏为可执行"触发器-动作"规则，最终得到LeanNeXt与LeanNeXt+。
AI.motivation: 现有神经架构搜索与LLM驱动进化普遍把评估压缩为单一标量适应度分数，丢弃了能解释设计为何成功或失败的失败信息，导致搜索效率低、结论难以复用。
AI.method: 构建LLM智能体参与的假设驱动发现闭环：诊断结构化错误模式→形成可证伪假设→在冻结的nnU-Net基线下进行反事实控制实验→将验证有效的机制蒸馏为可执行的trigger-to-action规则；共进行八轮搜索波次，并与随机采样、一次性LLM生成、按分数选择的智能体搜索三类基线对比。
AI.result: 提炼出两条3D医学图像分割设计原则：一是把计算从高分辨率解码器重新分配到中层编码器，在降低成本的同时保持细薄解剖结构边界；二是支持域受限的区域对比，缓解嵌套解剖腔室间的误差，并由解剖相关的触发器决定规则是否生效。由此得到LeanNeXt（MACs为nnU-Net的0.78倍、训练步时间为0.92倍，四折KiTS23交叉验证Dice提升1.63分）及触发器路由版LeanNeXt+，后者在全部15个CT/MRI设置上优于nnU-Net，并在15个基准中的12个上超过参数量为其3.3倍的ResEnc-M，而参数量仅为后者的0.30倍。
AI.conclusion: 以失败分析为核心的假设驱动闭环能产出可跨模态复用的设计规则，显著优于随机采样、一次性LLM生成与分数选择式智能体搜索。

title: DAiSy: Online Data Selection by Adaptive Utility Estimation for LLM Pretraining
summary: Model-aware online data selection prioritizes the training documents that contribute the most given the model's current state. Existing online selectors rank candidates upon gradient-based data utility scores, which requires the full forward-backward pass of the main model on every candidate document. Scoring each document therefore pays as much as training on it, yet only a small fraction is used for the real model update. We introduce DAiSy, a lightweight linear auxiliary model that learns to predict data utility scores from frozen document embeddings, which eliminates the computation overhead and infrastructure burdens. The linear estimator is updated alongside the main language model, fitting to the exact gradient-based utility scores obtained from the backward pass of regular training steps. Consequently, scoring a candidate requires only a linear transformation, bypassing the costly gradient-alignment computation. We demonstrate its effectiveness and efficiency for LLM pretraining in English and multilingual scenarios, with various steering target designs. The improvements from DAiSy can consistently survive the instruction-tuning phase.

AI.tldr: 提出DAiSy：用轻量线性辅助模型从冻结文档嵌入预测数据效用分数，替代逐候选文档的完整前向-反向传播打分，实现低成本在线数据选择。
AI.motivation: 现有在线选择器依赖梯度类数据效用分数，需要对每个候选文档跑主模型完整的前向-反向传播；打分成本与训练一份文档相当，但最终只有极少比例的数据真正参与模型更新，性价比极低。
AI.method: 训练一个线性辅助模型，以冻结的文档嵌入为输入预测数据效用分数；该线性估计器与主语言模型同步更新，拟合常规训练步骤反向传播所得到的精确梯度类效用分数。因此对候选文档打分只需一次线性变换，无需梯度对齐计算，从而消除算力开销与基础设施负担。
AI.result: 在英文与多语言LLM预训练场景、多种引导目标设计下验证了方法的有效性与效率；DAiSy带来的增益在指令微调阶段后仍能稳定保持。
AI.conclusion: 用从冻结嵌入到效用分数的线性代理打分可近似替代昂贵的梯度对齐打分，显著降低在线数据选择成本，且收益可延续至下游指令微调阶段。

title: Supply Geometry, Learn Execution: Screw Attention for Zero-Shot Policy Transfer in Robot Manipulation
summary: We present the Screw Attention Policy, a geometry-centric manipulation framework that supplies task geometry explicitly and learns only execution. The policy operates on object poses, relative SE(3) transforms, and joint screw axes provided by perception and robot models. The policy requires only 30K learned parameters. Trained entirely in simulation on a single robot arm, the policy generalises to new scene layouts, transfers zero-shot across robot embodiments, and deploys directly on a real robot, without adaptation or fine-tuning. It achieves 96% success on LIBERO, 85.8% under layout changes, 80.2% across five unseen robot arms, and 21 of 24 trials on a real robot. These results suggest that much of what manipulation policies learn at scale is geometric structure that can instead be supplied.

AI.tldr: 提出Screw Attention Policy：将操作任务的几何结构显式提供给策略，策略仅学习执行，参数仅30K，仿真单臂训练即可泛化到新布局、零样本跨机器人本体迁移并直接部署真机。
AI.motivation: 大规模操作策略所学到的大量内容其实是几何结构，而这类结构可以被显式提供而非从数据中隐式学习，从而大幅降低模型规模与数据依赖。
AI.method: 以几何为中心的操作框架：策略输入为感知与机器人模型提供的物体位姿、相对SE(3)变换及关节螺旋轴（joint screw axes），仅需学习执行部分，可训练参数约30K；完全在仿真中、单一机械臂上训练。
AI.result: LIBERO上96%成功率；布局变化下85.8%；五种未见机械臂上80.2%；真实机器人24次试验成功21次；跨本体零样本迁移无需适配或微调。
AI.conclusion: 操作策略规模化学习到的很大一部分是几何结构，该结构可被显式供给；显式几何+轻量学习执行即可实现强泛化与跨本体迁移。

title: Learning Agent States for Latent Action Modeling
comment: 27 pages, 12 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://agent-state-lam.github.io
summary: Latent action models (LAMs) learn action-like latents from unlabeled video by coupling frame-pair inference with latent-conditioned prediction, enabling policy and world-model pretraining. However, what the latent must explain depends on the representation space used for action inference and transition prediction. When this space entangles the agent's evolving physical state with visual context, such as background and persistent agent appearance, inferred latents can encode information unrelated to the agent's actions. To address this challenge, we propose Agent-State LAM, which jointly learns a compact agent-state representation and latent actions modeling its transitions. The compact state aggregates dense visual features into a shared space for both action inference and forward prediction. To guide what this state retains, we introduce spatially matched temporal discrimination (SMTD), which trains the state to distinguish its source frame from nearby frames through spatially flexible matching with frozen local visual features. Rather than comparing global frame representations, SMTD scores each frame by emphasizing its strongest local feature matches across spatial locations. This scoring allows background and persistent agent appearance to remain matched across frames despite displacement, making these shared cues less informative for identifying the source frame and encouraging the representation to capture the agent's evolving physical state. Extensive experiments on distracting control tasks and six real robot video datasets demonstrate improved action recovery, downstream control, and world-model prediction. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mid-Push/Agent-State-LAM.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agent-State LAM，联合学习紧凑的智能体状态表示与建模其转移的潜在动作，并用空间匹配时序判别（SMTD）抑制背景与外观等无关信息，在干扰控制任务及六个真实机器人视频数据集上提升了动作恢复、下游控制与世界模型预测性能。
AI.motivation: 潜在动作模型（LAMs）通过帧对推断与潜在条件预测从无标注视频中学习动作式潜变量，但潜变量必须解释什么取决于动作推断与转移预测所用的表示空间。当该空间把智能体不断变化的物理状态与背景、持久外观等视觉上下文纠缠在一起时，推断出的潜变量会编码与动作无关的信息。
AI.method: 联合学习紧凑的智能体状态表示与刻画其转移的潜在动作；该紧凑状态将稠密视觉特征聚合到共享空间，供动作推断与前向预测共用。引入空间匹配时序判别（SMTD）：借助与冻结局部视觉特征的空间柔性匹配，训练状态区分源帧与邻近帧；不比较全局帧表示，而是通过在每个空间位置强调最强的局部特征匹配为帧打分。
AI.result: 在含干扰的控制任务和六个真实机器人视频数据集上，动作恢复、下游控制与世界模型预测均取得改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过 SMTD 打分使背景与持久外观在位移下仍保持跨帧匹配，从而降低这些共享线索对识别源帧的判别性，促使表示聚焦智能体不断演化的物理状态；代码与检查点已开源。

title: VISE: Verifier-Independent Skill Self-Evolution with Feedback from Tool Implementations
summary: Agent skills provide reusable workflows that guide LLM agents in using tools. Refining these workflows requires feedback on missing or incorrect instructions, but task-specific verifiers are not always available. We propose VISE (Verifier-Independent Skill Evolution), a scripts-first approach that uses tool implementations to guide skill revision. It extracts tool capabilities, input requirements, usage conditions, and output formats from source code. Using the task request and execution trace, it compares this information with current workflow instructions to identify missing or conflicting steps. It then recommends specific edits to SKILL.md, linking each change to the relevant implementation and usage conditions. We evaluate VISE as an additional revision stage for four evolution methods on SkillsBench and SkillLearnBench. Compared with the corresponding No-verifier conditions, it improves overall average task success by 9.14-13.35 percentage points. The proportion of tasks solved in all three runs increases by 12.36-18.29 points. A case study shows how revised instructions connect tool outputs to later steps. These results support tool implementations as a practical feedback source for skill self-evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出 VISE：一种"脚本优先"的、不依赖验证器的技能自演化方法，直接以工具源码实现作为反馈来源修订 SKILL.md，在四个演化方法上使任务成功率提升 9.14–13.35 个百分点。
AI.motivation: Agent skills 是可复用工作流，用于指导 LLM agent 调用工具；改进这些工作流需要关于"缺失或错误指令"的反馈。然而任务特定验证器（task-specific verifier）并非总是可得，导致技能精炼缺乏可靠反馈信号。
AI.method: VISE（Verifier-Independent Skill Evolution）从工具源代码中抽取四类信息：工具能力、输入要求、使用条件、输出格式；结合任务请求与执行轨迹，将该信息与当前 workflow 指令比对，定位缺失或冲突的步骤；随后对 SKILL.md 提出具体编辑建议，并将每处修改链接到相应的实现代码与使用条件。
AI.result: 在 SkillsBench 与 SkillLearnBench 上，作为四种演化方法的附加修订阶段，相比对应 No-verifier 条件，整体平均任务成功率提升 9.14–13.35 个百分点；三次运行全部解出的任务比例提升 12.36–18.29 个百分点。案例研究表明，修订后的指令能够正确衔接工具输出与后续步骤。
AI.conclusion: 工具实现可作为技能自演化的实用反馈源，在缺少验证器时有效替代验证信号；"脚本优先"的修订策略具备可行性与可推广性。

title: SPRUNN: Structural Proximity for Pruning in Deep Neural Networks
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have demonstrated significant accuracy across various machine learning tasks. However, these networks suffer from a huge number of parameters and computations, which leads to time-consuming processes. Consequently, parameter pruning approaches have been proposed to compress DNNs and efficiently implement them. The main challenge in pruning is selecting the appropriate parameters for pruning without significantly damaging the accuracy. In this paper, we propose SPRUNN, an algorithmic pruning approach based on the structural proximity criterion for filter pruning in convolutional layers of deep neural networks. Structural Proximity (SP) calculates filter similarity by considering all filters and comparing each one with the others, effectively identifying less important filters for pruning in the convolutional layers. Furthermore, we integrate this approach with fine-grained pruning in Fully Connected(FC)layerstocompresstheDNNsthatinclude both convolutional and FC layers.Toenhancetheaccuracyoftheprunedmodel,weproposealearning rate refinement strategy during the retraining phase. Experimental results demonstrate that SPRUNN achieves significant compression with high accuracy across diverse architectures and datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出SPRUNN：基于结构邻近性（SP）准则的卷积层滤波器剪枝算法，结合全连接层细粒度剪枝与重训练学习率精调策略，在多架构多数据集上实现高压缩率并保持高精度。
AI.motivation: DNN参数与计算量庞大导致耗时，需压缩；剪枝的核心难点在于选取合适的剪枝参数同时不显著损害精度。
AI.method: 1) 结构邻近性（SP）准则：考虑全部滤波器并两两比较，以滤波器相似度衡量重要性，识别卷积层中较不重要的滤波器并剪除；2) 将该方法与全连接层的细粒度剪枝结合，可压缩同时含卷积层和FC层的网络；3) 在重训练阶段引入学习率精调（learning rate refinement）策略以提升剪枝后模型精度。
AI.result: 实验表明SPRUNN在多种网络架构和数据集上均可实现显著压缩，同时保持较高精度。
AI.conclusion: SPRUNN将全局滤波器相似性度量与细粒度FC剪枝及学习率精调相结合，是一种有效的DNN压缩方案；但摘要未给出具体压缩率与精度数值，且SP准则两两比较带来的计算开销未作说明。

title: MRBench: Benchmarking Physical Necessity Reasoning in Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Manipulation
summary: Recent advances in multi-robot manipulation have shown how robots can collaborate to accomplish complex tasks. However, successful coordination does not reveal which robots are actually needed. The same task may require different teams as robot capabilities change, resources become unavailable, or objects replace robotic support. We argue that reliable multi-robot manipulation requires physical necessity reasoning: understanding what a task demands, which resources can fulfill those demands, and which are truly necessary. We introduce MRBench, a benchmark for physical necessity reasoning in heterogeneous multi-robot manipulation. It comprises eight tasks with distinct concurrency and reach constraints, each evaluated under five configurations that change the required resources while preserving the task goal. Our evaluation reveals that existing coordination agents perform well with reference teams but struggle when robot embodiments change or passive objects can replace robotic support. To address this gap, we propose MRScissors, which separates task requirements from measured physical capabilities and identifies minimal feasible teams through constrained search. Across two model backbones, MRScissors achieves 85.4% and 91.2% team-selection accuracy, outperforming the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 9.5 points, respectively. Together, these findings expose a critical gap between coordinating robots and understanding their physical necessity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“物理必要性推理”问题并构建MRBench基准，评估异构多机器人操作中“哪些机器人真正必要”，并提出MRScissors方法实现最小可行团队选择，准确率达85.4%/91.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有多机器人协调研究只关注“能否协作完成任务”，但成功的协调并不能说明哪些机器人是真正必需的；当机器人能力变化、资源不可用或用被动物体替代机器人支撑时，同一任务所需的团队会不同，因此需要判断任务的物理需求与资源的真实必要性。
AI.method: 构建MRBench基准：包含8个任务，具有不同的并发性与可达性约束，每个任务在5种配置下评估（改变所需资源但保持任务目标不变）。并提出MRScissors，将任务需求与实测物理能力解耦，通过约束搜索识别最小可行团队。
AI.result: 现有协调智能体在有参考团队时表现良好，但在机器人具身改变或被动物体可替代机器人支撑时表现明显下降；MRScissors在两个模型骨干上分别达到85.4%和91.2%的团队选择准确率，比最强基线分别高出10.4和9.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了“协调机器人”与“理解其物理必要性”之间的关键差距，强调可靠的多机器人操作需要物理必要性推理，MRScissors为最小可行团队选择提供了有效方案。

title: HuluOPD: Unifying Heterogeneous Medical Specialists into One Lightweight Model with Unlabeled Prompts
summary: Specialist medical vision-language models (VLMs) are strong within their specialties but hard to unify: their training data are often private, and independently developed specialists cannot be assumed to share an architecture. Deploying these large models separately is costly. We present HuluOPD, an on-policy distillation recipe that unifies heterogeneous specialists into one lightweight VLM using only unlabeled prompts, without requiring reference answers or the specialists' training data. The lightweight model answers each prompt, and the specialist of the prompt's modality supervises its response; a continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss makes this possible even when they differ in architecture and tokenizer. We apply HuluOPD to five specialists, for ultrasound, pathology, optical coherence tomography, fundus photography, and dental imaging. To distill and evaluate them, we build HuluOPDCorpus, 914k unlabeled prompts, and HuluOPDBench, 47k held-out test items, from over 90 public datasets, and score all models under one protocol on 132k test items, including third-party benchmarks. A single model with 10% of the five specialists' combined parameters retains 94% of their question-answering performance, and one with 2% retains 89%. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of unifying heterogeneous medical specialist VLMs without requiring their training data or a shared architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HuluOPD，一种在线策略蒸馏方法，仅用无标注提示即可将五个异构医学专科视觉语言模型统一进单个轻量级VLM，无需参考答案、训练数据或共享架构；10%参数保留94%性能，2%参数保留89%。
AI.motivation: 医学专科VLM在各自领域表现优异但难以统一：训练数据常为私有，独立开发的专科模型架构不共享，单独部署成本高昂。现有方法无法在缺乏训练数据和统一架构的前提下完成整合。
AI.method: 提出HuluOPD在线策略蒸馏配方：轻量模型对每个提示生成回答，由该提示所属模态的专科模型对其响应进行监督；设计"续写对齐的跨分词器损失"（continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss），使架构与分词器不同的模型间蒸馏可行。应用于超声、病理、OCT、眼底照相、牙科影像五个专科模型；构建HuluOPDCorpus（91.4万无标注提示）与HuluOPDBench（4.7万留出测试项），源自90余个公开数据集，并在13.2万测试项（含第三方基准）上按统一协议评测。
AI.result: 单模型以五专科合计参数的10%保留94%的问答性能，2%参数仍保留89%；全部模型在统一协议下完成132k测试项的评测。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首次在不依赖专科模型训练数据与共享架构的条件下实现异构医学专科VLM的统一。

title: RecurSciBench: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement in Data-Driven Scientific Research
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are advancing the automation of data-driven scientific research. Recent advances in recursive self-improvement (RSI) offer the potential for these agents to continuously improve through experience, but evaluating transfer across scientific tasks requires executable, scientifically verifiable tasks and independent assessment of self-improvement gains. We introduce RecurSciBench, a scalable benchmark for evaluating RSI in data-driven scientific research. Its RecurSciPipe framework automatically constructs scientific modeling and data analysis tasks from raw datasets, with execution-based verification and scientific validity checks. RecurSciBench spans four scientific domains, multiple data modalities, and varied scientific objectives. We evaluate four RSI systems by comparing their initial and evolved states on independent tasks after evolution on source tasks, covering within-type, cross-type, and cross-domain transfer. Experiments show that the benefits of self-improvement vary across agent systems and scientific domains. Positive overall gains can coexist with regressions on individual tasks. Experience can transfer across task types and benefit other domains even without measurable gains in the source domain.

AI.tldr: 提出 RecurSciBench 基准（含 RecurSciPipe 自动任务构建框架），用于评估 LLM 智能体在数据驱动科学研究中的递归自我改进（RSI）能力及其跨任务类型、跨领域的可迁移性。
AI.motivation: RSI 使 LLM 智能体有望通过经验持续自我提升，但评估其"自我改进能否迁移到其他科学任务"缺乏可执行、可科学验证的任务集，也缺乏对改进增益的独立评测手段。
AI.method: 构建可扩展基准：RecurSciPipe 从原始数据集自动生成科学建模与数据分析任务，采用基于执行的验证与科学有效性检查；覆盖四个科学领域、多种数据模态与多样科学目标。对四个 RSI 系统进行评测，先在源任务上进化，再在独立任务上比较初始状态与进化后状态，涵盖同类型、跨类型、跨领域三种迁移设定。
AI.result: 自改进收益因智能体系统与科学领域而异；整体正增益可能与个别任务上的性能回退并存；经验可跨任务类型迁移，且即使源领域无显著增益，也能惠及其他领域。
AI.conclusion: RSI 的评测需以可执行、可验证的独立任务为基础；现有 RSI 系统的自我提升并非普遍有效，需区分整体与单任务表现，并重视跨类型、跨领域迁移的潜在价值。

title: When Exact Token Importance Is Not Enough: Limits of Top-K Selection in LLM Attention
summary: Long-context language models often retain only a limited set of past token positions for an attention query. A common strategy scores positions individually and keeps the highest-ranked K. Yet attention weights are renormalized over the chosen set: two individually important positions need not form the best pair. We ask whether independent ranking suffices even when each importance score measures the exact downstream change in next-token predictions caused by deleting that position alone. It does not. A four-position construction makes the ranked pair incur 133.2 times the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of the optimal pair, and a parametric family proves that this multiplicative gap is unbounded. An exact exchange identity and preference reversals for every K >= 2 explain the interaction. In exhaustive frozen-model audits of SmolLM2, Gemma, and Qwen, exact-singleton Top-4 leaves at least 10% relative improvement within a fully enumerated 24-position candidate pool in 55/60, 49/60, and 60/60 cases, respectively. SwapCert, a same-budget one-swap audit, detects 157/164 such cases and returns directly checkable improving supports. A KL-margin certificate relates support fidelity to next-token stability; larger-budget, multi-layer cached-decoding experiments measure predictive fidelity at K = 128 and 256. These results establish joint support quality as an essential object of analysis for sparse attention and motivate downstream-aware support selection under inference constraints.

AI.tldr: 该文论证长上下文稀疏注意力中"逐位置独立打分取Top-K"并非最优：即使打分是精确的单点删除效应，所选支撑集的联合质量也次优，且该乘性差距无上界；并提出SwapCert审计与KL-margin证书。
AI.motivation: 长上下文语言模型的注意力查询只保留少量历史token位置，常用做法是逐位置独立打分并保留排名最高的K个。但注意力权重会在所选集合上重新归一化，两个各自重要的位置未必构成最佳组合。作者要追问：即便每个重要性分数精确度量"单独删除该位置"对下一token预测的下游影响，独立排名是否仍然足够。
AI.method: 构造反例并做理论分析：给出四位置构造使排名配对的KL散度达最优配对的133.2倍，并用参数族证明该乘性差距无界；通过精确交换恒等式与K>=2时的偏好反转解释交互效应。实验上对SmolLM2、Gemma、Qwen进行冻结模型穷举审计，在24位置候选池中全枚举，比较单点精确Top-4与最优支撑；提出同预算单次交换审计方法SwapCert；并给出KL-margin证书联系支撑保真度与下一token稳定性，在K=128、256下用多层级缓存解码实验测量预测保真度。
AI.result: 四位置构造中排名配对的KL散度为最优配对的133.2倍，参数族证明差距无界。穷举审计中，精确单点Top-4在SmolLM2、Gemma、Qwen上分别有55/60、49/60、60/60的案例存在至少10%相对改进空间。SwapCert检出164例中的157例，并返回可直接检验的改进支撑。K=128与256的缓存解码实验量化了预测保真度。
AI.conclusion: 逐位置独立排名不足以选出最优支撑，联合支撑质量应成为稀疏注意力的核心分析对象；这为推理约束下的下游感知支撑选择提供了动机与方法基础。

title: Atomic Policy: Composing Atomic Manipulation Skills with Agentic Reasoning
summary: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to translate task intent into physical interactions as the scene changes. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer semantic and spatial reasoning, while visuomotor policies provide fine-grained control. Yet ambiguous goals and dependencies between actions make their integration challenging. We introduce Atomic Policy, a framework that composes learned manipulation skills through grounded steering and execution feedback. A VLM estimates the symbolic state and goal, and a PDDL solver constructs a skill plan. An agentic harness steers each skill through language, visual pointing, or both, and verifies its outcome to guide phase transitions and replanning. A common phase-level interface supports specialized policies and generalist action models. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot show how Atomic Policy improves task following and supports recovery in complex, long-horizon manipulation. Project page: https://aaronzkd.github.io/atomic-policy/

AI.tldr: 提出 Atomic Policy 框架，将 VLM 的任务规划与视动策略的精细控制结合，通过符号状态估计、PDDL 技能规划、以及基于语言/视觉指向的"agentic harness"逐技能引导与结果校验，实现长时程操作中的可靠执行与重规划。
AI.motivation: 长时程操作要求机器人随场景变化将任务意图转化为物理交互。VLM 擅长语义与空间推理，视动策略擅长细粒度控制，但目标模糊、动作间依赖关系使得二者难以有效集成。
AI.method: Atomic Policy 将学习到的操作技能按阶段组合：VLM 估计符号状态与目标，PDDL 求解器生成技能计划；一个 agentic harness 通过语言、视觉指向或二者结合来引导每个技能执行，并校验其执行结果以驱动阶段切换与重规划；统一的"phase 级"接口同时支持专用策略与通用动作模型。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人实验中，Atomic Policy 提升了任务遵循能力，并能在复杂长时程操作中支持失败恢复（recovery）。
AI.conclusion: 将符号规划（VLM+PDDL）与技能级引导执行、结果校验相结合的分层框架，可有效桥接语义推理与低层控制，提升长时程操作任务的鲁棒性与可恢复性。

title: Beyond Before-and-After Images: Evaluating Temporal Grounding in a Lightweight VLM for Disaster Assessment
comment: 13 pages (4 main + references + supplementary), 4 figures, 14 tables. Accepted at the CV4EO Workshop, WACV 2027
summary: Bi-temporal satellite imagery is central to disaster assessment: deciding what was damaged requires comparing a pre-event scene with its post-event counterpart. A vision-language model (VLM) can nonetheless appear to answer change questions while relying mainly on the post-event image or on the prompt's temporal framing. We present a controlled diagnostic of temporal grounding and apply it to one lightweight VLM, InternVL3-2B, on DisasterM3: 1,659 optical and SAR image pairs from 41 events and nine disaster types, in event-disjoint partitions, with 9,031 reasoning questions. We compare post-only input, the true pre/post pair, the post image repeated twice, reversed image order, and an unrelated pre-event image. The true pair scores $+0.5$ accuracy points above the repeated-post control (95\% paired bootstrap CI $[-0.2, +1.2]$), and reversing the order changes accuracy by $-0.2$ points ($[-0.8, +0.5]$). Under this protocol we therefore find no measurable benefit from the content of the true pre-event image and little sensitivity to temporal order. The model is not blind to the first image, however: the true pair scores $2.5$ points above a pair whose pre-event image comes from another event ($[+1.6, +3.4]$). State-transition and multi-hop questions remain hard, and optical and SAR inputs show different profiles. We outline temporal scene graphs as a testable next step, not a validated solution, and argue that temporal benchmarks for Earth observation should report whether answers depend on the intended evidence, not only how often they are right.

AI.tldr: 本文对轻量级VLM（InternVL3-2B）在DisasterM3双时相灾害评估任务上进行受控诊断，发现模型对真实灾前影像内容几乎无受益、对时序顺序不敏感，但对第一幅影像并非盲视，据此呼吁灾害时序基准应报告答案是否依赖预期证据。
AI.motivation: 双时相卫星影像的灾害评估本应依赖"灾前—灾后"对比，但VLM可能仅凭灾后影像或提示中的时间框架伪装出正确回答，即"答对但未真正使用证据"。现有基准只衡量准确率，无法揭示这种伪时序推理，因此需要一套控制变量的诊断协议来检验模型的时间接地（temporal grounding）。
AI.method: 构建事件不相交划分的受控诊断数据集：DisasterM3中41个事件、9类灾害、1,659对光学与SAR影像对、9,031道推理题。设计五组输入对照：仅灾后影像、真实前/后影像对、灾后影像重复两次、前后顺序颠倒、以及来自其他事件的不相关灾前影像；采用配对自助法（paired bootstrap）估计置信区间进行统计比较。
AI.result: 真实影像对仅比"灾后重复"对照高+0.5个百分点（95% CI [-0.2, +1.2]），顺序颠倒仅带来-0.2个百分点变化（[-0.8, +0.5]），即无可测量的真实灾前内容收益、时序顺序敏感性极低；但真实对显著优于异事件灾前对，高出+2.5个百分点（[+1.6, +3.4]），说明模型并非完全忽略第一幅影像。此外，状态转移与多跳问题仍较困难，光学与SAR输入表现出的错误模式不同。
AI.conclusion: 在该诊断协议下，模型的时序推理主要来自灾后影像与提示框架，真实灾前证据贡献有限。作者提出时序场景图（temporal scene graphs）作为可检验的下一步方向而非已验证方案，并主张地球观测时序基准应在报告准确率之外，同时报告答案是否真正依赖预期证据（证据依赖性评估）。

title: A Text-to-SQL Benchmark for Official Statistics
summary: Official statistics are critical datasets for a wide variety of actors, including policymakers and businesses. For providers of official statistics, improving accessibility, governance, and disclosure of their data is of key importance. This can be improved by providing question-answering systems based on text-to-SQL approaches. However, existing text-to-SQL benchmarks do not resemble this setting. Official statistics are published as open-domain catalogs of thousands of wide tables whose columns and values are codes, and whose meaning is recorded in separate metadata rather than in a relational schema. To address this gap, we introduce LOCuST, a text-to-SQL benchmark that pairs over two thousand English and Dutch tables from Statistics Netherlands with a semantic knowledge graph. The graph describes the tables, measures, and dimension codes through labels, definitions, hierarchies, and units, and is the external knowledge a system needs to find the right tables and ground a question in the right codes. The benchmark includes expert-annotated questions for different query and aggregation types, including raw value retrieval, summations, proportion calculations, and joins. Alongside standard evaluation measures, we introduce an observation F1 metric that measures how close a query is to the ground truth even when the answers are different. We evaluate a variety of state-of-the-art LLMs and find that they struggle to write SQL that answers the questions correctly.

AI.tldr: LOCuST是一个面向官方统计数据的text-to-SQL基准，将荷兰统计局2000余张英/荷双语宽表与语义知识图谱配对，并引入observation F1指标；实验表明现有先进LLM难以正确生成SQL。
AI.motivation: 官方统计数据对政策制定者和企业极为重要，改进其可访问性与公开披露可借助text-to-SQL问答系统实现。但现有text-to-SQL基准与该场景不符：官方统计以开放域目录形式发布数千张宽表，其列与取值均为编码，语义记录在独立的元数据中而非关系模式内，因此需要外部知识来定位正确表格并将问题落到正确编码上。
AI.method: 作者构建LOCuST基准：从荷兰统计局选取2000余张英文与荷兰文表格，并与一个语义知识图谱配对；图谱通过标签、定义、层级结构和单位描述表、度量与维度编码，作为系统检索目标表并进行编码grounding所需的外部知识。基准包含专家标注的问题，覆盖原始值检索、求和、比例计算和连接等不同查询与聚合类型。评估方面除标准指标外，提出observation F1指标，即使答案不同也能衡量查询与真实查询的接近程度。随后评测多种先进LLM。
AI.result: 多种先进LLM在该基准上表现不佳，难以写出能正确回答问题的SQL。
AI.conclusion: 现有text-to-SQL方法不足以应对官方统计这一真实场景，LOCuST为相关研究提供了贴近实际需求的基准与更细粒度的评估手段。

title: Beyond Hard Tokens: Predictive Memory for Multimodal Protein Generation
summary: Multimodal protein language models unify sequence and discrete structural tokens via iterative masked decoding, offering a promising paradigm for joint protein design. However, standard decoders rely on a memoryless mask reset at each iteration: only a sparse subset of newly committed hard tokens is carried forward, while all remaining unresolved sites are reset to an identical [MASK] embedding. In open-ended co-generation where neither modality provides a fixed external anchor, this stateless transition limits single-step refinement depth and deprives both tracks of stable cross-step soft anchors, leading to slow convergence or degenerative repetitive collapse. Observing that uncommitted predictions evolve with pronounced temporal coherence rather than erratic noise, we introduce Predictive Memory (PredMem), a training-free self-conditioning recurrence that carries these soft beliefs across steps. At each step, PredMem summarizes raw logits into a probability-weighted Top-$k$ expectation embedding at every residue and affinely interpolates it into eligible masked inputs on the next step at zero extra denoiser cost. Across DPLM-2, DPLM-2.1, and ESM3, PredMem raises unconditional sequence-structure co-generation success by 3.6, 17.7, and 48.7 percentage points, respectively, while improving the quality-diversity trade-off and suppressing repetitive mode collapse. Controlled diagnostics show that these gains stem primarily from early trajectory stabilization in unanchored cross-modal co-evolution rather than extra compute or simple entropy reduction, establishing PredMem as an efficient inference mechanism for multimodal discrete generation.

AI.tldr: PredMem：一种免训练的自条件化递归机制，将未提交的软预测跨步保留为记忆锚点，显著提升多模态蛋白语言模型的无条件序列-结构联合生成成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态蛋白语言模型（如DPLM-2、ESM3）采用迭代掩码解码，但解码器是"无记忆"的：每步重置掩码时仅保留少量新提交的硬token，其余未解析位点全部回到相同的[MASK]嵌入。在既无序列也无结构固定外部锚点的开放式联合生成中，这种无状态转移限制了单步细化深度，使两条轨道都缺乏稳定的跨步软锚点，导致收敛缓慢或重复性退化崩塌。作者观察到未提交的预测实际上具有显著的时间连贯性而非随机噪声，因此提出跨步携带软信念。
AI.method: PredMem为免训练的自条件化递归（无需额外训练、不增加去噪器计算成本）：在每个残基位置，将原始logits汇总为概率加权的Top-k期望嵌入（软信念表示）；在下一步将该嵌入以仿射插值方式融合进符合条件的掩码输入，使软预测跨迭代传播，为序列与结构两条轨道提供稳定的跨步软锚点。
AI.result: 在DPLM-2、DPLM-2.1和ESM3上，无条件序列-结构联合生成成功率分别提升3.6、17.7和48.7个百分点；同时改善了质量-多样性权衡，抑制了重复模式崩塌。对照诊断表明，增益主要源于无锚跨模态协同演化中的早期轨迹稳定化，而非额外计算或简单的熵降低。
AI.conclusion: PredMem是一种高效的多模态离散生成推理机制，通过自条件化软记忆解决无状态掩码解码在开放式联合生成中的局限，即插即用于现有模型且零额外去噪成本。

title: What Does a Skill Vocabulary Cost? A Closed-Loop Decomposition over Demonstrated Motions
comment: 27 pages, 7 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://intuitive-robots.github.io/mpq
summary: Discrete skill policies execute motions drawn from a finite vocabulary. In most current methods, this vocabulary is a latent codebook learned jointly with a selector and a decoder. When such a policy fails in closed loop, the failure cannot be traced to the vocabulary, to the choice of skill or to its execution. We present Movement Prototype Quantization (MPQ), which places a library of demonstrated motions after a trained policy instead of inside it. MPQ replaces each predicted action chunk with its nearest library element, corrects that element toward the prediction within a bound, and trains no parameters. Across six architectures, including a 7B vision-language-action model, the wrapped policy is statistically equivalent to the original. A reference policy executed through the library is therefore a baseline for any selector over the same library. Substituting a selector's components one at a time attributes its shortfall to them. On LIBERO-90, with selectors on three backbones, quantization costs nothing and the choice of skill costs at most 2 points under the reference's placement and correction. The selectors' own placement and correction account for nearly all of the remaining gap, up to 12 points. Offline reconstruction predicts none of these differences and misjudges library size, design and transfer across benchmark suites. Project page: https://intuitive-robots.github.io/mpq.

AI.tldr: MPQ 将示教动作库置于策略之外，用"量化+有界修正"替代预测的动作块，且不训练任何参数，从而把闭环失败归因于词汇表、技能选择或执行三者之一。
AI.motivation: 现有离散技能策略把潜在码本与选择器、解码器联合训练，闭环失败时无法区分归因于码本、选择还是执行。
AI.method: 提出 Movement Prototype Quantization（MPQ）：在已训练策略之后接一个示教动作库，把每个预测动作块替换为最近的库元素，并在有界范围内向原预测修正；无需训练参数。以经库执行的参考策略作为同一库上任意选择器的基线，逐一替换选择器组件以做归因分析。
AI.result: 在六种架构（含 7B VLA 模型）上，包裹后的策略与原策略统计等价。LIBERO-90 上三种骨干的三种选择器中，量化无损失，技能选择至多损失 2 分；选择器自身的放置与修正占剩余差距近全部（至多 12 分）。离线重建指标无法预测上述差异，并误判库大小、设计与跨基准迁移。
AI.conclusion: 将动作库外置可解耦离散技能策略的误差来源，提供可分解的基线；离线重建不是选择器质量的可靠代理指标。

title: View Management with Gaussian Placement and Opacity Regularization for Online 3DGS
summary: The realistic rendering of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has drawn interest from real-time applications that require maps to be built online. This led to coupling 3DGS with SLAM, providing camera poses and initial Gaussians for the map. However, the map is still optimized with designs inherited from conventional SLAM, which train only on keyframes selected for localization and regularize geometry with uncertain frontend depth. These designs overlook the model complexity of a 3DGS map: with millions of parameters but few views of each region, the map overfits to sparse inputs. Resolving this is challenging, as every view and Gaussian added to the map competes for the same real-time budget. We close this gap from both sides. To add views while keyframes preserve the structure of the map, we progressively admit non-keyframe images as mapping updates complete and allocate the limited updates across different groups of frames according to the supervision each group provides. To control the model complexity of the map, edge-guided initialization places new Gaussians where image detail requires them. To complement the uncertain frontend depth, Self-Referenced Opacity Regularization (SOR) uses accumulated rendering evidence, at no extra rendering cost, to suppress the opacity of Gaussians that persistently contribute in front of a map-derived surface reference. Together, these designs improve both the appearance and the geometry of online maps within the real-time budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对3DGS-SLAM在线建图中地图对稀疏输入过拟合的问题，从"增加监督视图"和"控制地图模型复杂度"两方面改进，在实时预算内同时提升外观与几何质量。
AI.motivation: 3DGS与SLAM耦合可为地图提供相机位姿与初始高斯，但地图优化仍沿用传统SLAM设计：仅在用于定位的关键帧上训练，并用不确定的前端深度做几何正则。这类设计忽视了3DGS地图的高模型复杂度——参数达数百万而每个区域仅少数视角，导致地图对稀疏输入过拟合。难点在于每新增一个视图或一个高斯都要争夺同一实时预算。
AI.method: 1）在关键帧维持地图结构的前提下，随着建图更新逐步引入非关键帧图像作为建图监督，并按各组帧提供的监督量在不同帧组间分配有限的优化更新；2）边缘引导初始化，在图像细节需要的区域放置新高斯，以控制地图模型复杂度；3）自参考不透明度正则（SOR），利用已累积的渲染证据（无额外渲染开销）抑制那些持续出现在地图导出表面参考之前的低透明/高不透明度高斯。
AI.result: 所提设计在实时预算内同时改善了在线地图的外观与几何质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过逐步引入非关键帧并按监督量分配更新、边缘引导高斯初始化、以及基于累积渲染证据的自参考不透明度正则，可在保持实时性的同时缓解3DGS地图对稀疏输入的过拟合，实现更高质量的在线建图。

title: GeoSurge: Geometry-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning for Auditable Liver Resection Planning
summary: Surgical resection planning centers on generating executable resection surfaces from anatomical evidence and operative constraints. Medical multimodal foundation models enable anatomical understanding, and segmentation models predict resection regions, but neither translates these capabilities into explicitly constrained, executable resection surfaces. We present GeoSurge, an anatomy-grounded framework that combines mask-derived metrics with structure-aware point-cloud tokens to generate executable, editable resection surfaces. To make resection geometry learnable and editable, GeoSurge maps actions to parametric geometry through a surface-action grammar. Using this grammar, anatomy-oriented and tumor-centered templates generate candidates, which are filtered by hard constraints and semantic deduplication. Training supervision is then derived from candidate-expert geometric agreement and independently recomputed feasibility metrics. At inference, the reasoner uses patient evidence and surgical requirements to select or revise an action, which an independent geometry engine subsequently materializes and verifies. GeoSurge achieves the best overall scores on DeepTumour Liver and CRLM-QA, improving the constraint satisfaction rate from 73% to 100% on CRLM and from 56% to 99% on GeoSurge-Bench.

AI.tldr: GeoSurge 是一个解剖学驱动的框架，结合掩码导出指标与结构感知点云 token，通过"表面-动作语法"将手术切除动作映射为参数化几何，生成可执行、可编辑的切除表面。
AI.motivation: 现有医学多模态基础模型能理解解剖结构、分割模型能预测切除区域，但二者都无法将这些能力转化为显式受约束、可执行的切除表面，导致术前切除规划缺少可落地的几何输出。
AI.method: 提出表面-动作语法将动作映射为参数化几何；基于该语法由解剖导向与肿瘤中心模板生成候选，经硬约束过滤与语义去重；训练监督来自候选-专家几何一致性与独立重算的可行性指标；推理时由推理器依据患者证据与手术需求选择或修改动作，再由独立几何引擎实例化并验证。
AI.result: 在 DeepTumour Liver 与 CRLM-QA 上取得最佳综合得分；CRLM 上约束满足率由 73% 提升至 100%，GeoSurge-Bench 上由 56% 提升至 99%。
AI.conclusion: 将切除规划解耦为"推理器选择动作 + 几何引擎执行验证"，并以语法化参数几何作为可学习、可编辑的中间表征，可有效将解剖理解转化为满足硬约束的可执行切除表面。

title: CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers
summary: Visual world models enable goal-directed planning by predicting action outcomes. Gradient-based planners optimize actions to lower predicted goal cost, but continued optimization can exploit prediction errors after execution stops improving. Comparing plans requires informative relative scores; improving them also requires reliable update directions. Exact-state execution reveals that a frozen hierarchical world model ranks goal-conditioned proposals even when its rankings among outputs of prolonged gradient search are uninformative. Effective planning pairs goal-directed candidates with predictions that distinguish their outcomes. We introduce CriticJEPA, which learns goal-conditioned flow proposals from reward-free trajectories and uses frozen rollouts to select among them at every hierarchy level. Forward selection forms a complete planner; short anchored updates refine candidates before selection. Across visual navigation and manipulation, CriticJEPA increases success at a fraction of the planning compute, transferring shared settings across independently trained models, hierarchy depths, and unseen tasks while keeping every world-model weight fixed.

AI.tldr: 提出 CriticJEPA：在冻结的层级世界模型中，用无奖励轨迹学习目标条件流提议（flow proposals），并通过冻结的 rollout 在每个层级上做前向选择，以极少的规划算力提升视觉导航与操作的规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于梯度的规划器通过优化动作降低预测目标代价，但持续优化会在执行效果不再提升后利用预测误差（即利用模型误差“刷分”）；同时，比较不同方案需要具有信息量的相对评分，改进方案也需要可靠的更新方向。作者观察到：冻结的层级世界模型即便在对长时间梯度搜索结果之间的排序无信息量时，仍能对目标条件提议给出有效排序，因此有效规划应把目标导向候选与能区分其结果差异的预测配对使用。
AI.method: CriticJEPA 从无奖励轨迹中学习目标条件流提议（goal-conditioned flow proposals），并在每个层级利用冻结的 rollout 在候选中进行选择；前向选择构成完整规划器，选择前用短程锚定更新（short anchored updates）精炼候选；整个过程中世界模型权重保持冻结。
AI.result: 在视觉导航与视觉操作任务上，CriticJEPA 以一小部分规划算力提升成功率；共享超参数可跨独立训练的模型、不同层级深度及未见任务迁移，且世界模型权重全程保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 相对评分的信息量与更新方向的可靠性是梯度式世界模型规划的关键瓶颈；用冻结模型上的前向选择配合学习到的目标条件提议，可在不训练世界模型的前提下实现高效、可迁移的目标导向规划。

title: Self-Sensing Compliant Anthropomorphic Hand for Speed-Dictated Shared Force Control in Teleoperation
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible. Project page: https://huijiang-wang.github.io/selfsensing-hand/
summary: In vision-based teleoperation of robotic hands, the operator receives no haptic feedback and therefore struggles to regulate the grasp force, while adding tactile sensors to the fingers increases wiring, cost and integration complexity.
