Compliant hands offer an alternative, as their mechanical compliance, usually treated only as a passive property for safe and adaptive grasping, can also serve as a source of information. Here, we show that the elastic transmission of a compliant, tendon-driven anthropomorphic hand can itself act as the sensor for shared-control telemanipulation. Series springs in the tendon routing are read by potentiometers in a forearm-mounted motor box, from which the hand estimates its joint states and finger forces without any external sensors. Building on this self-sensing, we develop a contact-aware shared-control framework for VR-based teleoperation. The robot hand is controlled through a mapping from the operator's hand kinematics until a contact is detected proprioceptively. Control then switches to a finger-level force controller whose set point is determined by the operator's grasping speed, and control authority can be allocated to individual fingers. Experiments validate the system's force estimation and increased grasp success rate compared with direct teleoperation for fragile and heavy objects. These results show that compliance can serve not only for passive adaptation but also as an intrinsic sensing resource for physical human-robot collaboration.

AI.tldr: 该文提出利用柔性腱驱仿人手的弹性传动本身作为传感器，在不加装触觉传感器的前提下实现关节状态与指力估计，并据此构建面向VR遥操作的接触感知共享控制框架。
AI.motivation: 视觉遥操作机械手缺乏力反馈，操作者难以控制抓取力；而在手指上加装触觉传感器会带来布线、成本与集成复杂度。作者希望把通常仅被视为"被动安全柔顺"的机械柔性，转化为可用的本体感知信息源。
AI.method: 在腱绳路径中串联弹簧，由前臂电机盒内的电位计读取形变，从而在无外部传感器条件下估计关节状态与指力（自感知）。基于此构建接触感知共享控制：接触前按操作者手部运动学映射控制；一旦本体感知检测到接触，即切换为指级力控制器，其设定点由操作者抓取速度决定，并可将控制权限分配给单根手指。
AI.result: 实验验证了系统的力估计精度；与直接遥操作相比，在易碎物体与重物抓取任务中抓取成功率提升。
AI.conclusion: 柔顺性不仅是实现安全、自适应抓取的被动特性，还可作为内在感知资源，服务于人机物理协作与遥操作的力觉反馈替代方案。

title: Do Occupancy World Models Really Follow Actions?
summary: Occupancy world models predict future 3D scenes conditioned on ego actions, yet their predictions may not faithfully follow the specified trajectory under counterfactual actions. Because driving datasets provide sparse coverage of alternative trajectories for each scene, existing models learn the spatial effect of ego motion implicitly from observed scene--trajectory combinations, which may entangle action effects with scene--trajectory correlations. We propose ReCast, an ego-trajectory-guided transformer that grounds future prediction in action-induced geometric correspondence across ego-centric frames. ReCast decouples historical encoding from future decoding and aligns deformable interactions using relative ego transformations, while retaining flexibility for non-rigid scene evolution. We also introduce a counterfactual action-faithfulness benchmark covering in-distribution, tail, and out-of-distribution trajectories. On Occ3D-nuScenes, ReCast achieves competitive standard forecasting performance while improving counterfactual forecasting, with particularly clear gains under out-of-distribution trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出ReCast：以自车轨迹为引导、基于跨自车坐标系几何对应关系的占用世界模型，解耦历史编码与未来解码，并用相对自车变换对齐可变形交互，提升反事实轨迹下的动作忠实性。
AI.motivation: 现有占用世界模型以自车动作为条件预测未来3D场景，但预测未必忠实遵循给定的反事实轨迹。原因在于驾驶数据集中每个场景的备选轨迹覆盖稀疏，模型只能从“场景—轨迹”组合中隐式学习自车运动的空间效应，导致动作效应与场景—轨迹相关性相互纠缠。
AI.method: 提出ReCast——一种自车轨迹引导的Transformer，将未来预测建立在跨自车中心帧的动作诱导几何对应关系之上。具体地：解耦历史编码与未来解码；利用相对自车变换对齐可变形交互（deformable interactions），同时保留非刚性场景演化的建模灵活性。此外构建了覆盖分布内、尾部与分布外轨迹的反事实动作忠实性基准。
AI.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上，ReCast取得具竞争力的标准预测性能，同时提升反事实预测能力，在分布外轨迹下增益尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 以自车相对几何变换显式建模动作效应，可有效解耦场景相关性与动作效应，使占用世界模型在反事实轨迹下更忠实地遵循给定动作，并具备更好的分布外泛化。

title: Economic World Model
summary: Can artificial intelligence reproduce the economic dynamics that emerge as households, firms and governments interact and adapt through markets and institutions? To answer this question, we define an economic world model (EWM) as an agent's internal representation of how an economic system works, enabling counterfactual simulation and decision-making under resource constraints. We then propose a general framework for studying EWMs that links three tasks: simulating agent behaviour, learning economic transitions and systematically evaluating the dynamics. As an initial implementation, we learn household policies from microeconomic data and calibrate a structural economic transition model using macroeconomic data, linking individual decisions to aggregate dynamics. Our micro-to-macro evaluation framework compares simulated individual actions and group distributions with observed microdata and assesses macroeconomic dynamics through forecasting and counterfactual experiments. Results show that simulated and observed household consumption distributions overlap by 94.9%, while EWM forecasts closely track real GDP and several other aggregate levels. In government-borrowing counterfactuals, the EWM reproduces the benchmark life-cycle model's short-run transmission from borrowing to consumption. For ex ante planning, the EWM enables an LLM agent to achieve 10.29% higher simulated GDP under the epidemic shock than direct LLM decisions. This initial EWM is only a starting point. We invite economists and AI researchers to build a stronger EWM together. Economists can contribute richer economic models and knowledge, while AI researchers can develop stronger data-driven methods for simulating agent behaviour and learning economic transitions. Together, we aim not only to reproduce real economic dynamics, but also to discover and test new mechanisms that support better decisions and benefit society.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"经济世界模型"（EWM）概念，即智能体对经济系统运行方式的内部表征，并给出连接"模拟主体行为—学习经济转移—系统评估动态"的通用框架及初步实现。
AI.motivation: 探讨人工智能能否复现家庭、企业与政府通过市场与制度互动适应所涌现的经济动态，为反事实模拟与资源约束下的决策提供统一的建模与评估工具。
AI.method: 从微观经济数据学习家庭策略，用宏观经济数据校准结构性经济转移模型，将个体决策与总体动态相连；构建微观到宏观的评估框架，对比模拟个体行为与群体分布与观测微观数据，并通过预测与反事实实验检验宏观动态。
AI.result: 模拟与观测的家庭消费分布重叠度达94.9%；EWM预测紧密跟踪真实GDP及多项总量水平；在政府借贷反事实中复现了基准生命周期模型的短期传导效应；在事前规划任务中，基于EWM的LLM智能体在疫情冲击下实现比直接LLM决策高10.29%的模拟GDP。
AI.conclusion: 该初始EWM仅是起点，呼吁经济学家贡献更丰富的经济模型与知识、AI研究者发展更强的数据驱动方法，共同复现真实经济动态并发现与检验支撑更优决策的新机制。

title: From the ELBO to Maximum Likelihood: Convergence of Variational Autoencoders for Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Modeling
summary: Nonlinear mixed-effects (NLME) models are the central statistical models of pharmacometrics, where they support dose selection, individualized dosing and regulatory decisions in drug development. Statistically, NLME modeling is a marginalized likelihood problem. Variational autoencoders (VAEs) solve such problems with a neural network encoder that amortizes the approximation of the intractable posterior distribution, and allow the integration of AI components into NLME modeling. This paper provides the convergence analysis of the VAE-NLME algorithm. First, its version for the evidence lower bound (ELBO) is proven to converge almost surely to the set of stationary points of the ELBO, without assuming that the encoder is trained exactly. Second, the final VAE-NLME algorithm trains the encoder on the ELBO by gradient-based optimization and uses it as proposal for importance-weighted sufficient statistics. It converges almost surely to the set of stationary points of the marginal log-likelihood, without any assumption on the training of the encoder. Thus, it combines the fast gradient-based training of VAEs with the limit of maximum likelihood estimation.

AI.tldr: 该文对VAE-NLME算法进行收敛性分析：证明了ELBO版本几乎必然收敛到ELBO的稳定点集（无需假设编码器被精确训练），并证明最终算法（编码器以ELBO为目标做梯度优化，并作为重要性加权充分统计量的提议分布）几乎必然收敛到边际对数似然的稳定点集（对编码器训练不作任何假设），从而兼具VAE快速梯度训练与最大似然估计的极限性质。
AI.motivation: NLME模型是药物计量学的核心统计模型，用于剂量选择、个体化给药与监管决策，其统计本质是边际似然问题。VAE通过神经网络编码器摊销难解后验近似，可将AI组件引入NLME建模，但该算法缺乏理论收敛性保证。
AI.method: 将VAE-NLME视为边际似然问题，进行随机近似算法的收敛性分析：先用ELBO目标对编码器做梯度优化，再将其作为重要性加权充分统计量的提议分布，分两阶段证明几乎必然收敛性。
AI.result: ELBO版本几乎必然收敛到ELBO的稳定点集，且不要求编码器被精确训练；最终算法在不对编码器训练作任何假设的情况下，几乎必然收敛到边际对数似然的稳定点集。
AI.conclusion: VAE-NLME在理论上兼具VAE快速梯度训练的效率与最大似然估计的统计极限性质，为AI组件融入NLME建模提供了收敛性理论支撑。

title: DynaMimic: A Physics-Informed World Model for Humanoid Motion Tracking
summary: Whole-body motion tracking enables humanoid robots to reproduce diverse skills from human demonstrations. Existing model-free reinforcement learning methods either distill motion specialists into a single policy at the cost of performance or train a generalist policy directly using cluster-scale computation. SuperMimic reduces this computational cost through a differentiable world model that implicitly learns the physics shared across motions by predicting the next state from the current state and action. However, this implicit formulation may not fully capture the underlying physical processes. Errors around changes of support can accumulate over imagined rollouts used to train the tracking policy. To address this challenge, we introduce DynaMimic, a differentiable world model that explicitly incorporates shared physics into state prediction. Specifically, its network predicts a contact wrench at each candidate support link and a residual generalized force. DynaMimic then uses these predictions to compute the next state through closed-form Lagrangian forward dynamics. Across 60 full LAFAN1 motions, DynaMimic reduces mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 18.6% relative to SuperMimic. For terrain tracking, we give both methods the same local height maps. Relative to terrain-conditioned SuperMimic, DynaMimic reduces MPJPE by 14.9% on A3 Parkour (66.15 to 56.28~mm) and by 10.8% on GRAIL terrain clips (141.88 to 126.57~mm). On a real A3 humanoid, the learned policies can perform diverse skills, such as floor recovery, cartwheel and a box vault.

AI.tldr: DynaMimic 提出一种显式嵌入共享物理的可微世界模型，用于人形机器人全身运动跟踪，以降低计算成本并提升精度。
AI.motivation: 现有无模型强化学习方法要么将运动专家蒸馏为单一策略而牺牲性能，要么依赖集群级算力直接训练通用策略。SuperMimic 通过可微世界模型降低算力，但其隐式形式难以完整刻画底层物理过程，在支撑切换附近产生的误差会在想象式 rollout 中累积。
AI.method: DynaMimic 网络为每个候选支撑连杆预测接触力旋量（contact wrench）及残余广义力，再通过闭式拉格朗日前向动力学由这些预测计算下一状态，从而把共享物理显式写入状态预测。地形跟踪实验中两种方法输入相同的局部高度图。
AI.result: 在 60 段完整 LAFAN1 运动上，MPJPE 相对 SuperMimic 降低 18.6%。地形跟踪下，相对地形条件化的 SuperMimic，A3 Parkour 上 MPJPE 由 66.15 mm 降至 56.28 mm（降低 14.9%），GRAIL 地形片段由 141.88 mm 降至 126.57 mm（降低 10.8%）。在真实 A3 人形机器人上，所学策略可完成倒地恢复、侧手翻和跳箱等多样技能。
AI.conclusion: 将共享物理以显式接触力旋量与闭式前向动力学形式注入可微世界模型，可在不依赖集群算力的前提下显著提升运动跟踪与地形跟踪精度，并成功迁移到真实人形机器人。

title: BodyWeave: Native Body-Conditioned 3D Garment Generation
summary: Generating 3D garments for digital characters requires preserving a reference design while adapting the garment to the target body's shape and pose. Sewing-pattern methods can struggle to reproduce unfamiliar designs and fine details, while image-to-3D generators offer rich shape priors but typically lack explicit 3D body context. We present \textbf{BodyWeave}, a framework that unifies garment generation and fitting through native 3D body conditioning. Building on 3D generative priors, BodyWeave uses the body as a spatial reference throughout geometry generation: a \textbf{Global Body Adapter} guides garment placement and extent in the shared coordinate frame, while \textbf{Local Body Attention} guides surface refinement using nearby body geometry. A \textbf{Surface Penetration Loss} supervises decoded surfaces to reduce body intersections, and the resulting geometry conditions material synthesis to produce garments with physically based rendering attributes. To support learning across designs and wearers, we construct \textbf{GarmentWeave3D} with 293K aligned garment--body observations, including 114K same-design cross-body pairs. Evaluations on out-of-domain \textbf{Artist-Created Garments} demonstrate high geometric fidelity and low body penetration. Cross-body evaluations demonstrate accurate adaptation to new wearers with consistent garment--body spacing, while appearance comparisons show faithful fabric reproduction. Additional results and resources are available at https://gavin-jy.github.io/bodyweave-page/

AI.tldr: BodyWeave 通过原生3D人体条件统一服装生成与适配：以人体作为几何生成全程的空间参考，结合全局人体适配器、局部人体注意力与表面穿透损失，实现高保真、低穿透的3D服装生成，并可自适应新体型。
AI.motivation: 为数字角色生成3D服装时，需在保留参考设计的同时使服装适配目标人体的体型与姿态。缝纫纸样方法难以复现陌生设计与细节，图像到3D生成器虽有丰富形状先验但缺乏显式3D人体上下文。
AI.method: 基于3D生成先验，全程以人体为空间参考：Global Body Adapter 在共享坐标帧中引导服装位置与范围；Local Body Attention 利用邻近人体几何引导表面细化；Surface Penetration Loss 对解码表面施加监督以减少穿模；所得几何进一步条件化材质合成，生成具备PBR属性的服装。同时构建 GarmentWeave3D 数据集（293K对齐服装-人体观测，含114K同设计跨体型配对）。
AI.result: 在域外 Artist-Created Garments 上取得高几何保真度与低人体穿透；跨体型评测显示对新穿着者的准确适配及一致的服装-人体间距；外观对比表明面料复现忠实。
AI.conclusion: 将人体作为原生3D条件可有效统一服装生成与拟合，兼顾设计保真与体型自适应，并支持材质级真实感输出。

title: CAPTA: Identifying LLMs Behind AI Agents
summary:
Large language model (LLM)-based agents access remote services through tools to complete user tasks, often via API calls. In this setting, a remote service may want to identify the backend LLM of an agent to launch model-specific attacks, including prompt injection or selective delivery of manipulated content. However, the service cannot directly query the backend model and must instead collect observable responses through its interactions with the agent, making identification challenging.
  In this paper, we present Completely Automated Preference Test to tell LLMs Apart (CAPTA), a model identification approach inspired by CAPTCHA (Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart), which distinguishes humans from automated programs. CAPTA presents multiple-choice questions as verification challenges, using differences in models' selection preferences to identify the backend LLM. It selects questions based on cross-model option-generation diversity and uses LLM-guided search to optimize their option sets. Our evaluation shows that CAPTA achieves 99.0% mean identification accuracy with only 10 questions across 25 LLMs from 10 model families. We further evaluate CAPTA with four widely used agents and seven representative LLMs, achieving 99.7% mean identification accuracy across all 28 agent-LLM combinations with 30 submitted answers.

AI.tldr: 提出CAPTA方法，通过类CAPTCHA的多选题偏好测试，仅凭代理可观测的响应对其后台大模型进行自动化指纹识别。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的代理通过工具/API调用访问远程服务以完成用户任务；此时远程服务可能希望识别代理背后的LLM以实施模型针对性攻击（如提示注入、选择性投递被操纵内容）。但服务方无法直接查询后台模型，只能收集与代理交互过程中可观测的响应，因此识别任务具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出CAPTA（Completely Automated Preference Test to tell LLMs Apart），借鉴CAPTCHA"区分人与程序"的思路，将多个选择题作为验证挑战，利用不同模型在选项选择偏好上的差异识别后台LLM；题目依据跨模型选项生成多样性进行筛选，并采用LLM引导的搜索优化选项集合。
AI.result: 在10个模型家族的25个LLM上，CAPTA仅用10道题即达到99.0%的平均识别准确率；在4个常用代理与7个代表性LLM组成的全部28种"代理-LLM"组合上，提交30个答案后平均识别准确率达99.7%。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择偏好可作为有效的指纹特征，使远程服务在仅能观测代理响应、无法直接查询模型的条件下高精度识别后台LLM；该能力同时揭示了基于代理的LLM部署存在模型指纹泄露与针对性攻击风险。

title: Metamorphic Testing of Learned Spatial Surrogates for Transit Accessibility
summary: Transit-network design requires evaluating many candidates, but detailed accessibility calculations are too slow to repeat inside an optimization loop. We therefore train a neural surrogate to approximate them. Given a candidate bus network and fixed information about rail service and nearby opportunities, it predicts the calculated spatial change in accessibility. We compare its predictions with routing-derived targets in geographically held-out regions and test specified qualitative relations under controlled input changes. Reference calculations on constructed networks assess the applicability of relations that have a routing-level counterpart. Models with positive predictive skill can still fail basic connectivity tests. One targeted intervention substantially increases pass rates for two connectivity relations while predictive skill also improves. Average prediction error is therefore insufficient when a learned model becomes an optimization objective. Predictive agreement and controlled behavioral tests should be reported separately.

AI.tldr: 论文提出训练神经代理模型替代昂贵的可达性计算以加速公交网络优化，但发现预测精度（空间留出区域）良好的模型仍可能违反基本连通性关系；一项针对性干预可同时提升两类连通性关系的通过率与预测精度，说明平均误差不足以评价被用作优化目标的学习模型，预测一致性与受控行为测试应分别报告。
AI.motivation: 公交网络设计需评估大量候选方案，而精细的可达性计算太慢，难以嵌入优化循环内部反复调用，因此需要快速近似手段；同时作者质疑仅用平均预测误差衡量代理模型是否足够。
AI.method: 训练神经代理模型：输入为候选公交网络及固定的轨道服务与周边机会信息，输出为计算得到的可达性空间变化。在地理上留出的区域与基于路径规划的目标值比较预测能力；在受控输入变化下检验预设的定性关系；用人工构造网络上的参考计算评估存在路径级对应关系的定性关系是否适用；并实施针对性的干预实验考察关系通过率的变化。
AI.result: 具备正向预测技能的模型仍会在基本连通性测试中失败；一项针对性干预显著提高了两个连通性关系的通过率，且预测技能同时提升。
AI.conclusion: 当学习模型被用作优化目标时，平均预测误差不足以评价其质量；预测一致性与受控行为测试应分开报告，定性关系检验应作为代理模型评估的必要组成部分。

title: CAPER: PartGround and PlanRefine for Reliable Manual-Guided Robotic Assembly Planning
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Project page and video: https://xhzzzz123.github.io/CAPER/
summary: Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) used in robot task planning to derive assembly procedures from existing manuals may correctly interpret individual assembly actions yet confuse exact part identities, predict unsupported Part IDs, or produce inconsistent parts across assembly steps. Thus, we propose CAPER (Capacity-Aware Part-grounding and Evidence Refinement), a manual-guided robotic assembly framework that enables VLMs to generate assembly procedures with two modules--PartGround and PlanRefine. PartGround aligns step-level manual evidence with product-specific inventory and part-reference information to identify exact Part IDs and quantities, transforming free-form hardware prediction into evidence-guided assignments represented in a shared Assembly Intermediate Representation (Assembly IR). PlanRefine audits PartGround assignments against finite inventory by removing the lowest-confidence assignments. Uncertain identity cases remain marked for review in the Assembly IR. We evaluate CAPER on the IKEA Assembly in the Wild (IAW) dataset. Experiment results show that CAPER reaches a Finite-inventory Consistency Rate of 83.33% and produces zero observed out-of-inventory Part-ID occurrences. At the plan level, PlanRefine removes all observed inventory-overuse pairs (9 -> 0) and excess units (51 -> 0). Overall, the results indicate that PartGround and PlanRefine improve part reliability, while also enhancing finite-inventory consistency and local prediction accuracy. Project page and video: https://xhzzzz123.github.io/CAPER/

AI.tldr: 提出CAPER框架（PartGround＋PlanRefine），使VLM在手册引导的机器人装配中生成可对齐产品清单的装配流程，显著提升零件可靠性。
AI.motivation: VLM用于由说明书推导装配流程时，虽能理解单个动作，却常混淆零件身份、预测清单外的Part ID，或跨步骤零件不一致，导致装配计划不可执行。
AI.method: CAPER含两个模块：PartGround将步骤级手册证据与产品库存、零件参考信息对齐，识别确切Part ID与数量，把自由形式硬件预测转为证据引导的分配，并统一表示于Assembly IR；PlanRefine依据有限库存审计分配结果，剔除最低置信度分配，不确定身份保留标记待复核。
AI.result: 在IKEA Assembly in the Wild (IAW)数据集上，有限库存一致率达83.33%，观测到零次库存外Part ID；计划层面超量使用零件对由9降至0，多余单位由51降至0。
AI.conclusion: PartGround与PlanRefine提升了零件可靠性、有限库存一致性与局部预测准确率，为手册引导的机器人装配提供了证据约束的零件接地方案。

title: DeCo-Attention: Decompose to Compensate for Low-Precision Attention
summary: Self-attention over tens of thousands of tokens dominates the generation time of video diffusion transformers, because its cost grows quadratically with sequence length. The FP4 matrix products of modern GPUs can speed up attention, but the 4-bit rounding of the queries Q and the keys K introduces large errors. We show that the exponential in softmax amplifies the error of their product QK, which therefore dominates the attention error. We propose DeCo-Attention, a co-design of algorithm and system for low-precision attention. DeCo-Attention is training-free and compensates the rounding error of Q and K along a few principal directions found by a per-head eigendecomposition. The lightweight compensation terms are appended to Q and K as extra channels, so the FP4 matrix product corrects its own rounding error while it computes the attention scores. Once the products run in FP4, the softmax bounds the kernel, and we optimize the softmax so that the gain of FP4 computation translates into realized speedup. With QK in FP4, we implement DeCo-Attention with the rest of attention in FP8 on GB300 and VR200 and in FP4 on RTX PRO 6000. On Wan2.2, these kernels run 2.13x, 2.49x, and 2.82x faster than BF16 attention, and the whole generation runs 1.55x, 1.68x, and 1.80x faster. On four video generation models, the FP8 configuration achieves LPIPS comparable to prior 8-bit QK methods, and the fully FP4 configuration lower LPIPS than prior fully 4-bit kernels.

AI.tldr: DeCo-Attention 提出一种免训练的算法-系统协同设计，用主成分方向补偿 Q/K 的 4-bit 舍入误差，使 QK^T 可在 FP4 矩阵乘上运行，从而加速视频扩散 Transformer 的自注意力。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 的自注意力开销随序列长度平方增长，在数万 token 时主导生成时间。GPU 的 FP4 矩阵乘可加速，但 Q、K 的 4-bit 舍入误差较大，且 softmax 中的指数会放大 QK 乘积误差，使该误差成为注意力误差的主要来源。
AI.method: 提出 DeCo-Attention：(1) 对每个注意力头做特征分解，找出少数主方向，用于补偿 Q、K 的舍入误差；(2) 将轻量补偿项作为额外通道拼接在 Q、K 上，使 FP4 矩阵乘在计算注意力分数的同时自行修正舍入误差；(3) FP4 化后 softmax 成为新的核瓶颈，故针对 softmax 进行优化，使 FP4 计算收益转化为实际加速。方法免训练。QK 用 FP4，其余注意力在 GB300/VR200 上用 FP8、在 RTX PRO 6000 上用 FP4。
AI.result: 在 Wan2.2 上，上述三种配置的注意力核分别比 BF16 注意力快 2.13x、2.49x、2.82x，整体生成分别快 1.55x、1.68x、1.80x。在四个视频生成模型上，FP8 配置的 LPIPS 与已有 8-bit QK 方法相当，全 FP4 配置的 LPIPS 低于已有全 4-bit 核。
AI.conclusion: 通过在主成分方向上以额外通道形式补偿 Q/K 舍入误差，可在免训练前提下将 QK 乘积降至 FP4，并配合 softmax 优化获得显著端到端加速，同时保持或改善生成质量。

title: EviCraft: Can Minecraft Agents Find What They Cannot See?
summary: In Minecraft, a common testbed for embodied agents, semantic tools such as mineBlock pick targets from the simulator's loaded world state without a visibility test, so a buried ore the agent has never seen is one call away, and scores cannot show whether the agent searched. We formalize the missing requirement as evidence closure: every decision of an agent system, including those inside its tools, may depend on the world only through facts for which the agent holds evidence. EviCraft is a runtime and benchmark that enforces closure below the agent and makes the admission rule an experimental variable: a perception-grounded regime (G) admits only what is in line of sight or returned by the agent's own actions, and a loaded-state regime (L) reproduces standard tool stacks, with agents, tools, and worlds held fixed. On Survival, the regime effect exceeds the strongest agent's lead: under G, three mid-sized agents reach the diamond in 32%-40% of runs, against 76%-94% under L, and the strongest agent under G scores below each of them under L. In two models, removing only the line-of-sight test closes 93%-96% of the score gap, and loading state only inside tools recovers 70%-98%, so safeguards on observations and queries leave most of the leak open. In open-ended acquisition, the gain from L concentrates in items that depend on buried resources or mobs. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/AllenReder/EviCraft

AI.tldr: 论文提出"证据闭合"(evidence closure)要求：智能体系统（含工具内部决策）只能通过智能体持有证据的事实依赖世界；据此构建EviCraft运行时与基准，将"准入规则"变为实验变量，发现Minecraft中语义工具绕开可见性检测造成严重信息泄漏，大幅夸大智能体能力评分。
AI.motivation: Minecraft是具身智能体常用测试床，但mineBlock等语义工具直接从模拟器已加载的世界状态中选目标，缺乏可见性检验：智能体从未见过的埋藏矿石一次调用即可获得，评分无法反映智能体是否真的进行了搜索。因此需要一个能在智能体之下强制证据闭合、并把准入规则作为可控变量的评测框架。
AI.method: 提出EviCraft运行时与基准，在智能体之下强制证据闭合，并将准入规则设为实验变量：(G)感知接地机制，仅允许视线内或由智能体自身动作返回的事实被准入；(L)已加载状态机制，复现标准工具栈。两者保持智能体、工具与固定世界一致，从而隔离泄漏效应。另做消融：仅在工具内部加载状态、仅移除视线检验，以定位泄漏来源。
AI.result: 在Survival任务上，机制效应超过最强智能体的领先幅度：G机制下三个中等规模智能体32%–40%的运行取得钻石，L机制下为76%–94%，且G下最强智能体的得分低于L下每一个中等智能体。两个模型中，仅移除视线检验即可弥合93%–96%的分数差距，仅在工具内部加载状态可恢复70%–98%的差距，说明对观测与查询的防护仍留下大部分泄漏。在开放式获取任务中，L机制的增益集中于依赖埋藏资源或生物的物品。
AI.conclusion: 现有Minecraft语义工具栈存在系统性证据泄漏，显著高估智能体的搜索与探索能力；仅在观测/查询层面加防护不足以消除泄漏。证据闭合应作为具身评测的基础约束，EviCraft提供了可复现的运行时与基准以支持该方向的标准化评测。

title: The Activity Geometry of Discrete Generative Sampling
summary: Iterative refinement is a key capability of diffusion-based generation and has motivated growing efforts to bring similar behavior to discrete diffusion and flow models. A growing line of work enables such refinement by allowing previously generated tokens to be revised during sampling, thereby shaping the coupling between successive sampling states. Despite its growing role in sampler design, this coupling freedom remains insufficiently characterized. We introduce Activity Geometry to study these finite-step couplings through expected transition cost, which we call activity. We show that activity decomposes into the minimum required by the induced marginal transport and an excess term arising from the coupling. Using this minimum as a reference, we propose Minimal-Activity Finite-Time Coupling (MAFTC) to realize prescribed marginals with minimum activity without retraining or additional model evaluations. In the continuous-time limit, the minimum activity per unit time converges to the minimum expected jump rate compatible with the prescribed path. For metric-induced Gibbs paths, we further show that the activity of the kinetic-optimal flux admits a geometric decomposition. We find that total activity alone can obscure coupling excess: a sampler may approach the minimum activity required by the prescribed marginal transport while still retaining substantial coupling excess. In language generation, as the number of model evaluations increases, refinement-based samplers accumulate additional trajectory activity with limited diversity gains, whereas MAFTC reduces trajectory activity while maintaining comparable generation quality and higher lexical diversity.

AI.tldr: 提出"活动几何"（Activity Geometry）框架刻画离散扩散/流模型采样中相邻采样状态间的耦合，将活动量分解为边缘传输所需最小值与耦合冗余项，并据此提出无训练、无额外模型评估的 MAFTC 采样器。
AI.motivation: 迭代精炼是扩散生成的核心能力，近期工作通过允许修正已生成 token 来为离散扩散与流模型引入精炼行为，其本质是设计连续采样状态之间的耦合。然而这种耦合自由度在采样器设计中作用日益重要，却缺乏充分刻画，现有采样器难以判断其轨迹活动是否必要。
AI.method: 以有限步耦合的期望转移代价定义"活动"（activity），证明活动可分解为诱导边缘传输所必需的最小值加上由耦合产生的冗余项（excess term）；以该最小值为参照提出 MAFTC（Minimal-Activity Finite-Time Coupling），在无需重训练或额外模型评估的条件下实现给定边缘分布的最小活动耦合；分析连续时间极限下单位时间最小活动收敛于与指定路径相容的最小期望跳率；对度量诱导的 Gibbs 路径证明 kinetic-optimal flux 的活动具有几何分解。
AI.result: 理论表明仅看总活动会掩盖耦合冗余：采样器可能在接近规定边缘传输所需最小活动的同时仍保留可观的耦合冗余。语言生成实验中，随模型评估次数增加，基于精炼的采样器累积额外轨迹活动而多样性增益有限；MAFTC 则降低轨迹活动，在保持可比生成质量的同时获得更高的词汇多样性。
AI.conclusion: Activity Geometry 为离散扩散与流模型的有限步耦合提供了可量化的分析工具，揭示了耦合冗余与边缘传输成本的分离；MAFTC 在无需额外计算开销的前提下实现最小活动采样，兼顾生成质量与多样性，说明耦合设计应以最小活动为基准而非单纯追求多步精炼。

title: At the Limit: Autonomous Vehicle Drifting under Generative Policies
summary: Autonomous drifting requires agile control despite tire-force saturation and highly nonlinear vehicle dynamics. We propose an online reinforcement learning method for flow policies that combines stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling for exploration with value-based policy optimization. This method supports both training from scratch and fine-tuning a policy pretrained on expert demonstrations. After training, control actions can be generated using either SDEs or ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Experiments on circular and eight-shaped drifting in an F1TENTH digital twin platform show that both training strategies can achieve effective real-time drift control, with tighter tracking, higher success rates, and better robustness under noisy conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在线强化学习方法，将基于随机微分方程（SDE）采样的探索与基于价值的策略优化结合，用于学习flow策略，实现自动驾驶漂移控制，并支持从零训练与专家示范预训练微调两种模式。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶漂移场景下轮胎力饱和、车辆动力学高度非线性，需要敏捷控制能力，现有方法难以在实时条件下实现稳定漂移跟踪。
AI.method: 面向flow策略的在线强化学习：用SDE采样进行探索，结合基于价值的策略优化；支持从零训练，也支持在专家演示预训练策略上微调；训练后动作生成可采用SDE或ODE两种形式。
AI.result: 在F1TENTH数字孪生平台上进行圆形与八字形漂移实验，两种训练策略均实现有效的实时漂移控制，跟踪更紧、成功率更高，且在噪声条件下鲁棒性更好。
AI.conclusion: SDE采样与价值型策略优化结合的flow策略在线RL方法可有效支撑实时自主漂移控制，从零训练与预训练微调均可行，且ODE推理具备部署友好的特性。

title: Instant LiDAR: Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction for LiDAR Simulation
summary: LiDAR reconstruction supports closed-loop autonomous driving simulation, but hours of per-scene optimization make large asset libraries costly to build and maintain. We present Instant LiDAR, a feed-forward pipeline that reconstructs multiple LiDAR scans as reusable Gaussian assets in minutes without per-scene optimization. LiDAR measurements provide strong geometric priors, but directly initializing Gaussians from them yields poor reconstruction due to nonuniform sampling and a limited field of view. Sparse returns leave surface gaps, while combining scans expands coverage but introduces redundant primitives. To address these challenges, Instant LiDAR combines measurement-anchored Gaussian prediction, sampling-aware Gaussian scales, and multi-frame consolidation. The predictor refines attributes anchored to recorded returns, while the scales adapt spatial support to LiDAR sampling. Multi-frame consolidation merges overlapping predictions into a compact asset spanning the driving log. Compared with NuRec, Instant LiDAR reconstructs scenes approximately 46 times faster on Physical AI (PAI) and 70 times faster on Waymo. It also achieves comparable downstream 3D detection accuracy on Waymo.

AI.tldr: Instant LiDAR：无需逐场景优化的前馈式LiDAR重建管线，将多帧LiDAR扫描在数分钟内重建为可复用高斯资产。
AI.motivation: LiDAR重建可支撑闭环自动驾驶仿真，但逐场景优化耗时数小时，使大型资产库的构建与维护成本高昂。目标是在无逐场景优化前提下快速重建可复用资产。直接由LiDAR测量初始化高斯会因非均匀采样与有限视场导致重建质量差：稀疏回波留下表面空洞，而多帧合并虽扩大覆盖却引入冗余基元。
AI.method: 提出三项关键设计：1）测量锚定的高斯预测（measurement-anchored Gaussian prediction），以记录的LiDAR回波为锚点并细化高斯属性；2）采样感知的高斯尺度（sampling-aware Gaussian scales），使空间支撑范围随LiDAR采样密度自适应；3）多帧整合（multi-frame consolidation），将重叠预测合并为覆盖整段驾驶日志的紧凑资产。
AI.result: 与NuRec相比，在Physical AI（PAI）上重建速度约快46倍，在Waymo上约快70倍；在Waymo上取得可比的下游3D检测精度。
AI.conclusion: Instant LiDAR以前馈方式在数分钟内生成紧凑、可复用的高斯资产，显著缩短资产库构建周期，并在保持下游3D检测精度的同时大幅提升重建效率，为大规模闭环自动驾驶仿真提供可行方案。

title: RubikSQL-HB: Agentic Text-to-SQL with Knowledge in the Loop
summary: Database agents need more than schema structure: business meanings, stored values and reference queries supply knowledge that becomes relevant at different points in reasoning. We introduce RubikSQL-HB, which exposes these materials through queryable, database-specific knowledge workspaces built on the HeavenBase platform. Its knowledge interface remains available as an agent constructs and investigates an answer. Candidate agents interleave knowledge access with SQL construction and execution; a downstream Judge can reuse the same interfaces to investigate disagreements. A two-stage example interface separates discovering a reference question from expanding its SQL. On a 500-question BIRD Mini-Dev evaluation, the full pipeline reaches 75.2% execution accuracy, against 71.2% for first-candidate selection and 70.4% for execution-majority voting, with a correct candidate available on 79.0% of questions. The raw-knowledge condition, which also regenerates candidates without the built workspace, is 3.0 points lower, and adjudication with tools and revision accounts for most of the gain over selection baselines. A recorded execution probe shows how continued investigation resolves a candidate disagreement. Separate archived runs show semantic revision recovering answers absent from their original candidate pools. A versioned development study further illustrates how recurring corrections become reusable execution checks. The system and results connect knowledge-interface design to agent decision quality: queryable knowledge supports the construction of useful alternatives, and evidence-aware adjudication connects those alternatives to a final answer. Keeping knowledge in the loop lets agents acquire relevant observations as their reasoning develops.

AI.tldr: 提出 RubikSQL-HB：基于 HeavenBase 平台构建可查询的、数据库特定的知识工作区，将业务语义、存储值与参考查询暴露为知识接口；候选智能体在构造与执行 SQL 之间交错访问知识，下游 Judge 复用同一接口进行证据感知的裁决。在 BIRD Mini-Dev 500 题上端到端执行准确率达 75.2%。
AI.motivation: 数据库智能体仅依赖 schema 结构不足：业务含义、库内存储值与参考查询所承载的知识，会在推理的不同阶段变得相关。需要一种能让智能体在推理过程中按需获取这些知识的机制。
AI.method: RubikSQL-HB 在 HeavenBase 平台上为每个数据库构建可查询的知识工作区；候选智能体将知识访问与 SQL 构造、执行交错进行；下游 Judge 复用相同接口调查候选分歧；采用两阶段示例接口，将"发现参考问题"与"展开其 SQL"分离。
AI.result: BIRD Mini-Dev 500 题上，完整流程执行准确率 75.2%，首候选选择为 71.2%，多数投票为 70.4%；79.0% 的问题存在正确候选。去掉工作区并重新生成候选的原始知识条件低 3.0 分；相对选择基线的大部分增益来自带工具与修订的裁决。
AI.conclusion: 可查询知识支持构建有用的候选方案，证据感知的裁决将这些候选连接到最终答案；将知识保留在回路中，使智能体能在推理推进过程中持续获得相关观察，从而把知识接口设计直接关联到智能体决策质量。

title: Evolve to Learn: Gradient-aligned experience evolution for model self-improvement
summary: Self-evolving language models can continuously acquire useful experience through test-time interaction, reflection, and prompt optimization, yet turning such experience into model itself to ensure self improvement remains challenging. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides a natural mechanism for internalizing test-time information into model parameters, yet it largely assumes that the gener- ated experience is worth learning. We show that this assumption does not always hold: experiences that improve test-time performance may provide limited or even harmful training signals. To better characterize which experience should be inter- nalized, we systematically analyze diverse mutated experiences across multiple tasks and reflection models, and find that gradient-based alignment is a more reli- able indicator of downstream distillation gains than immediate test-time improve- ment. Based on this finding, we propose E2L, a self-evolution framework that iteratively generates, evaluates, and distills experiences according to their esti- mated training utility. E2L closes the loop between experience generation and parameter learning, enabling agents to autonomously produce experience suitable for self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）默认“测试时的经验都值得学习”这一假设并不成立，并提出 E2L 框架，按估计的训练效用对经验进行筛选后再蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 自进化语言模型可通过测试时交互、反思与提示优化积累经验，但把这些经验内化为模型参数以保证自我提升仍困难。OPSD 提供了将测试时信息内化的机制，但默认生成的经验值得学习；作者发现能提升测试时表现的经验可能提供有限甚至有害的训练信号，因此需要刻画“哪些经验应被内化”。
AI.method: 在多任务、多反思模型上系统分析多种变异经验，比较“即时测试时提升”与“梯度对齐”作为蒸馏收益指标的可靠性；基于“梯度对齐更能预测下游蒸馏增益”的发现，提出 E2L 自进化框架，迭代地生成、评估并按估计的训练效用蒸馏经验。
AI.result: 实验分析表明梯度对齐是比即时测试时提升更可靠的下游蒸馏增益指标；E2L 将经验生成与参数学习闭环，使智能体能够自主产出适合自我提升的经验。
AI.conclusion: 经验不应以测试时收益为准入标准，而应以训练效用（梯度对齐）为准；基于该准则的 E2L 实现了经验生成与参数学习的闭环自进化。

title: EmbodiSafety: Benchmarking Risk Understanding and Response in Embodied AI
summary: Progress in embodied foundation models is largely measured by task success, while the physical safety of their decisions remains underexamined. Safety evaluations centered on rule following and binary judgments do not adequately assess whether embodied models understand environmental hazards and make safe decisions. We introduce EmbodiSafety, comprising 1,092 snapshot tasks and 540 trajectory tasks across 844 visual scenarios to assess safety over short and long horizons. Six response modes cover direct execution, refusal, clarification, constrained execution, autonomous recovery, and human escalation. Distinguishing recovery from human intervention makes the boundary of safe autonomy an explicit evaluation target. Our protocol assesses mode correctness, risk identification, and actionable handling, with complete decision accuracy requiring all applicable checks to pass. Claude-Opus-5.5 achieves the highest complete decision accuracy among reference models, reaching 56.1% on snapshots and 61.5% on trajectories. We further develop a data construction pipeline and curate 40k examples for safety alignment. Supervised training on this corpus raises the complete decision accuracy of Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3.5-4B.

AI.tldr: 提出具身安全基准 EmbodiSafety（1,092 快照任务 + 540 轨迹任务，覆盖 844 个视觉场景），以六种响应模式区分"自主恢复"与"人工接管"来刻画安全自主边界，并构建 40k 安全对齐数据提升小模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有具身基础模型评估以任务成功率为核心指标，对决策的物理安全性关注不足；而基于规则遵循与二分类判断的安全评测，无法有效衡量具身模型是否真正理解环境危害并做出安全决策。
AI.method: 构建 EmbodiSafety 基准：含 1,092 个快照任务与 540 个轨迹任务、844 个视觉场景，分别考察短时程与长时程安全。设计六种响应模式——直接执行、拒绝、澄清询问、约束执行、自主恢复、人工升级，将"自主恢复"与"人工介入"分离以显式标定安全自主边界。评测协议从模式正确性、风险识别、可执行处理三方面打分，仅当所有适用检查均通过才算"完全决策正确"。另构建数据构造流水线与 40k 安全对齐样本。
AI.result: 参考模型中 Claude-Opus-5.5 完全决策准确率最高，快照任务 56.1%、轨迹任务 61.5%；基于 40k 语料的有监督训练可提升 Qwen3.5-2B 与 Qwen3.5-4B 的完全决策准确率。
AI.conclusion: 具身模型的安全决策能力仍显著不足（最优模型准确率仅约 56%–62%），需要专门基准与多模式安全评测；所提数据构造与对齐训练是提升具身安全决策的有效途径。

title: SegPFN: Training-Free In-Context Segmentation with Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Networks
comment: 18 pages, including 8 pages of supplementary material
summary: In-context segmentation (ICS) uses one or a few annotated reference images to specify what to segment in a target image. Existing training-free ICS approaches typically rely on manually designed inference procedures, which may limit how flexibly reference information is combined. Learned in-context inference offers an adaptive alternative, but acquiring this capability through segmentation-specific training can compromise generalization to unseen domains. We therefore ask: can a pretrained in-context learner infer what to segment from annotated references without segmentation-specific training? We introduce SegPFN, a training-free framework that reformulates ICS as tabular classification over frozen visual features. A frozen tabular prior-data fitted network (PFN) uses labeled reference patches as context to classify patches in the target image. We comprehensively benchmark SegPFN against major existing ICS methods across 11 datasets spanning semantic, part, and personalized segmentation. SegPFN improves overall mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) by 4.7 points over the strongest overall baseline and achieves the highest average mIoU in four of five task-shot settings. Further analyses show that hard-negative reference patches improve fine-grained target discrimination, while joint conditioning enables SegPFN to use multiple references effectively. These results show that SegPFN offers a simple and effective paradigm for training-free in-context segmentation.

AI.tldr: SegPFN 将上下文分割重构为对冻结视觉特征的表格分类问题，借助冻结的表格 PFN 实现无需分割专门训练的上下文分割。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练 ICS 依赖手工设计的推理流程，限制参考信息的灵活组合；而通过学习获得上下文推理能力通常需分割专门训练，可能损害对未见域的泛化。作者因此探究：预训练的上下文学习器能否在无分割专门训练的情况下从标注参考中推断分割目标。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架 SegPFN，把 ICS 表述为对冻结视觉特征的表格分类：以带标注的参考图像块作为上下文，由冻结的表格先验数据拟合网络（PFN）对目标图像中的图像块进行分类。
AI.result: 在覆盖语义、部件与个性化分割的 11 个数据集上与主流 ICS 方法全面对比，整体 mIoU 较最强基线提升 4.7 点，并在五种任务-样本设置中的四种取得最高平均 mIoU。分析表明难负样本参考块可提升细粒度目标判别，联合条件化使模型能有效利用多张参考。
AI.conclusion: SegPFN 为免训练上下文分割提供了一种简单而有效的范式。

title: Learning World Models through Contrastive Identification of Actions
summary: Latent world models enable goal-directed planning from offline visual data, but prediction alone does not specify which action-related distinctions their representations should preserve. Inverse dynamics provides auxiliary supervision, yet squared-error action regression rewards additional information only through changes in the conditional action mean. We propose Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), which identifies the executed action among alternatives sampled from a history-conditioned behavior proposal. Comparing actions plausible in the same context targets information supplied by the next latent beyond history. Under exact behavior matching, we show that CIA can reward action information that leaves optimal inverse-regression error unchanged, and verify this distinction through a controlled learning example. CIA achieves higher planner-averaged mean success than the base world model and a regression inverse-dynamics baseline across five visual control benchmarks, without modifying the planner.

AI.tldr: 提出对比式动作识别（CIA）辅助目标：在同一历史条件下采样的候选动作中识别真实执行动作，代替传统的动作回归逆动力学，从而让世界模型隐表示保留更多与动作相关的信息，在五个视觉控制基准上提升规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型可基于离线视觉数据做目标导向规划，但仅靠预测目标并未规定隐表示应保留哪些与动作相关的区分性信息。常用的逆动力学辅助监督采用平方误差回归，只通过条件动作均值的变化来奖励额外信息，因此对不影响最优回归误差的动作信息没有激励。
AI.method: CIA 以历史为条件的行为提议分布采样若干候选动作，构造对比任务：从候选中识别被实际执行的动作。由于候选动作在同一上下文下均"合理"，比较被迫依赖下一时刻潜表示中超出历史所提供的信息。作者在精确行为匹配假设下做理论分析，并用受控学习示例验证该机制。
AI.result: 理论表明，在精确行为匹配下，CIA 能够奖励那些不会改变最优逆回归误差的动作信息，说明其监督信号严格强于平方误差回归；受控实验验证了这一区分。在五个视觉控制基准上，CIA 的规划器平均成功率高于基础世界模型和回归式逆动力学基线，且未修改规划器本身。
AI.conclusion: 对比式动作识别为潜世界模型提供了比动作回归更具信息约束力的辅助目标，在不改动规划器的前提下改善下游规划性能，并揭示了"预测/回归误差不变"与"表示信息充分性"之间的关键差异。

title: Fractal Neural Synthesis: Constant-Storage Procedural Weight Derivation via Complex Quadratic Boundary Dynamics
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Reproducible code, seeds, and raw benchmark telemetry archived under Zenodo Concept DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22774934
summary: Conventional neural networks store synaptic parameters as explicit tensors whose persistent Flash footprint scales linearly (O(W)) with parameter count, constraining resource-limited edge microcontrollers. We formulate and systematically evaluate Fractal Neural Synthesis (FNS), a procedural weight derivation architecture that replaces hidden-layer matrices with a constant 24-byte coordinate seed Theta = (c_x, c_y, ell) in F_64^3 anchored near the complex quadratic bifurcation boundary dM of f_c(z) = z^2 + c. We introduce a large-bailout (R = 256) smooth escape kernel, four zero-overhead geometric sampling apertures--Cartesian Grid, coprime 3x3 Rule-of-Thirds (Z/9Z), phi-Vogel spiral, and multi-scale Harmonic Tripod--and prove conditional Kolmogorov (K_Kolm <= 192 + c_0 bits) and Shannon entropy bounds. Across magnifications zeta in [10^0, 10^8], C^1 Fourier and lattice-noise bases collapse to post-standardization rank ~2.25 and SHA-256 PRNG exhibits avalanche discontinuity (rho ~ 0.019, 50.6% micro-step retention), whereas dM uniquely sustains both rank (~10.0) and local continuity (rho in [0.81, 0.97], 89.2% retention). Under leak-free 10-fold CV across four zero-scaler-byte non-linear benchmarks, FNS with an INT8 readout surpasses 0-hidden Linear-INT8 by +3.6 to +10.8 pp while delivering 10.7x-129x total Flash reduction (725x-2,773x hidden reduction) relative to converged Float32 MLPs (90.30% Ionosphere in 285 B; 97.22% Optical Digits in 2,598 B; 97.90% PenDigits in 2,598 B; 87.00% Satimage in 1,570 B).

AI.tldr: 提出分形神经合成(FNS)：用24字节复数坐标种子取代隐藏层权重矩阵，在Julia集双曲分支边界dM附近程序化生成权重，实现极端Flash节省下仍超越零隐藏层线性INT8基线。
AI.motivation: 传统神经网络以显式张量存储突触参数，Flash占用随参数量线性增长O(W)，难以部署于资源受限的边缘微控制器。作者希望寻求一种常数存储预算下的权重生成范式。
AI.method: 将隐藏层矩阵替换为位于f_c(z)=z²+c的双曲分支边界dM附近的常数24字节坐标种子Θ=(c_x,c_y,ℓ)∈F_64³；提出大逃逸半径R=256的光滑逃逸核；设计四种零开销几何采样孔径（笛卡尔网格、互素3x3三分法Z/9Z、φ-Vogel螺旋、多尺度调和三脚架）；并给出条件Kolmogorov复杂度(K_Kolm≤192+c_0比特)与Shannon熵界证明。在放大倍数ζ∈[10⁰,10⁸]内，与C¹ Fourier基、格点噪声基及SHA-256 PRNG作对照实验，用标准化后秩与局部连续性ρ评估。
AI.result: Fourier与格点噪声基塌缩至秩≈2.25，SHA-256 PRNG出现雪崩不连续(ρ≈0.019，微步保留率50.6%)；唯有dM同时保持秩≈10.0与局部连续性(ρ∈[0.81,0.97]，保留率89.2%)。在无泄漏10折交叉验证下，FNS+INT8读出层较0隐藏Linear-INT8提升3.6–10.8个百分点，总Flash较收敛Float32 MLP降低10.7x–129x(隐藏层降低725x–2,773x)：Ionosphere 90.30%/285 B、Optical Digits 97.22%/2,598 B、PenDigits 97.90%/2,598 B、Satimage 87.00%/1,570 B。
AI.conclusion: 程序化权重合成可在常数级(24字节)存储预算下替代显式隐藏层参数，且几何结构选择（尤其dM附近的高秩与局部连续性）是性能关键；该方法为微控制器端神经网络提供了可行的极低Flash部署路径。

title: Neural Implicit Representation for Bathymetry Estimation using Sidescan Sonar Imagery
comment: 7 pages, 8 figures. This paper is accepted by IEEE OCEANS 2026 Monterey
summary: Bathymetry measurement and estimation is critical for understanding the structure of underwater environments. While multibeam echosounders (MBES) provide accurate depth measurements, their deployment on surface vessels limits spatial resolution in deep water. Sidescan sonar (SSS), in contrast, can be deployed on autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) to operate closer to the seafloor, enabling high-resolution acoustic imaging. However, the inherent ambiguity in measurements and the limited observation coverage of sonar datasets degrade the performance of state-of-the-art methods for underwater bathymetry estimation from SSS. In this paper, we propose a differentiable neural rendering framework for SSS that enables effective estimation of bathymetry from SSS measurements. Our approach incorporates a measurement model based on SSS geometry, explicitly accounting for its wide elevation aperture and associated ambiguities. We evaluate our method on both synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrating improved robustness and accuracy compared to alternative approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向侧扫声呐的可微神经渲染框架，通过显式建模宽仰角孔径及测量歧义的几何测量模型，从侧扫声呐数据中实现稳健、高精度的水下地形估计。
AI.motivation: 多波束测深仪虽精度高，但搭载于水面船，深水区空间分辨率受限；侧扫声呐可搭载AUV近底作业，实现高分辨率成像，但测量本身存在固有歧义且声呐数据观测覆盖有限，导致现有基于侧扫声呐的地形估计方法性能下降。
AI.method: 构建可微神经渲染框架用于侧扫声呐；引入基于侧扫声呐几何的测量模型，显式刻画其宽仰角孔径及由此产生的歧义；通过可微渲染将声呐观测与地形表示联合优化。
AI.result: 在合成数据集与真实数据集上均进行评测，与对比方法相比展现出更强的鲁棒性与更高的估计精度。
AI.conclusion: 将侧扫声呐几何与歧义显式纳入可微神经渲染，可有效缓解观测歧义与覆盖不足问题，为基于侧扫声呐的水下地形估计提供可行且有效的方案。

title: SurgGenesis: A Generative Surgical World Model for Future-Aware Surgical Understanding
summary: Surgical scene understanding is constrained by data scarcity and long-tail class imbalance, as annotating surgical videos demands scarce clinical expertise while rare procedural events remain underrepresented. We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

AI.tldr: SurgGenesis：基于潜在空间的世界模型生成手术未来状态，用三阶段渐进式LoRA适配视频扩散模型，并以"未来感知性"和"动作忠实有用性"两轴验证其作为可扩展手术数据引擎的有效性。
AI.motivation: 手术场景理解受限于数据稀缺与长尾类别不平衡：手术视频标注依赖稀缺的临床专业知识，稀有手术事件样本严重不足。
AI.method: 提出SurgGenesis生成式手术世界模型，从视觉观测与文本流程描述中于潜在空间学习未来手术状态转移。为在数据稀缺的手术域中适配大规模视频扩散模型并避免灾难性遗忘，设计三阶段渐进式LoRA策略，依次注入内窥镜视觉先验、流程语义与空间运动线索。
AI.result: 沿两条轴验证：(i) 未来感知性——通过GT潜变量预测差距与时间跨度分析，将预测未来与真实未来对比；(ii) 动作忠实有用性——检验生成片段是否包含指定手术三元组，以及用其重平衡长尾事件并驱动下游任务（分割、三元组识别、三维重建）是否带来动作特异的性能增益。
AI.conclusion: SurgGenesis可作为可扩展的手术数据引擎，其条件化生成的未来片段能补充传统长尾采样策略，兼具未来预测能力与动作可控的下游实用价值。

title: Accuracy of Noise Ceiling Estimators for Brain Scores
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 35 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables
summary: The internal activations of modern machine learning models align surprisingly well with the activities recorded in real brains. In the last five years, the alignment between encoding models and brain activities, often called brain scores, has steadily increased. Because brain recordings are noisy, there exists an upper bound to the brain scores that any model can achieve. This bound, called the noise ceiling, is crucial for two reasons: it determines whether further improvements in model performance are possible, and it enables meaningful comparisons of brain scores across benchmarks. The field has developed multiple approaches to estimate noise ceilings, but the statistical properties of existing estimators remain poorly understood, leaving it unclear in which experimental settings they provide reliable estimates. Here, we introduce a unified mathematical framework for brain recordings, use it to derive closed-form expressions for four commonly used noise ceiling estimators, and provide theoretical predictions for the behavior of each estimator. We validate the theoretical predictions with simulations that we compare to noise ceiling estimates in existing fMRI and EEG datasets. We find that the existing methods underestimate the true noise ceiling in different settings. We conclude with recommendations for best practice in different situations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个脑记录的统一直觉数学框架，推导出四种常用noise ceiling估计量的闭式表达式并给出其统计性质的理论预测，发现现有方法在不同情形下低估真实noise ceiling，并据此给出使用建议。
AI.motivation: encoding模型与脑活动的对齐度（brain score）持续提升，但脑记录含噪声，存在任何模型都无法超越的上界——noise ceiling。它决定模型性能是否还有提升空间，并使跨基准的brain score可比。然而已有多种noise ceiling估计方法，其统计性质理解不足，不清楚在何种实验设置下可靠。
AI.method: 建立脑记录的统一数学框架，在该框架下为四种常用noise ceiling估计量推导闭式表达式，给出各估计量行为（偏差等统计性质）的理论预测；用模拟实验验证理论预测，并与现有fMRI和EEG数据集上的noise ceiling估计结果进行比较。
AI.result: 理论预测与模拟结果一致；与fMRI、EEG真实数据估计对比表明，现有方法在不同设置下均低估真实noise ceiling。
AI.conclusion: 现有noise ceiling估计量存在系统性低估偏差，估计值不能直接视为真实上界；论文最后针对不同实验情形给出最佳实践建议。

title: Not All Pairs Align: Caption-Guided Audio-Visual Contrastive Learning
summary: We address the problem of learning audio-visual representations from co-occurring modalities. Multimodal contrastive learning typically assumes that paired observations provide shared views of the same underlying information. While this may be true for datasets collected in constrained environments, it does not always hold. For instance, co-occurring audio and visual signals can differ substantially in their content due to off-screen sounds. Nevertheless, standard contrastive objectives treat all paired samples as equally aligned. In this work, we propose Caption Guided Alignment Aware Loss (CGAAL), a model-agnostic objective that leverages modality-specific captions to estimate semantic agreement between audio and video. CGAAL uses these agreement scores to weight the contribution of each positive pair. A warm-up period and gradual thresholding strategy progressively introduce this alignment-aware training signal. We demonstrate the generality of CGAAL by applying it to three contrastive baselines, consistently improving their performance on audio-visual retrieval.

AI.tldr: 提出CGAAL——一种模型无关的损失函数，利用模态专属字幕估计音视频语义一致性，并对正样本对加权，以缓解多模态对比学习中等权对待配对样本的假设缺陷。
AI.motivation: 标准多模态对比学习假设共现的音视频观测是同一潜在信息的共享视图，因而将所有配对样本视为同等对齐。但在非受控数据中，画外音等因素会导致音视频内容出现实质差异，等权处理正样本对会引入噪声监督。
AI.method: CGAAL以模态特定字幕（音频字幕与视频字幕）为依据，估计音频与视频之间的语义一致度，并将该一致度得分作为权重作用于每个正样本对的损失贡献；同时采用预热期与渐进式阈值策略，逐步引入该对齐感知训练信号。方法为模型无关，可嵌入现有对比学习框架。
AI.result: 将CGAAL应用于三个对比学习基线后，均在音视频检索任务上取得一致性性能提升，验证了其通用性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 对齐质量并非恒定，按语义一致性重加权正样本对是改进音视频对比表征学习的有效途径；CGAAL提供了一种可与多种基线组合的通用目标。

title: Exploratory Midtraining for Robot Policies
summary: Robot policies predominantly learn from human-collected data emphasizing competent behavior, limiting coverage of the low-level behaviors needed to support autonomous improvement. We study how a form of midtraining can be used to build coverage over diverse low-level behaviors that connect challenging states of the robot and its environment to states from which further progress is possible ("connected behavioral coverage"). We also examine how this coverage supports downstream adaptation and online improvement. To this end, we introduce $β$-Data, a dataset collected via adversarial teleoperation, where a human adversary reversibly perturbs the environment while a human operator continues toward completion without resetting. We relabel trajectory segments with local outcomes in natural language and finetune a pretrained policy conditioned on recent action history. The resulting policy exhibits sustained use of more low-level behaviors. Across manipulation tasks in simulation and on three real-robot platforms, our approach yields more favorable data scaling laws, better zero-shot generalization, and more effective use of additional rollout time than training on standard demonstrations. During online finetuning, these policies need fewer rollouts to collect successful experience and reach higher success rates, suggesting that midtraining can prepare robots for both more robust task execution and continued autonomous improvement. Our project page and robot videos are available at https://kshitiz-1225.github.io/exploratory-midtraining-robot-policies/.

AI.tldr: 提出"beta-data"数据集与中训练(midtraining)方法，通过人类对抗式遥操作收集多样低层行为，构建"连通行为覆盖"，提升下游适应与在线改进能力。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人策略主要从强调"胜任行为"的人类数据中学习，覆盖的低层行为有限，缺乏支撑机器人自主改进所需的多样性行为；作者希望研究中训练能否建立连接困难状态与可继续前进状态的低层行为覆盖（连通行为覆盖），并检验该覆盖对下游适应和在线改进的作用。
AI.method: 构建 beta-Data 数据集：采用对抗式遥操作，由人类对抗者可逆地扰动环境，同时操作者在不重置的情况下继续完成任务；随后用自然语言局部结果对轨迹片段重标注(relabel)，并以最近动作历史为条件微调预训练策略。在仿真操作任务和三个真实机器人平台上评估。
AI.result: 所得策略持续使用更多低层行为；相比标准演示训练，表现出更优的数据缩放律、更好的零样本泛化、以及对额外 rollout 时间的更有效利用；在线微调时所需 rollout 更少即可收集成功经验，并达到更高成功率。
AI.conclusion: 中训练可使机器人既具备更鲁棒的任务执行能力，也具备持续自主改进的准备，表明行为覆盖对任务执行与在线学习均有价值。

title: LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition
summary: We propose LoopDVR, a framework for converting pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks. Rather than reducing the network width or depth directly, LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across layers in both the ViT backbone and Transformer decoder, reducing the number of parameters while retaining the original computational structure. However, naively sharing parameters can disrupt the distinct transformations learned at different depths. To address this challenge, we identify suitable sharing groups based on inter-layer representation dissimilarity and keep the final backbone block independent for multi-scale feature construction. We then initialize each shared backbone block with the pretrained weights of its group's terminal layer to better preserve the learned representations. An independent Loop Adapter at each layer further helps retain depth-specific transformations within shared blocks. Subsequently, we distill visual representations into the looped backbone and integrate it with a looped decoder for task-specific training. Experiments demonstrate that LoopDVR achieves the best accuracy--parameter trade-offs across dense recognition tasks. Compared with the reference models, it reduces parameters by approximately 28% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Notably, LoopDet-S achieves 50.9 box AP with only 7.0M parameters, highlighting its effectiveness in compact models.

AI.tldr: LoopDVR将预训练Transformer密集视觉识别模型转换为参数高效的循环网络：在ViT主干与Transformer解码器间跨层复用模块，依据层间表示差异划分共享组、末层保持独立、组末层权重初始化并配独立Loop Adapter，经表征蒸馏后联合循环解码器训练；参数减少约28%而精度相当，其中LoopDet-S仅7.0M参数达50.9 box AP。
AI.motivation: 现有紧凑化方法多直接削减网络宽度或深度，会改变原有计算结构并损失性能；直接共享参数又会破坏不同深度学到的差异化变换。作者希望在保留原计算结构的前提下降低参数量，并缓解朴素参数共享带来的表示退化问题。
AI.method: 1) 跨ViT主干与Transformer解码器的层间复用Transformer块，不改动计算结构；2) 基于层间表示不相似度确定合适的共享分组；3) 保留主干最后一个块独立以构建多尺度特征；4) 每个共享块用其所属组末端层的预训练权重初始化；5) 每层引入独立Loop Adapter保留深度特异的变换；6) 将视觉表征蒸馏进循环主干，并与循环解码器结合进行任务特定训练。
AI.result: 在多种密集识别任务上取得最优的精度—参数折中；相较参考模型参数减少约28%，精度保持可比；LoopDet-S以7.0M参数达到50.9 box AP，显示其在紧凑模型上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 参数共享式循环化可在不改变计算结构的情况下有效压缩密集视觉识别模型，且共享分组策略、末层独立、组末层初始化与逐层Adapter是保持精度的关键设计。

title: Interactive Neural Computers
summary: Computers and their interfaces are usually treated as fixed, so a person, or increasingly an AI agent, must adapt to whatever the operating system presents. This is limiting when someone needs a different workflow, or an interface suited to hands-free use or a disability. We explore an overlooked alternative. Rather than training an agent to operate an existing computer, we train a generative model to be the computer, predicting each next screen from past screens and the user's mouse and keyboard actions. Treating a desktop as an interactive world model raises problems that natural-video world models largely avoid. Without a camera pose to index memory, the model must remember content that has left the screen without any geometric cues. Arithmetic in a terminal has to be exactly right, not merely plausible. Small interface text must also stay legible at interactive frame rates. Our Interactive Neural Computer is structured like a Neural Turing Machine and starts to address these problems with three modules trained end to end from pixels and actions. A surprise-gated slot memory, supervised by latent next-frame prediction (MEMORY-JEPA), stores what is off screen. An exploratory query bridge brings in the reasoning of a pretrained VLM, and a residual renderer predicts only the latent changes between frames. In long closed-loop rollouts, our model recalls occluded files in 64.2% of trials (chance is 33.3%), compared with at most 56.0% for recurrent and sliding-window baselines. It also raises terminal-text OCR accuracy from 1.3% to 50.1%. Finally, because the memory is explicit, it can be transplanted at test time to causally change what the model renders.

AI.tldr: 提出Interactive Neural Computer(INC)：不再训练智能体去操作现有计算机，而是用生成模型直接充当计算机，根据历史屏幕画面与用户鼠标键盘动作逐帧预测下一屏，像Neural Turing Machine一样由像素和动作端到端训练。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机与界面被视为固定，人和AI智能体只能被动适应操作系统，难以满足个性化工作流、免手操作或残障用户的需求；而让智能体适应界面属于被动的妥协方案。作者转而探索"让模型本身成为计算机"这一被忽视的方向，但桌面世界模型面临自然视频世界模型少有的难题：没有相机位姿可索引记忆、终端算术必须精确、小字号界面文本需在交互帧率下保持清晰。
AI.method: 三个模块端到端训练：(1) 惊奇门控槽记忆(surprise-gated slot memory)，由潜空间下一帧预测MEMORY-JEPA监督，用于存储已离开屏幕的内容；(2) 探索性查询桥(exploratory query bridge)，引入预训练VLM的推理能力；(3) 残差渲染器(residual renderer)，仅预测帧间的潜空间变化量。
AI.result: 长时闭环rollout中，模型在64.2%的试次里能回忆被遮挡文件（随机为33.3%），优于循环与滑动窗口基线的最高56.0%；终端文本OCR准确率从1.3%提升至50.1%；由于记忆是显式的，可在测试时移植以因果性地改变模型渲染结果。
AI.conclusion: 将桌面建模为交互式世界模型是可行且有效的，显式槽记忆+残差渲染+VLM查询的组合能缓解无位姿记忆、精确性与文本可读性问题，且显式记忆具备可解释、可编辑、可移植的优势，为"生成模型即计算机"提供了初步验证。

title: Optimal Transport Meets t-SNE: Integrated Visualization without Batch Effects in OT-tSNE
comment: 35 pages, 18 figures, 5 tables. Code at https://github.com/NDR-lab/ot-tsne
summary: Visual exploration is an integral step in understanding the structure of datasets. However, systematic variation between datasets collected under different conditions, known as batch effects, can obscure shared structure and complicate their joint visualization. Existing methods often rely on cross-batch nearest-neighbor relations to integrate the batches. Yet, these local correspondences can be unreliable for challenging cross-batch geometries. We propose optimal-transport t-SNE (OT-tSNE), which replaces nearest-neighbor-based matching with globally coupled affinities derived from entropic optimal transport. Controlled synthetic experiments demonstrated that nearest-neighbor-based methods can deteriorate, while optimal-transport affinities and OT-tSNE embeddings remain robust. Across seven real single-cell datasets, we benchmarked OT-tSNE against a broad range of integration and visualization methods and found that it achieves a Pareto-efficient trade-off between batch mixing and biological conservation, and integrates batches particularly well.

AI.tldr: 提出最优传输t-SNE（OT-tSNE），用熵正则最优传输得到的全局耦合亲和度替代t-SNE中的最近邻匹配，以实现更稳健的批次整合与可视化。
AI.motivation: 联合可视化多批次数据时，批次效应会掩盖共享结构；现有方法依赖跨批次最近邻关系进行整合，但在困难的跨批次几何下这类局部对应不可靠。
AI.method: 将t-SNE中基于最近邻的匹配替换为由熵正则最优传输导出的全局耦合亲和度；通过受控合成实验与真实单细胞数据基准测试进行评估。
AI.result: 合成实验显示最近邻类方法会退化，而最优传输亲和度与OT-tSNE嵌入保持稳健；在七个真实单细胞数据集上，OT-tSNE在批次混合与生物学保守性之间达到Pareto有效权衡，批次整合效果尤佳。
AI.conclusion: 全局最优传输耦合是替代局部最近邻匹配的有效方案，OT-tSNE可作为兼顾批次混合与生物信号保留的可视化整合工具。

title: iWAM: Efficient Action Prediction from World Models without Explicit Future Prediction
summary: World-action models (WAMs) build policies on pretrained video-generation models, on the premise that predicting how a scene evolves helps determine how to act. However, generating future scenes is expensive for real-time control. This motivates efficient proxies for future imagination, but how to train such proxies without sacrificing action-prediction quality remains unclear. An effective proxy need not generate a high-resolution frame; it only needs to provide enough information to distinguish between possible futures. This leads to the design principle behind iWAM: rather than denoising an entire future frame, can we condition the action policy on intermediate features from a single video-model evaluation? We show that the answer is yes. Exploiting the reversible dynamics of flow-matching models, we invert each training future into the corresponding latent noise vector. However, a single velocity evaluation at this latent does not necessarily yield informative features for action prediction. We therefore learn a bidirectional flow map that amortizes future-generation computation, enabling a single model evaluation to provide effective conditioning features. At inference, we sample a latent noise vector from the prior and condition the policy using just one video-backbone forward pass. Across simulated benchmarks and real robots, iWAM recovers the generalization benefits of WAMs while substantially reducing its inference cost.

AI.tldr: iWAM 提出一种高效的世界-动作模型：利用流匹配模型的可逆动力学把训练时的未来帧反演为隐噪声向量，并学习一个双向流映射，使策略仅需单次视频骨干前向传播即可获得有效的未来条件特征，从而在保持泛化能力的同时大幅降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）依赖预训练视频生成模型预测场景演化来指导动作，但完整生成未来帧的计算代价过高，难以支撑实时控制。现有高效代理方案在训练时往往牺牲动作预测质量，且如何训练这类代理仍不明确。作者指出，代理不必生成高分辨率帧，只需提供足以区分不同未来所需的信息。
AI.method: 基于流匹配模型的可逆性，将每个训练用未来帧反演为对应隐噪声向量；由于在该隐变量处仅做单次速度评估不足以产生有信息量的动作预测特征，论文学习一个双向流映射（bidirectional flow map）来摊销未来生成的计算，使单次模型评估即可给出有效条件特征。推理时从先验采样隐噪声向量，仅用一次视频骨干前向传播即可条件化策略。
AI.result: 在仿真基准与真实机器人上，iWAM 恢复了 WAMs 的泛化优势，同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 未来想象的高效代理无需完整生成帧，只需"足够区分未来"的信息；结合可逆流反演与双向流映射，可将世界模型的未来推演压缩为单次前向传播，为实时可用的世界-动作模型提供了可行路径。

title: Not the Scalar, but Its Evolution: Robust Source Attribution for Generated Images
summary: The widespread deployment of latent generative models (LGMs) makes generated image source attribution essential for copyright auditing and data governance, yet practical attribution should remain reliable under common post-processing and platform-induced processing. Existing reconstruction-based attribution methods summarize an image's reconstruction response to a single global scalar, such as the reconstruction error or the ratio of two consecutive errors. These summaries discard channel-frequency structure, allowing image content and post-processing variation to obscure source evidence and making attribution after spreading difficult. We instead uncover a more stable source-discriminative cue under post-processing: the frequency-resolved evolution of residual energy across repeated applications of the same reconstruction operator. Motivated by this insight, we characterize a phenomenon we term Spectral Contraction and use it to build SpCon, a source-attribution framework that accesses only the target model's VAE. SpCon obtains adjacent residuals through two deterministic reconstructions, builds a spectral-contraction representation from their frequency-resolved relative energy change, and aggregates Student-t response densities for each source-condition pair over a finite set of fitted reference components. The same representation supports three settings according to non-belonging reference availability: none (Target-Only, TO; belonging references only), external out-of-domain sources (External-Reference, ER), or known in-domain competitors (Known-Reference, KR). Across seven LGMs, TO, ER, and KR attain average AUROC/AP of 0.8786/0.6344, 0.9404/0.7886, and 0.9652/0.8626 over the 35 conditions, all outperforming the strongest baseline (0.8154/0.5277), and achieve 0.8581/0.5507, 0.9369/0.7549, and 0.9734/0.8773 on the three social platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出“Spectral Contraction”现象，用残差能量的频率分辨演化作为判别线索，构建仅需目标模型VAE的溯源框架SpCon，在35种后处理条件下AUROC/AP显著优于基线，并在社交平台条件下同样有效。
AI.motivation: 潜在生成模型（LGM）广泛部署，生成图像的来源溯源对版权审计和数据治理至关重要，但现有基于重建的溯源方法（如重建误差或相邻误差之比）将重建响应压缩为单一全局标量，丢失了通道-频率结构，使图像内容与后处理变化掩盖来源证据，传播后溯源困难。
AI.method: 从理论上刻画“Spectral Contraction”现象，构造SpCon框架：(1) 仅访问目标模型的VAE；(2) 通过两次确定性重建获得相邻残差；(3) 以其频率分辨的相对能量变化构建谱收缩表示；(4) 在有限拟合参考分量集合上，对每个源-条件对聚合Student-t响应密度。依参考可用性设三种设定：Target-Only（TO，仅归属参考）、External-Reference（ER，外部域外源）、Known-Reference（KR，已知域内竞争源）。
AI.conclusion: 相较于用全局标量概括重建响应，保留频率分辨结构的谱收缩表示对后处理更为稳健，可在仅访问VAE的实用约束下，跨模型、跨后处理及平台传播场景实现可靠溯源。

title: Measurement Artifacts in Trustworthiness Evaluations of Quantized Small Language Models
summary: Evaluations of quantized language models attribute the change in a benchmark score to quantization. We write the measured change as the true change plus a term contributed by the instrument. Instrument error that is the same at every precision can shrink a paired comparison but cannot create or reverse an effect. Error that interacts with quantization can do both, and it is reported as an effect of quantization. We estimate this interaction for four measurement choices in 8 instruction-tuned models below two billion parameters, at float16, LLM.int8() and NF4, on identical items. Measured against labels from two human annotators, the 4-bit rise in harmful compliance is about half to two-thirds of the rise in non-refusal that a corrected key word detector records. Cloze and lettered multiple-choice scoring disagree about the effect of quantization far more than their noise allows: their estimates correlate at \r{ho} = 0.10, against a ceiling of about 0.77. LLM.int8() answers and generations depend on which items share a batch, and padding alone changes its answers. Rounding activations to 8 bits is enough to produce this dependence. NF4 is batch-invariant. The two largest reported calibration losses are response-bias shifts. We release item-level predictions, option scores and human annotations, and give recommendations for evaluating compressed small models.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有量化语言模型评测把基准分数变化直接归因于量化，忽略了"测量工具误差"这一混淆项；作者提出并估计了量化与测量选择的交互误差，发现4-bit有害合规率上升被高估、Cloze与选项式多选题评测结论高度不一致、LLM.int8()存在批次依赖而NF4批次不变。
AI.motivation: 量化模型评测通常把"分数变化=量化效应"，但测量仪器本身会引入误差。若误差在各精度下相同，只会缩小配对比较（不能创造或逆转效应）；但若误差与量化发生交互，则既能创造也能逆转效应，并被误报为量化效应。作者希望量化这种交互误差，检验结论在多大程度上是测量artifact。
AI.method: 在8个参数低于20亿的指令微调模型上，于float16、LLM.int8()、NF4三种精度、完全相同的测试条目上，估计四种测量选择的交互误差：(1)以两位人工标注者的标签为金标准校准关键词型拒答检测器；(2)比较Cloze评分与字母选项式多选题评分；(3)测试批次组成与padding对LLM.int8()回答与生成的影响，并考察激活8-bit舍入是否足以复现；(4)复查报告的两处最大校准损失来源。全程使用条目级预测与选项分数。
AI.result: 4-bit下有害合规的上升幅度约为校正后关键词检测器所记录"非拒答"上升的1/2至2/3，即原指标高估；Cloze与字母多选题对量化效应的估计相关性仅ρ=0.10，远低于约0.77的噪声上限，二者分歧远超噪声可解释范围；LLM.int8()的答案与生成依赖同批次条目，仅padding变化即可改变输出，将激活舍入到8位即可产生该依赖性，而NF4对批次不变；两处最大校准损失实为回答偏向（response-bias）漂移。
AI.conclusion: 量化评测中相当一部分"量化效应"是测量交互误差的产物。评价小模型压缩后行为时需控制批次组成、padding、评分范式，并以人工标注校正自动指标、报告响应偏向；作者发布条目级预测、选项分数与人工标注，并给出压缩小模型的评测建议。

title: A Framework for Graph Node Symmetric Quantification under Dataset Shift
summary: Graph node quantification is the supervised learning task of estimating the prevalence of different classes within an arbitrary sample of unlabelled nodes from a graph, subject to some form of dataset shift. Existing approaches to graph node quantification typically follow the standard aggregative paradigm, i.e., they use labelled nodes from the graph to train an intermediate node classifier, and obtain an estimated class distribution for the sample by aggregating the classifier's predictions for the individual nodes and then correcting the result via some adjustment strategy that accounts for dataset shift. In this work we propose a framework for graph node quantification that does away with both node-level supervision, since its training phase only requires node samples labelled by their class distribution, and node-level predictions, since it estimates class prevalence values directly, without the need of any intermediate node classifier. The framework thus allows symmetric quantification, since (unlike in standard ``asymmetric'' quantification methods) the labelled items used for training and the unlabelled items on which predictions must be issued are of the same type (i.e., node samples). This framework (that we dub GSQ, for Graph Node Symmetric Quantification) allows building pipelines consisting of a node encoder, an embedding pooler, a prevalence predictor, and an optional post-hoc scaling step. These components can be instantiated by choosing from different trainable and reservoir-based encoders, different pooling operators, and different prediction objectives. We evaluate the GSQ framework on binary and multi-class datasets with different levels of homophily, under prior probability shift and under structural covariate shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GSQ框架，实现无需节点级监督与节点级预测的图节点对称量化，直接由节点样本的类分布标签训练并直接输出类别流行度。
AI.motivation: 现有图节点量化方法遵循聚合范式：先训练中间节点分类器，再聚合单节点预测并做数据集偏移校正。这类"非对称"量化所需的训练标注（节点级标签）与待预测对象（节点样本）类型不一致，且依赖中间分类器。
AI.method: GSQ框架由节点编码器、嵌入池化器、流行度预测器以及可选的后期缩放步骤构成一条流水线；训练阶段只需带类分布标签的节点样本，可直接从不同可训练编码器与储层（reservoir）编码器、不同池化算子以及不同预测目标中实例化各组件，直接估计类别流行度而无需中间节点分类器。
AI.result: 在二分类与多分类数据集上，涵盖不同同质性水平，并在先验概率偏移与结构协变量偏移两种设定下对GSQ框架进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: GSQ提供了一种对称量化范式，使训练与预测对象类型一致（均为节点样本），摆脱了节点级监督和节点级预测，为图节点量化提供了可组合的模块化框架。

title: ROAM-Bench: Evaluating Embodied Active Spatial Intelligence through Evidence Verification
summary: Embodied spatial intelligence requires agents to gather information through exploration and interaction, then use it to reason and act. Existing benchmarks insufficiently distinguish correct outcomes from completion of these task requirements. We introduce ROAM-Bench to evaluate these abilities under robot motion and collision constraints. Independent checks use simulation state and episode records to assess outcomes and task requirements, with stronger checks of geometry, coverage, or placement. It comprises 250 manually validated tasks across 11 types in five groups and 27 indoor environments, covering object and room search, counting, geometric judgments, direction reasoning, and relocation. Human evaluators achieve 84% strict task success on 100 sampled tasks, with every correct outcome satisfying the required checks. Across seven frontier vision-language models, we identify two complementary failure modes: correct outcomes with unmet task requirements, and incorrect outcomes despite passing stronger checks. Oracle-input diagnostics show that more complete target observations and calibrated feedback improve final spatial judgments.

AI.tldr: ROAM-Bench 是一个在机器人运动与碰撞约束下评测具身空间智能的基准，通过独立检查区分“结果正确”与“任务要求完成”，包含 250 个任务、11 类任务型、27 个室内环境。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法充分区分“正确结果”与“是否真正完成了任务要求”（即探索、交互过程是否符合要求），因此需要一个能在运动与碰撞约束下同时评估结果与任务完成质量的评测框架。
AI.method: 构建 ROAM-Bench：基于仿真状态与回合记录进行独立检查，对几何、覆盖率、放置等施加更强的过程性检查；涵盖 5 组 11 类共 250 个人工校验任务，分布于 27 个室内场景，涉及物体与房间搜索、计数、几何判断、方向推理和搬移；并对 7 个前沿视觉语言模型进行评估，辅以 oracle 输入诊断。
AI.result: 人类评估者在 100 个抽样任务上达到 84% 的严格任务成功率，且所有正确结果均满足必需检查；7 个前沿 VLM 表现出两类互补失败模式：结果正确但任务要求未满足，以及通过了更强检查却结果错误；oracle 输入诊断表明更完整的目标观测与校准反馈可提升最终空间判断。
AI.conclusion: 仅看结果正确性会高估具身空间智能，过程性约束检查不可或缺；观测完整性与校准反馈是改进模型空间推理的关键方向。

title: Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments
summary: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Clinical3D-Bench（3,368 题、8 类任务、373 个医院病房布局，含配对场景状态）与 44,750 题训练集 Clinical3D-45K，发现 35 个 MLLM 表现不佳且微调后仍不真正使用 3D 地图，进而提出 GeoJeV，让模型以 3D 操作推理并将证据注入选项打分，取得所有评估模型中的最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 医院空间推理需要识别外观相似的设备、理解患者相对方位、判断通道宽度等能力，而现有基准对这些能力的覆盖有限；同时需检验模型是否在相关证据变化时随之改变答案（而非依赖答案先验）。
AI.method: 构建 Clinical3D-Bench：基于医院设计规范的 373 个病房布局，自 3D 场景计算答案，共 3,368 题、8 种题型，采用第一人称漫游视频（照片级真实），设置配对场景状态，并经十名医生审核布局；另有 44,750 题训练集 Clinical3D-45K 用于微调。提出 GeoJeV：从视频重建场景记忆，依据 MLLM 的问题状态选择 3D 操作及参数，并将其证据加入选项分数。
AI.result: 35 个 MLLM 中，最佳开源与闭源模型宏平均准确率分别为 45.7% 与 53.6%，答案先验为 40.8%，医生子集为 79.0%；32 个开源模型中 27 个在两向患者相对方位题上低于 40%。Clinical3D-45K 微调可使两个 MLLM 超出最佳闭源模型 16–20 分；但微调模型几乎不使用作为输入的 3D 地图——替换为其他视频的地图（即便为真值）准确率几乎不变。GeoJeV 在所有评估模型中准确率最高，缩小了与医生的差距。
AI.conclusion: 现有 MLLM 在临床空间推理上显著落后于人类且常依赖答案先验；单纯微调与直接输入 3D 地图均不足以建立真正的 3D 推理，显式让模型"用 3D 计算"的 GeoJeV 是更有效的路径。

title: Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe
summary: AI agents working on long tasks often commit to an answer before they have enough evidence, a behavior called laziness. In our evaluations, they frequently commit even while their stated belief still names several possible answers. An outcome reward at the end of the episode scores only the final answer, so it cannot teach the agent when to commit, because a lucky guess receives the same reward as an answer backed by evidence. During training, however, the simulator can compute the exact posterior over the answer at every step and tell whether the evidence is already enough. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB), which rewards the agent for taking further steps while this posterior still allows several answers and for committing once the evidence is sufficient. The reward needs no judge, critic or reward model, and it never reads the belief line the agent writes before each action. We also introduce Pro Worlds, a benchmark of visual puzzles where the agent views a large world through a small window. We evaluate three vision-language models on three benchmarks, two of which are never seen in training. RLVB improves the base model in all nine settings, by 17.1% on average. Under the outcome reward, GRPO and PPO fall below the base model on average. RLVB also outperforms PPO with a process reward from an LLM judge by 9.3% on average while using 1.6 times fewer GPU-hours. The trained agent answers with sufficient evidence in 51%, 12% and 74% of the episodes on the three benchmarks, against 8%, 0.4% and 36% for the base model. Its accuracy gain therefore comes from answering more often at high levels of evidence. The belief line shows how the agent reaches this evidence: it acts on its own belief. It commits at only 0.1 to 2.2% of the turns at which the evidence is insufficient and its line still names several answers, against 3 to 68% for the base model.

AI.tldr: 提出RLVB方法，利用可计算的精确后验奖励智能体在证据不足时继续探索、证据充分时提交，在9个设置上平均提升17.1%。
AI.motivation: AI智能体在长任务中常过早提交答案（"懒惰"），甚至在自述信念仍列出多个候选答案时就下结论。轨迹末端的结果奖励只评估最终答案，无法区分"蒙对"与"有据可依"，因此无法教会智能体何时应当提交。
AI.method: 训练时仿真器可在每一步计算答案的精确后验。提出Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB)：当后验仍允许多个答案时奖励智能体继续采取步骤，证据充分时奖励其提交。该奖励无需评判器、评论家或奖励模型，也不读取智能体输出的信念行。同时构建Pro Worlds视觉谜题基准，智能体通过小窗口观察大世界。
AI.result: 3个视觉语言模型×3个基准（其中2个训练中未见）共9个设置，RLVB全部优于基座模型，平均提升17.1%；而结果奖励下的GRPO与PPO平均低于基座模型。RLVB平均比使用LLM评判过程奖励的PPO高9.3%，且GPU小时少1.6倍。在三个基准上，训练后智能体在51%、12%、74%的回合中以充分证据作答，基座模型仅为8%、0.4%、36%。在证据不足且信念行仍列多个答案的回合中，提交率仅0.1%~2.2%，基座为3%~68%。
AI.conclusion: 性能提升来源于在高证据水平下更频繁地作答；信念行显示智能体依据自身信念行动，能有效学会"何时提交"这一元决策。

title: See the Answer, Learn to Embed: Learning Universal Multimodal Embeddings from Hindsight
summary: Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) models map heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space, where pairwise similarity supports diverse downstream tasks. Recent reasoning-driven UME approaches use intermediate reasoning to generate additional context for embedding, but often incur extra computation at inference. In this paper, we explore the matched candidate (i.e., the paired target) as an alternative source of context, asking whether a model can "see the answer" during training and "learn to embed" without it at inference. However, direct conditioning on this privileged context can introduce candidate-specific information unavailable from the query alone or cause the candidate-conditioned query representation to collapse toward the candidate embedding. To address this, we introduce Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings (HEME), which learns query-grounded hindsight representations from such candidate context. HEME first trains a hindsight teacher with a hindsight attention mask, mismatched-candidate conditioning, and query-token alignment to limit excessive reliance on the candidate. It then freezes the teacher and distills its hindsight representation and similarity distribution into a standalone student embedder. At inference, the student independently encodes queries and candidates without candidate conditioning or the hindsight teacher. Experiments on MMEB-V2 and the agent and text tasks of MMEB-V3 demonstrate the effectiveness of HEME and show that it enables more efficient inference than explicit reasoning-driven methods.

AI.tldr: 提出HEME：训练时利用"匹配候选（答案）"作为特权上下文学习查询锚定的后见表征，并将其蒸馏到独立学生嵌入器，推理时无需候选条件或推理过程。
AI.motivation: 现有推理驱动的通用多模态嵌入（UME）方法需在推理时生成中间推理以获得额外上下文，计算开销大。作者探索能否把匹配候选作为上下文的替代来源：训练时"看到答案"，推理时"学会嵌入"而不依赖它。
AI.method: 直接以候选为条件会引入查询中不存在、且候选特有的信息，或导致候选条件化的查询表征坍缩至候选嵌入。HEME先训练后见蒸馏教师：采用后见注意力掩码、错配候选条件、查询token对齐来抑制对候选的过度依赖；随后冻结教师，将其后见表征与相似度分布蒸馏至独立学生嵌入器。
AI.result: 在MMEB-V2及MMEB-V3的agent与文本任务上验证了HEME的有效性，且相比显式推理驱动方法实现更高效的推理。
AI.conclusion: 匹配候选可作为免推理的上下文来源；通过后见教师+蒸馏的范式，可在不牺牲推理效率的前提下将训练期的特权信息转化为学生嵌入器的嵌入能力。

title: PyRUA-Dex: Learning Programmatic Policies for Dexterous Bimanual Manipulation with Coding Agents
comment: 23 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://vme0522.github.io/PyRUA-Dex/
summary: Learning for dexterous manipulation is limited by the scarcity of high-quality demonstrations: retargeting from human video is imprecise, teleoperation gives no force feedback to the operator, and exoskeleton-based collection is hard to scale up. We present PyRUA-Dex, a framework that enables coding agents to develop dexterous manipulation through programmatic policy, without the need of demonstrations. The programmatic policy is developed in two stages: during exploration, multiple agents explore in parallel for task skills and ways to compose them, and a distilling agent condenses the successful attempts into a task library and one program. During refinement, this program is improved through randomized layouts for enhanced robustness and execution efficiency. In simulated environments, PyRUA-Dex achieves SOTA on Bench2Dex with a score of 72.9 and reaches 81.0% success on DexJoCo under full randomization, ahead of every trained policy on both benchmarks. In real world experiments on a bimanual platform with two 22-DoF hands, PyRUA-Dex learns to play piano, write calligraphy, and other tasks efficiently: learning a new piece from sheet music takes as little as 30 minutes. These results suggest that PyRUA-Dex is an effective framework for developing dexterous manipulation policies with coding agents in the absence of high quality dexterous manipulation demonstrations.

AI.tldr: PyRUA-Dex 让编码智能体以程序化策略的方式学习灵巧操作，无需高质量演示，在仿真基准上达 SOTA，并在真实双臂22自由度平台上快速学会弹琴、书法等任务。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作学习受限于高质量演示的稀缺：从人类视频重定向不精确、遥操作缺乏力反馈、外骨骼采集难以扩展。因此需要一个不依赖演示的策略开发框架。
AI.method: 提出 PyRUA-Dex 框架，由编码智能体生成程序化策略，分两阶段：探索阶段多个智能体并行探索任务技能及其组合方式，由蒸馏智能体将成功尝试浓缩为任务库与单一程序；精炼阶段通过随机化布局提升鲁棒性与执行效率。
AI.result: 仿真中在 Bench2Dex 取得 72.9 的 SOTA 分数，在完全随机化的 DexJoCo 上成功率达 81.0%，均优于所有已训练策略；真实双臂双22自由度手平台上高效学会弹钢琴、书法等任务，从乐谱学习新曲目最快仅需30分钟。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在缺乏高质量灵巧操作演示的情况下，PyRUA-Dex 是借助编码智能体开发灵巧操作策略的有效框架。

title: Rethinking Post-Training Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large vision-language models (LVLMs) by calibrating quantization parameters on a small dataset without retraining. However, despite increasingly sophisticated calibration strategies, prior methods suffer substantial performance degradation under low-bit weight--activation quantization. To understand this degradation, we locate where quantization error is concentrated and examine the corresponding weight and activation distributions. We observe that a few outliers dominate the ranges shared by per-channel (PC) weights and per-token (PT) activations, leaving insufficient resolution for most values and mapping many of them to zero. These findings motivate a shift in focus from calibration refinement to the underlying quantization representation. We therefore present Rotate-and-Refine Quantization (RRQ) as a simple, effective baseline for LVLM PTQ, combining local Hadamard transforms with group quantization and efficient group-aware execution. Across 8 multimodal tasks and diverse quantization settings, RRQ substantially outperforms baselines while reducing inference time and memory usage. At W4A4, it retains over 96\% of full-precision performance on 8B models and over 99\% on a 32B model, compared with less than 8\% for these baselines. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/RRQ
