AI.tldr: 提出RRQ（Rotate-and-Refine Quantization），通过局部Hadamard变换+分组量化+分组感知高效执行，解决LVLM低比特W-A量化中离群值主导共享量化范围的问题，在W4A4下保留96%以上全精度性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM后训练量化（PTQ）方法虽不断改进校准策略，但在低比特权重-激活量化下仍严重掉点。作者定位量化误差集中位置并分析权重/激活分布，发现少数离群值主导了per-channel权重与per-token激活共享的量化范围，导致其余数值分辨率不足、大量被映射为零。因此指出应从"校准精修"转向"量化表示"本身。
AI.method: RRQ将局部Hadamard变换与分组量化（group quantization）结合，并配套高效的分组感知执行（group-aware execution），作为LVLM PTQ的简单有效基线。
AI.result: 在8个多模态任务及多种量化配置下显著优于基线，同时降低推理时间与显存占用。W4A4下8B模型保留>96%全精度性能、32B模型>99%，而基线不足8%。
AI.conclusion: 量化的瓶颈在于表示层面而非校准层面；离群值主导共享量化范围是低比特PTQ掉点的关键，旋转（Hadamard变换）与分组的表示改进可低成本大幅提升LVLM低比特量化效果。代码已开源。

title: InstructReplay: Replaying Assistant Turns to Preserve General Behavior During Factual Fine-Tuning
comment: Project page at https://xiaofengshi.github.io/InstructReplay/ and code at https://github.com/xiaofengShi/InstructReplay
summary: Fine-tuning an instruction-tuned language model on new facts often erodes its general abilities. We find that standard fine-tuning lowers instruction-following, reasoning and coding benchmarks by 35 points on average, and that these losses track a collapse in answer length: fine-tuned models at least halve their responses, and the further a response drifts from the initial model's length, the more often it fails. We propose InstructReplay: the initial model answers a set of general instructions once, and during fine-tuning the model is kept close to the initial model on these answers. Across three model families and two domains, InstructReplay reduces the average decline on five general benchmarks from 28.1 to 2.4 points and keeps answer length close to the initial model's, while learning the new facts as well as standard fine-tuning. It balances learning and retention better than seven adaptation methods in all six settings. Controlled comparisons attribute the gain to replaying the model's own answers to general instructions rather than to the form of the loss.

AI.tldr: 标准指令微调新事实会引发通用能力大幅下降（平均35分），且该损失与回答长度塌缩强相关；提出InstructReplay，用初始模型对通用指令的自我回答作为回放锚点约束微调，将五个通用基准的平均下降从28.1分降至2.4分，同时保持新事实学习效果。
AI.motivation: 在新事实上进行指令微调（instruction tuning）会导致模型通用能力（指令遵循、推理、编码）严重遗忘。作者观察到这一灾难性遗忘伴随回答长度显著塌缩（至少减半），且长度偏离初始模型越远失败越频繁，说明长度漂移是遗忘的可观测信号，亟需一种既能学新事实又能保持通用能力的方法。
AI.method: InstructReplay：先用初始模型对一组通用指令（general instructions）各生成一次回答，作为回放参照；在后续新事实微调过程中，通过正则/蒸馏式约束使当前模型在这些通用指令上的输出分布（回答）保持接近初始模型的自我回答，从而抑制长度塌缩与能力漂移。作者还通过受控实验区分了"回放自身回答"与"损失函数形式"的贡献。
AI.result: 在三个模型族、两个领域、共六个设置下：五个通用基准的平均下降由标准微调的28.1分降至2.4分；回答长度保持接近初始模型；新事实学习效果与标准微调相当。与七种适应方法相比，在全部六个设置中学习-保持权衡均最优。受控比较表明增益来源是回放模型自身的通用指令回答，而非损失形式。
AI.conclusion: 回答长度塌缩是微调遗忘的关键表征，以初始模型的通用指令自答作为回放锚点可在几乎不牺牲新知识获取的前提下近乎消除通用能力退化，是一种简单有效的持续学习/知识编辑式微调正则手段，且优势可归因于回放内容本身。

title: The Teacher Is Already Inside: Self-Distilling Looped Language Models Beyond Their Last Loop
summary: Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop is readable through the shared language-model head. Post-training them is hard. Reward-only reinforcement learning needs a verifier and learns from one sparse signal per response; spreading the reward over loops collapses the entropy of every loop; and cross-loop self-distillation, as in LoopOPD, can only teach intermediate loops, because the last loop cannot learn from its own frozen copy: the loss is zero at initialisation. We observe that a looped model already contains a policy that decodes better than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELPSD (Extrapolated-Loop Policy Self-Distillation) turns this distribution into a self-distillation target: a frozen copy of the model computes it, and the model's own last loop is distilled towards it on its own rollouts, using the exact reverse KL at every visited prefix. Teacher and student are the same model, so ELPSD needs no reward, no external teacher and no privileged context, and it leaves rollouts and decoding unchanged. We show that the objective pulls the last loop towards the base model's last loop with weight 1+w and away from the base model's first loop with weight w, and that the teacher must stay frozen, since an idealised teacher recomputed from the current model extrapolates without bound. We evaluate ELPSD on Ouro-1.4B-Thinking across five math benchmarks against the base model, GRPO, RLTT and OPSD. Without any reward, ELPSD raises the average avg@8 from 61.15 to 63.69 and is the best method on all five benchmarks, ahead of GRPO (62.32), which uses a verifier, and the self-distillation method OPSD (61.77), which needs reference solutions.

AI.tldr: ELPSD 利用循环模型自身"跨循环外推"的次词分布作为自蒸馏目标，在无需奖励、外部教师或特权上下文的情况下提升循环语言模型的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型每个 token 多次复用同一 transformer 栈，后训练困难：仅奖励的 RL 需验证器且信号稀疏；将奖励分摊到各循环会使每个循环熵崩塌；LoopOPD 式跨循环自蒸馏只能教中间循环，最后一循环无法从自身冻结副本学习（初始化时损失为零）。作者观察到模型本身已蕴含一个优于最后一循环的策略：由第一循环到最后一循环外推出的下一词分布。
AI.method: 将"外推循环策略"作为自蒸馏目标：冻结副本计算该外推分布，模型自身最后一循环在自身 rollout 的每个访问前缀上以精确反向 KL 向其对齐。教师与学生为同一模型，无需奖励、外部教师或特权上下文，且不改变 rollout 与解码过程。理论分析表明目标以权重 1+w 将最后一循环拉向基模型的最后一循环、以权重 w 推离基模型的第一循环；教师必须保持冻结，因为由当前模型重算的理想化教师会无界外推。
AI.result: 在 Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 上于五个数学基准对比 base、GRPO、RLTT、OPSD：无任何奖励下，ELPSD 将平均 avg@8 从 61.15 提升至 63.69，在全部五个基准上均为最优，超过使用验证器的 GRPO（62.32）与需参考解的 OPSD（61.77）。
AI.conclusion: 循环模型内部蕴含的跨循环外推策略可作为有效的自蒸馏监督信号；冻结教师的自蒸馏在无奖励设置下优于带验证器的 RL，为循环语言模型后训练提供了简单且不改变解码的方案。

title: OmniAct: One Policy, One Million Embodiments
summary: A single policy that controls diverse robots must not only transfer task knowledge across embodiments, but also adapt its behavior to each robot's capabilities. Existing approaches facilitate transfer through shared action representations, but these representations do not necessarily capture how differences in robot morphology should shape manipulation strategies. We introduce OmniAct, a cross-embodiment manipulation policy that conditions directly on each robot's kinematics in a specific scene to produce embodiment-specific behavior. This kinematic graph represents the robot's joint positions, motion axes, and connectivity to its visual observation, allowing the policy to account for how its embodiment related to objects and surfaces in the scene. A flow-matching policy predicts relative joint motions for each node, enabling control across robots with different degrees of freedom and kinematic configurations. To learn how physical structure shapes behavior at scale, we procedurally design and filter one million physically feasible robot embodiments; next, we develop algorithms to generate robot trajectories in simulation for all embodiments; finally, we train across diverse simulated manipulation tasks. On 2,000 embodiment-scene-held-out evaluation episodes, OmniAct achieves 63.0% success, compared to 17.8% for pi 0.5 and 57.9% for the strongest baseline; on the task families GPT-6 Astra was evaluated on, it achieves 64.7% against GPT-6 Astra's 41.1%. On a previously unseen real-world robot, it achieves nearly twice the success rate of the next best method, MolmoAct2. Beyond task success, we observe that OmniAct learns distinct manipulation strategies that exploit the capabilities and accommodate the limitations of different morphologies. Project: https://omniact.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniAct，一种以机器人运动学图（kinematic graph）为条件、用流匹配预测各关节相对运动的跨具身操作策略，并借助百万级程序化生成的可行机器人具身进行大规模训练。
AI.motivation: 单一策略控制多种机器人时，既要迁移任务知识，又要让行为适配各机器人自身能力。现有方法依赖共享动作表示，但这类表示未必能刻画"形态差异应如何塑造操作策略"，因此难以产生真正具身特异的操作行为。
AI.method: 1) OmniAct 直接以特定场景中该机器人的运动学为条件：构建运动学图，编码关节位置、运动轴与连接关系，并与视觉观测关联，使策略能推理自身具身与场景中物体、表面的关系；2) 采用 flow-matching 策略为图中每个节点预测相对关节运动，从而支持不同自由度与不同运动学构型的机器人；3) 数据侧程序化设计并筛选 100 万个物理可行的机器人具身，开发算法在仿真中为全部具身生成轨迹，并在多样化仿真操作任务上联合训练。
AI.result: 在 2,000 个具身-场景留出评测回合上，OmniAct 成功率为 63.0%，pi 0.5 为 17.8%，最强基线为 57.9%；在 GPT-6 Astra 评测过的任务族上达到 64.7%，对比其 41.1%；在未见过的真实机器人上成功率约为次优方法 MolmoAct2 的两倍。此外观察到 OmniAct 学到了利用不同形态能力、规避其局限的差异化操作策略。
AI.conclusion: 以运动学图为条件、节点级相对关节运动预测的跨具身策略，能在大规模具身数据上有效学习"物理结构如何塑造行为"，在留出具身泛化、任务族对标与真实机器人迁移上均显著优于现有方法，并涌现出形态特异的操作策略。

title: GUI-PRISM: Efficient Action Decoding for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate screenshots and user instructions into executable actions. Most existing approaches rely on vision-language models to generate actions as text, often leading to substantial inference latency due to autoregressive decoding. To address this inefficiency, we propose GUI-PRISM, a hybrid action decoder that directly predicts action types and structured arguments while retaining language generation for open-ended text. Unlike existing spatial decoding methods that primarily focus on target localization, GUI-PRISM extends direct prediction to action types and their associated arguments, enabling complete GUI action prediction. Specifically, GUI-PRISM employs field-specific queries to extract action-relevant semantic and spatial information from a shared multimodal feature bank. It further models dependencies among action components through conditional queries. Gated residual cross-attention refines these predictions using fine-grained multimodal information. GUI-PRISM achieves 95.1\% accuracy on ScreenSpot-v2, outperforming the strongest head-based spatial decoding method by 2.0 percentage points while delivering a 3.8$\times$ inference speedup over the baseline. On AndroidControl-v2 and MM-Mind2Web-v2, it improves complete-action accuracy by 4.8 and 0.7 percentage points while achieving 2.7$\times$ and 3.9$\times$ inference speedups over the baseline, respectively. Our code is available on our project page.

AI.tldr: GUI-PRISM 提出一种混合动作解码器，直接预测动作类型与结构化参数，同时保留开放式文本的语言生成，在保持或提升精度的同时实现约 3–4 倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI 智能体多依赖视觉语言模型以文本形式自回归生成动作，推理延迟高；而已有的空间解码方法主要只做目标定位，无法直接给出动作类型与参数。
AI.method: 采用字段专用查询（field-specific queries）从共享多模态特征库中抽取与动作相关的语义与空间信息；通过条件查询建模动作各组件间的依赖；并用门控残差交叉注意力（gated residual cross-attention）结合细粒度多模态信息精化预测；开放式文本仍走语言生成。
AI.result: ScreenSpot-v2 上准确率 95.1%，比最强的 head-based 空间解码方法高 2.0 个百分点，推理较基线提速 3.8 倍；AndroidControl-v2 完整动作准确率提升 4.8 个百分点（2.7 倍加速）；MM-Mind2Web-v2 提升 0.7 个百分点（3.9 倍加速）。
AI.conclusion: 将直接预测从空间定位扩展到动作类型及参数，可显著降低 GUI 智能体推理延迟，同时取得优于文本生成式与纯空间解码方法的性能。

title: Reading Decisions Before Spans: Efficient Generative Verification
summary: A developer checking an assistant's report may need only an alarm that a claim is unsupported. A generative verifier, however, can continue decoding to quote and classify the errors. We study how much of that output is needed to recover its decision. In a frozen 2B span verifier, the choice between an empty error list and its first object precedes all localization. Native8 stops generation at this branch. The preceding seven syntax tokens are fixed, so Prefill1 supplies them as input and generates only the unrestricted branch token, using the same native instruction. On 2,015 code-agent TEST responses, Prefill1 reduces eager resident service by 84.84% relative to full generation, with released-reference F1 of 83.43 versus 83.41. It saves 31.98% over Native8 even though their logical token totals are identical. Under default compiled execution, the extra saving is 6.74-26.73% on the complete workload, with small decision changes. Controlled evidence interventions and first-location decoding establish what these shorter readouts retain and what requires further generation.

AI.tldr: 该文研究生成式验证器（2B span verifier）的输出中哪一部分才足以恢复其"claim是否受支持"的判定，并提出 Prefill1：把可预先确定的前七个语法token作为输入预填，仅生成分支token，从而在几乎不损失F1的情况下大幅降低服务成本。
AI.motivation: 开发者往往只需要"某claim无支撑"的告警，而生成式验证器却继续解码以引用和归类错误。作者希望量化：恢复其最终决策到底需要多少输出token，从而在保持判定质量的前提下削减推理开销。
AI.method: 在一个冻结的2B span verifier上定位关键决策点：空错误列表与首个错误对象之间的选择先于所有定位步骤。Native8在分支处停止生成；由于分支前七个语法token固定，Prefill1将这七个token作为输入预填，只生成不受约束的分支token，并沿用同一原生指令。在2,015条code-agent TEST响应上评测延迟与F1，并结合受控证据干预与首位置解码进行机制分析。
AI.result: Prefill1相较完整生成将eager resident服务时间减少84.84%，released-reference F1为83.43（完整生成为83.41）；在逻辑token总数相同的情况下仍比Native8节省31.98%；默认编译执行下，完整工作负载额外节省6.74–26.73%，决策变化很小。
AI.conclusion: 生成式验证器的判定可由极少token恢复，原生长度截断并非最优；预填固定语法前缀可解耦逻辑token数与实际计算成本。更短的读出保留了决策信息，但引用与定位等更丰富输出仍需进一步生成。

title: When Knowledge-Tracing Rankings Depend on Available History: A Source-Correction and Matched-Information Audit on ASSISTments 2009 and 2015
summary: Knowledge-tracing benchmarks often compare models that have different access to a learner's previous responses. We examine how data provenance, history length, and representation affect those comparisons. First, we compare a pinned ASSISTments 2009 sequence mirror against the corrected official release. Of 4,148 learners represented in both, 817 have different ordered skill-response sequences; the mirror also contains fewer labeled events. Second, we retain earlier learner-disjoint model evaluations on the 2009 and 2015 datasets, distinguishing exploratory results from a corrective 2015 replication. Finally, we evaluate a new, nonoverlapping sample of 4,000 ASSISTments 2015 learners using three models constrained to the same one-event or 20-event prior-response window. On 20,592 test responses from 582 learners, the 20-event Brier scores were 0.17667 for count-based logistic regression, 0.17389 for an order-aware logistic model, and 0.17514 for a GRU. The GRU-minus-order-aware difference was 0.00125 (95% learner-cluster bootstrap interval [0.00008, 0.00243]); at one prior event, the corresponding difference was 0.00212 [0.00120, 0.00301]. Earlier comparisons had favored the GRU against simpler history summaries. The newer analysis instead favors a logistic comparator that represents order using the same permitted event stream. These results concern predictive performance on particular historical cohorts and model settings. They neither isolate an architectural effect nor establish generalization to contemporary classrooms.

AI.tldr: 该文考察数据来源、历史长度与表示方式如何影响知识追踪基准比较：比对ASSISTments 2009镜像与官方修订版的数据差异，并在同等先验作答窗口约束下重新比较三种模型，发现顺序感知逻辑回归优于GRU。
AI.motivation: 知识追踪基准中常比较"可访问学习者历史作答信息不同"的模型，导致比较不公平；且同一数据集的不同版本（镜像与官方修订版）可能存在序列差异。作者希望厘清数据来源（provenance）、历史长度与表示方式对模型比较结果的影响。
AI.method: (1) 将固定的ASSISTments 2009序列镜像与官方修订版对比，统计序列差异；(2) 保留2009/2015数据集上此前的学习者不重叠评估，区分探索性结果与2015年纠正性复现；(3) 在4000名不重叠的ASSISTments 2015学习者上，用三种模型——计数式逻辑回归、顺序感知逻辑回归、GRU——约束在相同1事件或20事件先验作答窗口内评估，并以学习者聚类bootstrap给出区间。
AI.result: 4,148名共同学习者中有817名在镜像与官方版的技能-作答有序序列不同，镜像的标注事件更少。在20,592条测试作答（582名学习者）上，20事件窗口Brier分数：计数式逻辑回归0.17667、顺序感知逻辑模型0.17389、GRU 0.17514；GRU减顺序感知模型差为0.00125（95%学习者聚类bootstrap区间[0.00008, 0.00243]），1事件窗口对应差为0.00212[0.00120, 0.00301]。此前比较多偏向GRU，新分析则偏向顺序感知逻辑回归。
AI.conclusion: 数据来源、历史窗口长度与表示方式会实质影响知识追踪基准结论；在同等信息访问条件下，简单顺序感知逻辑模型可优于GRU。结果仅针对特定历史队列与模型设置的预测性能，既不分离架构效应，也不能推广到当代课堂。

title: PreferenceScene: Personalized Indoor Scene Synthesis from Feedback
summary: Text-to-scene methods turn a short instruction into a furnished 3D room, but the room that a particular person wants rarely comes across fully in words: many preferences surface only when the person sees a concrete room and can point to what they like and dislike in it. We therefore study personalized indoor scene synthesis under hidden user preferences: over several turns, a system shows a 3D scene, and the user, who sees only rendered images of the scene, replies with brief free-form feedback and a satisfaction score. The system must therefore bring the whole room toward the user's preferences from feedback that comments on only part of it at a time. It must also be able to change every part of the room, because a preference concerns not only single objects but the look and atmosphere that surfaces, lighting, textiles, furniture and their arrangement create together. We present PreferenceScene, in which a large language model keeps an explicit estimate of the user's preferences for every design attribute of the room and, after each turn, infers the taste behind the feedback and revises the whole estimate, including the parts that the feedback does not mention. A scene instantiation module builds every estimated value as its own part of the room, so that each of these parts can follow the user's preferences. We evaluate on the test set of a benchmark with 320 instances in ten room types, with a simulated user and a render-based evaluator. PreferenceScene matches the hidden preferences better than five published text-to-scene baselines adapted to the same interaction, and its match rises with every turn. It even surpasses them when they are given the preferences directly, and a vision-language model rates its scenes as the most realistic and functional.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PreferenceScene：在多轮交互中，用户只看渲染图并给出简短自由反馈与满意度评分，系统需从只涉及局部的反馈推断整体偏好，并将整间房（表面、灯光、织物、家具及布局）调向该偏好。方法用大语言模型维护每个设计属性的显式偏好估计，每轮从反馈推断"品味"并全局修订未提及部分；场景实例化模块把每项估计值构建为房间的独立部件。在 320 实例、10 类房间的基准上，与 5 个适配同一交互的已发表 text-to-scene 基线相比匹配度更高且逐轮上升，甚至在基线直接获得偏好时仍更优，视觉语言模型也认为其场景最真实、最可用。
AI.motivation: 短期指令生成的 3D 房间难以体现个体偏好：许多偏好只在用户看到具体房间、指出喜恶时才显现，文字难以完整表达。因此需要研究"隐藏用户偏好"下的个性化室内场景合成，且系统必须能改变房间的每个部分，因为偏好不仅涉及单个物体，还涉及表面、灯光、织物、家具与其排布共同营造的外观和氛围。
AI.method: 采用多轮交互设定：系统展示 3D 场景，用户仅见渲染图，以简短自由文本反馈和满意度评分回应。核心为基于 LLM 的偏好维护机制——为房间的每个设计属性保留显式偏好估计，每轮后推断反馈背后的品味并修订全部估计（含反馈未提及的部分）；再由场景实例化模块将每个估计值实例化为房间中对应独立部件，使各部分都能跟随偏好变化。
AI.result: 在含 320 个实例、10 种房间类型的基准测试集上，使用模拟用户与基于渲染的评估器：PreferenceScene 对隐藏偏好的匹配度优于 5 个已发表并适配同一交互的 text-to-scene 基线，且随轮次递增；即使基线被直接给予偏好信息，本方法仍占优；视觉语言模型评价其场景在真实感与功能合理性上最佳。
AI.conclusion: 显式、逐属性的偏好估计加全局修订，配合细粒度场景实例化，能够从局部、简短的多轮反馈中有效逼近隐藏偏好，优于单向文本到场景生成范式；该框架支持对房间整体的可控调整，并得到渲染评估与 VLM 评判的一致支持。

title: ShellBench: What Matters More for AI Agents, Models, or Harness for Everyday Tasks
summary: The use of AI agents among the general public has been increasing exponentially throughout 2026, though it is often hard for users to determine which configuration is most effective for their personal use. To help provide clarity here we introduce ShellBench, 100 day-to-day tasks based on more than 10 million user requests, each set in a realistic workspace with messy files and competing data sources, and graded for both correctness and safety. We evaluate 12 models across 5 agent harnesses at 3 reasoning levels for a total of 53,100 rollouts, 20% of which are on tasks designated for public release. We find that model choice impacts performance more than harness choice, but the three leading models differ by only 1.1 percentage points. GPT-6.1 Sol passed 61.4% of attempts at about one-sixth of GPT-6 Astra's estimated token cost per attempt, while GPT-6 Astra led at 62.5%. We also found that harness choice had little effect on either performance or safety with all harnesses scoring between 42.9 (Claude Code) and 45.2 (OpenClaw) for pass@1.

AI.tldr: 提出 ShellBench——基于超千万条真实用户请求构建的 100 项日常任务评测集，涵盖 12 个模型 × 5 种 agent harness × 3 档推理强度共 53,100 次 rollout，结论是模型选择的影响大于 harness，但头部模型差距仅 1.1 个百分点，且 harness 对性能与安全影响甚微。
AI.motivation: 2026 年公众对 AI agent 的使用量激增，但用户难以判断哪种配置（模型、harness、推理强度）最适合自身需求，缺乏贴近真实使用场景的横向评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 ShellBench：100 个日常任务，源自超 1000 万条用户请求，任务置于含杂乱文件与相互冲突数据源的真实工作区，并按正确性与安全性双维度打分。实验覆盖 12 个模型、5 种 agent harness、3 档推理强度，共 53,100 次 rollout，其中 20% 基于公开释放任务。
AI.result: 模型选择对性能的影响大于 harness 选择，但三个领先模型间差距仅 1.1 个百分点：GPT-6 Astra 以 62.5% 领先，GPT-6.1 Sol 达 61.4%，且每次尝试的 token 成本约为 GPT-6 Astra 的 1/6。harness 对性能与安全几乎没有影响，各 harness 的 pass@1 介于 42.9（Claude Code）至 45.2（OpenClaw）之间。
AI.conclusion: 对日常 agent 使用而言，模型选择比 harness 更重要，但顶尖模型性能已趋于饱和，成本效率成为关键区分因素；harness 带来的差异有限。ShellBench 为用户配置选择提供了基于真实请求的实证参考。

title: Assessing Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cyber-Physical Systems
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 1 table, Accepted to SGAI 2026. This preprint has not undergone peer review or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record is published in 'Artificial Intelligence XLIII' and is available online at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-45236-8_34
summary: As the use of reinforcement learning (RL) becomes more widespread in cyber-physical systems, it becomes increasingly important to design RL agents that are able to adapt to changes in their environments in order to maintain safety and reliability. This paper addresses the question of whether different classes of RL algorithm are more robust against forgetting previously learned behaviours, a critical issue in continual learning, in non-stationary environments. We evaluate the robustness of representative examples of three important classes of RL algorithm in a non-stationary autonomous parking environment. These are Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which is a model-free on-policy algorithm, Soft-Actor-Critic (SAC), which is a model-free off-policy algorithm, and Drama, which is a model-based algorithm. The agents must learn to successfully park in four different scenarios, which are presented successively, with parking spaces oriented at varying angles. We find off-policy algorithms appear to be more robust compared to on-policy algorithms due to their use of replay, while model-based algorithms do not appear to offer any direct advantage over model-free algorithms. These experiments also highlight the additional challenges of finding robust abstractions of the environment, and oversensitivity to hyperparameters.

AI.tldr: 该文在非稳态自动泊车环境中比较PPO（无模型on-policy）、SAC（无模型off-policy）与Drama（基于模型）三类强化学习算法的抗遗忘鲁棒性，发现off-policy算法因使用经验回放而更稳健，基于模型算法相对无模型算法无明显直接优势。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在信息物理系统中日益普及，智能体需在环境变化下保持安全可靠；持续学习中的"遗忘已学行为"是关键问题，因此需明确不同类别RL算法在非稳态环境下的抗遗忘鲁棒性差异。
AI.method: 选取三类代表性算法——PPO（无模型、on-policy）、SAC（无模型、off-policy）、Drama（基于模型），在非稳态自动泊车环境中进行对比实验：四个场景依次呈现，车位朝向角度各不相同，智能体需逐一学会成功泊车，从而评估对先前所学行为的保持能力。
AI.result: off-policy算法（SAC）相较on-policy算法（PPO）表现出更强的鲁棒性，归因于其使用经验回放；基于模型的算法（Drama）相对无模型算法未显示出直接优势。实验还暴露了寻找环境鲁棒抽象表示的额外困难，以及算法对超参数的过度敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 在非稳态持续学习场景中，经验回放机制是提升抗遗忘鲁棒性的关键因素，基于模型方法并非天然更优；未来需重视环境抽象的鲁棒性与超参数敏感性对算法比较结论的影响。

title: RISE: Reasoning with Implicit State Embeddings for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate user instructions and screenshots into executable actions. To learn executable actions, existing approaches often rely on explicit reasoning during training, which encourage over-reliance on specific reasoning patterns rather than generalizable action-relevant information. In this paper, we propose an implicit framework, RISE, which integrates action-relevant reasoning into implicit state representations to guide GUI action prediction. To this end, action-relevant reasoning is captured through three complementary supervision objectives: full-CoT state alignment preserves information across the reasoning process, action-distribution alignment encodes action preferences, and reasoning-to-action boundary alignment captures the representation immediately before action generation. In this case, our RISE effectively learns informative implicit representations, thereby improving the accuracy of next-action token prediction. RISE achieves 70.6\% accuracy on OSWorld-G, establishing state-of-the-art performance among compared 8B models with a 4.3-point gain over its backbone. Results across two distinct backbones and six diverse benchmarks further demonstrate its effectiveness in GUI grounding and action prediction. Our code is available on our project page.

AI.tldr: 提出隐式框架 RISE，将动作相关推理融入隐式状态表示以指导 GUI 动作预测，在 OSWorld-G 上达 70.6% 准确率（8B 模型最优，较骨干提升 4.3 分）。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI 智能体依赖训练中的显式推理（explicit reasoning）学习可执行动作，易过拟合特定推理模式，难以获得可泛化的、与动作相关的信息。
AI.method: RISE 为隐式框架，用三个互补监督目标将动作相关推理编码进隐式状态表示：(1) 全 CoT 状态对齐，保留完整推理过程信息；(2) 动作分布对齐，编码动作偏好；(3) 推理-动作边界对齐，捕捉动作生成前一刻的表示。由此提升下一动作 token 预测准确率。
AI.result: OSWorld-G 上达 70.6% 准确率，在对比的 8B 模型中为 SOTA，较骨干模型提升 4.3 个百分点；在两种不同骨干与六个基准上验证了 GUI grounding 与动作预测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 隐式状态表示可替代显式 CoT 推理来承载动作相关推理，且泛化性更好；多目标对齐设计具可迁移性。

title: Beyond Expected Value: PPO with Distributional Critics for Systematic Conservation Planning
summary: Systematic conservation planning must allocate limited protection budgets sequentially under ecological and climatic uncertainty. Static tools cannot adapt as conditions change, and policies optimised only for expected outcomes can fail on the worst-case trajectories climate change makes increasingly likely. CAPTAIN was the first framework to cast this as sequential reinforcement learning, but its gradient-free Evolution Strategies (ES) optimiser lacks per-timestep credit assignment. We replace ES with Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) via a Plackett-Luce solution to CAPTAIN's non-differentiable action space, and replace its scalar critic with an Implicit Quantile Network (IQN) modelling the full return distribution. A matched-granularity comparison shows decision granularity, not the optimiser, drives most of the ecological gain, so the real contribution is training efficiency and extensibility to risk-sensitive objectives. On a New Zealand marine dataset, it matches or exceeds ES's outcomes at a fraction of the training cost, offering a template for future work ES's black-box design could not support

AI.tldr: 用 PPO（经 Plackett-Luce 处理非可微动作空间）替换 CAPTAIN 的进化策略，并用隐式分位数网络（IQN）替换标量评价器以建模完整回报分布，在更低训练成本下取得与 ES 相当或更优的规划结果。
AI.motivation: 系统性保护规划需在生态与气候不确定性下序贯分配有限保护预算。静态工具无法随条件变化自适应，仅针对期望结果优化的策略在气候变化下更可能出现的极端轨迹上会失效。CAPTAIN 首次将其建模为序贯强化学习，但其无梯度 ES 优化器缺乏逐步的信用分配，且黑箱设计难以支持风险敏感目标。
AI.method: 将 CAPTAIN 中的 ES 替换为近端策略优化（PPO）：针对其非可微动作空间，采用 Plackett-Luce 模型构造可微的排序采样动作分布；同时将标量评价器（critic）替换为隐式分位数网络（IQN），学习完整回报分布以支持风险敏感目标。在新西兰海洋数据集上进行匹配粒度的对照实验。
AI.result: 匹配粒度对比显示，生态效益的提升主要来自决策粒度而非优化器本身；因此在效果上 PPO 在远低于 ES 的训练成本下达到相当或更优的结果。真正贡献在于训练效率与向风险敏感目标的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: PPO+IQN 为序贯保护规划提供了可逐步信用分配、训练高效且可扩展至分布型/风险敏感目标的框架，弥补了 ES 黑箱设计无法支持的后续研究方向；但主要生态增益应归因于决策粒度设定。

title: InducedTFMs: A Family of Sub-Quadratic Tabular Foundation Models Using Induced Attention
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a serious competitor to gradient-boosted trees, predicting on a new table in a single forward pass by in-context learning. However, their attention is quadratic in the number of samples and features, which caps pretraining at small synthetic tables and forces inference on large ones to rely on chunking or subsampling. Row-compression models reduce the feature-wise cost, but only by discarding the cell-level representation, and remain quadratic in the number of samples. We introduce InducedTFM, which replaces both attention stages of a bidimensional TFM with the induced attention of the Set Transformer, preserving cell-level representations while making its cost linear in both samples and features. Under a training budget matched to a full-attention TabICLv2 reimplementation, InducedTFM matches its accuracy on TabArena and on a benchmark of larger datasets, and clearly outperforms a kernel linear-attention baseline of the same asymptotic cost. It overtakes TabICLv2 in inference time on narrow tables, reaching a 30x speed-up at 640K rows, although row compression remains preferable on wide tables.

AI.tldr: 提出 InducedTFM，用 Set Transformer 的诱导注意力替换双维表格基础模型的两个注意力阶段，在保持单元格级表示的同时，将样本维与特征维的计算成本都降为线性；在匹配训练预算下精度与全注意力 TabICLv2 持平，并在窄表大样本推理上取得最高 30 倍加速。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）借助上下文学习可在单次前向中完成新表预测，已成为梯度提升树的有力竞争者；但其注意力对样本数和特征数均为二次复杂度，导致预训练只能局限于小型合成表，大表推理必须依赖分块或下采样。行压缩类模型虽降低了特征维成本，却丢弃了单元格级表示，且在样本维上仍是二次复杂度。
AI.method: InducedTFM 将双维 TFM 的两个注意力阶段（特征向与样本向）均替换为 Set Transformer 的诱导注意力（inducing points 机制），在保留单元格级表示的前提下，使计算复杂度对样本数与特征数均为线性。实验采用与全注意力 TabICLv2 复现版匹配的训练预算，并与同渐近成本的核线性注意力基线对比。
AI.result: 在匹配训练预算下，InducedTFM 在 TabArena 及一个更大规模数据集基准上的精度与全注意力 TabICLv2 相当，并明显优于同渐近成本的核线性注意力基线；推理时间上，在窄表上反超 TabICLv2，640K 行时实现 30 倍加速；但在宽表上，行压缩方法仍更具优势。
AI.conclusion: 诱导注意力是降低表格基础模型复杂度的有效途径，可同时兼顾精度与效率；但其收益具有形状依赖性——窄表（大样本、少特征）优势显著，宽表场景下行压缩仍为更优选择。

title: An Automated Framework Integrating Deep Learning and Anatomical Reasoning for Cardiac Phenotyping From CCTA
summary: Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) depicts coronary anatomy and cardiac fat, but segmentation alone does not ensure anatomically consistent measurements. We propose an automated framework that combines deep learning with anatomical reasoning for quantitative cardiac phenotyping. Its anatomical measurement module uses graph geometry, branch identity, and surrounding structures to define vessel-specific pericoronary adipose tissue (PCAT) sampling and a surrogate epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) compartment. The latter also generates training targets without requiring expert pericardium contours. A companion module quantifies coronary calcium on non-contrast CT. Component-wise benchmarking was conducted on five public datasets: ImageCAS, ImageCAS-X, COCA, Visual Lab, and MultiD4CAD. On ImageCAS-X Test-160, lumen segmentation with validation-selected post-processing achieved a Dice score of 0.9133 and a clDice score of 0.940, exceeding the corresponding published CAS-Net point estimates. In the four-split ImageCAS evaluation, the four-member ensemble outperformed the single ResEnc-L model. Analysis of 800 paired scans showed that PCAT attenuation measurements differed between whole-vessel and lumen references. External EAT evaluation showed strong volume correlation and good spatial overlap. Explicit anatomical rules make the resulting measurements interpretable and inspectable. In practice, the framework provides a standardized pipeline for processing cardiac CT cohorts and quantifying coronary calcium, PCAT, and EAT for population-level analysis and comparison across studies. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/HarryTRAN207/CardiacCT-Research

AI.tldr: 提出结合深度学习与解剖推理的自动化心脏CT定量表型分析框架，实现管腔分割、钙化量化及PCAT/EAT测量。
AI.motivation: CCTA可显示冠脉解剖与心脏脂肪，但仅靠分割无法保证解剖学一致的测量；需要标准化、可解释的定量表型流程。
AI.method: 框架含解剖测量模块（利用图几何、分支身份与周围结构定义血管特异性PCAT采样及EAT替代腔室，并无需专家心包轮廓即可生成训练标签）、冠脉钙化定量模块（非对比CT），以及深度学习分割；在ImageCAS、ImageCAS-X、COCA、Visual Lab、MultiD4CAD五个公开数据集上做分组件基准评测。
AI.result: ImageCAS-X Test-160上管腔分割Dice 0.9133、clDice 0.940，超过已发表CAS-Net点估计；四折ImageCAS评估中四模型集成优于单ResEnc-L；800对配对扫描显示全血管与管腔参考的PCAT衰减测量存在差异；外部EAT评估体积相关性强、空间重叠良好。
AI.conclusion: 显式解剖规则使测量可解释、可检查；框架为心脏CT队列处理及钙化、PCAT、EAT的人群级定量与跨研究比较提供标准化流程，代码已开源。

title: LoomKV: Lossless KV Cache Compression from GPU Memory to SSD for LLM Serving
summary: Large language model (LLM) serving engines offload the key/value (KV) cache from GPU memory to host DRAM and SSD so multi-turn and agent requests can reuse prompt prefixes. Capacity then limits service at two levels: external tiers govern prefix reuse before eviction, while the GPU KV pool bounds concurrent long requests, and lossy compression alters KV values and outputs. LoomKV brings lossless KV compression to both external tiers (tier mode) and the GPU pool (pool mode) on an unmodified engine. Using a calibrated per-head two-level 3-bit code over BF16 high bytes (sign and upper seven exponent bits), LoomKV stores BF16 KV at 0.71 of its raw size across nine models and FP8 KV at 0.85-0.87. In tier mode, TileStream writes exact-length records with length readback off the load path, leaving tier storage, eviction, and prefetch unchanged, and decompresses fetched records straight into scattered GPU pages. In pool mode, FragPack packs variable-length records into smaller shared-budget GPU pages read in place by a fused decode-attention kernel faster than FlashAttention-3 on BF16. Built with LMCache and vLLM, LoomKV makes compressed tiers act as 1.4x larger raw tiers on AgentX: across LMCache's LRU cliff, tier mode delivers 2.7-3.6x raw's goodput and 1.9-3.1x lower mean time-to-first-token (TTFT), shifts the cliff identically under other simulated replacement policies, and cuts repeated-prompt TTFT up to 1.7x via SSD-to-DRAM promotion. When tiers hold the working set, pool mode fits 1.31-1.34x as many GPU tokens, admitting 12 long requests with roughly raw's queue and goodput at 8. On an AI IDE trace where both tiers and the GPU pool are constrained, tier and pool modes raise goodput by 1.24x and 1.59x. Where raw capacity suffices, compression costs at most 2.2% throughput; tier mode is bit-exact with raw tiers, and pool mode matches FlashAttention-3's numerical accuracy.

AI.tldr: LoomKV 在未修改的推理引擎上，将无损 KV cache 压缩同时引入外部存储层（tier mode）与 GPU KV 池（pool mode），显著扩大有效容量并提升吞吐与 TTFT。
AI.motivation: LLM 推理引擎将 KV cache 从 GPU 显存卸载到主机 DRAM 与 SSD 以支持多轮/Agent 请求的前缀复用，但容量在两层形成瓶颈：外部层决定淘汰前的可用前缀复用窗口，GPU KV 池限制并发长请求数；而现有有损压缩会改变 KV 数值并影响输出质量。
AI.method: 提出逐 head 校准的两级 3-bit 编码，作用于 BF16 高字节（符号位+高 7 位指数）；tier mode 中 TileStream 写入精确长度记录、长度回读不在加载路径上、不改变存储/淘汰/预取策略，取回记录直接解压到离散 GPU 页；pool mode 中 FragPack 将变长记录打包进更小的共享预算 GPU 页，由融合 decode-attention kernel 原地读取；基于 LMCache 与 vLLM 实现。
AI.result: BF16 KV 压缩至 0.71 原始大小，FP8 KV 为 0.85–0.87；AgentX 上压缩层等效 1.4x 原始层，LRU cliff 处 tier mode 吞吐为原始的 2.7–3.6x、平均 TTFT 降低 1.9–3.1x；pool mode 可容纳 1.31–1.34x GPU token，8 请求吞吐下可接纳 12 个长请求；AI IDE trace 上 tier/pool 分别提升吞吐 1.24x 与 1.59x。
AI.conclusion: 容量充足时压缩开销不超过 2.2% 吞吐；tier mode 与原始层比特一致，pool mode 数值精度与 FlashAttention-3 相当，且融合 kernel 在 BF16 下快于 FlashAttention-3。

title: Branch and Consolidate: A Unified Recipe for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Specialists post-trained from a shared checkpoint acquire complementary capabilities, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) can consolidate them into a single model. However, we find that existing consolidation methods, from weight merging to MOPD, fall short when specialists diverge substantially from the shared checkpoint, whereas prior studies mostly examine specialists that remain close to it. We present a unified recipe for multimodal MOPD that consolidates such specialists back into the single student they branched from. The recipe specifies initialization, data selection, balanced supervision across teachers, and preservation of existing capabilities for consolidation, together with a targeted refinement stage for capabilities that still lag behind their specialists. In an industrial setting with six specialists, the student closely approaches each specialist in its own domain and surpasses the perception specialist. It recovers 97.0% of their average gain, compared with 79.8% for IM-MOPD. In the fully open five-domain setting with Qwen3-4B, our method recovers 95.7% of the specialists' average gain after consolidation and 97.5% after refinement, compared with 94.1% for IM-MOPD. We further analyze the full pipeline through mechanism ablations and training dynamics, providing practical guidance for diagnosing incomplete consolidation. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出一套面向多模态场景的多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）统一方案，可将偏离共享基座较远的多个专家能力整合回单一学生模型，工业场景恢复专家平均增益97.0%（IM-MOPD为79.8%），开放五域Qwen3-4B上整合后95.7%、精修后97.5%（IM-MOPD为94.1%）。
AI.motivation: 现有整合方法（权重合并到MOPD）在专家显著偏离共享checkpoint时效果不佳，而以往研究多只考察贴近基座的专家；工业与开放场景中专家间差异大，需要能处理"远偏离"专家的整合方案。
AI.method: 统一的多模态MOPD配方，涵盖四方面：初始化、数据选择、跨教师的均衡监督、整合时保留已有能力；另设针对仍落后于对应专家的能力进行定向精修阶段；并通过机制消融与训练动态分析整条流程。
AI.result: 工业六专家设置下，学生在各自领域接近对应专家并超过感知专家，恢复专家平均增益的97.0%（IM-MOPD为79.8%）；Qwen3-4B完全开放五域设置下，整合后恢复95.7%，精修后97.5%，IM-MOPD为94.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该配方能有效整合显著偏离共享checkpoint的专家，显著优于IM-MOPD；机制消融与训练动态分析为诊断整合不充分提供实践指导，代码将开源。

title: The Old Scene Lives in the Cache: Diagnosing and Shedding Stale History in Streaming Video Generation
summary: Switching scenes while preserving the original subject in streaming video generation exposes a conflict: cached history helps maintain the subject but also sustains old-scene objects that should disappear. Through controlled interventions on text conditioning, denoising steps, the local window, and the attention sink, we identify how cached visual history keeps this obsolete content. When the original frames remain in the cache, KV flush and sink recomputation still leave old-scene objects in the generated videos. Replacing this history with target-scene history largely removes those objects, but also changes the subject, reducing face similarity to the pre-switch subject. We then propose Molt Forcing, a training-free method that rebuilds scene history from a cold-start target scene while selectively retaining subject tokens from the original cache. Across 16 scene families, Molt Forcing removes old-scene objects at least as reliably as an Echo-Forcing hard cut while keeping the subject much closer to its pre-switch appearance.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 Molt Forcing 方法：在流式视频生成的场景切换中，从冷启动目标场景重建场景历史、并选择性保留原缓存中的主体 token，从而在去除旧场景物体与保持主体外观之间取得更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 流式视频生成在切换场景时需保留原主体，但缓存的视觉历史存在内在冲突：它既维持主体一致性，也持续保留本应消失的旧场景物体。作者希望厘清缓存历史如何导致这一"残留"，并找到兼顾去旧物体与保主体的方案。
AI.method: 通过控制变量干预（文本条件、去噪步数、局部窗口、attention sink）定位旧内容被缓存保留的机制；发现仅靠 KV flush 与 sink 重计算无效、直接替换为目标场景历史会改变主体。据此提出 Molt Forcing：免训练，用冷启动的目标场景重建场景历史，同时从原始 KV 缓存中挑选性保留主体 token。
AI.result: 在 16 类场景上，Molt Forcing 去除旧场景物体的可靠性与 Echo-Forcing 硬切换相当，且切换后主体面部相似度显著更高，更接近切换前外观。
AI.conclusion: 旧场景残留源于缓存视觉历史对过时内容的维持；将"场景历史"与"主体 token"解耦（重建场景、保留主体）可有效缓解该冲突，且无需额外训练，具备较强的实用性。

title: Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study
summary: As clinical AI agents begin to interact with electronic health records (EHRs), large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate their actions. But how reliably can these judges recognize clinically dangerous mistakes, especially when an agent appears to have completed its task successfully? We investigate this question using MedAgentBench by introducing controlled clinical errors into verified agent trajectories. The experiments include 416 faulty trajectories, eight error categories, and six open-weight LLM judges. By comparing each faulty trajectory with its correct counterpart, we measure whether judges genuinely recognize errors rather than simply flagging more actions as unsafe. The findings show that access to clinical evidence significantly improves judge reliability. When shown only the final answer, judges cannot distinguish errors that leave it unchanged, while flagging 56% of correct trajectories. With full trajectory information, the ability to distinguish unsafe actions from correct ones reaches a score of 0.75, and providing actual EHR responses improves discrimination by 0.39. Surprisingly, including the agent's reasoning does not improve overall performance and reduces detection of incorrectly reported clinical values by 0.18, which remain the hardest errors to detect. MedGemma performed worse than the general-purpose model and was the only judge to miss potentially dangerous medication overdoses. We also find that the benchmark's original grader accepts all 38 trajectories with an intentionally skipped laboratory check, while combining LLM judges with a rule-based checker informed by the full EHR record detects 97% of injected faults.

AI.tldr: 本研究在 MedAgentBench 中注入受控临床错误，系统评估六个开放权重 LLM 作为"裁判"识别临床危险错误（尤其任务看似成功时的隐蔽错误）的可靠性，发现临床证据（完整轨迹与 EHR 响应）对判别至关重要，而智能体推理过程反而无益甚至有害。
AI.motivation: 临床 AI 智能体开始与电子健康记录交互，LLM 被广泛用作评估其行为的裁判；但这些裁判能否可靠识别临床危险错误——尤其是当智能体表面上"完成任务成功"时的错误——尚不清楚。现有基准的原始评分器还存在明显漏检问题。
AI.method: 基于 MedAgentBench，向已验证的智能体轨迹中注入受控临床错误：共 416 条错误轨迹、8 类错误、6 个开放权重 LLM 裁判。通过将每条错误轨迹与其正确对照轨迹配对比较，测量裁判是真正识别错误，还是仅倾向于将更多动作标记为不安全；并考察不同证据呈现方式（仅最终答案、完整轨迹、真实 EHR 响应、含推理）对判别力的影响，以及 LLM 裁判与规则检查器组合的效果。
AI.result: 仅给最终答案时，裁判无法区分不改变答案的错误，同时将 56% 的正确轨迹误判为有问题；提供完整轨迹后，区分不安全动作与正确动作的得分达 0.75；提供真实 EHR 响应使判别力提升 0.39。包含智能体推理并不提升整体表现，反而使"临床数值报告错误"的检出率下降 0.18，该类错误仍最难检测。MedGemma 表现劣于通用模型，且是唯一漏检潜在危险药物过量的裁判。原基准评分器接受全部 38 条故意跳过实验室检查的轨迹，而 LLM 裁判结合基于完整 EHR 记录的规则检查器可检出 97% 的注入错误。
AI.conclusion: LLM 裁判的可靠性高度依赖临床证据的可及性，而非推理文本；单一 LLM 裁判不足以保障安全，规则检查与模型裁判结合更为稳健；现有基准评分器存在严重漏检，需重新审视其有效性。

title: Beyond Robust Algorithmic Recourse: Sharing the Burden of Validity through Model Multiplicity
summary: Algorithmic recourse provides actionable recommendations that enable individuals to achieve favourable outcomes. Implementing recourse for individuals requires significant time and effort, thus emphasizing robust recourse: recommendations that remain valid even under future model updates. While robustness preserves validity, we show it introduces systematic harms by constraining feasible recommendations to regions that disproportionately reflect majority behavior, reducing individual flexibility and amplifying disparities. Thus, non-robust recourse risks invalidation, whereas robust recourse creates a preference for high-density regions in the data that induces unfairness. However, this trade-off is driven by an implicit assumption that individuals alone should bear the burden of validity. We challenge this narrative and show that strategic model selection can help maintain validity while relaxing robustness requirements for individuals. By leveraging multiplicity, the existence of equally good yet competing models, system owners can share this burden with individuals, thus resolving the tension between validity and unfairness.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示算法追索（algorithmic recourse）中"稳健性"与"公平性"的内在冲突，并提出以模型多重性（multiplicity）实现责任共担的解决路径。
AI.motivation: 面向个体的追索建议实施成本高，故学界强调"稳健追索"（模型更新后仍有效）。但作者指出稳健性会带来系统性伤害：将可行建议限制在过度反映多数群体行为的高密度区域，压缩个体灵活性并放大群体差异。由此形成两难：非稳健追索面临失效风险，稳健追索则偏好数据高密度区域而诱发不公平。作者认为该权衡源于"有效性的负担应完全由个体承担"这一隐含假设，并对此提出挑战。
AI.method: 概念/理论分析与形式化论证：(1) 形式化刻画稳健追索为何将建议约束至高密度区域，论证其与不公平之间的因果联系；(2) 质疑负担分配假设，提出由系统所有者通过"模型选择"分担有效性责任；(3) 利用模型多重性——存在多个性能相当但相互竞争的模型——使系统方在保持有效性的同时放松对个体的稳健性要求。
AI.result: 证明稳健性与公平性之间存在由个体负担假设所驱动的张力；并表明通过策略性模型选择与多重性利用，可在不牺牲有效性的前提下降低对个体的稳健性要求，从而缓解有效性—不公平的冲突，实现负担共享。
AI.conclusion: 追索设计不应将有效性负担单方面转嫁给个体。系统所有者应借助模型多重性进行策略性模型选择，与个体共担责任，这是化解稳健性与公平性矛盾的有效方向，也为追索研究引入了"模型侧"责任的新视角。

title: EditText: Structure-Aware Generation and Selective Visual Transport for Fine-Grained Text Editing
summary: Fine-grained text editing aims to accurately replace text in a specified region while preserving the source text's font, color, and texture, as well as visual consistency in unedited regions. We present EditText, a unified framework for fine-grained text editing that combines target character generation with visual transport from the source image. The model uses dual-condition Fill inputs: a masked image and a source text style reference, both sharing a spatial reference with the target image. The masked image hides the original text and retains unedited content as a source canvas; the style reference supplies appearance cues that guide new character generation together with the target text. We introduce an Attention Transport framework in which Source Weight describes the attention allocated to a condition and the Spatial Aggregation Kernel describes its internal spatial attention distribution. Accurate transfer of source details depends on attention strength, the retention of details in condition features, and spatially accurate aggregation. For selected non-edit queries, we therefore preserve the total attention weight assigned to the masked image while redistributing its attention toward spatially corresponding neighborhoods, enabling selective visual transport. Multi-stage training, combined with a Glyph-aware Structural Loss on local target character structure, teaches the model to generate accurate text, preserve source text appearance, and retain unedited details. We also introduce TBench, a fine-grained text editing benchmark covering Alphabetic, Logographic, and Arabic numerals, to evaluate character updates, appearance preservation, and the preservation of unedited details. On TBench, EditText achieves state-of-the-art non-edit-region SSIM (0.9769) and full-image LPIPS (0.0460).

AI.tldr: EditText：统一框架，结合目标字符生成与源图像视觉搬运实现细粒度文本编辑；提出注意力搬运框架与Glyph-aware Structural Loss，并发布TBench基准，取得SOTA（非编辑区SSIM 0.9769，全图LPIPS 0.0460）。
AI.motivation: 细粒度文本编辑需在指定区域精确替换文字，同时保持源文本的字体、颜色、纹理，并维持未编辑区域的视觉一致性，现有方法难以同时满足"字形准确生成"与"源细节精确迁移"两方面需求。
AI.method: 采用双条件Fill输入：掩码图像（隐藏原文字、保留未编辑内容作为源画布）与源文本风格参考，二者与目标图像共享空间参照。提出Attention Transport框架，以Source Weight刻画分配给某条件的注意力总量、以Spatial Aggregation Kernel刻画其内部空间注意力分布；对选定的非编辑query，在保持分配给掩码图像的总注意力权重不变的前提下，将其注意力重分布到空间对应邻域，实现选择性视觉搬运。训练上采用多阶段策略并结合面向局部目标字符结构的Glyph-aware Structural Loss。
AI.result: 在自建的TBench（覆盖字母文字、表意文字与阿拉伯数字，评估字符更新、外观保持、未编辑细节保持）上，EditText取得SOTA：非编辑区SSIM 0.9769，全图LPIPS 0.0460。
AI.conclusion: 源细节的准确迁移取决于注意力强度、条件特征中的细节保留程度以及空间聚合的准确性；通过注意力重分布与字形感知结构损失的多阶段训练，模型可同时实现文字生成准确、源外观保持与未编辑细节保留。

title: RecordRoute: Auditing Agent Failures with Localization-Guided Diagnosis
summary: Auditing failed agent executions requires identifying the responsible actor, the earliest decisive step, and the error mode. Representative supervised methods either focus on step localization or predict multiple attribution targets from shared trajectory representations. These methods do not use the localization result to select the text for mode diagnosis. To address this limitation, we propose RecordRoute, which couples comparative localization with local diagnosis. Specifically, it represents each record with word and character features and learns to rank records through comparisons within each trajectory. The selected record supplies the actor and step, while its text and metadata drive mode prediction. On controlled-injection Who&When Pro, RecordRoute outperforms StepFinder and ASCon on all four official metrics. With actor and step predictions fixed, local diagnosis reaches 77.47% pooled joint accuracy versus 69.28% for full-trace diagnosis. On natural failures from TraceElephant and CatchBench POST, it outperforms these baselines and three open LLMs in localization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RecordRoute，将"比较式定位"与"局部诊断"耦合：用词/字符特征表示每条记录并在轨迹内学习排序，选出责任记录以确定责任者与最早决定性步骤，再用该记录文本与元数据预测错误模式。在 Who&When Pro、TraceElephant、CatchBench POST 上优于 StepFinder、ASCon 等基线。
AI.motivation: 审计失败的智能体执行需同时给出三个答案：责任者、最早决定性步骤、错误模式。现有监督式方法要么只做步骤定位，要么从共享的轨迹表示中一次性预测多个归因目标；它们都没有利用定位结果去筛选用于错误模式诊断的文本，导致定位与诊断相互割裂。
AI.method: RecordRoute 采用两阶段耦合设计：(1) 比较式定位——将每条记录表示为词级与字符级特征，在每个轨迹内部通过记录间比较学习排序，选出最优责任记录；(2) 局部诊断——由所选记录提供责任者与步骤，并以其文本及元数据作为输入预测错误模式。核心思想是以排序式的相对比较替代绝对打分，并把定位输出显式作为诊断的输入。
AI.result: 在受控注入的 Who&When Pro 上，RecordRoute 在全部四项官方指标上均超过 StepFinder 与 ASCon。固定责任者与步骤预测后，局部诊断的联合准确率（pooled joint accuracy）为 77.47%，而全轨迹诊断为 69.28%，提升约 8.2 个百分点。在 TraceElephant 与 CatchBench POST 的自然失败数据上，其定位性能优于上述基线及三个开源大模型。
AI.conclusion: 定位与诊断的耦合是有效且必要的：用比较式排序选出单一责任记录，再以该记录为上下文做模式诊断，显著优于全轨迹诊断范式。该框架在受控注入与自然失败两类设置下均具稳健性，验证了"先定位、后诊断"的分解式审计思路。

title: Contact Geometry for Generative Models: An Unbalanced Optimal Transport Formulation
comment: 50 pages, 20 figures; accepted for poster presentation at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Real-world generative problems in biology, medical imaging, or robotics, rarely come with perfectly paired source and target distributions. While unbalanced Optimal Transport (uOT) provides a robust framework to bridge unpaired datasets via minimum-length paths in probability space, existing formulations based on the Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) geometry introduce a structural bias toward high density regions, often triggering mode collapse. We introduce Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport (CuOT), a novel uOT formulation grounded in contact geometry that decouples density transport direction from mass growth to eliminate structural bias. This allows CuOT to adapt sampling steps to the local data structure, naturally reducing step sizes in high-density regions to prevent overshooting and ensuring stable convergence. The result is a stable, scalable path-length minimization solver that consistently outperforms WFR-based methods on biological dynamics reconstruction, unpaired image-to-image translation, and video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于接触几何的无平衡最优传输新形式 CuOT，通过解耦密度传输方向与质量增长消除 WFR 几何的结构性高密度偏置，从而避免模式坍缩。
AI.motivation: 生物、医学影像与机器人等真实生成任务中源与目标分布很少完美配对。uOT 可处理非配对数据，但基于 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) 几何的现有形式存在朝高密度区域的结构性偏置，常引发模式坍缩。
AI.method: 提出 Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport (CuOT)，一种以接触几何为理论基础的新 uOT 形式：将密度传输方向与质量增长解耦，使采样步长可自适应局部数据结构——在高密度区域自然减小步长以避免过冲；并据此构建稳定、可扩展的路径长度最小化求解器。
AI.result: 在生物动力学重建、非配对图像到图像翻译以及视频生成任务上，CuOT 稳定收敛并一致优于基于 WFR 的方法。
AI.conclusion: 接触几何为无平衡最优传输提供了消除结构性偏置的原理性建模途径，CuOT 兼具稳定性、可扩展性，是 WFR 类方法的有力替代方案。

title: Interpretable Orthogonal Latent Diffusion with Scale-Selective Uncertainty for Medical Image Super-Resolution
summary: Diffusion models are increasingly used for medical image reconstruction and super-resolution, but their samples may contain plausible fine-scale hallucinations that are difficult to identify from the reconstructed image alone. We propose Med-PODiff, a patch-wise proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) diffusion framework for brain MRI super-resolution that performs generative reconstruction in compact and interpretable local coefficient spaces. Unlike pixel-space or learned-latent diffusion models, Med-PODiff uses the POD structure to separate low-rank anatomical variation from fine-detail residual variation, enabling predictive uncertainty to be decomposed into total, coarse, and fine components. Building on this decomposition, we define a pixel-wise hallucination-risk score, $H_p$, that emphasizes regions where fine-detail uncertainty dominates coarse structural uncertainty. On brain MRI, Med-PODiff outperforms representative diffusion baselines in reconstruction quality while producing well-calibrated predictive intervals, with total uncertainty detecting high-error regions at AUROC 0.954. More importantly, the decomposed uncertainty is scale-selective: coarse and fine uncertainty preferentially predict errors at the corresponding scales, with $H_p$ localizing fine error at AUROC $0.906$. Controlled injections and retrospective Cartesian $k$-space undersampling further support fine-detail localization and degradation robustness. The discarded POD tail is only $3.8\%$ of the retained fine-error magnitude, and Med-PODiff improves downstream segmentation consistency while requiring substantially less inference time than pixel-space diffusion.

AI.tldr: Med-PODiff：基于分块POD(本征正交分解)的扩散框架用于脑部MRI超分辨重建，在紧凑可解释的局部系数空间做生成式重建，并将预测不确定性分解为总/粗/细尺度分量，定义像素级幻觉风险分数H_p定位细尺度伪影。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型用于医学图像重建与超分辨时，样本可能包含"看似合理"的细尺度幻觉(hallucination)，仅凭重建图像难以识别。像素空间或学习潜空间的扩散难以区分低秩解剖结构与细节残差，缺乏可解释的不确定性归因与幻觉风险定位手段。
AI.method: 提出Med-PODiff：1）对图像做分块(patch-wise)POD分解，将低秩解剖变化与细细节残差分离；2）在紧凑的POD系数空间进行扩散生成重建；3）将预测不确定性分解为总不确定性、粗尺度(低秩)不确定性与细尺度(残差)不确定性；4）据此定义像素级幻觉风险分数H_p，强调细细节不确定性主导粗结构不确定性的区域。实验含对照注入与回顾性笛卡尔k空间欠采样鲁棒性验证，以及下游分割一致性评估。
AI.result: 脑MRI上重建质量优于代表性扩散基线，预测区间校准良好；总不确定性检测高误差区域AUROC 0.954；分解不确定性具尺度选择性——粗/细不确定性分别预测对应尺度误差，H_p定位细误差AUROC 0.906；POD丢弃尾部仅占保留细误差幅度的3.8%；下游分割一致性提升，推理时间显著低于像素空间扩散。
AI.conclusion: 在可解释的POD局部系数空间做扩散，可实现尺度选择性的不确定性分解与幻觉风险定位，兼顾重建质量、校准性与效率，为医学图像生成式重建的可信度评估提供新思路。

title: Hybrid AI for AI-Native RAN Control: A Functional Perspective
summary: AI-native radio access network (RAN) control involves interdependent decisions across network entities, protocol layers, and timescales. Understanding how AI and conventional methods can jointly support these decisions requires a common basis for comparing their functional roles. This survey introduces a technique-agnostic taxonomy of RAN decision-making organized around four complementary capabilities: Representation and Reasoning, Prediction and Simulation, Adaptive Control, and Decision Synthesis. These capabilities are defined by their roles in the control process, independently of the techniques used to implement them. Through this perspective, we examine representative AI and model-based approaches, including foundation models, world models, reinforcement learning, and optimization. We then apply the taxonomy to representative RAN control solutions across slow, medium, fast, and cross-timescale applications to identify which capabilities they implement and how these capabilities are combined in hybrid AI systems. We also review datasets, benchmarks, simulators, digital twins, and experimental platforms according to their support for the decision-making process and reproducible evaluation. The review highlights a gap between the availability of resources for closed-loop experimentation and the standardization of tasks, metrics, and evaluation protocols needed for meaningful comparisons.Finally, we identify research directions for hybrid AI in AI-native RAN, including capability integration, multi-agent and cross-timescale coordination, constraint handling, and reproducible closed-loop evaluation. A curated list of surveyed works and evaluation resources is available at https://github.com/pegahani/Hybrid-AI-RAN-Survey.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个与具体技术无关的 RAN 决策能力分类法（表征与推理、预测与仿真、自适应控制、决策综合），用于统一比较 AI 方法与模型方法在 AI 原生 RAN 控制中的功能角色，并据此综述方法、跨时间尺度应用、数据/基准/仿真资源和混合 AI 研究方向。
AI.motivation: AI 原生 RAN 控制涉及跨网络实体、协议层与时间尺度的相互依赖决策；现有研究多以技术为中心（如 RL、优化、基础模型）组织综述，缺乏比较 AI 与传统方法功能角色的共同基准，难以判断混合 AI 系统中各组件贡献及互补性。
AI.method: 1) 构建与实现技术无关的四能力分类法：Representation and Reasoning、Prediction and Simulation、Adaptive Control、Decision Synthesis，按其在控制过程中的角色而非所用技术定义；2) 以该视角梳理代表性 AI 与模型方法（基础模型、世界模型、强化学习、优化）；3) 将分类法应用于慢、中、快及跨时间尺度的代表性 RAN 控制方案，识别其实现的能力及混合 AI 中的组合方式；4) 按对决策过程与可复现评估的支撑程度，评审数据集、基准、仿真器、数字孪生与实验平台。
AI.result: 给出四能力分类下的 AI/模型方法映射与跨时间尺度 RAN 控制方案的能�力画像，揭示混合 AI 系统中能力的典型组合模式；资源评审显示闭环实验资源相对丰富，但任务定义、指标与评估协议的标准化不足，存在明显缺口，影响有意义的可比性。
AI.conclusion: AI 原生 RAN 中混合 AI 的关键挑战在于能力集成、多智能体与跨时间尺度协同、约束处理以及可复现闭环评估；未来需建立标准化的任务、指标与评估协议，以支撑可比较的闭环实验。

title: Representation and Model Contributions on Small Molecular Benchmarks: Controlled Comparisons and External Evaluation
comment: Accepted at the 2026 7th International Conference on Computing and Informatics (ICCI), Cairo, Egypt. 7 pages plus a 6-page supplement
summary: Improvements in molecular property prediction are usually attributed to the model, although part of the gain may come from the molecular representation. New models are commonly benchmarked against a random forest (RF) trained on a molecular fingerprint, a comparison that changes the model and the representation at the same time. We separate the two contributions with a two-by-two factorial design in which the RF and a second model (CatBoost or the tabular foundation models TabPFN and TabFM) are each trained on a fingerprint and on RDKit descriptors, and each effect is tested with a paired scaffold bootstrap. Seven small MoleculeNet datasets (3 regression, 4 classification) are evaluated on the published split of a recent graph transformer (DGT), on 10 additional scaffold splits and on external datasets. For solubility and lipophilicity, the representation effect exceeds the model effect in every main factorial design, in all three evaluations. For hydration free energy, the result depends on the starting fingerprint: from ECFP4 the representation effect is larger, and from MACCS neither effect is significantly larger. On the classification datasets, only one main factorial design has a significant difference between the two effects. Although the model effect is smaller on solubility and lipophilicity, TabFM outperforms the RF on all 7 datasets when both use RDKit descriptors. With RDKit descriptors in place of a fingerprint, the RF baseline reported for DGT surpasses the transformer's published solubility score. We recommend that model comparisons evaluate classical baselines on more than one representation and report the representation and model effects separately.

AI.tldr: 本文用2×2析因设计分离分子性质预测中的“模型效应”与“表示效应”，发现溶解度与亲脂性任务上表示效应在各评测中均超过模型效应，建议基线比较应跨多种表示并分别报告两类效应。
AI.motivation: 分子性质预测的性能提升通常被归因于模型本身，但常用做法是新模型与“指纹+随机森林(RF)”基线对比，这同时改变了模型与表示，导致无法区分增益来源，混淆了模型贡献与表示贡献。
AI.method: 采用2×2析因设计：模型取RF与另一模型（CatBoost或表格基础模型TabPFN、TabFM），表示取分子指纹与RDKit描述符，交叉组合；每个效应用配对scaffold bootstrap检验。在7个小型MoleculeNet数据集（3回归、4分类）上评测，使用近期图Transformer(DGT)的公开划分、额外10次scaffold划分及外部数据集。
AI.result: 在溶解度与亲脂性上，表示效应在全部主析因设计、全部三种评测中均大于模型效应；水合自由能结果依赖起始指纹（从ECFP4出发表示效应更大，从MACCS出发二者均无显著差异）；分类数据集仅一个主析因设计存在两效应显著差异。尽管溶解度与亲脂性上模型效应较小，TabFM在7个数据集上使用RDKit描述符时均优于RF；RF在改用RDKit描述符后其溶解度得分超过DGT已发表成绩。
AI.conclusion: 表示选择常是性能提升的重要来源，甚至可超越模型改进。建议模型比较应让经典基线在多种表示上评测，并分别报告表示效应与模型效应，以避免把表示增益误归为模型增益。

title: VIDE : Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation
summary: In embedding-based video anomaly detection (VAD), normal clips can have high similarity to anomalous descriptions, an anomaly bias that leads to false positives. Methods such as PRISM mitigate this bias by measuring deviations from a normality reference along anomaly directions. Both the normality reference and the anomaly directions are derived from text and shared across videos, although normal activity and the appearance of anomalies vary across scenes. The resulting scores are also sensitive to prompt selection. To address these limitations, we propose Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation (VIDE), a training-free framework that adapts text-derived scoring to each test video using frozen clip embeddings. VIDE estimates normal scene content from clips with low initial anomaly scores and uses this estimate to partially correct the textual reference. It then rescales category responses, penalizes clips with strong responses across categories, and refines the anomaly directions using high-scoring clips. VIDE averages scores across prompt views to reduce sensitivity to prompt selection and fuses scores from two frozen encoders. With both encoders, VIDE improves AUC over the best PRISM result by $1.5$, $1.9$, and $3.5$ points on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD, respectively, and AP by $6.5$ points on XD-Violence and $9.3$ points on MSAD. VIDE yields the highest AUC among the compared training-free methods on all three benchmarks and the highest reported AUC among all compared methods on XD-Violence and MSAD. Our code is included in the supplementary material and will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架VIDE，用冻结的CLIP嵌入对每个测试视频自适应地校正文本导出的异常打分，缓解跨场景共享参考带来的异常偏置与提示敏感性，在UCF-Crime、XD-Violence、MSAD上显著提升AUC与AP。
AI.motivation: 基于嵌入的视频异常检测中，正常片段可能与异常文本描述高度相似，产生异常偏置导致假阳性。PRISM等方法沿异常方向度量对正常性参考的偏离，但正常性参考与异常方向均来自文本且跨视频共享，而正常活动与异常外观随场景变化；同时打分对提示词选择敏感。
AI.method: VIDE为免训练框架：1）由初始异常分数低的片段估计正常场景内容，并用以部分校正文本参考；2）对类别响应重新缩放，惩罚在多个类别上响应都很强的片段；3）用高分片段精化异常方向；4）对多个提示视图的分数取平均以降低提示敏感性；5）融合两个冻结编码器的分数。
AI.result: 双编码器设置下，相比PRISM最优结果，AUC在UCF-Crime、XD-Violence、MSAD分别提升1.5、1.9、3.5个百分点；AP在XD-Violence提升6.5个百分点，MSAD提升9.3个百分点。在三个基准上均为所比较免训练方法中AUC最高；在XD-Violence与MSAD上为所有比较方法中报告的最高AUC。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉内在分布估计对文本先验进行逐视频自适应校正，可在无需训练的情况下有效缓解异常偏置与提示敏感性问题，取得领先的免训练VAD性能。

title: Auditing the Judge: Human-Derived Bias Discovery, Quantification, and Mitigation in LLM Judges
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated evaluators in evaluation and training pipelines, their judgements are often affected by systematic biases that conflict with human preferences. Although prior work has identified various biases and proposed methods for detecting and mitigating them, less attention has been paid to using human preferences to inform bias identification and mitigation. Moreover, these approaches rely heavily on pre-discovered bias lists, overlook bias strength, and depend on costly interventions. In this work, we propose HUB-J, an integrated framework based on human-derived bias factors that detects, quantifies, and mitigates biases in LLM-as-a-Judge systems. Our approach leverages human-LLM judgement disagreement cases to automatically discover interpretable bias factors, and utilizes agreement cases to quantify bias strength through controlled input modifications and resulting shifts in model decisions. Finally, building on these quantified biases, we introduce a lightweight, training-free regression-based mitigation strategy that estimates the influence of each bias factor on model judgments and corrects bias-influenced decisions by removing its estimated effect. Empirical results show that HUB-J uncovers both known and novel bias factors, reveals meaningful differences in model susceptibility, and consistently reduces bias-driven decision flips while generalizing across models.

AI.tldr: 提出HUB-J框架，基于人类偏好衍生的偏见因子，对LLM-as-a-Judge系统中的偏见进行自动发现、强度量化与轻量级缓解。
AI.motivation: LLM作为自动评估器日益广泛用于评估与训练流程，但其判断存在与人类偏好冲突的系统性偏见。现有工作虽已识别多种偏见并提出检测/缓解方法，但较少利用人类偏好来指导偏见识别与缓解；且这些方法依赖预先枚举的偏见清单、忽视偏见强度、并依赖高成本干预。
AI.method: HUB-J包含三个环节：(1) 利用人类与LLM判断不一致的案例自动发现可解释的偏见因子；(2) 利用判断一致的案例，通过受控输入修改及模型决策偏移来量化偏见强度；(3) 基于量化偏见，提出无需训练的轻量回归式缓解策略，估计各偏见因子对模型判断的影响并剔除其估计效应以纠正受偏影响决策。
AI.result: 实验表明HUB-J既能发现已知偏见因子也能发现新颖偏见因子，揭示不同模型在偏见易感性上的显著差异，并持续减少由偏见导致的决策翻转，同时在不同模型间具有泛化性。
AI.conclusion: HUB-J提供了一种以人类偏好为核心、可自动发现并量化偏见强度、且无需额外训练的偏见缓解一体化框架，为LLM-as-a-Judge的可靠性提升提供了可迁移方案。

title: Boiling Down Uncertainty: Deep Generative Scenario Search with Decision-Guided Evolution Strategies for Two-Stage Stochastic Optimization
summary: One of the most common models for handling uncertainty is two-stage stochastic programming. Choosing the right number of scenarios is a trade-off between the uncertainty that can be represented and computational cost. A recent method, Deep Generative Scenario Search, generates synthetic scenarios and improves them by learning from the decisions they induce. The original approach used a black-box gradient estimate, since decisions are piecewise constant across scenarios. This paper provides the missing analytical foundation by deriving the gradient in closed form from recourse duality and an adjoint solve of the regularized reduced problem. The decision-focused direction, with a heuristic direction as a backup when duals are unavailable, defines the sampling subspace of a guided evolution strategy rather than being used as a direct update. For any guiding subspace, the expected update is a descent direction of the smoothed objective, so an inaccurate guide adds variance while the expected step still descends. For six problem families, both guided estimators outperform the baseline. The decision-focused version reduces the mean gap by three-quarters, and on the two families with the most integer variables the reduced sets beat the exact solver's two-hour incumbent in most runs, using a fifth of the time.

AI.tldr: 本文为深度生成情景搜索（DGSS）补上了缺失的解析基础：利用追索对偶性与正则化缩减问题的伴随求解，得到梯度的闭式表达，并将决策聚焦方向作为引导演化策略的采样子空间而非直接更新。
AI.motivation: 两阶段随机规划中情景数量选择需在不确定性表达能力与计算代价间权衡；已有 DGSS 方法因决策对情景呈分段常数，只能用黑箱梯度估计，缺乏解析依据。
AI.method: 从追索对偶性和正则化缩减问题的伴随求解推导闭式梯度；以决策聚焦方向（对偶不可用时以启发式方向兜底）定义引导演化策略的采样子空间；并证明任意引导子空间下期望更新均为平滑目标的下降方向。
AI.result: 在六个问题族上，两种引导估计器均优于基线；决策聚焦版本将平均间隙降低约四分之三；在两个整数变量最多的族上，多数运行中缩减情景集以五分之一的时间优于精确求解器两小时的 incumbent。
AI.conclusion: 解析梯度为 DGSS 提供了理论基础，引导子空间设计在不牺牲下降保证的前提下注入决策信息，显著提升情景缩减的效率与质量。

title: LiteSTAR: Low-Rank Channel Modulation for Temporally Consistent CVD Video Compensation
summary: Color Vision Deficiency (CVD) affects a large population worldwide, yet practical recoloring must run continuously on-device. Frame-wise video recoloring produces color flickering, while existing methods rely on costly cross-frame alignment in pixel or feature space. We observe that color flickering correlates with variations in channel-wise responses, with color-sensitive variations concentrated in a low-rank subspace. Based on this observation, we propose Lightweight Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Recoloring (LiteSTAR), built around LiCaD, a plug-and-play Lightweight Channel-Adaptive Decoder. LiCaD performs temporal filtering in a low-rank state space with learned process and observation uncertainties. It then modulates feature channels to achieve temporal consistency without explicit spatial alignment. LiteSTAR further employs adaptive patch routing to improve color discrimination for CVD users while avoiding unnecessary over-enhancement. We also introduce EgoCVDSet, the first egocentric video benchmark for CVD recoloring. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that LiteSTAR achieves superior performance with only 0.05M parameters. LiCaD further demonstrates strong generalization across different tasks and network architectures. The code, models, and dataset will be released after review.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级时空自适应重着色框架 LiteSTAR，以即插即用的通道自适应解码器 LiCaD 在低秩状态空间做时序滤波，无需显式空间对齐即可抑制视频重着色闪烁，仅 0.05M 参数。
AI.motivation: 色觉缺陷（CVD）人群基数大，实用重着色需在端侧连续运行；逐帧视频重着色会产生颜色闪烁，而现有跨帧方法依赖昂贵的像素级或特征级对齐。
AI.method: 观察到颜色闪烁与通道响应变化相关、且颜色敏感变化集中于低秩子空间；据此设计 LiCaD：在低秩状态空间中结合可学习的过程/观测不确定性进行时序滤波，再以特征通道调制实现时序一致性；外层 LiteSTAR 采用自适应 patch 路由提升 CVD 用户色彩区分度并抑制过度增强；并构建首个自我中心视频 CVD 重着色基准 EgoCVDSet。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验表明 LiteSTAR 在仅 0.05M 参数下取得更优性能；LiCaD 在不同任务与网络架构上表现出良好泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 以通道级低秩时序建模替代显式空间对齐，为端侧视频重着色提供高效、可插拔且可泛化的解决方案，并配套发布数据集、模型与代码。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Candidate Generation for Entity Linking in Cyber Threat Intelligence
comment: This paper has been accepted for oral presentation at the 19th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART 2027)
summary: Entity Resolution (ER) pipelines often collapse ambiguity into early hard decisions: upstream Named Entity Recognition (NER) selects a single span and type, and downstream Entity Linking (EL) treats that choice as ground truth. This discards valuable information about the ambiguity of the underlying data (e.g., span boundary disagreement and type confusion), leading to brittle systems that fail unpredictably when faced with uncertainty in inputs. Therefore, this work presents a proof-of-concept for uncertainty-aware ER that treats uncertainty as native data that should be preserved and exploited throughout ER pipelines. We (i) capture uncertainty signals in the NER stage and (ii) leverage these signals into the EL stage to improve candidate retrieval under ambiguity. Using a BERT-based NER model augmented with two auxiliary span-boundary prediction heads, we apply Monte Carlo (MC) dropout at inference time to derive three mention-level proxy signals: the MC-averaged start-boundary probability, the MC-averaged end-boundary probability, and De Luca-Termini fuzzy entropy computed over the Begin-Inside-Outside (BIO) predictive distribution. These signals are used to adapt the fuzzy cutoff in candidate generation (CG) for EL. Because CG is treated as a blocking step, we evaluate retrieval recall. On the AnnoCTR dataset linked to the MITRE ATTCK knowledge base, the boundary-aware and dual-signal fuzzy linking approaches improve Recall@10 from 0.6186 to 0.7966. The contribution lies not in an end-to-end optimised ER pipeline but in establishing uncertainty preservation as a viable and beneficial component of ER pipelines, enabling downstream EL to make better-informed decisions under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"不确定性感知"的实体解析（ER）概念验证：在NER阶段用MC dropout和双边界预测头捕获提及级不确定性信号（起止边界概率、BIO分布模糊熵），并将其传入EL的候选生成阶段自适应调节模糊截断阈值，在AnnoCTR数据集上将Recall@10从0.6186提升至0.7966。
AI.motivation: 现有ER流水线在上游NER即把歧义压缩为单一span与类型的硬决策，下游EL将其视为真值，丢弃了span边界分歧、类型混淆等数据固有歧义信息，导致系统在输入不确定时表现脆弱、失效难以预测。作者主张不确定性应作为原生数据在整条ER流水线中被保留与利用。
AI.method: 在BERT-based NER模型上增加两个辅助的span边界预测头，推理时使用Monte Carlo (MC) dropout采样，导出三个mention级代理信号：MC平均起始边界概率、MC平均结束边界概率，以及在BIO预测分布上计算的De Luca–Termini模糊熵。将这些信号用于EL候选生成（CG）阶段，自适应调整模糊截断值（fuzzy cutoff）；由于CG被视为blocking步骤，评估指标采用检索召回率。
AI.result: 在连接MITRE ATT&CK知识库的AnnoCTR数据集上，边界感知方法与双信号模糊链接方法将Recall@10由0.6186提升到0.7966。
AI.conclusion: 贡献不在于端到端优化的ER流水线，而在于确立"不确定性保留"作为ER流水线中可行且有益的组件，使下游EL能在不确定条件下做出更明智的决策。

title: Understanding the Importance of Massive Activations through Adversarial Robustness
comment: Includes an appendix. Code available at https://github.com/tigranfah/ma-robustness
summary: A common occurrence in Large Language Models (LLMs) is the emergence of so-called massive activations. This phenomenon is well known in the literature and has been connected to attention sinks, representational compression, as well as signal propagation. However, the reasons and consequences for their appearance are not yet well understood. In this paper, we explain the role of massive activations in deep learning by showing that they are connected to the region migration phenomenon in delayed robustness. Under the spline theoretic interpretation of deep networks, we show that massive activations push the representations away from the nonlinearity boundaries of the network, decreasing the complexity of its input-output map around data points. Furthermore, we uncover for the first time that this phenomenon is not unique to transformers and actually appears in a number of common architectures performing simple supervised learning tasks. We validate this connection through extensive experiments on a diverse set of architectures including residual MLP, ResNet18, Vision Transformers and GPT and datasets including MNIST, CIFAR10, Imagenette and Shakespeare Text. We consistently observe that massive activations and region migration co-occur with adversarial robustness. Furthermore, we illustrate that this connection holds in the large-scale pretraining of LLMs by showing that the rise of massive activations in LLMs closely tracks the adversarial accuracy of the model under perturbations of the token embeddings.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示大规模激活（massive activations）与延迟鲁棒性中的"区域迁移"现象相关联：大规模激活将表示推离网络非线性边界，从而降低输入-输出映射的复杂度；该现象并非Transformer独有，且在多种架构中与对抗鲁棒性共同出现。
AI.motivation: 大规模激活在LLM中普遍存在，已有工作将其与attention sink、表示压缩、信号传播联系起来，但其产生原因与后果仍缺乏清晰解释，尤其缺乏一个统一的理论视角说明其功能性作用。
AI.method: 在深度网络的样条理论（spline theoretic）解释框架下进行分析，论证大规模激活使表示远离非线性边界（即激活函数的折点区域），从而降低数据点附近输入-输出映射的复杂度；并将其与延迟鲁棒性中的区域迁移（region migration）现象建立联系。实验覆盖残差MLP、ResNet18、ViT、GPT等架构，以及MNIST、CIFAR10、Imagenette、Shakespeare文本等数据集，并结合大规模预训练LLM的对抗精度（token embedding扰动下）进行验证。
AI.result: 实验一致观察到大规模激活与区域迁移同对抗鲁棒性共现；在大规模LLM预训练中，大规模激活的出现与模型在token embedding扰动下的对抗准确率变化高度同步，表明该关联可扩展至大规模场景。
AI.conclusion: 大规模激活并非Transformer特有，而是跨架构的普遍现象，其作用可从样条视角解释为降低网络映射复杂度并增强局部鲁棒性；该发现为理解大规模激活的成因与功能提供了统一解释。

title: CSC-Mamba: Bridging multimodal convolutional sparse coding and state space models for multi-contrast MRI super-resolution
comment: This manuscript has been submitted to the IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2027) and is currently under review
summary: Multi-contrast MRI super-resolution accelerates clinical protocols by reconstructing high-resolution (HR) target modalities from low-resolution (LR) inputs, guided by easily acquired reference contrasts. While purely data-driven deep neural networks achieve strong performance via rich representation capacity, they rely on heuristic fusion mechanisms (e.g., naive concatenation or black-box cross-attention) that lack theoretical grounding. Alternatively, model-based deep unfolding networks enforce principled cross-contrast fusion through explicit priors, yet their unrolled steps remain constrained to shallow convolutions, lacking modern deep blocks to capture global context. To bridge this gap, we propose CSC-MAMBA, unifying deep-unfolded multimodal convolutional sparse coding with the Vision Mamba state-space backbone. By fusing common structural priors from the guidance modality via unfolded sparse coding and globally refining contrast-specific representations with a Mamba back- bone, our approach benefits from interpretable, model-guided fusion and long-range spatial context. Experiments on the IXI dataset demonstrate that CSC-MAMBA outperforms state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality, achieving up to a 0.62 dB gain in PSNR while remaining computationally efficient.

AI.tldr: 提出CSC-MAMBA，将深度展开的多模态卷积稀疏编码与Vision Mamba状态空间骨干统一，实现可解释且具全局建模能力的多对比度MRI超分辨重建。
AI.motivation: 多对比度MRI超分辨中，纯数据驱动网络依赖缺乏理论依据的启发式融合（朴素拼接或黑箱交叉注意力）；而模型驱动的深度展开网络虽通过显式先验实现有原则的跨对比度融合，但展开步骤受限于浅层卷积，缺乏捕捉全局上下文的现代深度模块。
AI.method: 以深度展开的多模态卷积稀疏编码作为融合框架，将引导模态中的公共结构先验通过展开稀疏编码注入，再用Vision Mamba状态空间骨干对对比度特异性表示进行全局精炼，兼顾可解释的模型引导融合与长程空间上下文建模。
AI.result: 在IXI数据集上，重建质量优于现有最先进方法，PSNR最高提升0.62 dB，同时保持计算高效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了模型驱动展开方法与现代深度骨干之间的鸿沟，验证了稀疏编码先验与状态空间全局建模结合的优越性与实用性。

title: Delegent: A Multi-Agent Harness That Reduces Cost without Sacrificing Performance
summary: Agents built on frontier language models are expensive. At every step, the frontier model re-reads its entire context and executes every subtask regardless of its difficulty. This paper explores the simple thesis that much of this cost can be removed by delegating easy subtasks to a small language model, or SLM, that runs on hardware one already owns. To test it, we build Delegent, a simple and effective agent harness built on Claude Code, in which the frontier model stays in charge of every task but hands focused subtasks, such as investigating code, running tests, and searching a corpus, to SLM subagents. Existing approaches such as cascades and model routers usually choose which model executes the entire task, whereas in Delegent, the frontier model always leads the execution and delegates easy subtasks to the SLM. No router or model is trained, so either model can be swapped freely. With the help of a 27B FP8 SLM, Delegent reduces the frontier cost of long-horizon coding by 67% and of agentic search by 59%, with no loss in task performance, and even a 2B SLM that fits on a laptop reduces the coding cost by 66%. The savings grow with the legwork that the frontier model would otherwise do itself, and a short instruction, which leaves the main coding tasks to the frontier model, accounts for most of the saving and keeps the 2B SLM from losing tasks. Code: https://github.com/castorini/delegent

AI.tldr: Delegent 让前沿模型始终主导任务、把简单子任务下放给本地小模型（SLM），在长程编码与智能体搜索中分别降低前沿成本 67% 和 59%，任务性能无损失。
AI.motivation: 基于前沿大模型的智能体成本高昂：每一步都要重读全部上下文并亲自执行所有子任务，无论其难度如何。作者提出，这部分成本的大部分可通过把简单子任务交给运行在自有硬件上的小模型来消除。
AI.method: 在 Claude Code 之上构建 Delegent 智能体框架：前沿模型保留全部任务主导权，仅将聚焦子任务（代码调研、跑测试、语料检索）委派给 SLM 子智能体。区别于级联与模型路由（由路由器决定整个任务由哪个模型执行），Delegent 不做任何路由或模型训练，两模型可自由替换；并配合一段简短指令把主要编码任务留给前沿模型。
AI.result: 配合 27B FP8 SLM，长程编码前沿成本降低 67%、智能体搜索降低 59%，性能无损；可装于笔记本的 2B SLM 也能降低编码成本 66%。节省幅度随前沿模型原本需承担的"跑腿"工作量增长；简短指令贡献了大部分节省，并使 2B SLM 不掉任务。
AI.conclusion: 子任务级委派是一种免训练、可即插即换、无需额外路由器的降本方案，能在大幅削减前沿模型开销的同时保持任务表现，适合长程、工具密集的智能体工作流。

title: On the Effectiveness of Resampling for Supervised Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Class imbalance and scarce anomaly labels motivate oversampling in supervised graph anomaly detection (GAD), but its benefits across detectors and benchmarks remain unclear. In the low-label setting of GADBench, with 20 labelled anomalies and 80 labelled normal nodes, we compare class weighting and up to six oversampling strategies in ten detector configurations from three families: graph neural networks (GNNs), tree ensembles on neighbourhood-aggregated features, and tabular foundation models, on 17 datasets. On the eight datasets with organic anomalies, no strategy has a statistically resolved average gain in any configuration, and which nodes are labelled matters as much as the strategy. On the nine datasets with injected anomalies, Gaussian-noise oversampling (ROSE) gains up to 5.2 AUPRC points in four of the six tree and tabular foundation model configurations, and in all six only on attribute-swap anomalies; in four GNNs its gain is not distinguishable from zero. This gain depends on the injection recipe, which gives swapped nodes an atypical feature norm: it is no longer distinguishable from zero when the swap uses a single random donor or preserves the norm, although most detectors then also stop detecting the swaps. Over the 17 datasets, tuning the tree detectors adds about three points, as much as ROSE, and cuts ROSE's gain by about half or more. With the same source nodes and class weight, sampled graph views are not distinguishable from plain copies of those nodes. We recommend tuning baselines, repeating labelled splits, reporting organic and injected anomalies separately, and checking label-free degree and feature-norm baselines.

AI.tldr: 在GADBench低标签设定下，对17个数据集、10种检测器配置系统比较类别加权与最多六种过采样策略，发现：有机异常数据上无策略有统计显著增益；注入异常数据上高斯噪声过采样(ROSE)最多提升5.2 AUPRC点，但增益依赖注入配方；调参树模型约等于ROSE增益且会削弱其一半以上。
AI.motivation: 监督式图异常检测存在类别不平衡与异常标签稀缺问题，过采样被视为常规对策，但其在不同检测器与基准上的实际收益尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在GADBench低标签设定（20个已标注异常节点、80个已标注正常节点）下，于17个数据集、来自三类家族（GNN、基于邻域聚合特征的树集成、表格基础模型）的10种检测器配置中，对比类别加权与最多六种过采样策略；并做消融：改变异常注入方式（单随机供体、保范数交换）、树模型调参、图视图采样 vs 节点拷贝、无标签度与特征范数基线。
AI.result: 8个有机异常数据集上，任何配置均无统计显著的策略平均增益，标注哪些节点与策略选择同等重要；9个注入异常数据集上，ROSE在6个树/表格基础模型配置中的4个获得最高5.2 AUPRC点增益，全部6个仅在属性交换异常上成立；4个GNN上增益与零不可区分。该增益源于注入配方赋予交换节点非典型特征范数，改为单供体或保范数交换后增益消失，但多数检测器也随之失效。17个数据集上树模型调参约贡献3点，等同ROSE，并使ROSE增益减半以上；相同源节点与类别权重下，采样图视图与节点直接拷贝不可区分。
AI.conclusion: 过采样的收益高度依赖注入配方与调参程度，并非普适有效；建议基线调参、重复标签划分、分别报告有机与注入异常结果，并核查无标签的度与特征范数基线。

title: ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models
summary: First-order reinforcement learning, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is widely used to post-train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for multimodal reasoning. However, it incurs heavy memory and system overhead from backpropagation, optimizer states, and a reference model. Forward-only zeroth-order (ZO) methods, such as Evolution Strategies (ES) and its top-k variant Augmented Random Search (ARS), avoid these overheads via reward-guided weight perturbations, yet remain unexplored for VLM reasoning. We find that directly applying standard ES or vanilla ARS to VLMs suffers from two fundamental failure modes: (i) patch-grid overfitting, fitting fragile grid-specific visual token artifacts while ignoring spatial invariants, and (ii) catastrophic forgetting, degrading general perception and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks due to unbounded high-rank parameter and policy drift. We propose ARS-VLM, a visually aligned Augmented Random Search framework for forward-only VLM post-training. First, ARS-VLM extracts a contrastive visual basis from bilinearly paired cross-grid views, concentrating perturbations on shared visual signals while suppressing patch-shift artifacts. Second, ARS-VLM anchors shallow visual-fusion layers with a soft subspace prior while freeing deep reasoning layers, restraining policy drift without a reference model. Third, ARS-VLM scores perturbations on paired views to discard view-fragile directions during top-k selection. We evaluate ARS-VLM on Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B on multimodal reasoning tasks. On 8B, ARS-VLM reaches 61.0% validation accuracy in 20 steps versus 150 for GRPO (7.5x fewer optimization steps) and avoids the late OOD collapse of vanilla ARS and ES. Moreover, ARS-VLM achieves 75.41% single-view micro accuracy across seven OOD vision reasoning benchmarks, compared with 75.31% for full-parameter GRPO, using forward-only post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出前向零阶优化框架 ARS-VLM，将 ARS/ES 类方法首次有效用于 VLM 多模态推理后训练，通过对比视觉基、浅层软子空间先验与配对视图打分三个机制，缓解 patch 网格过拟合与灾难性遗忘，在 20 步内达到 GRPO 150 步的验证精度并保持 OOD 能力。
AI.motivation: 一阶强化学习（如 GRPO）是 VLM 多模态推理后训练的主流方法，但反传、优化器状态与参考模型带来沉重显存和系统开销。前向零阶（ZO）方法（ES 及其 top-k 变体 ARS）虽能规避这些开销，却在 VLM 推理任务上未被探索；作者发现直接套用 ES/ARS 存在两个根本失效模式：(i) patch 网格过拟合——拟合脆弱的网格相关视觉 token 伪影而忽略空间不变性；(ii) 灾难性遗忘——无界的高秩参数与策略漂移损害通用感知与 OOD 任务。
AI.method: ARS-VLM 由三部分组成：(1) 从双线性配对的跨网格视图提取对比视觉基，使扰动集中于共享视觉信号、抑制 patch 位移伪影；(2) 对浅层视觉融合层施加软子空间先验、放开深层推理层，在无参考模型条件下约束策略漂移；(3) 在配对视图上为扰动打分，top-k 选择时剔除视图脆弱方向。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B 上评测：8B 模型 20 步即达 61.0% 验证精度，GRPO 需 150 步（优化步数少 7.5 倍），且避免了 vanilla ARS/ES 的后期 OOD 崩塌；在七个 OOD 视觉推理基准上单视图微精度 75.41%，略高于全参数 GRPO 的 75.31%，且仅用前向后训练。
AI.conclusion: 仅前向的零阶后训练可在 VLM 推理上以更少步数和更低系统开销匹配甚至略优于全参数一阶 GRPO，关键在于以视觉对齐的扰动生成与选择机制同时抑制网格伪影过拟合和策略漂移，从而在提升推理精度的同时保持通用与 OOD 泛化。

title: Temporal Conditioning for Human Behavioral Cloning in Chess
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted manuscript of the paper published at the 2026 IEEE Gaming, Entertainment, and Media Conference (GEM). Code: https://github.com/Prof-it/temporal-chess-model; weights: https://huggingface.co/holymolyyy/temporal-chess-model
summary: Behavioral cloning models in chess typically predict human moves from board states while ignoring temporal inputs such as the remaining clock. However, time pressure is a major determinant of human decision-making quality, and temporal state is a missing dimension of human behavioral modeling. This paper introduces a time-aware transformer that extends a Chessformer-style architecture with learned temporal conditioning tokens encoding player clock state, time control, and recent tempo, together with behavioral heads for thinking time and resignation. The model is trained on large-scale online chess data and evaluated against time-agnostic baselines and the state of the art. Results show that temporal conditioning yields modest overall accuracy improvements but substantially stronger gains under time pressure. Beyond move choice, it also produces more accurate thinking-time and resignation predictions. More importantly, the model better matches human move-quality degradation in critical time regimes, reducing the systematic over-strength observed in time-agnostic behavioral cloning models. These results suggest that temporal state is a previously underutilized but important signal for human behavioral cloning in chess.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种时间感知 Transformer，通过引入编码玩家时钟状态、时间控制与近期节奏的可学习时间条件 token，以及对思考时间和认输行为的行为预测头，将时间压力纳入国际象棋行为克隆建模。
AI.motivation: 传统国际象棋行为克隆模型仅从棋盘状态预测人类走子，忽略了剩余时钟等时间输入；而时间压力是人类决策质量的重要决定因素，时间是人体行为建模中缺失的维度。
AI.method: 在 Chessformer 类架构基础上扩展：加入学习得到的时间条件 token（编码玩家时钟状态、时间控制、近期节奏 tempo），并设置思考时间与认输两个行为预测头；在大规模在线棋局数据上训练，与时间无关基线及当前最优方法进行对比评估。
