AI.result: 时间条件化带来总体准确率的小幅提升，但在时间压力下增益显著更大；除走子选择外，思考时间与认输预测也更准确；模型能更好匹配关键时间区间内人类走子质量的下降，减少了时间无关行为克隆模型的系统性“过强”偏差。
AI.conclusion: 时间状态是国际象棋中人类行为克隆一个此前未被充分利用但非常重要的信号。

title: Gated Concept Adapters: Layer-Wise Concept Bottlenecks for Auditable Text Understanding
summary: Human-facing text understanding systems are used to infer affect, moderate harmful content, and support socially sensitive decisions. However, Transformer predictions are difficult to audit because they are produced from high-dimensional hidden states that do not provide a compact, inspectable interface for human analysis or intervention. We introduce Gated Concept Adapters (GCA), a layer-wise concept bottleneck framework that attaches gated, low-dimensional concept-producing readout adapters to selected outputs of pretrained Transformers. Token representations are mapped into concept activations, filtered by learned gates, pooled into layer-level summaries, and exposed to the prediction head as a concept-mediated interface. The dimensions can be inspected through usage statistics, signature n-grams, post-hoc concept names, and targeted concept interventions. We evaluate GCA on fine-grained emotion classification, toxicity detection, topic classification, and a controlled verb-cloze stress test. In the affective and safety-relevant classification settings, GCA learns comparatively low-redundancy and intervention-sensitive concept representations while retaining useful predictive performance. On toxicity detection, it remains close to an unconstrained ModernBERT baseline while enabling concept-level inspection, targeted intervention, and lightweight post-hoc control. On GoEmotions, the end-to-end concept model incurs a macro-F1 cost relative to unconstrained RoBERTa, while a task-initialized frozen variant substantially reduces this gap. On AG News, GCA remains competitive with recent concept-based baselines, and the Qwen verb-cloze experiment clarifies the limits of concept-mediated full-vocabulary prediction. Overall, GCA provides a neural concept interface for auditable text understanding, prioritizing transparency, diagnosis, and intervention over unconstrained accuracy maximization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Gated Concept Adapters (GCA)，一种逐层概念瓶颈框架，在预训练 Transformer 的选定层输出上挂接带门控的低维概念读出适配器，形成可检查、可干预的概念中介接口，以牺牲部分自由度换取可审计性。
AI.motivation: 面向人类的文本理解系统需推断情感、审核有害内容并支持社会敏感决策，但 Transformer 的高维隐状态缺乏紧凑可检查的接口，预测难以审计、诊断与干预。
AI.method: GCA 逐层附加门控低维概念读出适配器：将 token 表示映射为概念激活，经学习门控过滤，池化为层级摘要，再以概念中介接口送入预测头。可通过使用统计、signature n-gram、事后概念命名及定向概念干预对概念维度进行检查。
AI.result: 在细粒度情感分类、毒性检测、主题分类及受控动词完形压力测试上评估：情感与安全相关任务中学习到低冗余、对干预敏感的概念表示且保留可用预测性能；毒性检测接近无约束 ModernBERT 基线并支持概念检查与轻量事后控制；GoEmotions 上端到端概念模型相比无约束 RoBERTa 有 macro-F1 损失，任务初始化冻结变体显著缩小差距；AG News 上与近期概念基线具竞争力；Qwen 完形实验揭示概念中介全词表预测的局限。
AI.conclusion: GCA 为可审计文本理解提供了神经概念接口，优先考虑透明性、诊断与干预，而非无约束的精度最大化。

title: RoboProbe: Benchmarking Physical Plausibility of Robot World Models
summary: Evaluating the physical plausibility of generated videos is critical for reliable robotic planning with world models. These videos inform action proposal and assessment before real-world execution, so undetected physical violations can lead to erroneous assessments of action feasibility and safety. Yet current video generators often produce physically implausible interactions. Detecting such violations directly with vision-language models (VLMs) remains challenging as physical verification requires evidence-grounded spatiotemporal reasoning beyond high-level semantic understanding. We develop five law-specific metrics for evaluating physical plausibility by combining spatiotemporal evidence from segmentation, tracking, 3D geometry, or appearance comparisons with targeted VLM reasoning: Contact fidelity, Object persistence, Solidity, Robot deformation, and Object deformation. Building on this metric suite, we introduce RoboProbe, an agentic evaluation framework that coordinates metric execution and selectively refines evaluations through constrained actions. To evaluate the physical plausibility of robot world models, we further introduce RP-Bench, with 761 human-labeled generated videos and 130 real demonstrations of 239 manipulation tasks from 12 robot datasets. On RP-Bench, all five metrics achieve AUROCs above 0.85 and outperform the evaluated learned judges, prior evaluators, and a frames-only Gemini baseline. Applying these metrics to five video generators reveals distinct patterns of physical violations across models, in both violation types and frequencies.

AI.tldr: 提出五项基于物理定律的视频合理性度量，并构建代理式评估框架RoboProbe与基准RP-Bench，用于评估机器人世界模型生成视频的物理合理性，各项指标AUROC均超0.85。
AI.motivation: 机器人规划依赖世界模型生成的视频来预演与评估动作，但现有视频生成器常产生物理上不合理的交互，而未被检出的物理违规会导致对动作可行性与安全性的误判。直接用视觉语言模型（VLM）检测此类违规困难，因为物理验证需要基于证据的时空推理，超出其高层语义理解能力。
AI.method: 将分割、跟踪、3D几何或外观比较所得的时空证据与针对性VLM推理相结合，设计五项按物理定律划分的度量：接触保真度、物体持续性、固体性/不可穿透性、机器人体形变、物体形变；在此基础上提出RoboProbe——一个协调各度量执行、并通过受限动作选择性精化评估的代理式（agentic）评估框架；同时构建RP-Bench，含761段人工标注的生成视频与130段真实演示，覆盖12个机器人数据集的239个操作任务。
AI.result: 在RP-Bench上，五项度量AUROC均高于0.85，优于所评估的学习型评判器、既有评估器以及仅用帧输入的Gemini基线；将度量应用于五个视频生成器，揭示出不同模型在违规类型与发生频率上的显著差异模式。
AI.conclusion: 证据锚定的时空度量加代理式评估可有效、可靠地检测生成视频中的物理违规，为机器人世界模型的可靠性评估提供可量化基准，并揭示不同生成器存在系统性且各异的物理缺陷。

title: Let The Pixels Through: Rethinking Long Skip Connections for Scalable Pixel Diffusion
summary: Training pixel diffusion models remains less straightforward, owing to the ad hoc training recipes and architecture designs, along with the sensitivity to hyper-parameter choices. We show that strong denoisers can be built by refining existing pixel-native designs from the literature. Specifically, we revisit the long skip connection in U-Net and find that the optimization benefit commonly attributed to it is not necessary for its denoising benefit. We further find that the conventional linear combination of features from the skip and main backbone is inadequate for regimes of various noise levels. Motivated by these observations, we introduce two core modifications. First, we adopt asymmetric long skips, which propagate fine-grained information from input embeddings to decoder layers. Second, we introduce adaGLU, a SwiGLU-like MLP block, in decoder layers to adaptively filter information from the embeddings before being added to main-branch features. The above designs give a simple pixel diffusion transformer architecture. When trained from scratch, it scales smoothly from small-scale baselines up to 1.6B parameters, achieving 1.62 and 1.70 FID on ImageNet-256 and -512, respectively. Besides, it natively supports multimodal inputs, such as text and images, yielding competitive performance in text-to-image generation. We release our codes at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/PiT

AI.tldr: 论文提出简化且可扩展的像素扩散Transformer架构PiT：通过非对称长跳跃连接与adaGLU自适应门控MLP替换U-Net式长跳跃与线性特征融合，从零训练可平滑扩展至1.6B参数，在ImageNet-256/-512上取得1.62/1.70 FID，并原生支持多模态（文本、图像）条件生成。
AI.motivation: 像素扩散模型训练不够"顺手"：依赖经验性训练配方与架构设计，且对超参数敏感。作者希望从既有像素原生（pixel-native）设计中提炼出稳健的强去噪器构建原则，减少对trick的依赖。
AI.method: 1）重新审视U-Net长跳跃连接：发现其优化收益与去噪收益并非同一来源，去噪收益不依赖其优化作用；2）指出跳跃分支与主干特征的常规线性组合在不同噪声水平下不充分；3）提出两项核心修改：(a) 非对称长跳跃（asymmetric long skips），将输入嵌入的细粒度信息传入解码层；(b) adaGLU——类SwiGLU的MLP块置于解码层，在嵌入信息加回主干前进行自适应过滤。组合后形成简洁的像素扩散Transformer。
AI.result: 从零训练时，模型从小规模基线平滑扩展至1.6B参数，在ImageNet-256与ImageNet-512上分别达到1.62与1.70 FID；原生支持文本、图像等多模态输入，在文生图任务上具竞争力。代码已开源（AMAP-ML/PiT）。
AI.conclusion: 像素扩散的强去噪器可通过精炼既有pixel-native设计获得，关键在于跳跃信息的传递方式与按噪声水平自适应的特征门控，而非沿用U-Net的原始跳跃与线性融合；所得架构简洁、可扩展、可多模态化。

title: MetaFORGE: A Meta-Learning Framework for Harness Optimization in Automated Code Generation for Parallel Computing
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) can generate parallel programs, but their correctness and performance depend strongly on the instructions that guide generation. We present \textsc{MetaFORGE}, an execution-grounded meta-learning framework that iteratively optimizes persistent natural-language skill specifications for MPI C code generation. \textsc{MetaFORGE} combines correctness testing, compiler diagnostics, static-analysis findings, runtime measurements, and rank-level load-imbalance profiles into a scalar reward that drives textual-gradient refinement, while an external memory distills and retrieves reward-supported optimization knowledge across runs.
  Across six MPI tasks and three workload sizes, \textsc{MetaFORGE} improves static-analysis quality, runtime, and load balance relative to zero-shot generation and generally exceeds the evaluated \textsc{TextGrad} iterative baseline. A model-matched refinement ablation shows that the MetaFORGE advantage persists when its refinement model is reduced to \texttt{gpt-4o}. An expanded retrieval ablation across all 18 task--workload configurations shows consistent runtime benefit and broad static-analysis and load-balance benefit from retrieved context. Leakage-controlled held-out and zero-update experiments further provide evidence that optimization knowledge persists in both the transferred skill and external memory under the evaluated protocol.

AI.tldr: MetaFORGE：以执行反馈为驱动的元学习框架，迭代优化持久化自然语言技能规范以提升LLM生成MPI C程序的正确性与性能。
AI.motivation: LLM可生成并行程序，但其正确性与性能高度依赖引导生成的指令；如何自动、持续地获得高质量的生成指令尚缺系统方法。
AI.method: 将正确性测试、编译器诊断、静态分析结果、运行时测量与rank级负载不均衡画像聚合成标量奖励，驱动文本梯度式（textual-gradient）精修；同时用外部记忆在多次运行间蒸馏与检索经奖励验证的优化知识，形成持久化的自然语言技能规范。
AI.result: 在6个MPI任务×3种负载规模上，静态分析质量、运行时与负载均衡均优于零样本生成，并总体超过所评估的TextGrad迭代基线；模型匹配消融显示精修模型降为gpt-4o时优势仍保持；18个任务—负载配置的检索消融显示运行时收益稳定、静态分析与负载均衡收益广泛；受控泄漏的留出与零更新实验表明优化知识同时留存于迁移技能与外部记忆。
AI.conclusion: 执行反馈驱动的元学习可有效且稳健地优化程序生成技能规范，且知识可跨运行积累与迁移；所提方法在MPI代码生成上较零样本与迭代式文本优化基线更具优势。

title: ST-GNN-AAAS: Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection in the Traveling Salesman Problem
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems: From Forecasting to World Modeling (FMTS)
summary: Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection (AAAS) aims to make solver choices under varying time budgets. The existing AAAS approaches largely rely on static instance characteristics and make limited use of temporal information revealed during solver execution. We propose ST-GNN-AAAS, a Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network framework for AAAS in the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). The framework represents evolving incumbent tours using time-varying node features, including distances from each node to its neighbors in the current tour, and combines these features with solver performance observations over a short history window. Given this short history, ST-GNN-AAAS predicts solver selections over a longer future horizon. We evaluate the method on a subset of diverse TSP benchmarks from NATIONAL, TNM, TSPLIB, and VLSI, releasing the corresponding solver execution data to support reproducibility. Our model achieves a selection accuracy of 76.59% and closes 46.05% of the average rank gap between the single best solver (SBS) and the virtual best solver (VBS).

AI.tldr: 提出ST-GNN-AAAS：以时空图神经网络建模TSP求解过程中演化的当前最优解（incumbent tour）与时序求解器表现，实现任意时间预算下的自动算法选择，选择准确率76.59%，缩小SBS与VBS平均排名差距的46.05%。
AI.motivation: 现有Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection（AAAS）方法主要依赖静态实例特征，对求解器执行过程中揭示的时序信息利用不足，难以随求解进展动态调整算法选择。
AI.method: 将求解中的incumbent tour表示为时变节点特征（各节点到当前tour中邻居的距离），与短期历史窗口内的求解器性能观测相结合，用时空图神经网络从短历史预测更长未来时域内的求解器选择；在NATIONAL、TNM、TSPLIB、VLSI的多样TSP基准子集上评估，并公开求解器执行数据。
AI.result: 选择准确率76.59%，消除单最优求解器（SBS）与虚拟最优求解器（VBS）之间平均排名差距的46.05%。
AI.conclusion: 融合空间（图结构）与时间（求解轨迹）信息可有效提升AAAS的求解器选择质量，优于仅用静态特征的方案；公开执行数据支持可复现研究。

title: Seeing Is Not Reaching: Instruction Shortcuts Override Visual Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 31 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/QZhang2111/psg
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are expected to inherit visual grounding from vision-language models, yet often reach for an object's training location after it has been moved. Across six VLAs, we identify two shortcuts: a scene shortcut, where the arm follows the scene's original task despite a new instruction, and an instruction shortcut, where the instruction retrieves the requested object's training location. In $π_{0.5}$, the instruction shortcut persists even though object-name attention follows the moved target. We call this Seeing Is Not Reaching. To determine whether this grounding is unused or overridden, we separately mask an image-mediated grounding pathway and a direct instruction-to-action pathway. Masking the grounding pathway eliminates reaches to moved targets, whereas masking the direct pathway increases them. Thus, grounding already guides action but is often overridden by the instruction shortcut, which acts through the direct pathway. We introduce Pathway-Separated Guidance (PSG), which amplifies grounding and suppresses the shortcut without training or external target locations. On LIBERO-PRO Object under Position perturbations, PSG raises the target-reaching rate from 22.0% to 52.6% and task success from 16.6% to 40.8%, while largely preserving performance on the original tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）在物体被移动后仍伸向其训练时位置，源于"场景捷径"与"指令捷径"两种捷径，并提出免训练的通路分离引导（PSG）方法
AI.motivation: VLAs理应从视觉语言模型继承视觉定位能力，但在目标物体被移动后仍常伸向训练时位置，说明感知与动作之间存在断裂，需要诊断这一"Seeing Is Not Reaching"现象的成因
AI.method: 在六个VLAs上归纳出两种捷径：场景捷径（忽略新指令而跟随场景原有任务）与指令捷径（指令直接检索物体训练位置）；通过分别掩蔽图像介导的定位通路与指令到动作的直连通路进行因果式通路分离分析；据此提出无需训练、无需外部目标位置的Pathway-Separated Guidance（PSG），增强定位信号并抑制捷径
AI.result: 在π0.5中，即便物体名称注意力已跟随被移动目标，指令捷径依然存在；掩蔽定位通路会消除对移动目标的伸取，掩蔽直连通路则增加之，表明定位已能引导动作但被捷径覆盖。LIBERO-PRO Object位置扰动下，PSG将目标伸取率从22.0%提升至52.6%，任务成功率从16.6%提升至40.8%，且基本保持原任务性能
AI.conclusion: VLAs的视觉定位通路本身有效，问题在于其作用被经直连通路实现的指令捷径所压制；通过通路分离的引导即可在不训练的情况下显著改善位置泛化

title: HiCal: Offline Calibration for Hierarchical Scale Encoding in Accurate HiF4 Quantization
summary: Block floating-point (BFP) quantization is widely adopted for efficient low-bit large language model (LLM) inference, where the choice of block scales plays a critical role in quantization accuracy. HiFloat4 (HiF4) employs a hierarchical scale encoding scheme consisting of a global E6M2 scale and two levels of binary scale extensions. However, its conventional rounding rule and fixed scale extension thresholds may not fully capture the statistical characteristics of the quantized tensors in practice, leading to suboptimal scale representations. In this work, we propose HiCal, an offline calibration approach that improves HiF4 quantization accuracy by refining the encoding decisions across all three scale levels. Specifically, we introduce a calibrated rounding bias for the Level-1 E6M2 scale and optimize the scale-extension thresholds at Levels 2 and 3 based on the empirical distributions of local group magnitudes. The resulting calibration parameters are determined offline and remain fixed during inference, while the hierarchical encoding continues to adapt to individual blocks through their local values. This design eliminates the need for per-block multi-candidate scale search while preserving the original deterministic HiF4 encoding procedure. Experiments across five synthetic and real activation distributions show that the proposed method reduces quantization MSE by 9.91%-23.50% relative to the original HiF4 scheme, including a 13.00% reduction on real Qwen3-8B activations. End-to-end evaluations across six benchmarks further show average-score improvements of 0.91 and 1.25 percentage points on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, respectively, without per-block multi-candidate search during inference.

AI.tldr: 提出HiCal——一种面向HiFloat4 (HiF4) 块浮点量化的离线标定方法，通过修正三级尺度编码决策（Level-1 E6M2标定舍入偏置、Level-2/3尺度扩展阈值优化）降低量化误差，无需推理期逐块多候选搜索。
AI.motivation: HiF4采用全局E6M2尺度加两级二进制尺度扩展的分层编码，但其常规舍入规则与固定尺度扩展阈值难以匹配实际张量的统计特性，导致尺度表示次优、量化精度受限。
AI.method: 离线标定：为Level-1 E6M2尺度引入标定后的舍入偏置；基于局部组幅值的经验分布优化Level-2与Level-3的尺度扩展阈值。标定参数离线确定并在推理时固定，分层编码仍通过局部值自适应各块，保持原确定性编码流程，避免逐块多候选尺度搜索。
AI.result: 在五种合成与真实激活分布上，量化MSE相对原始HiF4降低9.91%–23.50%，其中真实Qwen3-8B激活上降低13.00%；六个基准的端到端评测在Qwen3-8B与Qwen3-30B-A3B上平均分分别提升0.91和1.25个百分点，且推理期无需逐块多候选搜索。
AI.conclusion: 针对HiF4分层尺度编码的离线标定可有效提升低比特LLM推理的量化精度，且以零推理开销、保持确定性编码的方式实现，具备实用部署价值。

title: GOLD-SLAM: Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM
summary: Panoramic cameras capture nearly the entire spherical field of view in a single frame. However, the mismatch between this panoramic coverage and the field of view of LiDAR poses a substantial challenge for panoramic Gaussian splatting SLAM that relies on LiDAR depth priors. We introduce GOLD-SLAM, a Gaussian-splatting Omnidirectional LiDAR-Depth SLAM system that combines high-quality rendering with accurate geometric reconstruction. It performs tracking and mapping in the spherical domain and uses tracked visual features in regions without LiDAR coverage to improve pose estimation. To address insufficient coverage of newly observed surfaces and floating artifacts during incremental mapping, we introduce Depth-Aware Map Extension and Pruning (DAEP). To enable broader evaluation, we collect a new dataset, WHOLE, using a UAV platform across Weak-geometry, High-dynamic, Omnidirectional, Low-light, and Easy scenarios. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and WHOLE demonstrate competitive rendering quality and improved geometric accuracy relative to perspective systems. Compared with existing panoramic baselines, GOLD-SLAM improves mean PSNR by 5.56-9.10 dB and reduces mean Depth-L1 by 71.9-83.9%. To assess deployment feasibility on resource-constrained platforms such as UAVs, we evaluate an embedded configuration of GOLD-SLAM on a Jetson Orin NX (16 GB), demonstrating online operation at the cost of reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 GOLD-SLAM：面向全景相机的 LiDAR-深度高斯泼溅 SLAM，在球面域完成跟踪与建图，并引入深度感知地图扩展与剪枝（DAEP）与 WHOLE 数据集；相比现有全景基线平均 PSNR 提升 5.56–9.10 dB、Depth-L1 降低 71.9–83.9%。
AI.motivation: 全景相机单帧可覆盖近整个球面视场，而 LiDAR 视场有限，全景覆盖范围与 LiDAR 深度先验覆盖范围之间的不匹配，使依赖 LiDAR 深度先验的全景高斯泼溅 SLAM 难以直接套用透视域方法；同时增量建图中新观测表面覆盖不足、浮动伪影等问题也需处理。
AI.method: 1) 在球面域统一进行跟踪与建图；2) 在无 LiDAR 覆盖区域利用跟踪到的视觉特征辅助位姿估计；3) 提出 Depth-Aware Map Extension and Pruning（DAEP），处理新观测表面覆盖不足与浮动伪影；4) 构建 UAV 平台采集的 WHOLE 数据集（Weak-geometry、High-dynamic、Omnidirectional、Low-light、Easy 五类场景），并在 Jetson Orin NX (16 GB) 上评估嵌入式配置。
AI.result: 在公开基准与 WHOLE 上取得有竞争力的渲染质量与更优几何精度（相对透视系统）；相较现有全景基线，平均 PSNR 提升 5.56–9.10 dB，平均 Depth-L1 降低 71.9–83.9%；嵌入式配置可在 Jetson Orin NX 上在线运行，但重建质量有所下降。
AI.conclusion: GOLD-SLAM 通过球面域跟踪建图、无 LiDAR 区域视觉特征利用与 DAEP 机制，有效弥合全景覆盖与 LiDAR 视场不匹配问题，实现高质量渲染与准确几何重建，并在资源受限平台展示可行性。

title: SoccerNarrate: Event-Grounded Streaming Soccer Commentary with Macro-Window Preference Alignment
summary: Existing clip-based soccer commentary models often produce delayed, repeated, or poorly synchronized narration on untrimmed full-match videos. Recent streaming video-language models make low-latency full-match narration feasible, but they often favor general descriptions rather than professional, event-grounded soccer commentary. They may describe nearby actions while failing to mention key events such as goals, cards, substitutions, and offsides correctly and on time. In this paper, we present SoccerNarrate to bridge low-latency streaming narration with event-grounded professional soccer commentary across data, training, and evaluation. First, we construct SoccerNarrate-Data, a large-scale time-anchored dataset with word-level ASR alignment, quality filtering, and entity calibration. Second, we perform macro-window preference alignment (MWPA), which aligns the model with complete event-level commentary semantics by comparing causal multi-step rollouts from the same streaming prefix while keeping second-level inference unchanged. We further use event-mismatched human commentaries as counterfactual negatives to emphasize event semantics over commentary style. Third, we introduce SoccerNarrate-Eval, an event-centric benchmark based on temporally constrained event entailment. Full-match experiments show that SoccerNarrate improves event coverage and event-aligned precision over strong offline and streaming baselines. Code and models are released at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/SoccerNarrate.

AI.tldr: SoccerNarrate 提出一套面向全场足球直播的流式解说框架，在数据、训练与评测三方面弥合低延迟与事件落地之间的差距，显著提升事件覆盖与事件对齐精度。
AI.motivation: 现有切片式足球解说模型在未剪辑全场视频上存在延迟、重复与音画不同步问题；近期流式视频语言模型虽实现低延迟全场解说，但偏向通用描述，无法及时准确提及进球、红黄牌、换人、越位等关键事件。因此需要同时兼顾低延迟与专业事件级解说的方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建 SoccerNarrate-Data：大规模时间锚定数据集，具备词级ASR对齐、质量过滤与实体校准；2) 提出宏窗口偏好对齐（MWPA）：在保持秒级推理不变的前提下，对同一流式前缀的因果多步 rollout 进行比较，使模型对齐完整事件级解说语义，并以事件不匹配的人工解说作为反事实负样本，强化事件语义而非风格；3) 构建 SoccerNarrate-Eval：基于时间约束事件蕴含的事件中心基准。
AI.result: 全场实验表明，相比强离线与流式基线，SoccerNarrate 在事件覆盖率与事件对齐精度上均有提升。代码与模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据构建、偏好对齐训练与事件中心评测的统一设计，可在不牺牲流式低延迟推理的前提下实现专业、事件落地的足球解说，为流式体育解说提供了可复用的数据、方法与评测体系。

title: TeamFlowRL: Online Policy Optimization of Decentralized Flow Policies for Multi-Agent Coordination
comment: 27 pages. Project page: https://teamflowrl.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/teamflowrl/TeamFlowRL Models: https://huggingface.co/teamflowrl/TeamFlowRL
summary: Complex cooperative tasks require coordinated multi-agent behavior. Offline generative policies learn expressive cooperative behaviors from trajectories but remain limited by fixed datasets. Online reinforcement learning can improve them through environment interaction. However, fine-tuning flow policies is difficult because action likelihoods are hard to compute. We propose TeamFlowRL, a two-stage framework that pretrains multi-agent flow policies offline and fine-tunes them online. We formulate team policy optimization over the complete denoising trajectories of decentralized flow policies, avoiding intractable action likelihoods. The resulting objective weights each agent's trajectory ratio with a shared team advantage and clips each ratio separately, aligning local policy updates with the common team return. Across 51 paired configurations in seven simulation groups, TeamFlowRL improves every offline initialization, with a 47.3% average gain in normalized score. It also achieves 33.1% higher average success under exploration noise than Gaussian-policy fine-tuning across 6 bimanual tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出TeamFlowRL两阶段框架：先离线预训练多智能体流策略，再在线微调；以完整去噪轨迹上的团队策略优化规避动作似然不可算问题。
AI.motivation: 复杂协作任务需要多智能体协调行为。离线生成式策略能从轨迹学到表达性强的协作行为，但受限于固定数据集；在线强化学习可通过环境交互改进，然而流策略因动作似然难以计算而难以微调。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：离线预训练去中心化多智能体流策略，再在线微调。将团队策略优化定义在去中心化流策略的完整去噪轨迹上，从而避免难以处理的动作似然。所得目标用共享的团队优势对每个智能体的轨迹比率加权，并对每个比率分别裁剪，使局部策略更新与共同团队回报对齐。
AI.result: 在7个仿真组的51组配对配置中，TeamFlowRL对每种离线初始化均有提升，归一化分数平均提升47.3%；在6个双臂任务上，带探索噪声时平均成功率比高斯策略微调高33.1%。
AI.conclusion: 在完整去噪轨迹层面进行团队策略优化，可有效实现多智能体流策略的在线微调，并对多种离线初始化具有一致的改进效果。

title: ICLWorld: Benchmarking In-Context Learning of Agents from Digital to Physical Worlds
comment: Project page: https://iclworld.github.io Code: https://github.com/ICLWorld/ICLWorld Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aoraku/ICLWorld
summary: In-context learning (ICL) lets agents acquire new rules from context and adapt to user-specific requirements at inference time. The same frontier agents now operate both computers and robots, yet their ICL remains insufficiently assessed: existing benchmarks are largely offline, rely on text or static images, and risk training-data contamination, while robot evaluations are limited to method-level ablations. We present ICLWorld, an online benchmark that evaluates the ICL of agents from digital to physical worlds, covering computer use and robot use, together with UIverse, a unified harness that turns every environment into a user interface. We build 30 environments, record 630 demonstration videos (10+ hours), and design 160 tasks with customized, often counter-intuitive rules that cannot be satisfied without learning from the context. Each task comes with three rule versions, given as text or video, and we test generalization at three levels, from replaying the demonstration to new instances and unseen environments. Across six frontier models, the strongest agents, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, succeed on 82% and 76% of computer-use runs but only 27% and 26% of robot-use runs, and a no-rule control reduces success to at most 8%. GPT-6 Astra succeeds under all three rule versions on only 38% of computer-use tasks, half its rate under a single rule, and answers 98% of robot rule questions correctly yet completes only 20% of these tasks. Frontier agents learn rules comparably well from video and from text and transfer them across environments, whereas weaker agents rely on text and lose most of their video-based success once the demonstrated situation is resampled. These findings reveal substantial gaps between the digital and the physical world and between identifying a rule and acting on it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ICLWorld 在线基准与 UIverse 统一执行框架，从数字世界到物理世界（电脑使用与机器人使用）系统评测前沿智能体的上下文学习（ICL）能力，发现数字与物理世界之间、以及"识别规则"与"执行规则"之间存在显著鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 同一批前沿智能体已同时操作电脑与机器人，但其 ICL 能力评估严重不足：现有基准多为离线、依赖文本或静态图像、存在训练数据污染风险；机器人评测仅停留在方法级消融，缺乏统一、在线、可泛化的评测体系。
AI.method: 构建 ICLWorld 在线基准，覆盖电脑使用与机器人使用；提出 UIverse 统一测试台，将每个环境转化为用户界面；建立 30 个环境、630 段演示视频（10+ 小时）、160 个任务，任务规则定制化且常为反直觉，无法脱离上下文习得；每个任务配 3 个规则版本（文本或视频），并按三级泛化测试（重放演示→新实例→未见环境）。在 6 个前沿模型上进行实验，并设置无规则对照。
AI.result: 最强模型 Claude Opus 5.5 与 GPT-6 Astra 在电脑使用任务上成功率分别为 82% 和 76%，但机器人使用任务仅 27% 和 26%；无规则对照下成功率最高仅 8%。GPT-6 Astra 在全部三种规则版本下均成功的电脑任务仅占 38%，约为单一规则版本成功率的一半；在机器人规则问答上正确率达 98%，但任务完成率仅 20%。前沿智能体从视频与文本学习规则的效果相当，并能跨环境迁移；较弱智能体依赖文本，一旦演示情境被重采样，其基于视频的成功率大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 评测揭示了数字世界与物理世界之间、以及"识别规则"与"依据规则行动"之间的显著差距；ICL 在物理世界的执行落地仍是前沿智能体的主要短板。

title: Mind the Band: The Hidden Frequency Variable in Geometric RoPE
comment: 33 pages, 15 figures, 23 tables. Project page: https://bispl-wm.github.io/MindTheBand/
summary: Geometric rotary position encodings (RoPE) incorporate 3D camera geometry into multi-view attention by rotating token features according to viewing rays, depths, and reprojected image coordinates. Each coordinate is rotated across a progression of frequencies--its frequency band--yet existing implementations leave this band to inherited defaults, either retaining standard 2D RoPE's top frequency or letting the frequency span grow exponentially with the attention head dimension. We show that this unstandardized setting can reverse benchmark rankings. In novel view synthesis on RealEstate10K, RayRoPE matches the strongest baseline in the 47M model (144-channel heads), yet trails by 1.2 dB in the 25M model (48-channel heads), and exhibits the same reversal when varying head size alone at fixed model width. Populating a 243x range with four frequencies instead of the 3x default at 48 channels recovers 0.9 dB of that gap. Across view synthesis and two-view depth estimation, overly narrow bands consistently blur correspondence, whereas all three projection-based encodings perform reliably when their top frequency lies within 0.3--3 rotations per 8-pixel patch (10--90 rotations across 256x256 RealEstate10K). At the opposite extreme, overly wide bands degrade RayRoPE through a forward-backward asymmetry: averaging rotations over a predicted depth interval damps high frequencies in the forward pass, yet leaves their gradients with respect to predicted depth undamped. Blocking only those high-frequency depth gradients recovers 90--93% of the lost PSNR, showing that forward smoothing does not guarantee backward stability. Guided by this analysis, we distill practical guidelines--setting bands in image coordinates, populating spans in small heads, and avoiding unconditional same-view damping--and advocate reporting and matching frequency bands in future multi-view benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示几何旋转位置编码(RoPE)中"频带"设置未标准化会造成基准排名反转，并给出频带范围、前向-后向不对称性的机理分析与实践准则。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D相机几何的多视角RoPE实现将每个坐标的频率带沿用默认设置（沿用2D RoPE最高频率，或让频率跨度随注意力头维度指数增长），这一未标准化设定可能影响公平比较与结论稳定性，作者由此研究频带对性能与排名的影响。
AI.method: 以RayRoPE为对象，在RealEstate10K新视角合成与双视图深度估计任务上系统改变频率带（最高频率与跨度），对比不同模型规模与头通道数(144 vs 48)；并用"在预测深度区间上平均旋转"分析宽带下的前向/后向行为，通过屏蔽高频深度梯度做验证。
AI.result: 47M模型(144通道头)中RayRoPE与最强基线持平，25M模型(48通道头)中落后1.2 dB，固定宽度仅改头大小亦出现同样排名反转；48通道下用4个频率覆盖243×范围可挽回0.9 dB。频带过窄使对应关系模糊；三种投影式编码在最高频率落在0.3–3次旋转/8像素块(256×256下10–90次旋转)时表现可靠。频带过宽则因前向平均阻尼高频、而深度梯度未阻尼的不对称而退化，仅屏蔽高频深度梯度即恢复90–93%损失的PSNR。
AI.conclusion: 频率带是影响多视角几何编码性能与排名比较的关键超参数，前向平滑不保证后向稳定。作者给出准则：在图像坐标系中设定频带、在小头中充分填充频率跨度、避免无条件的同视角阻尼，并倡议未来多视角基准报告并匹配频率带。

title: LATEC: Learned Axial TEnsor Compression for High-Dimensional Scientific Data
summary: With the growing scale of scientific simulation and infrastructure, part of the burden has shifted from producing scientific data to analyzing and storing it. Compression is a key step to expanding storage capacity, but requires dedicated techniques to enforce user-specified pointwise error bounds that ensure the validity of downstream scientific workflows. To further push the limits of compression, novel learned codecs have been developed, in particular for images and videos, but these methods often optimize for aggregated distortion and fail to meet error bound standards. Moreover, these methods often target fixed field dimensionality, failing to account for many scientific data use cases, or at the expense of large adaptation or retraining costs. In this work, we introduce the Learned Axial TEnsor Compression (LATEC) method, an error-bounded codec with a dimension-agnostic learned predictor based on a GNN architecture. LATEC is pretrained on synthetic 2-D and 4-D fields, and evaluated with and without domain fine-tuning on 13 scientific fields in 3-D to 5-D. Results show that LATEC is consistently competitive with SZ3, achieving an 18.1% average improvement and greater consistency across all domains than other compressors. These results demonstrate that a shared learned predictor can serve as a single error-bounded codec across tensor dimensionalities, competitive with specialized compressors, while retaining pointwise error guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LATEC——一种基于GNN的维度无关学习预测器的误差有界张量压缩编解码器，在13个3-D至5-D科学数据场上与SZ3竞争，平均提升18.1%。
AI.motivation: 科学模拟与基础设施规模增长使负担从数据生产转向数据存储与分析，压缩是扩容关键，但需满足用户指定的逐点误差界以保障下游工作流有效性。现有学习型编解码器（多面向图像/视频）优化聚合失真、难以满足误差界要求，且通常只针对固定维度，跨维度适配或重训练成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出LATEC（Learned Axial TEnsor Compression）：采用基于GNN架构的维度无关学习预测器，实现逐点误差有界编码。模型先在合成的2-D与4-D场上预训练，随后在13个3-D至5-D科学场数据上分别以"域微调"和"不微调"两种设置评估。
AI.result: LATEC整体与SZ3具竞争力：平均相对改进18.1%，且在各数据域间表现更一致（优于其他压缩器）。
AI.conclusion: 单一共享学习预测器可作为跨张量维度的统一误差有界编解码器，性能可与专用压缩器竞争，同时保留逐点误差保证，从而降低重训练与适配成本。

title: LaWanle: Why Can't Leading Driving Models Make a Simple Turn?
summary: We were surprised to find that leading end-to-end driving models across major paradigms, despite scoring close to human drivers on NAVSIM, cannot reliably make a simple 90-degree turn in photorealistic closed-loop simulators. To investigate why, we build LaWanle, a benchmark of turns drawn from three such simulators. Driving each turn from several starts, we find that the same model passes it from one start and fails it from another, and that the two drives look alike until they enter the junction. Rotating the car by a few degrees at the junction entry can fail a turn it otherwise passes. Conversely, a slight heading correction to the plans can rescue about half of the failed turns we tested. Such errors arise when a model drives by itself, so we post-train an open-source lane-keeping model with closed-loop DAgger on its lateral path. Training 5% of its parameters is enough to raise its turn pass rate from 19% to 76%. The gain transfers to the two other benchmarks, where the policy also scores among the leading models. Further fine-tuning on recovery data repairs the deviations it is trained on but, against a control trained equally long, improves turns on none of the three benchmarks, and every variant stays far below a human driver.

AI.tldr: 现有领先端到端驾驶模型虽在NAVISIM上接近人类水平，却无法在逼真闭环仿真器中稳定完成简单的90度转弯；作者构建转弯基准LaWanle并揭示其失败源于路口进入时的分布敏感性（数度朝向扰动即可致失败、轻微航向修正可救回约一半失败转弯），随后用闭环DAgger后训练横向路径，仅训练5%参数即将转弯通过率从19%提升至76%，且增益可迁移到另两个基准。
AI.motivation: 作者意外发现，横跨各大范式的领先端到端驾驶模型尽管在NAVISIM上得分接近人类驾驶员，却在逼真闭环仿真器中无法可靠完成简单的90度转弯。这一“基准得分高、实际能力弱”的落差说明现有评测未能暴露模型在闭环交互下的真实缺陷，因此需要探究其失败原因，并提出可行的改进手段。
AI.method: 1) 构建LaWanle基准，从三个逼真闭环仿真器中采集转弯场景，并对每个转弯设置多个起点进行评测；2) 通过对照实验定位失败来源：比较同模型不同起点的通过/失败轨迹，分析二者在进入路口前的相似性，并施加“路口入口处数度旋转”与“对规划施加轻微航向修正”的扰动实验；3) 在模型自主闭环驾驶条件下，对开源车道保持模型以其横向路径为目标，用闭环DAgger进行后训练，仅更新5%参数；4) 在恢复数据上进一步微调，并设置同等训练时长的对照组；5) 在两个其他基准上验证迁移性。
AI.result: 同一模型在同一转弯的不同起点上会一个通过、一个失败，且两条行驶轨迹在进入路口之前几乎相同；在路口入口处把车辆旋转几度，就能让原本通过的转弯失败；反之，对规划施加轻微航向修正可救回约一半所测失败转弯。闭环DAgger后训练仅需训练5%的参数，即可将该模型转弯通过率从19%提升至76%，增益可迁移到另外两个基准，并使策略在其中跻身领先模型之列。但在恢复数据上进一步微调，只修复了其训练所覆盖的偏差；与同等训练时长的对照组相比，在这三个基准上均未提升转弯表现，且所有变体仍远低于人类驾驶员。
AI.conclusion: 高NAVISIM得分并不代表闭环驾驶能力：端到端模型的转弯失败并非源于轨迹形态差异，而是路口入口处对朝向扰动高度敏感、缺乏闭环纠偏能力所致。以闭环DAgger后训练横向路径可用极小的参数代价显著提升转弯鲁棒性并具备跨基准迁移性，但单纯在恢复数据上微调收益有限；模型表现仍显著低于人类驾驶员，说明该问题尚未解决。

title: MediaStormBench-CameraLog: Can Multimodal Models Identify a Camera's Log Curve?
summary: MediaStormBench is a multimodal benchmark for real-world film and television production, with each subset drawn from MediaStorm's day-to-day work. We release its first subset, MediaStormBench-CameraLog (CameraLogBench), on a common foundational task in footage ingest and initial color grading: identifying the Log curve of a clip without metadata. Cameras record Log footage by compressing a wide range of scene light into code values with a vendor-defined logarithmic curve, and color can be restored correctly only once that curve is known. The curve, however, is recorded only in file metadata, easily lost in transcoding and team hand-offs. A colorist then has to try candidate curves one by one against a waveform scope, and a wrong choice shifts the tones and colors of the whole clip. Recovering the curve from the image alone is challenging, because vendor curves cluster tightly in code value and are coupled with unknown exposure. CameraLogBench is built on professionally shot footage and tests whether multimodal models can identify the curve, with a probe that removes the correct option to expose guessing from priors. Because every candidate curve is strictly defined by a published vendor formula, we derive four controls from one implementation of these formulas: graded negatives, synthetic frames of identical scenes, in-context specification digests, and a training-free formula baseline, which together decouple semantic priors from photometric measurement. Across 11 models, real-footage accuracy barely exceeds always guessing the most frequent curve; when the correct option is removed, models almost never abstain, revealing heavy reliance on scene and brand priors. Supplying the vendor specification sharply improves recognition on calibrated charts but hardly helps on natural images without a photometric reference, exposing a gap between reading a specification and measuring pixels.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态基准 MediaStormBench，并首发子集 CameraLogBench，用于检验模型能否在无元数据条件下仅凭图像识别 Log 曲线。结果显示 11 个模型在真实素材上的准确率仅略高于"猜最常见曲线"，且缺乏弃答能力、依赖场景与品牌先验，暴露规格阅读与像素测量之间的能力缺口。
AI.motivation: Log 曲线决定了宽动态范围场景光到码值的压缩方式，只有已知曲线才能正确还原色彩；但曲线仅记录于文件元数据，转码与团队交接中极易丢失。调色师需逐条尝试候选曲线并用波形示波器比对，选错则整段素材的影调与色彩偏移。现有基准缺乏对"仅凭图像反推厂商曲线"这一真实作业任务的检验。
AI.method: 基于 MediaStorm 专业实拍素材构建基准，核心任务为无元数据下的 Log 曲线识别。设计去除正确选项的探针以区分真实识别与先验猜测。因每条候选曲线均由公开厂商公式严格定义，从同一公式实现派生四项对照：已调色负样本、同场景合成帧、上下文规格摘要、免训练公式基线，以解耦语义先验与光度测量。评测覆盖 11 个多模态模型。
AI.result: 真实素材准确率仅略高于始终猜测最常见曲线的水平；移除正确选项后模型几乎从不弃答，表明对场景与品牌先验依赖严重。提供厂商规格在标定图卡上显著提升识别，但在缺少光度参考的自然图像上几乎无帮助。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型尚不具备从像素进行光度反演的能力，缺乏弃答与不确定性表达。基准揭示"读懂规格"与"测量像素"之间的实质差距，为影视制作场景下的多模态评测提供了可控、可复现的对照设计范式。

title: Load Balancing Neurons: Firing-Rate Control Sustains Plasticity in Continual Learning
summary: Neural networks in continual learning often lose plasticity: some neurons become inactive, while others fire almost constantly. This limits adaptation to shifting data and wastes capacity. Prior work mitigates this by periodically reinitializing low-utility units, but such resets can destroy previously learned features and do not proactively prevent low utility. We study a simple diagnostic measure: the firing rate of ReLU units, defined as the fraction of positive pre-activations. Low rates identify dead units, while very high rates indicate linearized, always-on units. Based on this view, we introduce a lightweight load-balancing mechanism that adjusts per-neuron thresholds to keep firing rates within a target range. Across continual ImageNet and class-incremental CIFAR-100, firing-rate distributions explain differences in plasticity across a range of approaches, including well-known techniques such as L2 regularization and non-affine normalization, and load balancing matches or exceeds reset-based methods on both benchmarks. The same mechanism carries over to reinforcement learning, improving Rainbow DQN on Atari over a LayerNorm baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以 ReLU 单元"激活率"作为诊断持续学习中可塑性丧失的指标，并引入轻量的逐神经元阈值负载均衡机制，将激活率维持在目标区间，从而在持续图像分类与强化学习任务上匹配或超越基于重置的方法。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中的神经网络常出现可塑性丧失：部分神经元失活（dead），部分神经元几乎恒激活（线性化、always-on），导致对数据分布漂移的适应能力下降并浪费容量。已有方法通过周期性重置低效用单元来缓解，但会破坏已学特征，且无法主动预防低效用单元的产生，因此需要一种更主动、破坏性更小的机制。
AI.method: 1）定义诊断指标：以 ReLU 单元激活率（正预激活所占比例）刻画单元状态——低激活率对应死单元，极高激活率对应线性化的恒激活单元。2）在此视角下提出一种轻量负载均衡机制，逐神经元调整阈值（bias/threshold），使激活率保持在预设目标区间内，从而主动维持单元分布均衡。3）该机制与 L2 正则、非仿射归一化等方法对比分析其可塑性差异，并可迁移至强化学习场景。
AI.result: 在持续 ImageNet 与类别增量 CIFAR-100 上，激活率分布能够解释包括 L2 正则化、非仿射归一化等知名方法在内的多种方法之间的可塑性差异；负载均衡方法在两个基准上达到或超过基于重置（reset）的方法。同一机制迁移至强化学习，在 Atari 上使 Rainbow DQN 相对 LayerNorm 基线获得提升。
AI.conclusion: 激活率是一个简洁有效的持续学习可塑性诊断量，可用于解释不同方法的差异；基于阈值的负载均衡以更小的破坏性主动维持神经元效用，在持续分类与强化学习上均有效，是重置式方法的有力替代与推广。

title: DOPER: Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited
comment: 35 pages including appendices. Project page: https://nvlabs.github.io/DOPER/ Code: https://github.com/NVlabs/DOPER
summary: We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.

AI.tldr: DOPER：共享视觉主干联合检测/分割/关键点预测的RGB 6D位姿估计框架，用PnP求解位姿，仅需RGB即可实时达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有6D位姿估计多依赖深度输入或学习式位姿精化网络，且难以从合成数据迁移到真实场景（尤其CAD模型不精确、光照变化、对应关系歧义等问题），需要一种仅用RGB、可自合成到真实渐进适配的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 共享视觉主干，联合执行目标检测、分割与关键点预测，通过PnP恢复已知物体6D位姿；2) 从合成训练出发，保留合成关键点标签同时用部分监督适配真实观测；3) 利用标定多视角观测提供几何约束进行关键点监督；4) 推理时可选热图精化，将刚性位姿直接拟合到预测的关键点分布，无需深度或学习式位姿精化器即可缓解对应歧义；5) 从不完备CAD模型出发，渐进式联合精化物体表示与位姿估计器。
AI.result: 在SPEED+与SHIRT上展现对光照变化的有效适配与准确时序位姿估计；在HANDAL、HOPEv2、HOT3D、T-LESS的单/多视角配置下取得SOTA检测AP；仅用RGB，单块GB300上每个物体模型35 Hz实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 联合学习检测与位姿关键点、结合真实观测与几何约束，可有效实现纯RGB、免深度、免学习式精化器的实时SOTA 6D位姿估计，并支持从不精确CAD出发的渐进自改进。

title: LoopFit: Retrofitting Pretrained Diffusion Transformers with Recurrent Refinement
summary: Scaling inference computation offers a way to improve diffusion transformers (DiTs), but taking more sampling steps leaves the depth of each denoising prediction unchanged. Recurrently reusing Transformer blocks increases computation within each step, allowing further refinement of hidden representations. Retrofitting pretrained models enables this capability without repeating pretraining, but requires blocks learned for fixed-depth computation to refine states produced by their own repeated application. The challenge is to use each additional pass to correct local errors without disrupting the structure established by earlier passes. We introduce LoopFit, which uses feedback from earlier passes to guide refinement at each image patch. Residual Attention Modulation (RAM) uses each patch's feature change in one pass to scale and shift its input to attention in the next. During training, Residual Relay Loss (RRL) gives greater weight to patches whose prediction errors persist across passes. A noise-dependent depth schedule speeds up sampling by using four passes at high noise and one at lower noise levels. At comparable cost, backbones trained with four passes solve more problems using recurrent depth than extra sampling steps. Across 12 visual puzzle settings, LoopFit solves 89.8% of boards, compared with 87.8% for the strongest baseline evaluated on all 12. Most of the gain comes from tracing long paths on mazes and frozen lakes.

AI.tldr: LoopFit 通过让预训练 DiT 在每次去噪步骤中循环复用 Transformer 块，并用残差注意力调制与残差接力损失引导逐 patch 细化，在同等计算开销下优于增加采样步数。
AI.motivation: 增加采样步数可提升 DiT 推理效果，但每个去噪预测的深度不变。循环复用 Transformer 块可在单步内增加计算以进一步细化隐表示，且可对预训练模型"后装"而无需重新预训练。难点在于让原本为固定深度学习、却要细化自身重复应用所产生状态的块，利用额外轮次纠正局部误差而不破坏前几轮已建立的结构。
AI.method: 提出 LoopFit：Residual Attention Modulation (RAM) 用每个 patch 在一轮中的特征变化来缩放和平移其下一轮注意力输入，形成反馈式逐 patch 细化；训练时 Residual Relay Loss (RRL) 对跨轮次持续存在预测误差的 patch 赋予更大权重；并采用噪声相关的深度调度，高噪声阶段用 4 轮、低噪声阶段用 1 轮以加速采样。
AI.result: 在可比计算成本下，以 4 轮训练的骨干模型用循环深度比增加采样步数解决更多问题；在 12 个视觉谜题设置中，LoopFit 解出 89.8% 的棋盘，而最强基线（在全部 12 个设置上评测）为 87.8%。增益主要来自迷宫与冻结湖上长路径的追踪。
AI.conclusion: 逐 patch 的残差反馈调制配合误差持续性加权的接力损失，可使循环深度有效替代额外采样步数，在视觉推理类任务上带来稳定提升。

title: FourStat: A Dual AutoEncoder Leveraging Frequency and Stationarity for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: While numerous studies have focused on multivariate time series anomaly detection, many existing methods perform poorly or are not directly applicable to univariate settings. We introduce FourStat, a dual-model framework for univariate time series anomaly detection that combines two complementary approaches. The Fourier Autoencoder (FAE) captures global patterns like seasonality through frequency-domain analysis, while the Stationary Autoencoder (SAE) focuses on local structures by enforcing statistical stationarity. We also propose a new evaluation metric called Perfect Point that assesses whether perfect F1-scores can be achieved directly from anomaly scores, eliminating thresholding subjectivity. Results demonstrate that FourStat outperforms existing baselines, particularly on challenging anomaly types, while the new metric provides clearer insights into model performance gaps and advantages.

AI.tldr: 提出 FourStat 双模型框架用于单变量时间序列异常检测，融合频域全局模式与平稳性约束的局部结构，并提出 Perfect Point 指标评估任意阈值下能否取得完美 F1。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多聚焦多变量时间序列异常检测，许多方法在单变量场景下表现不佳或无法直接适用；同时下游评估依赖阈值选取，具有主观性。
AI.method: FourStat 由两个互补自编码器组成：Fourier Autoencoder (FAE) 通过频域分析捕捉季节性等全局模式；Stationary Autoencoder (SAE) 通过强制统计平稳性建模局部结构。二者结果融合形成异常分数。另外提出 Perfect Point 评估指标，直接判断异常分数能否在无需阈值调优的情况下达到完美 F1。
AI.result: FourStat 优于现有基线，尤其在困难异常类型上优势明显；Perfect Point 指标能更清晰地揭示模型间性能差距与优势。
AI.conclusion: 频域与平稳性双视角互补对单变量异常检测有效；Perfect Point 提供了消除阈值主观性的评估视角。

title: SGD with Large Learning Rates: General Analysis & Improved Rates
summary: Stochastic Gradient Descent lies at the core of modern machine learning. However its classical analysis typically restricts the stepsize to be below a curvature-dependent stability threshold. Recent developments in deterministic optimization have challenged this paradigm, showing that suitably chosen large stepsizes can not only preserve convergence, but also accelerate Gradient Descent (GD). Whether this phenomenon persists in the presence of stochastic gradient noise has remained an open question (Wu et al., 2024). In this work, we answer this question affirmatively for the cross-entropy loss with linear predictors and two-layer neural networks, establishing an accelerated $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2})$ convergence rate. At the core of our analysis is a fine-grained characterization of the stochastic large-stepsize dynamics. This sharper control of the trajectory further yields tight convergence guarantees within the stable regime, improving existing bounds even in the deterministic setting. Taken together, our results show that the acceleration mechanism induced by large stepsizes survives stochasticity and extends beyond linear models. Numerical experiments demonstrate the benefits of large learning rates in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文在有随机梯度噪声的情况下，证明了交叉熵损失（线性预测器与两层神经网络）采用大学习率时仍可获得加速的 O(T^{-2}) 收敛率，回答了大步长加速能否在随机场景中成立的开放问题。
AI.motivation: 经典SGD分析通常要求步长低于依赖曲率的稳定性阈值；近期确定性优化表明适度大的步长不仅保持收敛还能加速GD。但随机梯度噪声是否会破坏这一加速机制此前仍为开放问题（Wu et al., 2024），本文旨在解答该问题。
AI.method: 对交叉熵损失下的线性预测器与两层神经网络，精细刻画大歩长随机动力学的轨迹行为，从而对随机大步长动态实现更细致、更紧的控制；并在稳定区域内给出更紧的收敛保证。
AI.result: 证明了 O(T^{-2}) 的加速收敛率；所得轨迹控制还改进了稳定区域内的收敛界，即使在确定性情形下也优于已有结果；数值实验验证了大学习率的实际收益。
AI.conclusion: 大歩长诱导的加速机制在随机性下依然存在，并可超越线性模型扩展到两层神经网络。这挑战了传统的曲率稳定性阈值观念，为SGD大步长的理论与实践提供了新认识。

title: Scaling Laws of Ensemble Uncertainty in Language Models
summary: Many use cases for large language models (LLMs)---from AI safety to exploration and human interaction---can benefit from epistemic uncertainty estimates. We argue that existing Bayesian Deep Learning solutions, which are often restricted to a fixed model family, fail to capture the full epistemic uncertainty at practical LLM scales. This is because the error due to the bounded capacity of the model family remains invisible to disagreement among models supported by the prior. We relate this error to the well-known power-law scaling of LLM loss with model size. We then show that a second power law quantifies the shrinking disagreement within ensembles as model size increases. Its slower decay relative to the capacity law above suggests that ensembles capture a growing share of epistemic uncertainty and become more competitive as an axis for scaling, compared to a single larger model. Finally, a third power law quantifies the loss of ensemble diversity as members share a larger fraction of training before branching, and therefore identifies a further limitation, beyond the capacity error, for LoRA ensembles and optimization-based or second-order methods that approximate uncertainty around a single training solution. At a high level, these findings suggest diverse ensembles can be a promising axis, both for scaling and uncertainty quantification at larger scales.

AI.tldr: 论文论证固定模型族的贝叶斯深度学习方法无法捕捉LLM规模下的全部认知不确定性，并以三条幂律分别刻画容量误差、集成内分歧随规模的收缩，以及共享训练导致的多样性损失。
AI.motivation: AI安全、探索与人机交互等LLM应用需要认知不确定性估计，但现有贝叶斯深度学习方法通常局限于固定模型族，其在模型规模增大时因容量有限产生的误差无法通过先验支持下的模型间分歧体现出来，因此在实用LLM规模下系统性低估认知不确定性。
AI.method: 将容量导致的误差与LLM损失随模型规模的幂律缩放联系起来；提出第二条幂律刻画集成成员间分歧随模型规模增大而收缩的速率；提出第三条幂律刻画集成成员在分支前共享训练比例增大时集成多样性的损失。
AI.result: 集成内分歧的幂律衰减速率慢于容量幂律，说明随规模增大集成所捕获的认知不确定性份额上升，作为扩展轴比单个更大模型更具竞争力；同时第三条幂律揭示了LoRA集成及基于优化/二阶近似、围绕单一训练解估计不确定性的方法，除容量误差外还存在多样性损失这一额外局限。
AI.conclusion: 多样化集成是兼顾规模扩展与不确定性量化的有前景方向，尤其在大规模下相对单模型扩展更具优势；而共享训练过多的集成与单解近似方法受多样性衰减限制。

title: Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep
summary: The ability to learn and generalize from limited experience, or sample efficiency, is a cornerstone of intelligence. How can we build language models that turn a few user interactions, a few snippets of unfamiliar code, or a handful of experimental results provided in context into knowledge that generalizes? Prior work has found that sleep, a process where the model performs $N$ recurrent forward passes to refine its representations of a chunk of context, can improve long-context reasoning (specifically, within SSM-attention hybrid models). We study whether this method also improves in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic tasks for transformer language models. To this end, we pre-train language models up to 1.2B-parameters on up to 100B tokens with sleep mechanisms. Notably, longer sleep (i.e., using a larger number of recurrent forward passes $N$) enables the model to learn faster in-context on multiple few-shot algorithmic, question-answering tasks, while also achieving lower next-token prediction loss on out-of-distribution evaluations. On held-out code, models with $N=2$ and $N=4$ match the no-sleep baseline's loss using $2.10\times$ and $2.39\times$ fewer tokens in-context, respectively. More broadly, we view our work as a step toward building models that have better tradeoffs between in-context adaptation and decoding latency.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"睡眠"机制（对一段上下文执行 N 次循环前向传播以精炼表示）能否提升 Transformer 语言模型的上下文内适应能力与样本效率。
AI.motivation: 从少量经验中学习和泛化（样本效率）是智能的核心。已有工作发现睡眠机制能改善长上下文推理，但仅限于 SSM-Attention 混合模型且多为合成任务。作者希望验证该方法能否在通用、非合成任务上提升 Transformer 的上下文内适应能力。
AI.method: 在最多 1.2B 参数、最多 100B token 的规模上，对 Transformer 语言模型加入睡眠机制进行预训练；睡眠即对一段上下文执行 N 次循环前向传播以迭代精炼表示，并系统改变 N 的大小，在少样本算法题、问答等任务和分布外评测上评估。
AI.result: 更长的睡眠（更大的 N）使模型在多个少样本算法与问答任务上上下文内学习更快，同时在分布外评测上取得更低的下一词预测损失。在留出代码上，N=2 和 N=4 的模型分别用少 2.10× 和 2.39× 的上下文 token 达到无睡眠基线的损失水平。
AI.conclusion: 睡眠机制可提升 Transformer 在通用任务上的上下文内适应效率，为在上下文适应能力与解码延迟之间取得更优权衡提供了思路。

title: NativeDrive: Native Multimodal Foundations for Autonomous Driving
comment: 16 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Autonomous driving requires semantic understanding and fine-grained scene perception for precise action prediction. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic priors, but low-dimensional action labels provide limited structural supervision. Some studies extend VLAs with visual generation tasks or adopt video-based world-action models (WAMs), but both approaches introduce appearance-reconstruction overhead, which is less relevant to planning. Native multimodal models offer an alternative to unify understanding and generation within one backbone. On this basis, we propose NativeDrive, a native encoder-free multimodal driving framework adapting the unified backbone for policy learning and introduce a dense supervision task tailored to driving. The Native Action Interface reuses the understanding expert's token-prediction interface for the discrete policy and adapts the generation expert for continuous policy. Driving Semantic Editing reuses the generation expert's editing capability for dense scene-structure supervision during training, while inference runs only the selected planning policy. NativeDrive achieves competitive planning performance among unified understanding-and-generation models on NAVSIM v1 and v2, with ablations validating its components' effectiveness. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 NativeDrive：无需视觉编码器的原生多模态驾驶框架，复用统一理解-生成主干，通过 Native Action Interface 与 Driving Semantic Editing 实现离散/连续策略与稠密监督。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需要语义理解与细粒度场景感知以精确预测动作。VLA 继承语义先验，但低维动作标签提供的结构监督有限；用视觉生成或视频世界动作模型补充监督又带来与规划关系不大的外观重建开销。
AI.method: 基于原生多模态（理解+生成）统一主干构建无编码器框架。Native Action Interface：复用理解专家的 token 预测接口输出离散策略，并适配生成专家输出连续策略；Driving Semantic Editing：训练时复用生成专家的编辑能力提供稠密场景结构监督；推理时仅运行所选规划策略。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM v1 与 v2 上，在统一理解-生成模型中取得有竞争力的规划性能；消融实验验证各组件有效性。
AI.conclusion: 统一理解-生成主干可在不引入外观重建开销的前提下为驾驶策略提供结构化稠密监督，是一种有效的原生多模态驾驶范式。

title: Tabra Blends: Improving the Accuracy--Latency Trade-off with Complementary Tabular Models
summary: Tabular foundation models make different trade-offs between prediction accuracy and latency. We study whether a compact ensemble can deliver higher accuracy in less time. Across 816 TabArena splits, our blend of four-estimator Kumo and one LimiX pipeline reaches 2063.8 Elo, 45.4 points above the top published entry in the same fit. Its normalized fit + predict time is 15% lower than Kumo-16's and 98% lower than full LimiX's. We find that greater prediction diversity between the two models helps explain the reduction in error.

AI.tldr: 本文研究紧凑集成能否以更少时间取得更高精度，提出由4个Kumo估计器与1个LimiX流水线构成的5成员混合集成，在816个TabArena划分上达到2063.8 Elo，超过同批次最强公开条目45.4分，同时归一化拟合+预测时间低于Kumo-16约15%、低于完整LimiX约98%。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型在预测精度与推理时延之间存在不同权衡：Kumo类模型速度快但精度有上限，LimiX精度更高但开销大。作者希望验证"紧凑集成"能否同时改善两端——即在更短时间内获得更高精度，而非简单堆叠算力换取精度。
AI.method: 在两个表格基础模型上构建受限规模的异构集成：Kumo侧取4个估计器，LimiX侧取1条流水线，组成5成员混合集成（blend），而非扩大单一模型容量。评估在TabArena的816个数据划分上进行，采用Elo评分衡量相对精度，并用归一化拟合+预测时间衡量成本；此外通过分析两模型间的预测多样性（prediction diversity）来解释误差下降来源。
AI.result: 集成在816个TabArena划分上取得2063.8 Elo，比同一拟合条件下排名最高的已发表条目高45.4分；归一化拟合+预测时间比Kumo-16低15%，比完整LimiX低98%。分析显示，两模型之间更大的预测多样性有助于解释集成误差的降低。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的异构集成可在精度-时延帕累托前沿上取得优于单模型的折中，且优势主要来自模型间预测多样性而非模型数量；这为表格基础模型在实际部署中"降本增效"提供了可行路径，也提示后续工作可围绕多样性驱动的成员选择与配比设计展开。

title: FaceNet versus VGG Features in Wasserstein Distortion for Face Image Compression
summary: Wasserstein distortion (WD) compares local statistics of deep features and has been used to optimize learned image codecs for perceptual quality, but existing WD objectives rely on features from networks trained for generic image classification, such as VGG. We ask whether features from a face recognition network better reflect the perceived quality of compressed faces. In the Cool-Chic codec, we replace the VGG features in a WD-based objective with intermediate feature maps of FaceNet, and compare the two objectives on 20 LFW face images at a matched average bitrate of about 0.15 bits per pixel. In a preliminary pairwise human study, FaceNet-based reconstructions were preferred in 72.5% of judgments and by a majority of participants on 16 of the 20 images. These results suggest that the choice of feature network inside WD affects the perceived quality of face images, and that face recognition features are a promising direction for face-aware perceptual compression.

AI.tldr: 在Cool-Chic编解码器中用FaceNet中间特征替换Wasserstein失真(WD)目标里的VGG特征，在约0.15 bpp等码率下对20张LFW人脸图像比较两种目标。初步成对主观实验中，FaceNet重建在72.5%的判断中被偏好，20张图中16张获得多数参与者偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有WD感知目标依赖通用图像分类网络（如VGG）特征，未必能反映压缩人脸的感知质量；作者探究人脸识别网络特征是否更贴合人脸图像的主观质量评价。
AI.method: 以Cool-Chic学习式编解码器为平台，将WD目标中的VGG特征替换为FaceNet的中间特征图，构建两种对比目标；在LFW 20张人脸图像上、匹配平均码率约0.15 bpp条件下训练并比较；开展初步成对主观实验进行偏好统计。
AI.result: 成对主观判断中FaceNet方案被偏好比例达72.5%；20张图像中有16张的多数参与者偏好FaceNet重建。
AI.conclusion: WD中特征网络的选取会影响人脸图像的感知质量；人脸识别特征是人脸感知压缩的有前景方向。研究为初步规模，样本与主观测试规模有限。

title: Weight Scale Rebalancing: Transferable Training Recipes for Transformers
summary: Training Transformers requires careful hyperparameter tuning, which becomes increasingly costly for large models. We introduce UDV-Rebalance (UDVR), a reparameterization that inserts an auxiliary diagonal matrix $D$ between naturally paired weight matrices $(U,V)$ appearing throughout Transformer architectures. UDVR periodically rebalances the factors to maintain unit-norm columns in $U$ and unit-norm rows in $V$, with $D$ absorbing the corresponding scales. With rebalancing, a single hyperparameter setting of UDVR remains effective across model scales, architectures, and data distributions. This yields a tuning-free rule that adapts to each weight matrix using only its dimensions. We fit this rule once on ViT models trained on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, and it remains valid when the activation function or the optimizer is changed. The same rule transfers to new image domains in DomainNet, to ViT, Swin, and MaxViT on ImageNet, and to language-model pretraining with up to 1.3B parameters. UDVR consistently outperforms Weight Normalization and $σ$Reparam and matches a vanilla baseline whose hyperparameters are swept on each target model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 UDV-Rebalance（UDVR）重参数化方法，在 Transformer 中成对权重矩阵 (U,V) 之间插入辅助对角矩阵 D，并周期性重平衡因子，使超参数设置可跨规模、架构与数据分布迁移，实现免调参训练。
AI.motivation: 训练 Transformer 需要仔细调超参数，且随模型规模增大调参成本急剧上升。作者希望找到一种仅依赖权重矩阵维度的自适应规则，使单一超参数设置在不同模型规模、架构和数据分布下都有效，从而避免逐模型调参。
AI.method: UDVR 在 Transformer 中层内自然成对的权重矩阵 (U,V) 之间插入辅助对角矩阵 D，构成 UDV 分解。训练中周期性重平衡各因子：将 U 的列归一化为单位范数、V 的行归一化为单位范数，将对应尺度吸收进 D。归一化后的因子与尺度解耦，使得可依据矩阵维度推导出一条免调参规则（在 ViT + CIFAR-10/100 上拟合一次）。
AI.result: 在激活函数或优化器改变时规则依然有效；同一规则迁移至 DomainNet 的新图像域、ImageNet 上的 ViT/Swin/MaxViT，以及最高 1.3B 参数的语言模型预训练。UDVR 稳定优于 Weight Normalization 与 σReparam，并与在每个目标模型上单独扫描超参数的 vanilla baseline 相当。
AI.conclusion: UDVR 通过周期重平衡实现尺度与方向的解耦，给出了一条仅依赖矩阵维度的免调参初始化/缩放规则，具备跨规模、跨架构、跨数据分布与跨模态的迁移能力，是一种实用且鲁棒的重参数化方案。

title: Relation Before Action: Explicit Relation Modeling for Latent Action Pretraining
summary: Learning latent actions from unlabeled video sequences offers a promising way to acquire reusable action representations without relying on embodiment-specific control annotations. However, existing latent-action pretraining approaches commonly couple the modeling of visual transitions with action inference, directly mapping paired observations or derived transition cues into latent action codes. This formulation leaves two distinct tasks entangled: characterizing the relational structure of an observed transition and abstracting it into a compact action representation. We propose RELACT, a relation-first framework that explicitly separates transition relation modeling from predictive action abstraction. RELACT first constructs a structured relation representation $R$ that captures how visual elements and their interactions evolve across observations. It then infers a compact, state-conditioned stochastic latent action $U$, whose predictive effects are learned through action-conditioned latent dynamics. The resulting action representation can be grounded in native control spaces for model-based planning or used to supervise downstream embodied policies. Extensive experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain image-goal navigation, goal-conditioned manipulation, and downstream policy adaptation demonstrate improved predictive action representations and consistent gains in planning and control, supporting the effectiveness and generality of relation-first latent action pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出RELACT，将视觉过渡关系建模与潜动作抽象解耦的“关系优先”潜动作预训练框架，在导航、操作与策略适配任务上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有潜动作预训练把“刻画观测过渡的关系结构”与“将其抽象为紧凑动作表示”两个不同任务纠缠在一起，直接将成对观测或过渡线索映射为潜动作码，限制表示质量与可复用性。
AI.method: RELACT分两步：先用结构化关系表示R刻画视觉元素及其交互如何在观测间演化；再据R推断状态条件化的紧凑随机潜动作U，并通过动作条件化潜动力学学习其预测效果；所得动作表示可对齐到原生控制空间用于基于模型的规划，或监督下游具身策略。
AI.result: 在域内/域外图像目标导航、目标条件操作及下游策略适配等大量实验中，预测性动作表示质量提升，规划与控制性能一致改善。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离关系建模与动作抽象的关系优先预训练能获得更有效、更通用的潜动作表示，支持规划与控制，验证了该范式的有效性与泛化性。

title: MXFP4 for LLM Inference: Complementary Post-Training Quantization Techniques and Their Interactions
summary: Recent advances in low-precision representation have introduced several microscaling numerical formats for LLM quantization. By sharing a scale factor across groups of 16 or 32 elements, these formats enable aggressive low-precision quantization with minimal accuracy degradation, particularly when combined with modern PTQ algorithms. Their accuracy depends on how the numerical format interacts with rotation, PTQ, and scale selection. We study the composability of PTQ configurations across six LLMs and three microscaling formats: MXFP6, MXFP4, and NVFP4, systematically varying Hadamard rotation granularity, PTQ algorithm, and scale-selection strategy. Our central finding is that effective quantization recipes are format dependent: both MXFP4 and NVFP4 support accurate 4-bit inference, but techniques that benefit one do not necessarily transfer to the other. MXFP4 benefits substantially from rotation and error-correcting PTQ, whereas NVFP4 gains less from rotation, consistent with its finer-grained scales capturing more within-block variation. Building on these findings, we introduce Midmax, a calibration-free scale-selection strategy that mitigates clipping error in power-of-two block scales and improves accuracy across a majority of the evaluated MXFP4 configurations. We show that pairing MXFP6 activations with MXFP4 weights recovers most of the accuracy lost at 4-bit and, on Llama-3.1-8B, matches or exceeds our in-house BF16 baseline. An additional study finds that augmenting MXFP4 with a per-tensor macroscale, a mechanism intrinsic to NVFP4, does not improve average accuracy, suggesting that global rescaling alone does not address the limitations of E8M0 block scales for MXFP4 quantization. Together, these results provide practical guidance for combining numerical formats, rotation, PTQ, and scale selection for accurate low-precision LLM inference.

AI.tldr: 论文系统研究了MXFP6、MXFP4、NVFP4三种microscaling格式与Hadamard旋转、PTQ算法、scale选择策略的可组合性，发现有效量化配方依赖具体格式，并提出免校准的Midmax尺度选择策略。
AI.motivation: microscaling格式通过16/32元素共享scale实现激进低精度量化，但其精度取决于数值格式与旋转、PTQ、scale选择的交互作用，现有工作缺乏对多格式、多配置组合的系统性理解，难以给出可迁移的量化配方。
AI.method: 在6个LLM和3种格式（MXFP6、MXFP4、NVFP4）上系统变化Hadamard旋转粒度、PTQ算法与scale选择策略进行组合实验；提出免校准的Midmax尺度选择策略以缓解2的幂块尺度下的截断误差；并开展MXFP6激活+MXFP4权重混合精度实验，以及为MXFP4增加per-tensor macroscale的消融研究。
AI.result: 量化配方具有格式依赖性：MXFP4显著受益于旋转与纠错型PTQ，NVFP4因更细粒度scale对旋转收益较小；Midmax在多数MXFP4配置下提升精度；MXFP6激活+MXFP4权重可挽回4-bit大部分精度损失，在Llama-3.1-8B上达到或超过BF16基线；per-tensor macroscale对MXFP4平均精度无提升。
AI.conclusion: 不同microscaling格式需匹配不同的旋转、PTQ与尺度选择组合，技术不可直接迁移；全局重缩放无法弥补E8M0块尺度的局限；研究为低精度LLM推理的格式—算法协同设计提供了实用指导。

title: Relational Bottleneck Models
summary: Achieving both interpretable and high-performance inference is a key challenge in deep learning. While Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide inherent interpretability, they are constrained by task-specific training and rely on isolated visual concepts that fail to capture higher-order visual semantic relationships. Conversely, Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate zero-shot capabilities through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, standard CoT lacks a strict causal dependency between the generated rationale and the final output, compromising faithfulness. To bridge this gap, we propose Relational Bottleneck Models (RBMs), a novel training-free framework that transforms any off-the-shelf LVLMs into inherently interpretable models in a plug-and-play manner. RBMs consist of two stages: (i) Structured Rationale Generation (SRG), which explicitly models semantic interactions between visual concepts as subject-predicate-object triplets, and (ii) Rationale-Grounded Decoding (RGD), which enforces a strict causal dependency between the rationales and the final output. RGD aggregates rationale-conditional next-token distributions via an importance-weighted product-of-experts strategy, strictly excluding the image inputs from the decoding context. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across diverse benchmarks and LVLM backbones demonstrate that RBMs achieve superior interpretability while improving task performance over CBM baselines, entirely without task-specific fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的Relational Bottleneck Models (RBMs)，将现成LVLM转化为可解释模型，通过结构化三元组理据生成与理据因果解码，在零样本下兼顾可解释性与性能。
AI.motivation: CBMs虽具内在可解释性，但依赖任务特定训练，且使用孤立视觉概念、无法刻画高阶视觉语义关系；LVLM的Chain-of-Thought虽具零样本能力，但推理链与最终输出间缺乏严格因果依赖，忠实性不足。
AI.method: RBMs为即插即用的免训练框架，分两阶段：(i) Structured Rationale Generation (SRG)，以主谓宾三元组显式建模视觉概念间语义交互；(ii) Rationale-Grounded Decoding (RGD)，将图像输入严格排除在解码上下文之外，通过重要性加权product-of-experts聚合以理据为条件的下一词分布，从而强制理据与输出间的因果依赖。
AI.result: 在多个基准与多种LVLM骨干上的广泛零样本评测表明，RBMs在完全不进行任务特定微调的情况下，可解释性优于CBM基线，同时任务性能亦有提升。
AI.conclusion: RBMs以关系瓶颈替代孤立概念瓶颈，并将理据解码与图像输入解耦，为无需训练的忠实可解释推理提供了可行范式。

title: Shared information governs multi-view planted matching
comment: 139 pages, 4 figures. Ancillary files contain the scripts and tables for the computer-assisted proofs
summary: We study when the rows of $K$ shuffled views of the same $n$ objects can be matched, where each object is observed once in every view through a Gaussian feature vector with known covariance. For every fixed $K$, all views can be matched up to $o(n)$ errors if the shared information $J$ of one object's $K$ observations exceeds $(1+ε)\log n$, and not if it is below $(1-ε)\log n$; this can hold although no two views can be matched on their own. Below the threshold, two views can still be matched if some set of views containing both has shared information above $\log n$; otherwise every estimator, even one that reads all views, has vanishing overlap between them. Matching every row is governed by the weakest bipartition of the views: with weak correlations the threshold is $2\log n$ for the mutual information across it. For a weak common signal observed through independent noise, the two thresholds are $4/K$ and $4/(K-1)$ in units of $\sum_\ellρ_\ell^2/\log n$, which answers a question of Wee, Yang, Fan and Mao. Beyond weak correlations the bipartition condition is not sufficient: rare subpopulations impose a Rényi condition for every partition into at least three blocks. We conjecture that the two conditions together characterize exact recovery for Gaussian laws, and prove this for three views with equal correlations and in several further cases, in part with computer assistance. With equal correlations, layered screening attains $4/K$ for $K=3,4$ in $O(Kn^2d)$ operations, and for general laws a recursive decoder attains $J$. The almost-exact thresholds extend to known product laws and to objects observed in random subsets of the views.

AI.tldr: 研究K个打乱视图的行匹配问题：精确匹配阈值由共享信息J与logn的比较决定（(1±ε)logn相变），全行可匹配由最弱二部割决定；弱相关下阈值为2logn，并给出4/K与4/(K-1)的相变，回答Wee等的问题；进一步提出一般情形需二部条件加Rényi条件的猜想，并给出算法达到阈值。
AI.motivation: 多视图数据（同一批对象在多个打乱视图中的观测）行匹配是数据整合中的核心问题。已有工作多关注两视图匹配，缺少对K≥3、视图间可能都无法单独匹配时"何时能被恢复"的定量刻画，尤其是精确到常数的阈值、可计算的多项式算法，以及Wee、Yang、Fan、Mao所提公开问题的解答。
AI.method: 模型为每个对象在K个视图中各观测一次，特征向量为已知协方差的高斯向量。作者以单个对象K次观测的共享信息J（互信息）为主阈值参数，分析K固定时n→∞的相变；引入视图的"二部割"（bipartition）刻画最弱连接，用二部割上的互信息阈值2logn给出全匹配条件；弱公共信号经独立噪声观测时，以Σρ_ℓ²/logn为单位给出4/K与4/(K-1)两个阈值；对非弱相关情形，指出存在稀有子群体，需对每个至少三块的划分加Rényi条件，并证明三个视图等相关等若干情形；算法上提出"分层筛选"（layered screening）与递归解码器。
AI.result: 对每个固定K，当J>(1+ε)logn时所有视图可在o(n)错误内匹配，J<(1−ε)logn时不可能，且此现象可在任意两视图单独不可匹配时成立。低于阈值时，若存在包含某两视图的视图子集其共享信息超过logn，则这两视图仍可匹配；否则任何估计器（即使读取全部视图）在这两视图间重叠率趋零。全行匹配由最弱二部割支配，弱相关下阈值为2logn。弱公共信号独立噪声模型下两阈值为Σρ_ℓ²/logn的4/K与4/(K-1)，回答了Wee等的提问。等相关情形下分层筛选以O(Kn²d)运算达到4/K（K=3,4），一般分布下递归解码器达到J。近精确阈值可推广到已知乘积分布与对象仅在随机视图子集中出现的情形。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出多视图行匹配的尖锐相变理论：主阈值为共享信息J的(1±ε)logn，整体可恢复性由最弱二部割的2logn控制，弱相关下的常数阈值4/K与4/(K−1)解答了公开问题。非弱相关时二部条件不充分，作者猜想二部条件与对所有≥3块划分的Rényi条件共同刻画高斯律下的精确恢复，并在三视图等相关及若干其他情形（部分借助计算机）证明之；同时提供达到阈值的多项式时间算法，并可扩展到乘积分布与随机视图子集等设定。

title: ST-SfM: Spatio-Temporal Structure-from-Motion for Initialising 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Dynamic Gaussian splatting is usually initialised either with random points or with a structure-from-motion (SfM) cloud of the first frame. Neither says anything about what moves, where and when. We introduce ST-SfM, a sparse spatio-temporal SfM for synchronised, calibrated multi-camera video that splits the scene into two branches. Static structure is detected once per camera on a temporal-median image, gated for temporal stability and matched along epi-polar lines. Motion is detected as space-time interest points (STIPs) in the video volume, described with HOG3D and matched only between candidates that agree both epipolarly and in time. Union-find tracks that refuse inconsistent merges are triangulated with RANSAC over all view pairs, giving static 3D points and dynamic 4D points (x, y, z, t) with sub-frame times. We use ST-SfM derived sparse 4D cloud to initialise 4D Gaussian splatting. In comparison with random initialisation on N3DV scenes we get improvements in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS.

AI.tldr: 提出ST-SfM：面向同步标定多相机视频的稀疏时空SfM，通过静态分支与动态分支（STIP+HOG3D+时空-极线一致匹配）生成静态3D点与带亚帧时间的动态4D点，用于初始化4D高斯泼溅。
AI.motivation: 动态高斯泼溅通常用随机点或首帧SfM点云初始化，二者都不包含"什么在动、在哪动、何时动"的信息，导致初始化缺乏运动先验。
AI.method: 将场景分为两支：静态结构在每相机的时间中值图像上检测一次，经时间稳定性门控并沿极线匹配；运动在视频体中以STIP检测，用HOG3D描述，仅在同时满足极线与时间一致的候选间匹配；用拒绝不一致合并的并查集维护轨迹，并对所有视角对做RANSAC三角化，得到静态3D点与含亚帧时间的动态4D点(x,y,z,t)。该稀疏4D点云用于初始化4D高斯泼溅。
AI.result: 在N3DV场景上，相比随机初始化，PSNR、SSIM与LPIPS均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 用带时空语义的稀疏4D点云替代随机/首帧初始化，可为动态高斯泼溅提供有效运动先验并改善重建质量；摘要未给出量化数值与消融细节。

title: Polynomial-Time Learning of Random Automata from One Label per Word
comment: 74 pages. Lean sources for selected proof steps: https://github.com/Yilin-Cheng23/random-automata-lean
summary:
We study a binary deterministic finite automaton whose $2n$ transitions are chosen independently and uniformly from its $n$ states. The learner observes independent uniform words of length $m$, each labeled with a single bit indicating acceptance. For every fixed $β>0$ we give a polynomial-time algorithm that works outside a set of transition tables of probability $o(n^{-β})$. On each remaining table, for any start state and accepting set, the predictor has error at most $ε$ on fresh uniform words of length $m$ with probability at least $1-γ$ over the training sample and the learner's random choices. Its sample size and running time are polynomial in $n$, $m$, $1/ε$ and $\log(2/γ)$, with degree depending only on $β$. Although each word reveals only one output, comparing label moments at two consecutive history lengths lets us estimate the expected product of the signed outputs of two continuations from the same hidden state.
  We also refute Conjecture 4 of Fish and Reyzin on meeting times. For two distinct states fixed before the table is drawn and every fixed $c>0$, the fraction of words of length $\lfloor cn\rfloor$ that send them to different states converges in probability to $e^{-c}$. On a typical table, driving this fraction down to $1/n$ takes asymptotically $n\log n$ letters. Selected proof steps are formalized in Lean.

AI.tldr: 研究随机二元确定性有限自动机的分布无关学习问题，给出多项式时间算法（在极大概率下有效），并反驳了Fish–Reyzin关于会合时间的猜想4。
AI.motivation: 作者关注随机DFA上的学习问题：转移表随机、样本为带单比特接受标签的均匀随机词，每个样本只暴露一个输出。目标是设计高效算法，在绝大多数转移表上实现低误差预测，同时检验并纠正Fish和Reyzin提出的关于会合时间（meeting time）的猜想。
AI.method: 1）学习算法：对任意固定β>0，构造多项式时间算法，在概率为1−o(n^{−β})的转移表之外均有效；样本量和运行时间为n、m、1/ε、log(2/γ)的多项式，次数仅依赖β。关键技术是“矩比较”：比较两个连续历史长度上的标签矩，从而估计同一隐藏状态下两个延续的带符号输出乘积的期望，尽管每个词只给出一个输出。2）会合时间部分：对转移表抽取前固定的两个不同状态，证明长度为⌊cn⌋的词将其送到不同状态的比例依概率收敛到e^{−c}；在典型表上，使该比例降至1/n需渐近n·log n个字母。部分证明步骤在Lean中形式化。
AI.result: 学习：对除概率o(n^{−β})的转移表以外的所有表，任意起始状态与接受集，在新鲜均匀长度m词上错误率至多ε，成功概率至少1−γ（对训练样本与算法随机性）。会合时间：对每个固定c>0，长度⌊cn⌋词使两状态分离的比例依概率收敛到e^{−c}，从而反驳Fish–Reyzin猜想4；典型表上把该比例压到1/n需渐近n log n步。
AI.conclusion: 论文在随机DFA上建立了高效、接近分布无关的可学习性结果，核心工具是两个历史长度上的标签矩比较；同时给出会合时间的精确渐近刻画，推翻Fish–Reyzin猜想4，并通过Lean形式化验证了部分关键证明步骤，提升了结果的可信度。

title: MYSTIQUE: Few-Shot Facial Identity Transfer with Performance Preservation
summary: In visual effects, identity transfer replaces the identity in a driving image with that of a target person, while preserving the expression, lighting, pose and scene of that image. Paired ground truth is rarely available, so many methods are trained by self-reconstruction, where the model can learn a shortcut by copying identity cues from the driving image. This shortcut causes identity leakage at inference, where the driving image shows a different person. Our key observation is that leakage can enter through any input that reads the driving image. We therefore present MYSTIQUE, a diffusion-based identity transfer method that takes identity from a set of the target's photos and reads expression, lighting and scene through separate streams. It learns to disentangle identity from the other streams through multi-stage training, with disentanglement strategies at their inputs: a random block mask whose boundaries do not follow the face outline, self-augmentation, which randomly changes the face shape in the expression input and keeps its expression, and face randomization, which replaces the person in the expression and lighting inputs while the ground truth stays the driving image. At inference, we also warp the lighting input onto the face shape of a first pass, which reduces face-shape leakage through the lighting stream. Since face-recognition scores and human judgments each have limits, we evaluate identity with both, together with face-shape metrics on rendered faces of known shape. In a user study, raters judge MYSTIQUE's results more like the target than those of each compared method. Among these methods, MYSTIQUE also recovers the target's face shape most accurately, and its recognition score gains the most as more photos of the target are given.

AI.tldr: MYSTIQUE：基于扩散模型的身份迁移方法，通过多阶段训练与多输入流解耦身份，抑制自重建带来的身份泄漏，实现更准确的换脸身份迁移。
AI.motivation: 视觉特效中的身份迁移需保留驱动图像的表情、光照、姿态与场景，但成对真值稀缺，自重建训练会导致模型从驱动图像"抄"身份线索，推理时出现身份泄漏。
AI.method: 核心观察：泄漏可经由任何读取驱动图像的输入通道进入。据此将身份来源（目标人物的多张照片）与表情、光照、场景分开为独立输入流，并用多阶段训练解耦；在各输入上施加解耦策略：随机块掩码（边界不贴合人脸轮廓）、自增强（随机改变表情输入的人脸形状但保留表情）、人脸随机化（替换表情与光照输入中的人物，真值仍为驱动图像）；推理时还将光照输入扭曲到首轮结果的人脸形状上，以减少经光照流的形状泄漏。
AI.result: 用户研究中，受试者认为 MYSTIQUE 结果比各对比方法更接近目标人物；在已知形状的渲染人脸上，其恢复目标人脸形状最准确；随目标照片数量增加，其识别分数提升幅度最大。评估同时采用人脸识别分数与人工判断，并辅以人脸形状指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过在多输入流层面切断身份泄漏路径，可在无配对真值的自重建训练下实现有效的身份解耦与迁移，且在身份相似度、形状还原与多照片扩展性上均优于对比方法。

title: Eliciting the Recall Capacity of Linear Attention
summary: Linear attention models exhibit a disproportionate deficit relative to softmax attention in associative recall (AR) in language modeling. We investigate this gap through natural language evaluations, synthetic recall tasks, and targeted training interventions. Using a synthetic setting, we quantify the role of state-size in how many items can be recalled from memory and find a similar empirical scaling across the tested linear-attention architectures. Testing this relationship reveals that even a single layer at scale can learn to retrieve thousands of associations across long distances. Yet, standard language model training does not reliably teach a linear model to copy from context, whereas a comparable softmax model learns to do so. Considering this, we strengthen recall supervision during training through in-context sentence repetition and context-sensitive loss reweighting. Both methods improve recall-intensive benchmark performance and narrow the long-distance AR gap to the softmax baseline without changing the architecture, token budget, or number of optimization steps, at a slight cost to general language modeling. These targeted changes to training can thus elicit substantial but underutilized retrieval capacity in linear-attention models. These findings suggest that, although linear-attention architectures have substantial capacity for recall, their inductive biases and the demands of language model training make it difficult to develop this capability without dedicated incentives.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究线性注意力在联想回忆（AR）上相对softmax注意力的差距，发现该差距主要源于训练激励不足而非架构容量限制，通过在训练中加强回忆监督（上下文句子重复、上下文敏感损失重加权）可在不改架构下缩小长距离AR差距。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力模型在语言建模的联想回忆任务上表现显著弱于softmax注意力。作者希望厘清这一差距是源于架构容量不足，还是源于训练过程中的归纳偏置与优化激励问题。
AI.method: 采用三类手段：(1) 自然语言评测；(2) 合成回忆任务，量化状态维度（state size）对可回忆条目数的影响，并在多种线性注意力架构上比较经验缩放规律；(3) 针对性训练干预——上下文句子重复（in-context sentence repetition）与上下文敏感损失重加权（context-sensitive loss reweighting），在固定架构、token预算与优化步数的条件下增强回忆监督。
AI.result: 合成实验表明不同线性注意力架构呈现相似的随状态维度的经验缩放规律；即使单层大模型也能跨长距离检索数千个关联。但标准语言模型训练无法可靠教会线性模型从上下文复制，而同等softmax模型可以。两种训练干预均提升了回忆密集型基准性能，并将长距离AR差距缩小至softmax基线水平，仅以轻微通用语言建模性能损失为代价。
AI.conclusion: 线性注意力架构本身具备可观的、未被充分利用的回忆容量；但由于其归纳偏置与语言模型训练目标的需求，缺乏专门激励时难以发展出该能力。因此通过针对性的训练手段可有效激发这部分潜在检索能力。

title: Can You Find the Edit When Nothing Looks Wrong? A Paired Benchmark for Text-Driven Image Manipulation Localization Beyond Semantic Abnormality
summary: Instruction-driven image editing can alter a photograph while keeping the result coherent with the scene. Existing benchmarks lack matched plausible and anomalous edits of the same target, making it difficult to measure how localization performance changes with semantic plausibility. We construct a paired benchmark by generating semantically plausible and anomalous replacements of the same target in each source photograph. Both edits use the same editor, language, and generation settings. We estimate a separate mask for each output and retain pairs with sufficient mask overlap, enabling direct comparison of localization performance under the two semantic conditions. The release contains 47,747 bilingual triplets from 6,500 photographs, spanning four editors, three source domains, and six intended violation types. Across nine public localizers, editor-averaged IoU is lower on plausible edits in 26 of 27 model-dataset comparisons. This gap persists under pixel-change controls and region-size analyses. These findings reveal a semantic-plausibility shortcut: localization often weakens when an edited result looks ordinary. The benchmark provides a controlled setting for measuring this gap and developing localizers that remain effective on plausible edits.

AI.tldr: 该文构建了配对式指令驱动图像编辑基准（同一目标分别生成语义合理与异常替换，控制编辑器/语言/生成设置），含6,500张源图的47,747个双语三元组；在9个公开定位器上发现"语义合理性捷径"——合理编辑的定位IoU在27组模型-数据集对比中有26组更低。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏对同一目标的"合理编辑"与"异常编辑"的配对样本，因而无法衡量定位性能如何随语义合理性变化，也难以判断定位器是否依赖编辑痕迹而非语义异常线索。
AI.method: 为每张源图对同一目标分别生成语义合理与语义异常的替换，两者使用同一编辑器、同一语言与相同生成设置；对每个输出单独估计掩码，并仅保留掩码重叠充足的配对，从而在两种语义条件下直接比较定位性能。发布数据覆盖4种编辑器、3个源域、6类目标违规类型，共6,500张照片、47,747个双语三元组。
AI.result: 在9个公开定位器、27组模型-数据集对比中，有26组在语义合理编辑上的编辑器平均IoU更低；该差距在像素变化控制与区域尺寸分析下依然稳健。
AI.conclusion: 定位性能受语义合理性显著影响，存在"语义合理性捷径"：当编辑结果外观平常时定位往往减弱。该基准为量化此差距、并研发在合理编辑上仍有效的定位器提供了受控实验条件。

title: File Size as a Potential Dataset Bias in Audio-Visual Deepfake Data
comment: Accepted in WACV Workshop 2027 (Workshop Synthetic Realities and Data in Biometric Analysis and Security (SynRDinBAS))
summary: Deepfake detection benchmarks are commonly designed to evaluate whether models can distinguish authentic from manipulated audiovisual content. However, benchmark construction pipelines may introduce unintended associations between class labels and simple file-level properties. In this work, we identify a potential file-size bias in two widely used audio-visual deepfake datasets. In the 1M-Deepfakes Detection Challenge dataset, a score derived from file size alone achieves 70.13% AUC on the validation set. When file size is considered together with video duration, simple file-level methods exceed 90% AUC on 1M and 85% AUC on FakeAVCeleb. Although the same pattern is not observed in DFDC, the results suggest that the observed association is dataset-dependent rather than an inherent property of deepfake videos. We discuss several possible explanations, including differences in encoding, compression, source data, manipulation procedures, and post-processing, although the present analysis does not establish the underlying cause. We further discuss whether the factors associated with file size may also leave traces in decoded video or audio, and consequently whether they could influence content-based deepfake detection, as an important direction for future work. Our findings highlight the importance of examining simple file-level properties when constructing and evaluating deepfake datasets and benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文发现两个常用音视频深度伪造数据集中存在文件大小偏差：仅用文件大小导出的评分在1M-Deepfakes验证集可达70.13% AUC，结合时长后1M超过90%、FakeAVCeleb超过85% AUC，而DFDC中未观察到该现象，说明该关联是数据集依赖的。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造检测基准通常假设模型依赖内容层面的真伪线索，但基准构建流程可能无意引入类别标签与简单文件级属性之间的虚假关联，从而高估模型能力、掩盖捷径学习问题。作者希望检验这类低层文件属性是否本身就具备判别力。
AI.method: 在两个广泛使用的音视频深度伪造数据集（1M-Deepfakes Detection Challenge、FakeAVCeleb）以及对照数据集DFDC上进行统计分析：构造仅基于文件大小的评分，再构造文件大小与视频时长的联合简单文件级判别方法，以AUC衡量其区分真伪的能力；并对编码、压缩、源数据、篡改流程与后处理等因素作定性讨论。
AI.result: 仅文件大小评分在1M-Deepfakes验证集取得70.13% AUC；文件大小结合时长后，简单文件级方法在1M上超过90% AUC、在FakeAVCeleb上超过85% AUC；DFDC中未出现同样模式。作者强调当前分析未确立因果机制。
AI.conclusion: 文件级属性偏差是数据集依赖的而非深度伪造视频的固有特性；构建与评估深度伪造数据集和基准时应系统检查简单文件级属性，并进一步研究这些因素是否在解码后的视频或音频中留下痕迹、进而影响基于内容的检测，这是重要的未来方向。

title: CaveBench: Benchmarking Abductive Physical Reasoning from Internal Observations
comment: 50 pages, 47 figures, 13 tables, including the appendix. Guanxin Lin and Chen Yang contributed equally. Chen Wang is the corresponding author. Project page: https://pier-lab.github.io/CaveBench/
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are advancing in physical reasoning, but whether they can understand external physical drivers from internal observations remains an open question. Existing benchmarks have not specifically targeted this setting. To this end, we introduce CaveBench, a benchmark for abductive physical reasoning from internal observations. Models receive apparatus descriptions and internal images while the external controls remain hidden, and must infer the operations responsible for the observed responses. CaveBench spans 20 apparatus scenes in five physical domains and contains 10,200 simulated episodes, split into 9,000 training, 1,000 validation, and 200 test episodes. Questions span one to six events and require the complete control set at every event, testing whether an explanation accounts for the entire process. Synchronized observations and control records provide the inputs and reference answers.
