Evaluating 27 VLM configurations yields six-event exact-match accuracies of 68.0% for the strongest closed-source model and 12.5% for the strongest open-weight model. Seven adaptation baselines show that single-event gains need not improve complete sequences. Error analysis identifies failures in visual identification, physical inference, evidence integration, and action composition, specifying where current models struggle to connect internal phenomena with their external causes.

AI.tldr: 提出 CaveBench 基准，用于考察 VLM 从装置内部观测反推外部操控的溯因物理推理能力，共 20 个装置场景、10,200 段仿真 episode；27 种 VLM 配置在六事件完整匹配上最高仅 68.0%（闭源）与 12.5%（开源），揭示视觉识别、物理推断、证据整合与动作组合的系统性短板。
AI.motivation: VLM 在物理推理上已有进展，但能否从"内部观测"反推"外部物理驱动因素"尚属空白，且现有基准未针对该设定设计，因此需要专门基准来测量这一溯因推理能力。
AI.method: 构建 CaveBench：模型仅获得装置描述与内部图像，外部控制保持隐藏，需推断导致观测响应的操作。基准覆盖 5 个物理域、20 个装置场景，共 10,200 段仿真 episode（9,000 训练 / 1,000 验证 / 200 测试）；题目涵盖 1–6 个事件，每个事件均需给出完整控制集合，以检验解释是否覆盖全过程；同步的观测记录与控制记录分别作为输入与参考答案。评测 27 种 VLM 配置并对比 7 种适配基线（微调/提示等）。
AI.result: 六事件的 exact-match 准确率：最强闭源模型 68.0%，最强开源权重模型 12.5%。七种适配基线显示，单事件上的增益并不必然迁移到完整序列。错误分析将失败归为四类：视觉识别、物理推断、证据整合、动作组合。
AI.conclusion: 当前 VLM 在"由内及外"的溯因物理推理上仍显著不足，尤其难以在长事件序列上保持解释的完整性；单事件能力提升不等于序列级能力提升，需针对视觉识别、物理推断、证据整合与动作组合四环节分别改进。

title: AVQ-Attention-2: Adaptive Vector-Quantized Attention with Exact Local Blocks and Linear-Cost Training
summary: Attention costs $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ in the number of tokens. Vector-quantized attention reduces this to $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ by clustering the $N$ keys, attending to the $M$ codewords instead, and its adaptive form, AVQ-attention, concentrates codebook resolution where a query's attention mass actually falls. We present AVQ-Attention-2, a better design that merges it with exact local attention and attends to the mean of each cluster's keys rather than to a codeword. We show three improvements: consistently better quality at comparable cost; training that now also costs $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ rather than $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$; and an approximation accurate enough that the layer can be dropped into a pretrained transformer without fine-tuning. Across a variety of sequence lengths the result is competitive not merely with other approximate attention but with exact dense attention, running faster than FlashAttention at little to no loss in quality.

AI.tldr: AVQ-Attention-2 将向量量化注意力与精确局部注意力结合，并以簇内键的均值替代码字表示，实现训练与推理均为 O(NM) 复杂度，且无需微调即可替换预训练 Transformer 中的注意力层，质量可与精确稠密注意力竞争。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力复杂度为 O(N²)，向量量化注意力通过将 N 个键聚类为 M 个码字降为 O(NM)，其自适应版本 AVQ-attention 能将码本分辨率集中于查询注意力质量实际分布处。但仍存在质量、训练复杂度（原为 O(N²)）及近似精度不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出 AVQ-Attention-2：融合精确局部注意力与向量量化注意力，并将原来对码字的注意力改为对每个簇内键的均值进行注意力计算。
AI.result: 三项改进：(1) 在可比成本下质量一致更优；(2) 训练复杂度由 O(N²) 降为 O(NM)；(3) 近似精度足够高，可将该层直接替换进预训练 Transformer 而无需微调。在多种序列长度下不仅优于其他近似注意力，也可与精确稠密注意力竞争，且在几乎无质量损失下比 FlashAttention 更快。
AI.conclusion: AVQ-Attention-2 在保持 O(NM) 复杂度与高近似精度的同时达到与精确注意力相当的质量，是一种可直接部署于预训练模型的实用高效注意力方案。

title: StreamCoach: Proactive Sports Coaching via Continuous Visual Reasoning
summary: In fitness and sports training, timely action quality assessment (AQA) is essential for learners to identify and correct technical errors during movement execution. However, most AQA methods assess completed performances, limiting their ability to provide timely feedback. Streaming methods alleviate this latency, but limited reasoning hinders their use of subtle movement cues and sport-specific knowledge. Moreover, their fragmented feedback focuses on one body part at a time, overlooking movement details of other body parts and transitions between action phases. To address these limitations, we propose StreamCoach, a streaming AQA framework under the OnCueCoaching paradigm that couples continuous chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning with proactive, evidence-gated coaching. Technique-Aware Reasoning tracks body-part movements and action-phase transitions against sport-specific criteria, while Holistic Coaching integrates accumulated evidence to deliver timely, comprehensive feedback on strengths and technical errors. To support training and benchmarking, we construct EE4D-Stream from 1,213 sports video sequences in Ego-Exo4D through LLM-assisted reannotation and manual review of selected claims, pairing dense CoT annotations with evidence-gated speech content. Building on this dataset, we train StreamCoach using Temporal-Semantic Alignment Reinforcement Learning to jointly optimize feedback timing and content. We benchmark 11 offline and streaming baselines on EE4D-Stream, including three proprietary models. StreamCoach achieves state-of-the-art results across intervention timing, action assessment, and coaching quality, surpassing both GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5.

AI.tldr: 提出 StreamCoach 流式动作质量评估（AQA）框架，结合连续思维链推理与"证据门控"的主动教练反馈，并构建 EE4D-Stream 数据集，在最先进指标上超越闭源大模型。
AI.motivation: 现有 AQA 方法多针对已完成动作进行评估，反馈滞后；流式方法虽有低延迟优势，但推理能力有限，难以利用细微动作线索与专项运动知识，且反馈碎片化（一次只关注单一部位），忽略其他部位细节与动作阶段间的转换。
AI.method: 提出 OnCueCoaching 范式下的 StreamCoach 框架：1) Technique-Aware Reasoning 依据专项标准追踪身体部位运动与动作阶段转换；2) Holistic Coaching 汇聚累积证据，输出及时且全面的优点与技术错误反馈。数据方面，从 Ego-Exo4D 的 1,213 段体育视频经 LLM 辅助重标注与人工复核构建 EE4D-Stream，含密集 CoT 标注与证据门控语音内容。训练采用时序-语义对齐强化学习（Temporal-Semantic Alignment RL）联合优化反馈时机与内容。
AI.result: 在 EE4D-Stream 上与 11 个离线/流式基线（含 3 个闭源模型）对比，StreamCoach 在干预时机、动作评估与教练质量三项指标上均取得 SOTA，优于 GPT-6.1 Sol 与 Claude Opus 5.5。
AI.conclusion: 将连续思维链推理与主动、证据门控的教练反馈耦合，可有效解决流式 AQA 中推理不足与反馈碎片化的问题，实现及时、全面且具备专项知识的动作质量评估与指导。

title: On Potentiality and Actuality Of Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models are built through large-scale pretraining, often followed by post-training, and are then adapted to specific tasks and behaviors. But, does the adaptation add truly new capabilities, or the base model already holds it? We decompose the update induced by different adaptations into a component shared across all inputs and a residual that varies with the input. We find that the shared component suffices for most of the adaptation gain and can be learned directly: a shift adapter that learns a constant vector per layer, identical for every input, reproduces the behavior of LoRA and full fine-tuning. We call this the potentiality principle of foundation models: the base model already contains the capacity needed for task-specific expertise. To adapt to a new task, the model just needs to be actualized, i.e., pushed in a certain direction via a constant, input-independent shift. We show the implications of this principle on parameter-efficient adaptation, steering, and convergence across models, and how it explains the neural thickets phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"潜能原理"：基础模型已具备完成特定任务所需的能力，适配过程主要是通过一个与输入无关的常量偏移（逐层常量向量）对模型进行"现实化"，而该共享分量就足以复现LoRA与全量微调的大部分收益。
AI.motivation: 现有适配方法（如LoRA、全量微调）效果显著，但尚不清楚适配究竟带来了真正的新能力，还是仅仅激活了基座模型已有的能力。作者希望厘清适配增益的来源，并据此简化参数高效适配与模型引导。
AI.method: 将不同适配方法引起的参数更新分解为两部分：一个对所有输入共享的分量，以及一个随输入变化的残差。基于该分解，作者设计了一种"偏移适配器"（shift adapter）——为每一层学习一个对所有输入完全相同的常量向量，并检验其能否复现LoRA与全量微调的行为。
AI.result: 实验发现，共享分量即可解释适配增益的绝大部分，仅学习逐层常量向量的偏移适配器能够复现LoRA和全量微调的行为表现。
AI.conclusion: 由此提出基础模型的"潜能原理"：基座模型本就包含任务专长所需容量，适配只需沿特定方向以常量、与输入无关的偏移将其"现实化"。该原理对参数高效适配、模型引导（steering）、跨模型收敛具有启示，并可解释"神经灌木丛"（neural thickets）现象。

title: SofaSpace: A Benchmark for Executable Visual Spatial Reasoning in Continuous Motion and Environment Construction
summary: A rigid body can fit at its start and goal yet collide with a wall as it moves between them. Inspired by the moving sofa problem, we introduce SofaSpace, a benchmark for visual spatial reasoning through continuous planar rigid-body transport and environment construction. SofaSpace contains 3,000 scenes organized around three challenges: geometric compatibility, nonlocal maneuver planning, and interactive and temporal coordination. Four task views ask models to plan a motion, reconstruct a layout, design an environment that meets transport requirements, or jointly generate a layout and a motion. A separate set of 534 SofaSpace-Hard tasks tests planning and judgment. A geometric verifier checks the entire body throughout each submitted motion. On static planning tasks, endpoint agreement and continuous validity differ substantially within the same submitted plans: Claude drops from 97.2% to 52.8%, DeepSeek from 100.0% to 30.6%, and Kimi from 97.2% to 29.4%, while the strongest configuration retains 98.3% full validity. Environment construction reveals a further gap. Of 295 feasible layouts generated by the strongest configuration, 181 satisfy all evaluated functional requirements; for Kimi, one of 172 does. These results show how executable checks distinguish endpoint agreement from valid motion and geometric feasibility from functional compliance.

AI.tldr: 提出SofaSpace基准，通过连续平面刚体搬运与环境构建任务检验视觉空间推理，并用几何验证器全程校验，揭示模型"端点吻合"与"连续有效"之间的巨大差距。
AI.motivation: 刚体在起点和终点均可放置，却在两点之间的运动过程中与墙体碰撞——受"移动沙发问题"启发，现有视觉空间推理评测多以端点或最终布局为准，无法区分端点吻合与全程运动有效、几何可行与功能合规，故需构建可执行校验的基准。
AI.method: 构建SofaSpace基准，含3000个场景，围绕几何兼容性、非局部机动规划、交互与时间协调三类挑战；设四种任务视角：规划运动、重建布局、设计满足搬运要求的环境、联合生成布局与运动。另设534个SofaSpace-Hard任务测试规划与判断，并用几何验证器对每次提交运动做刚体全时段碰撞校验。
AI.result: 静态规划任务中，同一提交计划的端点一致率与连续有效率差异显著：Claude 97.2%→52.8%，DeepSeek 100.0%→30.6%，Kimi 97.2%→29.4%，最强配置保持98.3%完全有效。环境构建差距更大：最强配置生成295个可行布局中181个满足全部评估功能要求，Kimi 172个中仅1个。
AI.conclusion: 可执行校验能有效区分端点吻合与有效运动、几何可行与功能合规，表明当前模型在连续空间推理与功能约束满足上仍存在显著短板。

title: LEGOSpec: A Composable and Efficient Framework for Speculative Draft Design and Training
comment: 11 pages. Code and weights are available at the URL in the paper
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) generation using a lightweight draft. Existing methods evaluate complete recipes under different training configurations, leaving component effects, interactions, and composition benefits unclear. Therefore, we present LEGOSpec, a composable framework for speculative draft design and training. LEGOSpec decomposes draft models into Context, Backbone, Proposal, and Objective components that share a unified training infrastructure. Using LEGOSpec, we systematically vary components and evaluate selected combinations under matched training conditions to isolate their effects and interactions. These experiments reveal three findings: (1) Different workloads favor different backbones, depending on context length and memory budget, with within-block dependency modeling particularly important for long contexts. (2) Proposal design must balance acceptance and latency. (3) The training objective should match token distributions locally and optimize acceptance length across the block. These findings guide workload-aware configurations and DFlux, a balanced general-purpose draft combining a convolution-equipped SWA--GQA hybrid backbone, Residual Corrector, and hierarchical supervision. Across Qwen and Gemma models, DFlux improves acceptance length over the strongest baseline by up to 13.7% on regular benchmarks and 34.7% on long-context workloads. To support efficient training, LEGOSpec integrates metadata-aware scheduling and asynchronous execution, increasing training throughput by up to 79% and accelerating offline supervision preparation by up to $3.11\times$ over SpecForge.

AI.tldr: LEGOSpec将投机解码草稿模型分解为Context、Backbone、Proposal、Objective四组件并统一训练，系统性实验揭示三者规律，据此提出DFlux，接受长度提升13.7%（常规）/34.7%（长上下文），训练吞吐提升79%。
AI.motivation: 现有投机解码方法多在不同训练配置下评估完整方案，导致各组件单独效应、组件间交互以及组合收益不清晰，缺乏可复用的设计指导。
AI.method: 提出可组合框架LEGOSpec：把草稿模型拆为Context、Backbone、Proposal、Objective四个组件，共享统一训练基础设施；在匹配训练条件下系统变化组件并评估选定组合以隔离效应与交互；并集成元数据感知调度与异步执行加速训练。基于结论设计DFlux（卷积增强SWA-GQA混合骨干 + Residual Corrector + 分层监督）。
AI.result: 三项发现：(1)不同工作负载偏好不同骨干，取决于上下文长度与内存预算，块内依赖建模对长上下文尤为关键；(2)Proposal设计需在接受率与延迟间权衡；(3)训练目标应局部匹配token分布并在块级别优化接受长度。DFlux在Qwen与Gemma上接受长度较最强基线最高提升13.7%（常规基准）与34.7%（长上下文）；训练吞吐最高提升79%，离线监督准备较SpecForge加速至多3.11倍。
AI.conclusion: 组件化解耦+匹配条件下对照评估可有效揭示投机解码草稿的设计规律，并支撑工作负载感知配置与通用均衡方案DFlux；LEGOSpec兼具性能与训练效率优势。

title: $ε$-Seg++: Ensembling Across Hierarchy and Training Time for Label-Efficient EM Segmentation
comment: 23 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables. Edoardo Giacomello and Sheida Rahnamai Kordasiabi contributed equally and are listed in alphabetical order
summary: Semantic segmentation of electron microscopy (EM) volumes is a central step in quantitative cell biology, but dense voxel-wise annotation is prohibitively expensive. $ε$-Seg showed that a hierarchical variational autoencoder trained on sparsely annotated voxels can yield competitive segmentations, but it classifies from its topmost latent level only and operates exclusively on 2D patches. We introduce $ε$-Seg++, which places a semantic expert at every level of the hierarchy and consolidates their predictions with a parameter-free product of experts. We further enable 3D inputs through a leakage-free sub-volume splitting protocol, which allows 2D and 3D models to be compared under identical sparse supervision. Because validation labels are just as scarce as training labels, we treat checkpoint selection as part of the method and average the top-ranked checkpoints, a second ensemble, this time across training time. On the BetaSeg FIB-SEM dataset, the multi-level experts improve 2D mean Dice by about 0.1 at 2,500 training labels. With up to 600 training labels, the 2D model matches or exceeds 3D $ε$-Seg at about one eleventh of its prediction cost. Above roughly a thousand labels, 3D inputs dominate, and at matched annotation cost 3D $ε$-Seg++ reaches a mean Dice of 0.905 versus 0.880 for D3PM, while predicting between 5.4 and 27 times faster (with our checkpoint ensemble or a single model, respectively). Checkpoint ensembling matches single-best selection on average and markedly improves the worst case when the validation set is small.

AI.tldr: ε-Seg++ 在层级 VAE 的每一层设置专家并用无参专家乘积融合，配合无泄漏子体积切分支持 3D 输入、以及平均 top-ranked checkpoint 的验证选择策略，在稀疏标注的 EM 分割中同时取得更高精度与更低预测成本。
AI.motivation: EM 体数据的体素级语义分割是定量细胞生物学的关键步骤，但稠密标注成本极高。已有 ε-Seg 证明仅用稀疏标注体素训练层级 VAE 也能得到有竞争力的分割，然而它只从最高层潜变量分类，且仅支持 2D patch，无法利用多尺度信息与 3D 上下文；此外验证标签同样稀缺，checkpoint 选择本身成为未解决的难题。
AI.method: 1) 在层级 VAE 的每一层放置语义专家，用无参数 product-of-experts 融合各层预测；2) 提出无泄漏（leakage-free）子体积切分协议，使 2D 与 3D 模型可在相同的稀疏监督下公平比较；3) 将 checkpoint 选择视为方法的一部分，对排名靠前的多个 checkpoint 做跨训练时间的集成平均，以应对小验证集。
AI.result: BetaSeg FIB-SEM 上，2,500 个训练标签时多层级专家将 2D mean Dice 提升约 0.1；≤600 标签时 2D 模型即可匹配或超过 3D ε-Seg，而预测成本约为其 1/11；约 1,000 标签以上 3D 输入占优，同等标注成本下 3D ε-Seg++ 达 mean Dice 0.905（D3PM 为 0.880），且预测速度快 5.4–27 倍（分别对应 checkpoint 集成与单模型）。checkpoint 集成平均上与单最优选择持平，并在验证集较小时显著改善最差情况。
AI.conclusion: 多层级专家融合与无泄漏 3D 化在稀疏标注下显著提升精度–成本权衡，且 2D 与 3D 的优劣存在明确的标注量阈值；checkpoint 集成是低标注、小验证场景下稳健且几乎无额外代价的选择策略。

title: PAC-style Bounds on the Conditional Validity of Conformal Predictors
summary: Conformal prediction sets are guaranteed to be marginally valid over the attribute space, but local coverage can diverge from the user-defined target $1-α$. Constructing conditionally valid prediction sets with finite calibration data is impossible for a general data-generating distribution. We derive PAC-type probabilistic lower bounds on the input-conditional coverage of any conformal predictor, without assumptions on the data distribution. They are based on the Markov and Cantelli inequalities and adapt to both calibration-marginal and calibration-conditional setups. A tighter, model-dependent Cantelli bound depends on the variance of the conditional coverage and is estimable from data using a fully non-asymptotic Hoeffding argument. The results suggest conditional-coverage variance as a scalable and theoretically motivated empirical measure of conditional validity.

AI.tldr: 针对共形预测集局部覆盖率可能偏离目标 $1-\alpha$ 的问题，本文在无分布假设下推导了任意共形预测器输入条件覆盖率的 PAC 型概率下界，其基于 Markov 与 Cantelli 不等式，并可用非渐近 Hoeffding 论证从数据中估计条件覆盖率方差。
AI.motivation: 共形预测集仅保证在属性空间上的边际有效性，局部（输入条件）覆盖率可能显著偏离用户设定的 $1-\alpha$；而在有限校准数据下，对一般数据生成分布构造条件有效的预测集在理论上是不可行的，因此需要一个可计算、可估计的替代刻画。
AI.method: 在不假设数据分布的前提下，基于 Markov 不等式与 Cantelli 不等式推导任意共形预测器输入条件覆盖率的 PAC 型概率下界；该结果同时适配 calibration-marginal 与 calibration-conditional 两种设定；进一步给出依赖条件覆盖率方差的、更紧的模型相关 Cantelli 下界，并借助完全非渐近的 Hoeffding 论证实现该方差的经验估计。
AI.result: 得到不依赖数据分布假设的、可计算的输入条件覆盖率 PAC 下界；其中 Cantelli 型下界更紧且依赖条件覆盖率方差，该方差可由数据非渐近地估计。
AI.conclusion: 条件覆盖率方差可作为条件有效性的可扩展且具理论依据的经验度量；在无法直接构造条件有效预测集的情况下，该框架为评估与比较共形预测器的局部有效性提供了可行途径。

title: MaskedVGGT: Masked Multi-View Transformers Are Scalable 3D Learners
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/zzctmd/MaskedVGGT
summary: Multi-view feed-forward models show strong scalability, but their reliance on costly geometric annotations limits data scaling. Existing 3D self-supervised approaches reduce this reliance through cross-view completion (e.g., CroCo, MuM, Muskie) or novel-view synthesis (e.g., RayZer, E-RayZer), typically learning image representations and cross-view interactions jointly. We argue that learning single image representations from scratch is unnecessary for 3D pretraining methods, as doing so fails to benefit from the continuing advances in 2D foundation models (e.g., DINO, CLIP, frontier VLMs). We introduce MaskedVGGT, which freezes a strong pretrained 2D encoder and pretrains only an added, randomly initialized multi-view transformer, focusing on learning interactions across views. MaskedVGGT pretrains the multi-view transformer through masked self-distillation without annotations: a student predicts targets at masked locations based on complete anchor views and heavily masked remaining views, while an exponential-moving-average teacher provides prediction targets based on unmasked inputs. In experiments across model sizes up to 1B parameters, MaskedVGGT pretraining followed by fine-tuning outperforms single-stage supervised VGGT-$Ω$ training with the same training data, model architecture, and total number of optimization updates. MaskedVGGT also outperforms E-RayZer, CroCo, MuM, and Muskie, providing evidence for the effectiveness of building multi-view pretraining on strong 2D representations. Finally, extending pretraining with additional unlabeled videos further improves generalization, and the learned representations transfer to diverse downstream tasks. These results demonstrate an effective division of learning: reuse strong image representations from 2D pretraining and learn cross-view interactions from unlabeled multi-view data without relying on geometric annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出 MaskedVGGT：冻结强 2D 预训练编码器，仅预训练随机初始化的多视图 Transformer，通过无标注掩码自蒸馏学习跨视图交互，在同等数据与算力下优于单阶段监督 VGGT-Ω 及 E-RayZer、CroCo、MuM、Muskie。
AI.motivation: 多视图前馈模型可扩展性强，但依赖昂贵的几何标注，限制了数据规模。现有 3D 自监督方法（CroCo、MuM、Muskie 的跨视图补全，RayZer、E-RayZer 的新视图合成）通常联合学习图像表征与跨视图交互，需从零训练图像编码器，因而无法受益于 DINO、CLIP、前沿 VLM 等 2D 基础模型的持续进步。作者主张：3D 预训练无需从零学习单图表征，应复用 2D 基础模型，仅学习跨视图交互。
AI.method: MaskedVGGT 冻结一个强预训练 2D 编码器，仅预训练新增的随机初始化多视图 Transformer，专注于跨视图交互学习。预训练采用无标注掩码自蒸馏：学生网络以完整锚点视图加高度掩码的其余视图为输入，预测被掩码位置的目标；指数滑动平均（EMA）教师网络基于未掩码输入提供预测目标。实验覆盖至 1B 参数规模。
AI.result: 在与单阶段监督 VGGT-Ω 完全相同的训练数据、模型架构与总优化更新次数下，MaskedVGGT 预训练+微调性能更优；同时优于 E-RayZer、CroCo、MuM 与 Muskie。用额外无标注视频扩展预训练可进一步提升泛化性，所学表征可迁移到多种下游任务。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一种有效的学习分工：复用 2D 预训练的强大图像表征，从不含几何标注的多视图数据中学习跨视图交互，从而摆脱对几何标注的依赖并提升可扩展性。

title: Best Arm Identification with Unknown Post-Action Context Distribution
summary: We study best arm identification (BAI) with post-action context in the fixed-confidence setting. After choosing an action, the learner observes a post-action context together with a reward whose distribution depends only on this context. Incorporating such intermediate information can substantially reduce the sample complexity of identifying the best arm. While Shahverdikondori et al. (2026a) analyzed the case where the distribution of contexts given actions is known, we address the more challenging and practically relevant case where this distribution is unknown. We derive an instance-dependent sample complexity lower bound and propose a Track-and-Stop algorithm that matches it asymptotically with access to an optimization oracle. Our stopping rule uses a new concentration inequality that jointly controls uncertainty in the context distributions and reward means, removing the factor of two incurred by separate concentration bounds. Implementing the algorithm generally requires solving nonconvex optimization problems. We propose a convex relaxation with instance-dependent approximation guarantees, including asymptotic tightness on hard Gaussian instances. Experiments demonstrate that exploiting post-action context reduces the sample complexity relative to baselines that ignore it, even when the context distributions are unknown.

AI.tldr: 研究未知行动后情境分布下的固定置信度最优臂识别（BAI），给出实例相关样本复杂度下界，并提出渐近最优的Track-and-Stop算法及可求解的凸松弛。
AI.motivation: 行动后情境（post-action context）携带中间信息，可显著降低识别最优臂的样本复杂度。已有工作（Shahverdikondori et al., 2026a）仅处理情境在给定行动下分布已知的情形，而实际中该分布往往未知，本文针对这一更具挑战性的未知分布设定展开研究。
AI.method: 1) 推导实例相关的样本复杂度下界；2) 提出Track-and-Stop式算法，在可访问优化预言机的条件下渐近匹配该下界；3) 停止规则采用新的集中不等式，联合控制情境分布与奖励均值的不确定性，避免分别使用两条界导致的因子2损失；4) 针对原问题非凸性，提出带实例相关近似保证的凸松弛。
AI.result: 算法在优化预言机辅助下达到渐近最优样本复杂度；新集中不等式消除了因子 2 的松弛；凸松弛给出实例相关近似保证，并在困难高斯实例上渐近紧；实验表明即使情境分布未知，利用行动后情境仍比忽略该信息的基线方法降低样本复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 在未知行动后情境分布下，利用中间情境信息可有效降低BAI的样本复杂度，所提下界、渐近最优算法与凸松弛共同构成理论完整且实用的框架。

title: Towards a Multimodal Aesthetic Agent for Photographic Reference Grading
summary: Reference-guided photographic color grading helps users realize their aesthetic intent by selectively drawing on the color and tonal characteristics of a reference photograph. Doing so requires understanding which characteristics users wish to adopt and translating these preferences into controllable edits. However, image-only reference methods align overall appearance without instruction-grounded selection, while pixel-space generative editors typically produce flattened images without editable parameters, limiting subsequent refinement. To address these challenges, we introduce JarvisAura, a multimodal aesthetic agent that formulates photographic color grading as structured decision-making in an editable parameter space. JarvisAura offers three key advantages: (1) an aesthetic agent paradigm that integrates visual attribute perception, strategy-level reasoning, and parameterized execution for interpretable and controllable photographic color grading; (2) a unified reasoning-to-execution pipeline that connects aesthetic planning with backend rendering and editable parameter refinement; and (3) a three-stage training strategy comprising Parameter-Grounded Continual Pre-Training for parameter-appearance grounding, Reference-Grounded Supervised Fine-Tuning for reference-guided reasoning and parameter decisions, and Reference-Aligned Group Relative Policy Optimization for rendered-outcome refinement with multidimensional rewards and dynamic data derivation. On Ref-Bench, JarvisAura achieves the best scores among methods with results across reported automatic metrics and a 74% human-rated task-success rate, exceeding GPT-Image-2.5 by 9 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态审美智能体JarvisAura，将参考图引导的照片调色建模为可编辑参数空间中的结构化决策，通过三阶段训练实现"推理—执行"闭环，在Ref-Bench上自动指标最优、人工任务成功率74%，超GPT-Image-2.5约9个百分点。
AI.motivation: 参考图引导的调色需理解用户想借鉴哪些色彩与影调特征，并转译为可控编辑。现有方法存在两类缺陷：纯图像级参考方法只对齐整体外观，缺乏指令驱动的选择性借鉴；像素空间生成式编辑器输出"扁平化"图像、无可编辑参数，难以继续精修。
AI.method: 将调色形式化为可编辑参数空间中的结构化决策；构建审美智能体范式，融合视觉属性感知、策略级推理与参数化执行；建立统一"推理到执行"流水线，衔接审美规划、后端渲染与参数迭代精修；采用三阶段训练：参数挂接持续预训练（Parameter-Grounded CPT，建立参数—外观对应）、参考图挂接监督微调（Reference-Grounded SFT，学习参考引导推理与参数决策）、参考对齐分组相对策略优化（Reference-Aligned GRPO，基于渲染结果与多维奖励及动态数据派生进行优化）。
AI.result: 在Ref-Bench上，JarvisAura在已报告的自动指标上均取得最优；人工评测任务成功率达74%，较GPT-Image-2.5高出9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以参数空间决策替代像素直出，可在保证可解释、可控制的同时支持后续精修，验证了审美智能体范式与"推理—执行"统一流水线的有效性。

title: Score-Based Diffusion for Hypergraph Signals in the t-Spectral Domain
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: We introduce the first score-based generative model for signals on a fixed hypergraph, formulated in the spectral domain of t-product hypergraph signal processing (t-HGSP). The naive tensor heat semigroup is ill-posed, since after palindromic symmetrization the spectral slices of the Laplacian tensor are no longer positive semidefinite. A per-mode frequency shift repairs it, yielding a forward Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusion that decouples per (eigenmode, slice) pair with closed-form marginals, exact score targets, and an exactly isotropic stationary law. A lightweight slice-conditioned denoiser is trained on the resulting real spectral grid. Sampling combines its score on data-active modes with the closed-form score elsewhere, which proves essential for stability at scale. A closed cosine-form observation operator turns missing-node recovery into linear-Gaussian guidance with stabilized posterior sampling. On hypergraphs of up to 500 nodes, our model beats a clique-expansion baseline by margins growing from $2\times$ to $27\times$ in covariance error, matches the graph-spectral statistics of the data better than the graph-basis model itself, and reaches the finite-sample estimation floor on data rotated off the t-spectral axes. Posterior sampling reduces missing-node NMSE to 0.28-0.64 (classical baselines 0.87-1.1) at conservative coverage, and cuts the framework's own denoising baseline by up to $3.6\times$.

AI.tldr: 提出首个作用于固定超图信号的 score-based 生成模型，建立于 t-product 超图信号处理（t-HGSP）的谱域；通过逐模频率平移修正张量热半群的病态性，构造可解析求解的前向 OU 扩散，并用于超图生成与缺失节点恢复。
AI.motivation: 超图上的生成建模尚缺乏基于分数的框架；而直接沿用 t-HGSP 的张量热半群存在不适定性问题：经回文对称化后，拉普拉斯张量的谱切片不再半正定，导致前向扩散过程无法良定义。
AI.method: 1) 在 t-HGSP 谱域构造张量热半群，诊断回文对称化破坏半正定性；2) 引入逐模（per-mode）频率平移修复，得到按 (本征模, 切片) 解耦的前向 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 扩散，具闭式边缘分布、精确 score 目标与各向同性平稳分布；3) 在实谱网格上训练轻量切片条件去噪器；4) 采样时对数据活跃模态使用网络 score，其余模态使用闭式 score 以保证大尺度稳定性；5) 设计余弦形式观测算子，将缺失节点恢复转为线性-高斯引导的稳定后验采样。
AI.result: 在最多 500 节点的超图上：相比 clique-expansion 基线，协方差误差优势由 2× 增至 27×；图谱统计匹配度优于图基模型本身；在偏离 t-谱轴的旋转数据上达到有限样本估计下限。缺失节点恢复 NMSE 降至 0.28–0.64（经典基线 0.87–1.1，覆盖率保守），并较框架自身去噪基线最高降低 3.6×。
AI.conclusion: 通过频率平移修正张量热半群的病态性并实现谱域解耦的 OU 扩散，可在超图上获得可解析训练、数值稳定且可扩展到后验推断的分数生成模型，在生成质量与缺失节点恢复上均显著优于图基与经典基线。

title: Query-Guided Visual Minimization for Selective Disclosure to Cloud VLMs
summary: Cloud-hosted vision-language models (VLMs) require sending images beyond the user's local trust boundary, potentially exposing sensitive information the query does not need. We study query-guided visual minimization: a trusted local transformation preserves query-relevant visual content and reduces unnecessary disclosure before transmission. Unlike query-agnostic anonymization, it preserves the same sensitive content when the query requires it and suppresses it otherwise. We introduce QGVM, a framework that combines query grounding with an independent sensitive-item inventory, determines disclosure necessity at the type, instance, and text-content levels, and renders a minimized image for a black-box downstream VLM. We evaluate QGVM on complementary benchmarks measuring task utility, directly recoverable sensitive information, and inferential geolocation leakage. With OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol, QGVM achieves 85.3% DoxBench answer correctness versus 77.5% for PGP, while a separately prompted Sol geolocation attacker succeeds within 1 km on 5.8% of QGVM images versus 25.7% of unprotected images. On Scene-Privacy, QGVM reduces face re-identification from 27.7% (PGP) to 4.5%. On held-out BIV-Priv-Seg, unnecessary private-text recovery falls from 33.9% (PGP) to 15.3%. To verify that disclosure is query-dependent, we evaluate paired queries that either require or do not require the same sensitive information. QGVM achieves 69.6% correct disclosure switching, compared with 29.1% for grounding-only cropping. These findings highlight the value of distinguishing visual relevance from disclosure necessity, while revealing the privacy-utility trade-offs of selective visual disclosure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出查询引导的视觉最小化(Query-Guided Visual Minimization)任务与QGVM框架，在发送图像给云端黑盒VLM前本地做查询依赖的敏感信息抑制，在保持任务效用的同时显著降低敏感信息暴露与地理定位推断泄露。
AI.motivation: 云端托管VLM要求图像越过用户本地信任边界，可能泄露查询本身并不需要的敏感信息。现有查询无关的匿名化方法无法区分"视觉相关性"与"披露必要性"：当查询确实需要某敏感内容时应保留，不需要时应抑制。
AI.method: QGVM将查询grounding与独立的敏感项清单(inventory)相结合，在类型、实例、文本内容三个粒度上判定披露必要性，并渲染最小化图像供黑盒下游VLM使用。评测覆盖任务效用、可直接恢复的敏感信息、推断式地理定位泄露，并设计成对查询(需要/不需要同一敏感信息)检验披露的查询依赖性。
AI.result: GPT-6.1 Sol下DoxBench答案正确率85.3%(PGP为77.5%)；Sol地理定位攻击1km内命中率5.8%(未保护图像25.7%)；Scene-Privacy人脸再识别率由27.7%(PGP)降至4.5%；留出集BIV-Priv-Seg上非必要隐私文本恢复率由33.9%(PGP)降至15.3%；成对查询下正确披露切换率69.6%(仅grounding裁剪为29.1%)。
AI.conclusion: 区分"视觉相关性"与"披露必要性"具有明确价值，选择性视觉披露存在固有的隐私-效用权衡，需在真实部署中权衡设计。

title: Can a Frontier LLM Repair a Quantized Network by Tool-Free Weight-Space Programming?
comment: 14 pages, 9 figures. Code and prompts on GitHub (weight-space-programming-ptq): https://github.com/urbste/weight-space-programming-ptq
summary: We give four large language models (LLMs) of the Claude family the complete weights of a 20k-parameter CIFAR-10 CNN as text and ask them to produce a 4-bit network without tools, data or the ability to run inference. Standard round-to-nearest (RTN) quantization to 4 bit lowers the test accuracy from 81.4% to 60.4%. We design four evaluation protocols that differ in the input and task description given to the LLMs and analyze their responses. In the first two protocols the LLMs are given the float and the 4-bit RTN network and are told that the accuracy has dropped significantly. In the last two they receive only the float network and the task to quantize it, which tests whether they apply an optimization on their own or fall back to plain RTN. Our analysis shows that a frontier LLM can recover most of the lost accuracy. Given one answer per layer, Opus 5.5 raises the accuracy of the 4-bit network to 77.95% by balancing the rounding errors within each 3x3 kernel, reasoning over the integer weights without tools. This is 3.5 pp below the float network and 2.8 pp below AdaRound, which learns the rounding from calibration data. Given only the float network, the LLMs name error-cancelling corrections but do not apply them and fall back to plain RTN, at most with mildly clipped scales, which still lifts Fable 5.2's quantized network to 70.0%. We analyze in detail what the LLMs did and why it works. Code and prompts can be found at https://github.com/urbste/weight-space-programming-ptq

AI.tldr: 让前沿 LLM 在无权值工具、无数据、无法运行推理的条件下，仅凭文本形式的浮点权重直接输出 4-bit 量化网络，Opus 5.5 可将 4-bit 精度从 RTN 的 60.4% 恢复到 77.95%。
AI.motivation: 标准 RTN 4-bit 量化使 20k 参数 CIFAR-10 CNN 的测试精度从 81.4% 跌至 60.4%。作者希望检验 LLM 是否具备"权重空间编程"能力——即不依赖校准数据与工具，仅通过阅读权重文本就能自主设计并执行量化优化策略。
AI.method: 向 Claude 系列四个 LLM 以文本形式输入完整浮点权重，设置四种评估协议：前两种同时给出浮点网络与 4-bit RTN 网络并告知精度显著下降；后两种仅给浮点网络与量化任务，用以判别模型是自主提出优化还是退化为普通 RTN。要求每层只给一个答案，并分析其推理过程。
AI.result: Opus 5.5 通过在每 3×3 卷积核内平衡舍入误差、对整数权重进行推理，将 4-bit 网络精度提升至 77.95%，仅比浮点网络低 3.5 pp、比需用校准数据学习的 AdaRound 低 2.8 pp。仅给浮点网络时，LLM 能说出可抵消误差的修正方向却不实际执行，退化为普通 RTN，最多辅以轻度裁剪的 scale，仍可将 Fable 5.2 的量化网络提升到 70.0%。论文还详细分析了 LLM 的具体操作与奏效原因。
AI.conclusion: 前沿 LLM 具备一定的零数据、零工具量化优化能力，能在核级别平衡舍入误差从而大幅挽回 RTN 的精度损失；但在缺乏误差反馈（仅给浮点网络）时无法自发实施其提出的修正，表明其优化行为依赖于对量化后果的显式观察，而非内在的量化先验。

title: CREDIT: Compositional Reliability Learning for Noisy Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that satisfies user intent based on a multimodal query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. However, real-world training data are often corrupted by Noisy Triplet Correspondence (NTC), where the semantic correspondence among the reference image, modification text, and target image becomes unreliable. Existing methods implicitly assume that the correctness of triplet correspondence can be determined by fixed decision rules. However, under NTC, the authenticity of semantic correspondence is difficult to determine accurately, and different triplets exhibit varying degrees of semantic reliability rather than binary correctness. Consequently, deterministic confidence is insufficient to faithfully characterize correspondence reliability, often leading to overconfident supervision for unreliable triplets and progressively reinforcing noisy semantics during compositional representation learning. To address this challenge, we propose a Compositional Reliability learning framework with Evidential uncertainty and DiffusIon-guided refinemenT (CREDIT), which explicitly quantifies the uncertainty of triplet correspondence to estimate its reliability and suppress the propagation of noisy supervision. CREDIT consists of two complementary components: The Evidential Compositional Uncertainty Learning (ECUL) module explicitly models correspondence uncertainty via evidential learning, enabling uncertaintyaware reliability estimation to suppress noisy supervision. Building upon the reliable supervision provided by ECUL, the Diffusion-enhanced Reference Refinement (DRR) module further refines reference representations through textconditioned diffusion, producing more robust compositional query features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CREDIT consistently outperforms existing methods under various settings.

AI.tldr: 提出CREDIT框架，用证据不确定性学习+扩散引导精炼来量化三元组对应可靠性，抑制噪声监督传播，在噪声组合图像检索中一致优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 组合图像检索（CIR）的真实训练数据常含噪声三元组对应（NTC）：参考图、修改文本与目标图之间语义对应不可靠。现有方法隐含假设三元组正确性可由固定决策规则判定，但NTC下语义对应真实性难准确判断，且不同三元组的可靠性是连续而非二值的，确定性置信度会导致对不可靠三元组过度自信的监督，并在组合表示学习中逐步强化噪声语义。
AI.method: CREDIT框架含两个互补模块：(1) Evidential Compositional Uncertainty Learning（ECUL）：基于证据学习显式建模对应不确定性，实现不确定性感知的可靠性估计以抑制噪声监督；(2) Diffusion-enhanced Reference Refinement（DRR）：在ECUL提供的可靠监督基础上，通过文本条件扩散模型精炼参考表示，生成更鲁棒的组合查询特征。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CREDIT在多种设置下均一致优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 以不确定性量化替代确定性二值判断是处理CIR噪声对应的有效途径；证据学习与扩散精炼的互补设计可提升组合查询表示的鲁棒性。

title: When Is Product Decoding of ECOC MAP-Consistent? Pair Structure and the n-vs-Rest Codes
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures. Lean 4 formalization of all theorems in the ancillary files
summary: Error-Correcting Output Codes (ECOC) combine binary classifiers by the sum decoder, which totals probabilities, or the product decoder, which totals log-likelihoods. In the noiseless setting, where the binary classifiers output the true posteriors, we ask on which code matrices each decoder always agrees with the Bayes-optimal (MAP) class. For the sum decoder the answer is known: the code must be equidistant (James and Hastie, 1998). We answer the question for the product decoder. Two classes are compared through the votes of the columns on which they differ: the sum decoder decides by their sample mean, the product decoder by an M-estimator with influence function artanh, and each vote is the MAP margin plus a bias determined by the other classes alone. Our main theorem states that the product decoder is MAP-consistent if and only if, for every class pair, the columns on which the two classes differ are matched with the columns obtained by swapping the two classes (or their complements), and equivalently if and only if the code is a union of n-vs-Rest codes. Efficient equidistant codes are therefore excluded: Hadamard codes ($M\ge 8$), which meet the Plotkin bound with $M-1$ columns, have no such pairs, and for the Sylvester type the reversal margin can be at least a constant 0.0182 independent of $M$. All theorems are machine-checked in Lean 4. On six real datasets with estimated probabilities, the product decoder is slightly more accurate when each column is calibrated, and the sum decoder is better when the calibration error differs across columns; in either case the decoders disagree only near ties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究ECOC中product decoder的MAP一致性条件，证明其当且仅当码矩阵为n-vs-Rest码的并时一致，并用Lean 4机器验证、在六个真实数据集上比较两种解码器。
AI.motivation: sum decoder的MAP一致性条件已知（需等距码），但product decoder的对应条件未知；同时等距码（如Hadamard码）在实践中常用，厘清其与MAP一致性的关系有理论与实用意义。
AI.method: 在无噪声设定（二元分类器输出真实后验）下分析两类比较：类间差异列上，sum decoder取样本均值，product decoder取以artanh为影响函数的M-估计量，每个投票为MAP margin加上仅由其他类决定的偏置；据此推导product decoder的MAP一致性充要条件，并用Lean 4对全部定理做机器验证；在六个真实数据集（估计概率）上做实验比较。
AI.result: 主定理：product decoder为MAP一致当且仅当对每个类对，两类的差异列与交换两类（或其补）所得的列相匹配，等价于码为n-vs-Rest码的并。由此排除高效等距码：Hadamard码（M≥8，M−1列达到Plotkin界）无此类列对，Sylvester型的reversal margin可至少为与M无关的常数0.0182。实验上，各列均校准时product decoder略优；各列校准误差不同时sum decoder更优；两种情形下解码器仅在接近平局时分歧。
AI.conclusion: product decoder的MAP一致性刻画严格且与等距码不相容，说明高效等距码在该意义下不可用；实践中两解码器差异很小且集中于近似平局区域，选择应取决于校准条件是否跨列一致。

title: SynAVID: A Synthetic Audio-Visual Immersive Dataset of Dynamic Scenes
summary: Immersive scene modeling requires synchronized visual and auditory observations under changing viewpoints and scene conditions. Obtaining such observations and references for controlled scene changes remains challenging. We introduce SynAVID, a synthetic audio-visual immersive dataset comprising eight indoor and outdoor scenes. Each minute-scale episode combines fixed camera arrays and moving trajectories with synchronized, viewpoint-dependent binaural audio. Shared scene dynamics, sound-source events, and observer poses drive visual rendering and geometry-aware acoustic synthesis. We evaluate existing methods for visual reconstruction, binaural audio reconstruction, and audiovisual editing. Mixed-observation configurations generally improve visual reconstruction on fixed and moving test views, while transiently occupied and sparsely observed regions remain challenging. Methods rank differently on spectral, interaural, and perceptual audio metrics. Geometric and instance annotations expose uneven observation support and local Gaussian representations beyond aggregate scores. Paired references assess target edits and surrounding content, while controlled geometry changes produce listener-dependent acoustic responses. The project page is available at https://avery-xu.github.io/synavid-project/.

AI.tldr: 提出SynAVID——含8个室内外场景的合成视听沉浸式数据集，每个分钟级片段将固定相机阵列与运动轨迹结合，并配同步、视角相关的双耳音频，用于视觉重建、双耳音频重建与视听编辑的统一评测。
AI.motivation: 沉浸式场景建模需要在视角与场景条件变化下同步获取视觉与听觉观测，而受控场景变化所需的观测与参考数据难以获取，现有资源不足以支撑系统评测。
AI.method: 构建合成数据集：以共享的场景动态、声源事件与观察者位姿统一驱动视觉渲染与几何感知的声学合成，使视觉与双耳音频严格同步且随视角变化；并提供几何与实例标注及配对参考。基于该数据集评测视觉重建、双耳音频重建与视听编辑三类现有方法。
AI.result: 混合观测配置通常在固定与运动测试视角上改善视觉重建，但瞬态占用区域与稀疏观测区域仍具挑战；音频方法在频谱、双耳间与感知指标上排序不一致；几何与实例标注揭示观测支持不均衡及超出聚合分数所能反映的局部高斯表征问题；配对参考可评估目标编辑与周边内容，受控几何变化产生因人而异的声学响应。
AI.conclusion: SynAVID为视听沉浸式建模提供了可控、同步、多视角的评测基准，表明单一聚合指标不足，需结合几何/实例标注与多类感知指标进行细粒度评估。

title: Latent Merger: Latent-Space Composition of Hypernetwork-Generated LoRAs
summary: Recent work proposes hypernetworks that convert a document into a low-rank parameter update (LoRA) in a single forward pass, enabling fast injection of new knowledge into a frozen LLM. However, storing separate LoRA adapters for each document can be unsustainable in streaming settings. In this paper, we study the problem of composing hypernetwork-generated LoRAs using two representative systems, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE. We show that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a geometry sharply different from directly fine-tuned LoRAs. They exhibit greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters, which are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents. Guided by this observation, we propose latent-space LoRA merging. We compose the intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. We show that latent-space merging techniques consistently improve over weight-space and factor-space baselines while preserving a single fixed-rank adapter. These results support latent-space composition as a promising mechanism for combining hypernetwork-generated LoRAs under a fixed output-rank budget.

AI.tldr: 超网络单次前向生成文档级LoRA，其几何性质不同于微调LoRA（谱更集中、跨文档更对齐），据此提出在超网络隐空间合并LoRA，优于权重/因子空间合并且在固定秩预算下保持单一适配器。
AI.motivation: 流式场景下为每篇文档单独存储LoRA适配器不可持续，需要研究多个超网络生成LoRA的组合（合并）问题，而非简单堆叠存储。
AI.method: 以Doc-to-LoRA与SHINE两个系统为对象，先刻画超网络生成LoRA的几何特性（谱集中度、跨文档对齐度），并与直接微调（NTP与QA）LoRA对比；基于观察提出隐空间LoRA合并——先合并超网络的中间隐变量，再经冻结的LoRA生成头解码，与权重空间、因子空间基线比较，且保持固定秩单一适配器。
AI.result: 超网络生成的LoRA呈现更强谱集中与更强跨文档对齐，而NTP/QA微调适配器更弥散、跨文档近似正交；隐空间合并在各比较中稳定优于权重空间与因子空间基线，同时维持单一固定秩适配器。
AI.conclusion: 隐空间组合是固定输出秩预算下合并超网络生成LoRA的有效机制，为流式知识注入提供可行路径。

title: ASTERISM: Do Multimodal LLMs Actually Look at All the Images?
summary: Multi-image benchmarks aim to test whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) combines evidence across images, but many of their items can be answered from a single image. Across about 33k items from 19 public benchmarks, our audit and a two-stage single-image filter find that one image or the question alone settles 24.2% of them. On these items, MLLMs recover from one image a median 78% of the accuracy that all images add over the text alone, so these items reward answering from one image, which we call the single-image shortcut. MLLMs take this shortcut even on items where one image is not enough. On such items, most of their wrong answers repeat an answer they give from one image, at a rate well above chance. We build ASTERISM, to our knowledge the largest audited multi-image benchmark, from these 19 benchmarks by keeping their items that need more than one image. Its 18.7k items, 2.0k of them corrected or rewritten, share one format, one scorer and seven task categories. We also release ASTERISM-Train with 49k training items and ASTERISM-Lite, a hard subset whose items we manually verify one by one. On ASTERISM-Lite, the strongest proprietary MLLM scores 68%. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), now common in MLLM post-training, rewards the shortcut as well, because a correct answer read off one image earns as much reward as one that combines images. In line with this, existing RLVR objectives add little to the ASTERISM score. To stop rewarding the shortcut in training as ASTERISM does in evaluation, we propose cross-image credit assignment (CICA), an extension of RLVR that moves the credit toward the tokens that need more than one image. On three open-source MLLMs, CICA raises the ASTERISM score by 2.6 to 6.0 points, more than twice the gain of each general and vision-specific RL objective trained on the same data.

AI.tldr: 现有多图基准中约24.2%的题目可由单张图或问题本身直接答对，模型借此走"单图捷径"；作者审计19个基准构建ASTERISM系列基准，并提出跨图像信用分配（CICA）以在训练中消除该捷径奖励，使开源MLLM在ASTERISM上提升2.6–6.0分。
AI.motivation: 多图基准本意是检验MLLM能否跨图整合证据，但大量题目实际只需单张图即可作答（"单图捷径"），导致评测失真、训练奖励被捷径"窃取"；现有RLVR目标对这种捷径给予与真正跨图推理相同的奖励，因而难以提升多图推理能力。
AI.method: 1）对19个公开基准约33k题目进行审计，并用两阶段单图过滤器识别"单图/仅问题即可解"的题目；2）统计MLLM在单图条件下的准确率恢复比例与错误答案重复率，量化捷径程度；3）构建ASTERISM（18.7k题，含2.0k修正/重写题，统一格式、评分器与7类任务），并发布ASTERISM-Train（49k训练题）与人工逐条校验的困难子集ASTERISM-Lite；4）提出跨图像信用分配（CICA），作为RLVR的扩展，将信用分配给真正需要多图信息的token。
AI.result: 审计发现24.2%的题目可由单图或仅问题解决；在这些题上模型从单图恢复出"全图相对纯文本"增益的中位78%；对单图不足的题目，模型仍走捷径，其错误答案多为单图答案的重复，显著高于随机。最强闭源MLLM在ASTERISM-Lite上仅得68%。CICA在三个开源MLLM上提升ASTERISM分数2.6–6.0分，超过同等数据下各通用与视觉专用RL目标增益的两倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 多图基准普遍存在单图捷径，使评测与RLVR训练同时被"奖励作弊"污染；ASTERISM提供了经审计、统一规格的多图评测与训练资源，CICA通过在训练中抑制捷径奖励、把信用导向跨图token，可显著提升真实多图推理表现，实现评测与训练的一致性。

title: Local Indices Are Not Enough: Synchrony and Global Information in Bandit Algorithms
summary: Standard index-based stochastic bandit algorithms such as KL-UCB and Thompson Sampling achieve optimal $O(\log T)$ regret over a horizon $T$. The former uses the global timestep to construct each arm's index, while the latter samples each arm's belief distribution at every timestep. The necessity of global information and synchronous index updates for achieving optimal regret has not been examined yet. In this paper, we investigate the fundamental limits of asynchronous local index algorithms---those that recalculate an arm's index only upon pulling it, using solely that arm's own reward history and a local randomness budget. We prove that no such algorithm can achieve $O(\log T)$ regret across all bandit instances. We then analyse the functional equations arising from asynchronous updates, and show that the achievable regret lies in a sub-polynomial, super-polylogarithmic regime. We propose an asynchronous local index policy whose regret upper bound also lies in this regime. Turning to synchronous local algorithms, which sample every arm's index at all timesteps as in Thompson Sampling, we show that a locally determined randomness budget per arm suffices to retain $O(\log T)$ regret, demonstrating that synchrony, albeit with some randomness, is essential to the optimality of Thompson Sampling.

AI.tldr: 该文研究异步局部索引算法的根本极限，证明其无法达到 O(log T) 遗憾，可达遗憾处于次多项式、超多对数区间，并给出相应策略；同时表明同步局部随机性足以保持最优对数遗憾。
AI.motivation: KL-UCB、Thompson Sampling 等标准索引型随机 bandit 算法能达到最优 O(log T) 遗憾，但它们依赖全局时间步信息与同步的索引更新；全局信息与同步更新对最优遗憾是否必要，此前未被系统考察。
AI.method: 定义"异步局部索引算法"：仅在被拉动时、仅用该臂自身奖励历史与局部随机性预算重算索引。通过下界证明与异步更新产生的函数方程分析刻画可达遗憾区间，并据此设计异步局部索引策略；对同步局部算法则分析每臂局部随机性预算的作用。
AI.result: 证明任何异步局部索引算法都无法在所有 bandit 实例上达到 O(log T) 遗憾；可达遗憾落在次多项式、超多对数（sub-polynomial, super-polylogarithmic）区间，所提异步局部索引策略的上界亦属该区间；同步局部算法中，每臂局部确定的随机性预算即可保留 O(log T) 遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 全局信息与同步索引更新是实现最优对数遗憾的关键：同步性（即便仅配以局部随机性）是 Thompson Sampling 最优性的必要条件，而纯异步局部更新在原理上受限。

title: A recursive self-improvement framework for electron microscopy analysis
summary: Resolving local atomic structures such as defects and interfaces from electron microscopy contrast relies heavily on researcher judgement, leading to low efficiency and subjective standards. Here we present PhyEvo-Mic-RSI, a physics-guided and expert-informed recursive self-improvement framework that turns one-off human corrections into reusable, verifiable capabilities by updating executable operators, parameters and routing rules with versioned inheritance. Given researcher-defined tasks, the system selects analysis paths from image features without expert labels, while testing and inheriting code updates under fixed budgets. Combining physical priors with expert feedback improves atomic point-defect detection over larger models and raises cross-material interface coverage from 5.13% to 72.11% within a 10% area budget. Adapting the framework to micrographs from unseen studies further separates touching nanoparticles by aligning optimization with particle-level measurements. This work moves computational microscopy beyond standalone models and static scripts towards self-evolving platforms that accumulate human scientific expertise

AI.tldr: 提出物理引导、专家反馈驱动的递归自我改进框架 PhyEvo-Mic-RSI，将一次性人工修正转化为可复用、可验证的显微图像分析能力。
AI.motivation: 从电镜衬度中解析缺陷、界面等局部原子结构高度依赖研究者主观判断，效率低且标准不一；现有方法多为独立模型或静态脚本，难以积累和复用人工经验。
AI.method: 构建带版本继承的递归自我改进框架，通过更新可执行算子、参数与路由规则实现能力演化；在无专家标注条件下依据图像特征自动选择分析路径，并在固定预算下测试与继承代码更新；融合物理先验与专家反馈，并可与粒子级测量对齐以适配未见研究的显微图。
AI.result: 融合物理先验与专家反馈后，原子点缺陷检测优于更大规模模型；在10%面积预算下将跨材料界面覆盖率从5.13%提升至72.11%；迁移到未见研究的显微图时可有效分离粘连纳米颗粒。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使计算显微学从独立模型与静态脚本转向能够累积人类科学经验的自演化平台。

title: Understanding Clipping In Zeroth-Order Optimization
summary: Zeroth-order optimization has emerged as a resource-efficient alternative to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) when fine-tuning LLMs, thanks to the inherent low dimensionality of the loss landscape. It relies on a two-point estimate of the gradient that only accesses the function value and not the gradient, bypassing the resource-heavy backpropagation. Recently, it was accidentally discovered that per-sample clipping can improve the performance of the trained model, while running a differentially private version of zeroth-order optimization \cite{zhang2024dpzero} with a very large privacy parameter $ε$ (corresponding to very little privacy). In this paper, we systematically investigate this phenomenon and demonstrate that ($i$) the optimal choice of learning rate $η$ is inversely proportional to the clipping threshold $c$, satisfying $ηc =$ constant; ($ii$) clipping drives the zeroth-order optimization to a different solution with higher test accuracy; and ($iii$) this phenomenon is only observed with per-sample clipped zeroth-order optimization and not other zeroth-order alternatives that also provide robust estimates of the gradient. Further analyses with artificially injected label noise reveals that clipping leads to more robust predictions, which stems from the implicit down weighting of hard-to-fit training examples. Our code is available at https://github.com/SewoongLab/ClipZero

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了零阶优化中"逐样本裁剪"意外提升微调性能的现象，揭示学习率与裁剪阈值的反比关系、裁剪导致不同解、以及该现象的独特性，并归因于对难拟合样本的隐式降权。
AI.motivation: 零阶优化因损失景观低维性成为LLM微调的低资源替代方案，仅需函数值即可两点估计梯度，避开反向传播开销。此前在差分隐私零阶优化(DPZero)工作中偶然发现逐样本裁剪可提升模型性能，但该现象缺乏系统解释。
AI.method: 系统性的实证与理论分析：(i) 分析学习率η与裁剪阈值c的关系；(ii) 比较裁剪零阶优化与其他同样提供稳健梯度估计的零阶变体；(iii) 人工注入标签噪声进行鲁棒性分析，探究裁剪的作用机制。
AI.result: (i) 最优学习率与裁剪阈值成反比，满足 ηc = 常数；(ii) 裁剪使零阶优化收敛到测试精度更高的不同解；(iii) 该现象仅出现在逐样本裁剪的零阶优化中，其他稳健估计变体并无此效果；标签噪声实验表明裁剪带来更鲁棒的预测，源于对难拟合训练样本的隐式降权。
AI.conclusion: 逐样本裁剪并非单纯的隐私保护副产物，而是能通过隐式重加权改善零阶微调效果的机制；为理解并调优零阶微调提供了实用指导（如 ηc=常数 的调参规律）。

title: Longitudinal Characterization of Personalized Hydration Dynamics Using a Facial-Video Digital Hydration Biomarker
summary:
Background. Hydration is often assessed at a single time point despite continuous changes in body water. A facial-video biomarker has tracked hydration-state transitions, but its longitudinal behavior is unclear.
  Objective. To assess within-person hydration score changes, individual differences in fluid response, and implications for personal calibration.
  Methods. Five adults completed water and electrolyte days with an identical 2.0 L fluid schedule, using facial videos every 30 minutes over 12 hours (250 videos). On a separate morning, each completed a 500 mL electrolyte challenge with baseline and four follow-up videos over 2 hours (25 videos). Analyses assessed trajectories, post-drink changes, variability, time at or above score 50, and exploratory effects of starting score and beverage day.
  Results. The first scan was the day's lowest on 7 of 10 days. Across 50 intakes, the mean post-drink change was +4.0 points, exceeding a shuffled-time comparison (p less than 0.001). For 21 intakes starting below 50, no subsequent score fell; the mean rise was +11.3 points versus +5.7 expected under permutation (p less than 0.001). Intakes starting at 50 or above showed no rise beyond chance. After 500 mL electrolytes, mean change over 2 hours was positive for all five participants, with peak increases of 7.2 to 22.6 points at 30 to 90 minutes. Despite identical fluid schedules, time at or above 50 ranged from 16% to 100%. The electrolyte day showed a greater mean increase from morning baseline than the water day (+7.7 points), although day order was fixed.
  Conclusion. Facial-video hydration scores showed longitudinal changes associated with drinking and marked individual differences. These exploratory findings support further research on personal calibration and hydration protocols in larger controlled studies.

AI.tldr: 该预实验利用面部视频水合评分追踪5名成人在12小时内的水合状态变化，发现饮水后评分显著上升、个体差异明显，支持后续个体化校准研究。
AI.motivation: 水合状态会持续变化，但以往多采用单时点评估。已有面部视频生物标志物可追踪水合状态转变，但其纵向行为（个体内变化、个体间差异）尚不清楚。
AI.method: 5名成人分别完成"饮水日"与"电解质日"，两天采用相同的2.0 L补液方案，每30分钟采集一次面部视频，共12小时250段视频；另在单独早晨进行500 mL电解质挑战，采集基线与4次随访视频（2小时，25段视频）。分析指标包括评分轨迹、饮后变化、变异性、评分≥50的时间占比，并探索起始评分与饮料日类型的影响。
AI.result: 10天中有7天当日首测评分最低。50次摄入中，饮后平均变化为+4.0分，显著高于打乱时间对照（p<0.001）。21次起始评分<50的摄入后无评分下降，平均上升+11.3分（置换检验期望值+5.7，p<0.001）；起始≥50的摄入未见超随机上升。500 mL电解质后5名受试者2小时变化均为正，峰值升高7.2–22.6分，出现在30–90分钟。尽管补液方案相同，评分≥50的时间占比在16%–100%之间。电解质日较饮水日晨基线平均升幅更大（+7.7分），但日序固定。
AI.conclusion: 面部视频水合评分呈现与饮水相关的纵向变化及显著个体差异。这些探索性结果支持在更大规模对照研究中进一步开展个体化校准与水合方案研究。

title: U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning
summary: Since its introduction by DeepSeek, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted for training large reasoning models and agents, spurring a proliferation of its variants. Yet the group size, a crucial hyperparameter in these GRPO-type algorithms, remains largely chosen by trial and error. Exploiting the U-statistic structure of GRPO's policy gradient, we recast the selection of the group size as a classical statistical problem of variance ratio estimation. This problem is particularly challenging when the denominator of the ratio is small, rendering naive plug-in estimators unstable. To address this challenge, we propose a pessimistic ratio estimator that accounts for the denominator's estimation uncertainty. We characterise the statistical properties of this estimator across three sample-size regimes. Empirically, using %a jackknife-based pessimistic rule on synthetic tasks from Reasoning Gym and real-world benchmarks covering both mathematical reasoning and code generation, we show that our adaptive group size selection reduces the mean squared error of the resulting policy gradient and improves policy optimisation over fixed-group-size baselines, with modest additional computational cost.

AI.tldr: 本文将GRPO的组大小（group size）选择问题重新表述为基于U统计量结构的方差比估计问题，提出计入分母估计不确定性的"悲观"比率估计量，并在三种样本量情形下刻画其统计性质；实验表明自适应组大小选择降低策略梯度均方误差并改善优化效果。
AI.motivation: GRPO及其众多变体已被广泛用于训练大推理模型与智能体，但其中的关键超参数——组大小——长期依赖试错法（trial and error）选取，缺乏理论指导与原则性方法。
AI.method: 利用GRPO策略梯度的U统计量结构，把组大小选择转化为经典的方差比估计问题；针对分母较小时朴素plug-in估计量不稳定这一难点，提出考虑分母估计不确定性的悲观比率估计量（pessimistic ratio estimator），并在三种样本量情形下刻画其统计性质；实验中采用基于jackknife的悲观准则。
AI.result: 在Reasoning Gym合成任务以及涵盖数学推理与代码生成的真实基准上，所提出的自适应组大小选择降低了策略梯度的均方误差，并在策略优化效果上优于固定组大小基线，且仅带来适度的额外计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 组大小可通过方差比估计的统计框架被原则性地自适应确定；悲观比率估计量在分母估计不确定时更稳健，为GRPO类算法提供了一种低开销、可替代试错调参的实用方案。

title: FlowVecFont: Scalable Vector Font Generation via Latent Flow Matching
summary: Fonts are natively represented as vector outlines. Many existing studies on vector font generation have relied on specialized generation or refinement mechanisms, bitmap representations, or externally pretrained models to address the challenges of learning vector representations. These approaches often increase system complexity, incur additional computational and implementation costs, and introduce dependencies on external resources. We show that scaling a simple model enables high-quality pure vector font generation without external pretraining. We propose FlowVecFont, a scalable model for vector font generation based on latent flow matching and trained solely on vector outlines. A Transformer-based variational autoencoder maps glyph sequences into fixed-length continuous latent tokens, enabling standard conditional flow matching for vector glyph generation. The model supports conditioning on class labels or reference glyphs, with the latter enabling generalization to unseen characters and fonts. Experiments on 5M glyphs collected across Google Fonts, including non-Latin characters, show that generation quality improves with model scale across conditioning strategies. In a comparison on Latin glyphs, the 800M-parameter FlowVecFont outperforms DeepVecFont-v2 and DesigNet and achieves quality competitive with the pretrained 27B-parameter VecGlypher. We also provide TorchFont, a machine learning library for vector fonts.

AI.tldr: 提出 FlowVecFont：基于潜在流匹配、仅用矢量轮廓训练的简单可扩展模型，实现高质量纯矢量字体生成，无需外部预训练，800M 参数版本优于 DeepVecFont-v2 与 DesigNet，并与 27B 的 VecGlypher 质量相当。
AI.motivation: 现有矢量字体生成研究依赖专用生成/精修机制、位图表示或外部预训练模型，导致系统复杂度上升、额外计算与实现成本增加，并引入对外部资源的依赖。作者希望验证：仅靠扩大一个简单模型的规模，即可实现高质量的纯矢量字体生成。
AI.method: FlowVecFont 仅以矢量轮廓为训练数据：(1) 用基于 Transformer 的变分自编码器将字形序列映射为定长连续潜在 token；(2) 在潜空间上做标准条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）生成矢量字形；(3) 支持类别标签或参考字形两种条件方式，后者可泛化到未见字符与字体；结合模型规模扩展（scaling）。
AI.result: 在 Google Fonts 采集的约 500 万字形（含非拉丁字符）上实验：两种条件策略下生成质量均随模型规模提升。拉丁字形对比中，800M 参数的 FlowVecFont 优于 DeepVecFont-v2 与 DesigNet，并与预训练的 27B 参数 VecGlypher 质量相当（具有约 30 倍以上的参数效率优势）。
AI.conclusion: 简单的潜在流匹配模型在纯矢量字体生成上具备良好的可扩展性，无需外部预训练即可获得高质量结果，说明复杂的专用机制与外部依赖并非必需；同时发布 TorchFont 矢量字体机器学习库。

title: Shifter Quantization: Compact Representations for Native Integer Computation
summary: Groupwise quantization is used in LLM quantization to improve accuracy at low bit widths, but grouping weights keeps standard integer MMA from spanning the full dot product for efficient GPU inference. We develop a new quantization method, Shifter Quantization (SQ), that reconstructs native-width integer operands by appending and shifting shared bits. To further extend the efficiency, we develop a special variant of SQ, Shifter Integer (SHI), to use INT4 kernels. We show that SQ and SHI formats perform better than standard groupwise quantization in quality, as measured by projection error and KL divergence, and in inference speed, as measured during decoding and prefill. For low precision like 2-bit quantization, SQ2 and SHI2 achieve 2.71-3.77x the 4,096-token prefill throughput of llama.cpp on a Q2_K checkpoint and reduce WikiText-2 KL by 6.6-7.8%. For mid precision like 4-bit quantization, SQ4 achieves 1.43-2.47x the prefill throughput of NInfer's groupwise-integer baselines across the tested models and prompt lengths, with 24-40% lower KL than the NInfer baselines. For high precision like 8-bit quantization, SQ8 achieves 27.4% higher batch-one prefill throughput and 72.7% lower KL than vLLM's online FP8.

AI.tldr: 提出 Shifter Quantization (SQ) 及变体 Shifter Integer (SHI)，通过拼接与移位共享比特重构原生位宽整数操作数，使分组量化可用标准整数 MMA/INT4 kernel 高效计算，在质量（投影误差、KL）与速度上均优于标准分组量化。
AI.motivation: 分组量化（groupwise quantization）在低比特下能提升 LLM 精度，但分组权重使标准整数 MMA 无法覆盖完整点积，导致 GPU 推理低效。需要在保留分组量化精度优势的同时恢复硬件整数内核的效率。
AI.method: 提出 SQ：对分组共享的比特进行追加与移位，重构出原生位宽的整数操作数，从而让标准整数 MMA 能够完成整个点积；进一步提出 SHI 变体以复用 INT4 kernel。评测维度为投影误差、KL 散度与解码/预填充吞吐。
AI.result: 2-bit 下，SQ2/SHI2 的 4096-token 预填充吞吐为 llama.cpp 的 2.71–3.77 倍（Q2_K 检查点），WikiText-2 KL 降低 6.6–7.8%；4-bit 下，SQ4 预填充吞吐为 NInfer 分组整数基线的 1.43–2.47 倍，KL 低 24–40%；8-bit 下，SQ8 单 batch 预填充吞吐比 vLLM 在线 FP8 高 27.4%，KL 低 72.7%。
AI.conclusion: SQ/SHI 在低、中、高比特区间均同时改善精度与推理速度，验证了以比特移位重构原生整数操作数的思路可作为分组量化与标准整数内核之间高效兼容的方案。

title: Cross-Version Compatibility of TESSERA Embeddings Through Lightweight Translation
summary: Downstream models often outlive the embedding release on which they were trained. We test whether lightweight converters let a classifier trained on one Tessera release use embeddings from another. We fit converters between v1, v1.1, and v2 on 6,280 co-located triplets from 25 sites in 2024, with disjoint training, validation, and test sites. On a four-class land-cover test, a classifier trained on true v2 reaches 0.937 accuracy and 0.844 macro-F1. The same classifier scores 0.061 and 0.050 on raw v1.1, but 0.917 and 0.795 on converted v1.1. Direct v1-to-v2 translation has lower error than composition through v1.1. Geographic transfer is less reliable. On a separate cohort of 20 sites, a converter trained on the original sites reaches 0.597 accuracy despite 0.902 cosine similarity to v2, whereas a converter trained within the new cohort reaches 0.784. Tests with 2021 WorldCover labels and at 24 sampled sites without valid native v2 values extend the evaluation. Conversion recovers much of the frozen classifier's performance on the tested sites, but the new-site result shows that embedding similarity cannot stand in for downstream evaluation.

AI.tldr: 研究用轻量转换器使在某一 Tessera 嵌入版本上训练的冻结分类器可复用其他版本的嵌入：在测试站点上能恢复大部分性能，但跨新站点泛化不可靠，且嵌入余弦相似度不能替代下游评估。
AI.motivation: 下游模型生命周期常长于其训练所用嵌入版本。作者检验能否通过轻量转换器，让在某一 Tessera 版本上训练的分类器直接使用另一版本的嵌入，从而避免重训模型或重算嵌入，并考察转换与地理迁移的可靠边界。
AI.method: 在 2024 年 25 个站点的 6,280 组共址三元组上，拟合 v1、v1.1、v2 之间的两两转换器，训练/验证/测试站点互不重叠。以四类土地覆盖任务的冻结分类器评估：真实 v2 训练的分类器分别在原始 v1.1、转换后 v1.1 上测试；比较 v1→v2 直接转换与经 v1.1 复合转换的误差；另设 20 个站点的独立队列检验地理迁移，并用 2021 WorldCover 标签及 24 个无有效原生 v2 值的采样站点做扩展评估。
AI.result: 四类土地覆盖测试中，真实 v2 训练的分类器在 true v2 上达 0.937 准确率 / 0.844 macro-F1；在原始 v1.1 上骤降至 0.061 / 0.050，转换后 v1.1 回升至 0.917 / 0.795。v1→v2 直接转换误差低于经 v1.1 的复合转换。地理迁移更不可靠：在 20 站点新队列上，原站点训练的转换器仅达 0.597 准确率，尽管与 v2 余弦相似度为 0.902；在新队列内部训练的转换器则达 0.784。
AI.conclusion: 转换器在已测试站点上能恢复冻结分类器的大部分性能，使跨版本复用嵌入可行；但新站点结果（0.597 vs 0.784）表明嵌入相似度高不等于下游可用，余弦相似度不能替代下游任务评估，地理迁移需单独验证。

title: GREMLIN: Generating Random Environments for Meta-Learning with Interacting Networks
summary: Can randomly parameterized neural environments supply useful experience for learning a reinforcement learning algorithm? We investigate this question using DiscoRL's rule-discovery framework, replacing human-designed training games with sixteen selected neural environments. Each game combines bounded vector dynamics with a random strategy-based reward and an independent outcome reward. After 224.8 million agent-environment steps, we froze the teacher and trained fresh agents. DQN outscored GREMLIN on most games, both generated and human-designed. GREMLIN nevertheless outperformed the untrained teacher on all 26 games, showing that generated experience can improve a learning rule. It remains unclear whether this approach can yield a competitive rule with longer meta-training.

AI.tldr: 该文用DiscoRL规则发现框架检验"随机参数化神经环境"能否为强化学习算法提供有效训练经验，将16个人工设计训练游戏替换为神经环境进行元训练。
AI.motivation: 探讨元训练经验的来源是否可以脱离人工设计游戏：随机参数化的神经环境能否为学习规则的发现提供有用的经验信号。
AI.method: 基于DiscoRL规则发现框架，用16个选定神经环境替代人工设计训练游戏；每个游戏由有界向量动力学、基于随机策略的奖励和独立的结果奖励构成。在2.248亿智能体—环境交互步后冻结"教师"（生成的规则），再训练全新智能体评估。
AI.result: 在多数游戏（含生成环境与人工设计环境）上DQN得分高于GREMLIN；但GREMLIN在全部26个游戏上均优于未训练的教师，说明生成的经验可改进学习规则。
AI.conclusion: 随机神经环境生成的经历能够改善学习规则，但能否通过更长元训练得到有竞争力的规则尚不明确，需进一步研究。

title: GUI-WEdit and GUI-SkillEvo: Gradient-Free Adaptation of Small GUI Agents
summary: Small graphical user interface (GUI) agents can execute desktop workflows, but repeated local errors and fragile procedural decisions limit their reliability. We present GUI-WEdit-4B and GUI-SkillEvo-2B, two gradient-free adaptations of GUI-Owl-1.5 backbones. For the 4B model, we use trajectory feedback to construct guarded, closed-form updates to a late multilayer perceptron (MLP), retaining successful states as protection constraints. The final checkpoint changes 23,739,095 parameter values, or 0.535\% of the 4,437,815,808-parameter backbone, within one weight tensor. For the 2B model, an assistant iteratively proposes and refines procedural skills while the model weights remain fixed. On the 361-task OSWorld subset excluding Google Drive tasks, the frozen systems obtain final aggregate scores of 48.02\% and 45.47\%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出GUI-WEdit-4B与GUI-SkillEvo-2B两种无梯度适配方案，分别通过受限闭式MLP权重更新与迭代式程序性技能演化提升小型GUI智能体可靠性。
AI.motivation: 小型GUI智能体可执行桌面工作流，但重复出现的局部错误与脆弱的程序化决策限制了其可靠性。
AI.method: 以GUI-Owl-1.5为骨干，采用两种无梯度适配：(1) 4B模型利用轨迹反馈对靠后的多层感知机构造带保护的闭式更新，将成功状态作为保护约束，最终仅在一个权重张量内改变23,739,095个参数值，占44.4亿参数骨干的0.535%；(2) 2B模型保持权重冻结，由助手迭代提出并精化程序性技能。
AI.result: 在排除Google Drive任务的361项OSWorld子集上，两种冻结系统分别取得48.02%与45.47%的最终综合得分。
AI.conclusion: 极少量参数或纯技能层面的无梯度适配即可在GUI智能体基准上取得有竞争力的表现，为提升小模型智能体可靠性提供了低成本路径。

title: Reinforcement Learning Can Be Recovered From Its Own Rollouts
summary: Broadly speaking, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training converts compute into model capabilities by training on model-generated data. Typically, the rollouts are discarded after each update, and the knowledge acquired during RL resides in the model weights. In this work, we investigate how much of this knowledge is retained in the rollouts themselves. A natural first attempt is to replay the original RL algorithm on archived rather than freshly generated rollouts, but this leads to catastrophic collapse. We provide a simple explanation for this phenomenon, which in turn suggests a remedy: maximum likelihood on the archived rollouts. Surprisingly, starting from the same base model and replaying the rollouts in the order in which they were generated, without any distinction between correct and incorrect responses, is sufficient to recover the performance of online RL. In fact, a single maximum likelihood update per rollout batch closely tracks the entire learning curve of online RL. Furthermore, maximum likelihood on the rollouts of the last few RL steps often suffices to recover the final model's performance. This suggests that much of the compute invested in RL goes into discovering an improved sampling distribution rather than learning it from samples.

AI.tldr: 本文研究RL后训练阶段产生的rollout本身保留了多少知识，发现对归档rollout按生成顺序做极大似然（即离策略SFT）即可恢复在线RL的性能，说明RL的算力主要花在"发现更好的采样分布"而非"从样本中学习该分布"。
AI.motivation: 常规RL后训练中，rollout在每次更新后被丢弃，所学知识只存在于模型权重中。作者希望量化rollout本身携带了多少知识，并检验能否脱离在线生成过程重现RL效果。
AI.method: 先尝试用原始RL算法在归档rollout上重放，结果出现灾难性坍缩，作者给出简单解释；据此提出补救方案：对归档rollout直接做极大似然（SFT）。从同一基座模型出发，按rollout生成顺序回放，不区分正确/错误回答，每个rollout batch仅做一次极大似然更新。
AI.result: 按生成顺序的极大似然回放可完全恢复在线RL的性能，单个batch一次更新即可紧密跟踪在线RL的完整学习曲线；仅用最后几个RL步骤的rollout做极大似然往往就足以恢复最终模型性能。
AI.conclusion: RL后训练中大量算力用于发现改进的采样分布，而非从样本中学习该分布；rollout本身承载了RL获得的大部分知识，离线极大似然回放是可行且高效的替代路径。

title: Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding: Accelerating LLM Serving by Matching Draft and Target Distributions
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by employing a lightweight draft model to propose draft tokens and allowing the target model to verify the new tokens in parallel to improve inference-time compute utilization. The speedup relies on the acceptance probability of draft tokens in target verification, which is directly related to the gap $\|p-q\|_1$ between the target distribution $p$ and the draft distribution $q$. In this paper, we study draft calibration of speculative decoding to improve the speedup of speculative decoding, where we employ post-hoc methods to calibrate the draft distribution to mitigate the distribution gap. We observe that though current community open-source draft models may learn the top candidate token correctly, they are generally underconfident compared to the target model, suggesting a consistent distribution mismatch. To mitigate the effect of this mismatch on the acceptance rate of the draft models, we try various post-hoc calibration methods, including standard temperature scaling and token-wise calibration. Our results suggest that a standard temperature scaling applied to the draft distribution improves the acceptance length by up to approximately 10\% with almost no additional cost across different tasks. Throughput analysis further verifies that this improvement in serving efficiency. Analysis of more general calibration methods reveals further potential room for improvement.

AI.tldr: 投机的解码的加速比取决于草稿模型与目标模型的分布差距；作者发现开源草稿模型普遍"欠置信"，通过事后温度缩放校准草稿分布可显著提升接受长度。
AI.motivation: 投机解码的加速依赖草稿token在目标模型验证时的接受概率，而接受概率直接由目标分布p与草稿分布q的L1距离决定。现有社区开源草稿模型虽能正确预测top候选token，但相对目标模型普遍欠置信（underconfident），造成一致性的分布失配，从而限制了接受率和加速效果。
AI.method: 采用事后（post-hoc）校准手段弥合草稿分布与目标分布的差距：先诊断草稿模型的置信度偏差，再比较标准温度缩放（temperature scaling）与token级（token-wise）校准等多种校准方法，在多个任务上评估校准后草稿分布对接受长度的影响，并进行吞吐量分析。
AI.result: 标准温度缩放应用于草稿分布后，在不同任务上将接受长度提升约10%，且几乎不增加额外开销；吞吐量分析进一步验证了服务效率的提升。更一般的校准方法分析显示仍存在进一步改进空间。
AI.conclusion: 简单的温度缩放是一种低成本、即插即用的草稿分布校准方案，可有效缓解欠置信导致的分布失配并提升投机解码加速比；更精细的校准策略仍有潜力，值得后续研究。

title: Get the Next Moment Right: Short-Term Event Planning for Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: Video generation models synthesize realistic imagery yet still struggle to produce physically plausible evolution. Existing methods guide generation with a motion trajectory predicted for the entire clip in advance, so prediction errors accumulate and degrade later frames. We propose STEP(Short-Term Event Planning), a training-free closed-loop framework that guides generation one short clip at a time. Each round consists of four steps: grounding measures the scene state from the latest frames, event planning predicts the next physical event and renders it into a control clip, latent-guided generation produces the next short clip under this control, and verification checks whether the event occurs and resamples the clip if it does not. Because each round is grounded in the frames actually generated, control relies only on reliable short-range predictions. STEP improves the physical plausibility of three frozen generators on Physics-IQ Verified and PhyGenBench, and can be applied to new generators without training.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的闭环框架STEP，将物理事件规划拆分为多个短片段逐步引导视频生成，避免长时程预测误差累积，提升多个冻结生成器的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成方法依赖对整段视频一次性预测的运动轨迹来引导生成，预测误差会随时间累积，导致后续帧质量与物理合理性下降。
AI.method: STEP（Short-Term Event Planning）为免训练闭环框架，每次仅引导一个短片段，每轮含四步：1) grounding，从最新帧测量场景状态；2) event planning，预测下一个物理事件并渲染为控制片段；3) latent-guided generation，在该控制下生成下一短片段；4) verification，检验事件是否发生，未发生则重采样该片段。控制仅依赖可靠的短程预测，且每轮以实际生成的帧为基准。
AI.result: 在Physics-IQ Verified与PhyGenBench上，STEP提升了三个冻结生成器的物理合理性。
AI.conclusion: 通过短时程事件规划与闭环验证，STEP可在不训练的情况下提升视频生成物理合理性，并能直接迁移至新生成器。

title: A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient Edits Stop a Small Language Model's Thinking Loops and Complement a Frontier Model's Weight Edit
summary: Qwen3.5-0.8B rarely finishes reasoning in thinking mode: at a 4,096-token budget only 1 or 2 of 500 MATH-500 answers close their think block (two seeds), and accuracy is 15.4%. A recent demonstration had GPT-6 Astra edit 131,072 of the model's weights without gradients and reported MATH-500 rising from 7.9% to 48.1% at a 32,768-token budget. We provide the missing gradient baseline, then combine the two edits. Fine-tuning only the 140 to 139,750 weights with the largest gradient, on the model's own correct answers to MATH training problems, raises thinking-mode MATH-500 at 4k tokens to 39.0-45.5% after 2-9 minutes of training on one GPU; 50 training examples suffice, and 1,398 random positions give only 16.3%. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of each of the first three layers. Because the model has no bias terms, an edit confined to those channels acts as a constant vector added to the residual stream: adding three fixed vectors to the unedited model matches the accuracy of such an edit. Under the Astra protocol (32k tokens, presence penalty 1.5), the Astra edit scores 52.1% (finished and correct) in our reproduction and our full-strength edits reach 45.6-45.7%, but ours win at every budget up to 16k tokens (39.5% against 6.7% at 4k). The two edits are complementary. The Astra edit plus our 139,750-weight edit at half strength scores 62.2% at 32k, 10 points above the Astra edit alone (p = 3e-9), with half as many tokens; our half-strength edit alone scores 46.7%.

AI.tldr: 本文为 Qwen3.5-0.8B 提供缺失的梯度基线：仅微调梯度最大的少量权重即可大幅提升思维模式 MATH-500 准确率，并证明其机制等价于向残差流加入三个常数向量；该编辑与 Astra 无梯度编辑互补，组合后在 32k 预算下达到 62.2%。
AI.motivation: Qwen3.5-0.8B 在思维模式下几乎无法闭合 think 块（4,096 预算下 500 题仅 1–2 题完成，准确率 15.4%），而此前 GPT-6 Astra 的无梯度权重编辑报告了大幅提升却缺少梯度方法作对照基线。作者旨在补上这一缺失的梯度基线，并检验两种编辑能否叠加。
AI.method: 选取梯度最大的 140 至 139,750 个权重（在模型自身对 MATH 训练题的正确回答上微调），单 GPU 训练 2–9 分钟，50 个样本即可；对照实验包括 1,398 个随机位置（仅 16.3%）。机制分析显示梯度将编辑集中于前三层最接近常数的通道，由于模型无偏置项，该编辑等价于在残差流上叠加常数向量，故用三个固定向量加到未编辑模型即可复现。最后在 Astra 协议（32k tokens、presence penalty 1.5）下复现 Astra 编辑，并与半强度完整编辑组合评测。
AI.result: 4k 预算下思维模式 MATH-500 提升至 39.0–45.5%；随机位置仅 16.3%。Astra 协议下复现 Astra 编辑得 52.1%，全强度本文编辑为 45.6–45.7%，但在 ≤16k 各预算均胜出（4k：39.5% vs 6.7%）。Astra 编辑 + 半强度 139,750 权重编辑在 32k 达 62.2%，比单独 Astra 编辑高 10 点（p = 3e-9）且仅用一半 token；半强度编辑单独为 46.7%。
AI.conclusion: 梯度微调提供了 Astra 无梯度编辑所缺失的高效基线，且在小 token 预算下显著更优；两者机制互补，组合可进一步突破上限。该编辑的可解释机制为残差流上的常数向量偏移，为极低成本的推理能力修复提供了原理性解释。

title: Factorized Context Attention: From Emulated to Native Grid Probing
summary: Models read a book, an hour of video, or an image in one forward pass. As the context grows, this pass slows down, loses accuracy, and stops at the context window. Sparse attention is efficient, but keeps the other two limitations. Grid probing, a recent training-free method, recovers the accuracy and extends the reach by asking a frozen model the same question about short local and strided spans of the input, but every question repeats the whole computation, since each span is encoded again. Our insight is that grid probing is emulated attention, an attention pattern reproduced from outside the model through prompts, since each probe only restricts which part of the input the question can see. We introduce Factorized Context Attention (FCA), a training-free block-sparse attention that runs the same pattern natively, as the attention of the model itself. FCA encodes the input once into a KV cache, reads all spans as masked sequences in one batched forward, and uses a stair position schedule to keep every span inside the trained position range. Across long video understanding, long-context text inference and image grounding, FCA matches the accuracy and the reach of grid probing at a fraction of its cost. It gains about 10 points over the single pass on long video and 9 to 14 points on long novels, finds needles in videos of over a thousand frames and in texts four times the length of the window, and answers a later question about the same input in as little as a tenth of the time of grid probing. Native attention thus keeps what emulated attention gains without its cost, all with existing frozen language and vision-language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的分块稀疏注意力 Factorized Context Attention（FCA），把 grid probing 的"模拟注意力"原生实现为模型注意力，一次编码 KV cache 后批量读取所有局部/跨步 span，以远低于 grid probing 的成本达到同等精度与覆盖范围。
AI.motivation: 长上下文（整本书、一小时视频、图像）在单次前向中会变慢、精度下降并受限于上下文窗口；稀疏注意力虽高效但仍保留速度衰减与精度损失两个问题。近期免训练的 grid probing 可恢复精度并扩展覆盖，但对每个 span 都重复整段计算，代价极高。
AI.method: 核心洞见：grid probing 本质是"模拟注意力"——通过 prompt 从模型外部复现某种注意力模式，因为每次探测只是限制问题可见的输入范围。FCA 将该模式原生实现为模型自身的块稀疏注意力：输入只编码一次得到 KV cache；把所有 span 作为掩码序列在一次批量前向中读取；并用阶梯式位置调度（stair position schedule）保证每个 span 落在训练时的位置范围内。
AI.result: 在长视频理解、长上下文文本推理与图像 grounding 三类任务上，FCA 以极低代价达到与 grid probing 相当的精度与覆盖范围：长视频上比单次前向提升约 10 点，长篇小说上提升 9–14 点；能在超过一千帧的视频和长度为窗口四倍的文本中定位"针"；对同一输入回答后续问题的时间仅为 grid probing 的约十分之一。
AI.conclusion: 原生注意力可以保留模拟注意力带来的收益而无需承担其成本，且全部基于现有的冻结语言模型与视觉语言模型，无需训练。

title: DocPristine: Content-Aware Document Appearance Enhancement under Real-World Mixed Degradations
summary: Camera-captured documents often exhibit mixed degradations, such as highlights, shadows, and blur, that distort backgrounds and obscure text details. Document appearance enhancement (DAE) aims to mitigate these degradations and improve readability. Existing document appearance enhancement methods rely either on input-derived visual cues that can become unreliable under severe degradation or on LLM-based degradation diagnosis that lacks spatial guidance. Notably, we find that pretrained document visual encoders continue to attend to text regions in degraded documents, providing content-aware guidance. Based on this insight, we propose DocPristine, which adaptively fuses multi-layer features from a frozen document visual encoder and injects them into a pixel restoration network. To integrate these features into a pixel restoration network, DocPristine combines Adaptive Multi-Layer Feature Fusion (AMFF), Hierarchical Gated Conditioning (HGC), and Shifted-Window Cross-Attention (SWCA). Specifically, SWCA draws on structural cues from neighboring locations across window boundaries to recover fine text details.We also introduce DocACE, with a synthetic mixed-degradation training set (DocACE-Synthetic) and a real-world test set (DocACE-Real) containing manually restored ground-truth images and document parsing annotations. Comprehensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate that DocPristine achieves state-of-the-art appearance enhancement quality and consistently improves downstream document parsing. Code, models, and data will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 DocPristine，利用冻结的文档视觉编码器多层特征作为内容感知引导，注入像素复原网络，实现文档外观增强，并构建 DocACE 数据集。
AI.motivation: 相机拍摄文档存在高光、阴影、模糊等混合退化，扭曲背景并遮挡文字细节。现有方法或依赖退化下不可靠的输入视觉线索，或依赖缺乏空间引导的 LLM 退化诊断。
AI.method: 关键发现：预训练文档视觉编码器在退化文档中仍关注文本区域，可提供内容感知引导。据此自适应融合冻结编码器的多层特征并注入像素复原网络，由 AMFF（自适应多层特征融合）、HGC（分层门控条件化）与 SWCA（移位窗口交叉注意力，跨窗口边界借鉴邻域结构线索恢复细粒度文字）协同构成。同时构建 DocACE：合成混合退化训练集 DocACE-Synthetic 与含人工复原 GT 和文档解析标注的真实测试集 DocACE-Real。
AI.result: 在三个基准上的综合实验表明，DocPristine 取得 SOTA 的外观增强质量，并稳定提升下游文档解析性能。
AI.conclusion: 借助文档视觉编码器的内容感知引导可有效应对混合退化外观增强，并有益于下游解析任务；代码、模型与数据将公开。

title: One Subspace Is Not Enough: LocalSubspaceAD for Training-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Defect-free industrial samples can vary considerably in appearance, texture, and geometry. In few-shot anomaly detection, this variability has to be modeled from only a handful of images. SubspaceAD showed that a single principal subspace of foundation-model patch features is a strong training-free model of nominal appearance. However, a single subspace has to cover all of the nominal data's variability, so a deviation that is anomalous for one semantic region can be within the nominal variability of another. We propose LocalSubspaceAD, which extends SubspaceAD from a single subspace to a mixture of subspaces, assigning each group of patches with similar features its own subspace. The set of patch-features is partitioned using k-means, one subspace is fit per cluster, and each patch is scored by the minimum of re-projection residuals over all subspaces. The proposed method requires no training and no EM refinement. On MVTec AD, VisA and Real-IAD with 1, 2 and 4 shots, it improves over a single subspace (SubspaceAD) on both evaluated backbones: by 1.2 to 1.8 points image AUROC on DINOv2, and by 1.4 to 4.4 points in image AUROC, pixel AUPR and AUPRO on DINOv3. The gains are most pronounced on objects with heterogeneous nominal appearance, such as multi-instance categories and PCBs. Ablations show that the gains stem from a finer-grained model of variability through locally oriented subspaces, rather than from the subspace offsets (cluster means). We further show that the gains do not stem from added capacity alone: the local subspaces appear to capture the structure of coherent clusters in feature space, and the model does not merely act as a compressed memory bank.

AI.tldr: 提出 LocalSubspaceAD，将 SubspaceAD 的单一主子空间扩展为由 k-means 划分得到的局部子空间混合，无需训练即显著提升少样本工业异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 工业无缺陷样本在外观、纹理、几何上差异很大，少样本条件下更需从少量图像建模这种变异性。SubspaceAD 用基础模型 patch 特征的单一主子空间即可实现免训练的正常外观建模，但单一子空间必须同时覆盖全部正常变异，导致"对某一语义区域为异常"的偏差可能落在另一区域的正常变异范围内，从而漏检。
AI.method: 用 k-means 对 patch 特征集合进行聚类划分，为每个簇拟合一个子空间，形成子空间混合；每个 patch 的异常分数取其在所有子空间中重投影残差的最小值。方法无需训练，也无需 EM 迭代精修。
AI.result: 在 MVTec AD、VisA、Real-IAD 上以 1/2/4 shots 评测，两种骨干均优于 SubspaceAD：DINOv2 上图像 AUROC 提升 1.2–1.8 点；DINOv3 上图像 AUROC、像素 AUPR 与 AUPRO 提升 1.4–4.4 点。增益在多实例类别、PCB 等正常外观异质性强的对象上最明显。消融表明增益来自局部化子空间对变异性的更细粒度建模，而非子空间偏移（簇均值）；增益也不仅来自容量增加——局部子空间捕获了特征空间中连贯簇的结构，模型并非简单的压缩记忆库。
AI.conclusion: 局部化子空间混合是少样本免训练异常检测中更有效的正常性建模方式，通过细粒度刻画异质变异显著提升检测性能。

title: ThinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks
summary: People reason with pictures as well as words. Interleaved multimodal reasoning gives models a similar way to solve problems by creating intermediate images and using them to guide further reasoning. Training models with this ability usually relies on task-specific demonstrations, which are difficult to collect. We introduce ThinkMorph-SSL, a two-stage training recipe that uses images themselves as a source of supervision. The first stage, pretext reasoning, converts visual pretext tasks, such as image colorization and denoising, into instruction-free interleaved traces. Models describe a corrupted or transformed image, generate a restored or canonical image, and interpret the result. The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. The full recipe improves over the base model by an average of 11.33 accuracy points across twelve benchmarks. These results show that supervision derived from images can build the visual skills needed for interleaved reasoning and improve learning from task-specific demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出 ThinkMorph-SSL 两阶段训练方案，以图像本身作为监督来源，赋予模型"交错多模态推理"能力（生成中间图像辅助推理），在十二个基准上平均超越基座模型 11.33 个准确率点。
AI.motivation: 人类不仅用文字也用图像进行推理。让模型通过生成中间图像并据此引导后续推理，可模拟这种交错多模态推理过程；但现有训练方法依赖任务特定的演示数据，采集成本高、难以规模化。
AI.method: 两阶段自监督式训练配方：(1) 前置推理（pretext reasoning）阶段，将图像上色、去噪等视觉前置任务转换为无指令的交错轨迹，模型先描述被损坏或变换的图像，再生成复原或规范化图像，最后解释结果；(2) 第二阶段用自动构建的演示数据进行问题驱动的指令微调。
AI.result: 在相同指令微调预算下，加入前置推理训练的模型优于仅做指令微调的模型；完整配方在十二个基准上平均较基座模型提升 11.33 个准确率点。
AI.conclusion: 源自图像的监督信号能够构建交错推理所需的视觉技能，并提升模型从任务特定演示中的学习效率，为降低多模态交错推理训练的数据依赖提供了可行路径。

title: NRG-Twins: Pixel-Level Ground Truth for Rigidity Violations in Generated Videos
comment: 35 pages including supplementary material; 15 figures, 32 tables
summary: Video generators now produce realistic clips of scenes and objects, which makes generated video an attractive source of 3D content. Yet generated video is not 3D consistent: static content slowly deforms or slides, 3D reconstruction degrades, and the errors are too subtle to label by hand. To make generators 3D consistent, or to build rewards and guidance that push them there, we need data that say where and by how much a generated video breaks rigidity, and these data must come from generated video itself.
